title: Sosiaalityöntekijä, Asiakasohjaus Soihtu, Ankkuritoiminta, Uusikaupunki
description:
Haemme sosiaalityöntekijää Asiakasohjaus Soihdun Uudenkaupungin toimipisteeseen lapsiperheiden kanssa tehtävään asiakastyöhön sekä poliisiasemalla toteutettavaan moniammatilliseen Ankkuritoimintaan.

Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet lapsiperheiden palveluissa Uudenkaupungin, Laitilan, Vehmaan, Taivassalon, Pyhärannan ja Kustavin alueella. Soihtu-tiimit vastaavat sosiaalihuoltolain mukaisesta ohjauksesta, neuvonnasta ja palvelutarpeen arvioinnista. Tiimit palvelevat lapsiperheitä sekä alle 65-vuotiaita aikuisia.

Sosiaalityöntekijänä vastaat lastensuojeluilmoitusten sekä sosiaalihuoltolain mukaisten yhteydenottojen kiireellisyysarvioinnista ja käsittelystä. Teet palvelutarpeen arviointeja työparina sosiaaliohjaajan kanssa ja toimit osana monialaista sosiaalihuollon ja terveydenhuollon ammattilaisista koostuvaa tiimiä.

Moniammatillisen Ankkuritoiminnan tavoitteena on edistää nuorten hyvinvointia ja ehkäistä rikollisuutta. Työssä käsittelet sosiaalihuolto- ja lastensuojelulain mukaisia ilmoituksia sekä toteutat palvelutarpeen arviointeja yhdessä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Asiakastyön lisäksi osallistut arviointisosiaalityön vaikuttavuuden, toimintatapojen ja laadun arviointiin, rakenteelliseen sosiaalityöhön sekä yhteistyökumppaneiden konsultointiin ja neuvontaan.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan lasten, nuorten ja perheiden hyvinvointiin sekä tekemään vaikuttavaa arviointityötä osana moniammatillista verkostoa.

Tukenasi ovat esihenkilösi, oma tiimisi sekä Soihtujen sisäiset konsultaatio- ja kehittämistiimit. Työn tueksi saat säännöllisen työnohjauksen. Käytössä on myös tiimin yhteinen auto esimerkiksi kotikäyntejä varten.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden etätyöhön sovitusti sekä joustavan työajan liukuvan työajan puitteissa, jotta voit suunnitella työpäiväsi tarkoituksenmukaisesti.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Etsimme sosiaalityöntekijää, jolla on asiakaslähtöinen, reflektoiva ja arvioiva työote sekä hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Eduksi luemme työkokemuksen arviointityöskentelystä lapsiperheissä ja/tai Ankkuritoiminnassa.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja tyydyttävä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 817/2015 7 §:n mukainen sosiaalityöntekijän pätevyys.

Hae mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa sosiaalityötä lapsiperheiden, nuorten ja heidän verkostojensa parhaaksi sekä kehittämään arviointisosiaalityötä osana moniammatillista yhteistyötä.

title: Research Analyst - C12 - SHANGHAI
description:
The Research Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsibilities include: building financial models, writing research reports, conducting macroeconomic analysis on the global energy industry, communicating our team's ideas to institutional investors, conducting due diligence and working with Citi's product team to identify trends in the space.
  • Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within equity research
  • Conduct analysis
  • Make Investment Recommendations
  • Interact with Institutional Clients
  • Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes
  • Attend industry conferences and speak to industry contacts
  • Track company events and earnings
  • Develop financial models and valuation techniques
  • Establish yourself as an expert
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years previous experience
  • Distill research into an investable thesis and write report/note Market ideas to internal constituents and clients via phone calls and client marketing trips Help facilitate direct corporate access for investors Provide independent (regulatory controlled)
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Lead Engineer, Hardware Design
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as a market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

As a Hardware Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in defining, developing, and validating hardware solutions for next-generation hearing aid products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business and system needs into robust hardware requirements and innovative electronic solutions.

Working in an international R&D environment, you will be involved from concept development through implementation and verification, collaborating with experts across Hardware, Acoustics, Software, Mechanical Engineering, and Product Architecture teams.

What You Will Do

  • Define and develop hardware requirements from system level down to product level.

  • Design and specify electronic circuits and hardware solutions.

  • Translate stakeholder inputs into structured, traceable, and documented requirements.

  • Drive requirement discovery through workshops and cross-functional discussions.

  • Perform electronic circuit debugging and root cause analysis of complex technical issues.

  • Propose and implement robust technical solutions.

  • Conduct electronic design verification and validation activities.

  • Support hardware development projects from concept to implementation.

  • Prepare and maintain high-quality technical documentation.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Architecture, Acoustics, Mechanical Engineering, Software, and Product Management teams.

  • Contribute to future hardware concepts, technology platforms, and portfolio planning.

  • Drive continuous improvement and process optimization initiatives.

What you bring

Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

title: Financial Planning Graduate
description:
Are you a graduate with ambitions to become a Chartered Financial Planner?

Our Graduate Programme is designed to fast-track your development by giving you hands-on experience across key areas of the financial planning journey.

This 3-year rotational scheme provides a unique opportunity to build the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to succeed in a client-facing advisory role or discover alternative pathways within our growing and award-winning firm.

Programme Overview

This is not your typical graduate scheme. From day one, you’ll be working in real roles with real responsibility, supported by experienced mentors and a peer network of current and past graduates. Across three years you will work in rotations, you’ll gain exposure to the full advice process, from initial client contact through to technical planning and adviser support, giving you a comprehensive understanding of how we build lasting relationship with our clients and help them to achieve their goals through financial planning and wealth management. at the highest level.

Initial rotations
You’ll rotate through several areas of the business, gaining broad exposure and building a strong foundation across different teams. Each rotation is designed to enhance your technical understanding, develop your professional skills, and give you hands-on experience of how we deliver exceptional outcomes for clients. You’ll be supported throughout, with clear objectives in each placement and the chance to explore where your strengths and interests lie.

Paraplanning
Build your technical knowledge in a more analytical and research-driven role. You’ll work closely with paraplanners and advisers to produce financial planning reports and help construct tailored client recommendations. This stage is key to deepening your understanding of financial products, tax planning and compliance requirements.

Advice Team
Shadow and support a Financial Planner, working on real client cases and contributing to the delivery of financial plans and investment management. This rotation offers insight into the advisory role and gives you the opportunity to start developing the interpersonal and commercial skills needed to advise clients with confidence.

*Please note, these rotations can be subject to change if there is a requirement elsewhere in the business and are in no particular order.

What You’ll Gain

  • A comprehensive understanding of the advice journey in a real-world setting
  • Support in completing the Level 4 Diploma in Regulated Financial Planning (CII)
  • Access to a structured development programme, including cohort training sessions
  • Mentoring from senior colleagues and buddy support from previous graduates
  • Exposure to different departments and career paths within the business
  • The chance to build a strong internal network and lasting professional relationships

Career Progression

Upon successful completion of the programme, you'll be considered for a Financial Planning Executive (FPE) role or another suitable opportunity within the business. From there, you can continue your journey through our internal Training Academy, work closely with our adviser team, and ultimately progress into a Financial Adviser role, with full support towards Chartered status or alternative routes depending on your strengths and interests.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong academic background (at least a 2:1 degree in any subject)
  • A genuine interest in a career in financial planning and wealth management
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organisational ability and attention to detail
  • A proactive and collaborative mindset
  • Willingness to travel between offices (Leeds and London) when needed

Benefits

  • Company discretionary bonus scheme;
  • Full time hours (35 per week) Monday to Friday 9.00am and 5.00pm – 1 hour for lunch;
  • 24 holidays (increasing to 26), plus 2 additional days paid Christmas shut down period;
  • Private Healthcare*;
  • Group Income Protection;
  • Life Assurance;
  • Eye Care Scheme;
  • Wellbeing programme;
  • Bike to Work Scheme;
  • Full support with professional qualifications;

*after qualifying period

title: Vuoro-operaattori, Kilpilahti
description:
Haemme Kilpilahden Ilmakaasu-, hiilidioksidi- ja vetytehtaallemme Vuoro-operaattoria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Vuoro-operaattorina vastaat laitostemme turvallisesta, tehokkaasta ja häiriöttömästä toiminnasta osana ammattitaitoista operaattoritiimiä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

  • tuotantolaitosten toiminnan valvonta ja ohjaus

  • säännölliset tarkastus- ja valvontakierrokset

  • tuotenäytteiden ottaminen ja analysointi

  • hälytysten käsittely sekä häiriö- ja hätätilanteiden hallinta

  • vikojen tunnistaminen ja vianmääritykseen osallistuminen

  • yhteistyö kunnossapidon, päivävuorotiimin ja etävalvomokeskusten kanssa.

Työ on jatkuvaa vuorotyötä 12 tunnin työvuoroissa.

Menestyt tehtävässä jos

  • sinulla on tekninen koulutus ja kokemusta prosessiteollisuudesta

  • olet analyyttinen ja palveluhenkinen

  • sinulla on hyvät viestintä-, suunnittelu- ja organisointitaidot

  • puhut sujuvasti suomea ja englantia

  • sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti

Miksi viihtyisit meillä

Lindellä pääset osaksi kansainvälistä ja vakavaraista yritystä, jossa turvallisuus, osaaminen ja jatkuva kehittäminen ovat toimintamme perusta. Työskentelet osaavien kollegoiden kanssa ympäristössä, jossa yhteistyötä arvostetaan ja uuden oppimiseen kannustetaan.

Arvomme, turvallisuus, rehellisyys, vastuullisuus, osallisuus ja yhteisöllisyys, näkyvät jokapäiväisessä työssämme. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä, vaikuttaa toimintaan ja kehittyä ammatillisesti.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

  • kattavan perehdytyksen ja osaavan tiimin tuen

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa kansainvälisessä yrityksessä

  • kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen ja henkilöstöedut, kuten lisäeläkejärjestelyn sekä vakuutuspaketin.

Edistämme aktiivisesti tasa-arvoa, yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta. Toivotamme tervetulleiksi hakijat erilaisista taustoista ja eri uravaiheista.

Hienoa jos kiinnostuit!

Lähetä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 30.9.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että rekrytointijärjestelmämme on englanninkielinen, mutta voit lähettää hakemuksesi myös suomeksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Plant Manager Jan Ewalds, puh. +358 44 284 6533 (arkisin toimistoaikana).

title: Product Design (UX) - Summer 2027 Corporate Internship
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.


DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

As a Product Design Intern, you will look to discover, understand, and communicate user research and design practices to create intuitive, easy-to-use products. Interns will work in a fast paced, lean environment, collaborating closely with other interns, as well as full-time Product designers, product managers, and software engineers.

We are looking for people with hybrid talents who can inspire design-thinking ideas that set the standard for user-centered innovation in the retail industry.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with Product designers to develop your skills to formulate strategic design decisions during all phases of the product development life cycle

  • Effectively balance applying creative ideation to business challenges to build intuitive, easy-to-use products

  • Conduct research discovery through primary and secondary methods – including, but not limited to user ecosystem mapping, interviews, journey mapping, surveys, usability testing, competitive analysis, and more

  • Analyze research data and articulate findings through effective storytelling amongst your technology and business partners

Some of your experiences will include:

  • Multi-day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your fellow interns

  • Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as developing your business acumen and office professionalism

  • Extensive exposure to our senior leadership team through our exclusive intern-only Executive Speaker Series, which includes opportunities to interact with our CTO (Vlad Rak) & CEO (Lauren Hobart)

  • Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events

  • Fully furnished summer housing is provided for interns who reside outside of the Metro Pittsburgh area (or stipend for local interns)

  • Working 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday

Skills we are looking for:

  • Passionate about user-centered research and design and promoting empathy and understanding when creating product experiences

  • Strong curiosity when it comes to using new tools, adopting new technology, and learning new Product/UX methods that will progress your professional development

  • Dynamic written and verbal communication style, as well as the ability to communicate cross-functionally and vertically throughout the organization

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

We look for potential candidates with:

  • Attending an accredited university, college or technical school

  • A major in Design, Technology, or a related field

  • Anticipated graduation between December 2027 and May 2028

  • A digital portfolio that demonstrates user-centered research and design practices

  • There will be periods of time where you are asked to spend up to a week at our Corporate Office in Pittsburgh as part of the Summer Internship program. The majority of the summer and full-time roles within our Technology Department are eligible for remote work. Any travel and housing accommodations will be covered.

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027
Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:


Interns qualified for full-time opportunities will be evaluated at the end of the program. Qualified interns will be placed as Product Designers into a full-time technology development rotational program (Technology Development Program).

Perks:

  • Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*

  • Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG

  • Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.

  • Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th

  • Teammate Discount

  • Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office

  • Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks

  • Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders

  • Executive Speaker Series

  • Professional development

  • Volunteer opportunities

  • Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office.

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. I especially appreciated the collaborative environment and the opportunity to apply both creative and strategic thinking. This experience has strengthened my passion for the retail industry, and I would love the opportunity to come back and continue growing with the DSG team in the future." – Sarah Cyphers, Merchandising Intern

Interested to learn more? Watch our Internship Recap Video!

QUALIFICATIONS:

title: Risk Management Quantitative Associate Rotational Program
description:
Role Type:

Masters and Advanced Degrees

Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours:

37.5

Pay Details:

$95,000 - $95,000 CAD


TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Risk Management at TD Bank Group (TD) is the bridge between computational analysis and business best practices. Quantitative assessments play a key function within TD; these are actively used for developing, validating and managing models for risk, pricing, hedging and capital evaluation of the various portfolios and financial products of TD. In other words, it's all about the numbers.

Our enterprise has seen strong growth in its quantitative departments over recent years, reflecting improvements to computational ability, data quality and volume, along with the banking industry’s increasing attention to understanding and managing model risk. Our department is a global function that partners with all lines of businesses within TD, touching over 1,800 employees in offices across the globe: Canada, United States, the UK and Singapore. We also work externally with regulators and industry groups to align with industry standards, and we benchmark ourselves against best practices.


JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Program

Through executive mentorship, the Risk Management Quantitative Associate Rotational Program is an immersive 24-month program designed to provide qualified and ambitious candidates the opportunity to step into our world. You’ll receive comprehensive experience developing, validating, implementing and managing quantitative models throughout the enterprise. The goal of the program is to develop candidates with the necessary experience and tools to become effective leaders within Risk Management.

If you have a sharp mathematical mind with an eye for finance, we want you to be part of our leadership rotational program.

In this program you’ll rotate across various quantitative departments within Risk Management areas every six months:

  • Model Development

  • Model Validation

  • Treasury and Balance Sheet Management

  • TD Insurance

  • TD Asset Management

  • TD Economics

  • Internal Audit

We align rotation opportunities with our business strategies to ensure you work on the most important priorities.

What You'll Do

No matter where you work at TD, you’ll make a meaningful impact, grow your skills and thrive in our culture of care. Here’s what that means for each rotation in this program:

Make an Impact

  • Build mathematical and statistical models for the North American profile of TD, both US and Canada. These models include credit risk (e.g., Probability of Default, Exposure at Default and Loss Given Default), operational risk and market risk models used for risk management, accounting, economic/regulatory capital and stress testing purposes

  • Assist in the development and testing of new modelling methodologies and effectively challenge these models through benchmark modelling, model validation and/or review within Internal Audit’s model risk division

  • Prepare management summaries describing the mathematical analytics of models, validation techniques, test results and model limitations, including recommendations for further improvements

  • Help to manage the areas of risk and solvency assessment (ORSA), expected credit losses, asset and liability management along with liquidity

  • Participate in quantitative and qualitative validation efforts surrounding key processes including Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP), stress testing (DFAST / EWST / MST) and regulatory capital

Experience Growth

  • Liaise with other business partners to ensure timely delivery of new models and resolve modelling issues

  • Demonstrate governance, control and risk management in alignment with TD policies and practices

  • Work on challenging projects alongside experienced leaders in the field

Cultivate Our Culture of Care

  • Develop strong relationships to help identify collaborative opportunities and coordinate efforts with other Risk groups

  • Be supported by a robust team of colleagues, peers and advisors to ensure your growth, development and success


COLLEAGUE DEVELOPMENT

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. Receive regular career, development and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. Whether you have a passion for helping customers and want to expand your experience, or you want to coach and inspire your colleagues, there are many different career paths within our organization at TD – and we’re committed to helping you identify opportunities that support your goals.


JOB REQUIREMENTS

What You Need to Succeed

We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Strong quantitative background with advanced mathematical and/or statistical ability

  • Excellent problem-solving skills

  • Computational and programming skills (e.g., R, Python, SAS, Matlab, C++, C, among others)

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; can explain complex technical issues in everyday language

  • Strong time management skills with the ability to work independently when required

  • Fast learner who grasps new concepts and techniques quickly

  • Desire to work in a caring, respectful and inclusive environment where all employees are supported

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Educational Requirements; Must be graduated between May 2025 and May 2027 with a Master’s or PhD in a quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, physics, engineering, or similar).

Program Location and Start Date: Toronto-based program which starts in July 2027. Candidates must have graduated prior to start (including final grades, excluding convocation).

Applications Must Include:

  • Transcripts

  • Cover letter, including an explanation of how the Associate Program fits within your career aspirations (one letter-sized page or less)

  • Resume (maximum of 2 pages)

Hours & Workplace Model: Monday–Friday, standard business hours

INCLUSIVENESS

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. We thank all applicants for their interest!

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Java/Kotlin + Javascript)


Who is Parser?

Technology alone does not create impact- the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East.

We combine global reach with a mindset focused on agility, senior expertise, and close collaboration. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions, and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.


Why Join Us?

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.


How will you impact?

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Full Stack Engineer to drive the development of scalable, user-centric solutions across our entire technology stack.


This role focuses on building robust backend services alongside modern frontend experiences that power the travel ecosystem. You'll work on systems that directly impact customer experience and business outcomes, taking ownership from API design through user interface implementation.


Your key responsibilities:


Backend Development:

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend services using JVM languages (Java, Kotlin) that power distributed systems
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration patterns for microservices architecture
  • Optimize database performance (SQL, NoSQL) and design efficient data access patterns
  • Build event-driven and asynchronous systems that handle complex workflows


Frontend Development:

  • Develop responsive, user-centric frontend applications using modern web technologies
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to translate requirements into elegant, performant UI solutions
  • Implement client-side logic for data visualization, state management, and real-time interactions
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and accessibility standards


Cross-Functional:

  • Lead small, well-defined projects across the full stack, taking end-to-end ownership
  • Collaborate with team members to co-develop solutions and resolve problems
  • Apply software design principles, data structures, and design patterns to write clean, maintainable, modular code
  • Understand system and technology integration across distributed services
  • Help coordinate stakeholder input when developing solutions
  • Proactively identify inefficiencies and opportunities for technical improvement
  • Test, monitor, and debug applications effectively across layers


What you'll bring to the role:

  • +4 years of software development experience in team environments of at least five engineers (agile, version control, etc.)
  • Proven expertise with JVM languages (Java/Kotlin) in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, reactive frameworks)

  • Experience building and maintaining distributed systems in public or hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Solid understanding of data storage (SQL, NoSQL), API design, and microservices integration patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to test, monitor, and debug applications across the full stack
  • Experience with testing and monitoring tools
  • Ability to grasp how projects fit within team objectives and business needs
  • Comfortable working with moderately to highly complex systems
  • Experience with event-driven architectures
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)


Location:

  • Candidates based in Madrid, Spain: Hybrid model, 3 days per week in the office in Chamartin


You will receive:

  • The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A highly competitive compensation package.
  • A flexible and hybrid working environment.

title: Piha-, koti ja mökkitalkkari lisätulona - Helppo yrittäjämalli ilman kiinteitä kuluja
description:
Haluatko ansaita joustavasti ja tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Tarjoamme sinulle helpon yrittäjämallin, jossa voit toimia omassa kunnassasi tai lähialueellasi täysin oman elämäntilanteesi mukaan. Haemme yrittäjää Lohjalle.

  • Ei aloituskustannuksia

  • Ei kiinteitä kuluja

  • Ei sitoutumista

  • Päätät itse työmäärän, hinnat ja aikataulut

Voit aloittaa kevyesti ja halutessasi laajentaa yrittäjyyttä - samalla auttaen perheitä ja senioreita arjessa.

Sopii sinulle, jos haluat:

  • lisätuloja työn, eläkkeen tai opiskelun rinnalle juuri sen verran kuin sinulle sopii

  • kasvattaa omaa asiakaskuntaa vähitellen ja päättää itse, paljonko teet töitä

  • aloittaa yrittäjyyden kevyesti ja ilman isoja alkuinvestointeja

  • täydentää nykyistä yritystoimintaa joustavalla lisäansaintamallilla

  • tehdä merkityksellistä työtä auttamalla senioreita ja perheitä omalla alueella

Mitä palveluita voit tarjota?

Voit tarjota asiakkaille laajastitalkkaripalveluita ja pihatöitä, kuten esimerkiksi:

  • pihanhoitoa ja lumitöitä

  • kiinnitys- ja asennusapua

  • huonekalujen kasausta ja pieniä korjaustöitä

  • kiinteistöhuoltoon liittyviä tehtäviä

  • terassin, pihakalusteiden ja rännien huoltoa

  • pieniä pintaremontteja (maalaus, tapetointi yms.)

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Valmiin ja helpon yrittäjämallin ilman kiinteitä kuluja

  • Sähköiset työkalut: ajanvaraus, verkkokauppa, automatisoitu maksuliikenne

  • Markkinoinnin tuki ja näkyvyys omalla alueellasi et jää yksin

  • Selkeät ohjeet ja jatkuva tuki aloittamiseen ja toiminnan pyörittämiseen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • halua auttaa asiakkaita, erityisesti senioreita ja perheitä

  • oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullista työotetta

  • sujuvaa suomen kieltä

  • kunnossa olevia luottotietoja

Aloittaminen on helppoa Aloitat silloin kun sinulle sopii täysin vapaasti ja ilman sitoutumista. Lähetä meille lyhyt viesti itsestäsi tai täytä hakemus. Voit tilata esitteemme, jos haluat ensin lisätietoa.

Tervetuloa mukaan auttamaan oman alueesi asiakkaita ja rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopiva yrittäjyys.

title: Demand Planning Specialist
description:
Hos NORMAL har vi ambitiøse planer for vækst – både nationalt og internationalt. Det stiller høje krav til vores organisation og ikke mindst til vores processer, varedata og forståelse af, hvordan varerne bevæger sig gennem forretningen.

Derfor søger vi nu en Demand Planning Specialist, som får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte vores indkøbskoordinatorer i deres daglige arbejde med RELEX (varebestillingssystem) og processerne omkring vores vareflow.

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af vores Goods Flow-team i Indkøb, som sørger for, at vores indkøbsafdeling har den bedst mulige system- og procesmæssige understøttelse af vareflowet. Teamet består af otte skarpe hjerner, og du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både teamet og resten af indkøbsorganisationen. Her får du en vigtig rolle som sparringspartner for bl.a. vores indkøbskoordinatorer.

Din hverdag kommer primært til at handle om RELEX og vareflow – og om at sikre, at vores kolleger har de bedste forudsætninger for at bruge systemet effektivt.

Du kommer bl.a. til at:

  • blive superbruger på RELEX

  • være den primære go-to-kollega, når der er spørgsmål til processer og daglige rutiner i RELEX

  • udfordre status quo og definere nye processer, når det giver mening

  • analysere vareflowet og understøtte beslutningsgrundlaget for vores indkøbsteams

  • hjælpe med den systemmæssige onboarding af nye indkøbskoordinatorer

  • drive projekter omkring vareflow og varelagre, når du er kommet godt ind i rollen

Om dig

Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og har styr på detaljerne. Du er systematisk og trives med at arbejde med processer, systemer og data, hvor kvalitet og nøjagtighed er vigtigt.

Samtidig er du nysgerrig på, hvordan vi gør tingene, og har lyst til at gøre dem lidt bedre. Du tør stille spørgsmål ved eksisterende arbejdsgange, komme med idéer og udfordre, når noget ikke fungerer eller ikke bliver fulgt som aftalt.

Du trives også med en stor kontaktflade og har det godt med at være den, kollegerne går til, når de har brug for hjælp eller sparring.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • har minimum 3–5 års erfaring fra en rolle som demand planner, supply chain planner eller lignende roller med fokus på vareflow

  • har erfaring med F&R (Forecasting & Replenishment) systemer

  • har teknisk forståelse og erfaring med at analysere vareflow

  • taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk.

Hvem er vi?

Kulturen i NORMAL er uhøjtidelig, og vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde med det fælles mål at opnå succes og resultater – samtidig med at vi har det rigtig sjovt og til tider løber stærkt. Vi tror på OS mere end MIG, så derfor hjælper vi også hinanden, når der er travlt. Medarbejderne har stor grad af fleksibilitet og medindflydelse, da vi ønsker at skabe en arbejdsplads baseret på tillid og ansvar til den enkelte.

Vi tilbyder løbende sjove og spændende sociale aktiviteter, og derudover har vi en af Danmarks bedste kantiner, hvor vi hver dag kommer hinanden ved på tværs af afdelinger.

Vil du være en del af holdet?

Hvis du er interesseret i stillingen, bedes du sende os et motiveret CV og en ansøgning med et par ord om dig selv, og hvorfor du vil passe til netop denne stilling.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Steffen Thomsen,
Head of Goods Flow på +45 40 90 01 10.

OBS - Vi anbefaler, at du bekræfter SMS-kommunikation, så vi nemt kan komme i kontakt med dig i rekrutteringsprocessen.

title: Medior Mendix Developer
description:
In een team vol Mendix Experts kan jij jouw enthousiasme voor low-code helemaal kwijt. Als Medior Mendix Developer werk je aan creatieve en uitdagende projecten, zowel in Nederland als internationaal.

Bij Blue Green Solutions laten we al het management geneuzel links liggen. Iedereen is in de lead voor zijn eigen project en persoonlijke groei, en pakt zijn of haar verantwoordelijkheid. Zo heb je alle focus voor wat je echt leuk vindt: mooie oplossingen maken samen met je klant.

Jouw rol

Als Medior ben je naast low-code developer ook actief als business engineer, waar nodig met begeleiding van onze Seniors. Binnen een team van Mendix experts bouw jij aan nieuwe business applicaties.

Van een webapplicatie die processen automatiseert voor een grote Europese Bankinstelling, een Mendix App Factory opzetten bij een team van low-code rookies tot aan het ontwikkelen van een mobile native app die nieuwkomers verbindt met Nederlanders. Bij Blue Green kan het allemaal.

Samenwerken is bij ons de norm, of dat nu op kantoor in Amsterdam, thuis, of bij de klant is. We vinden het belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te zien, voor de lunch of een borrel, om van elkaar te leren of gewoon even bij te praten.

We hebben meerdere ervaren Mendix Experts in ons team. Mensen met wie je kunt sparren, die jou ondersteunen en omgekeerd. Kennis, ervaring en usecases delen we tijdens onze tweewekelijkse Mendix Mingles.

Wie we zoeken

  • Jij bent Mendix Advanced Certified. Verder ben je Scrum PSM-1 gecertificeerd of ben je bekend met agile werken.
  • Als ervaren low-code developer bouw jij zelfstandig applicaties op from scratch en kan je bestaande apps optimaliseren. Daarnaast vind je het leuk om meer ervaring op te doen als Mendix consultant. Denk aan kansen spotten bij je klanten, nadenken over hoe processen en systemen écht goed kunnen werken en mensen mee te nemen in jouw enthousiasme voor low-code.
  • Ervaring met UX / UI, Java of een andere expertise die waarde toevoegt aan ons team is mooi meegenomen!
  • Als organisatie zonder managers en bazen, verwachten we dat je zelf verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie haalt uit kansen spotten en gelijk doorpakken. Of het nu voor je eigen ontwikkeling, de klant of de organisatie is.
  • Verder spreek en schrijf je goed Nederlands en Engels en woon je in Nederland.
  • Bij voorkeur bezit ook over een Rijbewijs B.

Wat we bieden

Bij Blue Green houden we van transparantie, dus je krijgt gelijk alle arbeidsvoorwaardes op een rijtje:

  • Tussen €50k en €80k bruto per jaar, bij een fulltime dienstverband (40u)
  • Maandelijkse project-bonus, die kan oplopen tot 25% van je bruto maandsalaris.
  • Om je werk goed te kunnen doen, krijg je maandelijks een vergoeding voor
    • €25 voor je telefoonkosten
    • €40 voor snel internet thuis
    • €850 voor je reiskosten (fiets, openbaar vervoer, auto of motor)
  • De mogelijkheid om aandelen in te kopen en zo mee te ondernemen
  • 8% van je maandsalaris als vakantiegeld
  • 30 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van fulltime.
  • Elke 4 jaar kun je maximaal 4 maanden onbetaald verlof nemen. Zo kun je de wereld verkennen zonder je carrière op pauze te zetten. Wel terugkomen!
  • Gezellige borrels, spelletjesavonden, bbq's, Mendix meetups en een eigen personeelsvereniging!

Bij Blue Green Solutions kan elke medewerker ook ondernemer zijn. Wij verwachten van onze Blue Greeners inzet en ambitie. Dan is het alleen maar logisch dat inzet en beloning goed in een lijn zijn met elkaar. Naast winstdeling, betekent dit ook dat je je 'overal tegenaan mag bemoeien', want het is ook een beetje jouw toko.

Hoe nu verder?

Enthousiast geworden? Mooi, we kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Naast de juiste skillset, zijn we vooral op zoek naar iemand die goed binnen ons team past. Daarom heb je meerdere gesprekken met meerdere personen. Dit kun je verwachten:

Stap 1: Belletje: We bellen je snel op nadat je jouw sollicitatie hebt ingediend om kort kennis te maken en een vervolgafspraak in te plannen.

Stap 2: Meet & Greet: We nodigen je uit op ons kantoor in Amsterdam voor een gesprek met meerdere collega's. We leren je graag kennen en zijn benieuwd naar je technische skills en ambities. Natuurlijk kan jij ook al jouw vragen bij ons kwijt.

Stap 3: Voorstel: Zien we een match? Dan doen we dezelfde week van de Meet en Greet een voorstel. Deze nemen we graag samen met je door bij ons op kantoor.

Stap 4: Onboarding: Getekend? Leuk, welcome to the team! Jouw persoonlijke buddy zal je de eerste maand begeleiden, je zelf uitgekozen gear staat klaar op je eerste werkdag, en een eerste project om op los te gaan wordt voor je voorbereid, smooth sailing vanaf hier!

Over Blue Green Solutions

Blue Green Solutions is dé Nr 1 Low-code Expert Partner. Met een team enthousiaste llow-code fans werken we vanuit ons gezellige kantoor in Amsterdam uitsluitend aan Mendix projecten.

Vinden we leuk

  • Een mensgerichte aanpak
  • Samen delen in de organisatie, zowel in winst als in zeggenschap
  • Aandacht voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling

Krijgen we jeuk van

  • Hiërarchische structuren
  • Eindeloos slepende projecten
  • Winst boven alles

&Work helpt je verder

Blue Green Solutions werkt samen met &Work. &Work begrijpt dat het belangrijk is om te werken op een plek waar je gewaardeerd wordt, waar je je verder kunt ontwikkelen en waar je de ruimte krijgt om te groeien. Door via &Work te solliciteren, krijg je direct toegang tot hun brede netwerk van werkgevers. &Work kan je helpen bij de introductie bij Blue Green Solutions, achtergrondinformatie verstrekken, je voorbereiden op gesprekken zodat je jezelf overtuigend kan presenteren en je bijstaan tijdens de onderhandelingen om je een mooie stap vooruit te laten zetten in je carrière.

Vacature-informatie

  • Dienstverband: Fulltime
  • Ervaringsniveau: Medior
  • Salaris: €3500 - €6000

Customer Advisor

Part Time - 15 hours per week

B&Q Eastwood

You’ll be happy to expand your skills by using new technology and learning new ways of working. You’re great at working in a team too, and flexible enough to work on a rota that includes weekends, evenings and bank holidays.

As part of a great team, you’ll be valued for who you are. We’re committed to making B&Q more diverse and representative of the communities we serve, where everyone can feel they belong and have equal opportunities. title: Pool & Beach Supervisor
description:
Job Location:

Banana Island Resort Doha By Anantara



Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.


Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.


Position Summary

The Pool & Beach Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the hotel’s swimming pool and beach facilities, ensuring exceptional guest service, high standards of cleanliness, and strict compliance with health and safety regulations. The position supervises pool and beach attendants, coordinates daily operations, monitors facilities and equipment, and ensures a safe and enjoyable experience for all guests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise the daily operations of the swimming pool and beach areas.
  • Lead, motivate, train, and monitor the performance of Pool & Beach Attendants and Lifeguards.
  • Ensure the pool and beach areas are clean, organized, safe, and well-presented at all times.
  • Conduct regular inspections of pool, beach, sun loungers, umbrellas, cabanas, showers, changing areas, and other facilities.
  • Ensure all pool and beach equipment is properly maintained, stored, and used safely.
  • Monitor pool water quality and ensure appropriate testing and recording are carried out according to hotel and regulatory standards.
  • Ensure lifeguard coverage and safety procedures are maintained at all times during operating hours.
  • Monitor guest activities around the pool and beach and intervene promptly when unsafe behavior is observed.
  • Ensure all safety, emergency, hygiene, and operating procedures are strictly followed.
  • Welcome guests, provide information about pool and beach facilities, and promote available services and activities.
  • Assist guests with sun loungers, towels, umbrellas, cabanas, and other pool/beach requirements.
  • Handle guest requests, concerns, and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Recreation, and other departments to maintain smooth operations.
  • Report maintenance issues, damaged equipment, safety hazards, or other concerns immediately to the appropriate department.
  • Ensure adequate supplies of towels, amenities, cleaning materials, and operational equipment.
  • Monitor and control departmental inventory and report shortages or damaged items.
  • Conduct daily team briefings and communicate important operational information to staff.
  • Prepare staff schedules and allocate duties according to operational requirements, where applicable.
  • Ensure proper opening and closing procedures are completed for the pool and beach areas.
  • Maintain accurate records of pool water testing, incidents, maintenance issues, lost and found items, and other departmental activities.
  • Ensure all incidents and accidents are reported immediately and documented according to hotel procedures.
  • Assist in emergency situations and coordinate with Security,

title: Lähihoitaja keikkatyöhön Ikipihlaja Matinkartanoon Lietoon
description:
🧡 Millainen on sinun unelmien työpaikkasi?

Meille Pihlajalinnassa se tarkoittaa paikkaa, jossa ihminen tulee ensin; paikkaa, johon on mukava tulla ja missä sinun tarpeitasi kuunnellaan. Me pihlajalinnalaiset tarjoamme ihmisen kokoista huolenpitoa kaikkialla Pihlajalinnassa. Toimintamme nojaa Pihlis-periaatteisiin: rakennan luottamusta, onnistun yhdessä ja pidän huolta. Olemme sitoutuneet edistämään työyhteisöissämme monimuotoisuutta, osallisuutta sekä yhdenvertaisuutta.

Työpaikkana olemme kokoamme pienemmän tuntuinen – ihmisen kokoinen.

✨ Lähihoitajana Matinkartanossa olet mukana luomassa asukkaiden näköistä arkea ikääntyneille mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille ympärivuorokautisessa palveluasumisen yksikössämme. Työ lähihoitajana on itsenäistä hoivatyötä, mutta saat vahvan tuen työllesi muilta kollegoilta. Huolehdit asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisesta hoidosta aamu-, ilta- tai yövuorossa. Työsuhteesi keikkalaisena on vuoden loppuun saakka ja aloittaa voit vaikka heti!

🧡 Sinä olet meille tärkeä

  • Huolehdimme terveydestäsi tarjoamalla kokonaisvaltaisen työterveyden, johon sisältyy myös Mielen Pihlajalinnan palvelut

  • Huolehdimme hyvinvoinnistasi tarjoamalla kattavan vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Pihlajalinnalaiset saavat myös henkilöstöetuna osallistua työnantajan tukemana lukuisiin liikuntatapahtumiin ja kuntoilla edullisempaan hintaan Forever-liikuntakeskuksissa (tarjolla myös etäliikuntamahdollisuuksia)

  • Työnantajana ja kollegoina lupaamme kuunnella ja auttaa sinua kehittymään työssäsi. Palkkauksessa ja työehdoissa noudatamme sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta sekä huomioimme työkokemuksesi ja osaamisesi yksilöllisesti

🦊 Olisitko sinä meidän uusi työkaveri?

Tässä tehtävässä edellytämme lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja toivomme sinulta kokemusta ikääntyvien hoitotyöstä ja/ tai mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä tai harjoitteluista. Sinulta voisi mahdollisesti löytyä myös kokemusta Hilkka-järjestelmän käytöstä. Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakas- ja potilastyössä edellytetään tartuntatautilain mukaista soveltuvuutta. Tehtävään valittavan on myös esitettävä rikosrekisteriote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Kiinnostuitko? Meillä pääset mukaan iloiseen ja sitoutuneeseen työyhteisöön! Haethan pian, sillä haastattelemme jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Jos sinulla heräsi kysymyksiä, lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Päivi Järvensivu paivi.jarvensivu@pihlajalinna.fi

Rekrytoinnista huolehtii hoitajarekrytointi@pihlajalinna.fi

title: Lead New Product Development Engineer
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Lead New Product Development Engineer.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97000 - $143000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

This high impact role is involved in the design and development of Arresters for Eaton’s Line Installation and Protective Equipment (LIPE) product line. In this role, creativity and innovation are focused on leading teams and developing new electro-mechanical product solutions for application on electrical power systems.

This role is a key contributor to cross functional project teams that push concepts through a formal project process. It is expected that you will have the ability to lead and execute small projects or serve as a core team member on large projects. This position works directly with a broad set of technologies including metal oxide varistors (MOVs), polymers, rubber moldings, castings, and metal fabrications. Assignments range in scope from high level system concepts to detailed sub-system development and analysis.
-Creatively and efficiently solve design challenges by understanding the elements within a design that are critical for success, while eliminating the non-value-added elements
-Ability to translate internal and external customer requirements into measurable performance criteria, as well as being able to identify and resolve poorly defined or missing requirements
-Develop sub-system functional and reliability test plans, and coordinate the execution of the tests using both internal and external lab resources
-Design for Cost/Design for Manufacture Analysis (DFM/DFA) on individual parts, subassemblies with the ability to propose alternate materials and methods of assembly and manufacture.
-Guide teams of development engineers on the business unit’s biggest projects
-Provide technical leadership across the business, even on unassigned projects and efforts
-Ideate, organize, and lead functional improvement efforts within the department and larger business
-Mentor engineers and technicians on best practices for all aspects of documentation and tolerance of design for manufacturing, allowing for both personal and organizational development
-Leads problem solving techniques to resolve root cause analysis. This includes problems related to customer concerns.
-Ability to travel up to 25% for customer visits, supplier visits and test lab facilities.

Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:
-Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution.
-Minimum of five (5) years of experience in new product design of medium or high voltage electrical products.
-Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:
-Bachelor’s degree in electrical or ceramic engineering from an accredited institution.
-Eight (8)+ years of experience in new product design of medium or high voltage electrical products
-Knowledge in the application of medium voltage electrical distribution equipment
-Knowledge of metal oxide varistor technology (arresters)
-Familiarity with and practiced in IEEE C62.11 and IEC 60099-4 applicable arrester standards.
-Familiarity with C Sharp, VBNet, SQL Management Programming
-Experience with engineering-related projects would be beneficial
-Kinematic/Dynamic Analysis experience would be an advantage
-Knowledge of power test equipment and measurement instrumentation
-Six Sigma green belt or black belt trained is desired
-Experience in Engineering analysis, digital simulation, and 3D modeling (CAD, FEA, statistical analysis, software applications, electrical/mechanical analysis tools, etc.) is preferred
-Product design, DFM/DFA, and manufacturing knowledge is helpful

title: IT Support Technician Apprentice
description:
Beechwood Park School is an award-winning preparatory school for boys and girls aged 3 to 13, offering day and flexi-boarding in Hertfordshire.

About the role:

The IT Support Technician Apprentice is an important part of the IT team. The school is increasingly dependent on its IT systems working properly and efficiently. You will be responsible for system wide technical support including: workstations, laptops, printers, audio-visual, telecoms and printing. In co-operation with teachers you will support the teaching of IT by preparing relevant materials and working alongside pupils and teachers in the IT suites.

Responsibilities:

  • Handle frontline queries from various sources including email, helpdesk and telephone

  • Maintain communication with users, updating requests logged on the school’s ticketing system, and escalating them within the team as required

  • Install and maintain computer hardware, workstations, laptops, audio/visual equipment and peripherals

  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of IT equipment

  • Assist with the expansion of the school network infrastructure including switches, cabling and wireless network equipment

  • Routine administration including iPad maintenance, data backups, workstation health checks, anti-virus scans

  • Software installation, maintenance and upgrading

  • Support staff and pupils with the set-up and preparation of IT equipment around the school

  • Provide high quality customer focused technical support and training to non-teaching and teaching staff and to pupils

  • Assist with the set-up of AV equipment for lectures and presentations

Essential skills:

  • Good IT skills, hardware knowledge and familiarity with the full range of Microsoft products (including Office 365), Google Workspace and operating systems

  • Awareness of cyber security requirements

  • Health and safety awareness

  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team

  • Ability to take initiative

  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Excellent organisational skills

  • Ability to prioritise under pressure

  • The willingness to contribute to the lives of the pupils, parents and staff at the school

  • Well-motivated and reliable

The following experience would be beneficial:

  • Experience working in the education sector

  • Experience of working with iSAMS

  • Knowledge of non-windows environments (Apple and Linux)

  • Experience of learning platforms

  • Experience of managing social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook, etc.)

  • Internet and e-mail management

  • Experience of using and preparing audio/visual equipment

  • Experience of installing and maintaining PC hardware and software

  • Experience of supporting end users

  • Experience of troubleshooting network faults

Entry requirements:

  • 3 GCSEs (or equivalent) at grades 4+ (A-C) in any subject

  • GCSE Maths and English (or equivalents) at grades 3+ (D or above)

  • Prospective apprentices must not hold an existing qualification at the same or higher level as this apprenticeship is in a similar subject

You may also have a combination of qualifications and experience which demonstrate the minimum foundation needed for the programme. In this instance you could still be considered for the programme.

If you hold international equivalents of the above qualifications, at the time of your application you must be able to provide an official document that states how your international qualifications compare to the UK qualifications.

For more information please visit the UK ENIC website.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Benefits:

  • The post holder is eligible to be a member of the APTIS pension scheme, with an employer contribution of 6%

  • Lunch in the school dining room during term time, and staff room refreshments

  • Use of sports facilities including our indoor swimming pool

  • Staff discount on a selection of children’s holiday clubs

  • Free on-site parking

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

About QA:

Our apprenticeships are the perfect way to gain new skills, earn while you learn, and launch yourself into an exciting future. With over 50,000 successful apprenticeship graduates, we're a top 50 training provider, dedicated to helping you succeed.

Interested? Apply now!

title: DIN ERFARENHET GÖR SKILLNAD – BLI SERVICETEAMARE HOS HEMFRID I ÖRGRYTE
description:

Som serviceteamare är du en viktig del av vårt kvalitetsteam. Du arbetar nära Area Manager och Field Lead och bidrar till att våra kunder får en jämn och hög servicenivå.

Vi söker dig som är erfaren inom hemstädning och som vill ta ett större ansvar för kvalitet och service. Du är trygg i ditt arbete och har lätt för att anpassa dig till olika kunder och situationer.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Do you have experience in home cleaning and enjoy taking responsibility for delivering high-quality work? Would you like to develop further within service and cleaning and take on greater responsibility in your daily work? Then a Service Team Member role at Hemfrid could be the next step for you.

We are now looking for an engaged Service Team Member to join our team in Örgryte and the surrounding areas. You will have a varied working day and the opportunity to develop further within service and cleaning.

What do we offer?

  • A 75% position

  • Collective agreement and secure employment conditions

  • Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month

  • Mileage compensation when using your own car for work

  • Paid travel time between customers

  • Insurance (health, liability and occupational pension)

As a Service Team Member, you will be an important part of our quality team. You will work closely with the Area Manager and Field Lead and help ensure that our customers receive a consistently high level of service.

The role is varied and may include:

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with experience in home cleaning who wants to take greater responsibility for quality and service. You are confident in your work and able to adapt to different customers and situations.

We believe you are:

  • Detail-oriented and have an eye for detail

Apply today!

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and contact candidates who move forward in the recruitment process.

title: Personal Savings & Investing (PS&I) Product Management Intern/Co-op (WINTER 2027)
description:
Role Type:

Internship/Co-op

Work Term:

Winter/Term 2

Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours:

37.5

Pay Details:

$45,700 - $74,400 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Co-op and Internship opportunities allow you to gain valuable work experience across a number of the businesses at TD. You will work with experienced colleagues, receive world class training, and be part of a community of students across TD, where you will have an impact, grow as individual and experience our culture of care.

Our Co-op/Intern Programming is offered with select Co-op and Internship roles and is designed to help you better understand the TD business, build on critical career capabilities, and broaden your professional network. This program is designed to complement your on-the job experience and features:

  • Leadership talks with key Leaders from across the organization

  • Connect and Learns on topics such as Innovation

  • Diversity and Inclusion and Personal Branding and so much more

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

  • Canadian Personal Banking (CPB) provides a comprehensive suite of deposit, saving, payment and lending products and advice through a network of 1,062 branches, 3,438 automated teller machines (ATM), mobile specialized salesforce, and telephone, mobile and internet banking services. CPB is comprised of the following line of businesses:

  • Chief Operating Officer (COO) mandate is focused on building and executing innovative strategies for CPB partners that lead to new and deeper customer relationships, new revenue streams, improved colleague and customer experience, and greater productivity overall. The team is comprised of subject matter experts in diverse disciplines across strategy, finance, operations, risk management, regulatory governance, business architecture, change, communications, event planning, talent management, multi-media and more.

  • Real Estate Secured Lending (RESL) & Specialized Sales Force (SSF) help Canadians achieve their homeownership financial goals throughout the entire customer journey with Mortgages and TD Home Equity FlexLines. It also includes specialized credit advice, underwriting, and fulfillment of key processes for Personal Banking.

  • Canadian Card Payments, Loyalty & Personal Lending (CCPL&PL) is responsible for Credit Card and Personal Lending Banking Products that meet the unsecured borrowing needs of Canadians while enhancing TD's loyalty offerings and partnerships that improve the value propositions for our customers.

  • Everyday Savings & Investing (ES&I) is responsible for the day-to-day banking products (Chequing domestic and cross-border banking, Overdraft Protection, Savings, GICs and Mutual Fund products) that meet the everyday banking savings and investing needs of Canadians

  • Branch Banking Delivery Excellence (BBDE) is responsible for building customer and colleague confidence by supporting approximately 18,000 Branch Banking colleagues in TD's more than 1,100 branches across Canada.

  • Digital Transformation & Strategy focuses on driving CPB's digital strategy in partnership with our business leaders, journey owners and enterprise stakeholders, including Platforms and Technology and Transformation, Enablement and Customer Experience.

  • Small Business Banking focuses on supporting Canadian entrepreneurs with advice, products, services and distribution support across branch, digital, remote and specialist channels, helping customers start, manage and grow their businesses.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The co-op/intern will join Everyday Savings & Investing (ES&I) line of business and will support any of the following business groups:

Personal Savings & Investing (PS&I) - Product Management
The PS&I Product Team manages interest-bearing deposits for the Personal Bank, including Savings and GIC products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support day-to-day product management activities, including daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting, P&L analysis, and product reviews

  • Assist the Product team with month-end reporting and forecasting activities

  • Analyze product performance, market trends, competitive insights, pricing initiatives, and customer data to support business cases and recommend improvements to the customer and product experience

  • Support reviews and updates of product policies and procedures

  • Prepare executive updates, stakeholder presentations, meeting materials, and product documentation with strong attention to accuracy and detail

Skills / Experience

  • Self-starter who is proactive, independent, detail-oriented, and committed to high standards of quality, accuracy, and ownership

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with comfort working with large data sets and complex information

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with complex models; experience with Tableau or Power BI is considered an asset

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort preparing PowerPoint materials and stakeholder updates

  • Ability to quickly learn business concepts, collaborate with stakeholders, and adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with moderate guidance

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Currently enrolled in an 3rd – 4th year of an undergraduate degree OR master's degree in Finance, Marketing, Business/Commerce, Technology, Analytics, Computer Science or related field

  • Must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree with the intent of going back to school at the start of your work term

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • This position is a 4-month work term and will commence January 4 – April 30, 2027.

  • Applications must include a transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (maximum of 2 pages).

  • We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. Thank you for your interest.

  • TD requires employees to reside in the country where the role is located, irrespective of remote working arrangements

  • TD is committed to providing you with the best candidate experience and internship in these unique circumstances. As such, work location and start dates are subject to change.

HOURS

Monday-Friday, standard business hours

INCLUSIVENESS

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
