title: Guest Experience Executive
description:
What you'll bring to the team

Fancy helping guests experience London from its most iconic perspective?

At 135 metres above the city, the world-famous London Eye is the UK's most popular paid visitor attraction. Every day, thousands of guests step aboard to see London from a whole new angle and we're looking for a Guest Experience Executive to help ensure every visit lives up to the moment.

This is a pivotal role at the heart of the London Eye experience. Working closely with the Guest Excellence Manager, you'll be the voice of our guests, helping to shape how they experience the attraction before, during and after their visit.

From responding to enquiries and resolving concerns to managing online reviews and identifying opportunities to improve the guest journey, you'll help create experiences that are memorable for all the right reasons. Whether a guest is celebrating a special occasion, sharing feedback or seeking support, you'll ensure they feel listened to, valued and cared for.

As the first point of contact for guest enquiries and complaints, you'll manage our guest inbox and support guests across a range of communication channels. You'll balance empathy with sound judgement, taking ownership of issues and delivering fair, consistent outcomes that reflect our brand values.

You'll also play an important role in protecting both the reputation and commercial performance of the attraction. From reviewing refund requests and ensuring appropriate resolutions, to supporting revenue and profit protection through systems such as Fever, promotional codes and coupon validation, you'll help safeguard the integrity of our guest experience while making informed business decisions.

Beyond day-to-day guest communications, you'll oversee guest feedback and online reputation management across platforms including Yext and social media channels. You'll monitor trends, identify opportunities for improvement and work closely with operational teams to turn guest insight into meaningful action.

You'll also support our mystery shop programme, analyse customer experience data and produce reports that help drive continuous improvement across the attraction. By recognising success, sharing feedback and championing our guests' perspectives, you'll play a key role in helping the London Eye continue to deliver exceptional experiences.

This is a full-time, permanent role. The London Eye welcomes guests every day of the year, so flexibility to work weekends, bank holidays and peak trading periods is essential.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience delivering exceptional guest or customer experiences in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confidence handling guest enquiries, complaints and sensitive situations with professionalism, empathy and sound judgement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage guests in a clear, warm and professional manner.
  • Experience managing customer feedback, online reviews or reputation management activities would be advantageous.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to identify trends and turn guest feedback into actionable recommendations.
  • Confidence making balanced decisions relating to refunds, guest recovery and revenue protection.
  • Experience within hospitality, tourism, leisure, retail or visitor attractions would be beneficial.
  • A genuine passion for creating memorable experiences and exceeding guest expectations.

Benefits

  • Monthly Bonus based on customer satisfaction
  • 25% discount in our retail shops and restaurants
  • 40% off LEGO online
  • Merlin Magic Pass - giving you free tickets to all our attractions worldwide for you, your family, and friends every year
  • Enjoy the Ride pass – giving you and 5 others a Merlin Annual Pass (Gold edition)
  • X2 volunteer days a year
  • Employee pricing up to 55% off cinema tickets

If you have any questions or if you require any assistance, because of a disability or medical condition, please contact us by email at recruitment@merlinentertainments.biz and one of the team will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Hammaslääkäri Kuopion Oralin tiimiin
description:
Etsimme Kuopion Oralin tiimiin työkaveriksi hammaslääkäriä, työskentelyn painottuen Sektorin asemallemme.

Me Oralissa keskitymme 1700 asiantuntijamme voimin suomalaiseen suun terveyteen – meitä jokaista ammatillisesti yhdistävään intohimoomme. Siksi voimme luvata sinulle työyhteisön, jossa voit todella tuntea olevasi omiesi joukossa. Olemme tyytyväisten työntekijöiden työyhteisö, jolle on myönnetty myös Great place to work -sertifikaatti. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt ja voit hyvin – myös silloin, kun et ole töissä.

Ottaisitko siis urasi seuraavan askeleen hyvässä seurassa, omiesi joukossa?

Kuopiossa, Savon sydämessä, meillä on kaksi lämminhenkistä yksikköä hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä torin läheisyydessä. Ammattitaitoiseen henkilökuntaamme kuuluu yleishammaslääkäreiden lisäksi kattava erikoishammaslääkäriverkosto. Kanssamme pääset toteuttamaan ammattitaitoasi korkeimmalla mahdollisella tasolla, kehittämään osaamistasi laajan koulutustarjontamme kautta ja keskittymään siihen, mikä sinua eniten motivoi. Saat meiltä alan parhaat kollegat, laitteet, työvälineet – ja mielestämme ehdottomasti parhaat ja mielenkiintoisimmat asiakkaat. Mielenkiintoisen urapolun lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle hyvän ansainnan. Meillä on aina aikaa sinulle- ja ammattitaidollesi.

Anna meidän räätälöidä sinulle paras työarki ja pitää sinut kiireisenä, jos niin haluat. Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 § edellyttämää suojaa.

title: Fysioterapeutti tai toimintaterapeutti Espooseen / Tavana Villa Huvi
description:
IHAN TAVALLISTA ARKEA - YHDESSÄ TEHTYNÄ

Tule työkaveriksemme Espooseen!

Haemme nyt fysioterapeuttia/toimintaterapeuttia OHJAAJAN tehtävään toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen. Työ on kokoaikainen ja sijoittuu kahteen vuoroon, sisältäen jonkin verran viikonlopputyötä. Työvuorot painottuvat aamuvuoroihin.

Pääset tekemään monipuolista ja asukaslähtöistä työtä, jossa tuet asukkaiden toimintakykyä, osallisuutta ja hyvää arkea. Suunnittelet ja toteutat kuntoutumista edistäviä ratkaisuja, ohjaat asukkaita heidän päivittäisissä toimissaan ja vapaa-ajallaan sekä tuot oman erityisosaamisesi moniammatillisen tiimin käyttöön. Työpäiviisi voi sisältyä esimerkiksi ulkoilua ja uintireissuja asukkaiden kanssa, toimintatuokioiden ohjaamista sekä muuta yhteistä tekemistä. Toimit lisäksi apuvälinevastaavana vastaten apuvälineiden käytön ohjauksesta, henkilöstön perehdyttämisestä, yhteistyöstä toimittajien kanssa sekä apuvälineisiin liittyvistä ylläpito-, huolto- ja rekisteröintitehtävistä. Toivomme sinulta asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä innostusta kehittää toimintaa yhdessä työyhteisön kanssa.

Tavana Villa Huvissa asuu kehitysvammaisia aikuisia, jotka tarvitsevat tukea, ohjausta ja apua päivittäisissä toiminnoissaan sekä hoitoa ja huolenpitoa henkilökohtaisissa asioissa niin kotioloissa kuin kodin ulkopuolella. Meillä työskentelee osaava ja toimintaa jatkuvasti kehittävä tiimi, johon kuuluu lähihoitajia, sosionomeja ja sairaanhoitajia. Meidän työyhteisössä huumori kukkii ja nauru raikaa vaikka välillä päivät eivät menekään suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

- ammattitaitoisen ja toisistaan huolta pitävän työyhteisön
- lähiesihenkilön tuen työssäsi
- liikunta -ja kulttuuriedut tukemaan hyvinvointiasi
- lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon
- uuden työntekijän tervetuliaislahjan
- kivat työkaverit

Palkkauksemme pohjautuu yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimukseen. Palkkaluokka tässä tehtävässä on G24D, kokemusvuosiesi mukaan peruspalkka on: 2850,98- 3110,42€/kk. Lisäksi tehtävästä maksetaan Villa Huvi lisä 346,15 €/kk.

ODOTAMME SINULTA

title: Mission Critical Team Lead - Bus Assembly
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS division is currently seeking a Mission Critical Team Lead - Bus Assembly. Schedule for the role will be Monday-Friday and hours are 6:00am-2:30pm.

The hourly rate for this position is $24.00 per hour. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

The Team Leader, Mission Critical will fulfill responsibilities as a production leader. This role will provide manufacturing expertise, support, and direction in the assembly of all areas of the Mission Critical Segment Team with the overall goal of timely order fulfillment and adherence to Eaton’s quality standards. Incumbent will allow for timely execution of required tasks including but not limited to assembly, allocation of materials, inspection, testing, wiring, and shipping.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Promote a safe, engaged and inclusive work culture by proactively addressing and resolving concerns and escalating issues to your supervisor as appropriate.
• Work directly with the manufacturing team to ensure that customer orders are executed in a timely and efficient manner and that the most urgent orders are fulfilled first.
• Review orders and associated documentation (drawings, travel documents, bills of material) as needed to ensure the team has the appropriate information to complete the job and to assist with troubleshooting problems with the order documentation.
• Communicate professionally to provide updates on the status of specific orders, resolve issues with production and promote teamwork across departments.
• Support training and development of employees as the technical subject matter expert; support department supervisor to ensure a flexible workforce through cross training in critical positions.
• Delegate tasks and align resources as appropriate to meet production goals including working in a production associate capacity due to absenteeism/leaves of absence.
• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and drive assigned projects to completion.
• Attend tier meetings to discuss the progress of jobs, detect potential bottlenecks/roadblocks, and proactively work with the team to resolve issues.
• Request required materials/sub-assemblies to ensure complete and timely production.
• Work on projects and special assignments as required and assist/work in the area as needed.

Qualifications:

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or GED from an accredited institution.
  • 2 years of manufacturing experience.
  • 3 months of leadership experience managing people or project teams.
  • Must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship.
  • Must live within 50 miles of Sumter SC to be considered. No relocation benefits offered.
  • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate degree from an accredited institution.
  • 1 year of leadership experience managing people or project teams.
  • Experience with Eaton systems including order entry (Vista), material management (DMM), MRP/ERP (AS400)
  • 1 year experience in switchboard assembly.
  • 3 years of wiring experience

Position Criteria:

• Self-motivated / directed individual with well demonstrated written and verbal skills, along with great organizational and collaborative skills that positively promote a team environment.
• Attention to detail and thorough analytical skills.
• Must be willing to work flexible hours and overtime in support of business needs.
• Demonstrated proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office
• Working knowledge of Lean concepts
• Must work somewhat independently and make decisions that affect the workgroup. Focus efforts on attaining assigned goals and objectives, which include meeting needs and expectations of internal and external customers.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, persuasive skills, and analytical problem-solving skills. Work with individuals and groups to effectively participate within team environment.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Expected to work with some degree of independence and make decisions that affect the workgroup. Focus efforts on attaining assigned goals and objectives, which include meeting needs and expectations of internal and external customers.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, reach at or above shoulder level, grip, and use hands to handle and feel. The employee is frequently required to stoop, lift, carry, push, pull, and grip. The employee is frequently required to lift/carry up to 35 pounds and to push/pull up to or greater than 35 pounds with or without accommodation. The vision requirements include far and close vision with depth perception and color discrimination. While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to communicate.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly exposed to noise and frequently exposed to dust.

title: Koneistaja
location: Helsinki, Järvenpää, Karkkila, Kerava, Tuusula, Vantaa, Sipoo, Finland
description:
Oletko kiinnostunut kehittämään taitojasi koneistuksen parissa tai syventämään kokemustasi alan tehtävissä?

Asiakasyrityksemme etsii CNC-koneistajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteiseen metallituotteiden valmistukseen Uudenmaan alueella. Työnkuva räätälöidään osaamisesi mukaan ja asiakasyrityksemme perehdyttää sinut työhön.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

* Koneistajan opintoja tai vastaavaa työkokemusta
* Tarkkuutta ja huolellista työotetta
* Motivaatiota uuden oppimiseen
* Valmiutta vuorotyöhön
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 16-20 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
* Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä edellytykset, että onnistut työtehtävässä
* Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
* Työtehtävän mukaiset hyvät työvaatteet ja muut tarvittavat varusteet
* Luotettavan ja rehdin työnantajan, sekä vakavaraisen asiakasyrityksen
* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti eri kohteissa ja eri tehtävissä

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.


Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä Emmi Rajalalta emmi.rajala@worker.fi tai numerosta 050 473 0642. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: PRESALES SYSTEM ENGINEER CABLING & DATA CENTER INFRASTRUCTURE
description:
Axians, brand del Gruppo VINCI Energies, è un global system integrator e player di riferimento per le soluzioni e i servizi ICT.

È presente in 35 paesi del Mondo, con oltre 14.000 collaboratori e collaboratrici, per offrire soluzioni tecnologiche innovative a supporto della Digital Transformation delle aziende.

In Italia, Axians è presente su tutto il territorio con diverse sedi, tra le quali Torino, Milano, Vicenza, Roma, Napoli. Axians Italia lavora a fianco delle imprese – di qualsiasi dimensione, sia pubbliche che private – per costruire organizzazioni più efficienti e flessibili, garantendo la continuità e la sicurezza del business.

La gamma delle soluzioni e dei servizi offerti da Axians Italia risponde a qualsiasi esigenza in ambito ICT:

  • Cloud & Data Center Infrastructure
  • Collaborative Solutions
  • Enterprise network
  • Physical security
  • Cyber security

Dalla consulenza alla progettazione, dalla realizzazione alla manutenzione, Axians Italia disegna e realizza per i propri clienti soluzioni tecnologiche su misura basate sui principi di scalabilità e di integrazione.


Per la sede di Vicenza stiamo cercando una figura che ricopra il ruolo di



PRESALES SYSTEM ENGINEER CABLING & DATA CENTER INFRASTRUCTURE


In seguito a un periodo di affiancamento e accompagnata da opportuni percorsi di formazione, la risorsa entrerà a far parte del team Presales Systems Engineering occupandosi della progettazione di soluzioni di cablaggio strutturato e infrastrutture Data Center basate su standard internazionali, tecnologie innovative e architetture ad alte prestazioni.

Il ruolo prevede la definizione di architetture integrate comprendenti sistemi di cablaggio in rame e fibra ottica, infrastrutture passive di networking, rack e sistemi di contenimento, distribuzione energetica, gestione dell’infrastruttura fisica e design soluzioni per Data Center Enterprise, Edge e Campus.

Descrizione delle attività:

La risorsa, inserita all’interno del team dei Presales Systems Engineer, si occuperà di:

  • Progettazione di soluzioni Enterprise comprendenti sistemi di cablaggio strutturato in rame e fibra ottica, backbone campus, infrastrutture per Data Center e ambienti mission-critical, con particolare attenzione a scalabilità, affidabilità e conformità agli standard di settore.
  • Analizzare le esigenze del cliente proponendo la miglior soluzione tecnologica in relazione ai requisiti richiesti, anche in collaborazione con la forza vendita
  • Collaborare alla definizione di architetture ad alta densità e ad elevata disponibilità per Data Center di nuova realizzazione o ampliamento.
  • Supportare attività di assessment e consulenza finalizzate alla modernizzazione di infrastrutture esistenti.
  • definire l'architettura tecnica, il dimensionamento e i componenti necessari

  • redigere schemi, documenti di offerta tecnico commerciale, analizzando i costi e i ricavi delle soluzioni proposte
  • affiancare la forza vendita nella presentazione di progetti, offerte e visite presso i clienti
  • Coordinamento con installatori e/o fornitori tecnologici

Requisiti:

  • Laurea in Ingegneria (Elettronica, Informatica, Telecomunicazioni), in Scienze e Tecnologie Informatiche o formazione equivalente
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese a livello intermedio parlata e scritta
  • Aver maturato almeno 3 anni d’esperienza professionale in ambito progettazione con focus nei vertical indicati
  • Competenze di network base (switching Layer2/Layer3, VLAN, QoS, routing IP, multicast, PoE, firewall, VPN, NTP, autenticazione 802.1X (preferibile))

Costituiscono requisisti preferenziali la conoscenza di una o più delle seguenti soluzioni:

Cabling Infrastructure

  • Sistemi di cablaggio strutturato in rame Cat.6A, Cat.7 e superiori.
  • Sistemi di cablaggio in fibra ottica multimodale e monomodale.
  • Soluzioni ad alta densità per Data Center.
  • MPO/MTP e architetture preterminate.
  • Gestione e organizzazione delle infrastrutture passive.
  • Standard TIA/EIA, ISO/IEC, EN 50600
  • Familiarità con rack, PDU, containment e infrastrutture critiche
  • Infrastructure Management Systems (AIM).
  • Architetture Campus, Building e Data Center.
  • Testing e certificazione di reti in rame e fibra.
  • Conoscenze o certificazioni principali vendor di mercato (es. CommScope/SYSTIMAX, Datwyler, Panduit, Corning, Leviton, R&M, Siemon, Nexans )

Data Center Infrastructure

  • Progettazione di infrastrutture fisiche per Data Center Enterprise, Colocation ed Edge.
  • Rack e cabinet ad alta densità.
  • Sistemi di contenimento (Hot Aisle / Cold Aisle).
  • Power Distribution Unit (PDU).
  • Infrastrutture di alimentazione e continuità elettrica.
  • Soluzioni di raffreddamento e gestione termica.
  • Architetture ad alta disponibilità e ridondanza.
  • Sostenibilità, efficienza energetica e capacity planning.
  • Certificazioni BICSI, CDCP, CDCS o equivalenti.
  • Esperienza con soluzioni DCIM e monitoraggio infrastrutturale BMS.
  • Conoscenza di ambienti edge data center e hybrid cloud.
  • Conoscenze o certificazioni principali vendor di mercato (es.APC Schneider Electric, Rittal, Vertiv, Legrand, Eaton)

Competenze trasversali:

  • Spiccato orientamento alla precisione e alla qualità progettuale
  • Attitudine al team working e capacità di confronto ed apprendimento
  • Orientamento al cliente e alla consulenza
  • Capacità di tradurre requisiti tecnici in valore di business
  • Capacità analitica e problem solving.
  • Ottime capacità di presentazione e comunicazione tecnica.
  • Propensione al lavoro per obiettivi
  • Ottima gestione dello stress e dell’imprevisto

Cosa offriamo

  • CCNL Metalmeccanico
  • RAL 35 – 50K
  • Buoni Pasto


Sede e Orario Di Lavoro

title: QA Engineer – Manual - Desktop Applications
description:
Create the future of e-Health together with us by becoming a part of our Development Center in Bangalore

As a leading provider of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 passionate professionals. Join us and become part of a dynamic, innovative environment overflowing with possibilities. Your dedication and passion will empower you to make a lasting impact.

Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare. Become part of our mission and make a difference—for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Your Impact

We are looking for a QA Engineer who can execute test cases manually as well as converting them to automated test cases using C# and Automation Tools. These are for mission-critical Windows Desktop products. These products generate significant revenue and require robust, maintainable, and scalable test coverage.

You will be responsible understanding the product functionality, executing manual test cases, and for eventual conversion of the test cases to automation using C# and automation tools. Modern AI Tooling and AI Assisted development will be used in all applicable stages. You will be required to understand and comply with documentation requirements and other best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the development teams and own the QA activities
  • Perform manual QA - UI, functional, regression, and exploration testing on desktop applications
  • Write and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios based on requirements/specifications
  • Log, track, and verify defects using bug-tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps)
  • Perform UI, usability, and installation/uninstallation testing for desktop applications
  • Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand requirements and edge cases
  • Participate in test planning, test case reviews, and release signoffs
  • Document test results and prepare test summary reports
  • Extend the existing automation framework and add automated test cases
  • Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines

You Are a Good Fit for This Job If You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience in manual QA and automation.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC
  • Experience writing test cases, test plans, and defect reports
  • Familiarity with bug-tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Azure DevOps, or similar)
  • Good understanding of database concepts (basic SQL for data validation is a plus)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge in C# and .NET
  • Expertise with QA tools like Playwright
  • Experience in automating Windows desktop applications
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Experience, or an eagerness to learn, AI-assisted development.
  • Relevant academic qualifications.

What You Can Expect from Us:

  • High Performing Team: You will be part of a close-nit, elite team within CGM that will move fast, with accuracy and hit deadlines with confidence.
  • Hybrid Work: Enjoy the flexibility of working two days per week remotely and three days on-site at our Bangalore office.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Extensive group health and accidental insurance programs.
  • Seamless Onboarding: A safe digital application process and a structured onboarding program.
  • Career Growth: Various career growth opportunities and a competitive merit increment policy.
  • Stable & Resilient domain: Healthcare is a relatively stable and recession-proof domain.

Even if you do not meet all the requirements of this job post, we encourage you to apply! We are interested in your real-world experience, strengths, and problem-solving style rather than generic and theoretical assessments.

Convinced? Submit your application now (including desired salary and earliest possible starting date). We create the future of e-health. Become part of a significant mission.

title: Commercial Banking Intern / Co-Op (Winter 2027)

37.5

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW


Co-op and Internship opportunities allow you to gain valuable work experience across a number of the businesses at TD. You will work with experienced colleagues, receive world class training, and be part of a community of students across TD, where you will have an impact, grow as individual and experience our culture of care.

Our Co-op/Intern Programming is offered with select Co-op and Internship roles and is designed to help you better understand the TD business, build on critical career capabilities, and broaden your professional network. This program is designed to complement your on-the job experience and features:

  • Leadership talks with key Leaders from across the organization
  • Lunch and Learns on topics such as Innovation
  • Diversity and Inclusion and Personal Branding and so much more

JOB DESCRIPTION

TD Commercial Banking provides financial solutions to North American businesses. Our broad range of products and services allows us to meet the needs of our clients in every sector, providing customized solutions to build a strategy that’s right for them now, and in the future. Our quest is to deliver a first-class business banking client experience and to be” The Better Business Bank” in North America.

At TD, better business bankers have a strong background in business and finance as well as the specific products they are responsible to sell and service. They have keen insight into all their clients – their industry, products, finances, and markets. Better business bankers demonstrate good judgment in people, businesses and markets based on education, experience, “gut instincts” and “street smarts”.

This is an exciting introductory experience into the interesting and vital world of Commercial Banking. You will learn the fundamentals of commercial lending through financial analysis, risk management and industry analysis. This will give you the capability to work closely with a variety of mid-market businesses as they strive to successfully meet their individual and financial goals. title: Officer - Tax Analyst 2 (C10)
description:
The Tax Analyst 2 is a developing professional role. Applies specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Identifies policy gaps and formulates policies. Interprets data and makes recommendations. Researches and interprets factual information. Identifies inconsistencies in data or results, defines business issues and formulates recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Integrates established disciplinary knowledge within own specialty area with basic understanding of related industry practices. Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Develops working knowledge of industry practices and standards. Limited but direct impact on the business through the quality of the tasks/services provided. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own team.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the overall management of the tax liabilities, of Citi, both directly and in connection with transactions with clients, including the related compliance, financial reporting, planning and controversy processes.
  • Contributes to the planning, accounting, filing and the reporting of tax liability of the company.
  • Assists in determining and compiling information required to satisfy income tax filing and related requirements at all levels of jurisdiction.
  • May participate in managing payments to tax authorities in compliance with specific tax regulations.
  • Advises on procedures and concepts in technical/subject area and integrates with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family.
  • Improves process efficiencies in harmony of unit goals.
  • Uses conceptual/ practical grounding in applying policies to the business
  • Perform other duties and functions as assigned
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 2-3 years of experience

Education:

  • Bachelors degree

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Business/ Department

Objectives:

Responsible for in-scope processes related to one or multiple Citi lines of business within the centralized Tax Information Reporting function in FRSS. This position supports the reduction/elimination of Citi's franchise & regulatory risk through accurate and timely reporting and enhanced due diligence on customer accounts. The incumbent is expected to migrate information reporting work from various sub-units within the Business Line into FRSS; this process includes training and job shadowing, building documentation such as procedures and process flows, and identifies gaps in the process based on IRS regulations. In addition, the incumbent will support a specific business vertical and is expected to develop and enhance their product knowledge within a short timeframe.

  • Act as a tax / information reporting specialist to execute the FATCA, CRS advisory/

rollout, Systems conversions/rollouts.

  • Executes the tax information reporting processes to products issued by Citi’s business
  • Migration of work into our centralized hub
  • Develop "Go To" processes and implement appropriate procedures/ controls to

ensure consistent compliance with Information Reporting & FATCA, CRS requirements

  • Support FRSS's Service Delivery / Engagement model with client constituency and other

key stakeholders

  • Identify and participate in process reengineering & redesign to achieve better controls,

compliance and efficiency

  • Support audits with IRS and Internal Audit (IA), and any other special audits.
  • Participate in self-assessment testing, MCA, SOX controls as well as any audits with IRS

Or Citi's IA.

  • Review, validate and process W-8 and W-9 tax forms and related documentation

according to IRS Chapter 3, chapter 61, and FATCA regulations besides CRS.

  • Contribute towards departmental requirement to adhere to strict regulatory and

Compliance requirements, per IRS and Citi policy.

inquiries from operational areas

title: Software Engineer
description:
Location Details: India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

Join Our Team

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to assist in building and strengthening our Identity UI team. GoDaddy is a global products seller to customers from all over the world. Our Identity UI serves login, account create as well as profile and preferences for all GoDaddy’s customers. The UI’s we build are among the first the users see on their customer journey, and helps the user keep their profile up to date. Does that sound exciting to you? Then you are made for the role.

What you'll get to do...

  • Develop and enhance user-facing features using React
  • Optimize application performance, load times, and overall user experience while modernizing existing UIs
  • Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage, delivering through CI/CD pipelines
  • Use AI-assisted development tools as part of your daily workflow while critically reviewing and validating generated code
  • Collaborate within a global Agile team alongside product, design, and backend engineering partners

Your experience should include...

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale applications or distributed systems
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with an understanding of React.js and modern frontend development principles
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and a foundational understanding of accessibility (a11y) best practices
  • Experience using version control systems (Git preferred), working in Agile teams, and testing and deploying code through CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to clearly define problems, critically evaluate generated code, exercise sound judgment on when to rely on AI, and explain and defend the solutions you ship

You might also have...

  • Experience with authentication and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, MFA, session and token handling)
  • Experience with internationalisation and localisation
  • Experience with A/B testing or experimentation on conversion funnels
  • Experience in Next.js and AWS

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

title: TIG-svetsare till Siemens Energy i Trollhättan
description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad TIG-svetsning och vara med och tillverka komponenter till framtidens energilösningar? Nu söker Skill engagerade TIG-svetsare till Siemens Energy i Trollhättan.

Anställningen innebär innebär att du blir anställd hos Skill, men är placerad hos Siemens Energy AB. Det finns mycket goda möjligheter till övergång till kund. Här får du chansen att utvecklas i en modern och högteknologisk miljö tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.

Om företaget

Siemens Energy AB utvecklar och tillverkar världsledande gasturbiner för en global marknad. Företaget levererar även kompletta turbinbaserade kraftanläggningar för långsiktigt hållbar och kostnadseffektiv produktion av elektricitet, ånga och värme.

På Siemens Energy i Trollhättan blir du en del av ett engagerat team som tillverkar brännkammare och högkvalitativa komponenter till gasturbiner. Här arbetar du med avancerade material som rostfritt stål, legeringar och andra värmetåliga material. Med över 2600 medarbetare, merparten i Finspång och ca 120 i Trollhättan, och en årlig omsättning på ca miljarder kronor är företaget en betydande aktör inom energiteknik.

Du får möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens inom TIG-svetsning, montering, slipning och mätning i en säker, modern och utvecklande arbetsmiljö.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som TIG-svetsare hos Siemens Energy är din huvudsakliga arbetsuppgift TIG-svetsning av brännkammare och komponenter till gasturbiner, främst i nickelbaserade legeringar och andra värmetåliga material.

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår bland annat:

  • TIG-svetsa och förbereda fogar inför svetsning samt utföra efterbearbetning och slipning.

  • Montera och hantera fixturer samt genomföra mätning och kontroll av färdiga detaljer.

  • Läsa och tolka tekniska ritningar och arbeta enligt fastställda kvalitetskrav.

  • Dokumentera arbetet och säkerställa att produktionen håller hög kvalitet.

  • Samarbeta med kollegor och bidra till en säker, strukturerad och effektiv arbetsmiljö.

Önskad starttid: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse
Arbetstider: Dagtid under upplärningsperiod, därefter 2-skift

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av TIG-svetsning och är van vid att arbeta noggrant enligt höga kvalitetskrav. Du har god förståelse för tekniska ritningar och känner dig trygg med att arbeta självständigt utifrån arbetsinstruktioner.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av TIG-svetsning, gärna inom industri eller verkstad, och erfarenhet av rostfritt material eller motsvarande utbildning.

  • God förståelse för ritningsläsning och förmåga att arbeta självständigt efter ritning och instruktion.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, då arbetsinstruktioner och dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet.

  • Ett starkt säkerhetstänk och en noggrannhet som säkerställer hög kvalitet i arbetet.

  • B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. Du är en lagspelare som trivs med att samarbeta, samtidigt som du tar ansvar för dina egna arbetsuppgifter. Du planerar ditt arbete på ett strukturerat sätt, håller deadlines och tar dig an problem som uppstår, antingen på egen hand eller tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi ser gärna att du är nyfiken och har en vilja att lära dig nya arbetsmoment och utvecklas långsiktigt tillsammans med Siemens Energy.

Det är meriterande om du har truck- eller traverskort, samt erfarenhet av arbete med höglegerade material.

Ansökningsförfarande
Anställningen inleds som ett konsultuppdrag där du blir anställd hos oss på Skill och jobbar som konsult hos Siemens Energy.

Om du känner att tjänsten är rätt för dig är du varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan! Urvalet kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vänta därför inte med din ansökan. Vid eventuella frågor eller funderingar är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare, Olivia Gustafsson, olivia.gustafsson@skill.se

Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan, vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Kantajia pääkaupunkiseudun työmaille
description:
Kantotöihin rakennustyömaille!

Kiinnostaako raksa? Haemme ahkeria ja reippaita rakennusaputyöntekijöitä kantotöihin pääkaupunkiseudulle ja Uudenmaan alueelle. Työ sopii sinulle, joka pidät fyysisestä tekemisestä ja haluat tutustua rakennusalaan.

Työtehtävinä ovat erilaisten rakennusmateriaalien kantotyöt vaihtelevissa työmaakohteissa - pääset tärkeäksi osaksi työmaan logistiikkaa. Samalla pääset tutustumaan rakennusalaan ja sen erilaisiin kohteisiin!

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää motivaatiota fyysiseen työhön sekä voimaa kantaa painaviakin materiaaleja rakennustyömailla. Toivomme sinulta innostunutta, omatoimista ja joustavaa asennetta. Työtehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää tarkkuutta ja huolellisuutta, sillä kantokeikoilla on työskenneltävä ripeästi, mutta huolellisesti. Aikaisempi työkokemus ei ole välttämätöntä, vaan kaikkein tärkeintä on hyvä asenne, sekä tahto suorittaa sinulle annetut työtehtävät kunnialla alusta loppuun asti. Työskentely asiakkaidemme rakennustyömailla kuitenkin edellyttää:

* Täysi-ikäisyyttä
* Työturvallisuuskorttia
* Suomen kielen taitoa
* Valmiutta tehdä fyysistä työtä

Työnkuvaus:

Työpäivät sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo. 7–15.30 välille. Työskentely tapahtuu vaihtelevissa työmaakohteissa keikkaluonteisesti, joten hakijalta toivomme valmiutta liikkua eri työmaiden välillä. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on plussaa, sillä se helpottaa liikkumista työmaakohteiden välillä.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Meillä työskennellessä saat loistavan mahdollisuuden kartuttaa tietämystä rakennusalasta! Tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan, joka on rakennusaputyöntekijöillä yleisesti 12,59 €/h - 14,19 €/h. Tämän lisäksi saat meiltä kaikki tarvittavat työvarusteet sekä ammattitaitoisen HR-tiimin tuen koko työsuhteesi ajalle.

Hakuprosessi:

Mikäli kiinnostuit, olethan ihmeessä yhteydessä meihin ja laitat hakemuksen tulemaan, jotta voimme olla sinuun yhteydessä! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, haastattelut pidämme pääsääntöisesti etäyhteyksien välityksellä. Työt alkavat joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan tilanteesi huomioiden.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä:
HR-harjoittelija Essi Lindgren
essi.lindgren@workpower.fi


Avainsanat: rakennusapulainen, rakennustyöntekijä, kantotyö, rakennusala, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Uusimaa

title: Kiinteistösiivooja, Uusimaa
description:
Kiinteistöjen siivooja Uudenmaan aluelle!
Etsitkö vakituista ja kokoaikaista työtä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään siivousalan osaamistasi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi?

Millainen työ on kyseessä?

Pääset kiertämään siivouskohteissa pääasiassa itsenäisesti ja toisinaan myös työparin kanssa - taloyhtiöiden, toimistojen ja muiden kiinteistöjen siivoustehtävissä. Työtehtäviin kuuluuvat mm.

* porrassiivous,
* ylläpitosiivous,
* yleisten tilojen ylläpitosiivous,
* toimistosiivous
* peruspesu- ja lattioiden vahaus kokemus on eduksi.

Työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja kohteet vaihtuvat päivän aikana. Osa työpäivistä voi alkaa toimistokohteella jo klo 6–8, minkä jälkeen siirrytään muihin työkohteisiin.

Työ on kokoaikainen, 37,5 h/vko ja kyseessä on arkisin tehtävä työ.
Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan / heti.



Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme, että sinulla on:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta kiinteistösiivouksesta
* suomen kielen taito, sillä työnjohto ja työhön liittyvä ohjeistus tapahtuvat suomeksi
* luotettava ja vastuullinen työote
* Ajokortti on pakollinen - työauton saat yritykseltä käyttöösi

Arvostamme erityisesti sitä, että hoidat sovitut työtehtävät huolellisesti ja haluat pitää hyvää huolta sekä työn jäljestä että asiakkaidemme tiloista.

Visiolla on työntekijälupaus

Kun sinulla on visio siitä, mitä haluat työelämältäsi, me autamme sinua toteuttamaan sen. Haluamme, että viihdyt työssäsi ja tunnet olosi turvalliseksi osana työyhteisöämme. Tässä työssä saat:

* 13,00–14,30 €/h palkkaa kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimukseen perustuen – palkassa huomioidaan aikaisempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi
* palkan 2 kertaa kuukaudessa
* tehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet

Hakeminen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Hakemuksia tulee paljon, joten jätäthän sen järjestelmäämme niin se saapuu varmasti perille!
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin klo 9-15: Wilma Niskanen / wilma.niskanen@visiohr.fi.
Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut
Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. Työnantajia taas palvelemme etsimällä oikeat ihmiset avoimiin tehtäviin. Yhteistyö perustuu jokaisen kolmen tahon kesken vallitsevaan luottamukseen. Mikäli haluat työnantajan, jolle jokainen työntekijä on merkityksellinen ja arvokas, niin se on Visio!

title: Information Security and Systems Lead, (Associate) Director
description:
Information Security and Systems Lead, (Associate) Director

Location: Dakar, Senegal; Rabat, Morocco; Nairobi, Kenya; Lusaka, Zambia; Delhi, India, or Manila, Philippines


About the Information Security and Systems Lead Role

The Information Security and Systems team is the engine driving our uniquely dynamic, high-achieving, multicultural, multi-continental team at the cutting edge of how evidence is used to improve global development programs. This team's mandate is to build and maintain systems that enable IDinsight teams across 7+ countries to achieve social impact. We are looking for an Information Security and Enterprise Systems Leader to own that mandate end-to-end. You will lead a small, capable team of security and systems specialists, fractional resources, and external implementation partners. You will report to and advise the executive team. This role could be a fit if you have high-quality experience running both security and enterprise systems initiatives at a global organisation and you’re comfortable being the most senior technical voice in the room without being the only person who understands the decision.


Enterprise Systems Leadership

  • Strategy and roadmap — Define and own the multi-year enterprise systems strategy for a remote-first, globally distributed organisation, and the priorities that follow from it.
  • Systems implementation — Lead identification, selection, and implementation of new enterprise systems such as CRMs, ERPs, etc. Own architecture and integration decisions and the master data model that holds them together.
  • Implementation partner management — Select, contract, and manage external implementation and support partners, including scope, commercial terms, and delivery accountability.
  • Budget ownership — Lead annual budgeting and financial planning for organisational systems, and make the trade-offs that a non-profit budget requires.
  • Change management — Champion adoption across regions and functions, so that systems investments produce behaviour change.
  • Operational effectiveness — Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the estate, streamline usage to reduce shadow IT, and ensure systems and support functions operate reliably across time zones.
  • Leadership partnership — Work with functional and regional leadership on requirements, prioritisation, and the systems implications of organisational strategy.


Information Security Program Management

  • Security strategy — Define and own the information security strategy in alignment with organisational strategy and recognised frameworks, and monitor delivery against the roadmap.
  • Control framework — Lead implementation of security and privacy controls as regulation, client obligations, and risk require.
  • Governance — Coordinate the Information Security Steering Committee and contribute to Enterprise Risk Management.
  • Incident response — Own incident response planning, lead coordination during incidents, and drive the changes that follow.
  • External assurance — Commission and support penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, audits, and own remediation.
  • Risk management — Lead periodic risk assessment exercises and the ongoing identification, mitigation, and monitoring of information security risk.
  • Due diligence — Serve as senior point of contact for funder, client, and government partner security and data protection due diligence.
  • Investigations — Support Legal, Compliance, and Operations where digital evidence is relevant to policy violations.


Data Protection and AI Governance

  • Multi-jurisdiction compliance — Own compliance with GDPR and the national data protection regimes in the countries where we operate, including data mapping, retention, subject rights, and impact assessments.
  • AI governance — Define how IDinsight governs AI use on project and organisational data: tool assessment, acceptable use, and the controls that make responsible use the default.
  • Policy — Own the information security and data protection policy set, and keep it usable enough that colleagues consult it rather than route around it.


Team and Function Leadership

  • People management — Manage, develop, and grow full-time technology staff and fractional resources, including hiring and performance management.
  • Capability building — Build depth and redundancy in the team so that critical knowledge is not concentrated in one person.
  • Organisational contribution — Contribute to cross-functional leadership initiatives and to IDinsight's institutional practice on data ethics and responsible technology use.


Qualifications

We're looking for an entrepreneurial, “get stuff done” teammate with substantial leadership experience. Desired qualifications include:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in technology roles, including at least 5 years of Information Security or Enterprise IT leadership experience (involving people management).
  • Demonstrated ownership of an information security programme at organisational scale — strategy, control framework, governance forum, and incident response, not solely operations;
  • Experience leading the selection and implementation of major enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, including partner management and budget ownership;
  • Hands-on depth across enterprise security controls — endpoint protection, network security, vulnerability management — sufficient to make architecture decisions and evaluate your team's work credibly;
  • Strong command of identity and access management in enterprise environments, including SSO, MFA, LDAP, and federation protocols such as SAML;
  • Experience with control configuration and security architecture in common cloud environments;
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and of national data protection regimes in Africa or Asia, and of security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-171, or ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Experience administering enterprise systems for a globally distributed team, including workspace collaboration and human capital management platforms;
  • Experience with enterprise systems architecture and data modelling;
  • Information security leadership certification preferred — CISM, CISSP, CISA, or equivalent;
  • Excellent collaboration, interpersonal, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to present to and influence audiences of varying technical fluency, including senior leadership;
  • Strong internal and external stakeholder management skills, including with funders, government partners, and vendors;
  • Experience managing change in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.
  • Detail- and execution-oriented, able to take a task from high-level strategic idea to rapid execution with a large amount of autonomy and conscientiousness;
  • Demonstrated track record as a self-starter and leader, including comfort with ambiguity and dynamic environments and work streams;
  • Ability to handle sensitive information, data, and issues with mature and discreet professionalism;
  • Ability to work with international, cross-cultural, and diverse teams across time zones.


Nuts & bolts

Start date

The start date for this position is as soon as possible, with preference given to candidates who can start immediately. We expect a minimum two-year commitment, with regular professional development conversations and the potential for a long-term career at IDinsight.

Work Authorization

IDinsight is able to sponsor employment visas for all nationalities in the locations listed above; however, we will prioritize candidates who do not require IDinsight to sponsor work authorization in the aforementioned countries. All candidates who are not currently located in our country offices listed above will be expected to relocate to their office locations at the onset of their employment.

Compensation

Compensation is commensurate with relevant experience and background and is competitive within the social sector. Please note that, as a non-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading technology firms.


How to apply

This application includes several questions and requires a CV (one to two pages) covering your professional and personal experience as well as academic qualifications. Please omit headshots, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and similar personal information — these aren't relevant to our review. For more on IDinsight's hiring process, our commitment to reducing power asymmetries, and FAQs, visit .


IDinsight’s commitment to reducing power asymmetries

IDinsight is committed to reducing power asymmetries in the social sector. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.

We seek a workforce that is inclusive of a variety of perspectives that will help us refine and improve our methods and relationships, and strengthen the services we provide our clients and their communities or constituencies. The following commitments represent our vision for the IDinsight team:

  1. IDinsight will have greater representation from the populations with whom we work and clients we serve.
  2. IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
  3. Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from historically excluded communities.
  4. IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their best work.

IDinsight is committed to non-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organizational culture, regardless of people's age, disability, gender, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Taksinkuljettaja
description:
Taksinkuljettajaksi Petaxille ilta- ja yövuoroon
Viihdytkö ratin takana iltaisin ja öisin? Liity Petaxin kasvavaan kuljettajatiimiin ja tule ajamaan taksia Järvenpäähän tai Keravalle.

Etsimme iloisia, palveluhenkisiä ja luotettavia taksinkuljettajia kokoaikaiseen ilta- ja yötyöhön. Voit olla kokenut ammattilainen tai vasta alaa harkitseva – meillä on paikka sinulle.
Valmiilla pätevyyksillä voit aloittaa työt nopeasti. Jos kokemusta ei vielä ole, koulutamme sinut tehtävään maksutta ja autamme tarvittavien pätevyyksien hankkimisessa.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Ajat monipuolisia henkilökuljetuksia Petaxin, Menevän ja Lähitaksin välityksessä. Työhön kuuluu myös Kela- ja sote-kuljetuksia sekä omia tilausajoja.
Käytössäsi on uudehko, hyvin varusteltu ja automaattivaihteinen kalusto, johon kuuluu tila- ja invatakseja.

Työajat ja ansiot

Työ on kokoaikaista jaksotyötä, 120 tuntia kolmessa viikossa. Vuorot sijoittuvat ilta- ja yöaikaan, pääasiassa klo 17–5 välille. Työpäivät kestävät yleensä noin 8–12 tunttia, ja joka kolmas viikonloppu on vapaa.
Palkka koostuu 8 €/h tuntipalkasta sekä 10 %:n provisiosta verottomasta ajomyynnistä. Kokoaikaisessa työssä bruttoansiot ovat noin 1 800–2 200 €/kk.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
- Positiivista, luotettavaa ja asiakaslähtöistä asennetta
- Hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- Paikallistuntemusta Järvenpäästä, Keravalta, Keski-Uudeltamaalta tai pääkaupunkiseudulta — se on etu, mutta ei välttämätöntä

title: Customs Supervisor
description:
Do you have a strong background in customs compliance and enjoy leading teams in a fast paced logistics environment? Are you passionate about process excellence, regulatory compliance, and delivering high standards of customer service? If so, you could be the newest addition to our team as a Customs Supervisor.

Be part of the movement – and play your part.

About the role

Working Monday to Friday, 14:00–22:30, you'll oversee evening customs operations, ensuring customs declarations, compliance activities, and export documentation are completed accurately and on time. Leading a team of five Customs Clerks/Administrators, you'll play a key role in supporting customers, maintaining regulatory compliance, and driving process consistency across the customs function.

You will be responsible for:

  • Leading and supporting a team of five customs colleagues, ensuring workloads are managed effectively

  • Managing and overseeing customs entries across a range of freight movements

  • Conducting compliance checks to ensure declarations meet all regulatory requirements

  • Ensuring compliance with Catch Certificate, TRACES, customs, and border control requirements

  • Monitoring customs processes, identifying improvements, and driving operational efficiencies

  • Liaising with customers, internal departments, and external partners to resolve customs-related issues

  • Maintaining accurate records and supporting audit and compliance activities

About you

You'll have at least two years' experience in a customs supervisory role, with strong knowledge of customs compliance procedures and regulatory requirements. Experience managing Catch Certificates, TRACES documentation, RoRo movements, and deep-sea freight operations is essential.

Strong IT skills are required, including confidence using Microsoft Excel and Word, alongside customs and logistics systems. You'll be commercially aware, highly organised, and capable of balancing customer requirements with compliance obligations.

You'll thrive in this role if you're a confident people leader who enjoys developing and supporting others. Experience managing or mentoring a small team would be highly beneficial. We're looking for someone who is systems focused, process driven, and committed to continuous improvement, with the ability to lead by example while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and operational performance.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

Working at DFDS

Join the movement and grow with us.

Be a valued member of a diverse team at DFDS and help drive change together.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, we believe that development happens first and foremost through activities in the workplace. We will also offer training courses that can support you in your role, if needed.

Now, let’s talk about what we can offer you.

When you join us, you become part of a fantastic business that genuinely invests in the growth and development of its people. Alongside a supportive culture, you’ll have access to a range of excellent benefits, including:

  • Pension Scheme – After successfully completing your probation, you’ll have the opportunity to join our Company Pension Scheme. Plus, members of the scheme may also be eligible for life assurance (subject to criteria).

  • Holiday Purchase Scheme – Flexibility to buy additional holiday days to suit your lifestyle.

  • Bike to Work Scheme – Save money and stay active with our cycle-to-work initiative.

  • HSF Assist – Our employee assistance programme offers a variety of support services, including a GP Advice Line, Virtual Doctor, Counselling and Emotional Wellbeing Support, and a Legal Helpline.

  • Health Plan with HSF – Enjoy benefits like cashback on dental treatments, glasses, and more.

  • MyGym – Access great discounts at hundreds of gyms, health clubs, leisure centres, outdoor bootcamps, and studios offering yoga, Pilates, CrossFit, and more.

  • Free Ferry Travel – Enjoy unlimited free ferry travel for up to four guests between Dover and Calais or Newcastle and Amsterdam.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Supply Chain Program Manager
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

At Lam Research, the Factory Support Supply Chain Program/Project Manager is part of the Global Operations Group. This group brings together information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing to drive the engine of Lam’s Global business operations. They help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam’s business.

The impact you’ll make

As a Factory Support Project Manager, you will serve as a crucial link between the manufacturing and supply chain departments. Your role involves consistent interaction with both sectors to minimize shipment risks. This is achieved by ensuring the accuracy of components, their location, quantity, and quality. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in Supply Chain Management while maintaining a close understanding of manufacturing operations. Your contributions will be pivotal in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

What you’ll do

  • The candidates most successful in this role are individual contributors, self-starters, that can thrive both independently day-to-day and as a part of collaborative teams as they are a vital part of expediting material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates.
  • Analyzing Data: This position requires analyzing data in SAP and internal shortage tools to identify, validate and escalate the risk to Lead/Manager
  • Supporting Manufacturing and Delivery: Support expediting key material to meet manufacturing and customer delivery dates. The person will work as an interface to cross-functional teams consisting of manufacturing, order fulfillment, logistics, and engineering to ensure the manufacturing production and customer delivery are met.
  • Collaboration: Requires collaboration with Global Operations team and consisting of Buyers, Commodity, Supplier Business Managers, Manufacturing, Engineering, to find all possible solutions to mitigate material allocation priority.
  • Project Management: Manage non-technical, supply chain projects using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation through delivery. Build solutions that will improve Supply Chain Global Factory Support business processes and support critical business strategies.
  • Develop and monitor risk mitigation strategies and coordinate root cause corrective actions.
  • Participate in projects to resolve problems or to support continuous process improvement.
  • Develop timely reports and key performance indicators to identify/monitor material delivery challenges.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proficient in MS Excel and other standard Office programs (i.e. Outlook, Team, Word, ect.)
  • Good communication (verbal and written).
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work within a cross-functional teams.
  • Possess an understanding of comprehension of manufacturing operations and processes.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the field of Supply Chain with a bachelor’s degree
  • Buyer and/or Order Fulfillment experience.
  • SAP experience is preferred.

Preferred qualifications

  • Semiconductor industry or global supplier experience is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Associate III, Pricing Operation [L3] (Fresh pricing)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Pricing Operations 조직의 Fresh Pricing 팀은 고객에게 가장 경쟁력 있는 가격을 제공하기 위해 로켓프레시 상품의 가격 운영 프로세스를 관리하는 조직입니다. 본 포지션은 가격 결정 및 운영 프로세스 전반을 관리하며, 유관 부서와의 협업을 통해 운영 효율성과 가격 경쟁력을 지속적으로 개선합니다. 또한 표준 운영 절차를 수립·고도화하고, 데이터 기반의 운영 개선 활동을 주도하여 조직의 목표 달성에 기여합니다. 운영 과정에서 발생하는 이슈를 발굴하고 해결하며, 고객 관점에서 최적의 가격 경쟁력을 유지하는 역할을 수행합니다.

업무 내용

• 로켓프레시 상품의 가격 결정 운영 프로세스 전반 관리
• 유관 부서와의 협업을 통한 가격 운영 관련 프로젝트 기획 및 수행
• 표준 운영 절차(SOP) 문제점 발굴 및 개선
• 반복적으로 발생하는 운영 이슈 분석 및 개선 방안 도출
• 조직 목표 달성을 위한 실행 계획 수립 및 주요 과제 운영 관리
• 오프라인 시장조사를 통한 경쟁사 가격 동향 분석 및 가격 경쟁력 유지

자격 요건

• 전문 학사 학위 이상을 보유하신 분
• 운영, 프로젝트 관리 또는 프로세스 개선 관련 경력이 2년 이상 있으신 분
• 하나의 운영 프로세스를 기획부터 실행, 개선까지 주도적으로 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• Microsoft Excel 또는 Google 스프레드시트를 활용한 데이터 분석 및 업무 수행이 가능하신 분
• 스케줄 근무 및 주 1회 외근(오프라인 시장조사) 업무가 가능하신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스, 리테일 또는 플랫폼 산업에서 운영 업무 경험이 있으신 분
• 프로젝트 매니저 또는 프로덕트 오너 역할로 운영 프로세스를 관리한 경험이 있으신 분
• 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 프로젝트를 성공적으로 운영한 경험이 있으신 분

근무 스케줄

• 07:00 ~ 16:00 / 08:00 ~ 17:00 / 09:30 ~ 18:30 / 17:00 ~ 02:00

• 4개의 스케줄 중 직원 선호도 일부 반영하여 스케줄 근무 진행 (월 단위 계획 근무)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: (Indirect-Hiring) Clinical Facilitator & Practice Development Specialist
location: Sinclair Pharmaceuticals (Asia Pacific) Pte Ltd, MY
description:
Sinclair is Indirect-Hiring! Join Our Team as a Clinical Facilitator & Practice Development Specialist (Agency staff)🚀

Location: Malaysia

About Sinclair

Founded in 1971, Sinclair is a global medical aesthetics organisation, that delivers an extensive product range. With an in-house commercial infrastructure, including manufacturing and a network of distributors in leading global markets, our products are sold in 55 countries worldwide.

This is a great time to join Sinclair as we continue to increase our product range and expand into new markets and territories.

Sinclair Values:

✅ Act with Integrity Consistently doing the right thing even when it’s the hard choice; 100% Compliance with all rules, standard operating procedures and guidelines
✅ Results-Driven Make a business impact in all you do, whether sales, efficiency, operational excellence; it should make a meaningful impact
✅ Innovation-Centered Redefining Aesthetics, we must be pioneering in how we do business; this can be in products, in service models, or strategy
✅ One Company, One Goal Working towards unified mission, we are all Sinclair and be seen by customers as one company in every way

✅ Own It! Be Accountable for your decisions, actions and consequences; Be Reliable to your customers and colleagues

What You'll Be Doing:

The Clinical Facilitator & Practice Development Specialist is responsible for supporting physician capability development, treatment implementation, and educational engagement for Sinclair aesthetic brands in Malaysia.

This role focuses on reinforcing structured injection methodologies approach through workshop facilitation, post-training follow-up, clinical implementation support, and educational pathway management.

The role also supports local educational events, trainer coordination, workshop logistics, and clinic engagement activities to strengthen treatment confidence, consistency, and long-term physician adoption.

This position works closely with the commercial, medical, and marketing to ensure effective educational execution while maintaining strong alignment with business objectives.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities of the Role

1. Clinical Education & Training Facilitation (35%)
