title: Lead Data Engineer- SnowFlake
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Lead Tech Data Engineer — Snowflake (all genders), you will combine strong hands-on data engineering expertise with technical and people leadership. You will lead a team of around Data Engineers, ensuring high-quality delivery while staying close to the technology.

As part of our Data & AI practice, you will work with enterprise clients on modern data platforms, with a strong focus on Snowflake, data engineering best practices and AI-ready data solutions, Cliet facing.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A strong hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys leading and mentoring others
  • A pragmatic problem-solver who takes ownership of delivery
  • Comfortable working across technical and business stakeholders
  • Curious about AI and the evolution of modern data engineering

Role responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers.
  • Own day-to-day technical delivery, priorities and quality.
  • Support team development through mentoring, feedback and knowledge-sharing.
  • Review technical work and promote strong engineering practices.

Data Engineering

  • Stay hands-on, developing and improving Snowflake-based data solutions and pipelines.
  • Build scalable ELT/ETL workflows using Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Fivetran/Stitch or similar tools.
  • Drive best practices around SQL, data modelling, testing, data quality and CI/CD.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and support the team in finding pragmatic solutions.
  • Help teams adopt modern and more efficient ways of working.

Must have qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a similar technical role.
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake expertise.
  • Proven experience leading or mentoring Data Engineers.
  • Strong SQL and modern data pipeline experience.
  • Experience with dbt, Airflow, Fivetran/Stitch or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of data modelling, data quality and cloud data platforms.
  • Strong communication skills in French and English (C1).
  • Ability to balance hands-on engineering with team leadership.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You know how to get the best out of a team while remaining hands-on.
  • You are a technical leader, not just a manager.
  • You take ownership, make pragmatic decisions and keep delivery moving.
  • You are curious about AI and the future of data engineering.
  • Consulting or client-facing experience is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Snowflake Cortex / AI experience
  • Python
  • Kafka, Kinesis or Pub/Sub
  • AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Hightouch, Census or CDP platforms
  • Snowflake or dbt certifications

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a permanent position based in Paris/France with 3 days at the client’s office.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

As per the AGG (General Equal Treatment Act) in Germany and equivalent in France, jobs must be advertised in a gender-neutral manner. We use the statement (all genders) to make it clear that this position is open to all genders in these countries, even if the job title itself can be translated or interpreted as "masculine" in the French or German language.

title: HSE Officer
description:
WHAT IS ON OFFER



Alfred H Knight has an exciting opportunity for a HSE Officer to join our team in Johannesburg. This individual will offer support, as directed, on day-to-day operations and assist in ensuring all work is executed in line with Safety Legislation and ISO 17025. You will be a support function for all staff on HSE-related matters ensuring the Company’s H&S policy and legislative requirements are adhered to effectively in all areas of the business. You will provide a high-level report on health monitoring, incident statistics, site-inspection reports, nonconformances and corrective action monitoring, project progress, HSE audits etc. Maintain a professional standard and appearance during office hours when interacting with colleagues on various levels and or while promoting the company when on company business.



ABOUT US



Alfred H Knight is a totally independent, family owned business spanning five generations. A global network of strategically placed offices and laboratories enable global trade by providing independent inspection, analysis and consultancy services to the metals and minerals, solid fuels and agriculture industries.


We have honed and carefully crafted our reputation. Delivering knowledge and professionalism in all aspects of weighing, sampling and analysis. We thrive by continuing to re-invest in our facilities, technology and people. Click here to find out more about AHK.


DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES



To be successful at Alfred H Knight you will need to display the following:


REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND WORK EXPERIENCE



Essential



  • HSE Management and Compliance: Implement, maintain and continuously improve HSE policies, procedures and management systems, ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 requirements.
  • Audits, Inspections and Risk Management: Conduct internal audits, site inspections and risk assessments, identify non-conformances, and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.
  • Incident Management: Lead and coordinate accident and incident investigations, monitor incident trends and statistics, and report significant HSE or legislative compliance failures to management.
  • HSE Support and Legal Requirements: Provide HSE guidance and support to management and employees, while maintaining legal appointments, certificates, contractor safety documentation and other statutory requirements.
  • Health Monitoring and Employee Safety: Coordinate medical surveillance requirements and support initiatives aimed at protecting employee health and safety.
  • Training and Communication: Develop and deliver HSE inductions, safety awareness programmes, toolbox talks and other communications to ensure employees understand HSE requirements and changes.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain controlled HSE documents and records, prepare monthly HSE reports, and compile information for management reviews and HSE meetings.
  • Continuous Improvement and Coordination: Coordinate HSE committee meetings and work closely with management and operational teams to achieve HSE objectives and drive continuous improvement.


Required Competencies



  • Communication and Computer Skills: Highly proficient in English, both written and verbal, with good communication skills and computer literacy.
  • HSE Knowledge and Application: Good knowledge and understanding of Occupational Health and Safety legislation, regulations and HSE requirements, with the ability to apply these effectively in the workplace.
  • Planning and Time Management: Strong organisational, time-management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.
  • Quality and Attention to Detail: A strong commitment to accuracy and a “right first time” approach, with high attention to detail and a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Problem Solving and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgement, make decisions and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Resilience and Professional Judgement: Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage uncertainty and challenges in a professional and mature manner



Required Work Experience



  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a production, mining operations or laboratory environment, with a proven track record of implementing and maintaining HSE requirements.



Required Qualifications



  • Diploma or qualification in Health and Safety Management; NEBOSH IGC would be advantageous.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, relevant legislation and HSE management systems, including ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
  • Competency in legal liability, incident investigation, COIDA, hazard identification and risk assessment.



Required Language



  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.





BENEFITS


We are offering an excellent opportunity with a salary and benefits package to match.


Alfred H Knight is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.


If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.


Alfred H Knight is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community in line with our Employment Equity Plan.

title: Head of Product
description:
⛵ About our Crew

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

🚤 The role

We’re looking for a Head of Product to take ownership of Product across Click&Boat’s core business, as our VP Product shifts a significant part of his focus to our US expansion.

You’ll lead four Senior Product Managers, each owning their own squad. You’ll help them make better decisions, challenge their plans, connect the dots across squads, and make sure we’re collectively focused on the problems that matter most.

You’ll act as the VP Product’s key counterpart on the core business, with significant autonomy and responsibility for its product direction.

You’ll also work closely with the senior leadership team alongside the VP Product, giving you strong exposure to company-level decisions and priorities.

🛟 What floats your boat

  • Strategy & Execution
    You turn strategy into clear priorities and align teams when priorities conflict.

  • Product Organization
    You improve how the Product team operates, structuring key processes and cross-team initiatives without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Business & Judgment
    You understand the business, challenge senior stakeholders, and make sound decisions with imperfect information.

  • Team Development
    You challenge and coach experienced PMs, helping them grow in scope and impact.

🧭 What you bring aboard

  • You are fluent in English.

  • You have significant Product experience in a mature product organization.

  • You have managed experienced PMs / Senior PMs across multiple squads.

  • You’re comfortable working directly with senior leadership on business and product decisions.

  • You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on, business-oriented approach.

🗺 The hiring journey

  • HR call with Talent Acquisition,

  • Interview with the Product team,

  • Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values with our VP product and CPTO.

  • Final call with Christian, our Managing Director, to wrap up the process.

What awaits you on board

  • 8 to 10 additional days off;

  • Lunch vouchers (Cobee);

  • Gym partnerships (Wellhub);

  • PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;

  • Breakfast every Tuesday morning;

  • A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;

  • Team-building activities.

  • Hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 3 days per month spent in Paris — around 6 to 9 trips per year.

  • Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

Contract: Permanent position

Start date: ASAP

A competitive salary starting from €100K.

🪝 Ready to join?

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all. 🌊

title: Senior Product Manager - Strawberry Moon & Agentic SDLC
description:
Join OneAdvanced

This role owns the roadmap for OneAdvanced's own agentic toolchain, the tools, ways of working and systems moving product and engineering teams to frontier-level agentic development, and for Strawberry Moon, the product that has grown out of that internal capability and is now being taken to market. This role works directly with the team building the toolchain, translating internal adoption learnings into a roadmap that serves two audiences: OneAdvanced's own teams today, and external customers as Strawberry Moon is productised.

This role is advertised as a Birmingham hybrid position. However, we are committed to supporting internal mobility and will consider applications from colleagues with existing alternative working arrangements on a case-by-case basis.

What You Will Do

  • Own the internal agentic build framework and toolchain roadmap.
  • Own the Strawberry Moon roadmap as an externally marketed product, taking it from current implementation to market.
  • Work directly with engineering, translating capability and internal usage learnings into product priorities.
  • Define the ways of working, standards and quality gates internal teams adopt, and evolve them as the toolchain matures.
  • Lead customer and market discovery for Strawberry Moon externally.
  • Build the business case, commercial model and GTM sequencing for taking it to market.
  • Define and track internal adoption and effectiveness metrics to prioritise the roadmap.
  • Own GTM strategy and launch, partnering with marketing, sales and commercial teams.
  • Act as the internal authority on agentic development practice.
  • Define technical debt and platform investment priorities with engineering leadership, balancing internal needs against external readiness.

What You Will Have

  • Strong understanding of modern software delivery and the SDLC, including CI/CD, code review and quality gates, and how agentic development changes each stage.
  • Practical familiarity with agentic coding tools and workflows, such as Claude Code or comparable environments, enough to credibly prioritise with engineering.
  • Experience taking an internal tool to market as an external product, including the commercial, packaging and GTM thinking that requires.
  • Strong developer experience sensibility: what makes tooling genuinely adopted, not mandated.
  • Advanced understanding of AI-enabled and agentic development, and responsible AI considerations for tools that write and ship code.
  • Solid SaaS commercial knowledge, including pricing and packaging, for launching a new product line.
  • Strong stakeholder management across a deeply technical engineering conversation and a commercial, market-facing one.

Please note, This vacancy will remain open until 25 August 2026. Interviews will be scheduled shortly after the closing date, so we encourage interested colleagues to submit their application as early as possible. All applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application.

What We Do For You

Wellbeing that means something

  • 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays (and the option to buy more) plus 1 paid volunteering day every year
  • Exceptional family leave, 26 weeks fully paid maternity/adoption, 4 weeks fully paid paternity, 22 weeks fully paid shared parental leave, plus 5 days paid bereavement leave
  • Robust sick pay of up to 13 weeks full pay + 13 weeks half pay
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Private medical insurance for everyone, no medical-history exclusions

Financial benefits that have your back

  • Performance-based rewards tailored to your role, from company-wide bonuses to OTE and commission structures
  • Income protection: up to 75% salary for 5 years if you ever need it
  • Pension with 5% matched company contributions
  • Life assurance worth 4x your salary from day one
  • Free financial planning session with the option to engage in more tailored financial coaching.

Grow your career with us

  • SkillsHub learning platform with leadership pathways, future-manager training, and a huge online library
  • Access to external training and apprenticeships

Making a Difference

  • MatchIt! Fundraise for a cause close to your heart and OneAdvanced will match part of the funding
  • Pennies from Heaven donate the pennies from your pay check to help make a difference without lifting a finger

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

  • ULEV car scheme with 1,000+ models
  • Dental insurance, Health Cash Plan, Critical Illness Cover, Partner Life Cover, Health Assessment, Gym Membership

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

title: Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, laaja-alainen erityisopetus (425066)
description:
LAAJA-ALAINEN ERITYISOPETTAJA, määräaikainen virka

Nurmijärven Yhteiskouluun ajalle 1.10.2026–31.7.2027

Nurmijärvi – paremman arjen ilmiö

Nurmijärvi on reilun 44 000 asukkaan kasvukunta, joka sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä pääkaupunkiseudun välittömässä läheisyydessä. Koulutuspalveluissa työskentelee noin 600 kasvatus- ja opetusalan ammattilaista.

Oletko sinä uusi ilmiöntekijä?

Koulutuspalvelut hakee määräaikaiseen palvelussuhteeseen ajalle 1.10.2026–31.7.2027

LAAJA-ALAISTA ERITYISOPETTAJAA (päätoiminen tuntiopettaja)
Nurmijärven Yhteiskouluun

Tule osaavaan joukkoomme tekemään kanssamme laadukasta ja ajanmukaista perusopetusta. Haemme yhteistyökykyistä, kehittymismyönteistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä erityisopettajaa tukemaan nuorten oppimista, koulunkäyntiä ja hyvinvointia.

Nurmijärven Yhteiskoulu on vuonna 1929 perustettu perinteikäs mutta aktiivisesti kehittyvä yläkoulu. Noin 400 nuorta ja noin 60 aikuista muodostavat yhteisön, jossa oppiminen, hyvinvointi, osallisuus ja yhdessä tekeminen kulkevat käsi kädessä.

Tehtävän pääasiallisena vastuualueena on 9. vuosiluokka. Työhön kuuluu laaja-alaista erityisopetusta sekä oppimisen ja koulunkäynnin tuen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista yhteistyössä aineenopettajien, luokanvalvojien, opiskeluhuollon ja muiden koulun ammattilaisten kanssa. Yhdeksännellä luokalla korostuvat myös opintojen loppuun saattamisen tukeminen, koulunkäyntiin kiinnittyminen ja onnistunut siirtyminen toiselle asteelle.

Erityisopettaja toimii lisäksi 9. vuosiluokan tiiminjohtajana. Tehtävään kuuluu vuosiluokan yhteisen työskentelyn, tiedonkulun ja toimintatapojen koordinointia sekä yhteistyötä koulun johtoryhmän kanssa.

Toivomme hakijalta vahvaa erityispedagogista osaamista, yhteistyökykyä sekä kykyä kohdata yläkouluikäisiä nuoria lämpimästi ja jämäkästi. Arvostamme kokemusta yhteisopettajuudesta ja konsultatiivisesta työotteesta sekä halua kehittää oppimisen tukea osana tavallista opetusta ja koulupäivää. Kielellisten oppimisvalmiuksien ja kielenoppimisen tukemiseen liittyvä osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävän työmäärä on noin 20-24 vvt (opetusvelvollisuus 24). Viran kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen nro 986/1998 mukaisesti. Kelpoisten hakijoiden lisäksi huomioimme tarvittaessa myös hakijat, joilla on tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, osaamista ja kokemusta.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen, OVTESin, mukaan. Palvelussuhteeseen valitun tulee toimittaa lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan yhden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Kiinnostuitko? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Nurmijärven Yhteiskoulun rehtori Mikko Jordman, puh. 040 317 4158.

Voit tutustua kouluun osoitteessa:
https://www.nurmijarvi.fi/koulut/nurmijarven-yhteiskoulu/

Hakuaika päättyy 22.9.2026 klo 16.00. Tehtävään haetaan sähköisesti. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä. Haastattelut järjestetään välittömästi hakuajan päätyttyä.

title: Continuous Improvement (CI) Technician
description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

I. Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Continuous Improvement (CI) Technician to work directly on our facility for Hot Gas Path (HGP) Cell at PTG Service Center. In this role, you will be an integral part of our skilled workforce, tasked with identifying inefficiencies, project trials, and implementing sustainable solutions using lean methodologies as part of continuous improvement for the facility to make our work safer, better quality, and more efficient.

II. Essential Functions, responsibilities

  • Proactively identify safety hazards, daily inefficiencies, or "pain points" in operations area and propose practical - physical improvements.
  • Create project prototype by coordinating with engineering team using a range of manufacturing processes such as machining (lathe, milling, drilling, etc.), welding (including TIG, SMAW, and/or other welding techniques), and any other manufacturing processes.
  • Responsible for final project items creation as part of continuous improvement after prototype has been done and accepted.
  • Gather feedback from shop operators for continuous improvement. Capture data of record production counts, scrap rates, or cycle times to help prove that an improvement worked.
  • Perform documentation on any continuous improvement projects that will be needed for work procedure enhancement.
  • Conduct periodic 5S check and safety gemba evaluation and resolve them through the continuous improvement project initiation.
  • Maintain the visual shop floor, includes standardizing how tools are labeled, how components are marked, and ensuring the signage is accurately done.
  • Collaborate with operators, supervisors, engineers, KPO team, Lean, and other staff for daily operations & better alignment.
  • Adhere to all EHS procedures to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Monitor the availability of EHS and Quality MOC documents for the changes.
  • Raise any concerns and/or stop works if observing any unsafe condition or quality risks during daily job.
  • Participate in GEV Lean Action Work Out (AWO) event.

III. Qualifications requirements

  • Minimum graduated from vocational high school with major of manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, or other related disciplines.
  • Have at least two years working experience in manufacturing facility.
  • Have experience of doing continuous improvement projects.
  • Have experience with welding, machining (drilling, lathe, or other types of machining), and air tools operations.

IV. Desired Characteristics

  • High integrity and compliance with Company Rules & Company Values.
  • Open & Honest and Trustworthy.
  • Can work individually and/or in a team and can handle high working pressure / Resilience.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety and quality.
  • Willing to stay in Bandung.

V. Why Join GE Vernova:

At GE Vernova, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and dynamic work environment where innovation thrives. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and contribute to projects that shape the future of energy. Join us and be a part of a company that values your skills and expertise.

Additional Information

title: Lead UX Designer - UI Lead Designer
description:
What's the role?

We are seeking an experienced and creative UI Design Lead to join our multidisciplinary Web Experience team and take responsibility for developing, evolving and delivering best-in-class visual and interaction design across our ecosystem of websites.

This role is part of our Global Marketing function within the global Customer organization of HERE Technologies. Based in Mumbai, India, you’ll become part of an international cross-functional group that strategically and operationally runs our ecosystem of websites, with HERE.com being the main hub for inspiring and educating audiences about our offering, generating buyer demand, and providing a self-serve entry into the HERE platform.

You’ll work in a team of highly talented, creative professionals who are at the center of web experience for HERE, focusing on technology topics ranging from Automotive to Fleet Management and Supply Chains. Your input will be crucial in shaping and executing high-quality UI across our global rolling annual product roadmap, using your deep expertise in visual design, interaction design, design systems and scalable digital experiences as you liaise closely with UX Design, Content, Product Owners, Development, the HERE Design System team, Product and Revenue Marketing stakeholders, Market Intelligence and partner agencies.

We’ll count on you to be the go-to expert for UI craft excellence, helping to establish and maintain design standards, reusable components and patterns, and clear definitions of quality to ensure our suite of websites deliver consistent, accessible and compelling user experiences. We’ll also expect you to be enthusiastic about being hands-on, using a sprint-based, agile approach, while providing guidance and mentorship to fellow designers without direct line management responsibility.

Who are you?

  • Be our go-to person for UI design excellence across here.com and our broader website ecosystem, including visual design, interaction design, user flows, UI artifacts, prototypes and final design specifications.
  • Lead the design execution of key website initiatives from discovery through delivery, working closely with UX Design, Content, Product Owner and Development colleagues.
  • Translate complex HERE topics into elegant, intuitive and scalable digital experiences that support audience needs and business objectives.
  • Create high-quality, implementation-ready UI designs and documentation that clearly articulate design rationale, decisions and process.
  • Partner closely with Product Owners, UX Design, Content and Development teams to define goals, scope, priorities and success measures for website experiences.
  • Champion user-centered design decisions across Brand, Product, Performance Marketing, Development and other cross-functional stakeholder groups.
  • Champion adoption of the HERE Design System (HDS) across web experiences, ensuring consistency, scalability and alignment with brand principles.
  • Contribution to building our reusable component library with developers for the HDS to enable us to build faster and more efficiently.
  • Helping to create alternative interfaces for A/B testing ahead of full design rollouts.
  • Establish and maintain reusable UI components, interaction patterns and visual standards that raise the quality and efficiency of our design output.
  • Provide hands-on design guidance through design reviews and peer feedback.
  • Act as a key internal stakeholder for our design and agency partners, helping to ensure quality, consistency and design intent from concept through delivery.
  • Work directly in the details, in partnership with UX design, including responsive layouts, visual hierarchy, accessibility, interaction models, prototyping and final design handover.
  • Use data, performance insights, experimentation and iterative validation to refine design decisions and improve the effectiveness of our website journeys.
  • Collaborate closely with subject matter experts to understand business goals and draw out strong customer-facing user experiences.
  • Foster an integrated and collaborative approach to UI requirements before translating aspects of HERE into compelling, clear stories and offers.
  • Contribute to the growth of design maturity across the organization by identifying gaps, improving ways of working and proactively driving quality improvements.
  • Lead with excellent communication and storytelling skills, helping colleagues and stakeholders understand the why behind design decisions.
  • Help ensure our website experiences are accessible, inclusive and aligned with HERE Design System principles, quality standards and Brand strategy.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced business that requires a steady stream of innovative solutions across B2B and B2D audiences.

YOUR APPLICATION SHOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING:

  • A link to your portfolio, or samples of projects you’ve worked on or led.
  • Applications should include examples that highlight your visual design craft, interaction design thinking and experience with design systems at scale.
  • Case studies that show your process from problem definition through to final delivery are especially welcome.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • A minimum of 8-10 years’ experience in UI, visual design or digital product design, ideally in a B2B, enterprise, e-commerce or technology environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or significant experience delivering UI design with meaningful business impact.
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale, high-quality digital experiences across responsive web and digital platforms.
  • Deep expertise in design systems, including component libraries, reusable patterns, scalable UI frameworks and governance.
  • Strong visual design craft, with excellent understanding of layout, hierarchy, typography, color, interaction states and responsive design.
  • Highly skilled in prototyping to communicate ideas, validate assumptions and iterate quickly throughout the design process.
  • Ability to clearly articulate design decisions, backed by evidence-based rationale, user understanding and strong storytelling.
  • Experienced in working closely with UX, Content, Product Owners and Development colleagues to ensure high-quality implementation from concept through release.
  • Excellent understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design principles.
  • Adept at using performance metrics, user insights and data-driven evidence to define, refine and improve design solutions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including design libraries, components, variants and collaborative workflows.
  • Familiarity with traditional design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite is an asset.
  • Experience with micro-interactions, motion design or animation principles is a plus.
  • Experience in working within a marketing function and alongside colleagues to explore, build and launch ideas.
  • A strong collaborator who works well with a multidisciplinary team.
  • A positive can-do mentality, confident and effective in drawing out strong stories and aligning stakeholders.
  • Flexible and able to successfully navigate ambiguity and succeed in a rapidly changing, fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with multiple priorities.
  • Passionate about experimentation, iteration and fostering an environment where people can test, learn and improve.
  • Ability to think laterally and provide innovative UI solutions that simplify complex technical stories.
  • Excellent relationship-building, interpersonal and influencing skills across functions and responsibilities.
  • Fluent in English, verbal and written.
  • High level of awareness of the competitive landscape, emerging UI trends, design tools and digital experience standards to keep HERE ahead of the curve, relevant and innovative.

Who are we?

“Ever checked in somewhere on social media? Ever tracked your online orders?” You might be using HERE every day without even realizing it. You can find us everywhere: in vehicles, smartphones, AI agents or third-party apps. And we’re not stopping there. We are evolving what used to be thought of as a map, into a real-time, 3D, digital representation of the world. HERE is the world’s leading mapping company. Our customers are leading automakers, logistics firms, mobility providers and technology brands.

title: Senior, Apparel Designer, Outerwear, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest-moving product engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. As part of the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering locally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while building on consumer favorites and serving local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone who is eager to grow, challenge themselves, and operate independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Apparel Designer to join our dynamic, fast-paced design team. Based in Shanghai, China, this role will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Product Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a senior-level designer with apparel industry experience who can design and execute products that reflect our brand. They will create outerwear across a range of Greater China consumer, sport, and lifestyle opportunities, while independently managing the execution of multiple categories through a hyper-local lens. This designer has a strong eye for detail, deep expertise in premium craft, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, bring the brand vision to life, foster creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to take ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with key functional partners throughout the product creation process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

BA/BFA/MA/MFA preferred in Apparel Design or related field, or equivalent combination of education, experience or training.

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of professional apparel design experience in the apparel and sportswear industry, with strong expertise in outerwear materials, functionality, construction, and fit.

  • Clear understanding of apparel segments and multidimensional consumer profiles; experience in the Greater China market is preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials, garment construction, fit, tech packs, and schematic development.

  • Ability to design and execute lifestyle and performance apparel.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and adhere to timelines.

  • Excellent visual and verbal presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to contribute actively to the creative process and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, 3D visualization tools, AI-enabled design platforms, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Senior Apparel Designer, Outerwear, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Create apparel products that align with global creative direction, seasonal concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, and geo assortments while connecting with the Greater China consumer.

  • Create original product designs and evolve existing products under the guidance of Design leadership.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively, collaborate in a fast-paced environment, and apply Greater China consumer insights, trends, and design solutions to seasonal products.

  • Monitor prototype development and partner closely with Product Development to finalize product details, conduct fittings, and ensure design excellence throughout the process.

  • Champion storytelling and communicate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts clearly to internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, planning and executing product details, reviewing samples, resolving feasibility issues, and ensuring timely project completion.

  • Demonstrate strong trend awareness and consumer curiosity, maintaining a deep connection to city culture, emerging trends, and Nike's design DNA.

title: Senior Python Application Developer - Vice President
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution-focused Senior Python Application Developer with 12+ years of hands-on experience to design, architect, and deliver critical, horizontally scalable, highly available, and performant applications. This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture, Design & Hands-on Development

  • Lead Implementation: Lead the hands-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
  • Platform Engineering: Design and develop efficient software platforms for high-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
  • Standards & Alignment: Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
  • Database & API Design: Design, develop, and secure high-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).

2. Technical Leadership, Governance & Delivery

  • SDLC & Code Quality: Enforce industry-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • Project Ownership: Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
  • Change Management: Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
  • Independent Execution: Work independently, multi-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.

3. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
  • Global Collaboration: Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
  • Executive Communication: Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.

Required Technical Qualifications

I. Core Python, DSA & System Development

  • Experience: 12+ years of hands-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Python Expertise: Expert-level Python 3.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
  • Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
  • Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
  • Database Systems: Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
  • Operating Systems: Highly experienced with Unix/Linux-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system-level development.

II. Cloud, DevOps & Testing

  • Cloud Platforms: Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.

title: Network Scheduler
description:
We are currently recruiting for an experienced supply chain professional to join our team at Bedhampton in the position of Network Scheduler. This role is a key cog in our organisation and provides an opportunity to work in the exciting sector of Aerospace.

Join Eaton and be a part of our commitment to providing impactful, energy-efficient solutions that shape a sustainable future. At Eaton, we make what matters work, and we're dedicated to fostering a workplace where ethics, inclusion, diversity, and our people are at the forefront. Find out more on

Located in Bedhampton, Eaton's Aerospace business stands as a global leader in aerospace fuel systems.The core business of Bedhampton is; assembly and test of hydraulic parts for motors and pumps on aeroplanes.

We are ethical - We are passionate - We are responsible - We are efficient - We are transparent - We are learning. We are EATON!

What you’ll do:

The Supply Chain Network Scheduler is a key role in the integrated, intelligent and agile supply chain organization, focusing on the 0-3 months execution horizon, owning short term product availability and exception management for FG & semi-finished goods for their value stream across markets where there is an imbalance between supply and demand.


The Supply Chain Network Scheduler Is the primary face of supply for a given value stream, owning capacity & material constraint escalations by leveraging scenario planning and ensuring collaboration between demand and supply stakeholders. This role reports into the Network Planner role.

Responsibilities:


- Manages a team of production planners - or the respective production planning team leads - across the sites that are under the incumbents supervision
- The Network Scheduler will be responsible for developing timely and accurate plans for finished products at assigned level of the supply network and for short-term finished goods availability in the markets within the 0 to 12 weeks horizon for their portfolio.
- They will achieve this by managing all exceptions in the short-term horizon and collaborating with teams across the Eaton network and external vendors as needed, to identify root causes and drive corrective and preventative actions to solve exceptions.
- Creates the Master Production Schedule (MPS)
- Coordinates team of CoE resources (buyers, planners, production schedulers...) to deliver MPS Plan
- Interfaces with operations to drive schedule adherence
- Reports and analyses key performance indicators to drive supply network improvements in cash, cost and customer service results.
- Key to the role is to ensure a feasible plan to minimize demand at risk and maximize customer service level while remaining within inventory and cost targets. This requires the ability to create and analyze different scenarios against a defined scorecard.
- A key success driver to this role is the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple functions, in order to drive improvements across our end to end Supply Chain and serve our customers efficiently
- Manage all exceptions in the 0-12 weeks horizon where there is an imbalance in demand and supply, collaborate on root cause analysis and drive corrective actions.
- Ensure capacity shortages are addressed or escalated.
- Evaluate and share the impact of material exceptions on the short-term FG plan with material planners.
- Monitor customer on-time service level and inventory exceptions in the short term
- Participate in decision making and movement of slow moving inventory within the value stream
- Monitor planning parameters accuracy by conducting periodic audits and getting ERP updated as needed.
- Acts as primary point of contact for product availability in their value stream
- Stays close to the demand information to react quicker to changes
- Owns escalations, brings to conclusion in cooperation with material planners, buyers and production schedulers"

Qualifications:

- 5 years in Supply Chain (Materials Management, Inventory management, demand planning, supply planning, procurement, SIOP)


- 2 years experience as manager of people


- Preferably Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Supply Chain, Logistics,..)

Skills:

- Deep functional understanding of supply chain processes: procurement, SIOP, Materials Management, demand planning and forecasting, end-to-end planning, master production scheduling, capacity analysis, inventory management.
- Working understanding of MRP area.
- CPIM certification a plus
- Ability to adapt and to get results in a complex environment
- Influential and collaborative, able to challenge the status quo to solve complex challenges
- Must be able to build strong relationships at all levels
- Ability to use data to generate scenarios, and drive decision-making

Network Scheduler

title: Process Technician _ Metal deposition & Wafer thinning (Contractor)
description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

  • Staying customer-centric,

  • Inspiring dedication,

  • Persevering,

  • Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

  • As a Process Engineering Technician, you will join our Fab Engineering team to process semiconductor wafers and support Metal deposition and Wafer Thinning area in delivering robust, stable processes for ongoing R&D projects, Process Architects, and high-volume manufacturing.

  • This role is primarily cleanroom-based, involving hands-on operation and development across all equipment and processes within the Metal deposition and wafer Thinning area, with occasional support in adjacent process cells.

Working Pattern
2 Shifts Based, Rotating weekly
Monday to Friday, Total 37.5 hours per week

Shift One 07:00 – 15:00
Shift Two 11:00 – 19:00

Key Responsibilities:

  • Run day-to-day operations on metal deposition and wafer thinning equipment.

  • Process R&D and manufacturing wafers following guidance from Engineers and Architects.

  • Serve as the main contact between Cell Engineers and Maintenance team, providing hands-on support for preventive maintenance, chamber cleans, and tool upkeep.

  • Manage SPC data collection by ensuring test materials are ready and routine checks are completed on time.

  • Bridge communication between Manufacturing and Process Engineering when tool or process faults occur to keep downtime to a minimum.

  • Help the team smoothly return tools and processes to production following maintenance or downtime.

  • Coordinate with other area of the fabs to ensure material entering and leaving the Metallization and Thinning area meets quality standards.

  • Assist Process Engineers in drafting and updating practical documentation, including Standard Operation Procedure (SOP) and related documents.

  • Drive recipe control by keeping process recipes accurate, updated, and ready for manufacturing use.

  • Train operators on tools and process procedures whenever required.

  • Support Process Engineers with process optimization, new process development, and tool commissioning.

  • Actively participate in 7S and continuous improvement activities on the shop floor.

  • Carry out additional ad-hoc engineering support tasks as requested by the team.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

Required:

  • Good manual dexterity for handling semiconductor wafers and samples.

  • Science based education background or relevent previous experience in Cleanroom or Lab environments

  • Knowledge and experience of SPC processes and six sigma techniques.

  • Working knowledge of MES and general office and data software – eg, MS Word, Excel.

Desired:

  • Minimum of 1 year’s hands-on Fab experience in the following processes – metal deposition (PVD, sputtering and electroplating), etching and mechanical thinning of wafers.

  • Experience in running experiments in a scientific environment, collating and presenting results.

  • Good working knowledge of semiconductor materials and processes.

Personal Attributes:

  • Able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines – level headed, calm and considered.

  • Proactive team player who is also capable of working independently.

  • Positive attitude in working & learning and actively seeks to share ideas and information with colleagues.

  • Attention to details.

  • Proven ability to work under own initiative, and to seek advice when required.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Flexible approach to working – work the hours to do the job.

  • Supportive of the company culture and ethos.

Työskentelet asumispalveluiden resurssipoolissa ja varmistat koulutetun henkilöstön riittävyyden eri asumisyksiköissä henkilöstön poissaolojen aikana. title: Government Relations and Partnerships Analyst
description:
About Current AI


Current Al is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.


If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.



Role Overview

Current AI is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Government Relations and Partnerships Analyst to support its government relations, multilateral partnerships, and resource mobilization functions. The Analyst will play a central role in ensuring that engagement with governments, multilateral institutions, and donors is well-researched, well-organized, and effectively tracked. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional with a strong interest in international affairs, public policy, and philanthropic or donor engagement to gain hands-on exposure to high-level diplomatic and fundraising work within a small, fast-paced, and rapidly growing organization.



What you’ll do

The Analyst will work across three interconnected areas of work:



Government Relations

  • Conduct research on priority countries, including political context, government structures, key stakeholders, and relevant policy developments as they relate to AI, to inform engagement strategies.
  • Support the organization and logistical coordination of missions of the Vice President of Government Affairs including scheduling, briefing materials, and coordination with government partners.
  • Prepare high-quality briefing notes, background papers, and meeting briefs ahead of CEO’s and the VP Government Affairs’ government meetings, missions, and high-level engagements.
  • Draft follow-up notes and track action items and commitments arising from government meetings.
  • Maintain up-to-date country and stakeholder files to support institutional knowledge and continuity.


Global Affairs and Multilateral Partnerships

  • Conduct research on relevant international events, forums, and convenings (e.g., multilateral summits, conferences) to identify opportunities for engagement and visibility for Current AI.
  • Research potential partner organizations, including multilateral institutions, think tanks, and civil society actors, and assess alignment with organizational priorities for outreach.
  • Draft talking points, presentation slides, and briefing materials for senior leadership participation in external events.
  • Prepare correspondence, letters, and communications with partner organizations and government counterparts.
  • Support the coordination of joint initiatives or collaborative activities with partner organizations, as needed.
  • Support the organization of events or panel participation by senior leadership


Resource Mobilization

  • Conduct research to identify and profile potential donors and funding targets, including governments, foundations, private sector companies and multilateral funds.
  • Develop and maintain a dashboard tracking all potential and ongoing donor conversations, including status, next steps, and key contacts.
  • Regularly update the dashboard and provide summary reports to senior leadership on the status of fundraising pipelines.
  • Support the preparation of donor-facing materials, including concept notes, one-pagers, and correspondence.
  • Assist in tracking deadlines, deliverables, and reporting requirements associated with donor engagements.
  • Manage a dashboard of all fundraising targets, including tracking of all conversations.



What we’re looking for

Essential Qualifications

  • Education:
    • Advanced degree (Master's or equivalent) in public policy, international relations, political science, business administration, or a related field, with relevant internship experience; OR
    • Bachelor's degree in a related field with 1-2 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with diverse stakeholders, with excellent writing skills.
  • General knowledge of multilateral and international organizations and institutions.
  • Experience managing external relationships in a global and/or multilateral setting.



Nice-to-haves

  • Demonstrated ability to simultaneously and effectively manage multiple projects and competing priorities, within deadlines.
  • Openness to ongoing learning, feedback, and growth.
  • Track record of effective event management, including with government representatives.
  • Experience working across cultures and geographies.
  • Strong grasp of the evolving AI policy landscape, including associated risks, opportunities.
  • International experience working with organizations operating globally and regionally (Africa and the Middle East; Asia and the Pacific; Latin America and the Caribbean).
  • Fluency in English required; proficiency in additional languages (e.g., French, Spanish) is an asset.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with CRM or dashboard/tracking tools is an asset.


Character traits

We’re looking for people who:

  • Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
  • Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
  • Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
  • Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
  • Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
  • Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
  • Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, hands-on work to make that true.



How to apply

Please upload your CV and respond to the question prompt.


Equal opportunity commitment

Current AI is committed to ensuring equal access to employment and preventing all forms of discrimination. All applications will be reviewed fairly, without regard to origin, sex, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religious beliefs, views held, or any other criteria unrelated to professional qualifications. Selection will be based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.


Current AI does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have a signed agreement. Current AI will not be liable for any fees or commissions

Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a new Senior Java Developer for our next phase of growth.

About the Role

As a Java Developer at Qred, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of the backend systems that power our core financial products. Working within a cross-functional team of developers, UX designers, and product managers, you’ll serve as a mission-critical bridge between complex third-party integrations and a seamless user experience.

We trust our engineers to design, implement, test, deploy daily, and operate their own software in production, giving you direct control and architectural input over the future of our financial platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build secure, high-throughput backend microservices using Java and Spring, optimizing complex data flows across PostgreSQL databases.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, and cross-functional teammates to design efficient APIs and system logic that enhance the core user journey.

  • Lead by example as an early adopter of agentic workflows - using AI tools and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to accelerate feature discovery, implementation, and code quality.

  • Ensure high system availability by maintaining robust logging, tracing, and alerting frameworks within AWS.

  • Maintain high standards of security and compliance by enforcing best practices, system integrity, and thorough peer-review workflows.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a seasoned backend engineer who can tackle complex architectural challenges effortlessly at the core of our business. You thrive in a flat, non-bureaucratic environment, possess a strong team spirit, and take pride in building long-term scalable frameworks.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience writing, releasing, and maintaining production-grade backend applications (fintech or regulated environment experience is a strong plus).

  • Deep technical mastery in Java, Spring Framework, and JPA/Hibernate for data persistence.

  • Advanced knowledge of relational database design, optimization, and management using PostgreSQL.

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) for deploying, monitoring, and maintaining scalable cloud services.

  • Proficiency with AI development tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code to drive engineering velocity without sacrificing code quality.

Why Qred?

This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!

One Last Thing

This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

title: Head of Brand Design
description:
We are looking for a seasoned brand design leader to own and evolve the visual identity of Nordic Knots across every touchpoint, from store environments and packaging to editorial print, e-commerce and digital channels. This is a rare opportunity to shape the design language of a fast-growing premium interior brand at a critical moment in its development.

The Role

As Head of Brand Design, you will be the steward of how Nordic Knots looks and feels across the world. You will define, protect and evolve the brand’s visual identity and design system — setting the standard for how we express ourselves across physical and digital touchpoints, and ensuring that standard holds whether the work is produced in-house, by an agency or by a freelance specialist.

You will take ownership of how the brand design function should be structured as Nordic Knots continues to grow — assessing what capabilities we should build internally, where they should sit and when external expertise will create the strongest result. You will set priorities, bring in the right partners and resources, and work closely with the Chief Brand Officer and the creative team to translate the broader brand vision into enduring, elevated design.

This role requires both strong design authority and operational leadership — someone who can develop a long-term design system while also knowing how to get excellent work out the door today.

This role reports to the Chief Brand Officer.

Your Responsibilities


Brand design ownership

  • Own and continuously develop the Nordic Knots visual identity and design system — defining how the brand expresses itself across typography, colour, layout, imagery, iconography and all visual language

  • Ensure consistency and elevation across every touchpoint: packaging, retail environments, print, editorial, presentations, e-commerce and digital channels

  • Set and uphold quality standards across all design output, whether produced internally or externally

Strategy and design direction

  • Work closely with the Chief Brand Officer and the creative team to translate the broader brand direction into coherent, high-quality visual expression

  • Take a long-term view on how the design system needs to develop as the brand grows — anticipating new formats, new markets and new channels before they arrive

  • Bring a strong point of view on what good looks like within premium brand design, with a clear understanding of how design comes to life in retail and across the full customer experience

Function and resource leadership

  • Assess what design capabilities Nordic Knots needs and shape how the function should develop over time

  • Prioritise where internal capabilities will create long-term value and where specialist external expertise will produce the strongest result

  • Identify and bring in the right expertise for each challenge — from packaging and typography to retail environments and production

  • Brief and manage external partners with clarity, maintaining ownership of the brand design throughout the process

Production and systems

  • Oversee the development and maintenance of design templates, guidelines and production systems that allow the organisation to move efficiently without sacrificing quality

  • Build scalable processes that support the organisation as Nordic Knots continues to grow

  • Stay ahead of tools and emerging ways of working, including where AI can meaningfully support design production, efficiency or creative exploration

About You

You are a highly accomplished and senior brand designer who has held broad responsibility for design within a brand or organisation. You have spent years creating work that earns its place in the world and have built a reputation for clarity, craft and considered design. You know the difference between work that looks good and work that actually works, and you are as comfortable developing a design system for the long term as you are getting into the detail of a single layout.

You have led designers and shaped how design work is organised, prioritised and delivered. You understand what capabilities are important to have close to the brand, when specialist expertise is needed and how to build a strong network of internal and external resources around the work.

You work with conviction but without ego. You can build genuine partnerships with a Chief Brand Officer and a creative team, create clarity across different stakeholders and earn the trust of external agencies and specialists. You know how to hold a brief and how to push beyond one.

You have a broad understanding of brand design across formats — print, packaging, environmental, retail and digital — and a strong sense of how a premium brand should translate across each of them. You understand retail and the importance of creating a consistent, elevated brand experience at every customer touchpoint. You also have the industry awareness and relationships to identify the right expertise when it is needed.

You are organised, proactive and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where not everything is perfectly defined yet.

Experience

  • Significant senior experience in brand and graphic design, with a background spanning agency and/or premium in-house brand environments

  • Proven ownership of a brand’s visual identity and design system across physical and digital touchpoints — including packaging, print, retail and environmental design, and digital

  • Experience holding broad responsibility for design within a brand or organisation

  • Experience leading designers, shaping design capabilities and managing external creative partners

  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates refined aesthetic sensibility, typographic command and brand-level thinking

  • Familiarity with the premium lifestyle, interior design or luxury goods space is highly meriting

  • Experience building or significantly evolving a brand’s design system from the ground up is a strong advantage

  • Fluency in relevant design tools and curiosity about AI-supported workflows and emerging production methods

Nordic Knots

Nordic Knots was founded in 2016 by Liza Laserow, Fabian Berglund and Felix Berglund. We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer Scandinavian interior design brand with the USA as our primary market.

Nordic Knots was born from a culture of thoughtful design that lasts beyond seasons and trends. Fusing function and aesthetics with a Scandinavian sensibility, we craft timeless textiles for the modern home. We believe that great textiles are foundational — that they can transform a house into a harmonious home and frame the most beautifully curated lives.

Our head office and flagship store are located on Birger Jarlsgatan in central Stockholm. We have a growing team across both Sweden and the USA.

What We Offer

We are a driven team with high ambitions and an entrepreneurial, open-minded culture where new ideas and initiative are genuinely encouraged. At Nordic Knots, everyone plays a meaningful role in how the brand grows.

You will have real influence over the future of Nordic Knots’ brand design, a close relationship with the Chief Brand Officer and founders, and the opportunity to build something that outlasts you — a design system robust enough to carry the brand into its next decade.

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants who bring different perspectives, experiences and ideas to our team.

Location

This position is based at our Stockholm headquarters.

title: Management Analyst
description:

Identify operational trends to develop, arrange, and deliver training programs for processing location personnel on standardized policies, systems, and procedures.

Troubleshoot and resolve system access and functionality issues utilizing knowledge of collaboration tools, help desk programs, and the USMIRS system.

Develop and implement training and education performance standards to evaluate and improve processing location effectiveness.

Manage aptitude testing requirements and resolve associated functional issues within the Testing, Processing, and Medical areas.

Resolve internal and external help desk tickets by communicating with processing locations to address medical, testing, and general system concerns.
