title: Software Engineer II, IQ Grow
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, the IQ Grow team is on a mission to scale new, high-impact go-to-market initiatives. By combining the cutting-edge innovation of AI agentic solutions with human-in-the-loop workflows and touchpoints, we are redefining how restaurants connect with their guests. Our goal is to deliver a truly personalized marketing experience that empowers Toast customers to build lasting relationships, drive engagement and grow their businesses. If you're excited about pioneering at the intersection of advanced AI and human-centered design to make a real-world impact, we’d love to have you on the team! You will be a key part of a high-impact, high-ownership engineering team solving complex challenges in a fast-moving product space, balancing technical excellence alongside a strong product mindset to solve for continuous growth.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build and maintain high performing, flexible, and scalable solutions that help restaurants deliver a best-in-class guest experience
  • Ship features end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring for success and iterating based on real-world use
  • Be an awesome teammate who's all in on collaboration and collective success
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design and Engineering stakeholders
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 2+ years of Kotlin/Java experience, delivering products that drive impact
  • Comfortable reading and integrating with frontend applications and curious to work across the stack when needed
  • Excited about AI-assisted development and LLM-based agents (Claude Code or similar), and interested in pioneering new workflows with the team
  • Effectively works with ambiguity, agile delivery, and shipping usable software incrementally
  • Passionate about making users happy and seeing people use your product in the wild
  • Strong on software development fundamentals — code quality, unit tests, clean code — and open to evolving your workflow with AI tooling
  • Strong collaboration skills: you communicate clearly with engineers, product, and business stakeholders, and adapt technical detail to the audience
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset: you seek feedback, embrace change, and want to grow toward broader ownership

Our Tech Stack

  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services
  • React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.
  • Android app built in Java & Kotlin running in the restaurant
  • Claude Code and similar AI agentic development tools as part of daily engineering
  • PostgreSQL and DynamoDB as core persistence
  • And many more technologies that help us build a top class platform.

**This is a hybrid role requiring in-office collaboration two days per week in our Dublin office.**

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more:

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: .

title: Diabeteshoitaja, Terveysasemapalvelut
description:
Terveydenhuollon palvelujen toimiala, Terveysasemapalvelut
Diabetespalvelut
Jönsaksentie 4, 01600 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Hei diabeteshoitotyön osaaja! Haemme ammattitaitoista ja innostunutta sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen diabetespalveluihin.

Diabeteshoitajana työskentelet osana Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueen diabetesyksikköä. Diabetesyksiköissä hoidetaan yli 16-vuotiaita tyypin 1 diabeetikoita sekä tyypin 2 insuliinihoitoisia diabeetikoita. Vastaat diabetesta sairastavien asiakkaiden ohjauksesta, seurannasta ja omahoidon tukemisesta. Autat heitä löytämään omaan elämäntilanteeseensa sopivia ratkaisuja sairauden hoitoon sekä toimit asiakkaan rinnalla hoitopolun eri vaiheissa. Työhön kuuluu lääke- ja insuliinihoidon ohjausta, hoitotasapainon arviointia sekä diabeteshoidossa käytettävien teknologioiden käytön ohjaamista.

Olemme osa laajaa moniammatillista verkostoa, jossa diabeteshoitajat toimivat diabeteksen hoidon asiantuntijoina. Asiakastyön lisäksi tuet ja konsultoit muita ammattilaisia diabeteshoitoon liittyvissä kysymyksissä sekä edistät omalla osaamisellasi sujuvia hoitopolkuja ja hoidon jatkuvuutta.

Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden syventää osaamistasi diabeteshoitotyön asiantuntijana ja kehittää diabeteksen hoitoa yhdessä osaavan ja motivoituneen työyhteisön kanssa. Perehdytys suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti aiemman osaamisesi pohjalta.

Etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, joka kohtaa asiakkaat arvostavasti ja tukee heitä pitkäjänteisesti omahoidossa. Diabeteshoitajana toimit keskeisessä roolissa hoidon jatkuvuuden varmistamisessa. Toivomme sinulta asiakaslähtöistä työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja suunnitelmallisesti. Arvostamme halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja ylläpitää ammattitaitoasi muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.

Arvostamme lisäksi aikaisempaa kokemusta diabeteshoitotyöstä, diabeteshoitajan erityisosaamista tai muuta diabeteksen hoitoon liittyvää lisäkoulutusta. Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta diabeteshoidon uusiin toimintamalleihin ja teknologioihin sekä kehittämismyönteistä asennetta. Erityisen iloisia olemme hakijasta, joka viihtyy yhteistyössä, jakaa osaamistaan ja osallistuu aktiivisesti tiimin arkeen.

Diabetespalveluissa on yksikköä: pohjoinen, keskinen ja läntinen, joissa on 4 toimipistettä: Kerava, Koivukylä, Tikkurila ja Myyrmäki. Yksikössä työskentelee yhteensä 14 diabeteshoitajaa ja useita diabetesvastuulääkäreitä.

Tehtävä sijoittuu neljän toimipisteen muodostamaan kokonaisuuteen. Toivomme sinulta joustavaa työotetta ja valmiutta työskennellä eri toimipisteissä. Kaikki toimipisteemme ovat helposti saavutettavissa julkisilla liikennevälineillä ja sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä.

Haastattelut voidaan aloittaa jo hakuaikana ja valinta pyritään tekemään mahdollisimman pian hakuajan päätyttyä.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

Tutustu meihin tarkemmin > [Meille töihin-sivullamme](https://vakehyva.fi/fi/tyopaikat)

title: Banamex Analista de Proyectos Estratégicos
location: Ciudad De Mexico Distrito Federal Mexico
description:
The Business Development Officer is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the subfunction/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize all possible channels to source quality new-to-bank clients with potential to generate business across lending, treasury, capital markets, cash management products.
  • Responsible for the entire process of new client acquisition from identifying prospects, delivering customized financial service solutions to completing facility availment.
  • Facilitate client on-boarding process by resolving operations and service issues that may arise.
  • Work in preparing credit assessments and monitoring risk issues by liaising with clients on any document deficiency or requests for more information.
  • Follow up with clients on offer acceptance and confirm the facility is successfully availed.
  • Keep supervisor informed about key changes in market conditions, trend, clients information, etc., and escalate potential issues and concerns promptly.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, commerce, engineering or related disciplines
  • 2-5 years relevant commercial banking experience
  • Good record of proactively building relationships with product and credit review/approval partners


Education:

  • Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Objetivo del puesto

Fortalecer la toma de decisiones y ejecución de iniciativas del negocio mediante el análisis de información, identificación de oportunidades y desarrollo, coordinación, y seguimiento de proyectos, contribuyendo al crecimiento, rentabilidad y mejora de la cartera.


Responsabilidades principales

  • Realizar minería, procesamiento y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos mediante SQL y SAS, generando información relevante para la toma de decisiones.
  • Analizar el comportamiento de la cartera para identificar tendencias, oportunidades de crecimiento, áreas de mejora y posibles desviaciones, convirtiendo los hallazgos en recomendaciones y propuestas de negocio.
  • Desarrollar Business Cases para evaluar nuevas iniciativas, considerando impacto esperado, beneficios, costos y viabilidad.
  • Realizar seguimiento y análisis de P&L e indicadores de desempeño, identificando desviaciones, causas y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Tener un rol activo en el desarrollo y seguimiento de proyectos e iniciativas de negocio de punta a punta, desde su conceptualización hasta su implementación.
  • Elaborar y dar seguimiento a requerimientos e historias de usuario, asegurando que las necesidades del negocio sean correctamente entendidas y atendidas por las áreas involucradas.
  • Coordinar el seguimiento de proyectos con equipos multidisciplinarios, estableciendo actividades, responsables y fechas compromiso, dando visibilidad sobre avances y pendientes.
  • Identificar oportunamente riesgos, desviaciones y bloqueos en los proyectos, gestionando su solución y escalamiento cuando sea necesario para asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos.
  • Participar y dar seguimiento a pruebas, validaciones e implementación, verificando que las soluciones desarrolladas cumplan con los requerimientos definidos.
  • Realizar seguimiento posterior a la implementación para medir resultados e impacto de las iniciativas, identificando oportunidades de optimización.
  • Desarrollar análisis y reportes que permitan medir el desempeño de estrategias e iniciativas implementadas y generar recomendaciones para su mejora.


Perfil requerido

  • Experiencia sólida en minería y análisis de datos.
  • Manejo de SQL y Deseable SAS.
  • Experiencia en desarrollo, coordinación y seguimiento de proyectos, idealmente relacionados con productos, procesos o iniciativas de negocio.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información y transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones accionables para el negocio.
  • Conocimiento y capacidad para desarrollar Business Cases y análisis de P&L.(Deseable)
  • Capacidad para elaborar requerimientos e historias de usuario y trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios (Deseable)
  • Habilidad para dar seguimiento simultáneo a diferentes iniciativas, establecer prioridades e impulsar el cumplimiento de compromisos.
    Pensamiento analítico, estructurado y orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio de manera proactiva, no únicamente atender solicitudes de información.
  • Capacidad para comunicar avances, resultados, riesgos y recomendaciones de manera clara y ejecutiva.
  • Alto sentido de ownership, seguimiento y ejecución, con capacidad para llevar las iniciativas desde su definición hasta su implementación y medición de resultados.

title: Performance Testing - VOIS
description:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking a performance testing professional to lead non-functional testing (NFT) strategy and execution across complex Telecom technology landscapes, including Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. This role plays a critical part in shaping the QA vision, driving automation, ensuring delivery efficiency, and collaborating closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers and multi-vendor partners to deliver high-quality, scalable and resilient solutions.

What you’ll do

  • Plan, define and execute end-to-end performance and non-functional testing strategies aligned to delivery approach, project risks and business priorities.
  • Establish and implement a clear QA and performance testing vision, ensuring consistency, efficiency and continuous improvement across programmes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define performance acceptance criteria, design dynamic test scripts and scenarios, and coordinate test execution.
  • Execute and manage performance tests, analyse results, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Define and track testing metrics, processes, tools and reporting mechanisms to ensure effective delivery governance.
  • Work closely with product owners and development teams to resolve performance issues and assure quality of test deliverables.
  • Drive increased levels of test automation and promote reusability of test assets such as scripts and data sets across projects.
  • Maintain and baseline the NFT test strategy, updating it in line with changes to scope, schedule, risk profile or delivery model.
  • Provide input into resource planning, effort estimation and budgeting for performance testing initiatives.
  • Mentor team members, support capability development, and contribute to recruitment planning in collaboration with test leadership.
  • Communicate proactively with IT operations, developers and product teams, escalating risks and issues where required.
  • Deliver regular and ad-hoc status reporting in line with agreed methodologies, milestones and service levels.

Who you are

  • An experienced performance testing practitioner with strong understanding of Telecom technology stacks and enterprise delivery environments.
  • Confident in using load and performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI across multiple protocols.
  • Experienced in CI/CD environments and cloud-based infrastructures and applications.
  • Skilled in performance test scripting, execution, and detailed analysis of non-functional requirements and volumetric data.
  • Technically proficient with working knowledge of C, Java, VB macros, basic SQL and shell scripting to customise and enhance test automation.
  • Knowledgeable in Java/JVM architecture, including garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps, and database performance analysis (Oracle and SQL Server).
  • Experienced in application and infrastructure monitoring using APM tools such as HP Diagnostics, CA Wily, Dynatrace or AppDynamics.
  • Able to translate complex performance results into clear technical and business insights.
  • Familiar with supporting tools such as Fiddler, Firebug, HAR and Lighthouse (advantageous).
  • A collaborative communicator with strong interpersonal skills, comfortable working in multicultural, matrix environments.
  • Fluent in English, adaptable to change, customer-focused, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Willing and able to travel to Europe intermittently, as required.

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's in it for you

  • Exposure to large-scale, global Telecom transformation programmes.
  • Opportunities to work with modern cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines and advanced performance engineering practices.
  • A collaborative, inclusive environment that values continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
  • The ability to influence quality outcomes and performance standards across critical customer-facing systems.

What skills you will learn

  • Advanced performance engineering and automation techniques across complex, distributed architectures.
  • Strategic test planning and governance in large, multi-vendor delivery models.
  • Enhanced stakeholder management and communication skills across global teams.
  • Deeper expertise in application performance monitoring, diagnostics and root-cause analysis.

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Department Overview

TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), a member of TD Bank Group, is a leading North American investment manager offering progressive investment solutions to both institutional and individual investors. As of December 31, 2023 TDAM and its affiliates manage over CDN$410 billion in assets on behalf of pension, insurance, endowment/foundation and corporate clients, as well as high-net worth clients and retail mutual funds, across both active fundamental and quantitative-based solutions, private debts and alternative investments including real estate, infrastructure.

Job Description (responsibilities, accountabilities, etc.)

A passion or demonstrated interest in markets/economics/current events is critical to success:The Intern will support the team with some or all of the following activities.

  • Work with one of the following teams within TDAM - Fundamental Equities Research, Fixed Income or Asset Liability Management, Asset Allocation, Alternatives , or Investment Risk Management.

  • Build and maintain analytics to help facilitate portfolio decision making, data analysis or financial analysis to help understand and recommend investments or to better understand the macro-economic environment

  • Help run and support mission critical reporting used by the portfolio managers and attend and participate in team meetings and investment discussions.

  • Validate data to ensure the integrity of the data and information

  • Support projects focused on the ongoing improvement of our processes

  • Undertake projects touching on strategy, marketing, business and product development, portfolio management, finance, risk, governance, client service, operations and trading

Skills that the student must have (specific technical, and other skills)

  • Organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, multi-task and maintain attention to detail

  • Good foundation in business acumen, capital markets, problem solving skills and analytical capabilities

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint and Word)

  • Strong verbal and written presentation skills

  • Accuracy and attention to detail are essential

  • Highly motivated individual with the willingness and flexibility to take on different initiatives

  • Ability to operate within specialty software programs (e.g. Bloomberg, Factset, Thomson Reuters or Capital IQ etc.)

  • Must be able to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate across teams to research fulsome solutions

  • Bilingualism (French and English) is an asset

Skills that are not required, but would be an asset (specific technical, and other skills)

  • Microsoft Access, Python/SQL/Coding skills, financial modelling

  • VBA and SQL

  • Co-op experience in investment research, real estate, public and private securities analysis, risk management

Other information

Applications must include an unofficial university transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (two letter-sized pages or less).

Addition Information

Hybrid work model – 4 days of in-person/office.

More about our Investment teams:

Asset Allocation:

The TD Asset Allocation team manages multi-asset class investment solutions for clients across retail, high net worth and institutional channels. We build portfolios with mutual fund, ETF, real asset, and derivative capabilities, investing across asset classes including Equities, Fixed Income, Hybrid Securities, Foreign Exchange, Commodities, Real Estate, and Infrastructure Assets. The Asset Allocation investment process includes a thorough analysis of the global macroeconomic environment and trends in asset class dynamics, fund manager due diligence and bottom-up fundamental analysis to allocate to asset classes, funds, and direct index securities. The Funds can dynamically shift between asset classes and market, including the use of derivatives to modify the return and risk profile. Our goal is to help our clients achieve their long-term investment goals through the use of diversified investment solutions.

Fixed Income:

The Fixed Income team at TD Asset Management is one of the largest in Canada. The team manages a whole range of active fixed income solutions for both retail and institutional clients, requiring investment excellence both from a bottom up (credit research) security selection point of view and a top down (macro risk) asset allocation point of view. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work with Credit Analysts and Portfolio Managers in an investment environment that is engaging, dynamic and collaborative and focused on delivering the best outcomes for our clients.

Asset Liability Management:

The Asset Liability Management team manages approximately $50 billion in investments. Work alongside a close-knit team that designs and manages investment solutions for TDAM's liability-focused clients.

Fundamental Equities:

The Fundamental Equities Team is focused on deep fundamental research, using our experience and expertise to identify attractive investment opportunities for clients. The Team uses a combination of fundamental qualitative and quantitative analysis to identify companies with strong fundamentals, attractive valuations, and sustainable competitive advantage. We believe in active management and constantly monitor our holdings to ensure they meet our strict investment criteria. Our goal is to help clients achieve their financial objectives.

Alternative Investments:

The Alternative Investment team manages over $40bn in AUM in private market strategies at TD Asset Management. We manage direct investments in Canadian Real Estate, Global Real Estate, Infrastructure, Commercial Mortgages and Private Debt. The team includes investment management teams for each asset class, as well as client portfolio management, finance and portfolio and funds management teams to support all aspects of the investment process within Alternative Investments. We make direct investments doing bottom-up analysis on individual assets as well as top-down analysis on markets and regions as well as supporting the ongoing management of the investment funds with activities such as valuations, cash flow management, finance and accounting and client support within private markets. With a focus on income and income growth we build high quality portfolios of private assets to serve our clients.

Trading:

The Trading Team facilitates trade execution across multiple asset classes on behalf of the Active, Passive, Quantitative and Private Client portfolio management strategies managed by TDAM. These include global equity, futures, options, money market, fixed income and foreign exchange.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. title: Team Success Specialist
description:

The Team Success Specialist plays a critical role in creating that experience by ensuring employees are equipped, supported, and prepared from their first day through every stage of their employment.

This position serves as the central point of coordination for employee equipment, uniforms, supplies, company assets, and operational resources. The Team Success Specialist helps maintain a positive employee experience by proactively identifying needs, solving problems, and ensuring team members have what they need to perform their jobs effectively.

If you're highly organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and enjoy helping others succeed, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.

Roles & Responsibilities

New Hire Setup & Onboarding Support

  • Equipment recovery and asset tracking compliance.

Why Join Omni Home Services?

Our people are our greatest asset. The Team Success Specialist plays a direct role in helping every employee succeed by ensuring they have the tools, equipment, supplies, and support needed to perform at their best. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across multiple growing companies while helping build an exceptional employee experience and culture of support.

title: Platform Engineer - LLM Inference Infrastructure
description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.

We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.

Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

About the role

We run a multi-tenant LLM inference platform: customers send requests to an OpenAI-compatible gateway, and we handle routing, tenancy, access control, usage metering and billing on top of our own GPU fleet.

You would own backend services and the Kubernetes platform they run on. This is not a role where infrastructure is someone else’s problem, you write the Go service, the Helm chart, the network policy and the runbook, and you are the one who verifies it in production.

We are moving deliberately toward a Kubernetes-native architecture: less imperative tooling and hand-run scripts, more declarative APIs, custom resources and controllers that reconcile state. If you have wanted to build operators and control planes rather than consume them, that is the direction of this role.

Your responsibilities

  • Backend services in Go - the platform API, the customer-facing usage API, the metering and billing pipeline. Small, focused services with real correctness requirements.

  • Kubernetes-native platform work - GitOps deployment, custom resources and controllers, progressive rollout, network policy, secret and certificate management. Moving what is currently scripted into something that reconciles.

  • Multi-tenancy and access control - tenant provisioning, per-project model access, credential handling across environments.

  • Usage metering and billing correctness - a pipeline that turns raw requests into per-tenant token accounting, plus the reconciliation that proves what we bill matches what actually happened. This is money, and it has to be right.

  • Observability - logs, metrics and traces that answer questions during an incident rather than after it.

Your key competencies

  • 4+ years of experience

  • Strong Go. You have shipped and maintained production Go services, and you are comfortable with concurrency, context propagation and error handling that fails loudly instead of silently.

  • Real Kubernetes depth. Not just kubectl apply. You understand the control loop, know why a pod is not ready without guessing, and have written Helm charts, network policies and RBAC that you then had to debug.

  • SQL and relational data modelling. PostgreSQL specifically. You can reason about transactions, indexes and migration safety.

  • You verify your work. You do not report something as working because it deployed and the health check is green. You go and prove it, and you say plainly what you did not test.

  • Clear written English. Design notes, runbooks, incident write-ups. Much of our engineering context lives in writing.

Nice to have

  • Building Kubernetes operators / controllers (controller-runtime, CRDs, kubebuilder, Operator SDK)

  • GitOps at scale - Argo CD or Flux, ApplicationSets, multi-cluster

  • LLM serving internals - vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, KServe, or similar; GPU scheduling, batching, KV cache behaviour

  • Distributed messaging (NATS, Kafka) and event-driven pipelines

  • Traefik or Envoy/Istio at the ingress layer

  • Time-series and log stores (VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs, Prometheus, ClickHouse)

  • Frontend competence (React + TypeScript) - our operator console is ours to maintain, and being able to fix it end to end is valuable

  • Billing, metering or payments systems, or anything else where being wrong is expensive

  • Python, for the gateway extension layer

Why Verda

  • Cash and equity compensation along with various fringe benefits (healthcare, lunch, wellbeing, and more).

  • Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

  • 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

  • A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

  • Work mode: Based in Helsinki / London or remote in Europe

  • Level: Senior

  • Employment type: Full time and permanent

What's next

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email.

description:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to lead the end‑to‑end technical ownership of enterprise applications within systems. This role plays a critical part in ensuring architectural alignment, release governance, production stability and DevOps transformation across complex platforms. The individual will act as a senior technical authority, driving platform stability , operational resilience and effective collaboration with Stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Own end‑to‑end architecture and platform accountability for enterprise applications, ensuring alignment with strategic and operational objectives.
  • Driving platform stability, operational resilience and effective collaboration with Stake Holders.
  • Define and govern stability, resilience, performance, scalability and availability standards.
  • Lead release governance across the delivery lifecycle, ensuring production readiness, deployment approvals and rollback strategies.
  • Act as the final Level‑3 escalation point for high‑priority incidents, leading root cause analysis, defect resolution and service restoration.
  • Champion DevOps practices by defining and implementing CI/CD pipelines and automation strategies.
  • Govern multi‑environment landscapes, including infrastructure upgrades, disaster recovery readiness and capacity planning.
  • Engage with Technical stakeholders, providing clear technical direction and executive‑level reporting to support decision‑making.

Who you are

  • An accomplished technical professional with extensive experience in Oracle RODOD telecom IT environments.
  • Highly skilled in Siebel CRM, BRM, FMW,OSM/UIM, OSS, DevOps tooling and modern infrastructure platforms including cloud and container technologies.
  • Confident in release, change, incident and problem management within large‑scale production systems.
  • Experienced in working across multi‑vendor delivery models and influencing senior stakeholders through clear, evidence‑based recommendations.

A collaborative leader who applies sound judgement, structured thinking and a continuous improvement mindset

Not a perfect fit?

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's in it for you

  • Opportunity to shape and influence large‑scale enterprise platforms within a global organisation.
  • Exposure to complex transformation programmes spanning architecture, DevOps and cloud modernisation.
  • A role that combines strategic decision‑making with hands‑on technical leadership.

What skills you will learn

  • Advanced enterprise architecture governance within a large, regulated environment.
  • Leading DevOps transformation and automation at scale.
  • Strengthening stakeholder engagement and executive communication capabilities in complex delivery landscapes.

Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

title: Regulatory Specialist (UK team)
description:
Your knowledge can open doors for patients worldwide — become a key driver of regulatory excellence with us.

Come and join us as a Regulatory Specialist.

The opportunity

You’ll be joining a 6‑member Regulatory Marketing Authorization team that supports the British markets within a wider organization of approximately 130 colleagues. Our group plays a key role in both national (member‑state) marketing authorization processes and broader European regulatory activities.

We would like you to:

According to the requirements of the assigned end market, you will be responsible for:

  • Acting as a specialist within the team

  • Acquiring marketing authorizations for medicines in line with SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines

  • Maintaining existing marketing authorizations according to market specific requirements and internal procedures

  • Preparing and sending notifications to Trademark Holders in compliance with SOPs and WIs

  • Managing end to end submission processes, ensuring high quality documentation and smooth cross functional collaboration

  • Monitoring and interpreting regulatory and legislative changes, implementing them in daily operations

  • Performing core operational regulatory tasks, including submissions, maintenance activities, compliance support, and documentation management

  • Developing and maintaining SOPs, working instructions, and regulatory guidelines, and delivering internal trainings

  • Participating in and occasionally leading ad hoc projects, such as proof reading or process improvement initiatives

  • Providing professional guidance to junior colleagues and contributing to strategic decision making within the regulatory function.

What we need you to have:

  • 5+ years of regulatory expertise in a multinational environment

  • Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, or equivalent field

  • Strong ability to track, interpret, and apply legislative and regulatory changes

  • Professional conduct in English (C1 level)

  • Experience in communication with authorities and confidence in handling market specific regulatory expectations

  • Ability to work independently, make well founded decisions, and contribute to strategic thinking within the regulatory function

  • Capability to manage the full submission lifecycle: from business request to complete documentation, collaborating with graphic designers and business development

  • Willingness to participate in operational tasks, including submissions, maintenance, compliance, SOP and WI creation, trainings, and ad hoc projects (e.g., proof reading)

What we offer:

  • Support for work-life balance, flexible management approach;

  • Abacus is a long-term opportunity, we encourage your professional development with internal job opportunities and trainings;

  • Quarterly company bonus;

  • Cafeteria with optional elements;

  • Annual salary increase;

  • Employee referral program with high rewards;

  • AYCM SportPass membership opportunity;

  • Private health insurance package provided by Medicare after 6 months of employment.

Are you interested?

If you want to apply, please use the apply link and attach your resumé.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Moving Healthcare. Moving You.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,300 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

title: Peruskoulun päätoiminen tuntiopettaja resurssiopetukseen, Tiistilän koulu
description:
Haemme upeaan joukkoomme resurssiopettajaa. Sinun ei tarvitse pohtia yksin uuden tuenmuotojen toteuttamista vaan pääset työskentelemään yläkoulussa kolmen ammattitaitoisen erityisluokanopettajan, viiden erityisopettajan ja kahden kieli- ja kulttuuriryhmien opettajan tiimissä unohtamatta koulunkäynninohjaajia. Työsi on monipuolista ja haastavaa.
Tiistilän koulu on aloittanut opetuksen syksyllä 2024 täysin uudessa, puurakenteisessa koulurakennuksessa. Tiistilän koulu on ensi vuonna noin 800 oppilaan yhtenäinen peruskoulu ja henkilökuntaa on noin 85. Olemme laadukasta perusopetusta antava lähikoulu. Lisäksi meillä on yläkoulussa urhea-liikuntapainotusluokka.

Koulun nimi ja osoite: Tiistilän koulu, Tiistilänkuja 4, 02230 Espoo
Työaika: OVTES:in mukainen.
Haettava tehtävä on virkasuhteinen.
Haettava tehtävä on määräaikainen.
Palvelussuhde alkaa 28.9.2026.
Tämä työpaikka on esteetön.
Palkka: OVTES:in mukainen. Hinnoittelutunnuksen mukainen peruspalkka määräytyy henkilön koulutuksen perusteella. Tehtäväänsä kelpoiselle valmistavassa opetuksessa toimivalle kieli- ja kulttuuriryhmien opettajalle maksetaan hinnoittelukohdan mukaisen peruspalkan lisäksi työn vaativuuteen perustuvaa lisää. Hinnoittelutunnuksen mukaiset peruspalkat https://www.kt.fi/sopimukset/ovtes/palkat-palkkiot

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Peruskoulun aineenopettajan kelpoisuus.

Opettajan kelpoisuudet määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen no 986/98 mukaisesti. Asetuksen 9 §:n mukaisesti perusopetusta antavalla opettajalla tulee olla suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Määräaikaisissa tehtävissä huomioimme myös ei-kelpoiset hakijat.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Arvostamme kykyä ja halua yhteistyöhön koulun eri toimijoiden kanssa sekä käytännön näkemystä ja kokemusta ja ajatuksia uuden perusopetuslain tuen toteuttamisesta.

Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

Toimintamme perustuu avoimuuteen ja luottamukseen, ja kohtaamme toisemme arvostavasti. Olemme sitoutuneet yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseen ja toivomme työyhteisöömme eri-ikäisiä, eri taustoista ja eri kieliä puhuvia osaajia.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä tehtävän lisätietojen antajaan.

Erityistarpeisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit ottaa yhteyttä: keha.rekrytointi@espoo.fi. Käsittelemme yhteydenotot luottamuksellisesti.

Lue lisää: https://www.esitteemme.fi/espoonrekry/MailView/

title: Kantpressare till Holms Attachment AB  i Motala
description:
Om företaget
Holms Attachments AB är ett av Motalas äldsta bolag och grundades 1927. Företaget är i dagsläget marknadsledande inom flera produktnischer kopplat till löpande underhåll av vägar och industriella utomhusytor. Frontmonterad sop- och snöutrustning är kärnprodukter. Holms Attachments AB har de senaste åren uppvisat en god organisk tillväxt och har en tydlig strategi för att ytterligare expandera sin verksamhet. Produktionen i Motala behöver nu resursförstärkning i form av en flexibel montör!

För mer information om företaget och dess produkter, klicka dig gärna in på nedanstående länkar.


Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som kantpressare hos Holms Attachments AB blir du en viktig del av produktionen där du arbetar med bearbetning och bockning av plåtkomponenter utifrån ritningar och specifikationer. Du ansvarar för att ställa in, programmera och köra kantpressmaskiner samt säkerställa att produkterna håller rätt kvalitet enligt uppsatta krav.

Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat:

  • Inställning och programmering av kantpressmaskiner

  • Bockning och formning av plåt enligt ritning

  • Kvalitetskontroller och mätning av färdiga detaljer

  • Ritningsläsning och arbete utifrån produktionsunderlag

  • Löpande underhåll och tillsyn av maskiner

  • Samarbete med kollegor inom produktion för att säkerställa effektiva flöden

Din profil
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete som kantpressare, plåtbearbetare eller inom liknande industriell produktion. Du har god teknisk förståelse och är van att läsa ritningar. För att lyckas i rollen är du noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av kantpressning eller annan plåtbearbetning

  • Kunskap inom ritningsläsning och mätteknik

  • God teknisk förståelse

  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för ditt arbete

  • God samarbetsförmåga och ett positivt förhållningssätt

Har du erfarenhet av programmering av kantpressmaskiner är det meriterande. Truck- och traverskort är ett krav.

Arbetstiden är förlagd på dagtid.

Ansökningsförfarande
I denna process samarbetar Holms Attachments AB med oss på Skill för att hitta rätt medarbetare. Uppdraget inleds med en visstidsanställning på 6 månader hos Skill, med en tydlig ambition att anställningen därefter ska övergå till en fast tjänst hos Holms Attachments AB.
Vid frågor om tjänsten går det bra att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Malin Åkerblom på malin.akerblom@skill.se

Lycka till med din ansökan!

title: Innovation Project Leader - Mechanical
description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

Your mission, roles and responsibilities

Autonomous management and co-ordination of Innovation projects for new and further development of materials, products & processes in the field of automobile interior. Definition and completion of the Innovation project targets according to FIS internal Innovation process in respect of time and budget targets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning and Budget Control
    Define project objectives, plans, resources, timelines, and budgets; monitor project costs and initiate corrective actions or budget adjustments as needed.
  • Cross-functional Innovation Project Management
    Lead and coordinate innovation projects across multiple functions (e.g. GTS, Testing, Design, Purchasing, Marketing, Quality) to deliver concept studies, feasibility analyses, and validation plans in line with global innovation processes.
  • Project Review and Milestone Governance
    Organize and conduct regular project reviews and milestone presentations to key stakeholders and Innovation Committees; ensure clear decisions, actions, and follow-up.
  • Innovation Deliverables and Knowledge Management
    Ensure proper documentation of innovation results, including reports, concepts, prototypes, and simulations; maintain project documentation and contribute to the knowledge management system.
  • Innovation Transfer, IP Protection, and Team Leadership
    Support smooth transfer of innovation projects into serial development, ensure patent protection, manage external partners and suppliers, and supervise innovation engineers and cross-functional team members.

Your profile and competencies to succeed

  • Degree (Master) in Engineering, ideally in any of the following engineering disciplines: Tooling, Polymer/Composite, Transport/Automotive, Mechanisms, Mechatronics, Electronics, HMI, Lighting,
  • At least 3-5 years pre-development experience within an industrial environment, especially in the automotive industry.
  • At least 5-year experience in mechatronic product development of interiors or seating, such as armrest, seat frame, sliding track, electric actuators and so on.
  • Excellent at operating CAD software(CATIA/NX), be able to design key mechanical structure independently and lead external CAD engineer to finalize full 2D/3D CAD data
  • Structured & systematic with scientific & engineering mindset.
  • Team Player with extended communication skills at all levels.
  • Self driven & dynamic.
  • International mindset.
  • English is compulsory.

What we can do for you

  • At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
  • We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
  • We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
  • We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
  • We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
  • Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.

Why join us

FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.

title: Learning Design Manager
description:
Overview

Learning Design Manager

Help create learning that empowers people to grow, thrive and make a difference.

Learning has the power to unlock potential.

At Change Grow Live, we're building a workforce that is skilled, confident and supported to make a meaningful difference in communities across the UK. As we work towards our 2030 ambitions, we're investing in learning that helps people develop, adapt and succeed, whatever their role, background or career journey.

That's why we're looking for a Learning Design Manager to join our national Learning and Development team.

This is an opportunity to shape learning across a values-driven organisation where people are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work, share ideas and continuously grow. You'll play an important role in creating learning experiences that build confidence, strengthen capability and help colleagues deliver the best possible outcomes for the people we support.

If you believe learning should be engaging, accessible and genuinely impactful, we'd love to hear from you.

The opportunity

Learning is at the heart of organisational success.

As our Learning Design Manager, you'll help shape how learning is experienced across Change Grow Live, ensuring it is inclusive, accessible and aligned to the needs of our people and services.

Working closely with colleagues across the organisation, you'll lead the design and development of blended learning solutions that support growth, encourage curiosity and help individuals build the skills and confidence they need to succeed.

You'll lead a talented team, collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and create learning experiences that support both individual development and organisational goals.

This is more than a leadership role in learning design. It's an opportunity to influence how a national organisation develops its people, embraces innovation and builds the capabilities needed to deliver on our ambitions for the future.

How you'll make a difference

Create engaging learning experiences

Design and oversee innovative learning solutions that support colleagues at every stage of their development, ensuring learning is practical, relevant and accessible to all.

Champion quality and inclusion

Embed high standards for learning design while ensuring learning reflects diverse experiences, meets accessibility needs and creates equitable opportunities for development.

Support and develop your team

Lead, coach and inspire a specialist team, creating an environment where people feel supported, valued and empowered to do their best work.

Build strong partnerships

Work collaboratively with operational colleagues, subject matter experts and stakeholders to understand challenges and co-create effective learning solutions.

Encourage continuous improvement

Use evidence, feedback and insight to evaluate learning effectiveness and continuously enhance the learner experience.

Drive innovation

Explore new approaches, technologies and methods that help make learning more engaging, effective and accessible.

The details

Location: National role with hybrid working and regular travel.

Your contractual base will be the Change Grow Live office nearest to your home address.

If your contractual base is in London, you will receive London Weighting in line with Change Grow Live policy.

Please note: Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Please note: candidates who have previously applied for this vacancy will not be considered and are not required to reapply.

Responsibilities

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who is curious, collaborative and passionate about helping others learn and grow.

You may bring experience from different sectors or environments, but you'll likely have:

  • Significant experience leading learning design within a complex organisation
  • Expertise in blended, digital and technology-enabled learning
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles, learning science and behaviour change
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams
  • The ability to engage, influence and build credibility with stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience using insight, data and evidence to evaluate learning effectiveness
  • Strong project management and organisational skills
  • A passion for creating learning experiences that deliver measurable impact

Most importantly, you'll share our belief that learning can create lasting positive change for individuals, teams and communities.

Why join Change Grow Live?

Change Grow Live is a national charity driven by the belief that everyone has the potential to make positive changes in their lives.

Guided by our values to Be Open, Be Compassionate and Be Bold, we're building an organisation that is built on evidence and compassion and rooted in communities.

As we look ahead to 2030, we're focused on developing a skilled, confident and future-ready workforce, using learning, insight and innovation to continuously improve outcomes.

As Learning Design Manager, you'll play a vital role in helping colleagues develop the knowledge, skills and confidence needed to deliver on that ambition every day.

You'll join a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation where innovation is encouraged, ideas are welcomed and your contribution will have visible impact across the organisation.

A workplace where you can belong

At Change Grow Live, we believe our diversity is one of our greatest strengths.

We actively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and able to thrive.

We recognise that no candidate will meet every single requirement. If you're excited by this opportunity and believe your experience, skills or potential could help you succeed in the role, we'd encourage you to apply.

What we offer

We know that when our people thrive, our organisation thrives too.

That's why we offer:

  • 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), increasing annually to 30 days
  • A paid weekly Wellness Hour
  • Access to our wellbeing hub and Employee Assistance Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • A wide range of employee benefits and discounts
  • Learning, development and progression opportunities
  • A supportive and values-led environment where people are encouraged to grow and succeed

Our commitment to our people

We're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We do this by:

  • Creating the conditions for success for all colleagues and volunteers
  • Working together to deliver high-quality learning and organisational development
  • Building an inclusive culture where every voice is valued
  • Investing in the development and wellbeing of our people
  • Encouraging innovation, curiosity and continuous improvement

Ready to help shape the future of learning?

If you're passionate about creating learning that empowers people, builds confidence and supports meaningful change, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether your expertise comes from the charity sector, healthcare, education, public services or another complex environment, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact in a national organisation committed to helping people fulfil their potential.

Application guidance

When completing your application, please refer to the Job Description and demonstrate clearly how your skills, knowledge and experience meet the essential criteria for the role. We encourage you to provide specific examples and evidence of the impact you've made in previous positions.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a useful tool when preparing an application, and you're welcome to use it.

However, we're most interested in understanding you.

Please ensure your application reflects your own experiences, achievements and strengths, clearly demonstrating how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

The strongest applications are authentic, specific and evidence-based, helping us understand the unique contribution you can bring to Change Grow Live.

Important information

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer Skilled Worker Visa sponsorship for this vacancy. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Direct applications only. We will not be engaging recruitment agencies for this vacancy.

Salary Range (pro rata if part time)

CGL points 38 to 42 (£42,076.87 - £46,683.60)

ILW / OLW /Fringe

N/A - Outside London Weighting Area

Closing Date

13/9/2026

If you have any questions on this opportunity that you would like to talk through please contact us using the below details:

Liszel Nathaniel | liszel.nathaniel@cgl.org.uk

description:
