title: Architect, Electrical & Electronics
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Architect – Electrical & Electronics is responsible for shaping robust hardware and subsystem architectures that enable accurate, reliable, and compliant molecular diagnostic products. This role guides critical design and technology decisions to improve instrument performance, reduce technical risk, and accelerate solutions that strengthen patient outcomes.

This position reports to the Principal Electrical Engineer and is part of the Systems R&D Software – IDC located in Bangalore and will be an on-site role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Define electrical hardware architecture, leading its integration with mechanical and firmware systems across connectivity, compute, user interface, pressure, vibration, optics and thermal domains.
  • Influence components, topology, and technology selection through trade-off analyses involving performance, cost, power, size, EMI/EMC, and reliability.
  • Define critical-to-quality and critical-to-function parameters and quantify performance against requirements.
  • Advance technical roadmaps by evaluating alternative technologies and improving the robustness, reliability, and performance of critical subsystems.
  • Support diagnostic instruments and devices throughout their lifecycle by addressing regulatory compliance, field issues, yield improvements, and cost optimization.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, with 12+ years of experience in electrical hardware design and development for complex electromechanical products.
  • Expertise in completing product certification for CE marking and electrical compliance standards such as IEC 61326-2-6 , IEC 61000-3-x, 60601-1-2 and IEC 61010-1, and FCC Part 15 Subpart B.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Cadence, Xpedition, or Altium design tool suites, including schematic design and printed circuit board layout review.
  • Experience in designing and reviewing analog, digital, mixed-signal, power electronics, data-acquisition, and system power-distribution hardware.
  • Experience in applying risk analysis, design FMEA, reliability engineering practices, signal and power integrity analysis, EMI/EMC compliance and hardware verification.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel as required and collaborate with global internal and external stakeholders.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Board-level circuit design experience with FPGA-based embedded systems for motion control and/or data acquisition, including RTL development using Verilog or VHDL, is preferred.
  • Prior experience with electronic hardware development for PCR or molecular diagnostic instruments is preferred.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit .

title: Senior Agentic Engineer
description:
We’re looking for an exceptional systems thinker who believes AI has fundamentally changed how software should be built.

We are building an AI-first engineering organisation where engineers increasingly design systems, orchestrate agents and build the tools that build the features, rather than writing most code by hand.

This isn't about being good at Cursor or Claude Code.

We’re looking for a deeply experienced, hands-on engineer who has fundamentally redesigned the way they build because of AI: someone who thinks from first principles, designs excellent systems, creates their own agents and tooling, and can take an ambiguous problem from zero → architecture → build → production.

You’ll help us move faster, but more importantly, you'll increase the capability of the engineering team.

You won't simply execute our roadmap.

We expect you to challenge it.

Your purpose in our mission

We’ve raised $17.8 million in Series A funding led by Google Ventures and joined by Khosla Ventures. They believe in our vision that the law should be accessible to everyone, and this is where your skills come in.

We're hiring this person because we need another exceptional technical IC who can help us increase engineering velocity while challenging how and what we build.

The core problem we're tackling is AI Agentic Workflows.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is an exceptional systems thinker

  • Solves difficult problems from first principles

  • Designs excellent technical systems before reaching for implementation

  • Uses AI creatively to multiply their own and the team's productivity

  • Builds agents, subagents, tooling and automation, not simply uses them

  • Thinks in backcasting: starting from the desired outcome and working backwards

  • Has a strong cut strategy: simplifying architecture and identifying the shortest sensible route to an outcome

  • Moves with urgency and cares deeply about momentum

  • Is an exceptional hands-on IC who can own work end-to-end

  • Challenges assumptions and proactively identifies opportunities that aren't already on the roadmap

  • Can explain highly complicated technical ideas in remarkably simple language

  • Is curious, open-minded and constantly experimenting

This is a capability hire, not a capacity hire. We're looking for someone who raises the technical bar of the team.

This is what you’ll be doing

Your purpose is to increase Genie's engineering capability and speed through exceptional systems thinking and agentic leverage.

You won't just ship features.

You'll shape how we build products in the age of AI.

Design exceptional systems from first principles: You'll own technical design for complex problems, identifying technical risks, designing happy paths and edge cases, considering security, and breaking architecture into sensible milestones rather than producing huge theoretical design documents.

Build the machine that builds the feature: A conventional engineer might start by asking: “What already exists in the codebase that I can use to build this?”. We want you to also ask: “What tool could I build that would help build this for me?”. You'll create agents, subagents, software and workflows that allow AI to take on significantly more of the implementation process.

Own products end-to-end: You'll take ambiguous problems from: problem → discovery → technical design → architecture → implementation → verification → production. We care much less about whether you call yourself a frontend or backend engineer than whether you can understand the whole system and design it exceptionally well.

Orchestrate AI, don't just use it: You'll design, build and maintain agentic workflows that create genuine engineering leverage.

Create 10x team leverage: The goal isn't simply to make yourself faster. You'll build systems and tools that increase the output of the people around you too. sharing knowledge, improving workflows and designing for collective intelligence.

Challenge our roadmap: We don't want an engineer who waits for a PM to tell them what to build. Within 6–12 months, an exceptional person in this role will be identifying new ideas, technical opportunities and problems that the rest of us haven't even thought to put on the roadmap yet. You'll influence both engineering and product discovery.


This is how we’ll set you up for success and the outcomes we expect from you

We're a startup in an exceptionally dynamic stage of growth.

The problems we're solving today may look very different in six months. We'll give you context, access and support, but we expect you to create clarity rather than wait for detailed instructions.

By the end of your first month we would like you to:

  • Understand Genie's engineering and product-development workflow

  • Get deeply familiar with our agentic engineering approach

  • Understand how we prioritise speed improvements and legal-quality improvements

  • Begin contributing to our agentic tooling and workflows

By 90 days

We expect you to:

  • Be fluent in our development workflow and priorities

  • Independently identify when and where speed or legal-quality improvements should be made

  • Own meaningful work end-to-end

  • Build/improve agentic tooling and workflows

  • Begin proactively contributing to product and technical direction

By 6–12 months

You'll:

  • Independently design and ship sophisticated AI-native systems

  • Lead technical decisions within your area

  • Create significant engineering leverage through agents and tooling

  • Increase the team's delivery velocity

  • Proactively challenge and improve the roadmap

  • Identify valuable opportunities that weren't obvious to the existing team

We’ll continually develop and measure success on the below criteria:

Systems & technical design quality: Can you understand complicated systems, identify the real problem and design elegant solutions from first principles?

Agentic effectiveness: Are your agents, tools and workflows genuinely multiplying output, or are you simply using AI coding assistants?

Engineering leverage: Are you building things that make the entire team more capable?

Delivery & momentum: Are valuable things getting into production significantly faster because you're here?

Product contribution: Are you identifying valuable problems and opportunities rather than simply implementing an existing roadmap?

We are a start up in an exceptionally dynamic stage of our growth. We are a customer and employee led organisation. What this means is that we adapt to our customers' needs, and the problems we’re solving today could be very different in six months, or even by the end of this recruitment process. We also listen to our team as we empower you to have full autonomy of your role - you're the expert. You should expect to work with us on how your role develops, grows and changes throughout your time at Genie.

It can be tough here because

  • We move very fast

  • Problems change quickly

  • There are few precedents for this kind of engineering

  • You won't always receive detailed specifications

  • You'll need to create clarity from ambiguity

  • We expect engineers to think about what should be built, not simply how to build it

  • Our engineering practices are evolving rapidly as AI capabilities change

  • You'll be expected to challenge established thinking, including ours

But we think you’ll love

  • Working at a truly AI-first company

  • Building in ways much of the engineering industry is only beginning to discover

  • Having radical ownership and autonomy

  • Working alongside ambitious, deeply curious builders

  • Experimenting with new engineering practices rather than following established playbooks

  • Being close to product and technical decisions

  • Building systems that can fundamentally multiply engineering output

  • Challenging the roadmap rather than receiving it

  • Shaping how Genie builds software in the age of AI

  • Helping shape the future of legal infrastructure

The skills you need to succeed in this role

We're looking for an exceptional senior hands-on IC.

But we're much more interested in evidence of engineering excellence than a collection of keywords on a CV.

Exceptional systems thinking: You can understand complex systems and design excellent solutions from first principles. You think about: Architecture, Technical risk, Security, Happy paths, Edge cases, Scale, Simplicity, Milestones, Trade-offs. You know when architecture needs sophistication, and when the best engineering decision is to cut complexity entirely.

Deeply AI-native engineering: You don't simply have "experience using AI coding tools." AI has materially changed how you engineer. You may already be: Building your own agents/subagents, Creating internal developer tooling, Building MCPs or other agent/tool interfaces, Automating parts of your development process, Orchestrating multiple agents etc.

Exceptional hands-on engineering: You are still a builder. You can personally take something from zero through architecture, implementation and into production. We don't want someone whose seniority has taken them far away from the technical work.

Strong product instinct: You don't think your responsibility ends when a ticket lands in Jira. You question assumptions, identify opportunities, understand the user/problem and contribute to what gets built, not merely how.

Outstanding communication: You can explain something technically sophisticated in language almost anyone can understand. You are open-minded enough to have your own ideas challenged and confident enough to challenge ours

(Don’t worry about ticking every single box on the list to be considered for this role.)

Our benefits

Here’s just some of the benefits you can look forward to when you enter the Genie’s lamp:

  • Generous Stock Options: We want all our genies to share in our success

  • Private healthcare: To help keep you fit as a fiddle

  • Fully Remote Working: Work from anywhere your heart desires

  • Unlimited book budget: Dive into an unlimited budget for business, law, or technology books

  • Home Office Setup: Equip your home office with the best – a top-of-the-range laptop, monitor, wireless keyboard, mouse, and a comfortable office chair. Your workspace will be as splendid as a royal palace

  • Learning and Development Budget: Each Genie gets an individual £500 L&D budget annually, plus five days off for any job specific learning adventures

  • Unlimited Holiday: Take as much time off as you need to recharge your batteries

  • Parental Leave: Both genie parents get enhanced leave to welcome their little genies into the world

  • Free access to Genie: For you to create, negotiate and collaborate on legal documents in real time on one platform!


About Genie AI

Genie AI is a machine learning startup with a mission to enable everyone to draft quality legal documents. We're shaking up the legal world and flipping the business model on its head!

Think of what GitHub did with open source code, Instagram and TikTok with entertainment, Airbnb with hospitality, and Uber with travel – Genie AI is doing that with legal contracts. We're conjuring up a community-based AI law platform that'll change the game. Join us, and let’s make some legal magic together!

  • 100,000 companies use Genie AI today - we’ve been growing exponentially!

  • We’re funded by the world’s top investors, with significant runway - and we’re growing the team

  • We’ve collaborated with Oxford University and Imperial College London to co-author research papers on explainable AI

  • According to Forbes, we're also rated one of the top 29 AI startups in the UK

  • We're a Sunday Times Best Places to Work Award Winner 2024

  • We’re backed by top legal pedigree, from Lord Neuberger to representing the UK on multiple Ministry of Justice trade missions

  • Our customers save on average £15,000 on legal fees per year with Genie

  • This isn’t just a SaaS product - we’re redefining the business model of law

Ready to grant wishes and disrupt a £750bn industry? Click apply and join us in creating a world of digital wonders!

At Genie, we’re committed to creating a diverse environment. Whilst we’re on the cutting edge of innovation, it’s all about the people. We embrace differences and hire based on merit, giving equal consideration to all applications, regardless of gender, background and race.

title: Service User Involvement Lead
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live (CGL) are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our teams apply these daily offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Recovery Intervention Service Ealing (RISE) is an integrated end-to-end treatment and recovery service which offers a wide range of pharmacological and psychosocial interventions to Ealing residents 18 years and over who are experiencing issues with illicit drugs and/or alcohol use. RISE is a consortium, with CGL being the lead contractor, and includes Central and North West London NHS Mental Health Trust (CNWL) and service user led organisation Build on Belief (BOB).

We are undertaking an exciting new role to amplify the voices of people with lived and living experience across the service. The aim is to ensure that real feedback from the people who use our service drives meaningful, visible change.

The Service User Involvement Service Lead will champion innovative coproduction, strengthen involvement across the service, and help shape support that reflects the needs, hopes and aspirations of the individuals and communities we work alongside.

This is a mobile, hands-on role suited to someone resilient, empathetic, and motivated to drive change where it matters.

Where: Ealing

Hours: Full time, 37.5 Hours per week

Contract Type: Fixed Term unitl 31st of March 2027

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

About the role:

  • Recruit a diverse range of Lived Experience Volunteers as Pulse Network Members within the service.
  • Deliver accredited induction learning and mentor volunteers to become accredited trainers.
  • Supervise and support the service’s Lived Experience Group Members.
  • Support the service to achieve quarterly Pulse Survey targets (10% feedback), including reporting, evaluation and the You Said, We Did process.
  • Coordinate lived experience representation at service, team, partnership and management meetings.
  • Organise two mystery shop exercises per service per year.
  • Coordinate lived experience interview panels, stakeholder panels and recruitment involvement.
  • Lead creative and meaningful coproduction initiatives; collaborate with the National Lived Experience Group to deliver local and national SUI objectives.
  • Support the service to embed genuine involvement in strategic decisions, service improvement, and future commissioning priorities.

About you:

  • A strong passion for lived experience and coproduction principles.
  • Excellent lived and living experience engagement skills.
  • Strong leadership and organisational abilities.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Creative problem‑solving and innovation mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively with partner agencies, LEROs and community stakeholders.
  • Understanding of feedback processes and data‑driven service improvement.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels.

What We Offer

  • Enjoy a dedicated weekly Wellness Hour, access to our Wellness Hub, and a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental and emotional health.
  • We’re committed to your development, with extensive training, funded learning, and pathways into senior or specialist roles.
  • Benefit from transparent pay, a contributory pension scheme, and additional support through our wellbeing resources.
  • Start with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays(pro rata), increasing to the maximum 30 days over five years of service.
  • Join a supportive, values-led team where you’ll feel encouraged and valued from your very first day.
  • Where possible, we’re open to discussing working patterns that help you maintain a healthy work–life balance.
  • Enjoy discounts on shopping, cinema trips, holidays and more, along with our Refer a Friend scheme.

Please read attached Job Description for a more detailed out line of responsibilities and Person Specifications

If this sounds like you and you would like to begin your journey with Change Grow Live, then we would love to talk to you.

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

description:
Lähihoitaja säännölliseen keikkatyöhön Espoon, Kauniaisten ja Kirkkonummen alueelle

Etsimme lähihoitajaa säännölliseen keikkatyöhön Espoon, Kauniaisten ja Kirkkonummen alueelle. Työ alkaa heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja toivommekin, että voit aloittaa mahdollisimman pian.

Aluksi vuoroja on tarjolla noin 1–2 vuoroa viikossa, pääasiassa iltaisin. Pyrimme mahdollisuuksien mukaan sopimaan työntekijälle vakiopäivät, ja vuorot ovat yleensä muutaman tunnin mittaisia. Työ on joustavasti sovitettavissa esimerkiksi oman työn tai opiskelujen oheen.

Työssä asiakkaat ovat pääasiassa ikäihmisiä ja vammaispalveluiden asiakkaita. Työssä korostuvat asiakkaan kohtaaminen, yksilöllinen huomioiminen sekä itsenäinen ja vastuullinen työote. Kilometrikorvaukset maksetaan liikkumisesta asiakkaiden kotien väliltä.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa sekä Valviran rekisteröintiä
* B-ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta
* voimassa olevaa soteammattikorttia
* asiakaslähtöistä ja kohtaavaa työotetta
* kykyä kunnioittaa asiakkaan yksilöllisiä tarpeita ja toiveita

Kokemus autisminkirjon asiakkaista tai mielenterveyspuolen asiakkuuksista katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme:

* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: 18,53 €/h (sisältäen lomakorvauksen)
* joustavan vakikeikkatyön, jonka voi sovittaa muun työn tai opiskelun oheen
* mahdollisuuden sopia vuoroja etukäteen
* monipuolisia asiakkuuksia Espoon, Kauniaisten ja Kirkkonummen alueella
* kilometrikorvaukset työkohteiden välisistä siirtymistä

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian – aloitamme sopivan henkilön kanssa heti.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Project Construction & Residential
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER NAS division is currently seeking a Senior Sales Engineer - Project Construction & Residential. This is a hybrid position where candidates for this role must reside within 50 miles of our San Antonio, TX or Corpus Christi, TX location to be considered for this position.

What you’ll do:

Position Overview:
The primary function of the Senior Sales Engineer is to sell assigned product lines to targeted customers in targeted market areas. This position will be responsible to achieve the assigned sales goal consistent with the expectations of a thoroughly seasoned professional sales engineer for the assigned product categories while under little supervision. It will be an expectation to optimize sales volume, product mix and profit margin, while increasing sales in the marketplace. This position will need to coordinate sales for the assigned customer and distributor base. It has the responsibility to manage all aspects of the customer relationship, providing sales and technical assistance with distributors, customers, end users and specifiers.

The primary functions include: providing sales and technical assistance with distributors, contractors end users and electrical group personnel; provide timely and accurate information for order entry, while elevating quality issues to attention of management, and ensuring that accurate information flows to market intelligence data on competitive products, customer needs preference and buying habits; support distributor inventories and inventory turns by recommending specific products and levels to be stocked; and provide necessary reports and surveys requested in a timely manner.

In this function you will:
• Provide accurate and timely planning and specification interpretation, quotation and technical support
• Communicate with customers, warehouse and plants to facilitate problem resolutions
• Collect, analyze and utilize market intelligence regarding competitive products, customer needs, preferences and buying habits
• Review and interpret customer needs on plans and specifications
• Provide facility timely solutions to customer issues by utilizing available resources or creating procedure for resolution
• Be aware of and responsive to market conditions and competitive activities while communicating such information to product divisions
• Plan promotional events and presentations with distributor personnel to promote Eaton’s position, while developing a proven record of achieving assigned sales goals
• Prepare and present bids and quotations to customers using company price and delivery guidelines while using sound business judgment

Qualifications:

Required (Basic) Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
• Minimum three (3) years of commercial or technical experience
• Possess a valid driver’s license
• No relocation is offered for this position. All candidates must currently reside within 50 miles of San Antonio, TX or Corpus Christi, TX to be considered. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering

Skills:

Position Criteria:
• Possess excellent communication skills
• Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future
• Ability to respond to a variety of circumstances while continuing to demonstrate superior selling skills for important customer services and applications
• Electrical product knowledge
• Ability to provide technical solutions built around customer needs
• Skilled in time management
• Possess negotiating skills while understanding and using techniques needed to close orders
• Experience with preparing sales proposals that meet customer expectations
• Robust presentation & training skills
• Experience utilizing value-added selling techniques
• Strong work ethic, competitiveness, willingness to learn and adept at building relationships
• Experience working with Bidmanager and Vista
• Ability to travel up to 25%

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

The compensation range for this full-time position includes base pay and target sales performance incentive. This position has a target total compensation range of $107,250 - $157,300.

Base salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

title: Senior DevOps Technologist
description:
Job Title

Senior DevOps Technologist

Job Description

Philips is a global leader in health technology, committed to improving billions of lives worldwide and striving to make the world healthier and more sustainable through innovation. Driven by the vision of a better tomorrow.

But it’s not just what we do, it’s who we are. We are 80,000, wonderfully unique individuals, with two things in common. An unwavering sense of purpose and a relentless determination to deliver on our customers’ needs. It’s what inspires us to create meaningful solutions – the kind that make a real difference – when it matters most.

The world and our customers’ needs are changing faster than ever before and while we are proud of what we do already, we know we can do more. That’s why we need you, to help us tackle increasingly complex challenges posed by ever evolving health and well-being needs.

In this role, you have the opportunity to

Make life better. Looking at the challenges the world is facing today Philips’ purpose has never been more relevant. So whatever your role, if you share our passion for helping others, you’ll be working towards creating a better and fairer future for all.

You are responsible for

  • Deploy multiple digital propositions SaaS applications via automation & orchestration platforms.
  • Implement infrastructure for CI/CD for example Jenkins
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines
  • Consult with customer on CI/CD best practices
  • Implement monitoring across Philips wide Cloud based Platform
  • Create / version / test of scripts (Bash, PowerShell).
  • Automation of installation / configuration / management of n tier web applications in a secure environment, for example Apache Tomcat, MySQL and PostgreSQL– Java and Node.js.
  • Development Operations (DevOps), provision, run scripts and perform UAT / validation testing within secure environment.
  • Collaborate with software development to maintain test / staging / production environments to meet uptime, performance, cost, and security goals.
  • Deliver on SLA to both internal and external customers.

You are a part of

The HealthSuite Digital Platform is an open, cloud-based healthcare platform that will support data collection across the spectrum from clinical to consumer lifestyle, allowing for integration and analysis of ‘big’ data from multiple sources worldwide, including electronic medical records, diagnostic and treatment information, images, reports, notes, wearables and Philips connected consumer lifestyle products. The platform will utilize Philips’ clinical data models and medical device interoperability and is designed to be highly scalable with built-in comprehensive data security and privacy/permission control.

You will be part of a highly skilled cloud operations team responsible for overall IaaS and PaaS management at a global scale. This pivotal role will provide you the opportunity to leverage your diverse IT background including Windows, scripting, security, networking and cloud knowledge to deliver our healthcare platform services to a broad set of internal and external customers. Take your technical skills to the next level working on diverse and complex technical challenges in a dynamic and fast paced environment. As a part of this new organization you will have a unique opportunity to broaden your technical knowledge and problem solving skills while being at the forefront of healthcare innovation working on our advanced healthcare digital platform.

No other organization has the breadth and depth of the extended portfolio of health care solutions than Philips has across the entire health continuum, from the hospital into the home. Philips is uniquely positioned as a health technology leader. We’ve been doing this for over 100 years, and leading the confluence of clinical and informatics is in our DNA.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English language communication skills, both verbal and written. Cross-cultural etiquettes, customer centric and collaborative mindset.
  • Works autonomously within established procedures and practices.

Qualification and Technical Competencies

We are looking for:

  • Experience with CI/CD technologies, for example Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub actions
  • Deployment and management of modern multi-tier application deployments on cloud (preferably AWS).
  • Familiarity with RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL Database or related technologies.
  • Knowledge of RESTful web services, YAML, XML and JSON.
  • Familiarity with healthcare industry.
  • Experience working within a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with Docker.

AWS Knowledge:

  • Hands-On experience using AWS compute, network, storage and database services.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (BA / BS) in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field preferred or equivalent experience with at least 3 years of experience working on a 24x7 Cloud or SaaS production operations team.
  • Experience deploying applications within a production public cloud environment (AWS or similar).
  • Understanding of elasticity and scalability concepts.
  • Understanding of networking concepts including configuration (DNS, VPN, proxies).
  • Expertise with CI/CD technologies
  • Familiarity with Linux systems administration (CentOS, Ubuntu, RHEL or similar).
  • Experience in scripting languages (Ruby, Bash, Python or similar).
  • Familiarity with Cloud Infrastructure & Application monitoring tools.
  • Experience with orchestration/ provisioning solutions (Chef, Salt, Terraform or similar).
  • Exposure to Cloud Foundry.
  • Ability to interact with a diverse set of stakeholders
  • Ability to interact with AWS (AWS SDK, AWS API, Command Line Interface, AWS Cloud Formation, and other AWS Services such as SNS, SQS, SWF, DynamoDB, S3, etc).
  • Skilled in automation technologies. For example using Chef, Salt, Ansible, Bash, Scripting, Python, PowerShell to perform day-to-day support functions and release management activities.
  • Exposure to information and application security including public key encryption, SSH, access credentials, and X.509 certificates.

In return, we offer you

A path towards your most rewarding career with Philips a leading global healthcare company. An exciting role which your work can bring big impact in fast growing China healthcare industry and to improve billions of people life.

A challenging, innovative working environment with a group of multi-discipline, talented people and use of the latest Tech. We offer competitive health benefits, a flexible work schedule and access to local well-being focused activities. Furthermore, Philips University is available to all employees for learning and development opportunities.

How we work at Philips
Our newly-adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. We are embracing an approach wherein we spend more time together than apart – which for full-time employees translates to an average of at least 3 days working from the office and up to 2 days from home – for our hybrid roles.
Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way. Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.

Our hybrid working model is defined in 3 ways:
We believe in the importance of impactful collaboration: There's a certain energy when everyone’s in the same room that can heighten idea generation and creative friction needed for problem-solving.
We embrace flexibility: Choosing where, when and how to work can vary according to task and team schedules. Flexibility isn’t office or online, it means choosing the space that works best for you, your teams and our customers on a case-by-case basis.
We want to be at our best: The way we work and our workspaces are designed to support our well-being, offer career advancement opportunities, and enable us to be at our best.

Why should you join Philips?

Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on innovative, customer-first health technology solutions. Help us improve the health and well-being of billions of people, every year. Ultimately creating a career that no one could have planned for. Even you.

Across the Cox family of businesses (Cox Enterprises, Cox Communications and Cox Automotive), we’re looking for Software Development Interns to join our team and learn from the best. Ready to collaborate with us and work at a great company that truly cares about you and your future? Keep reading!

What’s In It For You?

  • You won’t be left alone to figure things out. You’ll have a team of supporters (plus an assigned program mentor) who will show you the ropes, guide you to excellence and cheer you on.

  • You’ll experience real accountability to develop your professional skills.

  • You’ll expand your network and professional toolbox through exposure to senior leaders.

What You’ll Do

You’ll develop and manage enterprise platforms, deployment pipelines, security and quality monitoring. You’ll also develop tools to automate tasks and maintain new and existing infrastructure platforms on public and private clouds. Responsibilities will include:

  • Developing automation for infrastructure provisioning and procedures, configuration management and ongoing support processes to be used across all environments.

  • Documenting new development, procedures or test plans as needed.

  • Helping develop and following best practices, security and engineering standards.

  • Building tools and pipelines needed to facilitate continuous integration and delivery of software to all environments.

  • Automating code packaging, code deployment and configuration management processes to be used across all environments.

  • Soliciting feedback from delivery and operations teams about continuous integration and delivery challenges and working with them to identify opportunities to optimize software engineering throughput and quality.

  • Tracking system and service performance continuously in all environments and escalates to the appropriate team.

  • Leverage AI tools to assist in productivity, testing, and automation

Who You Are

Inquisitive. Logical. Dependable. These are just a few words that describe you. You love a good challenge and are happiest when you’re solving problems. You have the following qualifications:

  • Currently a college student pursuing a BA/BS degree in computer science or a related field, including classes related to software development, systems, networking and security.

  • A passion for technology, reverse engineering and writing code to create solutions and fix problems.

  • A collaborative attitude and the ability to clearly articulate thoughts and processes with both verbal and written communication in one-on-one and group settings.

  • Experience with Windows and Linux systems, containers and databases.

  • Experience with source code, build, deploy, orchestration and configuration management tools.

  • Experience in writing code and scripts in at least one high-level programming language.

  • An eye to identify and a desire to resolve insufficiencies and manual activities via automation.

  • Familiarity with public cloud architecture and technologies, preferably AWS.

  • Familiarity with Agile concepts and processes (Scrum and Kanban).

  • An interest in building and continuously improving secure and resilient applications at scale.

  • An interest in gathering data and measuring the progress on what makes applications perform.

title: Senior Protection Engineer
description:
The opportunity

Are you interested in contributing to the energy transition by making the electrical grid smarter, greener and stronger? Then, we have the following great opportunity for you at Hitachi Energy, Grid Automation business in Vaasa or Helsinki, Finland.

We are currently seeking an enthusiastic, flexible and curious Senior Protection Engineer to strengthen our innovative engineering and testing team that specializes in the control and protection area of substation automation projects.

As a Protection Engineer, you will be responsible for the successful execution of the control and protection scope of our substation automation projects globally. Within those projects, you will be working closely together with the project manager, the SCADA engineer and the customer in successfully delivering those projects. Depending on the size of the project, you will technically lead a small team of engineers, based in our global engineering centers, that support you in delivering the project on time and with the highest quality. In addition, you will be part of a large world-class engineering community within our Hub Europe organization, surrounded by colleagues with many years of expertise and know-how in executing large and complex substation automation projects globally. Truly a great working environment to learn, to develop and to contribute to our companys vision of advancing the worlds energy system to be more sustainable, flexible and secure!

How you'll make an impact

- Develop together with the project core team the protection and control concepts for (sub-)transmission systems in close collaboration with the customer.

- Be responsible for leading the hardware design of the bay level cubicles within the substation.

- Be responsible for the configuration of Protection and Control IEDs for (sub-)transmission substations in line with customer specification.

- Be responsible for the factory testing of the project within our test area in Vaasa and lead the Factory Acceptance Test in front of our customer.

- Be responsible for the control and protection part site test at customer sites.

- Lead a small team of engineers, based in our global engineering centers.

Your background

- Bachelors degree in electrical, computer or systems engineering, or related field.

- Previous experience in substation control and protection systems and communication protocols like IEC61850.

- Previous experience with our Hitachi Energy protection and control IED portfolio (Relion family and PCM600) and/or previous experience with E3.series (for hardware design) is a big plus.

- Open-minded team player with high standards towards customer focus, safety, quality and efficiency. Ability to work independently but also to coordinate with different stakeholders within the project team.

- Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment.

- Structured and proactive engineering approach, with a high commitment towards maintaining project budget and project plan.

- Spoken and written proficiency in Finnish and English language.

title: Senior Engineering Lead-  Senior Vice President
description:
This is a Senior Lead Engineer position responsible for establishing and implementing innovative technology solutions and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer with extensive experience building robust, high-performance, and large-scale applications. We are constantly evolving our significant software assets and are seeking a leader who is passionate about leveraging diverse technologies to drive technical excellence and innovation.

Team Background

The Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions. These tools allow sales, traders, operations staff and risk officers to manage Citi's exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software that provides a complete platform for their users: limit monitoring, exception management, stress testing analysis and escalation workflow capabilities are some key areas of focus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and development oversight to the wider team of Software Engineers/Analysts. Ensure application design adheres to the appropriate architectural and design patterns for scalable and intelligent systems.

  • Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level/junior developers and analysts, helping build the overall engineering capabilities of the team, particularly in AI/ML and intelligent systems development.

  • Appropriately assess risk when decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Ideal background

  • Full-stack developer with 10+ years of experience in designing and developing robust, scalable, and maintainable applications applying Object Oriented Design principles.

  • Hands-on experience in Web technologies (HTML, CSS, React JS), REST-APIs, and Backend using Java/J2EE technologies.

  • Deep experience with Big Data technologies and data platforms capable of handling vast datasets for training, serving, and managing AI models.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and deployment/packaging solutions such as Dockers/Kubernetes, OpenShift.

  • Experience with Agile software development processes with a strong emphasis on test driven development.

  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and experience in tools such as JIRA, BlackDuck, SONAR etc.

  • Deep understanding of JVM internals such as class loading and memory management.

Skills

Extensive experience working with most if not all the technologies listed below:

  • Java Core with extensive hands-on experience with concurrent programming.

  • Spring Framework including Core, Integration, Batch, JDBC, Hibernate.

  • Distributed Caching frameworks such as Oracle Coherence, Redis or equivalent.

  • Cloud computing technologies with practical experience working with containers, microservices and large datasets (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Expertise in Big Data / Data Lake system architecture that supports enterprise data warehouse, real-time data processing, and large-scale data ingestion for AI/ML workloads.

  • Databases - RDBMS preferably Oracle, NoSQL preferably MongoDB.

  • Familiarity with Linux environment including scripting skills.

  • SDLC/Dev Ops - Git/BitBucket, CI/CD pipeline frameworks such as Jenkins, SonarQube, JIRA, any secure coding toolkits.

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate and optimize AI-assisted coding and development tools (e.g., Git Copilot, Devin AI) into team workflows to maximize efficiency and innovation.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance, metadata management, and data lineage platforms to maintain high data quality and auditability for AI systems.

  • Ability to evaluate design trade-offs and document choices effectively.

  • Demonstrated capacity to build sophisticated tooling for development and production team use.

Preferred:

  • Knowledge and experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau and Cognos for data visualization and reporting.

  • Experience with Big Data querying tools including Google BigQuery, Starburst, and DuckDB.

  • Experience with prominent Machine Learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face) and their deployment in production.

  • Knowledge of large language models, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and time-series analysis techniques as applied to Agentic AI and risk modeling.

  • Experience in designing, developing, and implementing AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making, adaptive learning, and complex interaction within a financial domain.

title: ⭐ To faste BPA-stillinger ledig hos 24-åring i Lillesand
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast stilling og tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg

Jeg er en 24 år gammel mann som søker nye assistenter til teamet mitt. Jeg bor i Lillesand sammen med mamma og lillebroren min, og har en aktiv hverdag med mange interesser. På fritiden liker jeg blant annet å bowle, dra på handleturer og utforske butikker. Jeg er også veldig glad i film og kan sitte lenge med fargeleggingsapper på nettbrettet mitt. I tillegg setter jeg stor pris på å reise. Det kan være alt fra dagsturer til Oslo eller Sverige til lengre turer når vi har blitt godt kjent. Jeg håper også å finne assistenter som vil bli med på aktiviteter som gåturer, sykling og fisketurer.

Jeg har epilepsi og trenger derfor å ha en trygg person i nærheten dersom jeg skulle få et anfall. Selv om jeg har begrenset talespråk, kommuniserer jeg godt gjennom kroppsspråk og ved å peke på bilder.

Nå ser jeg etter rolige, trygge og omsorgsfulle assistenter som har godt humør, er fleksible og ønsker å bidra til at jeg får en god hverdag. Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgsarbeid eller BPA er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig. Personlig egnethet og god kjemi vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Det er viktig at du er fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid, da vaktene kan variere og det av og til kan oppstå behov på kort varsel.

Stilling og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker nå:

  • 2 faste stillinger – 10 timer hver i uka- ofte på ettermiddag 14.15 -23.15

  • 1 tilkallingsvikar

Arbeidstidene kan variere og omfatter dag-, kveld- og helgevakter. Vaktene kan være både korte og lange, og enkelte langvakter kan deles opp i morgen- eller ettermiddagsvakter.

Ved ferieavvikling og andre behov vil det være aktuelt med vakter cirka kl.06.30-15-00 eller kl.15.00-23.30.

Det kan også oppstå behov for vakter på kort varsel. Vi søker derfor fleksible personer som kan arbeide på ulike tidspunkter og som ikke har faste begrensninger når det gjelder arbeidstid

Dette p.g.a. at mor jobber turnus og varierende vakter.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Tilberede mat og lett matlaging

  • Enkle huslige oppgaver kan forekomme som en naturlig del av oppfølgingen og bistanden til vedtakseier

  • Tilrettelegging for aktiviteter og fritid

  • Lett personlig stell, som dusj og vask av hår

  • Bistå ved anfall, god opplæring vil bli gitt

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Fremlegge gyldig politiattest

  • Erfaring fra helsesektoren er ønskelig, men ikke et krav

  • Fordel om du har førerkort og egen bil

  • Kjemi vektlegges

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Trygg og selvgående

  • Godt humør

  • Ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig

  • Spontan

  • Ikke være allergisk mot katt

  • Snakker norsk, russisk eller tsjetsjensk.

Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende for intervju og vi ansetter så fort vi treffer riktig kandidat.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

title: IT Sr App Dev Tech Lead
description:
Our Story

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

Our Benefits

With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

Great Place to Work

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards Click Here.

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at .

Role Overview

The Senior SQL Server Developer with hands-on experience in designs, builds, optimizes, and supports SQL Server solutions for CBA data processing, integrations, reporting, and production-ready database components. This role requires strong SQL engineering judgment, query optimization, ETL/data processing, performance awareness, secure data handling, and the ability to use AI tools responsibly as a productivity accelerator while independently reviewing, validating, and correcting all AI generated outputs.

AI capability requirement
Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate SQL development, query troubleshooting, documentation, validation, and test support. AI-generated code or analysis must be reviewed, corrected, secured, and explained before use.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and support SQL Server database objects, including stored procedures, views, functions, jobs, triggers and data processing logic.

  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, maintainable SQL solutions aligned to CBA data patterns and release processes.

  • Troubleshoot production and non-production data issues, including performance, correctness, data quality, and integration concerns.

  • Review execution plans, indexes, joins, filtering logic, transaction behavior, and data volumes to improve query performance and operational reliability.

  • Partner with product owners, QA/SQA, developers, architects, and support teams to validate requirements, support testing, and ensure production readiness.

  • Document technical designs, deployment considerations, operational dependencies, and support guidance for implemented solutions.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate routine development and analysis tasks, while validating correctness, security, performance, and business fit before implementation.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and contribute to technical best practices.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong SQL Server development skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, stored procedures, query tuning, and execution plan analysis.

  • Experience with data validation, source-to-target checks, reconciliation, exception handling, and root-cause analysis for complex data issues.

  • Ability to work in Agile delivery cycles, provide meaningful estimates, participate in sprint planning, and support defect resolution through release.

  • Strong understanding of secure data handling practices, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools.

  • Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and validation outcomes to both technical and business stakeholders.

AI Required and Preferred Skills

Skill Area

Requirement / Posting Language

AI-assisted development

Experience using generative AI tools to improve SQL development productivity, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.

Prompt engineering

Ability to write clear prompts for SQL query generation, troubleshooting, query tuning, data validation, documentation, and testing support.

AI output validation

Ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated SQL for correctness, security, data quality, and performance before implementation.

Secure data handling

Understands that confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data must not be entered into public AI tools.

Preferred AI usage

Experience using AI for ETL development, report logic, analytics support, documentation generation, test case creation, or troubleshooting.

Application and Interview

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

Our commitment to Inclusion

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world’s most complex technology estates. We are looking for a ServiceNow Business Analyst to work closely with business stakeholders, process consultants, and technical teams to gather requirements, analyze business needs, and support the delivery of ServiceNow solutions. title: Senior Java Developer – Vice President
description:
Citi is looking for a Senior Java Developer to design, build, and evolve enterprise-grade shared services that underpin high-volume, mission-critical financial systems. In this role, you will lead technical delivery across the full development lifecycle, shaping architecture decisions and setting engineering standards within a globally connected technology team. This is an opportunity to take real ownership of complex backend platforms and directly influence how Citi's technology ecosystem performs at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise shared services using Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB, ensuring solutions meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements in high-transactional environments.

  • Lead integration across messaging and middleware platforms — including WebSphere MQ, TIBCO EMS, Apache Camel, and JMS — to deliver seamless, resilient system connectivity.

  • Define and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, debugging, and deployment, driving consistency and quality across the development team.

  • Collaborate with architecture and infrastructure teams to ensure application designs align with the broader technology blueprint and long-term platform strategy.

  • Provide Tier 3 production support, diagnosing and resolving high-impact incidents through structured analysis and advanced troubleshooting techniques.

  • Mentor and guide mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work effectively and building technical capability across the team.

  • Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to identify system enhancement opportunities and translate business requirements into practical, high-quality technical solutions.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience developing and maintaining enterprise shared services using Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB.

  • Deep expertise in Java 8, Apache Camel, JMS, WebSphere MQ, TIBCO EMS, OSGi, REST APIs, SSL, and related open-source technologies.

  • Demonstrated ability to perform critical-situation troubleshooting across complex, high-traffic backend environments.

  • Practical knowledge of DevOps tooling, including GitHub, uDeploy, and SonarQube, with experience integrating these into an Agile development lifecycle.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to apply it effectively in application analysis, tuning, and performance measurement.

  • Proven ability to lead technical delivery, manage competing priorities, and operate with professional maturity across all levels of an organization.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and OpenShift.

  • Familiarity with critical-incident diagnostic tools including Samurai, Thread Dump Analyser (TDA), or Memory Analyser Tool (MAT).

  • Hands-on experience with Linux command-line administration, particularly in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.

  • Experience with the Lightspeed deployment platform within a regulated or enterprise financial services context.

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

What We Offer

At Citi, you will work alongside experienced engineers on technology that operates at global scale, giving you the platform to solve genuinely complex problems and make a tangible impact on systems used by clients and institutions worldwide. We invest in our people through structured development, meaningful work, and a balanced working model designed to support long-term performance and wellbeing.

  • A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing flexibility alongside team collaboration.

  • Ownership of technically complex, high-impact engineering challenges in a global financial services environment.

  • Access to learning and development programmes that support continued technical growth and career progression at a senior level.

  • A performance-driven team culture that values engineering excellence, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Competitive financial wellbeing support, including compensation and benefits structured to reflect the seniority and scope of this role.

  • Wellbeing resources and family support benefits designed to help you maintain balance across professional and personal priorities.

Apply now to bring your Java engineering expertise to a global platform where your technical leadership will shape the future of enterprise financial technology at Citi.

title: Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Outerwear, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest product engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting to the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while driving and extending consumer favorites, serving local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and act independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Outerwear to join our dynamic and fast-paced design team. This role will be based in Shanghai, China, and will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative leader with diverse experience in the apparel industry and the ability to manage a team of designers to develop and execute apparel products for our brand. They will lead the creation of apparel products across various GC consumer sport and lifestyle business opportunities and oversee the execution of multiple categories through a hyper-local lens. This designer has a strong eye for detail, a passion for and expertise in premium craft, and the ability to create highly desirable products that connect with consumers in Greater China through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, drive the brand vision, foster creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to bring ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is a people leadership role reporting to the Director, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners throughout the product design process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

BA/BFA/MA/MFA preferred in Apparel Design or related field, or equivalent combination of education, experience or training.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of professional apparel design experience within the apparel and sportswear industry, with extensive expertise in outerwear materials, functionality, construction, and fit across both lifestyle and performance products.

  • Extensive knowledge across multiple outerwear product categories, with experience in technical and innovative ideation and strong insights into the outerwear market in Greater China.

  • Experience in creative and team leadership, with a clear understanding of apparel segments and multidimensional consumer profiles; experience in the Greater China market is preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials and construction, tech packs, and schematic development for lifestyle and performance apparel products.

  • Strong collection-building ability, translating insights into authentic narratives and storytelling by integrating concepts across multiple dimensions, including color, silhouette, and key looks. Able to express concepts from a holistic point of view and drive cohesion in product construction within the same collection and across the brand.

  • Ability to lead, curate, and drive the design vision within assigned categories, collaborate cross-functionally, and align design expectations with key counterparts. Able to set direction through precise decision-making and guide the team throughout the design process.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and ensure the team adheres to timelines.

  • Excellent visual and verbal presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Proven team player and leadership skills, fostering a positive and inclusive environment to achieve shared creative goals. Ability to drive collaborative mindsets across the design team.

  • Sound decision-making abilities and strategic thinking skills.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, 3D/AI rendering software, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Outerwear Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Create apparel products that align with global creative direction, seasonal key concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, geo assortments and connect with the GC consumer.

  • Manage a team of apparel designers to mentor and drive creativity, build collaborative culture, and drive efficiencies on cross functional communication.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Development to establish and manage the seasonal new-creation toolbox, based on consumer insights, design direction, and product intent, while considering appropriate margin targets.

  • Collaborate with Product Development and external vendors on pre-development and innovation exploration for outerwear-specific products.

  • Bring seasonal creative direction to life through market-relevant trends and insights in color, material functionality, and GC-centric fit and proportion, as well as brand- and trend-relevant coordination of key looks and outfits. Build depth across the range through the use of color and define appropriate trend levels for individual products to drive excitement and variety.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively, collaborate in a fast-paced environment, and integrate GC-relevant trends and solutions into seasonal products.

  • Monitor the development of prototype samples and interact with development to finalize production details, conduct fittings, and ensure execution excellence in multiple categories.

  • Partner with Product Management and Development to build trend-driven assortments, communicate design intent, review prototypes, and refine execution.

  • Champion storytelling and clearly communicate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts to internal teams, leadership, and external partners, effectively explaining the purpose behind design decisions.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, planning and executing product details, reviewing samples, resolving feasibility issues, and ensuring timely project completion.

  • Demonstrate deep consumer curiosity and strong trend forecasting capabilities, maintaining a strong connection to city culture, emerging trends, and Nike's design ethos.

title: Tekninen kiinteistönhoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun, Turku
location: Turku, Raisio, Kaarina, Naantali, Turku, Turku, Finland
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Turkuun ammattitaitoista teknistä kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu kiinteistöjen monipuolinen ylläpito ja huolto. Pääasialliset vastuualueesi ovat teknisen kiinteistöhuollon tehtävät, kiinteistöjen kunnossapito sekä liiketilojen ja piha-alueiden hoito. Työkohteet sijaitsevat Turun keskustan alueella.

Toivomme sinulta jo osaamista teknisen kiinteistönhuollon tehtävistä. Osaamisen lisäksi työssä vaaditaan voimassaoleva B-ajokortti. Kiinteistöalan peruskoulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden pitkään työsuhteeseen. Työ on itsenäistä ja monipuolista, ja saat mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti kiinteistöpalvelualalla.

Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen sekä aikaisemman kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan, sijoittuen 13-17 €/h välille.

Jos olet oma-aloitteinen, vastuuntuntoinen ja nautit monipuolisista työtehtävistä, tämä työpaikka on sinua varten!

Tule mukaan osaksi ammattitaitoista tiimiämme ja kehittymään kiinteistönhoidon ammattilaisena. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuajalla, joten ethän aikaile hakemuksen jättämisen kanssa.

title: Toimintaterapeutti Oma väylä -kuntoutukseen
description: Työssä olet keskeisessä roolissa osana moniammatillista tiimiä, joka toteuttaa Kelan harkinnanvaraista Oma väylä- kuntoutusta 16-29-vuotiaille neuropsykiatrisen diagnoosin (ADHD, ADD, autisminkirjon häiriö) saaneille nuorille. Kuntoutuksen tarkoituksena on tukea nuorta opinnoissa tai työelämässä tai niihin palaamisessa. Kuntoutustiimiin kuuluu sosiaali- ja terveydenhoitoalan ammattihenkilöiden lisäksi myös psykologi, nepsy-valmentaja, erityisopettaja sekä työelämän asiantuntija. Työhön edellytetään vähintään kuuden kuukauden työkokemusta neurokehityksellisten häiriöiden kuntoutuksesta tai hoitotyöstä viimeisen kuuden vuoden ajalta. Työ on mahdollista toteuttaa myös alihankintasopimuksella.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React.js)
description:
Senior Frontend Engineer (React.js)


Who is Parser?

Technology alone does not create impact- the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East.

We combine global reach with a mindset focused on agility, senior expertise, and close collaboration. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions, and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.


Why Join Us?

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.


How will you impact?

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Frontend Engineer with a passion for building innovative, user-centric web applications. As a key member of our team, you will design and develop modern, responsive user interfaces using React.js, ensuring exceptional user experiences and seamless integration with backend APIs.


The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of frontend technologies, UI/UX principles, and the drive to stay updated with the latest trends in the field.


Your key responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, responsive web applications using React.js.
  • Translate design mockups and wireframes into high-quality, interactive user interfaces.
  • Implement best practices for frontend architecture, including performance optimization, state management, and reusable component design.
  • Design and implement comprehensive end-to-end automated tests to ensure backward compatibility and seamless integration with backend systems.
  • Collaborate closely with backend developers to integrate frontend components with robust APIs.
  • Ensure accessibility and cross-browser compatibility for all web applications.
  • Stay updated on emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and best practices, advocating their adoption when beneficial.
  • Conduct code reviews, write unit tests, and implement automated testing strategies to maintain high-quality code and seamless end-to-end integration.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI/UX issues, optimizing the performance and reliability of the applications.
  • Document code, development processes, and architectural decisions.


What you'll bring to the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 6+ years in frontend development, with a proven track record of delivering complex web applications.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and frontend frameworks, especially React.js.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and CSS preprocessors like Sass or Less.
  • Experience with state management libraries/tools such as Redux, React Query, or Context API.
  • Expertise in integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous programming techniques.
  • Familiarity with graphs libraries such as eCharts.
  • Basic understanding of the Python programming language, as the backend is developed on it.


Additional Skills:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards and responsive design principles.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Preferred Skills
  • Nice to have an understanding of micro-frontend architecture.


Location:

  • Candidates based in Spain: flexible remote work, with availability to travel to the UK office in Hayes, West London, once per month.


You will receive:

  • The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
  • The opportunity to form part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A highly competitive compensation package.
  • Medical insurance.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.
