title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
Sateliot is a Barcelona-based satellite company with one goal: connect everything, everywhere. Founded in 2018, we've built the first satellite constellation that lets standard commercial devices communicate directly from space. Our technology bridges the gaps that terrestrial networks will never reach, bringing affordable and secure connectivity to industries, governments, and communities across the planet.

Learn more:

About the team & this role

The Mission and Systems Engineering team is responsible for the development, integration and validation of the satellite’s core avionics and on-board software, ensuring reliable operation across all spacecraft subsystems.

As Flight Software Engineer, you’ll own the On-Board Software (OBSW) for Sateliot’s satellites — from today’s baseline to the next generation — developing, verifying and validating it, and supporting the platform through integration campaigns and in orbit, working closely with the Systems, Hardware, AIT and Operations teams.

What you'll do

  • Own the development of the on-board flight software for the platform, through to a flight-ready release.

  • Own its verification and validation: define and run the unit, integration and system-level test campaigns that produce the acceptance evidence for each release.

  • Deliver software that is robust and reliable in the space environment.

  • Own the integration of the on-board software with the satellite subsystems, interfaces and overall system architecture, working closely with the Hardware, Systems and AIT teams.

  • Resolve issues across software, hardware, interfaces and communication protocols, from the bench and AIT campaigns through to in-orbit operations.

What you bring

  • 5+ years developing embedded software in C or C++ for resource-constrained targets.

  • Hands-on development on real-time operating system (FreeRTOS, RTEMS, VxWorks or equivalent).

  • Hands-on development on data interfaces used in satellite systems (SpaceWire, CAN Bus, RS-422, RS-485, Ethernet, MIL-STD-1553).

  • Demonstrated ownership of embedded software verification: authored unit and integration test suites and executed them on target hardware.

Bonus if you have

  • Python or other modern scripting languages, applied to test automation and tooling.

  • Familiarity with ECSS and CCSDS standards.

  • Experience developing software for aerospace or safety-critical systems.

  • Experience with CI/CD for embedded systems.

  • Experience with Linux, Git and modern software development workflows.

  • Experience running FlatSat and hardware-in-the-loop test campaigns.

  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment, or willingness to.

  • Previous involvement in satellite AIT/AIV, commissioning, or in-orbit operations.

Additional requirements

  • Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate: this is a hybrid role with regular on-site presence at our Barcelona HQ, where the hardware benches and FlatSat are.

  • Availability for occasional travel to external test campaigns, and for extended hours around launch and in-orbit commissioning windows.

How we work

We lead with humility, move fast, and take ownership. We collaborate without ego and measure ourselves by real impact, not titles or hierarchy. We hire people who already live these values.

What we offer

  • Real impact on one of Europe’s most ambitious space projects.

  • Growth: we cover 50% of courses or master’s degrees (up to 5% of your salary), plus Spanish and Catalan classes.

  • Health & balance: 50% on private health insurance and Urban Sports Club, a flexible schedule, and hybrid work, we focus on results, not hours.

  • Flexible Compensation: flexible compensation through Cobee (meal, transport, kindergarten).

  • A truly global team: 20+ nationalities building something genuinely new - and genuinely nice to work with. Great vibes, real teamwork.

  • A real welcome: a dedicated buddy from day one.

  • Life outside work: we organize leisure and sports activities both during and outside working hours - because great teams connect beyond the screen.

  • Catering: if you don't have time to cook, we partner with a catering company so a freshmeal is sorted, no need to think about it.

  • Parking: on-site parking at the office, with Sateliot covering 50% of the cost - plus free bike parking if you prefer to pedal in.

Sound like you?

Apply now!

Sateliot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without discrimination on the basis of any legally protected characteristic.

title: Adjunct Curriculum & Quality Assurance Expert
description:
ABOUT ALU

ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world.

We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities.

HOW WE WORK

The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new.

The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The BSc Entrepreneurial Leadership (BEL) programme is a three-year degree programme with the aim of developing Ethical Entrepreneurial graduates at scale who are well prepared to leverage technology as the first hand solution to solve relevant problems in the continent and beyond and also who are ready to meet the needs of employers globally. This innovative and scalable programme prepares graduates not only with relevant technical skills but also problem solving and leadership skills missing in our tech graduates and promotes learning with a purpose.

The role of the Adjunct Curriculum & Quality Assurance Expert entails the responsibility to successfully design, refine and validate the existing learning components of the programme adhering to the principles of our ALU’s Learning Model and support the periodic review process with a set project plan and key milestones. The candidate will contribute to academic expertise, industry insight, quality assurance, curriculum design and future focused programme development experience to strengthen programme quality, graduate employability and long term programme relevance.

Job Description:

We are looking for an individual who can meet requirements as mentioned in the profile below:

  • Review, refine, design and validate the current learning curriculum of the Entrepreneurial Leadership programmes with documentation and with key attention to details outlined in the respective Project Plan and timelines
  • Assess programme alignment with accreditation requirements and quality assurance framework
  • Conduct a comprehensive curriculum gap analysis against global entrepreneurial leadership education standards, industry requirements and emerging technology trends
  • Review programme learning outcomes, graduate attributes, course sequencing, assessments and competency frameworks and recommend enhancements where required.
  • Ensure curriculum alignment with current and emerging domains including social innovation, Entrepreneurship Education, Policy and Advocacy, Planetary Health Innovation, Business Strategy, Leadership Development and other relevant business fields
  • Benchmark the programme against leading international Entrepreneurial Leadership and Entrepreneurship Management degree programmes and recommend improvements
  • Review and update course specifications, learning outcomes, assessment strategies, practical learning activities and programme documentation
  • Collaborate with academic leadership, faculty learning designers and industry stakeholders to validate curriculum recommendations and proposed programme changes
  • Ensure programme content reflects current industry practices, future workforce needs and technological advancements
  • Support quality assurance, accreditation and periodic programme review requirements through documentation and evidence based recommendations
  • Participate in curriculum review workshops, stakeholder consultations and validation sessions
  • Provide periodic progress updates against agreed project milestones and deliverables.
  • Contribute to the review and update of programme handbooks, curriculum guides and other academic documentation
  • Support the Programme Manager and designated faculty in implementing approved curriculum enhancements and recommendations
  • Undertake any other reasonable duties related to the successful completion of the curriculum review and redesign project.
  • Any other reasonable duties that may be allocated from time to time by the line manager.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Data & Analytics)
description:
Job Description

The Role

This is not a traditional QA role.

As an SDET in Data and Analytics, you’ll be a core member of the engineering team, responsible for designing and implementing the test automation infrastructure that enables us to move fast and build trustworthy software. You’ll work closely with software engineers to integrate test coverage into our development workflows and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that quality is everyone's responsibility, and that it’s supported by the right tooling and automation.

You’ll help define what “good” looks like for testability and automation, and you’ll partner with engineers to make sure our systems are robust, observable, and continuously verified.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain test automation frameworks that support integration, end-to-end, and regression testing.
  • Partner with engineers to design testable systems and incorporate automated tests into their workflows.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support safe, frequent releases.
  • Define and champion quality standards across the team including test coverage, reliability, observability, and traceability.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and propose pragmatic strategies to close them.
  • Provide guidance and coaching to engineers on testing practices, tools, and techniques.
  • Continuously improve our developer experience by reducing friction and increasing confidence in releases.

Essential Criteria

  • Solid engineering experience and capable of writing clean, maintainable code in a modern programming language.
  • Experience designing and building automated test frameworks (e.g. integration, E2E, API-level).
  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD tools and integrating tests into build and deploy pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of testing principles, test design, and how to test distributed systems.
  • You’ll have a collaborative mindset, and you enjoy helping others improve and raising the quality bar across the team.
  • Strong communication skills and a drive to simplify complex testing problems.

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience working in data-intensive, cloud-native environments.
  • Familiarity with performance testing, fault injection, and resilience testing.
  • Exposure to tools like NUnit, Pytest, Playwright, Postman, or similar.
  • Understanding of how to test asynchronous workflows or event-driven systems (e.g. with Temporal.io).
  • Interest in developer tooling, platform engineering, or internal developer platforms (IDPs).

What We Offer

  • A key role in building high-trust systems that power critical compliance workflows.
  • The chance to shape quality culture in a high-performing engineering team.
  • A supportive, collaborative team environment with smart people who care about good engineering.
  • Freedom to propose tools, techniques, and practices that improve reliability and velocity.
  • A modern, cloud-first tech stack and ambitious technical roadmap.

title: Luonnonhoidon asiantuntija
description:
Haluatko edistää metsäluonnon monimuotoisuutta ja kehittää ratkaisuja, joilla metsätalouden, muun maankäytön ja luonnon monimuotoisuuden tavoitteita sovitetaan yhteen? Etsimme Tapio Palvelut Oy:lle luonnonhoidon asiantuntijaa.

Luonnonhoidon asiantuntijuus on keskeinen osa työtämme Tapiossa. Vaikutamme aktiivisesti metsäalan vastuulliseen kehittymiseen kokoamalla yhteen metsien käyttöön, luonnon monimuotoisuuteen ja kestävään maankäyttöön liittyviä toimijoita. Autamme asiakkaitamme ja yhteistyökumppaneitamme löytämään ratkaisuja, jotka edistävät sekä elinvoimaisia metsiä että luonnon monimuotoisuuden turvaamista.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa yhdistyvät asiantuntijatyö, myynti- ja asiakastyö sekä kouluttaminen ja kehittäminen maastokohteilla eri puolilla Suomea. Työtehtävät liittyvät sekä talousmetsien luonnonhoitoon että suojelualueilla ja muissa metsäluontoon vaikuttavissa maankäyttömuodoissa toteutettavaan luonnonhoitoon ja ennallistamiseen.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti luonnonhoidon asiantuntijana metsäalan toimijoiden, maanomistajien, yritysten, tutkimusorganisaatioiden, järjestöjen ja viranomaisten kanssa.

Tehtävässä menestyäksesi sinulla on

  • Soveltuva korkeakoulutausta (esim. metsätiede, ympäristötiede, biologia tai muu vastaava koulutus)

  • Tavoitteellisen projektityöskentelyn osaamista, pystyt viemään hankkeita suunnitelmallisesti eteenpäin

  • Aiempaa kokemusta myynti- ja asiakastyöstä, kykyä tunnistaa asiakastarpeita sekä rakentaa niihin asiakaslähtöisiä ratkaisuja

  • Vahva käytännön ja teoreettinen osaaminen talousmetsien luonnonhoidosta sekä luonnon monimuotoisuuden turvaamisesta metsätaloudessa ja muussa maankäytössä

  • Tuntemusta ennallistamisen ja suojelualueiden luonnonhoidon tavoitteista, menetelmistä ja käytännöistä

  • Kokemusta metsäalan ammattilaisille suunnattujen maasto- ja verkkokoulutusten suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta

  • Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen viestintätaito. Olet taitava välittämään asiantuntijatietoa selkeästi erilaisille kohderyhmille

  • Kykyä rakentaa luottamusta ja käydä rakentavaa vuoropuhelua erilaisten toimijoiden kanssa

Lisäksi arvostamme

  • Kokemusta luonnonhoidon kehittämistyöstä tai asiantuntijapalveluista

  • Näkemystä luonnon monimuotoisuuden turvaamisen yhteensovittamisesta metsätalouden, suojelun ja muun maankäytön tavoitteiden kanssa

  • Kiinnostusta seurata metsä- ja luontoalan toimintaympäristön muutoksia sekä kehittää uusia ratkaisuja monimuotoisuuden turvaamiseen

  • Oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten luonnon monimuotoisuus huomioidaan käytännön metsätaloudessa ja miten luonnonhoidon parhaat käytännöt leviävät osaksi suomalaista metsätaloutta.

Työtä tehdään osana Tapion riippumatonta asiantuntijaorganisaatiota yhdessä Suomen arvostetuimpien metsä- ja luontoalan asiantuntijoiden sekä laajan yhteistyöverkoston kanssa.

Saat työsi tueksi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan yhteistyötä, asiantuntijuutta ja jatkuvaa oppimista. Lisäksi tarjoamme kattavat henkilöstöedut, joustavat työskentelytavat sekä mahdollisuuden etätyöhön.

Tehtävään hakeminen

Lähetä hakemuksesi, ansioluettelosi ja palkkatoiveesi osoitteeseen rekrytointi@tapio.fi viimeistään 22.9.2026.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa johtava asiantuntija Lauri Saaristo, p.+358 29 432 6055, lauri.saaristo@tapio.fi

Tapio on metsän, luonnon ja paikkatiedon asiantuntija – Metsäntuntija. Tarjoamme luotettavaa, tutkimukseen perustuvaa tietoa ja asiantuntijapalveluita, tehokkaita ratkaisuja sekä työvälineitä metsien kestävään hyödyntämiseen. Tapio-konserniin kuuluvat emoyhtiö Tapio Oy sekä tytäryhtiö Tapio Palvelut Oy. Tapio-konsernin tunnetuimmat brändit ovat Tapio, Metsälehti ja Karttakeskus.

title: Officer, Securities & Derivatives Intermediate Analyst, Markets Operations
description:
Domestic Securities (Yen Equity) Settlements – JPN – Markets Operations

About the Team

Citi Markets Operations and Operations Technology is a dynamic, global organization with a presence in over 60 countries, supporting all front-to-post execution Operations teams, including product-aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, and Listed Derivative & Commodities Operations.

Our teams support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services, including:

  • Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash, and Derivatives) — where Citi is consistently a top 3 player in the market
  • Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) — an area of significant growth investment
  • Syndicates — supporting both Fixed Income and Equity new issues and IPOs

Operations plays a critical role across the full trade lifecycle, partnering with Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and HR, while maintaining significant direct interaction with our global client base. Our Digitization and Implementation group works alongside Operations to deliver automation solutions, partnering with Citi's innovation labs to drive optimization and support our transformation to a target operating model, leveraging AI, natural language processing, and machine learning capabilities.

Role Summary

The Securities & Derivatives Intermediate Analyst is an intermediate-level position responsible for processing orders and transactions originating from trading desks and branch offices, in coordination with the Operations – Transaction Services team. The role's core objective is to facilitate the clearance, settlement, and investigation of client securities and derivatives transactions — specifically supporting day-to-day Yen Equity settlements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day Yen Equity settlement support, including:
    • Processing securities settlement
    • Making payments
    • Performing reconciliations
    • Inputting general ledger entries
    • Performing (complex) calculations
  • Interact with counterparties regarding settlement activities
  • Support an expansive and/or diverse array of products, services, risk, and control functions
  • Follow established procedures to identify and resolve problems requiring investigation or research
  • Make recommendations to management to support process improvement
  • Resolve problems by applying acquired technical experience, guided by precedent
  • Make evaluative judgments based on factual analysis and assist in implementing process improvements
  • Minimize risk to the firm through strong knowledge of procedural requirements; monitor errors and propose solutions to reduce them while adhering to audit and control policies
  • Manage and escalate settlement-related inquiries and issues in a timely manner
  • Interact directly with external customers to disseminate or explain information
  • Demonstrate an intermediate-level understanding of products/processes and how the role integrates with the team and closely related teams
  • Use strong communication, interpersonal, and diplomacy skills to engage colleagues and stakeholders, exchanging potentially complex or sensitive information with sensitivity to audience diversity
  • Exhibit strong executional capability
  • Appropriately assess risk in all business decisions, with particular consideration for the firm's reputation, safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and its assets — driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating/managing/reporting control issues with transparency

Qualifications and Skills

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience
  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
  • Ability to perform well in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work well under pressure and multi-task effectively
  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills in Japanese and English

Organizational Oversight (What You'll Be Part Of)

  • Pursuing daily core operations while maintaining a culture where processes, risks, and controls are continually monitored, with potential risks escalated in a timely manner
  • Contributing to an effective control framework meeting Audit, Compliance, and Regulatory requirements
  • Ensuring infrastructure and tools are in place to effectively manage risk and deliver high-quality client service

C11 – Intermediate level

title: Student Assistant, Commercial Excellence

· Curious and eager to learn, with an interest in commercial excellence.

title: [BI] Senior BI Developer (Analytics Engineer)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior BI Developer, you will be a key individual contributor building trusted data
products for Agoda’s technology organization, including curated datasets, metrics,
dashboards and visualizations, and scalable data transformations. You will work closely
with engineers, engineering managers, team leads, and senior leadership to help the
organization make better decisions with data. This role combines analytics, metrics
definition, and stakeholder consulting with hands-on data engineering and development


IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO
• Act as a partner and consultant to engineering managers and leaders: translate
stakeholder and engineering questions into measurable metrics/information such
as developer velocity, cost efficiency, and code quality, and keep those definitions
consistent across reports.
• Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT transformations, including Spark/Python
workflows and warehouse models, so data is accurate, timely, tested, and fit for
reporting. As a Senior, review others’ pipeline and metric work, raise delivery
standards, and unblock the team.
• Analyze large datasets with SQL and Python to support engineering and operational
decisions.
• Design and maintain dashboards and visual reports so engineering managers and
leaders can explore metrics (for example developer velocity, cost efficiency, and
code quality) without a ticket for every chart.
• Improve data reliability through validation, quality checks, observability, production
troubleshooting, and query performance tuning. Own published metrics: explain
filters and grain, flag numbers that should not be trusted, and recommend next
steps.
• Use AI tools (for example Cursor, Claude, or similar) to accelerate SQL
development, testing, refactoring, analysis, pipeline work, and documentation, and
reject unsafe or unverified output before it reaches production or stakeholders.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
• 5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, and/or data engineering, with
experience in both stakeholder consulting and hands-on pipeline or data-product
work.
• Advanced SQL (joins, window functions, and performance on large datasets).
• Strong Python skills (or similar) for building data pipelines.
• Experience with ETL/ELT and orchestration (for example Kubeflow or similar).
• Strong analytical thinking: comfortable framing business questions, exploring data,
and turning results into clear insights.
• Experience building dashboards or visual reports for stakeholders.
• Ability to switch context between stakeholder discussions and hands-on technical
work — metrics definition/analysis one day, ETL or data modeling the next.
• Practical AI-assisted development: generate, review, test, and own the result. You
can explain what you trusted AI to draft and what you verified yourself.
• Clear written and verbal English, and the ability to work independently with
engineers and leaders in an agile environment.


IT’S GREAT IF YOU HAVE
• Experience with software-delivery practices such as Agile/Scrum and CI/CD
(GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
• Interest in developer productivity or engineering analytics.
• Experience with common data platforms / big data technology (e.g., BigQuery,
Snowflake, Redshift, Hive, Spark, Vertica, StarRocks, or similar).
• Hands-on experience with visualization or data-serving UIs such as Apache
Superset, Tableau, or a lightweight web app.
• Experience building APIs or internal data products beyond dashboards, not only ad-
hoc analysis.
• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent
practical experience.

title: SENIOR SITE SUPERVISOR
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Role Summary

The Senior Site Supervisor independently supervises assigned construction areas, work packages or trades to ensure works are completed safely, on schedule and to the required quality standards. The role coordinates contractors, monitors workmanship and productivity, resolves routine site issues and provides practical guidance to junior site personnel.

Key Outcomes

  • Reliable Site Execution: Assigned construction works are completed according to approved drawings, specifications, work methods and project schedules.
  • Quality Assurance: Workmanship, materials and completed works meet the required quality standards, with defects identified and rectified promptly.
  • Site Coordination: Contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and site personnel are coordinated effectively to minimise work conflicts, disruption and delays.
  • Progress Visibility: Accurate and timely site records, progress updates and supporting evidence are maintained for project monitoring and decision-making.
  • Safety and Compliance: Site activities comply with applicable HSE requirements, regulatory standards and company procedures.
  • Early Issue Resolution: Daily operational problems and potential delays are identified early, resolved within the role’s authority or escalated with clear supporting information.
  • Supervisory Support: Junior site supervisors and site personnel receive practical guidance on work requirements, quality expectations and site procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site Operations and Work-Area Supervision
  • Independently supervise assigned construction areas, work packages or trades to ensure activities are carried out according to approved drawings, specifications, construction methods and schedules.
  • Plan and coordinate daily work priorities with contractors and subcontractors based on the approved construction programme.
  • Verify site readiness before work commences, including access, preceding works, approved drawings, materials, manpower, equipment and work permits.
  • Monitor work sequencing and interfaces between trades to prevent clashes, abortive work and disruption.
  • Ensure contractors maintain proper housekeeping, access and protection of completed works.
  • Provide practical site-level input to improve the execution and sequencing of construction activities.

  • Contractor and Workforce Coordination
  • Coordinate the activities of main contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and site workers within assigned work areas.
  • Communicate work requirements, priorities, quality expectations and completion timelines clearly to contractor representatives.
  • Monitor contractor manpower, equipment deployment and work productivity against planned requirements.
  • Identify insufficient resources, poor coordination or performance concerns and require the contractor to take corrective action.
  • Facilitate coordination between trades where work interfaces, access constraints or competing priorities arise.
  • Escalate recurring or material contractor performance issues to the relevant Project Implementation manager.

  • Progress Monitoring and Schedule Support
  • Monitor actual site progress against short-term work programmes, milestone dates and assigned deliverables.
  • Identify potential delays, sequencing issues, resource shortages or site constraints that may affect scheduled progress.
  • Verify completed work quantities and physical progress within assigned areas to support progress reporting and contractor claim verification.
  • Prepare accurate daily and weekly progress updates, including photographs, completed quantities, outstanding work and identified constraints.
  • Recommend practical recovery actions for routine delays and follow up on agreed corrective measures.
  • Promptly escalate matters that may affect major milestones, stage billing, inspections, handover or project completion.

  • Quality Control and Defect Management
  • Inspect construction works and materials to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, inspection and test plans and quality requirements.
  • Conduct or participate in inspection requests, joint inspections, mock-up reviews and quality checkpoints with contractors and consultants.
  • Identify defective, incomplete or non-compliant work and instruct the responsible contractor to undertake corrective or rectification work.
  • Monitor rectification progress and verify that identified defects have been properly closed.
  • Maintain accurate inspection records, defect registers, quality checklists and photographic evidence.
  • Support pre-handover, pre-VP, joint inspection and defect-management activities.
  • Reinforce good workmanship practices and contribute observations for continuous improvement and reduction of recurring defects.

  • Drawing, Material and Work-Method Compliance
  • Read and interpret approved construction drawings, specifications, schedules and relevant technical details for site implementation.
  • Confirm that the latest approved drawings and documents are being used at the work location.
  • Identify discrepancies, missing information or constructability concerns and raise them promptly to the Project Engineer or relevant project team member.
  • Check delivered materials against approved specifications, samples and quantities.
  • Monitor the storage, protection and usage of construction materials to minimise damage, deterioration and wastage.
  • Verify that contractors carry out works in accordance with approved method statements and inspection requirements.

  • Health, Safety and Environmental Compliance
  • Monitor site activities to ensure compliance with applicable HSE requirements, approved safe work procedures and project rules.
  • Identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, environmental concerns or non-compliance and require immediate corrective action where appropriate.
  • Stop and report work presenting an immediate risk to people, property or the environment, in accordance with established procedures.
  • Participate in site safety inspections, toolbox meetings, coordination meetings and incident reviews as required.
  • Ensure safety concerns, incidents and corrective actions within assigned areas are properly documented and followed through.
  • Work closely with the HSE team and contractor representatives to reinforce safe working practices.

  • Site Documentation and Reporting
  • Maintain complete and accurate site records, including:
  • daily site reports;
  • manpower and equipment records;
  • material delivery and usage records;
  • inspection and test records;
  • defect and rectification records;
  • site photographs;
  • work progress records; and
  • records of instructions, constraints and follow-up actions.
  • Use approved digital platforms, applications or reporting tools to record and communicate site progress and compliance information.
  • Analyse basic progress, defect, productivity or compliance data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring attention.
  • Provide factual and timely information to support project meetings, progress claims, audits, inspections and management reporting.
  • Ensure records are sufficiently clear and complete to support subsequent verification and decision-making.

  • Issue Resolution and Escalation
  • Resolve routine site coordination, workmanship, sequencing and resource issues within established procedures and delegated authority.
  • Investigate site problems by establishing the facts, consulting relevant parties and proposing practical corrective actions.
  • Distinguish between operational matters that can be resolved at site level and technical, contractual or commercial matters requiring escalation.
  • Escalate unresolved or higher-risk issues promptly, supported by photographs, drawings, progress records and recommended actions.
  • Follow up on instructions and decisions until agreed actions are completed and properly documented.

  • Guidance and Team Support
  • Provide practical guidance to Site Supervisors, junior site personnel and contractor supervisors on work requirements, inspection procedures and site standards.
  • Allocate or coordinate routine inspection and monitoring activities when assigned by the Project Implementation manager.
  • Check the completeness and accuracy of site information prepared by junior personnel before submission.
  • Share lessons learned and good site practices to improve consistency, quality and productivity.
  • Support the onboarding and familiarisation of new site supervisory personnel.

Core Competencies and Technical Expertise

Technical Competencies

  • Site Supervision and Construction Coordination – Independently supervises assigned work areas, packages or trades.
  • Drawing and Specification Interpretation – Applies approved drawings, specifications and construction details at site.
  • Contractor and Trade Coordination – Coordinates contractor activities and multiple work interfaces.
  • Work Sequencing and Site Readiness – Checks access, materials, manpower, equipment and preceding works before activities commence.
  • Progress and Productivity Monitoring – Monitors contractor progress, resource deployment and work productivity.
  • Quality Inspection and Defect Management – Identifies workmanship issues and monitors rectification through to closure.
  • Material and Workmanship Verification – Checks delivered materials and completed works against approved requirements.
  • Safety and Regulatory Compliance – Monitors compliance with HSE and project requirements.
  • Site Reporting and Digital Tools – Maintains accurate site, quality, progress and defect records.

Operational Skills

  • Daily Work Planning and Coordination – Coordinates work priorities and sequencing within assigned areas.
  • Independent Supervision of Assigned Areas – Manages routine site execution with limited supervision.
  • Practical Site Problem-Solving – Resolves routine coordination, workmanship and sequencing issues.
  • Contractor Performance Monitoring – Identifies productivity or performance concerns and follows up on corrective action.
  • Progress and Resource Monitoring – Tracks work progress, manpower, materials and equipment.
  • Issue Identification and Escalation – Recognises matters requiring engineering or managerial intervention.
  • Guidance of Junior Site Personnel – Provides practical guidance and checks the quality of junior personnel’s work.
  • Clear Communication – Communicates priorities, observations and site concerns effectively.
  • Follow-Up and Closure Discipline – Ensures defects, instructions and outstanding actions are followed through.

Mindset and Behaviours

  • Responsible and Accountable – Takes ownership of assigned site areas and outcomes.
  • Proactive – Anticipates site constraints and initiates action.
  • Practical and Solution-Oriented – Applies experience to resolve site issues.
  • Firm in Follow-Up – Holds contractors accountable for agreed actions.
  • Detail-Oriented – Pays close attention to workmanship, materials and progress.
  • Collaborative – Maintains constructive relationships while enforcing requirements.
  • Reliable – Provides consistent supervision and accurate site information.
  • Adaptable – Responds effectively to changing site priorities.
  • Ethical and Professional – Demonstrates integrity and professional behaviour.

Tools and Methodologies

  • Construction drawings, specifications and approved method statements.
  • Inspection and test plans, quality checklists and defect-management registers.
  • Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Autodesk Construction Cloud or equivalent project document and site-management platforms.
  • Digital site inspection, progress reporting and photographic-record applications.
  • Basic familiarity with Microsoft Project or equivalent scheduling tools.
  • Quality and environmental management frameworks, including ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.
  • Applicable HSE procedures, CIDB requirements and construction quality standards, including QLASSIC CIS 7.

Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualifications

  • Diploma in Civil Engineering, Building, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline may be advantageous but is not essential where the candidate possesses strong site experience.
  • CIDB certification, safety training, QLASSIC-related training or equivalent construction certification is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant site-supervision experience within the construction or property-development industry.
  • Demonstrated experience independently supervising defined construction areas, work packages or multiple trades.
  • Practical experience in contractor coordination, quality inspection, progress monitoring, defect rectification and site reporting.
  • Experience in township, high-rise, landed residential, infrastructure or industrial development projects is preferred.
  • Experience guiding junior site supervisors or coordinating site supervisory activities is advantageous.

The selection process may take some time as we carefully consider each talent that comes our way. Please note that we will only be in contact with successfully shortlisted candidates for the next phase of the recruitment process within 2-4 weeks. We truly appreciate your interest and always look forward to meeting great people who’d like to work with us!

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Tax Analyst
description:
Entity:

Finance


Job Family Group:

Tax Group


Job Description:

We are a global energy business involved in every aspect of the energy system. We are working towards delivering light, heat and mobility to millions of people, every day. Our people want to play their part in solving the big, sophisticated challenges facing our world today and, guided by our bp values, are working to help meet the world’s need for more energy while lowering carbon emissions. In our offices at Pune, we work in customer service, finance, accounting, procurement, HR services and other enabling functions – providing solutions as an integrated part of bp.

Would you like to discover how our diverse, hardworking people are owning the way in making energy cleaner and better – and how you can play your part in our outstanding team?

Join our team, and develop your career in an encouraging, forward-thinking environment!

About the role

The tax analyst will work within a small team providing transformation support to the global tax function - as a key member of the tax technology, data, and digitization team. The mission of our team is to enable tax to continuously adapt to a changing business landscape by improving data integrity, simplifying processes, and accelerating technology solutions. This team works closely with our information technology teams, business partners, and other members of the tax function to identify areas for process improvement and potential automation and to design and embed streamlined processes through digital solutions.

The work involves driving positive change in tax through technology and process optimization, coordinating agile teams, as well as gathering end user requirements from bp to deliver more efficient and, where applicable, standardized tax processes.

What you will deliver

  • Collaborate with the global tax function, tax technology and data team, and IT team to gather and understand business requirements.

  • Develop and implement solutions using MS Copilot, PowerBI, PowerApps, SharePoint, and other relevant tools to enhance tax processes and reporting.

  • Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and applications to support tax operations.

  • Participate in the testing and deployment of new solutions, ensuring they meet business needs and are user-friendly.

  • Provide training and support to end-users on new tools and applications.

  • Continuously monitor and improve existing solutions to ensure they remain effective and efficient.

  • Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in tax technology and data analytics.

Essential Education:

  • Educated to a degree standard with additional qualification or equivalent professional experience.

Crucial experience and job requirements:

  • Minimum of 1-2 years’ relevant experience in business transformation with a strong understanding of business transformation projects, including data and process change activities.

  • Ability to take the initiative to create opportunities for improvement and problem resolution.

  • Adept at understanding, compiling, and improving established policies and procedures through collaboration with support teams.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills, attention-to-detail, and self-starter.

  • Excellent business verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence others to accomplish initiatives.

  • Able to work on multiple projects and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience Microsoft Suite especially Power Apps, Power BI and Power Automate

Desirable criteria:

  • Experience with citizen development and low-code/no-code platforms.

  • Familiarity with data visualization and business intelligence concepts.

  • An understanding of developments in tax data, technologies, external digitalization including AI, and the impact on operational processes.

  • Previous experience with working on technology led finance / tax transformation projects

  • Knowledge of tax processes and regulations.

  • Experience in a global or multinational company.

You will work with

We are unique, as our team has access to other bp functions and senior leaders at a time when the organization is investing heavily in modernization, thus providing ample opportunity to develop networks and stakeholder management skills. In addition, our focus on data integrity, accessibility, and insights to address regulatory pressures from around the world means the incumbent will rapidly be exposed to the needs of the future finance and tax professional.

You will work with key stakeholders within tax, finance, technology and business teams alongside other members of the tax technology, data, and digitization team.


Travel Requirement

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role


Relocation Assistance:

This role is eligible for relocation within country


Remote Type:

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working


Skills:

acquisitions and disposals activity, acquisitions and disposals activity, Alteryx, Analytical Thinking, Commercial Acumen, Creativity and Innovation, Data Management, Digital Fluency, Direct and indirect tax compliance and accounting, Economic modelling, Financial Reporting, Influencing tax law and policy, Interpreting and applying tax law, Management of Change, Managing tax dispute resolution and controversies, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI), Project Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Tax advice for mergers, Tax advisory, Tax Automation, Tax compliance process management, Tax reporting and control, Tax Technology {+ 1 more}

.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Ii
description:
Etsitkö sinä ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.

Meille on tärkeää, että työ sopii yhtä hyvin avustajalle kuin avustaja asiakkaalle. Työvuorot suunnitellaan yhteisymmärryksessä, jotta arki pysyy kaikille toimivana ja selkeänä.

Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Ii. Asiakas tarvitsee apua arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidollista,harrastuksiin, yhteiskunnalliseen osallistumiseen ja ulkoiluun. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.

Työtunteja on 20 tuntia/kuukausi ja työaika tulee olemaan yleensä 2-3 kertaa viikossa arkisin aamupäivällä/ päivällä.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW


Co-op and Internship opportunities allow you to gain valuable work experience across a number of the businesses at TD. You will work with experienced colleagues, receive world class training, and be part of a community of students across TD, where you will have an impact, grow as individual and experience our culture of care.

Corporate Operational Risk Management ("C-ORM") is accountable for the design and implementation

of TDBG's Operational Risk Management Framework that sets out the Bank's governance,

policies, processes and practices for the identification, assessment, reporting, mitigation

and control of operational risk. Within this context, C-ORM acts as an independent risk

management function responsible for ensuring the Bank has an effective operational risk

management program to support our risk behaviours of Own It, Raise It and Know It and manage risk within the Bank's risk appetite.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role will provide a broad range of risk analysis, reporting, monitoring and support to business partner requests and act as a specialist/expert in providing advice on a range of risk related matters within the Issues Management team. The role involves conducting data quality checks and thematic analysis of issue data and drafting reporting insights to inform senior leadership of key themes and potential areas of concern. The successful candidate should possess strong analytical thinking and attention to detail skills as these reports are presented at various senior committees within the organization.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned

below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Data, Business/Commerce or related field

  • Provide regular commentary and industry analysis in supporting the development/ maintenance/ oversight of policies/ procedures/ practices related to the Issues Management program

  • Actively manage relationships within and across various business lines, corporate and/or oversight functions and ensure alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements

  • Keep abreast of emerging issues, trends, and evolving regulatory requirements and assess potential impacts

  • Conducts Issues Management analysis to inform decision making at senior levels

  • Works independently and performs ongoing monitoring and analysis of Issues management data to inform future trends

  • Participate fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure timely communication of issues/ points of interest

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • This position is a 4-month work term and will commence January - April 2026.

  • Applications must include a transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (maximum of 2 pages).

  • We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. Thank you for your interest.

title: Kundeservicemedarbejder
description:
Når julehandlen går i gang, får vi ekstra travlt. Derfor søger vi flere kolleger til vores kundeserviceteam med opstart omkring 28. september og ansættelse frem til midten af januar.

Hvem er Instabee?

Instabee blev grundlagt i 2022 efter fusionen af Budbee og Instabox og står i dag bag Budbee, Instabox og Porterbuddy (kun i Norge). Vi arbejder for at gøre det nemt at sende og modtage pakker og er en del af en international virksomhed inden for last-mile-levering i fem europæiske lande.

Du kender os måske bedst fra Budbees hjemmeleveringer og de røde Instabox-pakkebokse. Vi står også for levering af pakker i forbindelse med køb og salg af secondhand online.

Om jobbet

Som kundeservicemedarbejder hjælper du vores kunder med spørgsmål om deres pakker og leveringer og sørger for, at de får en professionel og god service.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kommunikation med kunder via chat, SMS, e-mail, kontaktformular og telefon

  • Besvare spørgsmål om pakkens placering, levering og afhentning

  • Hjælpe kunder, hvis der opstår problemer med deres levering

  • Håndtere forskellige kundehenvendelser og finde gode løsninger

Hvem er du?

Du er engageret og serviceorienteret og trives med at arbejde i et miljø, hvor der kan være travlt.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller et andet servicejob, fx butik, café eller restaurant

  • Er fortrolig med IT og lærer hurtigt nye systemer

  • Taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk

  • Tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket

  • Er stabil og trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med andre i et team

Det praktiske

Stillingen er en sæsonansættelse med opstart omkring 28. september og løber frem til midten af januar.

Der er mulighed for både fuldtid og deltid.

Vagterne ligger på hverdage mellem kl. 09.00 og 22.30. I den travleste del af julesæsonen kan der også forekomme enkelte vagter lørdag og søndag.

Vi sørger for en grundig introduktion til jobbet, så du er godt klædt på til julesæsonen.

Interesseret?

Send os din ansøgning. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Personlighedstest via Alva Labs indgår som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen.

title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing

title: TD Asset Management Business Management Intern/Co-op (Winter 2027  - Toronto, Winnipeg)
description:
Role Type:

Internship/Co-op

Work Term:

Winter/Term 2

Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours:

37.5

Pay Details:

$48,000 - $68,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Department Overview

TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), a member of TD Bank Group, is a leading North American investment manager offering progressive investment solutions to both institutional and individual investors. As of December 31, 2023 TDAM and its affiliates manage over CDN$410 billion in assets on behalf of pension, insurance, endowment/foundation and corporate clients, as well as high-net worth clients and retail mutual funds, across both active fundamental and quantitative-based solutions, private debts and alternative investments including real estate, infrastructure.

Job Description (responsibilities, accountabilities, etc.)

· Work in one of the following business units within TDAM including Investment Operations, Client Services, Regulatory & Policy Governance, Business Governance & Portfolio Oversight, Communications, Market Intelligence & Analytics, Sales Enablement, Internal or External Distribution, and Product & Strategy.

· Learn aspects of the asset management business, such as strategy, product design, distribution, operations, governance and oversight, trading and settlement process, or market intelligence.

· Support and contribute to market, prospect and competitor research

· Support, produce and deliver reports for internal and external stakeholders

· Support projects focused on the ongoing improvement of our processes

· Undertake projects touching on strategy, market intelligence, business and product development, portfolio management, finance, risk, governance, client service, operations

Skills that the student must have (specific technical, and other skills)

  • Organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, multi-task and maintain attention to detail

  • Good foundation in business acumen, capital markets, problem solving skills and analytical capabilities

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint and Word); advanced Excel capabilities

Skills that are not required, but would be an asset (specific technical, and other skills)

  • Microsoft Access, Python/SQL/Coding skills, financial modelling

  • VBA and SQL

  • Co-op experience in investment research, real estate, public and private securities analysis, risk management

  • Strong verbal and written presentation skills

  • Accuracy and attention to detail are essential

  • Highly motivated individual with the willingness and flexibility to take different initiatives

  • Must be able to work effectively in a team environment

  • Bilingualism (French and English) is an asset

Other information

Applications must include an unofficial university transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (two letter-sized pages or less).

Addition Information

Hybrid work model – 4 days of in-person/office.

Location: Toronto, Winnipeg

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Sans Objet

title: Retail Analytics - Summer 2027 Corporate Internship
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.


DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

The Retail Analytics Internship will give you the opportunity to work in one of many data-driven roles at the corporate level. These areas include but are not limited to eCommerce, Marketing, & Finance. Placement will be determined based on candidate skillset and business need. After the internship, candidates will be reviewed for full-time opportunities in one of our development programs.

Potential Areas of Placement:


• Web Analytics:


You will experience a diversity of work as you analyze a broad array of eCommerce data to drive business-altering recommendations. Learn the basic responsibilities of the job, working with your manager to explore and manipulate the core eCommerce data. You will be introduced to a variety of on and off-site analytics data spanning such topics as visitor tracking, navigation analysis, product performance, traffic segmentation, digital marketing, search optimization, voice of customer, e-mail, social, and omni-channel data. This data set will assist you in making informed, insightful decisions as you partner with the business owners to identify needs and leverage business intelligence.

• Marketing Analytics:


As a Marketing Analyst Intern, you will conduct analysis that generates insights, enabling the creation and execution of actions that drive increased revenues and margins for DICK’S Sporting Goods. You will analyze targeted customer populations and promotion selection for direct marketing campaigns (email, mail, etc.).

• Financial Planning & Analysis:


You will spend the summer as a Financial Analyst working on projects to support key business initiatives by preparing the appropriate analysis and presenting the results to senior management, preparing competitor benchmarking and analysis, ad hoc analysis and reporting on current business trends

Some of your experiences will include:


• Multi day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your teammates
• Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as develop their business acumen and office professionalism
• Extensive exposure to our senior leadership through our exclusive intern only Executive Speaker Series which includes a private meet & greet with our CEO
• Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events
• Fully furnished summer housing is provided for interns who reside outside of the Metro Pittsburgh area or stipend for local interns
• Working a 40 hour work week, Monday – Friday

Skills we are looking for:


• A competitive spirit with a passion for results
• An interest and confidence in working with data and numbers; strong mathematical/quantitative skills highly preferred
• Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to independently make data-driven recommendations
• A curiosity and desire to learn about consumer and retail trends, including customer demographics, purchasing influencers and emerging technology
• Dynamic written and verbal communication style to read and write reports, as well as communicate cross functionally and vertically throughout the organization
• Passion for analytics, strategy, retail, sports and/or innovation
• Comfort working in a fast-paced, growing and changing environment

We look for potential candidates with:
• Graduation date of December 2027 or May 2028
• A major in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Marketing, Management, Economics, or other related
business or retail major
• Strong proficiency in Excel
• An ability to relocate to the Pittsburgh, PA area for the summer**

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027
Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:


Interns will be evaluated for full-time opportunities in one of our development programs. Qualified interns will be placed into a full-time, development rotational program.

Perks:

  • Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*
  • Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG
  • Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.
  • Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th
  • Teammate Discount
  • Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office
  • Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks
  • Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders
  • Executive Speaker Series
  • Professional development
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. I especially appreciated the collaborative environment and the opportunity to apply both creative and strategic thinking. This experience has strengthened my passion for the retail industry, and I would love the opportunity to come back and continue growing with the DSG team in the future." – Sarah Cyphers, Merchandising Intern

Interested to learn more? Watch our Internship Recap Video!

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree

  • Strong verbal communication skills to read and write reports, as well as communicate cross-functionally and vertically throughout the organization

  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment

  • Eagerness to learn and work as part of a multidisciplinary team

  • Ability to communicate thoughts and technical ideas in an accessible manner

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
