title: Graduate Rate Salesperson
description:
Graduate Rates Salesperson — Interest Rate Derivatives

London | Graduate | Full-time

SilverTide is the leading fintech specialising in buy-side brokerage services. Our software gives portfolio managers differentiated trade idea creation, analysis and optimisation — and we cover interest rate derivatives for the largest hedge funds in New York, London, Dubai and Geneva. We're looking for graduates who want to learn this business properly, alongside the people who built it.



What you'll do

  • Support senior salespeople in covering portfolio managers at leading hedge funds
  • Help build and present actionable trade ideas in listed interest rate options and OTC swaps
  • Run trade analysis and optimisation for ad hoc client requests
  • Learn how the market works day to day — rates, volatility, positioning and flow
  • Work closely with our execution traders to see ideas through from pitch to fill
  • Help strengthen client relationships and grow the franchise as you develop



What we're looking for

  • A degree in Finance, Economics, Maths, Engineering, Physics or similar
  • Strong numeracy and analytical ability, with real attention to detail
  • Confident, clear communication — you'll be talking to sophisticated clients early
  • Genuine curiosity about markets and a commercial instinct
  • Comfort with data and technology in a fast-moving environment


No prior derivatives experience needed — just the appetite to learn quickly.



What you'll get

Structured training, mentorship from senior salespeople, direct client exposure from your first months, and a clear path to running your own coverage.

title: Electrical Technician - 1st Shift Arden, NC
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS PDCAD division is currently seeking an Electrical Technician - 1st Shift Arden, NC.

The hourly rate for this position is $26.50-30.00 per hour.

The shift hours are 5am - 3:30pm.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

Eaton’s Power Distribution and Control Assemblies is currently seeking a Electrical Technician I to join our team. This position is based at our Arden, NC facility.

The Electrical Technician I position is a key role in the final inspection and functional testing of Eaton’s products. As a Electrical Technician I you will create a test plan, electronically / electrically test, and inspect electrical components and connections in various applications; (structures, units, panels, panel-boards, component parts, controls, and assemblies) in order to verify correct product function. At times you will need to perform troubleshooting and complete or document needed repairs prior to shipping. The ability to follow diagrams, schematics, and various work instructions in line with engineered specifications, including test and working procedures will allow you to be productive in this role.

In this role, you will:
• Follow verbal and written instructions, drawings, and specifications to set up, inspect, and test equipment.
• Perform mechanical, electrical, insulation, and sequence testing; inspect assemblies, panels, and components for quality and functionality.
• Troubleshoot test failures, determine root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with Engineering, Quality, and supervision.
• Verify customer orders for completeness and support customer inspectors during testing and inspection activities.
• Recommend and support improvements to assembly, wiring, calibration, testing procedures, and ensure required changes and repairs are completed.
• Maintain test equipment, calibration status, records, and reports.
• Comply with all safety, PPE, hygiene, and housekeeping requirements.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Required (Basic) Qualifications:
• Requires a high school diploma /GED from an accredited institution.
• Minimum 2 years’ work experience working in power distribution or electrical distribution.
• Previous experience in troubleshooting complex electrical circuits.
• Able to read and interpret electrical schematics.
• Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
• No relocation benefit is being offered for this position. Only candidates within a 50-mile radius of the work location will be considered. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Associate’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Technology/Engineering / Electromechanical / Mechatronics or related field
• 1 year of reading and interpreting schematics
• Previous experience working with open and energized electrical equipment in a testing environment

title: Lead Python Application Developer - Vice President
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution-focused Senior Python Application Developer with 12+ years of hands-on experience to design, architect, and deliver critical, horizontally scalable, highly available, and performant applications. This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture, Design & Hands-on Development

  • Lead Implementation: Lead the hands-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
  • Platform Engineering: Design and develop efficient software platforms for high-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
  • Standards & Alignment: Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
  • Database & API Design: Design, develop, and secure high-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).

2. Technical Leadership, Governance & Delivery

  • SDLC & Code Quality: Enforce industry-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • Project Ownership: Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
  • Change Management: Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
  • Independent Execution: Work independently, multi-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.

3. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
  • Global Collaboration: Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
  • Executive Communication: Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.

Required Technical Qualifications

I. Core Python, DSA & System Development

  • Experience: 12+ years of hands-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Python Expertise: Expert-level Python 3.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
  • Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
  • Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
  • Database Systems: Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
  • Operating Systems: Highly experienced with Unix/Linux-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system-level development.

II. Cloud, DevOps & Testing

  • Cloud Platforms: Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.
  • Testing & TDD: Proficiency in automated testing frameworks (Pytest, unittest) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
  • Security: Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application of security principles (OWASP Top 10).
  • Version Control: Expertise in Git (Bitbucket, GitHub) for advanced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.

III. Quantitative & Risk Domain

  • Quantitative Computation: Multiple years of experience developing quantitative/calc-intensive Python solutions with advanced computation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
  • Risk Methodologies: Sound understanding of and exposure to various Risk Methodologies (e.g., Market Risk, Stress Testing, Value at Risk (VaR), Sensitivities).
  • Domain Delivery: Proven track record of delivering Stress Testing and Regulatory Risk projects in the Market Risk domain.
  • Mathematical Modeling: Exposure to mathematical modeling and financial insights.

IV. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration (Exposure)

  • AI/ML Frameworks: Exposure to AI/ML tools and frameworks.
  • Development Workflows: Practical experience utilizing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude, Gemini, GPT) to optimize development workflows.
  • Agentic AI: Experience with Agentic AI tools, including writing Agents and Skills, and contributing to Agentic frameworks.
  • Generative AI: Understanding and practical application of Generative AI concepts in software development.

Professional & Leadership Skills

  • Agile/Scrum: Deep understanding and practical experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical, logical, systems thinking, and critical analysis skills.
  • Design Thinking: Demonstrated design thinking skills to solve complex business and technical problems.
  • Ownership & Adaptability: Ability to take complete ownership of various parts of a project, adapt to changing priorities, and perform under pressure.

Preferred / "Good to Have" Qualifications

  • Banking Domain: Prior experience working within the banking/financial services domain, specifically in pricing, valuation, or risk management systems.
  • Certifications: Relevant Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Industry Certifications.
  • Financial Certifications: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is a strong plus.

title: Butiksmedarbejder over 18 år - dagtimer
description:
Vi søger en ny kollega OVER 18 år, der har lyst til at arbejde i vores butik i alle timer på ugen. Du skal primært hjælpe vores kunder og betjene dem ved kassen. Derudover skal du arbejde med vores mange varer, og være med til at kunderne møder en velopfyldt butik hver gang de besøger os.

Hvem er du?

Da vi har travlt i vores butik, skal du være frisk på at give den gas sammen med resten af teamet. Du trives i en dagligdag med fart på, og du brænder for at skabe den helt unikke kundeoplevelse i NORMAL. At tage ansvar og initiativ er noget, der falder dig naturligt, og du arbejder med dine daglige opgaver, indtil du er helt i mål. Vi forventer, at du kommer til tiden og overholder dine aftaler, så vi sammen kan skabe et godt team og lykkes i butikken.

Er du derudover hjælpsom, har godt humør og bidrager til den gode stemning – så er vi nok et godt match!
Har du allerede erfaring med at stå i butik er det kun en fordel.

Er du interesseret?

Send os din ansøgning ved at trykke "søg her". Grundet persondataloven behandler vi ikke ansøgninger på mail.

OBS: Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: VP Software Engineering
description:
About Us

At Nextlane, we don’t just develop software solutions – we create the future of the automotive industry.

We are a company that combines advanced technology with a clear vision: simplifying and digitizing every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.

We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to develop and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

  • Be part of a growth-oriented culture.

  • Collaborate with colleagues from all over the world.

  • Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.

  • Be committed to provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and collaborate on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate, push boundaries, and work on solutions that are transforming the automotive world.

🚀 The Mission

Nextlane builds the software that runs automotive retail across 14 countries, with more than 60 manufacturer integrations. Today that runs on around ten legacy dealer management systems, built over three decades in technologies that are now at the end of their life.

We are replacing them with a single cloud platform, and we are building it with AI at the centre: both in how our engineers work, and in what our customers get. Our AI products are already live and generating revenue, and they are the fastest growing part of our portfolio.

You will lead the engineering organisation that builds all of it: the cloud product portfolio, the single platform that replaces the legacy estate, and the AI products we sell to dealers and manufacturers.

This is a build job, not a caretaking job. The legacy estate keeps running while you build what replaces it, so you will be making hard sequencing calls about what gets migrated, what gets rewritten and what gets left alone, with real customers on the other side of every one of them.

🎯 Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Engineering strategy and delivery. Defining and executing the engineering strategy for the cloud product portfolio, aligned to the company strategy and the product vision, and owning delivery, scalability, reliability and operational excellence.

  • An engineering organisation of around 30 people, led through Engineering Managers, with Principal and Staff Engineers on the technical track. Building and scaling those teams across several product domains, and developing the leaders inside them.

  • The AI product portfolio. The engineering capability, evaluation discipline, reliability and unit cost model that let us ship customer-facing AI features safely and repeatedly, including ownership of the Skywalker team.

  • Agentic development. Driving our agentic development operating model inside your organisation. We have standardised on Claude Code for all engineers, with autonomy gated by a defined AI fluency scale. You will take this from adoption to measured delivery outcomes, and contribute to how it works across the company.

  • Architectural coherence. Working with our Architecture Practice and our Platform engineering team so that we ship one platform rather than several that resemble each other.

What success looks like

  • The single platform has a credible, sequenced delivery plan, with the first migrated modules live with real customers rather than in pilot.

  • Agentic development is measurably changing throughput and quality in your teams, with the numbers to prove it rather than anecdotes.

  • Shipped further customer-facing AI capabilities to production, with an evaluation and cost model you can defend to the executive team.

  • Your leadership bench is strong enough that the organisation runs without you in the middle of it.

🕵️ What We’re Looking For

These are the requirements that decide this hire. We will probe each one with specific evidence, so please come prepared with examples.

1. You have led a real agentic development transformation, not a tooling rollout.

You have taken an engineering organisation from AI-assisted coding to agentic delivery, and you changed the operating model to match: how work is decomposed, what the definition of done is, how code review and testing hold up when generated volume goes up, and how you measured whether any of it worked. We will ask what broke, what you changed, and what the numbers did.

2. You have shipped AI features to paying customers.

Production features built on models, not internal productivity tooling and not a prototype. That means evaluation harnesses, failure modes and hallucination posture, latency and unit cost per interaction, human in the loop design, data protection, and the conversations with legal and with customers about what the system is allowed to do. You know what you would build differently now.

3. You lead through managers, and you are still technical.

You have run an engineering organisation of around 30 to 50 people or larger, through Engineering Managers or Directors, across more than one product domain, and you have hired and developed those leaders. You are also credible in an architecture review: you can read the design, ask the question that exposes the weak assumption, and disagree with a Principal Engineer on the substance. We are not looking for a leader who has stopped engaging with the technology.

4. You communicate exceptionally well.

Fluent English, which is our working language and the language of the interview process. You can hold a room of engineers and a room of executives on the same subject and be equally clear in both, explain a technical trade-off in business terms without diluting it, and write well enough that a decision survives contact with a distributed organisation. A large part of this role is alignment across countries, functions and levels, so this is not a soft requirement.

6. You have built cloud-native B2B SaaS at scale.

Multi-tenant products with real reliability and scalability requirements, distributed and international teams, and a product-led organisation where engineering partners with Product rather than receiving specifications from it. You are fluent in cloud platforms, distributed systems and modern software delivery, and you can judge those decisions even where you are not hands-on.

Strong advantages

  • Experience in a private equity backed environment, and comfort with the reporting rhythm and capital discipline that comes with it.

  • Domain exposure to automotive, mobility, retail, fintech, telecommunications or another integration-heavy enterprise SaaS sector.

  • A second European language: French, Spanish, Portuguese or German.

  • Experience leading a small, high-autonomy innovation team alongside a larger delivery organisation.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. 30-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. Interview with the CTPO.

  3. Engineering Leadership interview.

  4. Executive Leadership interview.

  5. Final Executive conversation.

What We Offer:

We understand that flexibility and trust are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

  • 🏡 Hybrid Work: Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.

  • 💰 Annual Payments: 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments + 1 summer bonus + 1 Christmas bonus in November).

  • 🍽️ Meal Voucher: €10.20 per working day.

  • 🌴 Vacation: 23 vacation days, plus 24th or 31st December off.

  • 🗣️ Language Training: Access to group classes in Spanish, English, or French.

  • ⚕️ Private Medical Insurance: Multicare coverage.

  • Teambuilding: Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

  • Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.

  • Equal opportunities for all: We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Nextlane and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.

Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

title: R&D Project Leader
description:
Job Title

R&D Project Leader

Job Description

You are responsible for

  • Give direction and leads complex, integral projects, from initial phase until introduction in the Market or until internal company delivery, which are essential to Philips organizational strategy involving multiple business domains and knowledge centers inside and outside Philips and/or external business partners and/or customers.

  • Set strategic direction within the project(s) and related projects / program

  • Articulate complex schedules and interdependencies in a consumable way for stakeholders, can identify risks and issues and identifies mitigation actions and understands when to escalate.

  • In collaboration with project stakeholders identifies project risks (opportunities and threats) and issues, identify mitigation actions and supports in fostering a risk environment where considerate risk-taking behavior is encouraged, taking into consideration the balance between risk taking and risk escalations.

  • Apply daily management and methodical problem solving, partners with key stakeholders to constantly search for creative and innovative ways to elevate the capabilities of the portfolio and maintains advanced knowledge of business lines and products/services, as well as the competitive market.

  • Recognize critical project knowledge, value lessons learned, and share critical project knowledge in the Philips Knowledge Hub. Drive opportunities in the Philips PM community to add value and uses internal network to advance other teams.

  • Deliver innovative solutions that improve single domain business activities and/or operations and impact the long-term goals in the organization.

  • Responsible for project goals and objectives, key process decisions and alignment with project stakeholders related to large projects.

  • KPIs projections, tracking, and reporting for assigned initiatives.

  • Report project status regularly to key stakeholders and obtaining stakeholders’ approvals for completing each key milestone and major plan changes with discipline.

  • Deliver the quality initiatives via project and product development execution.

  • Support continuous improvement and compliance processes and initiatives according to corporate policies and procedures

  • Manage Change Management procedures as appropriate.

  • Maintain awareness of new and emerging technologies and the potential application on relevant G&B Product Development

  • The position requires a high degree of flexibility and the ability to work both independently and within a team. Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, analytical and communication skills are necessary to successfully deliver Philips G&B products and present Philips G&B message to individuals and groups in a professional manner.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience

Essential:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. business or engineering preferred)

  • 8+ years in engineering or R&D project management successfully leading large complex programs, projects, and initiatives with structured approach.

  • 5+ years in leading a cross-cultural and geographically dispersed project team developing small domestic appliances (SDA) preferably grooming, shaving or beauty products.

  • Subject Matter Expert in all aspects of Project Management plan-driven methodology, including Governance, Monitoring & Controlling, Scope Management, Schedule Management, Financial Management, Issue & Risk Management, Vendor, Contract, & Resources Management

  • Good technical knowledge and understanding of electronics and mechanical design aspects of household or consumer products.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills while maintaining high-quality standards.

  • Ability to tailor information and pitch at differing levels of detail, especially presenting management information to assist with and enable decision making.

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills to drive change & standardization across the businesses and markets.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, result oriented self-starter with excellent communication and people skills, attention to detail and initiative.

  • Fluent in English and Chinese Languages

  • Willing to travel.


How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 4 days per week.
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role.
About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business.
• Discover our rich and exciting history.
• Learn more about our purpose.
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Window Surveyor
description:
A bit about the role…


We are looking for experienced FENSA-registered Window Surveyors to join our team at Connolly Ltd, supporting the delivery of window and door replacement programmes within the Social Housing sector across the North West, Cumbria, and West Yorkshire.

The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out accurate surveys within occupied and void properties, ensuring all measurements, specifications, and compliance requirements are captured to support smooth project delivery.

Experience within social housing and window/door replacement programmes is essential, along with a strong understanding of working in tenant-occupied environments.

A bit about us…


Connolly is a leading refurbishment company with family values at our core. We don’t just improve homes—we help build stronger communities and are committed to making a positive impact for residents.

We operate within the Social Housing sector, delivering housing services to local authorities and housing associations across West Yorkshire, Cumbria, the Northwest, and North Wales.

What you will be responsible for…


  • Carrying out detailed surveys for window and door replacement works
  • Accurately measuring and recording specifications for manufacture and installation
  • Ensuring all surveys comply with FENSA regulations and current building standards
  • Working across occupied and void social housing properties
  • Identifying any potential issues that could impact installation or programme timelines
  • Liaising with site teams, residents, and client representatives

  • Maintaining accurate records and submitting survey data in line with company procedures
  • Supporting the delivery team to ensure works are completed efficiently and to specification

What we’d like from you…


  • Valid FENSA registration (essential)
  • Proven experience as a Window/Door Surveyor
  • Strong knowledge of Social Housing environments
  • Experience working within tenant-occupied properties
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in measurements
  • Good communication and organisational skills
  • Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel across the region

Why join us?


This is a fantastic opportunity to join a family-run business experiencing strong growth in the Social Housing sector, supported by a diverse and experienced leadership team.

At Connolly Ltd, we believe that when you feel valued and supported, you perform at your best and enjoy your work.

You’ll receive a competitive rewards package, including:

  • Comprehensive pension scheme

  • Access to ongoing training and development opportunities

Ready to join Team Connolly?


If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out.

description:
Haemme innostunutta myyjää vakituiseentyösuhteeseen K-Market Tikkuriin ja K-Market Dixiin. K-Market Tikkuri ja K-Market Dixi sijaitsevat vierekkäin Tikkurilan juna-aseman välittömässä läheisyydessä. K-Market Tikkuri on monipuolinen, aktiivinen ja sesongeissa mukana oleva ruokakauppa, jossa on tarjolla pakettipalvelut, verkkokauppa, ja Wolt. K-market Dixi tarjoaa asiakkailleen nopean ostamisen palvelun pienessä ja kompaktissa myymälässä.


Meillä pääset työskentelemään molemmissa kaupoissa ja monipuolisissa tehtävissä. Tylsää ei töissä tule olemaan, vaan vauhtia riittää! Meillä työskennellään reippaassa tahdissa mutta rennossa ja hauskassa porukassa.

Asiakkaiden arjen helpottaminen ja laadukas palvelu ovat toimintamme keskiössä. Myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa asiakaspalvelu kassalla ja pakettipalveluissa, aktiivinen myyntityö, esillepanojen rakentaminen, hyllysaatavuuden ja kauppakunnon varmistaminen sekä kaupan muut työt. Arvostamme vastuunottokykyä sekä tehokasta ja huolellista työskentelyotetta. Myyjänä merkityksesi asiakkaan ostoskäynnin onnistumisessa on ratkaisevan tärkeä.

Toivomme sinulta:
- iloista ja avointa asiakaspalveluasennetta - oma-aloitteista ja joustavaa asennetta sekä paineensietokykyä - kykyä työskennellä sekä yksin että tiimissä - kehittymishalua ja innostusta oppia uutta - suomen kielen taitoa ja vähintään 18 vuoden ikää - valmiutta työskennellä kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina





Työkokemus kaupan alalta on plussaa mutta ei pakollista, sillä perehdytämme sinut yhdessä tehtäviisi.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- loistavan työympäristön ja mukavat työkaverit - työn asiakaspalvelun ytimessä ja mahdollisuuden auttaa asiakasta - monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn - oman kaupan ostoedun ja K-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut - mahdollisuuden kouluttaa ja kehittää itseäsi päivittäistavarakaupan alalla




Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 20.09.2026 oheisen linkin kautta. Aloitamme hakemusten käsittelyn jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta kesko.fi/duunitaidot.

Rekrytointiin liittyvän tietosuojaselosteen saat rekrytoivasta kaupasta.


Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: In-Reach Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We have an exciting opportunity for a In-Reach Recovery Coordinator who has the skills and experience to assess and engage with our stakeholders.

Where: Nottinghamshire (County South and Bassetlaw for the bases and the role covers whole county)

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract until 31st March 2028

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

About the role:

With this role you’ll be working as part of Nottinghamshire County Rough Sleeping Team (RSDAT)

The team supports people with their drug and/or alcohol issues identified as SMD (Severe Multiple Disadvantaged) in accommodation based settings.

The In-Reach Recovery Coordinator will provide specialist drug and alcohol support to residents identified as SMD (Severe Multiple Disadvantage) living within accommodation based settings. The role aims to improve engagement with treatment services, reduce substance-related harm and support individuals to sustain accommodation and improve overall wellbeing.

The post holder will work alongside accommodation providers, housing teams, healthcare professionals, treatment services, and other partner agencies to provide person-centred, trauma-informed support to individuals experiencing substance misuse alongside multiple and complex needs. As well as upskilling and providing training for accommodation providers.

In addition, the post holder will:

  • Deliver a specialist drug and alcohol in-reach service within accommodation-based settings for individuals experiencing Severe Multiple Disadvantage (SMD).
  • Engage and support individuals who face barriers to accessing mainstream treatment services, using trauma-informed, strengths-based, and psychologically informed approaches.
  • Provide brief interventions, harm reduction advice, overdose prevention education, and Naloxone training to both service users and accommodation providers.
  • Assess substance misuse needs, identify barriers to engagement, and facilitate access to appropriate treatment, recovery, and healthcare services, including CGL and other specialist providers.
  • Develop positive working relationships with accommodation providers and partner agencies to improve outcomes for residents with complex needs.
  • Provide guidance, awareness sessions, and informal training to accommodation based settings on substance misuse, harm reduction, recovery pathways, and supporting people experiencing SMD.
  • Participate in multi-agency meetings, safeguarding processes, and joint risk management arrangements to promote coordinated support.
  • Maintain accurate records and contribute to the monitoring and evaluation of service outcomes, ensuring compliance with organisational policies and procedures.

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and/or experience of working within a similar field
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage change successfully in a way that prioritises the needs of service users
  • Understand the importance of information governance processes and commit to follow and apply all necessary safeguards
  • Seek out learning opportunities to improve and broaden your professional knowledge and skills and to contribute and oversee the learning and development of others

What we will give to you:

  • 25 days holiday (+ bank holidays) rising with each years’ service (capped at 30, allocated pro rata)
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities
  • generous refer-a-friend scheme

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Direct applications only we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Myyjä Porvoon Biltemaan ja Biltema Cafeseen
description:
Biltema on perheyhtiö, jonka menestyksen takana ovat työhönsä intohimolla ja ylpeydellä suhtautuvat työntekijät. Tartumme tuumasta toimeen täydellä sydämellämme ja teemme töitä yhdessä toisiamme kannustaen. Suomessa meillä työskentelee parhaimpaan sesonkiaikaan yli 550 innokasta tekijää 24 tavaratalossamme. Vuonna 2025 avasimme uudet Biltema-tavaratalot Kouvolaan, Porvooseen ja Lohjalle, helmikuussa 2026 Hämeenlinnaan ja kasvumme jatkuu edelleen - seuraavat Biltema-tavaratalot ovat tulossa Ouluun, Joensuuhun ja Kokkolaan syksyllä 2026.

Etsimme Porvooseen reipasta osa-aikaista myyjää

Bilteman Porvoon tavaratalon yhteydessä toimii Biltema Cafe ja etsimme nyt reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä osa-aikaista myyjää työskentelemään monipuolisesti sekä kahvilassa että myymälän puolella. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja työtunteja on keskimäärin 10-15 h/ vko.

- Biltema Cafessa huolehdit ensiluokkaisesta asiakaspalvelusta, kassatyöskentelystä sekä kahvilassa myytävien tuotteiden valmistamisesta ja houkuttelevasta esillepanosta.

- työskennelläsi myyjänä tavaratalossa, tehtäviisi kuuluvat normaalit myyjän tehtävät: asiakaspalvelu sekä tavaratalossa että asiakaspalvelupisteessä, kassatyöskentely, kuormanpurku ja hyllytys sekä myymälän siisteyden ylläpito.

Odotamme sinulta:
- Myynti- ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Täysi-ikäisyyttä myymiemme tuotteiden takia
- Valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa vuoroissamme: aamu-, ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroissa
- Hygieniapassia tai halua suorittaa se. Työnantaja järjestää säännöllisesti hygieniapassikoulutuksia.
- Kokemus kaupan alan asiakaspalvelutehtävistä ja osaaminen kahvilatyöskentelystä sekä kassatoiminnoista katsotaan eduksi

title: Business Systems Analyst 4
description:

title: Työhönvalmentaja
description:

- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

- B-ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttövalmiutta

- Palkkaus: 19-24 €/h, riippuen kokemuksesta sekä koulutuksesta

title: Network Architect (10-15 Years)
description:
Job Title: Network Architect (10-15 Years)

Job Location: Bengaluru

About Veoneer:

Veoneer is a world leader, and over the years, Veoneer has delivered more than 1.1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.

Owned by AIP and headquartered in the U.S. Veoneer has approximately 2,550 employees in 11 countries.

What you'll do?

  • Define, own, and maintain the global network and network security architecture across LAN, WAN, WLAN, Data Center, Cloud, and SD-WAN environments.

  • Develop and maintain network reference architectures, design standards, and technology roadmaps aligned with business, manufacturing, and security requirements.

  • Lead architecture decisions related to network segmentation, security zoning, high availability, resilience, and disaster recovery.

  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performing network solutions using Fortinet and Cisco technologies across global locations.

  • Review, approve, and govern high-impact network designs, changes, and transformation projects.

  • Establish standards for redundancy, failover, clustering, load balancing, and disaster recovery.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to Network Engineers and NOC teams.

  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Application, Infrastructure, and Business teams to deliver network initiatives and modernization programs.

  • Support major network implementations, migrations, cloud adoption projects, and SD-WAN deployments.

  • Drive root cause analysis and resolution of complex network and security incidents from an architectural perspective.

  • Ensure network performance, availability, scalability, and compliance with security standards and best practices.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance network capabilities and operational efficiency.

What will you bring?

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise networking, including at least 3 years in a Network Architect or Senior Technical Lead role.

  • Proven experience designing and managing network architectures within global enterprise or manufacturing environments.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Fortinet and Cisco networking and security platforms.

  • Deep experience with Fortinet technologies including:

    • FortiGate Firewalls

    • FortiManager

    • FortiAnalyzer

    • FortiEMS

    • FortiClient

    • FortiAuthenticator

    • Fortinet Switching Platforms

  • Strong experience with Cisco Switching, Wireless LAN Controllers, and Access Point technologies.

  • Expertise in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise networks using tools such as SolarWinds Orion, NCM, IPAM, and standard network diagnostic utilities.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • IP Addressing, Subnetting, CIDR

    • VLANs, ARP, MAC Addressing

    • Layer 2 and Layer 3 Segmentation

    • ACLs and Firewall Policies

    • NGFW, IPS/IDS Technologies

    • Static and Dynamic Routing (BGP preferred)

    • VPN Technologies (Site-to-Site and Remote Access)

    • SD-WAN Architectures

    • NAT, SSL Certificates, and PKI

    • High Availability, Clustering, Failover, and Load Balancing

    • Wireless Networking Technologies

    • SNMP, NTP, SSH, HTTPS, FTP/SFTP

    • Public and Private Cloud Networking

    • Proxy Solutions and Network Security Concepts

    • Data Plane, Control Plane, and Management Plane Architectures

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Networking services.

  • Good understanding of Windows Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP services.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

  • Fortinet NSE 5, NSE 7, or higher certifications.

  • Cisco CCNP or higher certifications.

  • Experience with network automation, scripting, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) concepts.

  • Exposure to large-scale network transformation programs, including network refreshes, SD-WAN deployments, and segmentation initiatives.

  • Experience supporting Zero Trust and Security Architecture initiatives.

  • Knowledge of Fortinet and Cisco management and security tools.

  • Experience with F5 load balancing and application delivery technologies.

  • Familiarity with other enterprise networking and security platforms.

  • Understanding of Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.

  • Knowledge of IT Service Management frameworks such as ITIL and COBIT.

  • Project Management experience is an added advantage.

  • Experience working with ServiceNow in an enterprise environment is preferred.

Preferred Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering or technology

title: Technical Product Owner - External Integrations
description:
Join Eaton, a global leader where equality and inclusivity are at the heart of our mission. Here, everyone is valued and belongs. Be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge, energy-efficient solutions, making a tangible impact on the world. We empower our customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy more effectively, safely, and sustainably. At Eaton, we’re dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment with our innovative energy management technologies and services.
Our EMEA Business Service Center (BSC) in Budapest is Eaton’s largest office in the region. With a diverse team of over 700 people, representing 40+ nationalities and speaking 20+ languages, the BSC is the central hub for business services. It empowers seamless operations and drives exceptional results across our electrical, industrial, and corporate teams. We are proud to be a Disability Friendly Workplace, ensuring an inclusive environment for all our employees.

What you’ll do:

The specific focus for a Technical Product Owner will be creating a strategic product offering for external Eaton distributors, partners, and customers through an integration and data first platform. In this role you will be responsible for understanding current capabilities in this space, collecting and prioritizing tasks from across global business units, and crafting a long-term strategy and roadmap to grow our digital channel. Typical use cases that will form the foundation of this product include capabilities in order management, pricing, inventory, deal registration and partner management, quoting.

The Technical Product Owner will work in close partnership with business counterparts to identify where Eaton's external partners can accelerate growth with the appropriate digital integrations and data directly in their workflows. This individual will be part of a larger program focused on unifying and accelerating all our digital external touchpoints and will help drive recommendations and build a product roadmap that will support the overall vision.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing technical experience and industry best practices for engaging with external organizations via digital integration channels across a variety of enterprise use cases
  • Bringing a strong technical understanding in modern integration methods, platforms, and API first data exchange in order to collaborate appropriately and drive the strategic vision for Eaton in this space.
  • Owning and prioritizing the external-API product roadmap and backlog across distributor and partner requests, balancing new endpoints against reliability, reuse, cost and business generated for Eaton.
  • Driving the modernization of Eaton's current offerings from pull-only to a push + pull, event-driven model, with the integration and platform teams
  • Sequencing and coordinating cross-team dependencies across the enterprise including support from integration, architecture, data, and security teams.
  • Defining and reporting external-API KPIs — organizations onboarded, transaction throughput, and SLA adherence — to program and business leadership'- Defining and communicating the product vision, roadmap, and epics to meet customer and business needs

Qualifications:

  • B.S. degree from an accredited institution
  • Min. 7 years of experience as an analyst, project manager, engineer, BRM or program lead on moderate to highly complex technology projects and programs
  • API product management: REST APIs, API gateway / management concepts, versioning, and rate limiting / throttling
  • Event-driven and push integration patterns (webhooks, publish/subscribe) alongside pull APIs
  • Working knowledge of identity and entitlements for external users (Okta, Saviynt; coarse- vs fine-grained access)
  • Familiarity with iPaaS / MuleSoft-style integration and B2B data exchange
  • 2+ years of experience as a Product Owner or equivalent position, experience working with Agile, Scrum, and/or Kanban software delivery teams
  • Familiarity with modern software development principles including code management, test automation, APIs, microservices, and cloud services
  • General understanding of DevSecOps principles
  • Strong understanding of enterprise use cases for external data needs such as order management, pricing, inventory, quoting, or other similar touchpoints

Skills:

  • Global first and business driven mindset
  • Strong leadership ability with a focus on building coalitions across a diverse set of stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to take complex technical use cases and drive simple messages effectively across the organization
  • Data orientation and ability to make data-driven decisions
  • Passion for great customer experiences

What we offer:

  • Wide Range of Employee Benefits: Hybrid work model, Annual bonus, Cafeteria, Private Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, - Eye-glass refund, AYCM partnership, Internal reward system (E-Stars)
  • Employee Wellbeing Support: Access comprehensive support programs designed to enhance your overall wellbeing

description:

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

For TD Bank Group (TD) to remain competitive, it is essential to selectively take and manage risks. TD acknowledges that having a strong risk culture and a robust approach to risk management is fundamental to our ongoing success.

The Risk Management team at TD plays a key role in enabling the business functions of the enterprise to understand the risks they face. Our team is responsible for developing policies, processes, and controls required to appropriately manage these risks, ensuring that all measures are aligned with the Bank’s overall strategy and risk appetite.

As a global function, we partner with all lines of business within TD, impacting thousands of employees across offices in Canada, the United States, the UK, and Singapore. Additionally, we collaborate externally with regulators and industry groups to stay in line with industry standards and benchmark ourselves against best practices.


JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Program

The Risk Management Associate Rotational Program is a comprehensive, 24-month initiative where participants complete four distinct 6-month rotations. These rotations are designed to provide hands-on experience in both Financial and Non-Financial Risk Management areas, including but not limited to credit, market, liquidity, operational, model, ESG, technology and data, regulatory, and product risk. The program aims to develop leaders who can apply risk knowledge across a broad spectrum of business functions at TD.

If you are inquisitive, enjoy driving change, and want to make a meaningful difference, we invite you to join our rotational program.

Throughout the program, you will rotate within the Risk Management division in Canada, with some opportunities to support global activities. Each rotation lasts six months and covers the following areas:

  • Market Risk: In Market Risk, we focus on accurately identifying current and emerging market risks, providing transparency on both trading and non-trading risk results. Our global team independently oversees counterparty credit, liquidity risk, and market risks across the enterprise. We ensure all outcomes align with the Bank’s risk appetite, utilizing business insights and market expertise.

  • Enterprise Market Risk Control (EMRC): Serving as a second line of defense, EMRC provides independent oversight and challenges the Bank’s trading, non-trading, and liquidity risks. EMRC ensures that all significant market and liquidity risks are properly governed, understood, analyzed, and measured. We support new business initiatives by closely collaborating with TD Securities, Treasury, and Balance Sheet Management to ensure TD remains within its risk appetite. EMRC consists of teams focused on Non-Trading Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, and Credit Risk.

  • Credit Risk: Credit risk refers to the potential loss if a borrower or counterparty fails to fulfill agreed payment obligations. The Credit Risk team sets risk policies for all products and services involving credit risk and establishes guidelines to monitor and limit exposures by country, industry, and group within portfolios.

  • Operational Risk (including ESG, Cyber, and Innovation): Operational Risk works alongside our business partners to ensure that risks arising from people and technological processes, including those due to change, are effectively identified, monitored, and managed.

  • Model Development (MD) & Validation: The Model Development team is responsible for creating risk and capital models related to Trading Market Risk, Credit Risk, and Operational Risk across the bank. These models include, but are not limited to, Advanced Measurement Approach for Operational Risk, Credit Risk Rating models, Credit Risk parameters (PD, LGD, UGD), Economic Capital models, IFRS9 models for Credit Risk, Value at Risk (VaR), and Counterparty Credit Risk models.

  • Regulatory Risk: This team provides advice and guidance on regulatory communications and emerging developments, as well as new initiatives that have a regulatory impact. Responsibilities include monitoring regulatory trends, identifying common themes across TD’s footprint, communicating these insights to internal stakeholders, tracking remediation efforts, and ensuring quality responses to the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI). The team also identifies threats to TD’s relationships with key Canadian and non-U.S. regulators and ensures effective strategies are in place.

  • Strategic & Enterprise Risk: The Enterprise Risk team evaluates TD’s risk appetite, ensuring the Bank takes risks that align with its business strategy, avoids significant single loss events, and protects the TD brand.

  • Strategy, Business Management & Governance: This central operational and governance function supports risk management groups by guiding the development and execution of strategies, standards, and protocols to achieve operational effectiveness and efficiency.

Rotation opportunities are closely aligned with our business strategies, ensuring that participants work on the most important priorities.

What You'll Do

No matter where you work at TD, you’ll make a meaningful impact, grow your skills and thrive in our culture of care. Here’s what that means for each rotation in this program:

Make an Impact

  • Apply strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to add value in each rotation.

  • Conduct relevant reporting and analysis, presenting clear results and actionable recommendations.

  • Identify potential challenges requiring attention and recommend actions to manage risks in diverse scenarios.

  • Contribute to a strong risk culture by raising issues related to strategic, reputational, and operational risks.

  • Identify key assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and risks.

Experience Growth

  • Develop a deep understanding of how theoretical risk management practices are implemented in real-world situations, covering both traditional risks (such as Credit, Market, and Trading) and non-traditional risks (such as ESG, Operational, and Cyber Risk).

  • Work independently with minimal supervision, prioritize tasks, and add value to assigned projects using your communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Collaborate directly with rotation managers and Risk business groups to continuously identify issues and enhance processes across TD.

  • Manage and escalate any exceptions as necessary, ensuring compliance with policy.

Cultivate Our Culture of Care

  • Build strong relationships to identify collaborative opportunities and coordinate efforts across Risk groups.

  • Engage in challenging projects with experienced leaders, supported by a robust team of colleagues, peers, and advisors.


COLLEAGUE DEVELOPMENT

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. Receive regular career, development and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. Whether you have a passion for helping customers and want to expand your experience, or you want to coach and inspire your colleagues, there are many different career paths within our organization at TD – and we’re committed to helping you identify opportunities that support your goals.


JOB REQUIREMENTS

What You Need to Succeed

We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Apply generally well-defined and straightforward methods or procedures, with occasional deviations as needed.

  • Ability to work in a dynamic, evolving business environment and adapt to ambiguity and complexity.

  • Provide analytical, interpretive, evaluative, and constructive thinking in various situations.

  • Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing with a range of audiences.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products, with advanced skills in MS Excel.

  • Strong business acumen, problem-solving abilities, and analytical capabilities—both qualitative and quantitative—with the capacity to see the "big picture" in complex environments.

  • Well-organized, able to prioritize multiple tasks, and deliver results in a fast-paced setting.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team, across teams, and independently to achieve business objectives.

  • Desire to work in a caring, respectful, and inclusive environment where all employees are supported.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Educational Requirements; Must be graduated between May 2025 and May 2027 with a Master's in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Risk, Statistics, or a related field, with high academic standing.

Program Location and Start Date: Toronto-based program which starts in July 2027. Candidates must have graduated prior to start (including final grades, excluding convocation).

Applications Must Include:

  • Transcripts

  • Cover letter, including an explanation of how the Associate Program fits within your career aspirations (one letter-sized page or less)

  • Resume (maximum of 2 pages)

Hours & Workplace Model: Monday–Friday, standard business hours

INCLUSIVENESS

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. We thank all applicants for their interest!

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

title: Vacature Medewerker Spoedlijn & Balie AniCura Drechtstreek - Rijswijk
description:
Voor wie energie krijgt van afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid en contact met mensen én dieren.

Ben jij servicegericht, stressbestendig en vind je het leuk om snel te schakelen? Krijg jij energie van een dynamische werkomgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Voor onze locaties in Dordrecht en Rijswijk zoeken wij een enthousiaste Medewerker Spoedlijn & Balie voor 24 tot 32 uur per week. Je werkt in wisselende dag- en avonddiensten tussen 08:00 en 00:30 uur.

Over AniCura Drechtstreek

Bij het AniCura Specialistisch Verwijscentrum in Rijswijk en Dordrecht draait alles om topzorg voor dieren, 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week. Wanneer anderen naar huis gaan, begint ons werk pas echt.

Wij combineren moderne medische zorg met oprechte aandacht voor dier én eigenaar. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar samenwerking, compassie en duidelijke communicatie centraal staan. Juist in deze functie maken jij en je collega’s het verschil.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een enthousiaste collega die het leuk vindt om de verbindende schakel te zijn tussen diereneigenaren, verwijzers en onze dierenartsen.

Je bent iemand die:

  • Servicegericht is en energie krijgt van klantcontact.

  • Rust en overzicht bewaart, ook wanneer het druk of hectisch is.

  • Goed kan prioriteren en snel kan schakelen.

  • Beslissingen durft te nemen en verantwoordelijkheid neemt.

  • Affiniteit heeft met dieren en de veterinaire zorg.

  • Duidelijk en professioneel communiceert en goed kan luisteren.

  • Goed kan omgaan met emoties en bezorgde diereneigenaren.

  • Zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband prettig werkt.

  • Ervaring heeft met klantcontact, plannen en/of triage. Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie is een pre.

  • Bereid is om op zowel Dordrecht als Rijswijk te werken.

Eigen vervoer is noodzakelijk, omdat je op beide locaties inzetbaar bent.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medewerker Spoedlijn & Balie ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor diereneigenaren en verwijzers. Je zorgt ervoor dat zij op een professionele, rustige en klantvriendelijke manier worden geholpen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Correct en klantvriendelijk afhandelen van inkomende en uitgaande telefoongesprekken.

  • Uitvoeren van telefonische triage en inschatten van de urgentie van hulpvragen.

  • Inplannen van reguliere en spoedafspraken.

  • Ontvangen van patiënten en hun eigenaren aan de balie.

  • Verstrekken van informatie aan diereneigenaren en verwijzers.

  • Ondersteunen van de dierenartsen en het paraveterinaire team.

  • Beheren van agenda’s en patiëntgegevens, onder andere in Animana.

  • Verwerken van e-mails en schriftelijke correspondentie.

  • Ondersteunen bij administratieve werkzaamheden rondom patiënten en uitslagen.

Werktijden

Je werkt in wisselende dag- en avonddiensten tussen 08:00 en 00:30 uur. Daarnaast werk je volgens een rooster ook in weekenden en op feestdagen. Nachtdiensten maken geen onderdeel uit van deze functie.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij AniCura Dierenziekenhuis Drechtstreek bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende functie binnen een professioneel en betrokken team.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een afwisselende functie met een gevarieerd takenpakket.

  • Een zelfstandige functie met ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een hecht, deskundig en betrokken team.

  • Een goede en persoonlijke inwerkperiode.

  • Een professionele werkomgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat.

  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden conform het AniCura Arbeidspakket.

Iets voor jou?

Ben jij servicegericht, houd je van dynamiek en wil je werken in een omgeving waarin jouw inzet écht verschil maakt? Vind je het leuk om mensen te helpen op momenten waarop zij zich zorgen maken om hun dier?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer via de onderstaande button en word onderdeel van ons team.

Heb je eerst nog inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met:

Andrea van Swieten, Teamleider Client Service, via andrea.van.swieten@anicura.nl.

Of

Sabrina Noordanus, Talent Acquisition Partner, via sabrina.noordanus@anicura.nl Of 06-27442126

title: Network Scheduler PMCC
description:
Join Eaton, a global leader where equality and inclusivity are at the heart of our mission. Here, everyone is valued and belongs. Be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge, energy-efficient solutions, making a tangible impact on the world. We empower our customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy more effectively, safely, and sustainably. At Eaton, we’re dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment with our innovative energy management technologies and services.
Our EMEA Business Service Center (BSC) in Budapest is Eaton’s largest office in the region. With a diverse team of over 700 people, representing 40+ nationalities and speaking 20+ languages, the BSC is the central hub for business services. It empowers seamless operations and drives exceptional results across our electrical, industrial, and corporate teams. We are proud to be a Disability Friendly Workplace, ensuring an inclusive environment for all our employees.

What you’ll do:

The Supply Chain Network Scheduler is a key role in the integrated, intelligent and agile supply chain organization, focusing on the 0-3 months execution horizon, owning short term product availability and exception management for FG & semi-finished goods for their value stream across markets where there is an imbalance between supply and demand. The incumbent is responsible for the end to end supply chain results of a network (group of products) with a turnover in the range of 50-100 M USD. The role will also directly manage a small team of production planners and planning team leads supervising the planning activities in at least 3 locations. The Supply Chain Network Scheduler Is the primary face of supply for a given value stream, owning capacity & material constraint escalations by leveraging scenario planning and ensuring collaboration between demand and supply stakeholders. This role reports into the Network Planner role.

Main responsibilities:

- Manages a team of production planners - or the respective production planning team leads - across the sites that are under the incumbents supervision
- Developing timely and accurate plans for finished products at assigned level of the supply network and for short-term finished goods availability in the markets within the 0 to 12 weeks horizon for their portfolio.
- Manages all exceptions in the short-term horizon and collaborates with teams across the Eaton network and external vendors as needed, to identify root causes and drive corrective and preventative actions to solve exceptions.
- Creates the Master Production Schedule (MPS)
- Coordinates team of CoE resources (buyers, planners, production schedulers...) to deliver MPS Plan
- Interfaces with operations to drive schedule adherence
- Reports and analyses key performance indicators to drive supply network improvements in cash, cost and customer service results.
- Ensure a feasible plan to minimize demand at risk and maximize customer service level while remaining within inventory and cost targets. This requires the ability to create and analyze different scenarios against a defined scorecard.
- Has ability to collaborate effectively with multiple functions, in order to drive improvements across our end to end Supply Chain and serve our customers efficiently
- Manages all exceptions in the 0-12 weeks horizon where there is an imbalance in demand and supply, collaborate on root cause analysis and drive corrective actions.
- Ensures capacity shortages are addressed or escalated.
- Evaluates and shares the impact of material exceptions on the short-term FG plan with material planners.
- Monitors customer on-time service level and inventory exceptions in the short term
- Participates in decision making and movement of slow moving inventory within the value stream
- Monitors planning parameters accuracy by conducting periodic audits and getting ERP updated as needed.
- Acts as primary point of contact for product availability in their value stream
- Stays close to the demand information to react quicker to changes
