title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit .

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

Brief team/department description:

Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R&D project management team, which coordinates cross-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change-inspired leader, to lead R&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.

This role will report to the R&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.

The role holder will lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance R&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement & simplification opportunities.

The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.

Principle Responsibilities:

  1. A) Lead project management
  • Enable preparation and management of CSO-R&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
  • Through the project managers, prepare month-on-month project forecasts and manage CSO-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
  • Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
  • Partner with the finance leadership and co-own the Long-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R&D opex, capex, and product-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage-wise Probability of Technical & Regulatory success.
  1. B) Management systems & processes:
  • Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
  • Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
  • Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
  • Support R&D operational planning - Lab space management, capex & support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
  • Responsible for drafting the R&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
  1. C) Digital enablement initiatives:
  • Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off-the-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in-house).
  • Champion the evaluation of cutting-edge data tools and data-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R&D’s strategic goals
  • Lead end-to-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
  • Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R&D / laboratory systems such as E-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R&D workflows
  • Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems

Qualifications/Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Master's degree preferred:
    • MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
    • MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
  • Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
    • PMP
    • PgMP
    • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt

Preferred Experience:

15-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:

Project and Portfolio Management

  • At least 7-10 years managing cross-functional development programs.
  • Experience with R&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
  • Experience leading governance meetings and stage-gate reviews.

Budget Management

  • Ownership or co-ownership of departmental budgets.
  • Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
  • Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.

Process and Organizational Change

  • Designing new departmental processes.
  • Simplifying complex workflows.
  • Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
  • Creating governance models and decision-making frameworks.
  • Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Lead, Footwear Color & Materials Designer, Performance, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of the fastest product engines at Nike, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting to the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. Local Creation team's mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while driving and extending consumer favorites, serving local consumers with executions that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and act independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Designer, Footwear Color & Materials, Performance, Local Creation GC to lead color and material expression across selected performance footwear opportunities for the Greater China marketplace.

The ideal candidate combines advanced color and material craft with a strong understanding of performance product expression, consumer behavior, local marketplace needs, and Nike design direction. They can turn Greater China consumer and sport insights into relevant product stories without losing sight of performance purpose, athlete needs, product integrity, or Nike brand standards.

This designer is expected to lead through creative influence. They will establish a compelling point of view, guide complex projects, align partners around design intent, and help elevate the color and materials capability of the wider team.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Design Director, Footwear Design, Local Creation GC.

You will collaborate with:

  • GC Footwear and Apparel Design, Color & Materials, and Graphics

  • GC Product Management, Merchandising, Development, and Marketing

  • Performance category and sport partners

  • Global and Geo Design counterparts

  • Material developers, vendors, manufacturers, and external creative partners

  • Consumer insights and marketplace teams

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Footwear Design, Color Design, Material Design, Textile Design, Industrial Design, Fashion Design, or a related field preferred.

  • Equivalent combinations of education, professional experience, and training will be considered.

Experience and Capabilities:

  • Typically 5 to 7 years of relevant professional design experience, with demonstrated advanced capability in footwear color and materials.

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong color sensibility, material thinking, product storytelling, executional craft, and consumer relevance.

  • Advanced understanding of color theory, color blocking, material selection, material application, finishes, trims, and color achievability.

  • Strong knowledge of footwear construction, manufacturing, product development, and commercialization.

  • Ability to translate consumer, sport, cultural, and marketplace insights into product opportunity.

  • Ability to lead complex creative projects with limited direction.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills across design, business, and development audiences.

  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams and resolving competing creative, technical, and business priorities.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

  • Experience with 3D and AI-enabled visualization tools such as Vizcom, and collaborative tools such as Miro.

  • Ability to travel as required by the role.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Lead Designer, Footwear Color & Materials, Performance, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Lead seasonal color and material direction for assigned GC performance footwear projects, aligned with global creative direction, sport intent, product briefs, and local consumer opportunity.

  • Translate Greater China sport, athlete, consumer, cultural, and marketplace insights into clear color and material strategies.

  • Create original palettes, color-blocking systems, material concepts, finishes, trims, and product details that strengthen both performance purpose and product emotion.

  • Set the product point of view across broader or more complex programs, including projects spanning multiple consumer groups, price points, product types, or seasonal tracks.

  • Connect individual product decisions to broader franchise, category, seasonal, and marketplace strategy.

  • Lead material briefs and work with Development and material partners to explore, test, refine, and commercialize material applications.

  • Review prototypes and samples, resolve color and material achievability issues, and protect design intent through final execution.

  • Build consumer stories, concept narratives, product presentations, and broadcast materials that clearly communicate the “why” behind the work.

  • Lead creative alignment with Product Management, Development, Merchandising, Marketing, and Global Design partners.

  • Make informed decisions around cost, feasibility, sustainability, timing, and product quality.

  • Guide project teams through ambiguity, changing inputs, and compressed Local Creation timelines.

  • Provide craft guidance and mentorship to other designers, helping elevate team standards in color, material selection, storytelling, and presentation.

  • Contribute to the continuing development of GC footwear color and material tools, standards, libraries, and working methods.

  • Support required digital product files, CAD pages, line art, and workflow submissions associated with assigned Local Creation projects.

#MYNEXT: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future

title: Principal Software Engineer - 260421-6
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high-growth, high-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.

At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.

Position Summary

The Principal Software Engineer will lead the technical strategy, architecture, and evolution of critical, large-scale systems that support key business capabilities. This role will drive company-wide architectural initiatives, AI adoption, platform modernization, and engineering excellence while influencing senior leadership and aligning multiple engineering organizations toward long-term technical and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of large-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures.
  • Define and drive company-wide technical strategy aligned with long-term business and product objectives.
  • Establish architectural principles, standards, and best practices to ensure scalability, consistency, and maintainability.
  • Drive the strategic adoption of AI-assisted development practices and AI-enabled capabilities across the organization.
  • Lead cross-functional and cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple systems, domains, and business units.
  • Identify and mitigate systemic technical risks and drive long-term modernization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
  • Advance system reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and operational maturity across the organization.
  • Mentor and influence senior technical talent while promoting a culture of engineering excellence and high technical standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience defining and driving technical strategy at an organizational or company-wide level.
  • Deep experience designing and evolving large-scale distributed systems and cloud-based platform architectures.
  • Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and cloud-native architecture patterns.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive technical alignment across multiple teams and organizations without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with .NET full-stack and API development across frontend and backend technologies.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Rust, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep.
  • Strong knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.
  • Deep experience with observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, and reliability engineering practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, automated testing, progressive deployment strategies, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong understanding of modern security practices, including secure coding, threat modeling, and vulnerability remediation

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Postityöntekijä Kankaanpäähän, Kankaanpää
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja reipasta postityöntekijää Kankaanpäähän. Työ on ensisijaisesti tuurausluonteista ja liittyy tilapäisten poissaolojen paikkaamiseen, joten työmäärä vaihtelee asiakkaan tarpeen mukaan. Työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi toisen joustavan osa-aikatyön tai opintojen rinnalle.

Työtehtäviin kuuluvat postin jakaminen autolla sekä mahdollisesti myös postin ja pakettien lajittelutyö. Työtä tehdään maanantaista perjantaihin, ja työvuorot alkavat pääsääntöisesti klo 5.00–6.00 välillä. Työpäivän pituus vaihtelee työpäivän ja reitin mukaan, ollen vähintään 4 ja enintään 9 tuntia. Työtunteja on tarjolla asiakkaan tarpeen mukaan, 0–38,25 tuntia viikossa, ja työvuoroista sovitaan aina erikseen.

Tehtävässä edellytämme B-ajokorttia ja suomen kielen taitoa. Toivomme hakijalta vähintään kahden vuoden ajokokemusta, sitoutunutta ja joustavaa otetta sekä reipasta ja positiivista asennetta työhön. Työ vaatii valmiutta aikaisiin aamuihin ja vaihteleviin työpäiviin.

Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, ja töitä on alustavasti tarjolla joulukuun 2026 loppuun asti. Mahdollisuus työn jatkumiseen myös tämän jälkeen.

Palkkaus on viestinvälitys- ja logistiikka-alan TES mukainen, 13,14 €/h (alle 2 vuoden kokemus). Lisäksi on mahdollisuus saada bonusta palkan päälle hyvin tehdystä työstä. Työterveyshuolto on voimassa ensimmäisestä työpäivästä alkaen.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae tehtävään pikaisesti, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivan tekijän löydyttyä!

title: Private Banking Executive
description:
Job Description

Purpose

Support and assist Relationship Managers in acquiring, onboarding, servicing and retaining clients to deliver overall business goals, managing complex client situations.

Where required liaise directly with clients regarding complex client requests in respect of various banking and servicing requirements such as onboarding, banking transactions, Investments, credit & digital solutions.

Work closely with Operations and other support functions to deliver positive outcomes for clients.

  • Responsible for all aspects of clients servicing and service engagement plans. To include leading client service review visits to support and improve client experience

  • Develop relationships with other areas of the bank; in doing so, they will have joint responsibility with internal colleagues for the end-to-end client experience, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.

  • Point of contact for all new account queries, complex servicing requests and a liaison between relationship teams and support/specialist teams

  • Ensure legal and regulatory standards and internal policies and procedures are adhered to, support relationship managers with risk related activities

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.

  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise

  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.

  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.

  • Partner with other functions and business areas.

  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.

  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.

  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.

  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.

  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.

They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Private Banking Executive | Barclays | Leeds.

Working as a Barclays Private Banking Executive, you will assist the Private Banker / Wealth Manager in acquiring, servicing, and retaining clients to deliver overall business objectives. You will act as a key point of contact for clients on day-to-day operational matters and support the team / business in achieving its targets and goals. In this role, you will also assist with marketing banking and investment products to clients.


To be successful as a Private Banking Executive, you should have experience with:

• Sound knowledge of banking products, operational procedures, risk management, lending, and security requirements

• Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and accuracy in administrative and operational tasks

• Strong commercial awareness and understanding of financial markets, products, and trends affecting HNW/UHNW clients

title: Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We are delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for a Recovery Coordinator in Coventry. This rewarding and dynamic role is ideal for someone who is passionate about supporting others and ready to make a meaningful impact every day. You will use your skills and experience to assess, engage and empower Service Users, ensuring they access the right support at the right time, in a way that truly meets their needs.

No two days are the same in this role. Each interaction is an opportunity to inspire positive change, making flexibility, curiosity and excellent listening skills essential. If you are motivated by the chance to make a genuine difference and want to be part of a supportive team that values innovation, compassion and courage, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Where: Coventry

Full Time Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

With this role you’ll be working as part of the Opiate Crack User Team in Coventry

About the role:

  • Supporting service users from point of entry into the service and through their treatment/recovery journey
  • Providing screening, assessment, and recovery planning and onward referral
  • Reducing drug and alcohol related harm to service users and the wider community
  • Promoting carer, service user and community involvement
  • Providing advocacy for access to partnership services
  • Working with service users to support social (re)integration, enabling them to lead meaningful and purposeful lives: promoting recovery, resilience, peer support and self-determination
  • Research, design and prepare subject matter and materials for groups / pods.
  • Deliver structured content within group settings to service users at various stages of recovery
  • Engage with debriefing and evaluations with co-facilitators after groups/pods have taken place, reviewing progress and identifying concerns with service users
  • Tailor specific workshops around the needs of the service users.

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and experience of working within a similar field
  • Experience of working with groups/pods and managing group dynamics, such as conflict or challenging behaviour.
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills
  • Have a good working knowledge of mental health interventions, services, and good practice
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders

What we will give to you:

  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

Direct applications only we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions. More information about eligible roles and occupations can be found here: Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK

title: Butiksassistance søges til Magasin Hillerød
description:
Hej, jeg hedder Caja og jeg er rekrutteringskonsulent i Magasin. Arbejdsopgaverne spænder bredt – fra at pakke nye varer ud og sørge for, at hylderne altid er indbydende og rene, til at skabe flotte visuelle oplæg, der inspirerer vores kunder.

Teamets ambitioner og hverdag:
Som medarbejder i Magasin Hillerød bliver du en del af et engageret og målrettet team, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og godt humør er fundamentet for vores hverdag. Vi arbejder tæt sammen for at skabe den bedst mulige oplevelse for vores kunder, uanset om det handler om personlig betjening, inspirerende varepræsentation eller effektiv håndtering af opgaver bag kulissen.

Du vil opleve en hverdag, hvor tempoet er højt, men hvor der altid er plads til sparring, grin og udvikling. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelinger og lægger stor vægt på at være fleksible og løsningsorienterede. Hos os er det vigtigt, at man både kan tage initiativ og tage del i de praktiske opgaver hvad enten det er udpakning af varer, opfyldning, oprydning eller at sikre, at butikken fremstår visuelt inspirerende.

Vores ambition er at være kundernes foretrukne shoppingdestination – og det kræver medarbejdere, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og gøre en forskel i hverdagen.

Du kan forvente en ugentlig arbejdstid på 8-15 timer, fordelt over både hverdage og weekender.

Magasin som arbejdsplads:

I Magasin står vi stærkt på vores værdier Positiv Attitude, Stærkt Holdånd og Godt Købmandskab. Du vil som medarbejder have adgang til mange dejlige fordele, herunder fælles kaffekantine, lækre rabatter. Din leder er altid klar til at sparre med dig i hverdagen, men din leder forventer også, at du tager ansvar og at du altid stræber mod at gøre dit bedste over for vores kunder og dine kolleger. Til gengæld kan du med tiden møde spændende muligheder, hvis du har det rette talent og ønsker at fortsætte din karriere i Magasin.

Vil du søge jobbet?

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, og går du videre i processen, skal du igennem flere steps, hvor både du og vi vurderer om denne stilling er det rigtige match for dig og Magasin. Vi ser frem til i sidste ende at byde den helt rette kandidat velkommen i magiske Magasin.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Millions of people across Europe want better ways to build long-term wealth, but traditional investing often feels complex or out of reach.

Mintos is solving that. We've built a platform that makes investing in income-generating assets simple, transparent, and accessible. And we're expanding fast.

As our Senior Product Designer, you'll own a product area, solve complex problems in a regulated financial environment, and take care of the craft, clarity, and user value as we grow to millions of investors.

If this is the kind of problem you want to solve, let's talk.

What you'll do

As our Senior Product Designer, you'll take ownership of a product area – spanning onboarding, investing, portfolio reporting, or the workflows that connect them – for the experiences hundreds of thousands of investors use to manage their money, on web and mobile. You'll take initiatives from discovery through launch and beyond, partnering with Product Managers, Engineers, and Marketing to ship intuitive, useful, and well-crafted work that supports our mission of making investing accessible and transparent, while helping mentor other designers as the team grows.


You will:

  • Design and deliver polished product experiences across a full product area - not just a single flow - spanning onboarding, investing, reporting, or portfolio flows

  • Keep the experience consistent and platform-appropriate across iOS, Android, and web across your area

  • Frame ambiguous problems, prototype early concepts, and validate direction through user interviews, usability tests, and competitor research

  • Work with analysts on behavioural data, define success metrics for your area, and follow what happens after launch so you can apply the learnings to what comes next

  • Deliver flows, wireframes, UI designs, prototypes, edge-case handling, and design-system-aligned documentation that engineering can build from without back-and-forth

  • Take part in critique, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar on craft and rigour as the team grows

Your professional skills and background

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer, ideally including work in a regulated or trust-critical industry (financial services, healthcare, enterprise), with a portfolio that shows real problems you've solved end-to-end

  • A track record of owning a product area or initiative across multiple quarters, not just producing screens for someone else's brief

  • Strong UX and visual design skills, with the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, intuitive experiences

  • An evidence-based approach – you pick the right research method for the question and can explain your reasoning to people outside design

  • A collaborative way of working – you share work early, listen to feedback, bring partners along with you, and help develop other designers

  • Genuine curiosity about personal finance, investing, or fintech – you don't need to be an expert, but you should care about the space

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, banking, or another regulated industry

  • Experience working with Compliance, Legal, or Risk teams

  • Experience designing for multi-market or multi-language products

  • Information design – turning complex data into clear visualisations

  • Design system contribution

  • A/B testing or experimentation experience

  • Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

What we offer

💸 Competitive salary and stock options. Your experience and contribution matter, and we reflect that in fair compensation. You’ll also receive equity so you can share in the value you help create.

🤹 Flexibility that fits real life. We understand how important it is to stay connected with colleagues while having the opportunities to work remotely. Come to the office to collaborate and be productive side by side, work from home when you need to, and spend up to three months each year working from another country.

🌴 Generous vacation policy. Rest and recovery are essential. We don’t limit vacation to the minimum required by law. Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed.

🧠 Learning and growth. An annual €1,200 learning budget to support your professional and personal growth. Whether you want to explore something new or deepen your expertise, we’ll support you along the way.

☕ Very well equipped office. Comfortable environment matters. When in the office, enjoy the parking, showers, kitchen with snacks and drinks, massage chair, nap room and others.

🏅 Proud to be recognized for fairness
Mintos was recognized by Figure Baltic Advisory for fairness and equality in compensation and representation, achieving 3rd place in 2025.

🌐 International team of 200+ people from 17+ countries

Join a diverse team where different perspectives and experiences are valued. We work across Europe, share ideas openly, and collaborate to solve meaningful challenges together.

Mintos is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and creating an inclusive workplace for everyone. If you need accommodations during the interview process, contact us at people@mintos.com.

title: Design Manager, Transmission
description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

Job Description

Benefits

  • Salary packaging, novated leasing and income protection

  • Subsidised health insurance and wellbeing support

  • Mentoring, leadership pathways and training support

Project Information

Western Power's Clean Energy Link is a landmark, large-scale infrastructure investment shaping Western Australia's energy future — delivering the transmission network needed to support growing renewable generation and a more reliable power system. Acciona is delivering significant work packages on this program and is looking for talented professionals to join its project delivery team.

This is an opportunity to work on major engineering and construction activity with real, lasting impact: strengthening WA's power grid and playing a direct role in the state's transition to clean energy. Joining now means getting in early on a program of state-wide significance — high-profile, high-impact work that offers strong career development and the chance to build expertise on one of WA's most important infrastructure projects.

About the Opportunity

As Design Manager, Transmission, you'll lead the planning, coordination and delivery of transmission line and substation designs across HV and MV infrastructure. You'll oversee design inputs and outputs from inception through delivery, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering, construction and client teams. The role covers overhead lines, underground cables, structures, and protection and control systems, and gives you the mandate to drive technical consistency, manage risk, and shape how design solutions perform across the project.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead transmission line and substation design from concept to detail
  • Manage design interfaces across HV and MV infrastructure
  • Drive constructability, systems integration and technical governance
  • Oversee cost, schedule, design change and risk using CPI, SPI and EVM
  • Lead SiD, HAZID/HAZOP and CoM reviews and deliverables
  • Mentor junior engineers and build internal design capability
  • Manage external consultants and cross-functional communication

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 10+ years leading HV transmission (220kV+) design, concept to detail
  • 5+ years fieldwork supporting hands-on engineering and site work
  • Strong knowledge of IEC, IEEE and AS/NZS standards
  • Chartered status (RPEV, RPEQ, NER, CPEng) or working towards
  • Ability to complete a successful pre-employment medical and National Crime check.

ACCIONA has been given the Top Employer 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025 certification in Australia, which certifies the company's commitment to excellence in human resources management and those who focus on putting their people first through their exceptional HR policies. Since establishing a presence in Australia in 2002, ACCIONA has made significant investments in local opportunities and project development. ACCIONA employs more than 3,000 people in its renewable energy, infrastructure and water projects across Australia & New Zealand.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and promote equality and diversity. Indigenous Australians and candidates from minority groups are encouraged to apply.

title: Lead, Apparel Designer, Jordan, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest product creation engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting into the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while building on consumer favorites and serving local consumers with greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and work independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Lead Apparel Designer, Jordan to join our dynamic, fast-paced design team. Based in Shanghai, China, this role will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative lead with broad apparel industry experience and the ability to design and execute products for our brands. They will create apparel products across a range of sport and lifestyle opportunities for Greater China consumers, working across multiple categories through a hyper-local lens. This designer has a strong eye for detail, a passion for and expertise in premium craft, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, champion the brand vision, foster creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to bring ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with key functional partners throughout the product design process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

A BA, BFA, MA, or MFA in Apparel Design or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

Experience:

  • 7 years of professional apparel design experience in the apparel or sports industry, with extensive expertise in materials, functionality, construction, and fit for apparel products.

  • Clear understanding of apparel segments and consumer profiles across multiple dimensions; experience in the Greater China market is preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials, construction, fit, technical packages, and schematic development.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Lead Apparel Designer, Jordan, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Work closely with Product Management and Development to establish and manage seasonal new-creation toolboxes based on consumer insights, design direction, and product intent, while keeping margin targets in mind.

Build depth across the range through color and define the appropriate trend level for individual products to drive excitement and cohesion.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability)

Physitrack PLC · Fully remote, based in Poland Contract: B2B contractor, EUR 8,000 per month

About us

Physitrack PLC builds digital health software used by clinicians, physiotherapists and employers in over 100 countries. Our two product lines, Physitrack (exercise prescription, telehealth and patient engagement) and Champion Health (workplace wellbeing), run on a multi-region AWS platform serving Europe, the UK, North America, Australia and the Middle East.

We are ISO 27001:2022 certified. We hold clinical data and a large proprietary content library, and both need defending properly.

The role

You will own the security and reliability surface of our infrastructure: the edge, the data layer, and the observability stack that tells us when either is misbehaving. It sits where security engineering meets SRE. You will design controls at the edge, harden our cloud posture, make sure we can see what is happening across a multi-region estate, then evidence all of it to auditors and enterprise customers. This is hands-on engineering, not a governance role.


We are recruiting two senior infrastructure roles. This one covers the edge, observability and cloud security posture. The other, Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform), covers the Kubernetes estate, delivery pipelines and migrations. Apply for whichever fits, and tell us if both do.

What you will do

Edge and network security

  • Own our Envoy based edge, along with WAF rules, rate limiting and bot management across our cloud and CDN layers

  • Design and tune protections against abuse, including content scraping, credential attacks and traffic anomalies

  • Build detection for the traffic patterns that matter, and keep improving its signal to noise ratio


Cloud security posture

  • Harden our AWS estate: IAM boundaries, least privilege access, threat detection and runtime monitoring on EKS

  • Manage secrets, certificates and token lifecycle across the platform

  • Produce the infrastructure evidence behind ISO 27001 audits, penetration tests and enterprise security reviews


Data platform

  • Run PostgreSQL and RDS in production across regions, covering upgrades, performance, encryption and access control

  • Own our search infrastructure, Typesense and vector search, end to end

  • Work with MongoDB and Elasticache alongside the primary data stores


Observability

  • Own the monitoring platform: Grafana, Loki and Prometheus, plus Sentry and PagerDuty

  • Build alerting people actually trust, with meaningful thresholds, low noise and clear runbooks

  • Improve how logs and metrics flow from the edge and the application into the stack

What we are looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, SRE or security engineering, with strong AWS depth

  • Real experience with edge, WAF or reverse proxy technology: Envoy, nginx, Cloudflare, ModSecurity, Coraza or equivalent

  • Production Kubernetes, ideally EKS, and strong Terraform

  • Operating PostgreSQL at scale. You have done upgrades and performance work, not just connected to one

  • Practical observability experience. You have built alerting that worked, and killed alerting that did not

  • A security engineer's instincts. You think about what an attacker does with the thing you just shipped

  • English at a working professional level. Our engineering team is international

Nice to have

  • Search infrastructure: Typesense, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or vector search

  • Content protection and anti-scraping work

  • Having supported ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar audits from the technical side

  • Healthcare, fintech or another regulated domain

  • Polish. Much of the engineering team is in Poland, though the company works in English

How we work

  • On-call. We run a 24/7 rotation through PagerDuty, with documented playbooks and readiness checklists. Participation is agreed with you rather than assumed, and separately compensated.

  • Cadence. Written async updates, a fortnightly planning touchpoint and a regular infrastructure and security sync. You set your own hours and choose your own tools.

  • Documentation. Threat models, decision records and runbooks are part of the work. We expect the reasoning to be written down, not just the config.

  • Autonomy. Small team, wide scope, very little process between you and a decision.

title: Distribution Supervisor - Late Shift
description:
Job Description

Heb jij altijd al willen werken in een topteam bij NIKE,Inc. ? Wij zoeken een enthousiaste Distribution Supervisor - vaste late shift voor onze Nike European Logistics Campus in Ham. Als je energie haalt uit het begeleiden van mensen, een passie voor logistiek hebt en klaar bent voor een gave uitdaging, dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou. Onze campus is een hypermoderne werkplek met vijf distributiecentra die NIKE product leveren voor onze klanten in de hele EMEA-regio.

MET WIE WERK JE SAMEN

In onze Ham campus werken we sinds kort met een vaste vroege en een vaste late shift systeem. Deze shiften werken naast de reguliere vroege en late shiften. Je bent hierdoor de ene week deel van de A shift, de andere week van de B shift. In de vaste late werk je samen met je vaste late collegas, je distributiemanager en collega-coaches. Als deel van het team neem je je rol op om samen te winnen en te groeien. Cross-functioneel heb je contact met verschillende teams zoals Human Resources, planning, onderhoud, IT, ...

WIE ZOEKEN WE

Iemand die met veel enthousiasme leiding kan geven aan een diverse groep in de vaste late shift.

Hier is wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Leiderschap: Je bent een natuurlijke leider die ervaring heeft in het inspireren en motiveren van individuen alsook diverse teams. Je neemt zelfverzekerd beslissingen en toont het juiste voorbeeldgedrag.

  • Flexibiliteit: Je werkt afwisselend samen met 2 shiften, dus een groot aanpassingsvermogen is key! Je kan deze mindset ook vlot overbrengen aan je team.

  • People-minded: Jouw team helpen waar mogelijk en hun groei ondersteunen staat centraal in deze job. Daarnaast is opkomen voor jouw team als zij geconfronteerd worden met verschillende dynamieken uit de andere teams ook vitaal.

  • Communicatie: Je kunt makkelijk communiceren in zowel Nederlands (Niveau C1) als Engels (Niveau C1). Je bent sterk in actieve communicatie en stemt je boodschap af op de ontvanger. Spreken en of presenteren voor een groep is voor jou geen probleem. In deze shift is dit des te belangrijker om je team steeds de nodige context te kunnen geven.

  • Probleemoplossend vermogen en het vermogen om onder druk te werken en prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving. Je trekt de nodige conclusies uit beschikbare data en gaat hier actief mee aan de slag.

  • ICT-kennis en vaardigheden: Je hebt een sterke basis in het Microsoft Officepakket en bent snel weg met nieuwe systemen.

  • Logistiek & Sport: Je houdt van een snel veranderende, competitieve omgeving en hebt een sportieve, flexibele mindset.

WAT GA JE DOEN

Als Distribution Supervisor ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de dagelijkse operationele processen binnen een van onze 5 distributiecentra. Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 20-25 atleten (magazijn medewerkers) en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt. Dit is een hands-on leiderschapsrol waarin je verantwoordelijk bent voor zowel mensen als processen en je werkt aan continue verbeteringsinitiatieven.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

  • Dagelijkse operationele processen aansturen: Je zorgt ervoor dat de orders steeds tijdig, kwalitatief en compleet worden verwerkt. Je start je shift met een teamoverleg, deelt de dagdoelen en wijst taken toe. Gedurende de shift stuur je bij om deze doelen te behalen. Hiervoor analyseer je operationele data en neem je proactief de nodige acties.

  • Teammanagement: Je werkt met diverse teams, bouwt sterke relaties op en geeft zowel begeleiding als feedback op individueel en team niveau. Je stelt duidelijke doelstellingen en coacht om deze te behalen. Je volgt de prestaties op en zorgt voor een goede taakverdeling. Je neemt daarnaast verantwoordelijkheden op zoals vakantie beheer en opvolging van aanwezigheid.

  • Leiderschap & Verbeteringen: Je geeft je team de ruimte en de nodige structuur om nieuwe ideeën te bedenken of na te denken hoe processen beter kunnen om onze organisatie te doen groeien. Met je hands-on mentaliteit werk je hieraan mee en zorg je via aangeleerde technieken voor structurele verbeteringen.

Waarom werken als Distribution Supervisor bij Nike?

  • Leiderschapservaring: Je kan je leidinggevende vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen samen met ervaren collega’s en managers.

  • Training: Je doorloopt een 3-maanden onboarding en trainingstraject, zodat je er helemaal klaar voor bent om mee het verschil te maken. Daarnaast hebben we tal van opleidingen ter beschikking, al dan niet op maat, om jou nog verder te doen groeien!

  • Super team: Werken bij NIKE, Inc. betekent dat je samenwerkt in een energiek en betrokken team. Team succes wordt samen gevierd.

  • Carrièregroei: NIKE, Inc. is een groeibedrijf en zoekt teamleden om samen te groeien. Naast een breed aanbod aan competentiegerichte opleidingen, bieden wij onze medewerkers ook veel kansen en leermomenten aan de hand van stretch assignments.

  • Voordelen van werken in late shift:

  • Geen files meer onderweg naar je werk.

  • Het flexibel plannen van je vrije tijd: bvb, zonlicht, sport, familietijd of shoppen.

  • Premie onsociale uren alsook een extra ploegentoeslag!

  • Voor jouw shift je uitleven in een van onze sportfaciliteiten (fitness, padel, atletiek piste,...)

  • Extra onsociale uren door het werken in een vaste late regime

PC226: 5

Er is geen verhuisondersteuning voorzien. Om voor deze positie in aanmerking te komen, moeten kandidaten reeds in Belgie wonen.

Voor deze rol is er geen bedrijfswagen voorzien in het salarispakket.

title: Kaivinkoneen perämies, FORSSA
description:
Etsimme kokenutta kaivinkoneen perämiestä Forssaan – aluksi 1–2 kuukauden määräaikaisuuteen, jossa on erinomainen mahdollisuus pitempään, jopa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

Työssä toimit kaivinkoneenkuljettajan työparina maanrakennustyömailla. Tehtäviin kuuluu perämiehen perustyöt, korkojen tarkistus lasereilla sekä tarvittaessa muiden koneiden käyttö (pyöräkuormaaja, jyrä). Etsimällämme tekijällä on varma ote niin pienten työkoneiden puikkoihin kuin perinteiseen lapioonkin.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Aiempaa kokemusta kaivinkoneen perämiehen tehtävistä ja maarakennusalalta

* Osaamista maarakennuslaserien käytöstä (tasolaser / putkilaser)

* Kokemusta pyöräkuormaajan ja jyrän käytöstä sekä lapiotöistä

* Voimassa olevaa BC-ajokorttia, tieturva- ja työturvallisuuskorttia

* Oma-aloitteista, reipasta ja joustavaa asennetta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Määräaikaisen työn (1–2 kk) reilulla mahdollisuudella jatkua jopa vakituiseksi

* KIPA TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen (vähintään 15,00 €/h, neuvotellaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan)

* Epassi-henkilöstöedun

Sijainti: Forssa

Työsuhde: 1–2 kk (mahdollisuus vakituiseen)

Palkkaus: Vähintään 15,00 €/h / KIPA TES

Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / heti

Asiakkaastamme, työstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.

Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!




---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary
The Centre for Migration Studies' (CMS) Communications Specialist is responsible for the strategic communications and knowledge mobilization activities that advance the visibility, accessibility, and impact of CMS as a whole and its research program, Immigrant Integration in the Mid-21st Century: Bridging Divides (Bridging Divides).

The Communications Specialist develops and implements strategic communications plans, oversees editorial planning and content development, manages CMS's digital communications platforms, and translates complex research into accessible content for academic, policy, practitioner, media, and public audiences. Working closely with faculty, researchers, trainees, students, and community partners, the incumbent develops plain language summaries, research stories, briefs, policy explainers, and other communications products that increase the reach and impact of CMS research.

Organizational Status
The Communications Specialist reports to the CMS Senior Manager and receives input from the CMS Co-Directors. This position requires collaboration with a wide range of partners and collaborators, including faculty members, trainees, and staff in other administrative and communications units at UBC; communications staff and researchers at Bridging Divides partner universities; and local community partners. Additionally, the Communications Specialist liaises with the Arts Service Centre (ASC) Communications to ensure adherence to Arts and UBC brand guidelines and best practices and to support a coordinated approach to the faculty-wide editorial strategy.

Work Performed

  • Works within ASC Communications guidelines to develop and execute strategic communications and knowledge mobilization plans (including an editorial calendar) to support the strategic priorities of CMS and Bridging Divides.

  • Translates complex research findings into accessible communications for academic, policy, practitioner, media, and public audiences by writing, editing, proofreading, and coordinating plain language summaries, research stories, briefs, policy explainers, reports, presentations, newsletters, website content, social media content, and other communications materials.

  • Collaborates with faculty members, researchers, trainees, and staff to identify research suitable for broader dissemination and maximize its accessibility and impact.

  • Identifies, supports, and executes media outreach opportunities including liaising with UBC News and University Affairs, directly pitching to and working with media, and organizing CMS affiliate participation in such opportunities.

  • Manages CMS’ online presence by creating and maintaining webpages (via WordPress) including research, news, events, feature pages, RSVP links, and other digital content, and produces and publishes CMS newsletters.

  • Manages the Centre’s social media channels including producing regular content, analyzing analytics, and providing issue management support.

  • Liaises with external partners for marketing and communications material, including photo or video shoots with faculty and students, to produce promotional materials for knowledge mobilization and fundraising purposes.

  • Provides strategic recommendations and advice on communications planning, knowledge mobilization, privacy, digital communications, marketing, social media, website best practices, and accessibility to support staff and faculty engaged in research dissemination and program delivery.

title: ESG Intern
description:
Company Profile:

candi is a dedicated solar partner for businesses across Asia and Africa. Combining the international capital of our Swiss-based platform with local expertise in these regions, we’re able to provide a unique offering to this underserved sector. In doing so, we aim to have a big social impact, reduce carbon emissions, create jobs, increase energy access, and save money for businesses of all sizes in emerging markets.

Our approach is to take the risk so our partners don’t have to, providing businesses with flexible, end-to-end solar and battery solutions that are built to last. Our shared value model leverages our experience in customizable finance and performance offerings, quality engineering, and data-enabled asset management to help guarantee optimized systems, lowering the barrier to entry and maximizing returns.


Job Summary:

We're looking for an ESG Intern who is genuinely curious about sustainability, not just someone who knows the theory. You'll work closely with our Environmental, Social, and Governance team on real initiatives that shape how the company operates responsibly. This is a hands-on role: you'll analyze data, spot patterns, question assumptions, and help turn insight into action. We want someone who reads the textbook and then asks "but how does this actually play out on the ground?"


What You Will Do?


  • Data Collection & Analysis: Gather and interpret data across environmental impact (energy, water, emissions), social programs (community engagement, diversity & inclusion), governance (compliance, ethics), and health & safety (training hours, injury rates) — and go beyond the numbers to explain what they mean.
  • Research & Benchmarking: Track ESG trends, regulations, and best practices, and benchmark our performance against peers to surface where we can genuinely improve, not just where we look good on paper.
  • ESG Strategy Support: Contribute ideas to strategy discussions — we want fresh perspectives, not just execution of existing plans.
  • Reporting & Communication: Help build ESG reports, investor materials, and sustainability content that translates complex data into clear, compelling stories for different audiences.
  • Project Support: Get involved in ESG projects and events from the ground up — from concept to delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, People & Culture, Marketing, and Projects & Asset Management to embed ESG thinking into everyday business decisions.
  • Ad-Hoc & Administrative Support: Maintain ESG KPI trackers and build presentations for training sessions and investor-facing topics.


Who You Are?



  • Analytically sharp: You can collect, interpret, and make sense of complex or messy data — and you're comfortable digging in until the numbers actually tell a story.
  • A creative, independent thinker: You don't just apply what you learned in class — you connect dots others miss, question the obvious approach, and bring original ideas to the table.
  • Genuinely passionate about sustainability: ESG isn't just a resume line for you — you care about the environmental and social impact of business, and it shows in how you engage with the work.
  • Curious and a fast learner: You're energized by new topics, tools, and frameworks, and you go looking for answers rather than waiting to be handed them.
  • A clear communicator: You can translate dense or technical findings into something a non-expert (or an investor) can actually understand.
  • Proactive and collaborative: You take initiative, work well independently, and thrive in cross-functional team settings.
  • Detail-oriented, without losing the big picture: You catch the small errors while still keeping sight of what the analysis is actually for.


Qualification :



  • Currently enrolled in or a recent graduate of a bachelor's or master's program — sustainability, environmental science/engineering, business, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with ESG frameworks (e.g., GRI, TCFD) is a plus, but a genuine interest in learning them matters more than prior exposure.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience with data or analytics tools is a bonus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Prior internship, volunteer, or project experience in sustainability or ESG is preferred but not required — we care more about how you think than your resume line count.


Who Join Us?



You'll get real exposure to how ESG strategy is built and executed in practice, mentorship from a team that values ideas over hierarchy, and the chance to leave a visible mark on projects that matter — not just make coffee and format slides.

title: Senior Manager, Apparel Graphics Design, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest product creation engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting into the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while driving and extending consumer favorites, serving local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and act independently as a self-driven leader.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Apparel Graphic Design to join our dynamic and fast-paced design team. Based in Shanghai, China, this role will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Product Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative leader with broad apparel industry experience and the ability to lead a team of designers in developing and executing multiple creative expressions across our brand. They will drive graphic expression excellence across Greater China Sport and Lifestyle business opportunities and lead the execution of multiple categories through a hyper-local lens for our target consumers. This leader has a strong eye for detail, deep expertise in premium craft, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, bring the brand vision to life, nurture creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to take ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is a people leadership role reporting to the Director, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teammates throughout the product creation process to deliver innovative, consumer-right product solutions for the Greater China marketplace.

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

A BA, BFA, MA, or MFA in Graphic Design or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of professional graphic design experience in the apparel or sportswear industry, with extensive expertise in graphic creation, application, and execution for apparel products.

  • Experience in creative leadership and people management, with a strong understanding of apparel consumer segments and profiles across multiple dimensions, preferably in the Greater China market.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials, garment construction, tech packs, and schematic development.

  • Strong ability to translate consumer insights into authentic narratives and compelling visual storytelling. Ability to develop concepts from a holistic point of view and drive cohesion across graphics, color, silhouettes, key looks, and overall product expression within collections and across the brand.

  • Ability to lead, curate, and drive a clear design vision across categories while collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners and aligning expectations with key stakeholders. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to guide and manage teams throughout the design process.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver quality work within established timelines.

  • Excellent visual, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Proven leadership capabilities and a collaborative mindset, fostering an inclusive environment that enables teams to achieve shared creative goals.

  • Strong strategic thinking and sound decision-making skills.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, AI-enabled design tools, 3D visualization software, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Senior Manager, Apparel Graphic Design, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Create product expressions that align with global creative direction, seasonal concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, geo assortments, and the unique needs of the Greater China consumer.

  • Lead and develop a team of apparel graphic designers, fostering creativity, strengthening collaboration, and driving excellence in cross-functional communication.

  • Build an emotional connection with consumers through graphic design, authentic narratives, and compelling storytelling. Bring seasonal creative direction to life through market-relevant trends, insights, and culturally relevant graphic expressions tailored to Greater China consumers.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively while collaborating in a fast-paced, close-to-market environment. Make informed design and graphic application decisions with agility while balancing costing objectives and business needs.

  • Partner with Product Development throughout the prototyping process to refine graphic execution, finalize production details, and develop trims and graphic applications that support seasonal stories and product intent.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Development teams to build trend-relevant assortments, communicate design intent, review prototypes, and continuously refine product execution.

  • Champion storytelling and clearly articulate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts effectively to internal teams, leaders, and external partners, ensuring purpose-driven design decisions.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, including graphic development, sample reviews, execution refinements, and resolution of production feasibility challenges.

  • Demonstrate strong consumer curiosity and trend forecasting capabilities, maintaining a deep connection to city culture, emerging trends, and Nike's design ethos while translating insights into commercially relevant product solutions.

#MYNEXT: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future
