title: VP Software Engineering
description:
About Us

At Nextlane, we don’t just develop software solutions – we create the future of the automotive industry.

We are a company that combines advanced technology with a clear vision: simplifying and digitizing every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.

We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to develop and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

  • Be part of a growth-oriented culture.

  • Collaborate with colleagues from all over the world.

  • Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.

  • Be committed to provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and collaborate on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate, push boundaries, and work on solutions that are transforming the automotive world.

🚀 The Mission

Nextlane builds the software that runs automotive retail across 14 countries, with more than 60 manufacturer integrations. Today that runs on around ten legacy dealer management systems, built over three decades in technologies that are now at the end of their life.

We are replacing them with a single cloud platform, and we are building it with AI at the centre: both in how our engineers work, and in what our customers get. Our AI products are already live and generating revenue, and they are the fastest growing part of our portfolio.

You will lead the engineering organisation that builds all of it: the cloud product portfolio, the single platform that replaces the legacy estate, and the AI products we sell to dealers and manufacturers.

This is a build job, not a caretaking job. The legacy estate keeps running while you build what replaces it, so you will be making hard sequencing calls about what gets migrated, what gets rewritten and what gets left alone, with real customers on the other side of every one of them.

🎯 Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Engineering strategy and delivery. Defining and executing the engineering strategy for the cloud product portfolio, aligned to the company strategy and the product vision, and owning delivery, scalability, reliability and operational excellence.

  • An engineering organisation of around 30 people, led through Engineering Managers, with Principal and Staff Engineers on the technical track. Building and scaling those teams across several product domains, and developing the leaders inside them.

  • The AI product portfolio. The engineering capability, evaluation discipline, reliability and unit cost model that let us ship customer-facing AI features safely and repeatedly, including ownership of the Skywalker team.

  • Agentic development. Driving our agentic development operating model inside your organisation. We have standardised on Claude Code for all engineers, with autonomy gated by a defined AI fluency scale. You will take this from adoption to measured delivery outcomes, and contribute to how it works across the company.

  • Architectural coherence. Working with our Architecture Practice and our Platform engineering team so that we ship one platform rather than several that resemble each other.

What success looks like

  • The single platform has a credible, sequenced delivery plan, with the first migrated modules live with real customers rather than in pilot.

  • Agentic development is measurably changing throughput and quality in your teams, with the numbers to prove it rather than anecdotes.

  • Shipped further customer-facing AI capabilities to production, with an evaluation and cost model you can defend to the executive team.

  • Your leadership bench is strong enough that the organisation runs without you in the middle of it.

🕵️ What We’re Looking For

These are the requirements that decide this hire. We will probe each one with specific evidence, so please come prepared with examples.

1. You have led a real agentic development transformation, not a tooling rollout.

You have taken an engineering organisation from AI-assisted coding to agentic delivery, and you changed the operating model to match: how work is decomposed, what the definition of done is, how code review and testing hold up when generated volume goes up, and how you measured whether any of it worked. We will ask what broke, what you changed, and what the numbers did.

2. You have shipped AI features to paying customers.

Production features built on models, not internal productivity tooling and not a prototype. That means evaluation harnesses, failure modes and hallucination posture, latency and unit cost per interaction, human in the loop design, data protection, and the conversations with legal and with customers about what the system is allowed to do. You know what you would build differently now.

3. You lead through managers, and you are still technical.

You have run an engineering organisation of around 30 to 50 people or larger, through Engineering Managers or Directors, across more than one product domain, and you have hired and developed those leaders. You are also credible in an architecture review: you can read the design, ask the question that exposes the weak assumption, and disagree with a Principal Engineer on the substance. We are not looking for a leader who has stopped engaging with the technology.

4. You communicate exceptionally well.

Fluent English, which is our working language and the language of the interview process. You can hold a room of engineers and a room of executives on the same subject and be equally clear in both, explain a technical trade-off in business terms without diluting it, and write well enough that a decision survives contact with a distributed organisation. A large part of this role is alignment across countries, functions and levels, so this is not a soft requirement.

6. You have built cloud-native B2B SaaS at scale.

Multi-tenant products with real reliability and scalability requirements, distributed and international teams, and a product-led organisation where engineering partners with Product rather than receiving specifications from it. You are fluent in cloud platforms, distributed systems and modern software delivery, and you can judge those decisions even where you are not hands-on.

description:

title: Software Engineer - Integrations

title: Hitsaaja Turkuun telakalle
description:
Telakalle Turkuun töihin?
Haemme Turun telakalle metallialan osaajaa monipuolisiin hitsaus tehtäviin. Työnkuvaan kuuluu MIG- ja TIG-hitsausta, rälläköintiä sekä puikolla heppausta erilaisiin telakan rakenteisiin. Työ alkaa vuokratyösuhteena, ja osaavalle tekijälle on mahdollisuus siirtyä myöhemmin suoraan asiakasyrityksen kirjoille. Palkka on alkuun 15-17 €/h.
Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:
* Hallitset MIG- ja TIG-hitsauksesta.
* Valmius työskennellä telakan vaativissa olosuhteissa ja hyvä työasenne
* Osaamista rälläköinnistä ja puikkohitsauksesta

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.
* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.
* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.
* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.
Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!
Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta.
Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.
Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä joonas.lahteenmaki@worker.fi

title: Java Developer – Assistant Vice President

  • 5 or more years of hands-on Java development, with deep expertise in Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Web, and Spring Data.

  • Advanced knowledge of core Java concepts including threading, collections, exception handling, JDBC, object-oriented design and programming principles, and SOA design patterns.

  • Proven ability to build, deploy, and manage containerized applications running on Kubernetes and Docker platforms.

  • Solid experience designing and delivering microservices and service-oriented architectures using REST-based communication patterns.

  • Practical experience working within Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines, applying Agile methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, with familiarity with Oracle as a preferred dialect.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate clearly across technical teams and engage effectively with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as Behavior Driven Development, Extreme Programming, and DevOps workflows.

Education

Joining Citi means working on backend systems that matter — at a scale and complexity that few organizations can offer. You will be part of a performance-driven technology team where your contributions directly influence the quality and resilience of financial platforms used by clients and institutions worldwide.

  • Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you structure and flexibility in equal measure.

  • Access to continuous learning and professional development resources to deepen your technical skills and grow your career in enterprise software engineering.

  • Meaningful technical ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to shape architectural decisions and drive engineering quality across a complex, large-scale technology environment.

  • Exposure to global technology teams and cross-functional collaboration across Citi's international network.

  • Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including financial wellbeing support, health coverage, and family support programs.

  • A team environment that values technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, and measurable impact.

Apply today to bring your Java engineering expertise to a global financial institution where the systems you build directly shape client outcomes at scale.

title: Information Technology Lead
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Engineer
Location: India
Department: Employee Services Technology & Operations (ESTO) – ITSM & Service Operations


  • Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.

About Zendesk

  • At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.

The Role

  • You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.

What You’ll Do

    • Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
    • Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
    • Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
    • Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-remediation runbooks.
    • Partner in operations: Work hand-in-hand with Incident & Problem Management to accelerate triage, cut MTTR, and drive durable RCAs and prevention actions.
    • Integrate the ecosystem: Connect observability to CI/CD, feature flags, incident tooling CMDB/service catalog, and collaboration channels (Slack/Zoom).
    • Champion reliability culture: Coach product and platform teams on instrumentation patterns, trace context, and SLO thinking; contribute reusable modules/templates.
    • Continuously improve: Lead telemetry hygiene initiatives, cost/usage optimization of monitoring platforms, and performance tuning across tiers.
    • Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics.

What You Bring

    • Experience: 4–8 years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
    • Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
    • Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
    • Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
    • Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
    • ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
    • Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
    • Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.

Nice to Have

    • Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
    • Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
    • Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).

Working Model

    • Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
    • Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest-moving product engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. As part of the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas, advance consumer favorites, and serve local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and work independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Lead Apparel Designer, Outerwear, Local Creation GC to join our dynamic, fast-paced design team. Based in Shanghai, China, this individual will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a seasoned creative leader with broad apparel industry experience and deep expertise in designing and executing outerwear products for the Nike brand. They will create apparel products across a range of Greater China consumer, sport, and lifestyle opportunities and lead the execution of multiple categories through a hyper-local lens. This designer has a strong eye for detail, a passion for premium craftsmanship, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, advance the brand vision, foster creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with multidisciplinary partners to bring ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with key functional partners throughout the product design process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

A BA, BFA, MA, or MFA in Apparel Design or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

Experience:

  • 7 years of professional apparel design experience in the apparel or sporting goods industry, with extensive expertise in outerwear materials, functionality, construction, and fit.

  • Clear understanding of apparel segments and multidimensional consumer profiles; experience in the Greater China market is preferred.

  • Ability to design and execute lifestyle and performance apparel.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials, construction, fit, tech packs, and schematic development.

  • Strong collection-building skills, with the ability to translate insights into authentic narratives and storytelling through color, silhouette, and key looks. Ability to apply a holistic point of view and create cohesion across products within a collection and across categories.

  • Ability to lead, curate, and advance the design vision across assigned categories, collaborate cross-functionally, and align design expectations with key partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and adhere to timelines.

  • Excellent visual and verbal presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Proven teamwork and leadership skills, with the ability to foster a positive and inclusive environment and achieve shared creative goals.

  • Sound decision-making abilities and strategic thinking skills.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, 3D/AI rendering software, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Lead Apparel Designer, Outerwear, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Create apparel products that align with global creative direction, seasonal key concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, and geo assortments while connecting with Greater China consumers.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Development to establish and manage seasonal new-creation toolboxes based on consumer insights, design direction, product intent, and margin targets.

  • Lead pre-development and innovation exploration in outerwear.

  • Bring seasonal creative direction to life through market-relevant trends and insights across color, material functionality, Greater China-specific fit and proportion, and brand- and trend-relevant coordination of key looks and outfits. Build depth across the range through thoughtful use of color and clearly defined trend levels that create excitement and cohesion.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively, collaborate in a fast-paced environment, and incorporate Greater China-relevant trends and solutions into seasonal products.

  • Monitor prototype and sample development and partner with Development to finalize production details, conduct fittings, and ensure execution excellence across multiple categories.

  • Champion storytelling and clearly communicate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts to internal teams, leadership, and external partners, explaining the rationale behind design decisions.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, planning and executing product details, reviewing samples, resolving feasibility issues, and ensuring timely project completion.

  • Demonstrate deep consumer curiosity and strong trend forecasting capabilities, maintaining a strong connection to city culture, emerging trends, and Nike's design ethos.

title: Innovation Software Developer
description:
Software Developer – Innovation (AI/ML, IoT & Digital Twins)

We're looking for an innovative and hands-on Software Developer to join our growing Innovation team. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Real-Time Data, and Digital Twin technologies, creating customer-facing solutions that demonstrate tangible business value.

You'll be responsible for designing and delivering Proofs of Concept (POCs) and Proofs of Value (POVs) that showcase how emerging technologies can solve real-world challenges. From ingesting live sensor data and building scalable APIs to integrating AI models and creating immersive 3D/4D Digital Twin experiences, you'll help bring cutting-edge ideas to life.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex engineering problems, and want to work on technology that pushes boundaries, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Build Customer-Focused Innovation Solutions

  • Design and deliver end-to-end POCs and POVs that demonstrate business value and accelerate customer adoption.
  • Develop solutions combining IoT, AI/ML, APIs, analytics, and Digital Twin technologies.
  • Present working prototypes to both technical and executive stakeholders.

Develop Data Pipelines and Integrations

  • Build streaming and batch ETL pipelines using Python and modern data frameworks.
  • Integrate data from sensors, databases, cloud platforms, and third-party services.
  • Orchestrate data workflows using tools such as Airflow and Prefect.

Create IoT and Real-Time Data Solutions

  • Collect, normalize, and process telemetry from connected devices.
  • Implement edge-to-cloud data flows using MQTT, HTTP, CoAP, and related technologies.
  • Build robust solutions capable of handling real-time and high-volume sensor streams.

Design Modern APIs and Services

  • Develop secure, scalable REST and gRPC services using FastAPI, Flask, and Node.js.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, observability, testing, and performance monitoring.
  • Ensure reliability, maintainability, and best-practice API design.

Deliver Digital Twin Experiences

  • Integrate real-time operational data with advanced 3D and 4D visualizations.
  • Work with OpenUSD, NVIDIA Omniverse, and Unreal Engine technologies.
  • Create interactive digital environments that represent assets and processes over time.

Integrate AI and Machine Learning

  • Embed AI/ML capabilities into prototypes and customer solutions.
  • Support use cases such as anomaly detection, forecasting, computer vision, and geospatial analytics.
  • Work with modern machine learning frameworks including PyTorch and Scikit-learn.

Support DevOps and Delivery Excellence

  • Deploy containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and observability tooling.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation and operational runbooks.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of software development experience in complex environments.
  • Strong expertise in Python for application development, data processing, and integration.
  • Advanced experience with C++ and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience developing and consuming REST and/or gRPC APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with IoT technologies, sensor data, and telemetry pipelines.
  • Knowledge of time-series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, QuestDB, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures.
  • Understanding of Digital Twin, 3D visualization, or simulation technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to rapidly prototype innovative solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, OpenUSD, or Unreal Engine.
  • Cloud platform expertise across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Geospatial technologies including PostGIS, GeoJSON, Cesium, or GIS platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka, Kinesis, or Pub/Sub.
  • Exposure to edge computing technologies such as NVIDIA Jetson.
  • Knowledge of robotics, ROS, industrial protocols, OPC-UA, or Modbus.
  • Experience building dashboards and data visualization tools.
  • Cloud certifications or advanced technical qualifications.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you'll:

  • Deliver multiple customer-facing innovation projects and prototypes.
  • Build solutions that seamlessly connect IoT, AI, APIs, and Digital Twin technologies.
  • Enable real-time visualization and analytics from live operational data.
  • Contribute to customer engagements that progress from concept to production opportunities.
  • Help establish best practices across innovation engineering and solution delivery.

Ready to build what's next? Apply today and help turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja
description:
Haemme kahta lasten tukemisesta kiinnostunutta varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajaa, joiden tehtävänä on työskennellä lasten tuen tarpeiden mukaisesti, joko ryhmäkohtaisena tai lapsikohtaisena lastenhoitaja-avustajana.

Työtehtävä on irrotettu perushenkilöstön mitoituksesta. Lastenhoitaja-avustajan työn tavoite on mahdollistaa lasten ja ryhmien tuen toteutuminen moniammatillisessa yhteistyössä muun henkilöstön kanssa. Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajana osallistut muiden tiimin jäsenten kanssa tuen ja toiminnan suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja arviointiin tehden yhteistyötä erityisopettajan kanssa.

Työsuhteet ovat vakituisia. Luonnollisesti ryhmät ja myös päiväkodit saattavat tulevaisuudessa vaihtua lasten tuen tarpeiden mukaisesti, mutta tällä hetkellä työt alkavat Pääskylinnan ja Leppäkertun päiväkodeissa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkinto tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto, joihin sisältyy varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018, 28§ mukainen kelpoisuus.
Lisäksi edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä kiinnostusta ja soveltuvuutta eri tavoin tukea tarvitsevien lasten kanssa työskentelyyn.
Eduksi katsomme osaamisen ja kokemuksen tukea tarvitsevien lasten kanssa toimimisesta. Eduksi luetaan myös työtä tukevat lisäkoulutukset, hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaidot sekä sitoutuneisuus lastenhoitaja-avustajan tehtävässä toimimiseen.

Vastaat tehtävistä yhdessä isännöitsijän kanssa ja toimit tarvittaessa hänen sijaisenaan. Tuet myös Suomenlinnan hoitokunnan johtajaa Suomenlinnan toimitilojen hallinnoinnissa sekä Museoviraston kiinteistöpäällikköä muiden Museoviraston hallinnassa olevien toimitilojen kiinteistöhallinnollisissa tehtävissä.

Kiinteistökoordinaattorin keskeiset työtehtävät:
Vuokrasuhteiden hallinta
Tehtäviisi kuuluu vuokrasuhteiden hallinta asuntohaun valmistelusta vuokrasuhteen päättymiseen. Laadit asuntoilmoituksia yhteistyössä viestinnän kanssa, käsittelet hakemuksia, järjestät asuntoarvontoja ja asuntoesittelyjä sekä huolehdit vuokrasopimuksiin, vakuuksiin ja avainten luovutukseen liittyvistä tehtävistä. Teet myös asuntotarkastuksia ja koordinoit niiden perusteella tarvittavia jatkotoimenpiteitä.

Asiakaspalvelu ja asukasviestintä
Vastaat asukkaiden neuvonnasta ja asiakaspalvelusta puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja paikan päällä Suomenlinnassa. Hoidat asumiseen liittyvää päivittäisviestintää. Ylläpidät asukkaille suunnattua verkkopalvelua ja sen käyttäjätietoja sekä päivität asukasopasta yhteistyössä viestinnän kanssa.

Kiinteistöjen ylläpidon koordinointi
Työhösi kuuluu huolto- ja kunnossapitotilausten käsittelyä ja koordinointia yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Vastaat lisäksi avainten, kulkuoikeuksien ja ovikoodien hallinnasta (ILOQ, Aviglion Alta) sekä saunavuorojen, tilaussaunan varausten ja autopaikkojen hallinnoinnista.

Taloushallinto ja rekisterit
Huolehdit vuokrien laskutukseen, vuokravalvontaan ja muuhun myyntilaskutukseen liittyvistä tehtävistä sekä ylläpidät asiakas- ja asukasrekistereitä.

Järjestelmät ja tiedonhallinta
Tehtävässä käytetään useita kiinteistö- ja vuokrahallinnan järjestelmiä (muun muassa CGI Koki, Koki360, AsukasKoki), joissa toimit myös pääkäyttäjäroolissa. Lisäksi huolehdit osaltasi kiinteistöhallintaan ja asunnonvuokraukseen liittyvien tietojen asianmukaisesta käsittelystä ja tietoturvasta.

Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Tehtävään ei ole säädettyjä kelpoisuusvaatimuksia.

title: Innovation Project Manager - Complete Seat
description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

Your mission, roles and responsibilities

Innovation System Architect plays a crucial role in driving global innovative projects within the organization and developing innovative solutions for the automotive complete seat industry

Key Responsibilities:

Project Oversight : Define, develop, and manage the technical part of innovation projects.

Team Leadership : Lead a project team including functional reports from technical contributors, responsible for Quality, Cost, Delivery of the project.

Performance Monitoring : Track project KPI, planning, budget & secure all data available & stored in GRIP.

Business case : Part of the business case elaboration with support from costing, purchasing & marketing.

Stakeholder Communication : Involve all required internal & external stakeholder to the project, report status to top management & functional team,

Promotion & implementation : Support communication to global OEM(s), & implementation in development programs as required,

Innovation : Lead and facilitate brainstorming sessions, workshops, and other innovation-related activities, secure patents as per need & opportunity.

Market Analysis: Understand market research & competitors benchmark to identify trends and opportunities for innovation.

Risk analysis : Lead project technical risk analysis through ERA / D-PFMEA as needed,

Sustainability Initiatives: Drive initiatives that align with Forvia's commitment to sustainable mobility.

Your profile and competencies to succeed

Qualifications:

Educational Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, technology.

Experience: Over 10 years complete seat product design, technical project management, preferably within the automotive industry.

Skills: Project team management skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, extensive complete seat design knowledge, proper English communication and understanding of market trends and technological advancements

Personal Attributes: Creativity, strategic thinking, innovative & sustainable thinking, and a passion for leading teams towards innovative solutions.

What we can do for you

  • At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
  • We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
  • We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
  • We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
  • We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
  • Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.

Why join us

FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.


Salary Range: EUR 57000-79000 €

title: Lead, Apparel Graphics Designer, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest product engines, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. As part of the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while advancing consumer favorites and serving local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and operate independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Lead Apparel Graphic Designer to join our dynamic, fast-paced design team in Shanghai, China. This role will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is an energetic designer who can build an emotional connection with Greater China consumers through brand-led narratives and storytelling. As part of a team of Apparel Graphic Designers, this person will contribute to graphic expression excellence across a range of Greater China consumer, sport, and lifestyle business opportunities. They will bring the vision of key collaborators to life while maintaining our brand objectives within each design story and curating expressions through a hyper-local lens for target consumers. This designer has a strong eye for detail, a passion for premium craft, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to bring ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Apparel Graphic Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with key functional partners throughout the product creation process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

A BA, BFA, MA, or MFA in Graphic Design or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in the apparel or sports industry, with strong expertise in graphic execution for apparel products.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials and construction, tech packs, and schematic development.

  • Ability to translate consumer insights into authentic narratives and visual storytelling; develop concepts holistically; and create cohesion across product elements, including color, silhouettes, and key looks within a collection.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and adhere to timelines.

  • Deep knowledge of Greater China consumers, with a proven track record of designing for this marketplace.

  • Strong understanding of apparel consumer trends in Greater China.

  • Excellent visual and verbal presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Proven ability to collaborate across design and cross-functional teams while fostering a positive, inclusive environment and supporting shared creative goals.

  • Sound decision-making abilities and strategic thinking skills.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, 3D and AI rendering software, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Lead Apparel Graphic Designer, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Apply sophisticated design skills to create product expressions that align with global creative direction, seasonal key concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, and geo-specific assortments while connecting with Greater China consumers.

  • Build an emotional connection with Greater China consumers through graphic design, narrative, and storytelling, bringing close-to-market, trend-relevant seasonal creative direction to life at both the product and collection levels.

  • Use graphics to deliver an elevated, consumer-relevant brand point of view in the marketplace through strategic vision, design direction, storytelling, and editing.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively and collaborate in a fast-paced, close-to-market environment. Make informed design and application decisions with efficiency and agility while keeping cost targets in mind.

  • Monitor prototype and sample development, partner with Development to finalize production details, and create story-appropriate trims.

  • Bring seasonal product direction to life at speed, ensuring relevance to Greater China consumers. Partner with Product Management and Development to build trend-driven assortments, communicate design intent, review prototypes, and refine execution.

  • Champion storytelling and clearly communicate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts to internal teams, leadership, and external partners, explaining the rationale behind design decisions.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, planning and executing product details, reviewing samples, resolving feasibility issues, and ensuring timely project completion.

  • Demonstrate strong trend mining skills with a deep connection to consumer and city trends, maintaining in-depth knowledge of Nike DNA.

#MYNEXT: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

title: IT-supporttekniker till Svensk Travsport
description:
Svensk Travsport söker en IT-supporttekniker!

Välkommen till IT-teamet på Svensk Travsport - ett team som genomsyras av höga ambitioner, nytänkande och en vilja att göra det enkelt för alla att ägna sig åt sin favorithobby: travsport.

Om rollen
Som IT-supporttekniker blir du en del av vår IT Operations-enhet och en viktig del av vår interna supportfunktion. Du jobbar tätt ihop med en kollega och tillsammans håller ni supporten öppen för våra cirka 550 användare - allt från medarbetare på vårt kontor vid Solvalla till personal ute på landets 33 travbanor.

Det är en varierad roll där du växlar mellan inkommande supportsamtal, ärendehantering och mer tekniska arbetsuppgifter under dagen. Rollen kräver att du är skicklig på att prioritera, följa upp och driva ärenden hela vägen till lösning.

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som är social, tålmodig och har en genuin vilja att hjälpa andra. Du är nyfiken och hungrig på att lära dig, trivs med att vara ansiktet utåt för IT-avdelningen och ser möjligheter snarare än hinder när du stöter på nya utmaningar. Vi tror på att bygga kompetens inifrån - hos oss finns goda möjligheter att fördjupa dig, specialisera dig och ta mer ansvar över tid.

Vi tror också att du har:

  • Några års erfarenhet av IT-support, IT Operations och/eller Modern Workplace

  • God kunskap inom Microsoft 365 och Entra ID

  • Erfarenhet av hybridmiljöer med Entra ID, Active Directory och Windows 11

  • God erfarenhet av Microsoft Intune och modern klienthantering

  • Erfarenhet av felsökning inom Exchange Online, Teams och SharePoint Online

  • God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av macOS via Jamf, Freshservice eller PowerShell. Är du dessutom travintresserad är det ett extra plus!

Praktiskt
Tjänsten är förlagd till Hästsportens Hus vid Solvalla i Stockholm. Tjänsten är primärt på plats men med viss flexibilitet för distansarbete. Arbetstider varierar mellan 08–17.

Vi erbjuder
🤝 Ett schysst gäng kollegor som gärna pratar teknik, trav och annat roligt
📚 Udemy – kompetensutveckling i Netflix-format
🏋️ Gratis gym, träningslokaler och tillgång till naprapat i huset
🍽️ Lunchförmån och en fräsch matsal med utsikt över Solvalla Travbana
🏇 Årskort med fri entré till landets 33 travbanor och prenumeration på Travronden

Om Svensk Travsport
Svensk Travsport är huvudorganisation för den svenska travsporten. Vi leder, organiserar och utvecklar travsporten i Sverige och fungerar som serviceorgan för landets alla travsportintressenter. Vår vision är Världens bästa travsport - attraktiv för alla, alltid med travhästen i centrum.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Ett CV och en kort beskrivning om varför du är taggad på rollen räcker gott. Har du frågor? Kontakta mig på Caroline.kylbergh@travsport.se


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: CE SKD Factory Lead (Myanmar Branch)
description:
Position Summary

Role and Responsibilities

Factory Setup & Project Implementation

  • Lead factory implementation projects including production line setup, equipment installation, process validation and production ramp-up.
  • Drive factory readiness by coordinating layout planning, production flow, capacity planning and infrastructure preparation.
  • Establish production processes in compliance with company standards, local regulations and import/customs requirements.
  • Monitor implementation progress and ensure timely project execution.

Factory Operations

  • Lead factory operations including production, warehouse, inventory, material flow and logistics.
  • Drive operational excellence by improving productivity, efficiency and resource utilization.
  • Establish operational KPIs and monitor factory performance.
  • Identify operational risks and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Production Planning & Supply Chain
  • Develop annual and monthly production plans based on sales forecasts and PSI.
  • Coordinate production schedules, material planning and inventory to ensure stable operations and on-time delivery.
  • Review production capacity and resolve supply constraints with cross-functional teams.
  • Optimize inventory levels while minimizing shortages and excess stock.

Quality & Compliance

  • Establish and maintain factory quality management systems and production standards.
  • Lead factory audits, certification activities and regulatory compliance.
  • Drive corrective and preventive actions based on quality analysis and operational findings.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards and applicable regulations.

Factory Partner & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead factory implementation and operational activities with factory partners.
  • Coordinate with global teams, including HQ, Factory Hub, RHQ, TSE and factory partners to align production requirements, engineering changes and operational activities.
  • Monitor project milestones, factory readiness and partner performance through regular operational reviews.
  • Prepare management reports, project updates and business presentations.
  • Drive collaboration across cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in factory operations, production planning, supply chain or project management
  • Experience in factory setup, production operations or contract manufacturing is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of production planning, inventory management, quality systems and factory operations.
  • Excellent project management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
  • Fluent in English written and spoken.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint and Word).

title: Intern Salgs- og Ordrekoordinator

title: Data Scientist
description:
ERNI is a fast-growing Software Development company headquartered and founded in Switzerland in 1994, with more than 800 employees. We are highly specialized in IT & software engineering to enable and deliver innovation in process and technology. Our first service center in Asia Pacific is in Metro Manila (Mandaluyong) from where we provide our service to Europe, APAC incl. our local market Philippines, and USA regions. We are now geared towards expansion and are looking for highly motivated joiners.

WHY ERNI is the best place to call HOME? 🏡

  • 🤩 At ERNI, this is how we can support you; ALL company PERKS AND BENEFITS take effect UPON HIRING!

  • Contract: there is always a project and opportunity for you.

  • Personal Development and Travel Opportunities outside the Philippines.

  • Baby Basket – to welcome your newborn to the ERNI family.

  • Fruit Basket – boost of vitamins during hospitalization.

  • Free snacks and coffee in the office

🔐 UNLOCKING NEW DOORS OF GROWTH & OPPORTUNITIES

  • Free Training with Certifications: Grow with us through technical and non-technical training.

  • Challenging Projects: ERNI is dedicated to developing high-quality software in complex technical environments such as MedTech, Industry, Finance, and Transportation. Have the chance to participate in various technically challenging projects amongst passionate and skilled colleagues.

  • Employee Welfare: You will be guided by a group of people who will guide and support you to have the right tools and mindset.

  • Promotions & Recognition: From the very first day, we offer you a way to learn and develop yourself in our company. Your colleagues and superiors consistently recognize and appreciate all efforts, making you feel satisfied with your achievements.

  • Communication: You will find transparency, honesty, and open communication in our working culture. we value suggestions, opinions, and feedback from all employees.

⏱ FLEXIBILITY

  • Hybrid Set-Up: We are combining both remote work and in-person work. The hybrid setup will allow you to reduce commuting time and have a more flexible work schedule. This will help you to manage better your work-life balance.

🎉 EVENTS:

  • We provide many opportunities to connect and build relationships. We are learning, growing, and celebrating achievements together. You will experience a wide range of different exciting activities. What to expect? Leisure Events, Summer Events, Family Events, Social Events, and Year-End Events.

👋 What are our wishes?

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or another related discipline.

  • At least five years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, or a closely related role.

  • Hands-on experience designing or implementing machine learning solutions.

  • Strong experience in statistical analysis and statistical modeling.

  • Practical experience with Generative AI applications or solutions.

  • Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL.

  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes.

  • Experience creating dashboards, analytical reports, or interactive visualizations using Power BI.

  • Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform, particularly Microsoft Azure or AWS.

  • Demonstrated ability to perform data validation and implement data quality checks.

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working within Agile teams and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong data storytelling skills, including the ability to communicate complex findings to business stakeholders and senior executives.

  • Ability to work effectively with globally distributed and culturally diverse teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or other advanced qualification in Data Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Relevant professional certifications in machine learning, artificial intelligence, data science, cloud technologies, or analytics.

  • Experience modernizing legacy analytical models implemented through Excel formulas or VBA.

  • Experience working with financial projections, financial modeling, treasury data, balance sheet analytics, income projections, key financial ratios, or similar quantitative domains.

  • Experience working with the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem.

💼 How can you contribute to the team?

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who will design and implement advanced analytics solutions, including machine learning models and Generative AI applications. The role combines data science, data engineering, statistical analysis, and data visualization to help stakeholders generate actionable insights and make data-driven decisions. The successful candidate will contribute to the modernization of a bank-wide financial projection platform. The initiative involves transforming existing Excel, VBA, and Oracle-based processes into a scalable architecture built on the Azure data ecosystem and customized Python solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, evaluate, and maintain machine learning models that address defined business and analytical requirements.

  • Design and implement Generative AI applications for appropriate enterprise use cases.

  • Perform exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, and statistical modeling to identify patterns, relationships, risks, and actionable insights.

  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non technical stakeholders.

  • Build, maintain, and improve scalable data pipelines and ETL processes.

  • Support the migration of financial projection logic currently implemented through Excel formulas and VBA into maintainable Python solutions.

  • Integrate data from multiple source systems through automated interface jobs.

  • Support the modernization and enhancement of existing data marts to accommodate projection results, assumptions, and related analytical information.

  • Help enable parallel computation of financial projection scenarios.

  • Create interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI.

  • Work with business stakeholders, data analysts, analytics engineers, and other technical teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective solutions.

  • Implement data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to maintain data accuracy and integrity.

  • Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, analytical reports, insights, and recommendations.

  • Participate actively in Agile activities and collaborate with cross-functional project teams.

  • Communicate analytical concepts and results effectively to senior executives and stakeholders from diverse cultural backgrounds.

  • Keep current with relevant developments in machine learning, Generative AI, analytics engineering, cloud data platforms, and data visualization.

  • Perform other relevant responsibilities assigned by the Project Manager or designated project stakeholders.

Work Arrangement

  • RTO 3x, WFH 2x a week

  • 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Mon–Fri)

title: Boat Builder
description:
Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team?

Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels. Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation – the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not only operating in Stockholm, but is now attracting orders from around the world.

Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, reducing energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels.

And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel-free lakes and oceans.

You can now be part of the amazing team at Candela! We are looking for Boat Builders to support Candela’s future growth ambitions.

About the role

As a Boat Builder, you will play an important hands-on role in building our electric boats. We have opportunities in two different areas of production: Assembly and Composite.

Depending on your experience and profile, you may join one of these teams:

Assembly
In the Assembly area, you will help build and install the interior of our boats. Your work will mainly involve composite parts, including measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling components according to drawings and instructions.

Composite
In the Composite area, located at the beginning of the production process, you will work with carbon fiber and other composite materials. You will prepare and mix materials and ensure they are properly prepared and placed for the molding process.

Across both areas, you will work with a variety of hand tools and power tools, and be responsible for using and maintaining them safely and efficiently. Precision, attention to detail and a strong focus on quality are essential, as your work contributes directly to the quality and performance of our vessels.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Working hands-on with the production and assembly of our electric boats

  • Measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling composite components

  • Working with carbon fiber and other composite materials

  • Preparing and mixing composite materials for the molding process

  • Assembling components according to technical drawings, instructions and specifications

  • Using hand tools and power tools safely and efficiently

  • Performing adjustments and ensuring proper fit, alignment and finish

  • Inspecting your work to ensure it meets quality standards and specifications

  • Maintaining tools, equipment and a clean and organized work environment

  • Documenting work according to company procedures

  • Following safety rules and using provided personal protective equipment (PPE)

  • Working in an international environment – our corporate language is English, including in production

What are we looking for?

You are a practical, detail-oriented and hands-on person who enjoys building high-quality products. You have experience working with tools and are comfortable working in a production or workshop environment.

You take pride in your work and understand the importance of precision, quality and following instructions. You are eager to learn, adaptable and enjoy working as part of a collaborative and diverse team.

Experience with composite materials is valuable, but we are also interested in candidates with a strong practical background and the right mindset who are motivated to learn.

Requirements:

  • Ability to communicate in English in your daily work

  • Experience working safely with hand tools and power tools

  • Ability to read and work according to technical drawings and instructions

  • Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality

  • Good physical condition and ability to work hands-on, including standing for extended periods and working in tight spaces

  • Willingness to work in a production environment and follow safety procedures

Meritorious (nice to have):

  • Experience from assembly or production work

  • Experience working with composite materials, carbon fiber or similar materials

  • Experience from the marine, automotive or other manufacturing industries

  • Experience with mechanical assembly or installation

  • Experience working with technical drawings

  • Experience from a workshop or manufacturing environment

Form of employment: Full-time with initial 6-month probation period
Start date: ASAP
Location/base: Rotebro
Team: Assembly or Composite
Reporting to: Production Area Manager

Why people love working at Candela

At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels – we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges and seeing the results in action – sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers!

We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness. That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun – whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes or cheering each other on during Candela Months, our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events.

We’re office-first but not office-only. We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person – but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated and the ride is just as important as the destination.

Recruitment process

We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well.

Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR, so please use our career website for your application.

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

title: Automyyjä
description:
Tule töihin Suomen suurimpaan vaihtoautokauppaan! 🚗

Etsimme vakituista myyjää Lahden toimipisteeseemme vahvistamaan myyntitiimiä 🔥 Meillä asenne ratkaisee – sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis autoalan ammattilainen, sillä me koulutamme sinut alan huipuksi!

Onko sinulla nälkää menestyä omalla työlläsi ja halu ansaita juuri niin paljon kuin tuloksesi näyttävät, ilman palkkakattoa? Tulevana sakalaisena sytyt kehittämisestä ja kehittymisestä. Et hätkähdä kovia tavoitteita ja tekemisen meininkiä, vaan ne saavat sinut painamaan lisää kaasua. Asiakkaat ovat meille tärkeintä ja asiakaspalvelumme on tutkitusti maan parasta, joten olet luonteva ihmisten kanssa sekä haluat löytää asiakkaillemme parhaat ratkaisut. Aikaisempi myynnin kokemus on eduksi.

Mikäli olet ennakkoluuloton, yrittäjähenkinen ja löydät keinot päästä tavoitteisiin, on aika laittaa vaihde silmään ja tulla mukaan Sakan kasvavaan joukkoon!

Kaiken tekemisemme ytimessä ovat meille tärkeät arvot: menestymme intohimolla yhdessä, arvostamme jokaista ja olemme aina luotettavia sekä rehellisiä.


Millaista on automyynti Sakalla?

Sakalla myyntityö on monipuolista ja tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittyä alan huipuksi. Arkesi koostuu asiakkaiden kanssa neuvottelemisesta, vaihtoautojen hinnoittelusta ja kauppojen klousaamisesta. Asiakkailla on aina tarve jo valmiiksi olemassa! Pääsetkin tarjoamaan heille tarpeeseen sopivia ratkaisuja laajasta valikoimastamme ympäri Suomea sekä auttamaan asiakkaita tekemään isojakin valintoja. Vaikka vastaat omasta myynnistäsi, et työskentele yksin. Tukenasi on myyntitiimi, automyynnin assistentit, myynnin johto sekä hallinnon väki.

Työaika tehtävälle on 37,5 h/vko. Myymälä on auki arkisin klo 10-18 sekä lauantaisin klo 10-16, mihin työvuorotkin ajoittuvat. Työsuhde alkaa Sakademyn järjestämillä uusien myyjien START-päivillä Helsingissä.

Tehtävän vaatimuksena on sujuva suomen kielen taito. Lisäksi sinulta löytyy B-ajokortti sekä puhtaat luottotiedot.

Kurkkaa videolta automyyjämme Osmon fiiliksiä Sakalla työskentelystä:


Miksi Sakalle? 🔥

  • Vaikuta ja kehity: Sakalla saat ajatella itse. Kasvuyrityksenä haastamme itseämme ja koko toimialaa kehittymään jatkuvasti.

  • Sakademy: Koulutusyksikkömme coachaa alan huipputekijöitä ja hiottu myynnin konseptimme auttaa sinua menestymään.

  • Hienot autot myyntituotteena: Tarjoamme 4000 laadukkaan ja monipuolisen auton valikoiman, jota on helppo kaupata.

  • Innostava työympäristö: Sakalla tekeminen on matalahierarkkista, nopeatempoista ja energistä. Arkeemme sisältyy paljon naurua, skabailuja ja aidosti hyvää meininkiä.

  • Palkkaus: Tarjoamme alan parhaat edellytykset onnistua: laadukkaan autovalikoiman, alan kovimman kannattavuuden ja motivoivan provisiomallin, joka mahdollistaa esimerkiksi 4000-10000€ kuukausiansiot. Pohjapalkka on 700€/kk sekä ensimmäiselle 2 kuukaudelle saat takuuprovision.

  • Työsuhde-edut: Työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen sekä koeajan jälkeen liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hierontaedun sekä auton myynti- ja ostoedun.

  • Etene uralla: Vahvasti kasvavassa yrityksessämme aukeaa mahdollisuuksia edetä uralla erilaisiin rooleihin ja haluamme panostaa jokaiseen meille valittuun työntekijään. Tänäkin vuonna meillä on ollut useita sisäisiä rekrytointeja uusiin ja vastuullisiin tehtäviin.

Saka on palkittu työnantaja mm. työntekijäkokemuksen, palvelun ja markkinoinnin saralla. Olemme saaneet kolme perättäistä GPTW-sertifikaattia, uusimpana vuonna 2025 Future Workplaces -sertifikaatin ja meidät on palkittu lokakuussa 2024 yhdeksi Euroopan parhaista työpaikoista Fortune 100 -listalla, sijoituksella 37! Olemme myös voittaneet laajan Palvelu 1 -ostotutkimuksen kahtena vuotena parhaana käytettyjen autojen jälleenmyyjänä, sekä markkinointimme on noteerattu useana vuotena Effie-palkinnoin. Työskentelet siis kunnianhimoisessa ja loistosuorituksiin tähtäävässä ympäristössä.

Ajattele itsesi huipulle & hae Sakalle! 🏆


Lisätietoja työnkuvasta ja tehtävästä saat Lahden yksikönpäälliköltä Hannes Lahtiselta numerosta +358504768013 tai sähköpostilla hannes.lahtinen@saka.fi. Lähetä hakemuksesi 30.9.2026 mennessä! Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävät heti sopivien ehdokkaiden löydyttyä. Lisäksi otamme huomioon ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta tulleet hakemukset.

Tarkistamme ennen palkkausta luottotiedot.

Saka – Suomen suurin vaihtoautokauppa – tekee kaikkensa, jotta sinun ei tarvitse autokaupoilla luottaa tuuriin. Tekemistämme ohjaavat kolme arvoa; menestymme intohimolla yhdessä, arvostamme jokaista sekä olemme aina luotettava ja rehellinen.

Saka Finland Oy lukuina: Liikevaihto noin 751 miljoonaa euroa vuonna 2025, 29 myymälää ja etämyynti kautta maan, yli 220 000 myytyä autoa & yli 35 000 kotiintoimitettua autoa.

Näin rekrytointimme etenee:

  1. Hakemus: Kerro meille kuka olet ja miksi juuri sinä sopisit Sakalle. Suosittelemme videon laittamista mukaan!

  2. Lyhyt henkilöarviointi: tästä saamme lisätietoja juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi ja saat kattavasti myös tietoa itsestäsi esimerkiksi urasuunnittelua varten. Emme pohjaa rekrytointipäätöksiä tähän analyysiin vaan katsomme aina hakijoita kokonaisuutena.

  3. Puhelinkeskustelu: Nopea keskustelu puolin ja toisin – katsotaan, kohtaavatko odotuksemme.

  4. Tapaaminen myymälässä: Pääset tapaamaan myyntipäällikön ja aluemyyntipäällikön. Tässä vaiheessa pääsemme tutustumaan paremmin.

  5. Suosittelijoiden tarkistus ja luottotiedot: Haastattelun jälkeen suoritamme suosittelijoiden tarkistuksen (Refapp) sekä luottotietojen varmistuksen.

  6. Päätökset: Meillä ei turhia jarrutella eli heti kun oikea vahvistus tiimiin löytyy, lyömme nimet paperiin välittömästi.

title: Senior Software Engineer, IQ Grow
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, the IQ Grow team is on a mission to scale new, high-impact go-to-market initiatives. By combining the cutting-edge innovation of AI agentic solutions with human-in-the-loop workflows and touchpoints, we are redefining how restaurants connect with their guests. Our goal is to deliver a truly personalized marketing experience that empowers Toast customers to build lasting relationships, drive engagement and grow their businesses. If you're excited about pioneering at the intersection of advanced AI and human-centered design to make a real-world impact, we’d love to have you on the team! You will be a key part of a high-impact, high-ownership engineering team solving complex challenges in a fast-moving product space. Your engineering leadership will be balancing technical excellence alongside a strong product mindset to solve for continuous growth within both the team and our product space.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build and maintain high performing, flexible, and scalable solutions that help restaurants deliver a best-in-class guest experience
  • Ship features end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring for success and iterating based on real-world use
  • Be an awesome teammate who's all in on collaboration and collective success
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design and Engineering stakeholders
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and up-level the team through design reviews, constructive feedback, and agent-assisted engineering practices

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of backend/full-stack experience, delivering products that drive impact
  • Ability to read and integrate with frontend applications; showing curiosity to work across the stack when needed
  • Excited about AI-assisted development and LLM-based agents (Claude Code or similar), and interested in pioneering new workflows with the team
  • Effectively works with ambiguity, agile delivery, and shipping usable software incrementally
  • Passionate about making users happy and seeing people use your product in the wild
  • Strong on software development fundamentals — code quality, unit tests, clean code — and open to evolving your workflow with AI tooling
  • Strong collaboration skills: you communicate clearly with engineers, product, and business stakeholders, and adapt technical detail to the audience
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset: you seek feedback, embrace change, and want to grow toward broader ownership

Our Tech Stack

  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services
  • React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.
  • Android app built in Java & Kotlin running in the restaurant
  • Claude Code and similar AI agentic development tools as part of daily engineering
  • PostgreSQL and DynamoDB as core persistence
  • And many more technologies that help us build a top class platform.

**This is a hybrid role requiring in-office collaboration two days per week in our Dublin office.**

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more:

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: .

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.
