title: AVP Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

  • Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
  • Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
  • Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a AVP Software Engineer at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as a AVP Software Engineer , you should have experience with:

  • Strong proficiency in UiPath. Understanding of platform, orchestrator, asset management, performance management.

  • Deep understanding of process automation, RPA architecture and design patterns.

  • Good Engineering experience with large-scale automations

  • Should have experience with REST APIs, SOAP services, Web services integration.

  • Ability to use existing RPA and Machine Learning knowledge to rapidly learn how to develop automations using other tools including home-grown solutions.

  • Should have experience in version control, release management, automation performance monitoring, Incident handling, RCA.

  • Good understanding of infrastructure – virtual machines, credential vaults, active directory.

 

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  • Working knowledge of Blue Prism.

  • Experience on development in-house automation tools.

  • Exposure to Machine learning, OCR, and AI.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to lead mid-size technical teams and mentor junior developers.

  • Exposure to service management.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering is required.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Chennai.

title: Electrical Technician - Weekend Shift Arden, NC
description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ARS PDCAD division is currently seeking an Electrical Technician - Weekend Shift Arden, NC.

The hourly rate for this position is $26.50-30.00 per hour with a shift differential of 11.12% for the weekend shift.

The shift hours are Friday-Sunday (7am -7pm).

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

Eaton’s Power Distribution and Control Assemblies is currently seeking a Electrical Technician I to join our team. This position is based at our Arden, NC facility.
The Electrical Technician I position is a key role in the final inspection and functional testing of Eaton’s products. As a Electrical Technician I you will create a test plan, electronically / electrically test, and inspect electrical components and connections in various applications; (structures, units, panels, panel-boards, component parts, controls, and assemblies) in order to verify correct product function. At times you will need to perform troubleshooting and complete or document needed repairs prior to shipping. The ability to follow diagrams, schematics, and various work instructions in line with engineered specifications, including test and working procedures will allow you to be productive in this role.
In this role, you will:
• Follow verbal and written instructions, drawings, and specifications to set up, inspect, and test equipment.
• Perform mechanical, electrical, insulation, and sequence testing; inspect assemblies, panels, and components for quality and functionality.
• Troubleshoot test failures, determine root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with Engineering, Quality, and supervision.
• Verify customer orders for completeness and support customer inspectors during testing and inspection activities.
• Recommend and support improvements to assembly, wiring, calibration, testing procedures, and ensure required changes and repairs are completed.
• Maintain test equipment, calibration status, records, and reports.
• Comply with all safety, PPE, hygiene, and housekeeping requirements.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Required (Basic) Qualifications:
• Requires a high school diploma /GED from an accredited institution.
• Minimum 2 years’ work experience working in power distribution or electrical distribution.
• Previous experience in troubleshooting complex electrical circuits.
• Able to read and interpret electrical schematics.
• Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
• No relocation benefit is being offered for this position. Only candidates within a 50-mile radius of the work location will be considered. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Associate’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Technology/Engineering / Electromechanical / Mechatronics or related field
• 1 year of reading and interpreting schematics
• Previous experience working with open and energized electrical equipment in a testing environment

title: Project Manager, Electrical
description:
Adven on dynaaminen energiakonserni ja yhdessä 600 työntekijämme kanssa tarjoamme teollisuudelle resurssitehokkuutta edistäviä höyryntuotannon, lämmityksen, jäähdytyksen ja infrastruktuurin palveluja sekä kotitalouksille ja yrityksille kaukolämpöä ja suurkiinteistöille geoenergiaa. Meillä on yli 50 vuoden pitkä ja vankka kokemus energia-alalta ja tällä hetkellä noin 350 toimipaikkaa eri Pohjoismaissa ja Baltian maissa.

Etsimme sähköistyksen projektipäällikköä liittymään osaksi Advenin projektitiimiä ja johtamaan uusiutuviin energiaratkaisuihin pohjautuvia investointiprojektejamme.

Projektitiimimme vastaa kymmenistä teollisuuden ja kiinteistötoimialan investointihankkeista, joiden yhteenlaskettu arvo voi olla kymmeniä miljoonia euroja. Teemme työmme ammattitaitoisesti ja huolellisesti – aina asiakkaan tarpeet ja energiatehokkuuden tavoitteet edellä. Projektitiimimme varmistaa, että energialaitos tai -ratkaisu rakennetaan konseptisuunnitelman mukaisesti.

Tiimimme tekee läheistä yhteistyötä operatiivisen organisaatiomme kanssa varmistaakseen, että laitos toimii suunnitellusti ja täyttää niin asiakkaan nykyiset kuin tulevatkin tarpeet. Rakennushankkeet toteutetaan verkostomaisesti tiiviissä yhteistyössä suunnitteluyritysten ja laitetoimittajien kanssa, joten hyvät projektiviestintätaidot ovat myös tärkeässä roolissa.

Sähköistyksen projektipäällikkönä vastaat pääasiassa teollisuuden suurien laitosprojektien sähköistyksestä, sekä mahdollisuuksien mukaan yksittäisten projektien kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta. Lisäksi toimit asiantuntijana sähköistyksen osalta projektien suunnittelussa ja toteutuksessa. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä suunnittelijoiden, teknologiatoimittajien, urakoitsijoiden, asiakkaiden ja muiden advenilaisten kanssa varmistaen, että projektit etenevät suunnitellusti ja laadukkaasti.

Osallistut asiantuntijana myös investointihankkeiden kustannusten, aikataulujen ja teknisen konseptin arviointiin jo projektien myyntivaiheessa – erityisesti sähköistyksen näkökulmasta.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee Advenin Vantaan pääkonttorilla, mutta myös muut Advenin toimipisteet voivat tulla kyseeseen (Jyväskylä, Oulu, Seinäjoki). Teemme töitä joustavasti hybridimallilla (toimistolla, työmailla, tuotantolaitoksilla ja etänä). Tehtävä vaatii lisäksi jonkin verran matkustamista.

Menestyäksesi tehtävässä odotamme sinulta

  • kokemusta teollisuuden investointiprojekteista (esim. voimalaitokset, elintarviketeollisuus, metsäteollisuus)

  • vahvaa sähköteknistä osaamista ja kokemusta suurjännitejärjestelmien ylätason suunnittelusta, hankinnoista ja rakennuttamisesta

  • projektinhallinta- ja projektinjohtamisosaamista

  • tehtävään soveltuvaa insinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin koulutusta

  • oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja yhteistyökykyistä työotetta

Arvostamme lisäksi halua kehittää toimintaa. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan aidosti siihen, miten energiaratkaisuja toteutetaan tulevaisuudessa.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • vastuullisen ja keskeisen roolin kasvavassa, kansainvälisessä yrityksessä

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisissa projekteissa

  • tiiviin ja osaavan projektitiimin tuen sekä vapauden ja vastuun tehdä päätöksiä työarjessa

  • mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa hiilineutraalia tulevaisuutta yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa

Hakeminen

Lähetä CV:si ja hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen 28.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme prosessissa heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää tehtävästä tai rekrytointiprosessista, voit olla yhteydessä rekrytoivaan esihenkilöön: Jaakko Tiittanen, jaakko.tiittanen@adven.com, +358 40 842 6425, tavoitettavissa:

torstaina 17.9. klo 13-15.30 ja
perjantaina 25.9. klo 8-11

title: Junior QA Engineer
description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world’s most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com

DXC Vietnam has been recognized as one of the "Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2025" by HR Asia Magazine, highlighting its exceptional HR practices and 31-year legacy in the country. The company also earned the special "Most Caring Company Award" in 2025 for prioritizing employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive workplace culture.

We are seeking a Junior QA Engineer (Manual + Automation) to ensure product quality across web and mobile applications. This role is manual‑testing focused but requires hands‑on experience with test automation to support regression and improve testing efficiency.

You will be responsible for the full defect lifecycle using Jira, work closely with cross‑functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, and maintain and execute automated test scripts using Katalon Studio and/or TestComplete. Basic API testing using Postman/Katalon is also part of the role.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements and create detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Execute manual testing including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT for web and mobile applications.
  • Log, track, and manage defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps and proper prioritization.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, BAs, and Product Owners in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Perform and support test automation activities, including:
  • Maintaining and executing automated test scripts using Katalon Studio and/or TestComplete
  • Updating object repositories / name mapping
  • Creating small reusable keywords, functions, or scripts
  • Conduct basic API testing using Postman or Katalon (REST).
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, documentation, and test data management.

Job Requirements

  • 2 years of experience in QA testing, with strong exposure to manual testing (functional, regression, integration).
  • Solid understanding of SDLC/STLC and QA best practices.
  • Hands‑on experience with test automation is required, specifically:
  • Katalon Studio (Groovy/Java – basic custom keywords)
  • and/or TestComplete (JavaScript / VBScript / Python – small functions, name mapping)
  • Experience with API testing (Postman / REST); basic SQL knowledge is an advantage.
  • English Intermediate (INT); good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Detail‑oriented, analytical, and willing to balance manual testing with automation tasks.

Nice to have:

  • Git, Jenkins / Azure DevOps
  • Test management & reporting tools (Xray, Zephyr)

Employee Benefits and Perks

At DXC Vietnam, we follow a people‑first philosophy, offering competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support your professional growth and personal well‑being.

  • Attractive and competitive salary package

  • Full salary‑based contributions to Social Insurance, Health Insurance, and Unemployment Insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law

  • 13th‑month salary (guaranteed)

  • Generous leave policy: 12 annual leave days, 6 personal leave days, 1 volunteer leave day, plus sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and childcare leave.

  • Premium Healthcare Insurance (1+1) for employees and dependents

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential 1:1 consultation for physical and mental well‑being to support you and your family

  • Access to the Well‑being Hub covering health, mental wellness, and financial planning

  • Extensive resources to support your onboarding and continual development including DXC University and sponsorship for professional certification exams.

  • DXC Recognition, our global virtual platform that fosters a culture of appreciation and celebration with real-time reward and recognition

  • Opportunities to work on global projects, collaborate with international teams, and explore overseas assignments or relocation

  • Special allowances and gifts (English/Japanese language allowance, wedding gifts, newborn gifts, etc.)

  • Annual team activities and company events

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment that promotes knowledge sharing and continuous growth

How to Apply & Our Commitment to You

If you would like to be part of a culture that drives innovation, delivers results, rewards performance, and encourages ideas, please click “Apply Now” to submit your resume.

In return, we are committed to providing a hiring experience that is transparent, fair, and engaging. Interviews and onboarding are conducted online as part of DXC’s virtual‑first approach to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DXC Technology is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and celebrate diversity as a source of strength. We believe in bringing your whole self to work, and our company grows only when our people grow.

Reasonable accommodation for qualified candidates may be made in accordance with the DXC Accommodation Policy, including support for individuals with physical and mental disabilities.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer - Vice President
description:
The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.

title: Project Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for the management of microelectronics and optoelectronics product projects within the defence sector. This includes planning and implementing production capacity to meet increased customer order requirements, delivering cost-reduction and process-improvement initiatives through continuous improvement methodologies such as LEAN and Kaizen, and managing current and future component obsolescence strategies, including Integrated Logistics Support (ILS).

The role will act as a key customer interface and will be responsible for reporting through quarterly business reviews, weekly work-in-progress tracking, Failure Reporting, Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS), delivery schedules, capacity plans, quality control audits, repairs, and returns.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Provide project leadership for high-reliability and defence contracts, including planning and defining scope, directing and coordinating project activities, and reporting on complex, high-visibility projects.
  • Maintain overall accountability for tracking, reporting, and forecasting project performance against approved schedule and budget baselines, both internally and with customers.
  • Manage new product development and product redesign projects in accordance with the SCL product design process.
  • Chair and present project gate reviews from initial kick-off through to production handover, including the management of any necessary qualification activities.
  • Act as a key customer interface, supporting regular customer meetings and providing accurate and timely project reports.
  • Assist in the management of changes to project scope, schedules, and costs using appropriate verification techniques, ensuring project plans remain accurate, current, and reflective of authorised changes.
  • Ensure adherence to internal project management processes, including the use of Earned Value reporting as part of the monthly reporting process.
  • Prepare and submit appropriate customer documentation, including Project Management Plans, project schedules, and other documentation required as part of the deliverable data pack.
  • Support bids and proposals as required, including bid management and the definition and development of project budgets.
  • Populate, maintain, and score project risk registers, including defining and implementing appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
  • Complete project optimisation activities with a focus on inventory metrics, cost understanding, capacity planning, lead-time reduction, and on-time delivery through projects and programmes that continuously improve Site operational performance.
  • Understand, plan, and implement production processes and equipment to meet required production volumes.
  • Work with the Process Engineering Manager to identify appropriate solutions, evaluate necessary trade-offs, and complete the qualification of production lines and processes required to meet customer demand.

OTHER JOB FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the effective transition of projects from initial kick-off through to production handover.
  • Coordinate with relevant internal functions to ensure project objectives, qualification requirements, production volumes, and customer commitments are achieved.
  • Support continuous improvement and cost-reduction activities using methodologies such as LEAN and Kaizen.
  • Manage current and future component obsolescence strategies, including relevant Integrated Logistics Support activities.
  • Support quarterly business reviews and provide regular updates on work in progress, FRACAS activities, delivery schedules, production capacity, quality control audits, repairs, and returns.
  • Maintain project documentation and reporting in accordance with internal processes, contractual requirements, and customer expectations.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties relevant to the role, as requested by the line manager.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

  • Degree-level qualification in Engineering, such as a BEng, or a similar relevant technical discipline.

Experience:

  • Experience managing projects with values of up to £10 million.
  • Experience in project planning and scheduling.
  • Experience in Earned Value Management.
  • Experience in risk management, including risk identification, scoring, mitigation, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning tools within a project environment.
  • Experience planning for production and supporting the implementation or qualification of production processes and equipment.
  • Understanding of the relevant industry, including applicable standards and requirements.
  • Strong leadership, teamwork, initiative, and conflict-management capabilities.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Formal Project Management training or certification, such as PRINCE2, Project Management Institute certification, or a similar recognised qualification.
  • Knowledge and experience of working for, or with, Prime organisations.
  • Knowledge of planning and implementing production capacity within a technical manufacturing environment.
  • Experience within the defence, high-reliability, microelectronics, or optoelectronics sectors.
  • Understanding of continuous improvement methodologies, including LEAN and Kaizen.
  • A willingness to continue learning and developing professionally.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Project planning and scheduling.
  • Earned Value Management.
  • Leadership.
  • Risk management.
  • Initiative and sound decision-making.
  • Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability to manage conflict effectively.
  • Customer and stakeholder management.
  • Budget management and financial forecasting.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to manage complex, high-visibility projects.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Other Requirements

  • You must be eligible for full security clearance.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier, customer, or project engagement.

title: Call for Talent-Team Leader -Action for Learning Programme (GOAL), Pakistan
description:
Overview

Oxford Policy Management (OPM) is seeking a Team Lead on a fixed-term basis, subject to the successful outcome of its bid for the anticipated Girls and Out-of-School Children: Action for Learning Programme (GOAL) in Pakistan. The anticipated duration of the programme is 37 months.

The position would be located in Pakistan- Lahore, Islamabad or Peshawar

We are an international development consultancy working to improve lives through sustainable policy change in low- and middle-income countries. Our vision is for fair public policy that benefits both people and the planet.

Through our global network of offices, we work in partnership with national stakeholders and decision makers to research, design, implement, and evaluate impactful public policy. We draw on our local and international sector experts to provide the very best evidence-based support. We deliver projects with expert knowledge and experience and can be relied upon for excellence in all aspects of project delivery. We work collaboratively, with ambition, to help deliver impactful public policy that will bring about lasting change.

Position Summary

The Team Lead will provide overall strategic, technical and operational leadership to the anticipated Girls and Out-of-School Children: Action for Learning Programme (GOAL) in Pakistan. The role will lead the provision of politically informed technical assistance to provincial education systems, with primary focus on Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), alongside targeted scoping and engagement in Sindh.

The Team Lead will be responsible for ensuring that technical assistance is coherent, politically informed, evidence-based, adaptive and responsive to the priorities and institutional realities of provincial education systems. The role will provide strategic direction to the programme team, build effective relationships with government and other stakeholders, and ensure that interventions contribute to sustained improvements in inclusive and quality education.

The position will provide leadership across the programme's key areas of work, including foundational learning, inclusive education, teacher professionalisation, education governance and accountability, and education financing and public financial management (PFM).

The responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Provide overall strategic, technical and operational leadership to the GOAL programme, ensuring coherent delivery across Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and, where relevant, Sindh.
  • Provide strategic direction and oversight to politically informed technical assistance supporting inclusive, quality education, foundational learning, teacher professionalisation, governance and education financing.
  • Build and maintain strong, constructive relationships with government stakeholders, including senior policy and political counterparts, and effectively influence and build consensus around education reforms.
  • Ensure technical assistance is contextually appropriate, politically informed and impartial, reflecting the institutional, political and socio-cultural realities of Pakistan and the different provincial contexts.
  • Provide strategic oversight of education financing and PFM reforms, including strengthening complex financial management systems, processes and flows.
  • Lead the programme's approach to research, evidence, adaptive learning and continuous improvement, ensuring learning informs strategy and implementation.
  • Lead, motivate and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of technical experts, ensuring collaboration, technical quality and effective delivery across workstreams.
  • Identify and manage strategic, political and operational risks, adapting programme approaches in response to changing circumstances and emerging opportunities.
  • Represent the programme with government, donors, development partners and other key stakeholders, providing credible technical and strategic leadership.
  • Ensure delivery of agreed programme results, quality standards and contractual requirements, with a strong focus on sustainability, government ownership and systems change.

Key Qualifications / Experience / Skills / Behaviours

  • Advanced degree in education, public policy, public administration, international development, economics or a related field.
  • At least 15 years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience leading complex education or education systems reform programmes in developing-country contexts.
  • Proven experience providing strategic leadership and technical direction to multidisciplinary teams and complex technical assistance programmes.
  • Demonstrated experience working effectively with government at senior policy and political levels, with strong influencing, negotiation and consensus-building skills.
  • Strong understanding of Pakistan's education system and reform context, particularly in Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, with knowledge of Sindh.
  • Proven experience in education financing and public financial management (PFM), including strengthening complex financial management systems and processes.
  • Demonstrated experience applying political economy, research, evidence and adaptive learning to programme design and implementation.
  • Strong technical credibility, political awareness and ability to lead education technical assistance impartially and constructively.

Our Offer

Whether you join us in a corporate position, as a project delivery colleague, or as an independent contractor driving programme management - at OPM you will find a company that places equal value on excellence and integrity. As a leading international development consulting firm, we strive to enable and empower everyone who works with us to do their best work in an environment that welcomes ambition, creativity and passion for positive change.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

We strongly believe in a fairer distribution of power between all stakeholders, and we commit to reflecting this in our organisational structures and in the design and delivery of our projects. We proactively work to evolve ourselves and our stakeholders to shape inclusive and fair programming, implementation, and policies. Our recruitment and procurement processes reflect our ambition to make the international development sector more diverse and inclusive.

Application

If you share our vision for fair public policy that benefits both people and planet, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application through our careers’ site by the closing date. We review and interview applicants on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply by way of CV via our careers site at the earliest.

title: Senior, Apparel Designer, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of Nike’s fastest-moving product engines, enabling designers to connect quickly and effectively with consumers across Greater China. As part of the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to local marketplaces and consumer audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. The Local Creation team’s mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while extending consumer favorites and serving local consumers with products that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and work independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Apparel Designer to join our dynamic, fast-paced design team. Based in Shanghai, China, this role will work closely with cross-functional partners across Design, Product Management, Development, Merchandising, and Marketing. The ideal candidate is a senior-level designer with apparel industry experience who can design and execute products in line with our brand standards. They will create apparel across a range of Greater China consumer, sport, and lifestyle opportunities and manage the execution of multiple categories through a hyper-local lens. This designer has a strong eye for detail, a passion for and expertise in premium craft, and the ability to create highly covetable products that connect with Greater China consumers through authentic local narratives. They can operate independently, bring the brand vision to life, foster creativity within the team, navigate ambiguity, manage multiple timelines, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to take ideas from concept through execution.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Apparel Design, Local Creation GC. You’ll collaborate closely with key functional partners throughout the product design process, including:

  • GC Apparel and Footwear Design teammates across categories

  • GC Product Management and Development teams

  • GC Merchandising and Marketing partners

  • Global Design counterparts and Nike Creative stakeholders

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Apparel Design or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

Experience:

  • 7 years of professional apparel design experience in the apparel or sports industry, with strong expertise in materials, functionality, construction, and fit for apparel products.

  • Clear understanding of apparel segments and consumer profiles across multiple dimensions, preferably with experience in the Greater China market.

  • Comprehensive understanding of apparel materials, construction, fit, tech packs, and schematic development.

  • Ability to design and execute lifestyle and performance apparel.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and adhere to timelines.

  • Excellent visual and verbal presentation skills.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts clearly and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to participate actively and effectively in the creative process and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, 3D design and AI rendering tools, and Miro.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Senior Apparel Designer, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Create apparel products that align with global creative direction, seasonal key concepts, gender strategies, franchise journeys, and geo assortments while connecting with Greater China consumers.

  • Create original product designs and refresh existing products under the guidance of Design leadership.

  • Communicate design concepts effectively, collaborate in a fast-paced environment, and incorporate trends and solutions relevant to Greater China into seasonal products.

  • Monitor prototype development and partner with Development to finalize production details, conduct fittings, and ensure execution excellence across multiple categories.

  • Participate actively and effectively in the creative process and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Champion storytelling and clearly communicate the “why” behind the work. Present concepts to internal teams, leadership, and external partners, explaining the rationale behind design decisions.

  • Manage design deliverables and project timelines, planning and executing product details, reviewing samples, resolving feasibility issues, and ensuring timely project completion.

  • Demonstrate strong trend-mining skills and a deep understanding of consumer and city trends while maintaining in-depth knowledge of Nike’s DNA.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior UI/UX Engineer with at least 5 years of hands-on experience crafting intuitive iOS and Android applications for our telecommunications platform. In this role, you will own the end-to-end mobile experience—transforming complex subscriber workflows like plan top-ups, eSIM activations, and real-time usage tracking into effortless, high-performing mobile app features.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mobile Product Design: Own the native iOS and Android design lifecycle, from user flows and wireframes to interactive prototypes and high-fidelity interfaces
  • Telecom App Workflows: Design seamless mobile-first journeys for core utility features, including instant bill payments, data package purchases, eSIM onboarding, and live support
  • User Research & Usability: Conduct user testing, A/B experiments, and mobile usability audits to validate feature designs and reduce app drop-off rates
  • Mobile Design Systems: Maintain and expand our mobile component library in compliance with iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design (Android) standards
  • Cross-Functional Handoff: Collaborate directly with Mobile Engineers (iOS/Android/Flutter) and Product Managers to ensure design fidelity and technical feasibility
  • App Performance Optimization: Leverage app analytics (e.g., user session recordings, funnel analytics) to continuously refine navigation, micro-interactions, and conversion loops

Person Specifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of dedicated UI/UX design experience for mobile applications (native iOS/Android or cross-platform), ideally within telecom, fintech, or high-volume consumer apps
  • Tooling Expertise: Expert-level skills in Figma (auto-layout, components, interactive prototyping) and mobile-focused handoff tools
  • Mobile Design Standards: Deep understanding of gesture-based navigation, touch-target standards, responsive layouts, and native platform patterns
  • Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to turn complex backend telecom logic into clean, minimal, and accessible mobile interfaces
  • Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing real-world mobile app designs, end-to-end UX rationale, and visual polish

Contract Duration - 06 months

title: Compensation Lead
description:
About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

We are seeking an experienced Compensation Lead to own the operating engine of broad-based compensation at Chainlink Labs. Reporting to the Head of Total Rewards, you will lead compensation programs across offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures, ensuring our decisions are data-backed, defensible, and easy for managers and team members to understand.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone who can move seamlessly between strategy, analytics, and execution. You will partner closely with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Ops & Tech, LTI Operations, Finance, and Legal to evolve our compensation function from execution-focused to increasingly recommendation-led.

Your impact

  • Own the execution and evolution of broad-based compensation programs, including offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures.

  • Lead global initiatives across pay equity, job architecture, workforce planning, and compensation program design.

  • Build compensation models, dashboards, and analyses that inform business and People decisions.

  • Lead benchmarking, survey participation, job matching, market pricing, and pay competitiveness analysis.

  • Review complex offers and compensation escalations across levels, functions, and global markets, providing clear recommendations

  • Partner with People Tech on our migration to Pave and the continued development of our compensation data infrastructure.

  • Design clear, accessible compensation views and resources for managers, team members, and People Partners.

  • Advise People Partners and business leaders on compensation strategy, programs, and individual decisions.

  • Translate complex compensation data and trade-offs into concise, executive-ready recommendations.

  • Use AI and modern tooling to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of compensation analysis, reporting, and communication.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of broad-based compensation experience within a fast-paced, global organization; 10+ years for consideration at the senior level.

  • Proven experience owning compensation programs across offers, promotions, compensation cycles, market pricing, and salary structures.

  • Strong compensation benchmarking and market-pricing expertise, including experience with major compensation surveys and datasets.

  • Advanced Google Sheets or Excel modelling and analytical skills; experience working with structured data is highly valued.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to turn complex compensation questions into clear options and recommendations.

  • Experience advising People Partners and senior business leaders on compensation decisions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and build scalable processes in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with teams such as People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and HRIS/People Tech.

  • A builder mindset with an interest in using data, automation, and AI to improve how compensation work gets done.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience with Pave, Workday, SQL/BigQuery, and/or benchmarking platforms such as Radford or Mercer.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, or AI environments, with exposure to equity/LTI programs, pay transparency, or job architecture.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

  • Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
  • Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
  • Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we shape it. Embark on a transformative journey as Lead Engineer , where you'll spearhead the delivery of the technology stack, using strong analytical and problem-solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions coming up with the process design of the Foundational / Consolidated and Business data Products. You will be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts, and business stakeholders.

To be successful as a Lead Engineer, you should have experience with:

  • Strong hands-on experience in Java JDK 17+ & REST (Open Api).

  • Proficiency in Angular, React JS, Java scripting and HTML & J Unit 5, Integration testing and Acceptance Testing and associated libraries.

  • Strong exposure of TDD software development practices.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms, especially AWS or OpenShift.

  • Practical knowledge and hands‑on experience with AI-powered development tools such as Copilot, Claude Code, and GitLab Duo.

  • Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript skills with proficiency in React & experience using Gradle, ideally with Kotlin DSL.

  • Proficiency with Docker & CI/CD automation experience (Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus Repository) & understanding of container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.

  • Experience with data messaging platforms like Apache Kafka.

  • Familiarity with data analytics platforms and tools such as Spark and Elasticsearch & Scrum Master experience.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  • A self-starter with good communication & and stakeholder management skills.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring or leading small development teams.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The location of the role is Pune, IN.

policies, processes and practices for the identification, assessment, reporting, mitigation

and control of operational risk. Within this context, C-ORM acts as an independent risk

management function responsible for ensuring the Bank has an effective operational risk

management program to support our risk behaviours of Own It, Raise It and Know It and manage risk within the Bank's risk appetite.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role will provide a broad range of risk analysis, reporting, monitoring and support to business partner requests and act as a specialist/expert in providing advice on a range of risk related matters within the Issues Management team. The role involves conducting data quality checks and thematic analysis of issue data and drafting reporting insights to inform senior leadership of key themes and potential areas of concern. The successful candidate should possess strong analytical thinking and attention to detail skills as these reports are presented at various senior committees within the organization.

We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned

below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Participate fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure timely communication of issues/ points of interest

title: Tekninen kiinteistönhoitaja, Helsinki
description:
Coor on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kiinteistöpalvelualan yrityksistä. Coor Suomen kiinteistöhuoltoliiketoiminnan palveluksessa työskentelee yhteensä yli 150 ammattilaista erilaisissa kiinteistöjen yllä- ja kunnossapidon tehtävissä sekä ulkoalueiden hoidossa useilla eri paikkakunnilla Hangosta Rovaniemelle. Tutustu kiinteistönhoitajan työhön Coorissa tarkemmin täällä. Liity sinäkin mukaan kasvavaan porukkaamme rakentamaan entistä parempia kiinteistöpalveluita!

Etsimme nyt teknistä kiinteistönhoitajaa Helsinkiin!

Työsuhde: vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (37,5 h/viikko)

Aloitus: sopimuksen mukaan

Työvuorot: arkisin klo 7-16 välillä

Asiakaskohteisiimme kuuluu Helsingin keskustan arvohotelleja ja etsimme nyt tiimiimme uutta kiinteistöhuollon luottohenkilöä vastaamaan hotellien sujuvasta arjesta. Tehtävässä vastaat alueesi kiinteistöjen teknisten järjestelmien, kuten lämmitys-, ilmanvaihto-, vesi- ja automaatiojärjestelmien seurannasta, valvonnasta ja säädöistä. Työhösi sisältyy vikojen syiden paikantamista, pienten vikojen korjaamista sekä monipuolisesti erilaisia kiinteistöjen hoitoon ja ylläpitoon liittyviä tehtäviä. Toivomme, että sinulla on päivystysvalmiutta, kun olet perehtynyt asiakaskohteisiin.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Coorin tiimien lisäksi asiakaskohteiden henkilökunnan kanssa ja huolehdit sujuvasta yhteydenpidosta kiinteistöjen käyttäjiin.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas- ja virike-edun, mahdollisuuden liittyä vapaaehtoiseen sairauskassaan sekä laajan työterveyshuollon - Kattavan perehdytyksen kohteisiin, työturvallisuuteen ja Coorin toimintatapoihin - Työn luotettavassa ja vakaassa yrityksessä - Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi - Kannustavan työyhteisön, jossa ajatuksiasi ja ideoitasi arvostetaan
Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme tiiviiseen tiimiimme sinua, kiinteistöhuollon ammattilainen. Sinulla on silmää hyvälle asiakaspalvelulle, olet ylpeä osaamisestasi ja osaat jakaa sitä myös muille.

Lisäksi odotamme sinulta:

- Aikaisempaa työkokemusta liike- tai hotellikiinteistöistä - Kiinteistöhuollon ammattitutkintoa - Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa - B-ajokorttia
Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään huumausainetestaus ja suppea turvallisuusselvitys. Tarvitset tehtävässä työturvallisuus- ja tulityökortin, mutta koulutukset voidaan järjestää myös työsuhteen alkaessa.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Lähetä meille hakemus täyttämällä hakulomake nettisivuillamme. Luemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Tutustu tarkemmin rekrytointiprosessiimme nettisivuillamme.

title: Product Management - Summer 2027 Corporate Internship
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.


DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

As a Product Management Intern, you will look to discover, understand, and communicate product management methodologies and frameworks to create intuitive, loveable products. Interns will work in a fast-paced, lean environment, collaborating closely with other interns, as well as full-time Product designers, product managers, and software engineers.

We are looking for people with hybrid talents who are curious, passionate about problem solving, and can drive successful product outcomes in support of our customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities:


Strategy – You will learn the following while working with a Product Management coach:


• Use data to identify customer pain points
• Participate in sessions to identify the right problems
• Participate in prioritizing problems for best business outcomes
• Gather & analyze market data inclusive of creating competitive analyses, bench market or SWOT presentations
• Participate in identifying patterns in data & build expanded research models
• Create & present reports on findings, defects, improvements, statuses & risk management
• Use decision support tools to weigh the competing factors for prioritization of backlog
• Contribute to team discovery efforts

Execution – You will learn the following while working on a Product Team


• Tasked with key projects & provides support to more senior-level Product Managers
• Scoping & prioritization of tasks that are assigned to you
• Perform validation for production releases, bug fixes & feature requests
• Troubleshoot defects, participate in root cause analysis & find solutions for resolution
• Work on specific features, improving them & creating new ones upon instruction
• Participate in Agile ceremonies, including planning, grooming, demos & retrospectives
• Write user stories to articulate work to be done by Engineering that support outcome delivery
• Work closely with engineering to ensure delivery of products map to customer experience & business requirements within needed timelines

Key Deliverables of a Product Manager at DICK’S Sporting Goods


• Stakeholder Relationship Management
• Competitive Gap Analysis & Benchmarking
• Product Data Analysis & Reporting
• Writing & Grooming User Stories
• User Acceptance Testing


Some of your experiences will include:


• Multi-day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your teammates
• Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as develop your business acumen and office professionalism
• Extensive exposure to our senior leadership through our exclusive intern only Executive Speaker Series which includes a private meet & greet with our CEO
• Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events
• Working a 40-hour work week, Monday – Friday

Skills we are looking for:


• A foundational understanding of Product Management
• Ability to balance business objectives and customer needs
• Strong deductive reasoning skills
• A customer-centric view into developing great product experiences
• Ability to distill complex technical concepts into plain language for stakeholders
• Strong curiosity when it comes to using new tools, adopting new technology, and learning new product management frameworks that will progress your professional development
• Dynamic written and verbal communication style, as well as the ability to communicate cross-functionally and vertically throughout the organization
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and outcome-oriented environment

We look for potential candidates with:


• Attending an accredited university, college or technical school
• Graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring 2028
• An undergrad or Master’s degree in Product Management, Business, Technology or related field

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027
Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:


Interns qualified for full-time opportunities will be evaluated at the end of the program. Qualified interns will be placed into a full-time Technology Development Program.

Perks:

  • Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*

  • Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG

  • Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.

  • Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th

  • Teammate Discount

  • Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office

  • Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks

  • Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders

  • Executive Speaker Series

  • Professional development

  • Volunteer opportunities

  • Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. title: Lead - LME, Delhi
description:
Role: Lead - LME, Delhi
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Salary: upto 22 LPA
Reporting to: Director – Research
Location: New Delhi / Flexible with frequent travel to project sites across India
__________________________________________________________
Role Overview
We are looking for a data-driven leader to manage our national and state-level Learning, Monitoring, and Evaluation (LME) strategy. This role is responsible for establishing robust M&E frameworks, managing multi-tier database systems, and building real-time data visualisations to drive adaptive program management and strengthen government partnerships.
The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on technical skills in data collection and analytics with strategic experience in large-scale public systems.

Key Responsibilities
1. Lead & Oversee LME Strategy and Decision-Making
  • Framework Development: Design and manage national and state-specific LME frameworks, ensuring core indicators capture reach, dosage, and fidelity of implementation.
  • Real-Time Monitoring: Oversee multi-state data collection workflows to ensure accurate, timely, and actionable data on program expansion and field activity.
  • Learning Reviews: Lead routine data reflection cycles (every 3–6 months) with leadership and field teams to translate monitoring trends into operational and strategic course corrections.
  • Evaluative Studies: Collaborate with research teams and government partners to execute longitudinal and evaluative protocols assessing both individual and system-level outcomes.
2. Systems, Architecture & Dashboard Design
  • Tiered Database Management: Build and manage scalable databases structured around multi-tier public administration hierarchies (e.g., School → District → State → National level).
  • Tailored Data Visualization: Design dual-purpose visual analytics platforms:
    • Detailed Dashboards: Granular, operational views for internal monitoring and program teams.
    • Simplified Dashboards: Executive summaries and clean, high-level views tailored for government officials and school leaders.
  • Data Integrity: Implement validation rules and automated workflows to ensure data quality and completeness across large-scale field collections.
3. Capacity Building & Field Enablement
  • Non-Technical Training: Design and execute practical training programs to help non-technical field staff, trainers, and district coordinators enter, review, and act on data.
  • Tool Suitability: Develop and validate contextual assessment tools (e.g., Master Trainer assessment protocols) suited for specific field training contexts.
Required Technical Capabilities & Qualifications
1. Data Collection & Field Tools
  • Hands-on Expertise: Proficiency in building, deploying, and managing forms on ODK (Open Data Kit) or KoboToolbox.
  • Lightweight Workflows: Proven experience integrating Google Forms and Google Sheets (via scripts, formulas, or third-party connectors) for quick deployments with smaller field teams.
  • UX for First-Time Users: Demonstrated experience designing digital data collection interfaces for users with low digital literacy (e.g., government school staff, field enumerators).
2. Analytics & Statistical Modeling
  • Advanced Spreadsheet Skills: Expertise in Excel (advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, power queries, data models).
  • Statistical Packages: Hands-on experience executing complex statistical analyses in SPSS, R, or Stata.
  • Core Metrics: Deep understanding of tracking implementation metrics, including reach, dosage, and fidelity.
3. Dashboards & Visualization
  • BI Platforms: Hands-on experience developing interactive dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
  • Web-Based Analytics: Experience creating lightweight visual reports in Google Looker Studio (Data Studio).
  • Multi-Tier UI Design: Ability to present the same dataset in two distinct layouts: deep-dive operational dashboards vs. high-level executive summaries.
4. Database Architecture & Government Systems Exposure
  • Scale & Hierarchy: Track record of managing databases tracking hundreds of schools, districts, and teachers across multiple states.
  • Government MIS Familiarity: Direct experience or strong working knowledge of government education management information systems like UDISE+ or similar state/national public databases.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Experience: 10+ to 15+ years of experience in LME, data systems architecture, or research operations within social development or public systems.
  • Education: Master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Social Work, or related quantitative field required; M.Phil/Ph.D. preferred.

Step 1: HR Interview Round
Step 2: Assignment
Step 3: Technical Round of interview
Step 4: Final Interview

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med digital og/eller trykt produktion, gerne fra et bureau eller en tilsvarende produktionsafdeling.

  • Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk.

Om WPP Media

WPP Media er WPP's globale mediebureau. I en verden, hvor medier er overalt og i alt, samler vi de bedste platforme, mennesker og partnere for at skabe grænseløse muligheder for vækst.

  • Vær optimistisk ved at fremme vækst og udvikling for at mobilisere virksomheden.

Udover spændende arbejdsopgaver og et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø, tilbyder vi frokostordning, selvvalgt arbejdstelefon, arbejdscomputer, sundhedsforsikring, favorable barselsvilkår, tilbud om coach og uddannelse, globalt netværk og meget mere.

  • Respond to change notices, customer‑requested adjustments, and development updates.
  • Support engineering, drafting, and supervision with customer‑driven development work.
  • Train and coach colleagues to support knowledge transfer and skill development.

This job posting describes the general nature and level of work being performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Other duties may be assigned as business needs require.

Qualifications:

Basic (Required):

• High school diploma or GED equivalent from an accredited institution.

Preferred:

Position Criteria

Physical Demands (with or without reasonable accommodation):

  • Must meet vision requirements, including near and far vision, depth perception, and color discrimination.
