title: Infrastructures and Maintenance Officer (m/f/d - 6 months contract) - Bénin
description:
PLEASE KINDLY NOTE BEFORE APPLYING

  • This position is based in Cotonou (Benin) for the first 3 months then in Lome (Togo) for the last 3 months ;

  • 6 months temporary local contract offered ;

  • Fluent in written and spoken English & French - mandatory ;

  • Open to working overtime and weekends, basically be on site everyday from start to finish ;

  • Open to travel in the West African region.

WHO ARE WE ?

CAPAGO is a French provider of outsourcing services for European governments and their diplomatic missions, responsible for financing and managing visa application centers to process their Schengen visa applications.

We currently operate in 9 countries, and welcome more than 500,000 visa applicants each year.

As part of our development, we are looking to strengthen our Infrastructures department by seeking an Infrastructures and Maintenance Officer, for our affiliate in Cotonou (Benin).

You will report directly to the Infrastructures Supervisor and the Infrastructures Director.

INTRODUCTION

The main mission of the Infrastructures and Maintenance Officer within the Infrastructures Department at Capago is to manage, execute, and coordinate all necessary tasks to open, run, maintain, and secure the physical infrastructures of Capago offices and Visa Application Centres (VACs).

This role combines hands-on technical maintenance, facility upkeep, and project execution support to ensure operational efficiency, minimize downtime, and deliver a safe, compliant, and high-standard environment for both staff and visa applicants.

Operating in a fast-paced project and operational environment, the Infrastructures and Maintenance Officer ensures all facilities strictly adhere to Capago’s established standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. New Infrastructure Projects & Opening Support:

  • Assist in planning and executing the opening, fit-out, and renovation of new Capago infrastructures ;

  • Shortlist construction companies, signage vendors, and local suppliers in alignment with procurement guidelines ;

  • Distribute layout plans to contractors and conduct on-site follow-ups with construction companies, artisans, and signage vendors ;

  • Manage the safekeeping and logistics tracking of materials and equipment, both in transit and on-site ;

  • Supervise the installation of furniture, signage, partition layouts, alarms, fire-fighting equipment, and biometric cabins/equipment with relevant authorities ;

  • Support the Drafting process by preparing or updating layout plans (Partitioning, Demolition, Electrical, Flooring, Wall/Ceiling finishes, HVAC, Lighting, Furniture, Joinery, CCTV, and Security Devices).

  1. Routine Maintenance, Technical Repairs & Handyman Operations:

  • Perform daily hands-on routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs across electricity, light plumbing, painting, furniture upkeep, locks, doors, and general handyman tasks ;

  • Inspect, diagnose, and resolve technical issues related to lighting, air conditioning (HVAC), water, LAN cabling, and utility systems ;

  • Respond promptly to maintenance requests, operational breakdowns, and emergencies to minimize disruption to center activities ;

  • Safely maintain and manage all department tools, equipment, workshop areas, and spare parts inventory.

  1. Preventive Maintenance & Facility Audits:

  • Implement and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all building systems and equipment across Visa Application Centres ;

  • Conduct regular site inspections and audits to identify wear, damage, or safety hazards, ensuring full alignment with Capago corporate standards ;

  • Maintain logs of completed maintenance, track equipment life cycles, and suggest proactive improvements to extend facility assets.

  1. Maintenance Desk Management & VAC Support:

  • Handle and resolve tickets and queries submitted to the central Maintenance Desk from Visa Application Centres (covering electrical, plumbing, painting, furniture, signage, LAN cabling, doors, etc.) ;

  • Ensure all centers are maintained in optimal working condition with a clean, professional, and neat overall look and feel ;

  • Liaise directly with Operations Managers to resolve facility issues and support operational updates as Capago evolves.

  1. Safety, HSE & Compliance:

  • Adhere strictly to Occupational Health and Safety (HSE) standards and local building regulations ;

  • Ensure physical security systems (CCTV, alarms, fire safety, access control) remain fully operational at all times ;

  • Promptly report hazards, structural issues, or regulatory non-compliance to management.

  1. Administration, Logistics & Reporting:

  • Collaborate with the Procurement Department for ordering tools, supplies, and external contractor services ;

  • Monitor contractor performance on-site for specialized or major repair works ;

  • Keep detailed track of mission expenditures, compile receipts, and submit accurate expense reports to the Finance Department ;

  • Provide regular follow-up reports, activity logs, and progress updates to line management and collaborating departments.

DIPLOMA & EXPERIENCE

  • You have a Bachelor in electrical engineering, or civil engineering ;

  • Experience in project management in construction fit out for offices ;

  • You have 3 to 5 years of experience in the same position.

COMPETENCIES

Hard Skills (Technical & Operational Competencies):

  • Technical Trade Skills: Strong hands-on technical skills in the electrical field, with working knowledge of light plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, painting, and general facility repairs ;

  • Drafting & Layouts: Ability to read, interpret, and produce basic drafting plans (electrical, layout, HVAC, CCTV, furniture packs) ;

  • Technical Software & Tech Literacy: Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive), online ticketing/helpdesk systems, and reporting software ;

  • Tool & Equipment Handling: Practical mastery of maintenance tools, diagnostic equipment, and safety gear ;

  • HSE Knowledge: Practical understanding of occupational health and safety standards and building regulations ;

  • Good and professional management and coordination of on-site contractors to meet deadlines ;

  • Provide regular and transparent of the onsite work by reports ;

  • Open to working overtime and weekends, basically be on site everyday from start to finish ;

  • Open to travel in WAF region : 3 first months in Benin, then the 3 last months in Togo.

Soft Skills (Behavioral & Interpersonal Competencies):

  • Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Fast diagnostic ability, solution-oriented mindset, and practical troubleshooting skills ;

  • Communication & Collaboration: Clear verbal and written communication with internal teams, Operations, landlords, and third-party vendors ;

  • Time Management & Autonomy: Ability to work independently, prioritize urgent maintenance tickets, and manage multiple tasks efficiently ;

  • Negotiation Skills: Ability to review vendor quotes and coordinate effectively with local contractors ;

  • Mobility & Sense of Direction: High geographical mobility for multi-site visits, audits, and hands-on site interventions ;

  • Creativity & Adaptability: Ability to find practical, cost-effective solutions in a fast-changing project environment.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Committed to diversity and inclusion, we ensure an accessible recruitment process for everyone. We particularly encourage applications from people with disabilities.

title: Keittiömestari, Antell Stella, Espoo
description:
Haemme lounasravintolaamme ammattitaitoista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja iloista Keittiömestaria.

Olet lounaan ja edustusruuan monipuolinen ja vahva osaaja, joka seuraa aktiivisesti alan trendejä ja haluaa olla kehittämässä tulevaisuuden ruokapalveluita. Innostut uusista ideoista ja uskallat kokeilla rohkeasti uutta – niin keittiössä kuin palveluissa.

Sinulla on henkilöstöjohtamistaitoja sekä loistava palveluasenne. Johdat keittiötiimiä innostavasti ja osallistavasti, ja rakennat yhdessä heidän kanssaan toimivaa arkea ja erinomaista asiakaskokemusta. Haluat olla mukana jatkuvasti kehittämässä keittiön toimintaa ja palveluita.

Vastuullasi on ruokalistojen suunnittelu, raaka-aineiden hankinnat ja tehokas käyttö, sekä keittiön töiden johtaminen osallistuen keittiön päivittäisiin käytännön töihin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä ravintola- ja asiakaspalvelupäällikön kanssa tarjousten laatimisessa sekä vitriini- ja edustustuotteiden kehittämisessä – tavoitteena tyytyväiset asiakkaat ja hyvä liiketoiminnallinen tulos.

Toivomme, että sinulla on alan esimieskoulutus, vahva kokemus tehokkaasta raaka-ainekäytöstä, kokemusta keittiömestarin tehtävistä sekä vahva osaaminen kokous- ja edustustarjoiluista. Sinulta löytyy intohimoa ja näkemystä hyvän ruoan ja palvelun tekemiseen sekä taloudellista ajattelutapaa. Olet asiakaslähtöinen ja vahva tiimipelaaja, jolla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja kyky toimia tehokkaasti myös paineen alla. Olet tottunut käyttämään erilaisia työssä tarvittavia järjestelmiä ja pystyt omaksumaan uusia nopeasti. Edellytämme hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työtehtävän, ja saat tueksesi lämminhenkisen ja välittävän työyhteisön. Innostumme teknologioista, jotka auttavat arjessamme, joten saat ammattitaitosi rinnalle myös nykyaikaiset työkalut. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

- monipuolisen päivätyön herkullisia makunautintoja hakevien asiakkaiden parissa
- osaamisen ja tehtävänmukaisen palkan, palkitsemme myös onnistumisista
- liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hierontaedun
- lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon 24/7
- työvaatteet ja työkenkätuen
- mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja koulutuksiin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ravintolapäällikkö, yhteystiedot löydät ilmoituksen alaosasta.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille hakemuksesi sekä ansioluettelosi. Huomioithan, että aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Antell tekee aidosti hyvää! Antell tarjoaa herkullisia makunautintoja noin 60:ssä lounas- ja henkilöstöravintolassa ympäri Suomen. Arjen iloisten lounashetkien lisäksi tarjoamme asiakkaillemme ihania makuja ja elämyksiä kokouksissa ja muissa tilaisuuksissa. Haluamme olla mukana rakentamassa asiakkaidemme hyvinvointia. Osaamisemme ytimessä on monipuolinen, hyvää tekevä ja herkullinen ruoka. Syyskuusta alkaen olemme osa Sodexo-konsernia.

Löydät meidät somesta

- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/antellsuomi)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/antellsuomi)
- [LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/antell)

title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Engineering
description:
About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

Why We Do What We Do

In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.

Position Overview

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on AWS Lead Engineer to lead cloud modernization, engineering excellence, and AI-driven innovation for our Provider Payments platform. This role will work across all Provider Engineering Pods, driving scalable solutions, reusable capabilities, and modernization of healthcare payment systems while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of secure, scalable, cloud-native solutions on AWS.
  • Drive modernization of .NET applications into microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Partner across all Provider Engineering Pods to establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
  • Champion AI-driven engineering practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, observability, and operational efficiency.
  • Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Mentor engineers and promote a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes.
  • Drive operational excellence through automation, reliability engineering, and proactive monitoring.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong AWS experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
  • Deep expertise in.NET Core / .NET 6+, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and API-first development.
  • Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, and high-volume transaction systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of cloud security, authentication, authorization, and secure engineering practices.
  • Experience building highly available and resilient payment platforms.

AI-Driven Engineering Mindset

  • Passion for leveraging AI and GenAI tools to accelerate software development lifecycle activities.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering productivity.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, developer experience, and platform intelligence.
  • Drive a culture of experimentation, automation, and data-driven decision making.
  • Curiosity to continuously learn emerging AI capabilities and apply them responsibly within engineering teams.

Domain Experience

Preferred experience in:

  • Provider Payments
  • Healthcare Claims
  • Payment Integrity
  • Revenue Cycle Management
  • Healthcare Financial Platforms

Behavioral Competencies

  • Ownership mindset with strong accountability.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence across teams without direct authority.
  • Growth mindset and passion for mentoring others.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results.
  • Customer-focused with a bias for action and execution excellence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 8-12 years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in AWS and .NET technologies.
  • Experience leading cloud modernization and large-scale engineering initiatives.
  • Agile delivery experience and strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • AWS certifications preferred.

Ideal Candidate: A technology leader with deep AWS and .NET expertise, healthcare payment domain knowledge, an AI-first engineering mindset, and the ability to influence and collaborate across all Provider Engineering Pods while living Zelis' IMPACT values.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Accessibility Support

We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Mekaanikko K-Auto vaihtoautokeskukseen Vantaalle
description:
Arvostatko vaihtelevia työpäiviä ja eri automerkkien parissa työskentelyä?

Tule vahvistamaan K-Auton vaihtoautokeskuksen osaavaa tiimiä Vantaalle.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa K-Auton vaihtoautokeskukseen Vantaalle.

Vaihtoautokeskuksessa työskentelet monipuolisesti eri automerkkien ja -mallien parissa. Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat vaihtoautojen huollot, korjaukset, vikadiagnostiikka sekä ajoneuvojen kunnostaminen myyntikuntoon. Työssä pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi laajasti, sillä työskentelet jatkuvasti erilaisten autojen, tekniikoiden ja käyttövoimien parissa.

Haemme erityisesti osaajaa, jolla on kokemusta monimerkkikorjaamosta tai useiden automerkkien huollosta ja korjauksesta.

Tarjoamme sinulle
- monipuolisen työn eri automerkkien parissa - nykyaikaiset työkalut ja diagnostiikkalaitteet - kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen sekä kannustavan suoriteperusteisen palkkamallin - vakaan ja luotettavan työnantajan osana K-ryhmää - kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten henkilöstöostot K-ryhmän kaupoissa - liikunta-, hyvinvointi- ja henkilöstöedut - vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen - kattavan työterveyshuollon - mahdollisuuden kouluttautua ja kehittää ammattitaitoasi - ammattitaitoisen ja hyvähenkisen työyhteisön tuen
Odotamme sinulta
- ajoneuvoalan koulutusta tai vastaavaa käytännön kokemusta - kokemusta useiden automerkkien huolloista ja korjauksista - hyviä vikadiagnostiikka- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja - oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta - positiivista asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta - B-ajokorttia - sähkö- ja hybridiajoneuvojen tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
Miksi meille?

Meillä pääset työskentelemään jatkuvasti vaihtuvien autojen parissa. Työ sopii erinomaisesti mekaanikolle, joka nauttii monipuolisista haasteista ja haluaa hyödyntää osaamistaan laajasti eri automerkkien kanssa. Samalla saat suuren ja vakavaraisen työnantajan tarjoaman turvan, kattavat henkilöstöedut sekä mahdollisuuden pitkäjänteiseen urakehitykseen.



Tehdään hyvä kauppa – tule K-ryhmään.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Huoltopäällikkö Timo Vuori, sähköpostitse timo.vuori@k-auto.fi tai puhelimitse 050 390 5419.

Lähetä hakemuksesi 18.9.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta.

Suoritamme huumausainetestauksen koeajan aikana.



Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: EBI Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We are delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for a EBI Recovery Coordinator in Coventry. This rewarding and dynamic role is ideal for someone who is passionate about supporting others and ready to make a meaningful impact every day. You will use your skills and experience to assess, engage and empower Service Users, ensuring they access the right support at the right time, in a way that truly meets their needs.

No two days are the same in this role. Each interaction is an opportunity to inspire positive change, making flexibility, curiosity and excellent listening skills essential. If you are motivated by the chance to make a genuine difference and want to be part of a supportive team that values innovation, compassion and courage, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Where: Coventry

Full Time Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

With this role you’ll be working as part of the Brief Intervention Team, based in Coventry,

About the role:

  • Supporting service users from point of entry into the service and through their treatment/recovery journey
  • Providing screening, assessment, and recovery planning and onward referral
  • Reducing drug and alcohol related harm to service users and the wider community
  • Promoting carer, service user and community involvement
  • Providing advocacy for access to partnership services
  • Working with service users to support social (re)integration, enabling them to lead meaningful and purposeful lives: promoting recovery, resilience, peer support and self-determination
  • Research, design and prepare subject matter and materials for groups / pods.
  • Deliver structured content within group settings to service users at various stages of recovery
  • Engage with debriefing and evaluations with co-facilitators after groups/pods have taken place, reviewing progress and identifying concerns with service users
  • Tailor specific workshops around the needs of the service users.

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and experience of working within a similar field
  • Experience of working with groups/pods and managing group dynamics, such as conflict or challenging behaviour.
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills
  • Have a good working knowledge of mental health interventions, services, and good practice
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage change successfully in a way that prioritises the needs of service users
  • Understand the importance of information governance processes and commit to follow and apply all necessary safeguards
  • Seek out learning opportunities to improve and broaden your professional knowledge and skills and to contribute and oversee the learning and development of others

What we will give to you:

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Additionally, you'll receive one extra day of annual leave for each year of service during your first five years, therefore you will enjoy 30 days of leave after five years with us
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities
  • Generous Refer-a-Friend scheme

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

Direct applications only we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions. More information about eligible roles and occupations can be found here: Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If this sounds like you and you would like to begin your journey with Change Grow Live, then we would love to talk to you.

Salary Range (pro rata if part time)

CGL points 23 to 28 (£28,557.79 - £32,802.41)

ILW / OLW /Fringe

N/A - Outside London Weighting Area

Closing Date

title: Kassa-myyjä, Kokemäki (määräaikainen 12h/vko)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi keskittyy asiakaspalveluun ja kassatyöhön. Toisinaan päivään voi kuulua tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Tehtävä on 1 kuukauden mittainen määräaikainen sijaisuus. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja työaika on 12h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!



Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

- Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
- Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
- Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
- Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen - Kyky palvella asiakkaitamme suomenkielellä; hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

Heb jij overzicht en ben je een nauwkeurige en harde werker? Wij zoeken een logistiek medewerker die ons team in Dalfsen komt versterken voor 40 uur per week.

Wat PartsPoint doet

Vanuit onze PartsPoint vestigingen leveren wij onderdelen om auto’s die voor onderhoud of reparatie bij de garage staan razendsnel weer de weg op te krijgen. Al het werk dat wij doen draait om het ondersteunen van onze klant: garagisten en hun monteurs.

Wat de functie inhoudt

Onze logistiek medewerkers verwerken de inkomende en uitgaande goederenstromen. Zij picken orders, controleren pakbonnen, regelen de administratieve verwerking en handelen garanties en retouren af. Ook zorgen zij voor orde, netheid en een efficiënte inrichting van het magazijn. Het is een afwisselende functie waarin veel wordt samengewerkt met de overige teamleden.

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde vmbo opleiding.
  • Je bent in bezit van rijbewijs B (geen vereiste);
  • Je kunt werken met digitale systemen;
  • Je hebt logistiek inzicht, bent nauwkeurig en werkt goed en graag in teamverband;
  • Je bent eerlijk, betrokken en sympathiek;
  • Je woont in de omgeving van Dalfsen.

  • Je kunt gebruik maken van ons vitaliteitsprogramma, waaronder een e-bike regeling en korting op je sportschoolabonnement;

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Director, Solutions Engineering

What You Will Be Doing

In this highly strategic, individual contributor role, you will lead all technical aspects of pre-sales engagements for complex, high-value customers. You will partner closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to design tailored electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE) architectures, energy management strategies, and battery storage solutions. Success in this role means effectively bridging the gap between technical complexity and business value, ensuring seamless deployments, and positioning ChargePoint as the undisputed leader in fleet electrification and infrastructure.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Drive and manage complex technology evaluations as the primary technical authority during pre-sales customer engagements, acting as a trusted advisor for ChargePoint products and solutions.
  • Conduct comprehensive engineering site and architecture assessments, either virtually or in-person, to develop tailored recommendations for EV charging infrastructure deployments.
  • Design sophisticated solutions addressing the operational needs of light, medium, and heavy-duty fleets, incorporating vehicle charging capabilities, dwell times, routing, scheduling, and energy management.
  • Architect software API implementations and integrations between ChargePoint’s platforms and external third-party systems to meet specific customer requirements.
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations and product training to partners, customers, and internal stakeholders to articulate the value proposition of ChargePoint solutions.
  • Lead the technical response for complex Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Tenders, and partner with the sales team to craft accurate Statements of Work (SoWs) and proposals.
  • Partner with Product Management by translating customer feedback and market trends into actionable insights that help shape the product development roadmap.
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical roadblocks that could impact customer satisfaction, ensuring a smooth transition from pre-sales to deployment.
  • Maintain advanced knowledge of local electrical installation codes, EVSE standards, and industry trends surrounding battery energy storage and high-power solutions.
  • Advise customers on technical best practices and system architecture, demonstrating how to effectively integrate charging infrastructure into their broader business operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 8 years of combined experience in technical sales, technical consulting, or solutions engineering, with a proven track record of handling complex enterprise accounts.
  • Demonstrated foundational knowledge in areas such as electrical engineering, telecommunications, IT infrastructure, or software development.
  • Exceptional presentation, oral, and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical executive audiences.
  • Strong customer-facing skills with a demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships and navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • High degree of self-motivation and critical thinking, with the ability to autonomously manage time and prioritize strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% across Europe, predominantly within the UK and Ireland, to conduct site visits and client meetings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with fleet vehicle operations, routing, and scheduling logistics.
  • Working knowledge of High Power charging solutions and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
  • Experience working with large-scale facility electrical planning and energy management systems.
  • Background in technical writing for complex proposals and technical documentation.

Location

UK- Remote

description:

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Role & Responsibilities:

As a Zscaler administrator you are responsible for managing and configuring Zscaler security services, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), to ensure secure network access for users by implementing and maintaining policies like URL filtering, threat prevention, and access controls, while also monitoring for security incidents and collaborating with network and security teams to optimize the Zscaler platform within an organization's infrastructure; essentially acting as the primary point of contact for all Zscaler related operations and troubleshooting.

  • Manage user and machines access to ZPA

  • Manage IdP configurations / Administrators / Configure AppConnectors

  • Maintain User Portal and Browser Access to applications

  • Maintain ZPA policies (Access, Timeout, Client Forwarding, Isolation)

  • Manage ZIA authentication settings / IdP configurations / Administrators

  • Maintain hosted pac files / URL categories / Certificates

  • Configure and maintain SSL Inspection policies

  • Configure and maintain URL & Cloud App Control policies

  • Configure and maintain File Type Control policies

  • Manage ZDX “Standard”

  • Support Mobile Connector Portal

Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 5+ years of experience focused on Network support, configuration, and implementation.

  • 3+ years of experience in ZScaler administration.

  • Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains.

  • Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision.

  • Experience in working on Service Now.

  • Qualifications-bachelor’s degree or master’s degree.

  • Zscaler Certified (e.g., Zscaler Digital Transformation Administrator, Zscaler Digital Transformation Engineer, Zscaler Digital Experience Administrator, Zscaler Certified Professional, Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator)

Preferred Technical and Professional Certifications:

  • Cloud Security Certifications (e.g., CCSP – Certified Cloud Security Professional)

  • Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate)


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Project Manager: Data Center Delivery, Sweden
description:
Imagine a future where everyone has instant, low-cost access to intelligence. We’re building a fully featured European AI cloud - with everything one needs to train, experiment with, and deploy AI models. In addition, our GPUs run on 100% renewable energy.

We’re ambitious, curious, and gutsy doers. We practice a low hierarchy across the company and high morale in our teams. We’ve already achieved a lot, yet we’re only getting started. Now it’s your chance to join the ride. We offer more than just the job - we offer a career-defining opportunity to be part of building something big!

Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

Why Verda

  • Cash and equity compensation along with various fringe benefits (healthcare, lunch, wellbeing, and more).

  • Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

  • 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

  • A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

  • Traveling: Frequent travel required.

  • Employment type: Full-time and permanent.

About the role

You are the primary engine behind the physical expansion of our digital footprint. Your mission is to lead the end-to-end delivery of mission-critical infrastructure, ranging from large-scale greenfield build-outs to precision tenant fit-outs in global colocation facilities. You ensure that every megawatt of capacity is delivered safely, on time, and to the exacting standards required for high-density AI and cloud workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Drive projects from initial site inception and design through procurement, construction, and final commissioning.

  2. Hybrid Project Execution: Concurrently manage a diverse portfolio, balancing multi-year, large-scale builds with fast-paced colocation fit-out projects.

  3. Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Act as the central point of contact for internal engineering teams, general contractors, and colocation providers to ensure alignment on design intent and operational goals.

  4. Fit-out Precision: Oversee the installation of critical "white space" infrastructure—including power strips, overhead busways, containment systems, and liquid cooling manifolds—within active, live-data center environments.

  5. Risk & Budget Management: Proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks while maintaining rigid oversight of multi-million dollar capital budgets to prevent margin erosion.

  6. Quality & Safety Governance: Lead site walks and supervise integrated system testing (IST) to ensure all MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and CSA (Civil, Structural, Architectural) packages meet zero-downtime reliability standards.

  7. Agile Resource Allocation: Ability to shift resources and priorities rapidly between major construction sites and smaller, high-velocity fit-out initiatives.

  8. Standardization Advocate: Contribute to the development of repeatable "deployment playbooks" and handover templates to streamline global expansions.

Ideal Background

Experience: 5+ years of project management experience in mission-critical environments (e.g., data centers, semiconductors, or pharma). Technical Knowledge: Solid grasp of data center core components, specifically power distribution, high-density cooling (Air/Liquid), and structured cabling.

General Skills & Personal Characteristics

To succeed in this team, candidates must look beyond their CAD screens and embrace a high-ownership, peer-to-peer collaboration style:

  • Adaptive Problem Solvers: You don’t wait for a manual. When a 100kW rack presents a new thermal challenge, you iterate quickly and find a path forward.

  • Radical Transparency: You communicate complex technical risks clearly and early. You value "getting it right" over "being right."

  • Holistic Thinkers: Even if you are the Electrical Lead, you understand how a pipe leak affects a busbar. You design with the entire system in mind.

  • Practical Visionaries: You have the "Grand Design" in your head but keep your feet on the ground—focusing on buildability, serviceability, and cost-efficiency.

  • The "Helper Peer" Mentality: You treat your teammates as collaborators, not silos. You are willing to jump into a different discipline to help the team meet a deadline.

  • Outcome-Oriented: You aren't just "doing engineering"; you are building the foundation for the future of AI. You take pride in seeing your container go from a drawing to a humming 1MW reality.

What's next

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don’t accept applications sent by email.

title: Edustustarjoilija Dipoliin Espooseen
description:
Laumaannu kanssamme

Hei Pääkaupunkiseutu! Laumamme kaipaa edustustarjoilijaa.

Työn tiedot:
- Espoon Otaniemessä, osoitteessa Otakaari 24, Espoo.
- Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen
- Työ alkaa 5.10. tai sopimuksen mukaan
- Monipuolisen tapahtumatalon tiimissä työajat elävät asiakkaiden ja tilaisuuksien mukaan, mutta pääsääntöisesti työaika arkisin 7-19 välillä, välillä myös viikonloppuja
- Palkkaa tehtävästä maksamme kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi mukaan 2400-2600€

Palvelemme asiakkaitamme useissa eri ravintolatoiminnoissa kuten kahvilassa ja opiskelijaravintolassa ja näiden lisäksi vastaamme korkeatasoisten kokousten ja tilaisuuksien järjestämisestä Dipolin tiloissa.

Aalto yliopisto ja Dipolin asiakkaat ovat mitä mainioin asiakaskunta, laatua ja palvelua arvostavia ja omassa tekemisessään ja opiskelussaan alan huipulla. 14 hengen tiimimme on energinen ja toimintamme on mukavan muuttuvaista. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme joustavaa työkaveria, joka haluaa, että tiimimme onnistuu.

Laatu on intohimona tehtävässäsi

Edustustarjoilijana vastaat monipuolisten edustus- ja kokoustarjoilujen hoitamisesta itsenäisesti. Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi kokouskahvitusten hoitaminen ja edustuslounaiden tarjoilu. Lisäksi osallistut myös kassa- ja salityöskentelyyn sekä astiahuoltoon, puhtaanapitoon ja omavalvontaan.

Tarjolla tänään - mahtava lauma

Olemme luotettava ja vakaa työnantaja. Esihenkilösi Sanna ja koko työtiimisi varmistaa, että saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja että onnistut työssäsi.

Tarjoamme sinulle hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten:
- Työkengät kerran vuodessa
- Epassi -rahaa 150 € koeajan päätyttyä
- Henkilökunta-alennuksen tapahtumataloissa ja avoimissa ravintoloissa
- Kattavan työterveyshuollon
- Tuemme laumasi yhdessä tekemistä laumarahalla

Olemme savuton yritys.

Näillä ominaisuuksilla pärjäät tehtävässä ja hymy ei hyydy

Pidämme tärkeänä tehtävään soveltuvaa alan koulutusta ja vähintään 3 vuoden työkokemusta edustustarjoilijan tehtävistä sekä hygienia- että anniskelupassia. Olet organisointikykyinen ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn tottunut. Sinulta löytyy kokous- ja edustusosaamista sekä viinituntemusta. Hallitset yleisimät dieetit ja kassatyöskentelyn. Vati- ja a la carte tarjoilun osaaminen katsotaan eduksesi.

Kielitaitona sujuva suomen kieli ja englannin kielen taito.

Yhtenä laumana, ole hyvä!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viimeistään 23.9.2026. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja palkkaamme sopivan tekijän löydyttyä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Sanna Isopahkala, arkisin klo 14-16.

Lue meistä lisää: www.compass-group.fi

title: Head of Product - Neighbourhood & Urgent Care
description:
Join OneAdvanced

OneAdvanced is seeking a Head of Product to lead the strategy and delivery of its Neighbourhood and Urgent Care propositions within its Health & Care portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for realising the neighbourhood health strategy, connecting care around the patient, and joining up the dots across the product set.

What You Will Do

You will be responsible for owning the neighbourhood health strategy and delivering it through the product set in your remit, while working closely with other stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Own how we realise our neighbourhood health strategy, using various products to join up care around the patient.

  • Set the multi-year product direction for Neighbourhood and Urgent Care, positioned within the wider IQ Health roadmap.

  • Work alongside other Heads of Product to connect strategy across the portfolio.

  • Think differently about how established and emerging products combine, and set the direction for modernising heritage technology.

  • Own delivery for national enterprise customers, meeting large-scale commitments alongside the roadmap.

  • Balance strategy with hands-on delivery support, ensuring committed releases land against roadmap and commercial plan.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the product team across both areas.

  • Represent these products with NHS and enterprise customer stakeholders, turning clinical and market needs into a prioritised roadmap.

You will need to possess senior product leadership experience and a track record of setting and delivering multi-year product direction.

Making a Difference

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second-year running, an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: Senior Functional Consultant
description:

The role is remote-based in India and suited for a senior CLM professional who can independently lead functional workstreams, engage confidently with global stakeholders, and act as a subject matter expert for Sirion CLM.

title: Senior, Footwear Graphics Designer, Jordan, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of the fastest product engines at Nike, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting to the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. Local Creation team's mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while driving and extending consumer favorites, serving local consumers with executions that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and act independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Designer, Footwear Graphic Design, Local Creation GC who can independently create compelling, locally relevant graphic expressions across footwear products and collections.

The ideal candidate has a distinct creative voice, advanced graphic craft, strong product instincts, and a deep understanding of Greater China consumers and visual culture. They can move from insight to narrative, from narrative to graphic system, and from concept to manufacturable execution.

The Senior Designer owns complex projects and is expected to make sound decisions with limited direction. While this is not a formal people-management role, the designer should model strong creative practice, offer guidance to junior teammates, and contribute positively to team culture.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Footwear Graphic Design, Local Creation GC.

You will collaborate with:

  • GC Footwear and Apparel Design, Color & Materials, and Graphics

  • GC Product Management, Merchandising, Development, and Marketing

  • Performance category and sport partners

  • Global and Geo Design counterparts

  • Legal and intellectual property partners

  • Material developers, vendors, manufacturers, and external creative partners

  • Consumer insights and marketplace teams

  • Design Integration and digital workflow partners

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Graphic Design, Illustration, Communication Design, Footwear Design, Fashion Design, or a related field preferred.

  • Equivalent professional experience and training will be considered.

Experience and Capabilities:

  • 4+ years of relevant design experience.

  • A portfolio demonstrating advanced graphic design, visual storytelling, product application, and execution.

  • Strong knowledge of typography, illustration, branding, print, pattern, trims, color, composition, and graphic systems.

  • Strong understanding of footwear expression, graphic application methods, manufacturing, and commercialization.

  • Strong understanding of Greater China consumers, visual culture, marketplace signals, and emerging creative communities.

  • Ability to independently manage work from brief through final production.

  • Ability to translate cultural and consumer insight into design without relying on surface-level references.

  • Strong presentation and verbal communication skills.

  • Working knowledge of legal and intellectual property considerations in product graphics.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

  • Experience with 3D and AI-enabled visualization tools such as Vizcom, and collaborative tools such as Miro.

  • Ability to travel as required by the role.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Senior Designer, Footwear Graphic Design, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Own graphic design for complex GC footwear projects from initial insight through final execution.

  • Create original artwork, branding, typography, trims, prints, patterns, engineered graphics, and product details.

  • Translate Greater China consumer, sport, city, cultural, and marketplace insights into authentic graphic stories.

  • Develop clear narratives and graphic systems that can extend across individual products, collections, or head-to-toe expressions.

  • Adapt global and seasonal creative direction for the GC consumer while maintaining Nike brand integrity.

  • Establish a distinct creative point of view and explore multiple creative solutions before refining a final direction.

  • Work closely with Footwear and Apparel Color and Material, Graphic Designers to integrate graphics into the full product expression.

  • Build presentations and communicate design intent to partners and leadership.

  • Develop graphic schematics and production-ready artwork in partnership with Development.

  • Review samples, strike-offs, trims, prints, and prototypes, and resolve execution issues through commercialization.

  • Consider application method, material behavior, scale, placement, cost, legal requirements, and production feasibility.

  • Manage multiple projects, seasonal tracks, handoffs, and deadlines with growing independence.

  • Submit or support required legal and intellectual property review materials.

  • Share expertise, provide constructive critique, and help junior designers strengthen craft and product thinking.

  • Contribute to graphic libraries, templates, tools, workflows, and creative standards. Ensure appropriate review and completion of graphic schematics, artwork specifications, trim specifications, legal submissions, and related product files.

title: Senior Cyber Defense Analyst
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Kyndryl’s Security & Resiliency is one of our most critical practices, ensuring enterprises, regardless of their size and complexity, remain secure, available, reliable, and resilient. We take Cybersecurity seriously. We're not just invested; we're committed. We're not just protecting data; we're empowering. Kyndryl is committed to making the world safer, not only by investing in state-of-the-art services and technologies but also by empowering underserved communities with essential cyber skills.

When you walk through our doors, you're not only joining a team but you're also becoming part of a legacy. Welcome to Kyndryl, where Cybersecurity isn't just a job – it’s a passion; a commitment to designing, running, and managing the most modern and reliable technology infrastructure that the world depends on every day.

As a Senior Cyber Defense Analyst at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in protecting customers and Kyndryl environments through cybersecurity operations, incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, detection engineering, and security investigations. Unlike traditional Security Operations Center (SOC) environments, this role owns investigations from start to finish, giving you the opportunity to manage the full lifecycle of an incident from initial alert triage through investigation, containment, remediation, and recovery.

In this role, you won't just monitor alerts; you'll actively investigate and respond to cyber threats across complex enterprise environments. You will leverage your experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, endpoint detection capabilities, and security telemetry to identify, analyze, and respond to threats. Whether conducting threat hunting activities, building detections, or performing digital forensic investigations, your expertise will be instrumental in strengthening our cyber defense capabilities.

Your responsibilities go beyond operational monitoring. You will develop and tune detections, write and optimize security queries, perform proactive threat hunting, and conduct detailed investigations into suspicious activity and security incidents. You will collaborate with security professionals across the organization, applying investigative techniques and threat intelligence to identify indicators of compromise and emerging threats before they become material risks.

In Cybersecurity Defense at Kyndryl, you’re not just protecting the present – you’re shaping the future of digital security.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Proven experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat hunting, or cyber defense roles.

  • Hands-on experience managing security incidents through the full investigation lifecycle, from alert triage to remediation and closure.

  • Experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic, LogRhythm, or similar technologies.

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills with the ability to identify, analyze, and respond to complex cyber threats.

  • Experience in detection engineering, including creating, tuning, and optimizing detections and security analytics.

  • Experience conducting proactive threat hunting and leveraging threat intelligence to identify indicators of compromise (IOCs).

  • Knowledge of digital forensics techniques and experience investigating endpoint and/or network-based security incidents.

  • Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash is highly desirable.

  • Experience with Palo Alto technologies, particularly XDR, is advantageous but not required.

Your Future at Kyndryl

When you join Kyndryl, you're not just joining a company – you're entering a space of opportunities. Our partnerships with industry alliances and vendors mean you'll have access to skilling and certification programs needed to excel in Security & Resiliency, while simultaneously supporting your personal growth. Whether you envision your career path as a technical leader within cybersecurity, an incident response specialist, a threat hunting expert, or transition into other technical, consulting, or go-to-market roles – we’re invested in your journey.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

title: Myyntipäällikkö Vantaalle Tuupakkaan
description:
Haluaisitko hyödyntää enemmän osaamistasi autokaupassa? Haetko uusia haasteita ja haluatko kehittyä ihmisten johtajana sekä autokaupan ja myynnin osaajana entisestään?


Oletko energinen, tavoitteellinen ja terveellä tavalla kunnianhimoinen? Löytyykö sinulta aitoa paloa autokauppaan ja halu saada tiimisi onnistumaan?

Haemme nyt myyntipäällikköä Vantaan Tuupakan suurmyymäläämme. Tule rakentamaan Bilarin kasvutarinaa kanssamme!

Haemme myyntipäällikköä

Myyntipäällikkönä olet Vantaan Tuupakan suurmyymälän kapteeni. Johdat 16 hengen myyntitiimiä ja vastaat koko myymälän päivittäisen toiminnan, myynnin ja tuloksen johtamisesta. Tässä roolissa pääset johtamaan merkittävää kokonaisuutta ja vaikuttamaan suoraan yrityksen ja myymäläsi menestykseen.

Tehtäväsi on monipuolinen ja vastuullinen. Johdat myymälän operatiivista toimintaa jämäkästi ja ihmisläheisesti sekä varmistat, että arki toimii ja tavoitteet saavutetaan. Vahvat tukitoiminnot auttavat sinua pääsemään asetettuihin tavoitteisiin. Työpäiväsi koostuvat muun muassa varastonhallinnasta, autojen hinnoittelusta, kouluttamisesta, valmentavasta johtamisesta ja motivoinnista. Lisäksi vastaat työvuoroista, kehityskeskusteluista, rekrytoinneista ja perehdyttämisestä.

Menestyt myyntipäällikkönä, jos sinulla on loistavat vuorovaikutustaidot, rohkeutta tehdä nopeitakin päätöksiä sekä kyky hahmottaa ja hallita laajoja kokonaisuuksia. Olet organisointikykyinen, määrätietoinen ja tavoitteellinen sekä mukaudut nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Samalla ymmärrät, että parhaat tulokset syntyvät ihmisten kautta. Johdat tiimiäsi suoraselkäisesti ja ihmisläheisesti.

Tarjoamme ketterän ja joustavan työympäristön, jossa pääset itse myös paljon vaikuttamaan. Positiivisen ja tavoitteellisen asenteen lisäksi meille on tärkeää ennen kaikkea asiakaskokemuksen ymmärrys ja yrityksen arvojen sisäistäminen. Asiakaslähtöisyys ja henkilöstötyytyväisyys ovat toimintamme keskiössä ja kohtelemme jokaista ihmistä lupauksemme mukaisesti siten, että jokainen voi kokea aidosti olevansa meille tärkeä. Tässä olemme myös mitatusti onnistuneet: olemme valtakunnallisesti alan parhaimmistoa.

Aikaisempi kokemus autokaupasta on tehtävässä välttämätön. Työskentelet esimerkiksi automyyjänä tai myyntipäällikkönä, olet ollut vastuussa päivittäin autojen hinnoittelusta ja sinulla on näyttöä menestyksekkäästä automyynnistä.

Aloitusajankohta on sovittavissa, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.


Miksi minun kannattaisi hakea töihin juuri Bilar99:lle?

❤️ Pääset töihin tavoitteelliseen ja kunnianhimoiseen porukkaan, jossa jokainen pyrkii parhaisiin mahdollisiin tuloksiin yhdessä. Välillämme on sisäistä leikkimielistä kilpailua, joka synnyttää hyviä tuloksia myyntityössä.

🏆 Olemme Great Place to Work -sertifioitu™ työpaikka! Peräti 90 % työntekijöistämme pitää meitä loistavana työpaikkana ja suosittelevat meitä. Tämä arvostettu tunnustus perustuu henkilöstötutkimukseen, jossa korostuvat tiimihenki, avoimuus ja mahdollisuudet kehittyä.

🤝 Meillä on matala hierarkia ja avoin ilmapiiri, jossa jaetaan tietoa ja tuetaan toisiaan. Työkaverit ovat helposti lähestyttäviä ja yhteistyö sujuu mutkattomasti. Hyväksymme myös sen, että joskus sattuu virheitä – yhdessä korjataan ja mietitään, mitä niistä opitaan.

🚀 Haluamme, että meillä jokainen työntekijä pääsee kasvamaan ammattilaisena. Tarjoamme aina työsuhteen alkuun perusteellisen perehdytyksen. Kun kokemuksesi karttuu ja tahtotilaa riittää, edessäsi on kiinnostava urapolku kasvuyrityksessä.

💰Todella kannustava palkkaus, jossa onnistumiset näkyvät suoraan tililläsi. Palkkauksesi muodostuu pohjapalkasta ja provisioista. Keskimäärin myyntipäälliköidemme kuukausipalkat liikkuvat yli 5000 euron tasolla, ja tuloksekkaalla tekemisellä kokonaisansiot voivat nousta 8000-15 000 euroon kuukaudessa. Työsuhteen alussa on myös takuupalkka. Lisäksi saat vapaan autoedun palkan päälle.

🚤 Lisäksi saat meiltä kattavat työsuhde-edut kuten lounas- ja virike-edun, pyöräedun, auton ostoedun, yhteisiä palloiluvuoroja sekä mahdollisuuden käyttää firman veneitä. Osa eduista tulee voimaan 6 kuukauden jälkeen koeajan loputtua.

Kuulostaa hyvältä! Entä mitä toivoisitte minulta?


✅ Vahvaa kokemusta tuloksekkaasta myyntityöstä autokaupassa.

✅ Olet aktiivinen ja tavoitteellinen tekijä. Olet valmis käärimään hihat ja menemään tavoitteita kohti rohkeasti.

✅ Olet helposti lähestyttävä, sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, positiivinen asenne ja innostava ote tekemiseen.

✅ Sinulla on vahva oppimishalu ja kyky omaksua uutta sekä kehittää omaa ja tiimisi tekemistä.

✅ Aikaisempi esihenkilökokemus katsotaan eduksi.

Kiinnostuin! Miten haku etenee?

✅ Hakuaika päättyy 27.9.2026 mutta käymme läpi hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.

✅ Jos vaikutat porukkaamme sopivalta tekijältä, kutsumme sinut haastatteluun.

✅ Seuraavaksi tapaat myynninjohdon työhaastattelun merkeissä.

✅ Hakuajan päättymisen jälkeen ilmoitamme kaikille hakijoille valinnoista.

Anna persoonasi näkyä hakemuksessa! Haluamme tutustua sinuun sellaisena kuin olet. Kerro meille omin sanoin, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä kiinnostaa sinua. Hakemuksen ei tarvitse olla täydellinen tai viimeisen päälle hiottu – tärkeintä on, että siitä välittyy, kuka olet.

Henkilökuntamme on autoalan terävintä kärkeä. Jos olet valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen urallasi ja liittymään dynaamiseen tiimiimme, haluamme kuulla sinusta!


Tervetuloa Bilarille!

title: Associate II, Quality Operations
description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Quality & Regulatory Affairs function, a team that ensures our products are in compliance with global, local, and internal regulations and meet the strictest standards of quality as we help people see brilliantly.

The Associate II, Quality Operations (Professional Path) is primarily responsible for managing complex quality processes, leading investigations, and contributing to advanced quality management initiatives. This role supports product quality monitoring, non-conformance resolution, CAPA management, compliance activities, and continuous improvement efforts across manufacturing and distribution operations while applying advanced quality systems knowledge.

Specifics Include:

  • Handle complex tasks and contribute to advanced quality management projects within manufacturing and distribution processes

  • Make independent decisions within assigned project areas to drive quality outcomes and operational effectiveness

  • Monitor product quality throughout various stages of manufacturing and distribution and ensure timely resolution of non-conformances

  • Lead and document investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, and quality events in accordance with established procedures

  • Conduct thorough root cause analyses utilizing appropriate methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Analysis, FMEA, and other problem-solving tools

  • Develop, implement, and monitor corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans to mitigate risk, prevent recurrence, and improve process performance

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure effective investigations and sustainable CAPA implementation

  • Communicate investigation status, findings, risks, and scope updates to leadership and key stakeholders

  • Prepare and present investigation reports, CAPA summaries, and supporting documentation for management reviews and regulatory inspections

  • Maintain accurate quality records and documentation in compliance with Good Practice (GxP) regulations and internal procedures

  • Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), training requirements, and applicable industry regulations

  • Participate in internal and external audits, providing quality system support, CAPA documentation, and responses as required

  • Analyze quality data and trends to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and enhanced process performance

  • Conduct independent research and apply critical thinking to support quality initiatives and optimize business outcomes

  • Meet individual performance expectations while contributing to organizational quality and compliance objectives

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +8 yrs; Assoc.+4 yrs)

  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English

  • Work Hours: Monday – Friday: 8:00 AM CST – 5:00 PM CST

  • Travel Requirements: 0%

  • Location: Onsite

  • Sponsorship & Relocation: Not Available

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:

  • Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves!

  • See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities!

  • Join Alcon’s mission to provide outstanding, innovative products and solutions to improve sight, improve lives, and grow your career!
