Job Description

We encourage candidates to apply to no more than three internship opportunities within a 90-day period. Our recruiting team will review your application and ensure you are considered for the opportunities that best align with your skills and interests.

There’s something really inspiring about the idea of innovators teaming up to build something incredible. If you agree, then you might be a perfect fit for a tech job at Cox!

Across the Cox family of businesses (Cox Enterprises, Cox Communications and Cox Automotive), we’re looking for Software Development Interns to join our team and learn from the best. Ready to collaborate with us and work at a great company that truly cares about you and your future? Keep reading!

What’s In It For You?

  • We value your time and potential. At Cox, you’ll be exposed to meaningful and challenging work.

  • You won’t be left alone to figure things out. You’ll have a team of supporters (plus an assigned program mentor) who will show you the ropes, guide you to excellence and cheer you on.

  • You’ll experience real accountability to develop your professional skills.

  • You’ll expand your network and professional toolbox through exposure to senior leaders.

  • You’ll help us build a bold future that is sustainable, accessible and inclusive.

What You’ll Do

You’ll develop and manage enterprise platforms, deployment pipelines, security and quality monitoring. You’ll also develop tools to automate tasks and maintain new and existing infrastructure platforms on public and private clouds. Responsibilities will include:

  • Developing automation for infrastructure provisioning and procedures, configuration management and ongoing support processes to be used across all environments.

  • Documenting new development, procedures or test plans as needed.

  • Helping develop and following best practices, security and engineering standards.

  • Building tools and pipelines needed to facilitate continuous integration and delivery of software to all environments.

  • Automating code packaging, code deployment and configuration management processes to be used across all environments.

  • Soliciting feedback from delivery and operations teams about continuous integration and delivery challenges and working with them to identify opportunities to optimize software engineering throughput and quality.

  • Tracking system and service performance continuously in all environments and escalates to the appropriate team.

Inquisitive. Logical. Dependable. These are just a few words that describe you. You love a good challenge and are happiest when you’re solving problems. You have the following qualifications:

  • A passion for technology, reverse engineering and writing code to create solutions and fix problems.

  • A collaborative attitude and the ability to clearly articulate thoughts and processes with both verbal and written communication in one-on-one and group settings.

  • Experience with Windows and Linux systems, containers and databases.

  • Experience with source code, build, deploy, orchestration and configuration management tools.

  • Experience in writing code and scripts in at least one high-level programming language.

  • An eye to identify and a desire to resolve insufficiencies and manual activities via automation.

  • Familiarity with public cloud architecture and technologies, preferably AWS.

  • Familiarity with Agile concepts and processes (Scrum and Kanban).

  • An interest in building and continuously improving secure and resilient applications at scale.

  • An interest in gathering data and measuring the progress on what makes applications perform.

  • Familiarity with AI tools that assist in producing, testing, and automating tasks in software development and deployment.

title: Yleislääkäri Loimaan ikääntyneiden arviointiyksikköön 4.1.-31.12.2027
description:
Hei [yleislääkäri], tule osaksi Solon kaveriporukkaa!


Haemme lääkäriä Loimaan sote-keskukseen, ikääntyneiden arviointiyksikköön ajalle 4.1.2027-31.12.2027.


Työyksikkö ja työtehtävät
Arviointiyksikössä ikääntyneiden palvelu- ja kuntoutustarpeita arvioidaan moniammatillisesti. Lääkäri toimii osana tätä tiimiä.

Edellytämme sinulta
- Yleislääkärin pätevyyttä
-Kokemusta perusterveydenhuollosta
- Tartuntatautilain 48§ mukaista rokotussuojaa
- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Työaika ja korvaus
Työaika on 38,25h/vko, työtä tehdään arkisin virka-ajan puitteissa. Työ on lähityötä, mutta 1pv/vko on mahdollisuus tehdä etätyönä.

Miksi tämä on loistava tilaisuus?
ePassi etu 400 €/vuosi – Käytettävissä liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointipalveluihin (työsuhteissa, jotka kestävät vähintään 60 työvuoroa)
Työterveys – Hyvinvointiasi tukevat työterveyspalvelut
Vahva tuki ja yhteisö – Et jää yksin! Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, vastuulääkärien tuen sekä kannustavan ja osaavan työyhteisön ympärillesi
Hyvä ja motivoiva palkka – Panostamme reiluun ja motivoivaan palkkaukseen
Mahdollisuus kehittyä – Tarjoamme koulutusrahan, joka kasvaa tehtyjen työtuntiesi myötä
Uusia ovia urallesi – Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia

Mikä on Solo Health?
Olemme suomalainen, mutkattomasti toimiva porukka. Meillä hommat etenevät nopeasti ja ilman turhia välikäsiä – yhteyshenkilösi tuntee sinut nimeltä ja vastaa kysymyksiisi selkeästi. Tunnemme sote-alan arjen ja ymmärrämme, että elämässäsi on muutakin kuin työ: välillä haluat tehdä töitä enemmän, joskus vähemmän. Olemme mukana joustavasti silloin, kun sinulle sopii.

Työllistämme lääkäreitä, hoitajia, psykologeja ja sosiaalityöntekijöitä moninaisiin sosiaali- ja terveysalan tehtäviin ympäri Suomen – myös hiljaisessa haussa oleviin työpaikkoihin, joita et löydä muualta. Vuonna 2019 perustettu Solo Health on Suomen nopeimmin kasvava sote-alan toimija. Vuonna 2025 lähes 800 sote-ammattilaista toimi erilaisissa tehtävissä Solon kautta.

Olemme luotettava ja joustava kumppani julkiselle sektorille sekä pienissä palvelukokonaisuuksissa että laajoissa ulkoistuksissa. Panostamme palveluidemme laatuun, vaikuttavuuteen ja henkilöstömme ammattitaitoon.

Ihmiset ovat toimintamme ydin. Tarjoamme säännöllistä koulutusta ja tukea työhyvinvointiin, mistä kertoo poikkeuksellisen korkea henkilöstötyytyväisyytemme (NPS 70). Meillä ammattilaiset viihtyvät ja voivat työskennellä eettisesti sekä laadukkaasti.

Solo Health on terveydenhuollon paras työkaveri, joka tuntee alan haasteet ja pitää huolta ihmisistä.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae viimeistään [päivämäärä].

Heräsikö kysyttävää?
Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työhön liittyen, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä:
Senior Aluepäällikkö Irina Nordblom
044 700 29 11
irina.nordblom@solohealth.fi

They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Step into a role of FCS Training Analyst , where you will take responsibility for client service and operational execution task. You must take responsibility for controlling risk and enhancing controls in connection to your job and areas of responsibility in accordance with rules and regulations.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja
description:
Perustuuko työsi kasvatusoptimismiin, positiiviseen työotteeseen ja yhteisöllisyyden periaatteeseen? Haluatko työskennellä kunnassa, jossa kuuluu lapsen ääni?

Etsimme sinua

Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja

Varhaiskasvatuksen ammattilaisten joukkoon Vihtiin toteuttamaan laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta oppivassa yhteisössä. Vihdin kunnassa on avoinna määräaikainen varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajan tehtävä ajalla 28.9-23.12.2026. Tehtävä on 50% normaali työajasta ja työpäivät ovat ma-ke. Tehtävän ensimmäinen sijoituspaikka on Hiidenrannan päiväkoti.

Päiväkodeissamme on työhönsä sitoutunut, innostunut ja motivoitunut henkilöstö. Varhaiskasvatuksessamme on vahva yhdessä toimimisen ja positiivisen pedagogiikan kulttuuri. Keskeisiä arvojamme ovat lapsen arvostava kohtaaminen ja lämmin vuorovaikutus. Työtäsi tukee varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja, esiopetuksen kuraattori ja monialaisten toimijoiden yhteistyöverkosto.

Hiidenrannan 6-ryhmäinen päiväkoti sijaitsee Hiidenveden läheisyydessä rauhallisessa ympäristössä. Hyödynnämme päiväkodin monipuolista lähiympäristöä ja luontokohteita osana oppimisympäristöämme. Toimintamme lähtökohtia ovat huoltajien, lasten ja henkilöstön yhteisöllinen ja osallisuutta korostava arki. Henkilöstömme sitoutuneisuus luo pohjaa hyvälle ja rakentavalle yhteistyölle perheiden kanssa. Toimimme pääosin pienryhmissä. Pienryhmätoiminta mahdollistaa lasten yksilöllisten tarpeiden huomioimisen. Pidämme tärkeänä leikkiä ja sen merkitystä lasten hyvinvoinnille ja oppimiselle. Leikki tuottaa lapsille iloa ja mielihyvää. Pedagogisessa toiminnassamme tavoitteena on oppiva ja hyvinvoiva lapsi.

Hiidenrannan päiväkodissa tarjoamme lapsille turvallisen yhteisön kasvaa ja kehittyä.

Odotamme sinulta yhteistyötaitoja ja yhteisöllisyyteen sitoutumista. Arvostamme erityisesti sensitiivisyyttäsi lapsen vuorovaikutuksessa ja moninaisuuden kohtaamisessa. Viihdyt meillä, mikäli koet tärkeäksi jokaisen lapsen ymmärtämisen ja läsnä olevan vuorovaikutuksen sekä itsesi kehittämisen.
Kelpoisuus työsuhteeseen määräytyy varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukaisesti. Työsuhteeseen valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetussa laissa (504/2002) tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Suunnitelmallisen perehdytyksen
- Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja läsnäolevan esihenkilön
- Erinomaiset koulutusmahdollisuudet oman osaamisesi kehittämiseen
- Henkilöstöetuina mm. ePassilla liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalveluita, BREAK PRO taukoliikuntaohjelman, alennuksia vihtiläisistä yrityksistä
- Työterveyshuollon palvelut
- Työhöntulotarkastuksen työterveydessä
- Kunta-alan lomaetuudet

Lisätietoja: Päiväkodin johtaja Heidi Kanerva, p. 040 677 1223, heidi.kanerva@vihti.fi

title: Perheneuvojan virka
description:
Haluatko kohdata perheitä, pareja ja yksilöitä elämän käännekohdissa? Oletko valmis tekemään tavoitteellista terapiatyötä ja viemään kirkon perheneuvontaa eteenpäin osana osaavaa, toisiaan tukevaa ja työtään yhdessä kehittävää tiimiä viihtyisissä ja toimivissa työtiloissa vanhassa pappilassa?

Hyvinkään seurakunnan perheasiain neuvottelukeskuksessa on haettavana perheneuvojan virka, joka täytetään 7.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtäviin kuuluu perheneuvontatyö perheiden, parien ja yksilöiden kanssa, ryhmien ohjaaminen sekä ennaltaehkäisevä työ.

Työlläsi on merkitystä. Hyvinkään seurakunnan perheneuvonnassa tuet aikuisia yksilöitä ja pareja erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa. Työsi tukee samalla myös lasten, nuorten ja perheiden hyvinvointia. Perheneuvonta on arvostettu osa alueen tuki- ja auttamistyötä. Tarjoamme työpaikan pienessä ja asiantuntevassa työyhteisössä, jossa yhdistyvät itsenäinen työ, kollegiaalinen tuki ja mahdollisuus kehittää toimintaa yhdessä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:

- tehtävään soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa
- Suomenevankelisluterilaisenkirkon järjestämää perheneuvonnan - erityiskoulutusta tai valmiutta sitoutua sen suorittamiseen
- valmiutta ryhmien ohjaamiseen
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja verkostoitumistaitoja
- taitoa käydä hoidollisia keskusteluja digitaalisessa ympäristössä
- pari- ja psykoterapeuttista osaamista

Arvostamme:

- valmiutta tehdä terapiatyötä englanniksi
- kokemusta kirkon perheneuvontatyöstäja ymmärrystä sielunhoidollisesta työotteesta
- taitoa viestiä parisuhteen ja perheen teemoista digitaalisessa ympäristössä ja tuottaa perheneuvonnan sisältö someviestimiin
- ymmärrystä ennaltaehkäisevän työstä

Virkaan valitun tulee olla Suomenevankelisluterilaisenkirkon konfirmoitu jäsen. Virkaan valitun tulee ennen viran vastaanottamista esittää hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus.

Virka täytetään 7.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Virkapaikka on Pappilankatu 14 Hyvinkää. Virassa on kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaika. title: Liikunnan ja terveystiedon lehtori (422041)
description:
LIIKUNNAN JA TERVEYSTIEDON OPETTAJA, määräaikainen virka

Nurmijärven Yhteiskouluun ajalle 28.9.2026–31.7.2027

Nurmijärvi – paremman arjen ilmiö

Nurmijärvi on reilun 44 000 asukkaan kasvukunta, joka sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä pääkaupunkiseudun välittömässä läheisyydessä. Koulutuspalveluissa työskentelee noin 600 kasvatus- ja opetusalan ammattilaista.

Oletko sinä uusi ilmiöntekijä?

Koulutuspalvelut hakee määräaikaiseen palvelussuhteeseen ajalle 28.9.2026–31.7.2027

LIIKUNNAN JA TERVEYSTIEDON OPETTAJAA
Nurmijärven Yhteiskouluun

Tule osaavaan joukkoomme tekemään kanssamme laadukasta ja ajanmukaista perusopetusta. Haemme yhteistyökykyistä, kehittymismyönteistä ja positiivisen työotteen omaavaa pedagogia, joka haluaa innostaa nuoria liikkumaan, huolehtimaan hyvinvoinnistaan ja löytämään omia tapojaan aktiiviseen ja tasapainoiseen arkeen.

Nurmijärven Yhteiskoulu on vuonna 1929 perustettu perinteikäs mutta aktiivisesti kehittyvä yläkoulu. Noin 390 nuorta ja noin 60 aikuista muodostavat yhteisön, jossa oppiminen, hyvinvointi ja yhdessä tekeminen kulkevat käsi kädessä.

Tänä lukuvuonna yksi keskeisistä kehittämisteemoistamme on liikunnallisempi ja hyvinvointia tukeva koulupäivä. Olemme lisänneet koulupäivään pitkiä välitunteja, toimintaa ja työpajoja sekä mahdollisuuksia liikkua ja tehdä yhdessä. Tavoitteena on vähentää paikallaanoloa, vahvistaa oppilaiden osallisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä sekä rakentaa koulupäivästä kokonaisuus, joka tukee sekä oppimista että hyvinvointia.

Haemme opettajaa, joka haluaa olla tässä työssä aktiivisesti mukana. Arvostamme kykyä innostaa myös niitä nuoria, joille liikunta ei ole ennestään luonteva osa elämää, sekä kiinnostusta käsitellä hyvinvointia nuorten omaan arkeen liittyvällä, keskustelevalla ja osallistavalla tavalla. Liikkumisen lisäksi meille tärkeitä teemoja ovat esimerkiksi uni ja palautuminen, mielen hyvinvointi, sosiaaliset suhteet, arjen rytmi sekä digilaitteiden vaikutukset hyvinvointiin.

Toivomme hakijalta vahvaa pedagogista otetta, kykyä kohdata yläkouluikäisiä nuoria lämpimästi ja jämäkästi sekä halua tehdä yhteistyötä muiden koulun aikuisten kanssa. Meillä asioita kehitetään yhdessä, ja uuden opettajan omille ajatuksille ja osaamiselle on tilaa.

Tehtävä sisältää pääasiassa liikunnan ja terveystiedon opetusta vuosiluokilla 7–9 sekä joitakin lukion liikunnan kursseja. Opetuksen tarkempi jakautuminen määräytyy lukuvuoden työjärjestyksen mukaan. Tehtävän opetusvelvollisuus määräytyy opetettavien aineiden mukaisesti.

Viran kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen nro 986/1998 mukaisesti. Kelpoisten hakijoiden lisäksi huomioimme tarvittaessa myös hakijat, joilla on tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, osaamista ja kokemusta.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen, OVTESin, mukaan. Palvelussuhteeseen valitun tulee toimittaa lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan yhden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Kiinnostuitko? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Nurmijärven Yhteiskoulun rehtori Mikko Jordman, puh. 040 317 4158.

Voit tutustua kouluun osoitteessa:
https://www.nurmijarvi.fi/koulut/nurmijarven-yhteiskoulu/

Hakuaika päättyy 22.9.2026 klo 16.00. Tehtävään haetaan sähköisesti. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä. Haastattelut järjestetään välittömästi hakuajan päätyttyä.

Odotamme yhteydenottoasi – tule rakentamaan kanssamme liikkuvampaa ja hyvinvoivaa koulupäivää!

title: LCA Analyst
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Principal Responsibilities:

  • Life Cycle Assessment: Conduct comprehensive life cycle assessments (LCA) for products and processes, including data collection, modeling, and analysis.

  • Data Management: Ensure all LCA data is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible. Regularly update LCA databases with new data and revisions.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with product development teams, sustainability experts, and other stakeholders to understand LCA requirements and integrate them into the product development process.

  • Quality Assurance: Conduct regular audits of LCA data and reports to ensure data integrity and consistency. Address and resolve any discrepancies or issues.

  • Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation for LCA processes, including usage guidelines and best practices.

  • Tool Proficiency: Utilize and manage LCA software tools (e.g., SimaPro or One Click LCA) for conducting assessments and managing data.

  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members on LCA methodologies, data collection, and software tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Sustainability, Environmental Science, or a related field.

  • 3-5 years of experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), EPD development or product sustainability analysis.

  • Experience using LCA software such as SimaPro (preferred) or One Click LCA tools.

  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Must-Have Competencies

Sustainability & LCA

  • Strong understanding of ISO 14040 and ISO 14044 standards.

  • Knowledge of EN 15804, ISO 14025, ISO 21930, and EPD development requirements.

  • Experience performing environmental impact assessments and interpreting results.

  • Understanding of manufacturing processes, product life cycles and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

AI & Digital Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI platforms. Proven ability to design, develop, and implement agentic AI applications and intelligent AI agents.

  • Ability to effectively use AI to improve data analysis, reporting, documentation and workflow efficiency.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Experience working with large datasets and product information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power Automate, or Power Apps.

  • Experience integrating sustainability data with ERP/SAP systems and other engineering platform.

  • Familiarity with water technologies, industrial equipment, pumps, or manufacturing industries.

Good to Have Competencies:

  • Knowledge of product design and development.

  • Familiarity with environmental regulations and compliance.

  • Knowledge of the manufacturing industry process.

  • Adaptability to work with different work cultures and time zones.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Business Analytics Sr Analyst AVP
description:
The Business Analytics Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Excellent communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

  • Gathers operational data from various cross functional stakeholders to examine past business performance
  • Identifies data patterns & trends, and provides insights to enhance business decision making capability in business planning, process improvement, solution assessment etc.
  • Recommends actions for future developments & strategic business opportunities, as well as enhancements to operational policies
  • May be involved in exploratory data analysis, confirmatory data analysis and/or qualitative analysis
  • Translate data into consumer or customer behavioral insights to drive targeting and segmentation strategies, and communicate clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leaders all findings
  • Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
  • Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of experience
  • This position requires excellent analytical and business strategy skills
  • Effective communication skills
  • Ability to present to business partners and/or leaders to gain approvals
  • Project and process management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
  • Experience with a prior focus in financial services analytics
  • Solid organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects at one time
  • Self-starter who also has a demonstrated ability to work successfully in team environment and drive


Education:

  • Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

•Working Environment: office setting, minimal travelling and working hours in the office may be required during projects.
• Effort: minimal physical effort required. High levels of prolonged and intense concentration may be required in front of computer.

title: Snöskottare – Bli en del av vårt snöteam i vinter i Norrtälje centrum
description:
Vill du hålla dig aktiv under vintern, arbeta utomhus och vara en del av ett härligt team? Nu söker vi flera personer till vårt snöteam i Norrtälje. Här får du ett flexibelt uppdrag där du hjälper till att skapa trygga och framkomliga boendemiljöer när vintern visar sig från sin snörika sida.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker snöskottare för vinterunderhåll av ett större bostadsområde i Norrtälje.
Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

  • Handskottning av gångvägar och entréer

  • Halkbekämpning och sandning

  • Snöröjning vid trappor, ramper och nödutgångar

  • Säkerställa framkomlighet till garage, parkeringsytor och entréer

  • Arbeta enligt tydliga instruktioner och snökartor

Arbetet utförs vid behov när snöfall och halka uppstår. Snöröjningen påbörjas enligt fastställda riktlinjer för att säkerställa trygga och säkra miljöer för de boende. Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor och blir en viktig del av ett välorganiserat snöteam.

Om verksamheten

Du kommer att arbeta inom en etablerad fastighetsförvaltning som ansvarar för att skapa trygga, välskötta och attraktiva boendemiljöer. Vinterunderhållet är en viktig del av verksamheten, och här får du möjlighet att bidra till att människor kan röra sig säkert även när vädret är som mest utmanande.

Vem vi tror passar för rollen

Vi söker dig som:

  • Trivs med att arbeta utomhus vintertid

  • Är i god fysisk form

  • Gillar att arbeta i team

  • Är ansvarstagande och pålitlig

  • Inte är rädd för att hugga i när det behövs

  • Har möjlighet att rycka in när behov uppstår

Erfarenhet av snöröjning, fastighetsskötsel eller liknande arbete är meriterande men inget krav

Praktisk information

📍 Plats: Norrtälje
📅 Start: Vintersäsongen 2026/2027
⏳ Omfattning: Vid behov under vinterhalvåret
🕗 Arbetstid: Varierar efter väder och snömängd, alla veckans dagar kan förekomma
👥 Upplägg: Arbete i team

✅ Du väljer själv vilka uppdrag du vill tacka ja till och binder dig inte till någon beredskap.

Detta är ett perfekt uppdrag för dig som vill kombinera frisk luft, motion och gemenskap med ett arbete som verkligen gör nytta. Tillsammans hjälper vi de boende att få en tryggare och enklare vintervardag samtidigt som vi har roligt på jobbet. Välkommen att bli en del av vårt uppskattade snöteam!

Vad vi erbjuder: Att arbeta på Veteranpoolen ger dig som pensionär en unik möjlighet att berika pensionen. Vi förstår vikten av flexibilitet och anpassar våra uppdrag så att du kan njuta av din pension samtidigt som du får lön för att sätta guldkant på tillvaron med. Som anställd bjuds du även in till sociala aktiviteter som biokvällar, julbord och sommarfester. Veteranpoolen erbjuder inte bara ekonomisk fördel utan även en meningsfull & social upplevelse. Gör din pension ännu mer givande med oss!

Om oss: Veteranpoolen är Sveriges största arbetsgivare för pensionärer. Vi har över 12 000 anställda och finns på 64 kontor i hela landet. Vi bemannar företag i de flesta branscher och hjälper privatpersoner med hushållsnära tjänster. Som anställd hos oss är du självklart försäkrad och vi följer kollektivavtal. Lön är personlig och kan skilja sig från olika uppdrag men följer alltid avtal.

Ansök idag! Anmäl ditt intresse, så kontaktar vi dig och berättar mer om villkor, lön och hur det fungerar att jobba genom Veteranpoolen!

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Retail Assistant
description:
Overview

Everything we do starts with the people we serve. We’re proud to be the traders behind the tradespeople: the nuts and bolts behind the job, always ready to save the day (or at least the project).

From power tools to workwear, cables to pipe fittings, we offer over 60,000 products across 900+ stores – and that’s not to mention our industry-leading digital services. Join Screwfix and be part of a team of experts who get the job done quickly, affordably, and always with a smile.

You’ll be at the core of Screwfix, making sure our customers are the heart of everything we do. You’ll take your time to really get to know them whilst delivering genuinely great service. Our Retail Assistants are vital to the running of a store, so you’ll always be kept busy. And with the help of our excellent training programmes and varied shift patterns to support a healthy work life balance, you’ll be on the right track for a promising career with us!

Opening hours:

Monday - Friday (7am to 8pm)

Saturday (7am to 6pm)

Sunday (9am to 4pm)

Responsibilities

WHAT’S IT LIKE TO BE A RETAIL ASSISTANT?

  • Host – you’ll welcome customers into your store, understand what they need, guide them to the right products, and make it super easy for them
  • Warehouse standards – you’ll assist with deliveries, maintaining product stock, collecting customer orders and keeping standards high
  • Part of the team – you’ll join a team who take pride in their store, work together and have lots of fun along the way!

Qualifications

YOU ARE…

  • Amazing at giving great service, with a positive can-do, no-nonsense approach
  • Prepared to work hard and make the most of our training
  • A great communicator who loves to help people
  • Willing to learn, you don’t need retail experience to succeed
  • Friendly, flexible, reliable, honest and enthusiastic!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

  • Joining Screwfix means joining a growing team – full of support, opportunities, and fun!
  • We offer a competitive salary
  • 28 days annual leave (including an allowance for Bank Holidays). Increasing with length of service, up to a maximum of 33 days annual leave.
  • Award-winning company pension scheme - up to 14% Kingfisher contribution!
  • Life cover
  • 20% discount with Screwfix and B&Q
  • Discounted healthcare
  • Company share save schemes
  • Excellent training and ongoing development, we’ll also help you be the best you can be.

Follow us and find out more on our LinkedIn, Instagram & Twitter pages!

Apply now! – Upload your CV and complete your application

Please note, this advert may close early if the appropriate number of applications has been reached.

*Our hourly rates may include a location allowance which is reviewed annually and may change.

Our policy is to employ the best qualified people and provide equal opportunity for the advancement of employees including promotion and training and not to discriminate against any person because of gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief or disability.

If you require any additional support or adjustments to help you make an application, please contact us at careers@screwfix.com

title: Communications Specialist - GPC Asia Pacific
description:
Summary: Shape, plan and deliver strategic communications and service offering, drive stakeholder engagement, and bring fresh ideas in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Join a leading APAC organisation as a Communications Specialist where you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to build communications capability and deliver impactful communications that connect people to business priorities.

This is an opportunity for an experienced communications professional who thrives in an autonomous environment, builds trusted relationships across all levels of the business, and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo with innovative ideas. You'll play a key role in shaping internal and external communications capability and service offering, managing key channels and events, and helping drive engagement across Australia and New Zealand.

About the Role

  • Develop and mature communications capability and service offering aligned to strategic objectives
  • Develop and deliver strategic internal and external communication plans aligned with organisational priorities.
  • Create compelling content across multiple channels including intranet, newsletters, email communications, social media, websites and presentations.
  • Build, maintain and optimise SharePoint sites, ensuring content is accessible, engaging and aligned to governance standards.
  • Coordinate and deliver major employee engagement initiatives and events, including Town Halls, R U OK? Day and Safety Week.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand to uncover stories, translate complex information and develop meaningful communications.
  • Prepare communication materials, briefing packs and presentations for senior leaders and executives.
  • Support enterprise initiatives, organisational change and business transformation activities through effective communication strategies.
  • Monitor communication effectiveness and use insights, analytics and feedback to continuously improve outcomes.
  • Maintain external-facing website content and support social media planning and delivery.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and maturity of the communications function through process improvement and innovative thinking.
  • Work in a hybrid environment with a minimum of three days per week in the Rowville office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute integrated communication and content plans across internal and external channels.
  • Manage editorial calendars and deliver high-quality written communications including newsletters, leader updates, presentations and campaign materials.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, providing communications advice and guidance.
  • Source and develop engaging business stories by proactively engaging with teams across the organisation.
  • Own and maintain SharePoint sites, intranet content and communication assets.
  • Coordinate communications for key business initiatives, ensuring messages are clear, timely and aligned to organisational objectives.
  • Deliver end-to-end communication support for internal events and employee engagement programs.
  • Ensure all communications maintain brand consistency, quality and accessibility standards.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Safety, Technology, People & Culture and operational teams to support business objectives.
  • Track communication performance and provide recommendations to improve engagement and effectiveness.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and manage multiple projects in a dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environment

Looking after you:

We are committed to ensuring our people are well looked after. In addition to a rewarding and challenging career, we will provide:

  • Staff discounts across the GPC Asia Pacific group of Companies
  • Private health insurance discounts
  • Employee assistance program
  • A highly safety conscious work environment
  • We proactively support our working parents in a variety of meaningful ways, and our parental leave top-up allowance is one of the ways we do this
  • Paid volunteer leave allowing you to give back to your chosen charity/community organisation

GPC Asia Pacific

Movement is in our DNA. We are GPC Asia Pacific: one of the largest industrial and automotive aftermarket parts and service suppliers in Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia. Our iconic brands include Repco, NAPA & McLeod Accessories.

Yet we are more than just a parts and service company. We propel people forward.

With over 8000 team members in Asia Pacific, and 60k+ globally, being part of Genuine Parts Company won’t leave you standing still. Reach is key to our success. Learn more about our business online at www.gpcasiapac.com

Send your CV to our Careers Team by clicking APPLY!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by joining our Talent Community on or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

GPC conducts its business without regard to sex, race, creed, color, religion, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, military status, status as a veteran, or any other protected characteristic. GPC's policy is to recruit, hire, train, promote, assign, transfer and terminate employees based on their own ability, achievement, experience and conduct and other legitimate business reasons.

title: Aeronautical Engineering Intern
description:
About us:

CENTUM was founded in 2010 with a clear vision: ‘Flying with a purpose’. We are a team of highly qualified engineers with more than 15 years of experience in the areas of digital signal processing: mobile communications and software defined radio.

Our mission is to design, develop and commercialize mission aircraft systems for the Emergency, Security, Defense and Aerospace markets.

At CENTUM, we believe that human talent is our greatest asset. Our mission is clear: to develop innovative technology solutions that directly contribute to the safety and well-being of people globally. Every member of our team works on projects that save lives and make the world a safer place.

We provide technological solutions that maximize the efficiency in operations such as search and rescue, maritime surveillance, firefighting, emergency communications, disaster relief, and border control. Furthermore, we support our customers in integration and throughout the whole lifecycle by a highly qualified engineering team, with the clear purpose of improving people’s lives.


About the role:

We are looking for an Aeronautical Engineer or a final-year Aeronautical Engineering student to support the organization in the certification process under EASA Part 21G and Part 145, focused on the manufacturing and repair of aeronautical mission systems.

The position offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the aerospace and avionics industry, working closely with Production, Engineering, R&D team, the Integrated Management System (IMS) team, and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) area.

No previous professional experience is required. We are looking for someone with a technical mindset, curiosity, and a strong willingness to learn and grow within the organization.

Key responsibilities:

• Support the definition and industrialization of manufacturing and repair processes for aeronautical mission systems in accordance with EASA Part 21G and Part 145 requirements.

• Assist in the preparation and maintenance of technical work instructions, manufacturing procedures, and repair documentation for certified aerospace products.

• Collaborate with the Production and Engineering teams to define, document, and standardize assembly, integration, and testing processes.

• Participate in process reviews, configuration control activities, and continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment.

• Assist in coordinating with R&D, IMS, and ILS teams to ensure manufacturing documentation and procedures are aligned with system architecture, certification constraints, and maintainability requirements.

Requirements:

  • Degree in Aeronautical Engineering or currently studying the final year of an Aeronautical Engineering degree.

  • Interest in avionics, electronic systems, manufacturing, and aerospace technology.

  • No previous professional experience required.

  • Good level of English: B2/C1.

Soft skills:

  • Methodical and organized, with attention to detail.

  • Curious and eager to learn, with a proactive attitude.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic and flexible environment.

  • Autonomous and responsible, with the ability to manage assigned tasks.

  • Good teamwork and communication skills.

  • Willingness to take on new challenges and progressively assume responsibilities.

We offer:

  • Opportunity to join a high-technology aerospace environment and work on real aeronautical mission systems.

  • Internship / TFG support for students, with the possibility of continuing their professional career within the company.

  • 24 vacation days + December 24th and 31st + public holidays.

  • Friday afternoons off and reduced working hours during the summer.

  • Continuous internal and external training.

  • Career development opportunities and progressive assumption of responsibilities.

  • Opportunity to work with the latest technologies in the aerospace and avionics sector.

We value both the growth and well-being of people. In this environment, you will find an atmosphere that supports not only professional development, but also work-life balance. We encourage work-life balance and flexibility to adapt to the needs of each team member. From ongoing training to wellness initiatives, we strive to make each person feel valued, motivated and purposeful.

At Centum, equality and diversity are essential values. We are committed to creating an inclusive, discrimination-free workplace where everyone is respected. Each individual’s unique perspective enhances our team, driving a collaborative culture that promotes shared growth and success.

title: Senior Product Manager - IQ
description:
Join OneAdvanced

Owns the end-to-end technical strategy, roadmap, and product management for OneAdvanced, IQ-Intelligent-Platform. Acts as the connective tissue between platform capabilities (Data & AI, Core Services, Security, Integrations, etc.) and the vertical/product teams that consume them. This is a deeply technical product role — not pure feature ownership and not pure technical marketing or Product Management. The PM must translate complex platform primitives into clear product outcomes, drive prioritisation across engineering and data teams, define how platform capabilities surface to customers and internal builders, and ensure the IQ Intelligent Platform becomes the foundation that accelerates every vertical and application. Works in close partnership with Platform Engineering, Data, Security, Architecture, Principal PMs, IX, and the Technical Marketing Teams who turn the platform into compelling narratives, demos, and sales assets.

This role is advertised as a Birmingham hybrid position. However, we are committed to supporting internal mobility and will consider applications from colleagues with existing alternative working arrangements on a case-by-case basis.

What You Will Do

  • Own the overall platform product technical vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap (including the phased evolution of core services, Data & AI foundations, integrations, security, and developer experience).
  • Define and prioritise the platform capability backlog in partnership with engineering and architecture — balancing foundational investment, customer-driven needs, and vertical acceleration.
  • Translate complex platform architecture into clear product surfaces, APIs, SDKs, and self-service experiences that both customers and internal product teams can consume.
  • Own platform success metrics: adoption, engagement, time-to-value for builders, platform reliability/SLA impact, and contribution to vertical revenue / AI data consumption.
  • Lead high-stakes product decisions that cut across multiple teams (e.g. data model changes, identity, compliance controls, AI runtime, integration patterns).
  • Work with Legal, Security, Compliance, and Data teams on platform-level governance, privacy, and regulatory readiness (especially for regulated industries).
  • Partner tightly with Marketing and Commercials so that technical capabilities are turned into battlecards, demos, case studies, and field narratives without the PM becoming the primary storyteller.
  • Coach other Product Managers (vertical and feature) on how to leverage platform capabilities effectively and avoid rebuilding platform concerns inside verticals.
  • Define the “platform product contract” — what is guaranteed, what is self-service, what requires engagement, and how verticals request or extend platform capabilities.
  • Represent the platform in cross-company forums (architecture reviews, investment prioritisation, customer advisory boards) and ensure platform decisions are informed by real customer and field insight.

What You Will Have

  • Deep technical fluency across Data & AI, APIs, identity, security, and modern cloud platforms — able to hold technical conversations with architects and engineers while still owning the product “why” and “what”.
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of pure product management and technical enablement (similar energy to the Platform TME role, but with full roadmap ownership and prioritisation authority).
  • Turns complex platform capabilities into simple, compelling product stories that builders and customers understand.
  • Strong systems thinker who can see second- and third-order effects of platform decisions across the entire product portfolio.
  • Bias to action and high ownership — does not wait for perfect consensus before driving progress.
  • Excellent collaborator with engineering, data, security, marketing and commercial teams; earns trust by being technically credible and commercially aware.

Please note, This vacancy will remain open until 25 August 2026. Interviews will be scheduled shortly after the closing date, so we encourage interested colleagues to submit their application as early as possible. All applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application.

What We Do For You

Wellbeing that means something

  • 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays (and the option to buy more) plus 1 paid volunteering day every year
  • Exceptional family leave, 26 weeks fully paid maternity/adoption, 4 weeks fully paid paternity, 22 weeks fully paid shared parental leave, plus 5 days paid bereavement leave
  • Robust sick pay of up to 13 weeks full pay + 13 weeks half pay
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Private medical insurance for everyone, no medical-history exclusions

Financial benefits that have your back

  • Performance-based rewards tailored to your role, from company-wide bonuses to OTE and commission structures
  • Income protection: up to 75% salary for 5 years if you ever need it
  • Pension with 5% matched company contributions
  • Life assurance worth 4x your salary from day one
  • Free financial planning session with the option to engage in more tailored financial coaching.

Grow your career with us

  • SkillsHub learning platform with leadership pathways, future-manager training, and a huge online library
  • Access to external training and apprenticeships

Making a Difference

  • MatchIt! Fundraise for a cause close to your heart and OneAdvanced will match part of the funding
  • Pennies from Heaven donate the pennies from your pay check to help make a difference without lifting a finger

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

  • ULEV car scheme with 1,000+ models
  • Dental insurance, Health Cash Plan, Critical Illness Cover, Partner Life Cover, Health Assessment, Gym Membership

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second-year running, an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

Learn more at www.oneadvanced.com

title: Lääkäri, lasten ja nuorten lääkäri- ja kuntoutuspalvelut (Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue)
description:
Tervetuloa lääkäriksi Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle! Haemme osa-aikaista (50%) LÄÄKÄRIÄ vakituiseen virkaan 7.1.2027 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan. Palvelussuhteen alkaessa virka sijoittuu Lasten ja nuorten lääkäri- ja kuntoutuspalveluyksikköön.

Tiimissämme työskentelee kuusi kokenutta lääkäriä, jotka ovat innostuneita lanupe-työstä. Yksikön lääkärit toimivat Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen ehkäisy- ja perhesuunnitteluneuvolassa, äitiys- ja lastenneuvolassa, koulu- ja opiskeluterveydenhuollossa sekä lasten ja nuorten mielenterveys- ja päihdepalveluissa. Lisäksi vastaamme alueen lasten ja nuorten neuropsykiatristen ja monimuotoisten oireiden arvioinnista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksen suunnittelusta.

Etsimme yleislääkäriä tai soveltuvan alan erikoislääkäriä. Tällä hetkellä etsitään erityisesti lastenneuvolan ja koulu- sekä opiskeluterveydenhuollon lääkäritehtävistä kiinnostunutta kollegaa, mutta tehtävänkuva sovitaan yhdessä hakijan toiveiden ja erityisosaamisen mukaan, ja tehtävään mahtuu myös äitiysneuvolatyö.

Tiimimme lääkärinä työskentelet terveydenhoitajan työparina, ja moniammatillinen yhteistyö on keskeinen osa työtä. Kuulut lääkäritiimiin, joka tarjoaa kattavan perehdytyksen, vertaistukea ja hyvät konsultaatiomahdollisuudet.

Alueemme toimii HUS-alueen koulutusterveyskeskusjärjestelmässä, ja yksikössä voi suorittaa osan Yleislääketieteen erityiskoulutuksesta (YEK). Meillä on kehitysmyönteinen ilmapiiri ja hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet perehtyä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden terveyshaasteisiin.

Porvoon sairaalan ja Itä-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen työntekijöille on järjestetty mahdollisuus maksuttomaan työpaikkakuljetukseen Espoosta ja Helsingistä Porvooseen ja takaisin. Työterveyspalvelut ovat Mehiläisessä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on Suomessa laillistettu lääkärin pätevyys. Soveltuva erikoislääkärin tutkinto ja erityispätevyys, kuten lastenneuvolan ja kouluterveydenhuollon tai nuorisolääketieteen erityispätevyys, sekä kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme erityisesti kiinnostusta työskennellä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa sekä halua oppia ja kehittyä. Kielitaitovaatimuksena on yhden kotimaisen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja toisen kotimaisen kielen hyvä suullinen taito. Tutkinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään työhaastattelun yhteydessä.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärien työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (LS) mukaisesti. Palkkaus on uraporrasjärjestelmän mukainen, alkaen vastavalmistuneella 6170,97 €/kk ja erikoislääkärillä 7322,53 €/kk + mahdollinen aiempaan työkokemukseen perustuva lisä. Suoritteet maksetaan lisäksi erikseen. Uraporrasmalli mahdollistaa myönteisen palkkakehityksen myös jatkossa.

Viikkotyöaika 50 %:n virassa on 19,125 h/vko. Mikäli hakija toivoo laajempaa työaikaa, virkaa voi täydentää esimerkiksi toimimalla alueen lääkärin sijaisena. Työ on pääosin lähityötä Porvoossa ja Sipoossa, sekä mahdollisesti muualla hyvinvointialueella. Pieni osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä etätyönä. Virassa noudatetaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain § 48 mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä § 55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Valinta on ehdollinen, kunnes tehtävään valittu on esittänyt työterveyshuollon arvion edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä kuukauden kuluessa työn aloittamisesta. Valitun henkilön on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

title: Quantitative Researcher – EU Policy & Data Analysis
description:
Quantitative Researcher – EU Policy & Data Analysis (Verian Lithuania | Remote-friendly / Vilnius)

About Verian
At Verian, we use research, evidence and data to help governments and public institutions make better decisions.
Our Lithuania team brings together researchers, policy experts and data specialists working on complex European and international public policy challenges. We combine rigorous research methods with practical policy understanding, turning complex evidence into clear and useful insights for decision-makers.
We are looking for a Quantitative Researcher to join our team and contribute to research and evaluation projects for European and international clients.


About the role
This role is for someone who enjoys working with data but also wants to understand the policy questions behind it.
You will work with large and often complex datasets, helping to prepare, analyse and interpret quantitative evidence across European public policy projects. Your work may include analysing programme and project data, financial and monitoring information, indicators and other socio-economic datasets.
Initially, you will contribute particularly to projects related to EU Cohesion Policy and regional development, examining patterns in public investment, programme implementation and performance across regions, programmes and countries.
The role goes beyond producing numbers. You will work closely with researchers and policy experts to understand what the data tells us, identify meaningful patterns and limitations, and translate quantitative findings into clear conclusions for policy audiences.


What you'll work on

  • Prepare, clean, combine and validate large and complex datasets from different sources.
  • Conduct quantitative analysis using appropriate statistical and econometric methods.
  • Explore patterns, relationships and differences across programmes, regions, countries and other relevant groups.
  • Analyse programme implementation, performance, financial, monitoring and indicator data.
  • Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, outliers and limitations, and determine how they should be handled analytically.
  • Translate policy and methodological concepts into clear analytical approaches and variables.
  • Interpret quantitative findings in their broader policy and institutional context.
  • Produce clear analytical outputs, including tables, charts, visualisations and concise written analysis.
  • Contribute to research reports, evaluations, impact assessments, presentations and other client-facing outputs.
  • Work collaboratively with researchers, economists, policy experts and project teams across Verian.


What we're looking for

A strong candidate will bring:

  • Professional experience in quantitative research, data analysis, econometrics or applied social science research.
  • A degree in economics, econometrics, statistics, data science, public policy, social sciences or another field with a strong quantitative component.
  • Strong data management skills, including experience cleaning, combining, validating and analysing complex datasets.
  • A good understanding of quantitative research methods and the ability to select and apply appropriate analytical techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one analytical environment such as Python, R, Stata, SPSS or similar, as well as strong Excel skills.
  • The ability to move beyond purely technical analysis and interpret findings in their policy, economic or institutional context.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a critical approach to data quality and limitations.
  • The ability to communicate quantitative findings clearly to non-technical audiences through writing, tables, charts and visualisations.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing transparent, robust and reproducible analysis.


What will strengthen your application

The following would be valuable, but are not required:

  • Knowledge of EU Cohesion Policy, regional development, public investment or EU funding programmes.
  • Experience working with EU programme, project, financial, monitoring or indicator datasets.
  • Familiarity with European Structural and Investment Funds or other EU funding instruments and monitoring frameworks.
  • Experience analysing programme performance, financial implementation, outputs, results, costs, targets or indicators.
  • Experience with more advanced econometric analysis, including panel data, fixed effects, robustness or sensitivity analysis.
  • Previous experience in policy evaluation, impact assessment, monitoring, applied economic research or EU-funded research projects.
  • Experience using EU-level datasets, administrative data or open-data platforms.
  • Data visualisation skills.
  • Knowledge of additional European languages.


What we offer

  • The opportunity to work on meaningful European and international public policy projects where quantitative evidence directly informs decision-making.
  • Access to complex and varied datasets and the opportunity to apply analytical methods to real policy questions.
  • Collaboration with experienced researchers, economists, policy experts and international partners.
  • Opportunities to develop your skills in quantitative research, policy evaluation and applied data analysis.
  • A multicultural and intellectually stimulating working environment.
  • Gross monthly salary from EUR 0,000 to EUR 0,000, depending on your experience and qualifications.
  • Flexi-time: we operate with no fixed office hours, so you can work when you feel most productive.
  • Hybrid working model with the flexibility to work from home several days per week (for Vilnius-based colleagues).
  • Regular team events and workplace initiatives.
  • Private health insurance (for employees under a Lithuanian employment contract).
  • Access to the Mindletic wellbeing platform.
  • Additional days off as you grow with us, as well as extra personal leave days.


Location and working arrangement

This is a remote-friendly role, and we welcome candidates based in Lithuania as well as candidates interested in a fully remote working arrangement.

Candidates based in Lithuania may be offered employment under a Lithuanian employment contract and have the option to work from our Vilnius office at Gedimino pr. 50.
For candidates based outside Lithuania, the exact cooperation arrangement will depend on location and may be organised through a service agreement.


If you enjoy using data to understand how policies and public investments work in practice – and want your analysis to contribute to better decisions – we would be happy to hear from you!


Please submit your CV through our application system.

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

Our Associate Programs offer new graduates the opportunity to work in one of TD's many lines of business, and the chance to work on challenging projects and assignments, alongside experienced colleagues, and receive coaching and mentorship from business leaders and the Early Talent Experience team, to set you up for success in your career at TD.

As an Associate, you will also have access to programming, tools and a community of support for your pursuits and interests beyond the 9-5. This includes leadership talks, lunch and learns, self-development workshops, TD sponsored conferences, socials, team challenges, volunteer opportunities, career coaching and more. You will be part of a cohort along with other TD Associates from across Canada!

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Data Scientist Associate will perform a variety of activities, which may include:

  • Perform data queries and prepare data sets for analysis/modelling, including cleaning data and feature engineering

  • Analyze large data sets and identify trends and insights to inform business decisions; communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Collaborate with team members and business partners to develop, test and deploy analytics solutions, for example: forecasting, optimization, or pricing models

  • Proactively identify business problems and opportunities where a data-driven solution would be appropriate and develop proposals / approaches

  • Collaborate with business partners to support the business case development process for analytics solutions

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be graduated between May 2025 and May 2027 with a Graduate degree in Business, Management, and/or Data Analytics or related.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience; which can include work terms during your completion of studies.

  • Strong statistical and analytical skills and interest are necessary.

  • Experience with analyzing large data sets, drawing insights and inferences, and communicating outputs.

  • Experienced in one or more of:

  • Big Data – Predictive Analytics, Optimization, Regression, Logit Modeling, Discreet Choice, Simulation, Propensity Modeling.

  • Machine Learning – Data/Text Mining, Programming, Algorithm Development, Automation Data Visualization, Natural Language Processing.

  • Strong technical knowledge and experience with at least one of: R, Python, SQL, SAS, Java, or C/C++

  • Technical knowledge or experience with Spark and Cloud. Experience with Data Management, and Project Management is a plus.

  • Must have strong leadership qualities including demonstrating initiative, establishing priorities and using strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills to add value to each initiative, project or team assigned to.

  • Able to participate as part of a team with targeted deliverables, working on initiatives designed to improve decisions, processes, systems, and applications which support our key businesses.

title: Projektcontroller
description:
Vill du arbeta med projektredovisning och projektstöd? Arcada söker en projektcontroller som vågar utmana existerande processer och testa nya lösningar. Som projektcontroller ansvarar du för redovisnings-, rapporterings- och uppföljningsfrågor samt projektstöd beträffande yrkeshögskolans projektportfölj i ett professionellt och stöttande team.

Vi söker dig som brinner för projekt, redovisning och uppföljning samt att stöda forskare med projektverksamheten i högskolan. Idealt har du erfarenhet av bland annat projektverksamhet och projektadministration relaterat till högskole- och forskningssektorn.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter som projektcontroller är:

* Bokföring- och uppföljning av projekttimmar och -kostnader

* Ekonomisk projektrapportering till interna och externa intressenter (finansiärer)

* Analytik och prognostisering med fokus på högskolans forsknings- och projektverksamhet

* Rådgivning, stöd och information i projektfrågor, projektbudgetering och uppföljning inom organisationen, som del av högskolans forskningsenhet

Du har relevant högskoleexamen och gärna även tidigare erfarenhet av att jobba med projekt inom högskole- och forskningssektorn. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift samt har goda kunskaper i finska. Som person är du noggrann och systematisk, har förmåga att jobba självständigt och hanterar större helheter samt är positiv och tjänstvillig.

Vi erbjuder dig ett jobb i en mångprofessionell och dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Dina kolleger inom ekonomiavdelningen och forskningsenheten är engagerade och blickar framåt. Du kommer att jobba tätt tillsammans med vår projektcontroller och forskare, men också brett med de övriga enheterna i högskolan. Jobbet är en tidsbunden anställning, 1.10.2026 (tidigast) - 31.12.2028.

Har du frågor? Kontakta Tom Lindström, tel. 040 161 6955, 9-11.9.2026 kl. 9-12 eller skicka epost till tom.lindstrom@arcada.fi [tom.lindstrom@arcada.fi]

Skicka in din ansökan, ditt CV och löneanspråk senast 21.9.2026

title: Lead TFA Generator Mechanical
description:
Job Description Summary

Do you want to play a pivotal role in maintaining the world’s power infrastructure while leading technical excellence in the field?

GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Lead TFA Generator Mechanical to join our Field Services team based in Milan, Italy.

Job Description

GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Power Our Power portfolio provides sustainable, more efficient energy solutions. With expertise across Gas, Hydro, Nuclear, and Steam Power, we help customers deliver electricity to homes, industries, and communities worldwide.

Let’s Talk about the Role

The Lead TFA Generator Mechanical will serve as the primary technical expert and site lead for the installation, maintenance, and repair of industrial power generation rotating equipment, specifically generators.

You will lead complex field service operations, providing technical direction to teams, ensuring high-quality execution at customer sites, and acting as a mentor to develop the next generation of field talent. You are the heartbeat of our on-site customer experience, ensuring that our equipment operates safely, efficiently, and reliably.

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Leading on-site installation, preventive maintenance, and emergency repair of generators, ensuring technical precision and high-quality results.

  • Driving customer satisfaction by providing expert technical instruction and transparent, timely communication throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Collaborating with customer representatives and third-party contractors to oversee critical tasks, including dimensional checks and alignment procedures.

  • Improving equipment reliability by troubleshooting complex issues and executing aftermarket upgrades to meet modern performance standards.

  • Developing and mentoring team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on technical growth and operational excellence.

  • Creating accurate and comprehensive technical reports, ensuring all documentation reflects the full scope of site activities and future maintenance requirements.

Special Role Requirements

  • Able to travel extensively to and from projects and various field assignments.

  • Ability to spend considerable time away from home for training and field assignments (around 80% of their time).

Skills for Success

Required Qualifications & Experience:

You should be a seasoned technical leader in power generation with:

  • The ability to interpret complex electrical and mechanical diagrams and perform high-precision tasks such as dial and laser alignment, to provide direction to others.

  • The capability to manage multiple project workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a rigorous focus on safety standards.

  • An understanding of Generator Operation and Controlling Parameters across a wide range of equipment.

  • An expertise in providing clear, professional technical guidance to both customers and on-site staff.

  • Previous experience in a field services or power generation equipment maintenance position.

  • Fluency in both English and Italian to effectively navigate our diverse operational environment.

A formal education in Engineering (Mechanical or Electrical preferred) is essential, but we are also interested in your total experience and professional achievements in the field.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Ability to act as a senior rep on any outage for the unit qualified. Acts as project manager and mentor on complex projects. Demonstrates mentor and team lead skills.

  • Experience and training on either BBC / ABB / ALSTOM equipment or any other oOEM equipment.

  • Extensive Field Engineering Services experience.

  • Strong organizational, project management, oral and written communication and interpersonal and leadership skills.

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in Milan, with the expectation of extensive travel to project sites.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

We're determined to be the best place to grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

title: Finance Development Program
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

This program, based out of Pittsburgh, PA, will expose you to a broad range of business activities while working through Finance Analytics. The FDP is a 2-year rotational program in which participants, Retail Finance Associates (RFAs), complete 6-moth rotations on four different teams across crucial areas of the business. Participants are placed in one of two tracks (Accounting or Finance), depending on education, experience, and interest.

Your rotations may include:

Accounting

  • Financial Reporting/Controls/Technical Accounting

  • Internal Audit

  • General Accounting

  • Elective: Automation, Treasury, FP&A

Finance

  • Non-Merchandise Procurement

  • Corporate Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  • FP&A Business Support Store Operations

  • FP&A Supply Chain

Upon completing this structured program, you will be placed into a full-time role based on business need, as well as your overall performance throughout the rotations and specific areas of interest.

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office.

Key program experiences:

  • Orientation to introduce you to the company, Pittsburgh, the program, and your teammates

  • Develop functional and leadership skills by working alongside experts within the function

  • Real-life, hands-on practical application within the specialized disciplines

  • Exposure to cross-functional areas of the organization

  • Interaction with teammates across all levels of the company, including Senior Executives

  • On the job training specific to your area

  • Various professional development workshops and opportunities

Skills we are looking for:

  • A competitive spirit with a passion for results

  • An interest and confidence in working with data and numbers; strong mathematical/quantitative skills highly preferred

  • Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to independently make data-driven recommendations

  • A curiosity and desire to learn about consumer and retail trends, including customer demographics, purchasing influencers and emerging technology

  • Dynamic written and verbal communication style to read and write reports, as well as communicate cross functionally and vertically throughout the organization

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment

Program Start Date: June 15, 2026

Overview of DICK’S Sporting Goods:

Today, headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. is a leading omni-channel sporting goods retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories. The Company operates over 720 DICK'S Sporting Goods locations across the United States, serving and inspiring athletes and outdoor enthusiasts to achieve their personal best through a blend of dedicated associates, in-store services and unique specialty shop-in-shops dedicated to Team Sports, Athletic Apparel, Golf, Lodge/Outdoor, Fitness and Footwear.

DICK’S also owns and operates Golf Galaxy and Public Lands specialty stores, as well as GameChanger, a youth sports mobile app for scheduling, communications, and live scorekeeping. DICK'S offers its products through a content-rich eCommerce platform that is integrated with its store network and provides customers with the convenience and expertise of a 24-hour storefront.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

  • Less than 1 year experience required.

  • An ability to relocate to Pittsburgh, PA

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.

  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.

title: Commercial & Mid-Market Sales Engineer
description:
Datadog Sales Engineers help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners. You will provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations (POCs). Sales Engineers have a voice with the product team to help prioritize features based on input from customers, competitors, and partners.   • Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 25% of the time

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence.
