title: UX Researcher
description:
In deze rol zorg je dat we minder bouwen op aannames en meer op bewijs. Inzichten verdwijnen niet in een rapport, maar werken direct door in betere productbeslissingen. Je toetst hypotheses, maakt impact meetbaar en helpt teams digitale producten bouwen die echt waarde toevoegen.

Word onderdeel van ons team

Bij Framna bouwen we digitale producten die ertoe doen, voor marktleiders en organisaties die dat willen worden. We geloven in win by product: ons werk stopt niet bij livegang, maar pas bij aantoonbare impact voor de business van onze partners. Daarom zoeken we mensen die niet alleen meten wat er gebeurt, maar ook valideren of het waarde toevoegt.

Als UX Researcher versterk je een groeiende product discipline waarin onderzoek, experimentatie en meetbaarheid de standaard zijn. Je werkt direct samen met onze Senior Product Researcher, die je coacht in hypothese-gedreven werken en als inhoudelijke sparringpartner naast je staat. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met Product Owners, Designers en Developers aan producten voor partners in onder andere luchtvaart, retail, gezondheidszorg en financiële dienstverlening.

Wat je gaat doen

In deze rol zorg je dat productbeslissingen worden genomen op basis van gevalideerd inzicht, niet op gevoel. Je vertaalt businessvragen naar scherpe onderzoeksvragen, daagt aannames uit met bewijs en zorgt dat nieuwe features meetbaar worden opgeleverd.

Je werkt mee over de volle breedte van de productcyclus:

Bij projectstart

  • Je helpt onderzoeksvragen en toetsbare hypotheses scherp te krijgen, samen met de Senior Product Researcher

  • Je sluit aan bij product alignment-sessies en helpt succesdefinities en KPI’s concreet te maken

  • Je gebruikt prioriteringsmodellen zoals RICE om scopediscussies van mening naar onderbouwing te brengen

Tijdens uitvoering

  • Je begeleidt tracking-implementaties samen met development, bijvoorbeeld in GA4, Firebase en GTM

  • Je schrijft SQL-queries in BigQuery voor data-extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalyses

  • Je ontwerpt en draait zelfstandig A/B-tests en gebruikersonderzoeken op basis van heldere hypotheses

  • Je bouwt dashboards in Looker Studio die teams en partners ook echt gebruiken

Bij afronding en doorwerking

  • Je vertaalt onderzoeksuitkomsten naar heldere verhalen en concrete aanbevelingen

  • Je bewaakt dat features meetbaar worden opgeleverd en dat learnings terugkomen in het team

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze interne aanpak voor product research en experimentatie

Wie jij bent

Klaar om deze rol echt eigen te maken? Dan denken we dat je goed bij ons past als je:

  • 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring hebt met product research, digital analytics of een vergelijkbare data-gedreven productrol

  • Sterk bent in GA4 of Firebase, BigQuery en Looker Studio, of vergelijkbare tooling

  • Vloeiend bent in SQL en zelfstandig queries schrijft voor extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalyses

  • Zelfstandig A/B-tests kunt opzetten en interpreteren, en statistische basisprincipes zoals significantie, power en sample size begrijpt

  • Hypothese-gedreven werkt en start vanuit de vraag wat je wilt weten en waarom

  • Sterk bent in data storytelling en analyses altijd vertaalt naar een duidelijke conclusie en concrete vervolgstap

  • Stevig genoeg in je schoenen staat om tegenspraak te geven als onderzoek iets anders laat zien dan de heersende aanname

  • Nieuwsgierig bent naar de business van partners en pragmatisch werkt: liever een goede beslissing op basis van goed bewijs dan een perfecte analyse waar niemand iets mee doet

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met GTM

  • Ervaring met server-side tracking

  • Ervaring met Python, bijvoorbeeld pandas, scipy of statsmodels, voor diepere statistische analyses

Over Framna

Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.

Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.

Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.200 en €4.600, afhankelijk van je ervaring

  • Pensioenbijdrage van 67%

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen of te verkopen

  • Vergoedingen voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken

  • Een MacBook en telefoon in bruikleen

  • Dagelijkse lunch op de studio

  • Persoonlijke coaching door onze Senior Product Researcher

  • Een helder ontwikkelpad richting Senior niveau


Goed om te weten

  • Voor deze rol zoeken we een collega die vloeiend Nederlands spreekt

  • Wij bieden geen visa sponsorship aan

Het sollicitatieproces

Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten waar onderzoek en data echt het verschil maken? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen vijf werkdagen neemt Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op.

Klikt het? Dan starten we met een korte online kennismaking. Zijn we daarna allebei nog steeds enthousiast, dan nodigen we je uit in een van onze studios voor een vakinhoudelijk gesprek met de Senior Product Researcher. Klikt het daarna nog steeds? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

title: Senior SAP Project Manager
description:
Do you enjoy leading SAP projects of different sizes and complexity? We do.

We’re looking for a Senior SAP Project Manager to join Vincit and take ownership of SAP projects of varying size and complexity, from more focused deliveries to larger business transformations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for making sure projects move forward smoothly, while working closely with customers and expert teams to balance delivery, scope, and business goals.

You know you’ve succeeded when projects are delivered as planned, stakeholders are aligned, and the work creates real value for the customer – whether it’s through a smaller improvement or a larger transformation.

What is the job like, really?

Our SAP customer portfolio is broad and diverse, and the work varies from more focused implementations to larger transformation initiatives. You’ll work in both multi-vendor environments and projects where Vincit takes full delivery responsibility.

Here’s a snapshot of your key responsibilities:

☘️ Leading SAP projects end-to-end: You take ownership of delivery, ensuring projects stay on track in terms of scope, timeline, and quality.

☘️ Owning financials and scope: You take responsibility for project profitability, budgeting, and scope management.

☘️ Driving business transformation: You don’t just deliver systems, you help customers implement real business changes through SAP.

☘️ Leading teams and stakeholders: You lead cross-functional teams and work closely with stakeholders to ensure alignment and success.

☘️ Supporting sales and pre-sales: You act as an expert in sales cases, helping shape solutions and identify new opportunities.

What are we looking for?


You’ll succeed in this role if you’re able to see the bigger picture and take ownership not only of delivery but also of business outcomes.

You’re comfortable leading complex projects where expectations are high and things don’t always go as planned. You take responsibility for financials, scope, and team performance – and know how to balance all three.

Your background

🎯 Experience leading SAP projects, including large-scale business transformations

🎯 Experience delivering complex SAP solutions (e.g. S/4HANA)

🎯 Experience managing project financials, profitability, and scope

🎯 Ability to lead teams and stakeholders in demanding environments

🎯 Understanding of business processes and ability to identify new opportunities

🎯 Working proficiency in Finnish and English

It’s a strong plus if you have:

🎯 Experience in manufacturing or other industry domains

🎯 Experience with both core ERP and cloud-based SAP solutions

🎯 Project management certifications

🎯 Experience working in consultancy environments

🎯 Experience supporting sales or pre-sales activities

What’s in it for you?


Why we believe this role is worth your time:

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is a worthwhile place for experienced SAP professionals:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects – from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core – work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem – as an SAP Gold Partner and Microsoft Solutions Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working – our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

🌟 Top-notch SAP community – with 90+ SAP experts in-house and a partner network of 100+ professionals to learn from and collaborate with

🌟 Time to truly grow your expertise – we actively invest in learning through knowledge groups, certifications, and modern tools. We also dedicate time for continuous learning and development – up to 20% of working time – making growth a real part of the job, not something you do only on the side.

🌟 No offshore model – close collaboration with local teams.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?


🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance – shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay – your monthly total compensation (5500-7000€) reflects your experience and expertise and combines a solid base salary with a variable bonus model. You’ll also benefit from personnel fund and transparent salary weeks.

🌟 Comprehensive benefits – including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities – develop your skills and gain certifications through Univincity and shared learning, while shaping your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Explore inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities – a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion – we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our People & Culture blog and learn more about how we work in our Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
Salesforce Solution Architect | Global Tech Consultancy

Location: Pretoria / Johannesburg (Hybrid out of Menlyn, Pretoria)

Package: Up to ~R1,500,000 per annum / R125,000 per month base (Negotiable based on expertise and certifications)

Many Salesforce architect roles trap you on a single internal platform, fixing the same legacy setup month after month. Others throw you into pure client-facing sales pitches with zero oversight of the actual build.

This role balances high-level client strategy with real technical delivery.

Joining a leading global technology consultancy out of their Pretoria office, you will lead end-to-end digital transformations across diverse enterprise environments. You will run architectural discovery, design scalable Salesforce blueprints, and direct delivery teams to ensure your target state becomes reality.

What is in it for you:

  • Diverse Enterprise Portfolio: Design architectures across a mix of account sizes and client environments rather than getting stuck managing one static instance.
  • Clear Professional Growth: Access structured training opportunities and sponsorship to help you gain specialised Salesforce certifications and advance your career.
  • True Architectural Governance: Own the full technical lifecycle, from initial client discovery sessions and API integration design down to oversight of delivery teams.
  • High-Visibility Advisory Scope: Step up as the primary technical advisor to executive business and IT stakeholders, pitching proposals and technical roadmaps directly.
  • Comprehensive Remuneration: A competitive base package up to R1.5m CTC, plus standard company benefits and hybrid work flexibility out of a modern Pretoria hub.

What you bring to the table:

  • 4+ years of Salesforce Architecture experience: A proven track record designing scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform.
  • Active Certification: At least 2 active Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Consultant tracks, or Architect path preferred).
  • Strong Systems Analysis Roots: A background in business process mapping, gap analysis, and writing clear functional specifications.
  • Gauteng Location: Based in Pretoria or Johannesburg with the ability to work on-site at the Pretoria office on a hybrid schedule.

A background in Apex/LWC development, REST/SOAP integration design, or experience within a systems integrator will put your application right at the front of the queue.

If you are ready to take on a broader architectural scope, send your CV through to Badger & Bird Talent today.

title: DomaCare -järjestelmän pääkäyttäjä
description:
Innostutko järjestelmistä, ja siitä, miten toimivalla teknologialla voidaan luoda sujuvaa työarkea? Haluatko päästä ongelmatilanteissa pintaa syvemmälle ja etsiä pitkän aikavälin ratkaisuja?

Siinä tapauksessa tämä tehtävä voisi olla sinua varten! Etsimme nyt osaksi Esperin laatutiimiä DomaCare -pääkäyttäjää ottamaan kokonaisvastuun järjestelmään liittyvästä kehittämisestä, ohjaamisesta ja taustatyöstä.

DomaCare -järjestelmä Esperillä

Esperi on valtakunnallinen, yli 7000 henkeä työllistävä, sosiaali- ja terveysalan yritys. Liiketoimintamme perustuu eri asiakasryhmille tuotettaviin asumispalveluihin, jotka luetaan sosiaalihuollon piiriin. Asukasryhmämme käsittävät ikäihmiset, vammaispalvelun asiakkaat sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujat. Lisäksi tytäryhtiömme Saga-palvelutalot muodostavat 12 palvelutalon kokonaisuuden itsemaksaville senioreille. Esperi-koteja on tällä hetkellä noin 260, ja toimimme yli sadalla paikkakunnalla ympäri Suomen.

DomaCare on keskeinen asiakastietojärjestelmä, jota henkilöstömme käyttää päivittäin. Siksi meille on tärkeää, että järjestelmä tukee käytännön työtä, ohjeet ovat ymmärrettäviä ja ongelmatilanteisiin saadaan apua nopeasti. DomaCare ja sen yhteydet Kanta-palveluihin kehittyvät jatkuvasti. Pääkäyttäjänä pysyt muutoksissa mukana ja viet ne henkilöstölle selkeiksi ohjeiksi ja toimintatavoiksi. Pääset vaikuttamaan myös siihen, että tieto kirjataan oikein ja että sitä voidaan hyödyntää luotettavasti raportoinnissa, laadun seurannassa ja johtamisessa.

Tärkeimmät tehtävästi ja yhteistyökumppanisi

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos haluat ymmärtää miten järjestelmä, kirjaaminen, raportointi ja käytännön päivittäinen työ liittyvät toisiinsa. Et tyydy ratkaisemaan vain yksittäisiä tukipyyntöjä, vaan selvität huolellisesti taustat ja kehität niiden pohjalta parempia toimintatapoja. Työskentelet osana laatutiimiä ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Esperin raportointitiimin, ICT-tiimin, liiketoiminnan, yksiköiden ja järjestelmätoimittajan kanssa.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- DomaCare-asiakastietojärjestelmän pääkäyttäjänä ja sisäisenä asiantuntijana toimiminen
- käyttäjien neuvonta ja kouluttaminen sekä selkeiden käyttöohjeiden laatiminen
- järjestelmän käyttöön, toiminnallisuuksiin, käyttöoikeuksiin ja tiedonkulkuun liittyvien ongelmien selvittäminen
- järjestelmän asetusten, käyttäjähallinnan ja toimintamallien kehittäminen
- käyttäjäviestintä häiriö- ja muutostilanteissa
- uusien ominaisuuksien, integraatioiden ja järjestelmämuutosten testaaminen ja käyttöönotto
- Kanta-palveluihin ja erityisesti sosiaalihuollon Kanta-ratkaisuihin liittyvien muutosten ja toimintatapojen toteuttaminen
- kirjaamisen rakenteiden ja ohjeistuksen kehittäminen yhdessä toiminnan asiantuntijoiden kanssa
- päällekkäisen ja tarpeettoman kirjaamisen tunnistaminen ja vähentäminen
- yhteistyö raportointitiimin kanssa tiedon laadun, raportoinnin ja tunnuslukujen luotettavuuden varmistamiseksi
- toistuvien tukipyyntöjen ja ongelmien seuranta sekä niitä koskevien kehittämisehdotusten tekeminen.

Mitä me odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka viihtyy ajoittain nopeatempoisessa toimintaympäristössä ja tarttuu asioihin oma-aloitteisesti. Olemme kehittämismyönteinen yritys, ja yksi arvoistamme – Meissä on rohkeus uudistua – kuvaa hyvin myös asiantuntijatyömme ydintä.

Olet valmistunut soveltuvalta alalta tai viimeistelemässä opintojasi. Koulutustaustasi voi olla esimerkiksi tietojenkäsittelyn, tietojärjestelmätieteen, terveysteknologian, sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon tai muun tehtävään soveltuvan alan koulutus.

Edellytämme sinulta:

- kokemusta asiakas-, potilas- tai muun toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän teknisestä käytöstä
- Kanta-palvelujen ja sosiaalihuollon Kanta-ratkaisujen tuntemusta
- kykyä hahmottaa järjestelmän toimintalogiikkaa, tietorakenteita ja tiedonkulkua
- kiinnostusta järjestelmien, toimintatapojen ja raportoinnin kehittämiseen
- taitoa opastaa ja kouluttaa erilaisia käyttäjiä selkeästi ja kärsivällisesti
- ratkaisuhakuista ja sitkeää työotetta
- rohkeutta kysyä, haastaa ja viedä asioita loppuun
- hyvää yhteistyö-, paineensieto- ja priorisointikykyä
- sujuvaa suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme:

- kokemuksen DomaCare-järjestelmästä
- kokemuksen asiakas- tai potilastietojärjestelmän pääkäyttäjä- tai tukitehtävistä
- sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen toimintaympäristön tuntemuksen
- kokemuksen raportoinnista, integraatioista, käyttäjäkoulutuksista tai järjestelmäkäyttöönotoista
- ymmärryksen tietosuojasta ja tiedon laadun varmistamisesta.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata tai tietää valmiiksi, vaan perehdytämme sinut tehtävään. Arvostamme erityisesti uteliasta asennetta, nopeaa oppimiskykyä ja halua selvittää asiat määrätietoisesti loppuun.

Miksi voimme suositella tämän tehtävän hakemista?

- Työskentelet osaavan laatutiimin osana ja saat tueksesi laajan yhteistyöverkoston. Yksin ei tarvitse jäädä.
- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myös raportointitiimin kanssa ja näet konkreettisesti, miten järjestelmään kirjattu tieto jalostuu raportoinniksi, laadun seurannaksi ja johtamisen tueksi.
- Et ole vain järjestelmän ylläpitäjä, vaan ennen kaikkea kehittäjä. Luotamme asiantuntijuuteesi ja annamme tilaa uusille ratkaisuille.
- Saat vastuuta ja vapautta. Rooli on uusi, joten pääset myös vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi tehtävä muodostuu.
- Työskentely on joustavaa asiantuntijatyötä. Työpaikka Esperin toimistolla Tilkassa Helsingissä, mutta työtä voi ajoittain tehdä myös etänä.

- Saat käyttöösi hyvät työvälineet ja henkilöstöedut.

Rekrytointiprosessi

Jos tämä kuulosti ihan sinun jutulta - laita meille ihmeessä hakemus tulemaan! Hakuaika päättyy 21.9.2026. Hakemuslomake koostuu muutamista avoimista kysymyksistä ja liitä mukaan ajantasainen CV. Yhteen avoimeen kysymykseen vastataan erillisellä liitteellä. Erillinen hakukirje ei ole pakollinen.

Huomioimme ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta jätetyt hakemukset. Ensimmäinen haastattelukierros on tarkoitus pitää paikan päällä Tilkassa, Helsingissä syyskuun viimeisellä viikolla. Rekrytointiprosessiin kuuluu ennakkotehtävä, jossa arvioimme hakijan kykyä jäsentää kirjaamista, tiedonkulkua ja raportointia sekä esittää käytännöllisiä ratkaisuja.

Hakemusten läpikäynnissä tai päätöksenteossa emme hyödynnä tekoälyä. Tehtävän rekrytoiva esihenkilö lukee hakemukset läpi ja päättää haastatteluun kutsuttavat.

title: Kassa-myyjiä jouluavuksi, Järvenpää (määräaikainen 15-24 h/vko)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Hei!

Kaipaatko tulevaan talveesi jotakin uutta ja haluat ansaita lisätienestejä esimerkiksi opintojen ohella? Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden joustavalle työnteolle monipuolisessa ja vauhdikkaassa työympäristössä!

Haemme Kauhavan Tokmannin iloiseen joukkoon kahta asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja aidosti positiivista kassa-myyjää, jolla on intoa työskennellä kaupan alalla joulusesongin parissa.

Tehtävät keskittyvät kassatyöhön ja asiakaspalveluun kassalla ja eri osastoilla. Osastopuolen tehtäviin kuuluu mm. tuotteiden vastaanottoa ja hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Käy lukemassa lisää Tokmannin jouluapulaisen työstä Venlan ja Saran kertomanahttps://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/...

Työt ovat noin 3 kuukauden mittaisia määräaikaisuuksia, jotka alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on 15-24 h/vko. Täytämme tehtävät heti, kun löydämme sopivat työkaverit joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:
- Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne - Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää - Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä - Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli - Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin - Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen
Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Yhdessä tekemistä ja onnistumista
- Avointa, kannustavaa ja mukavaa työyhteisöä
- Ihmisistä ja ympäristöstä välittämistä
- Kilpailukykyistä palkkaa ja henkilöstöetuja
- Valmennus- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- Uusia haasteita ja urapolkuja
- Kehittymiseen kannustamista virheitä pelkäämättä
- Monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia työtehtäviä
- Työhyvinvointia ja -turvallisuutta

title: Expression of Interest- Audiologists Townsville and Rockhampton
description:
Rockhampton & Townsville, QLD

Help People Hear Better. Thrive in a Career That Matters.

WSAudiology is a global leader in the hearing aid industry. Together with our 12,000 colleagues across 130 countries, we help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

Part of the WSAudiology group, Bloom Hearing Specialists operates a national network of hearing clinics equipped with the latest technology and, most importantly, exceptional people. We are passionate about supporting progressive career pathways and creating opportunities for our employees to grow and develop in the direction that suits them best.

As we continue to expand our presence across Queensland, we are seeking expressions of interest from passionate Audiologists who would like to explore future opportunities within our Rockhampton and Townsville clinics.

Why Join Bloom?

At Bloom, our people are at the heart of everything we do. When you join us, you'll become part of a customer-centric organisation known for its industry-leading Net Promoter Score (NPS) and commitment to delivering outstanding hearing outcomes.

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration package

  • Relocation support opportunities (where applicable)

  • Ongoing training and professional development to support your career growth

  • Clinic incentive opportunities throughout the year

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Hearing aid benefits for employees, family and friends

  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • A supportive and collaborative team culture

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in regional communities

  • Career development pathways within a global organisation

The Opportunity

As an Audiologist with Bloom Hearing Specialists, you'll play a vital role in helping clients achieve better hearing and an improved quality of life through clinically excellent, personalised care.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Assessing and diagnosing hearing loss using Bloom-approved audiological techniques

  • Delivering tailored hearing solutions and educating clients to make informed decisions about their hearing health

  • Supporting successful hearing outcomes through the recommendation and fitting of appropriate hearing devices

  • Promoting hearing health awareness through local community engagement and outreach activities

  • Building and maintaining strong referral partnerships with GPs, ENT specialists and other healthcare professionals

  • Contributing to the continued success and growth of the clinic while delivering exceptional client experiences

About You

You are passionate about improving lives through better hearing and enjoy building meaningful relationships with clients and healthcare professionals alike.

To be successful, you will have:

  • A current QP number and full membership with Audiology Australia (AudA) or ACAud

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

  • A client-first mindset and commitment to delivering exceptional care

  • The ability to effectively manage your day and balance clinical and business development responsibilities

  • A passion for making a difference in regional communities

Why Rockhampton & Townsville?

Both Rockhampton and Townsville offer the perfect balance of rewarding clinical work and lifestyle benefits. These thriving regional communities provide the opportunity to build strong client relationships, make a genuine impact, and enjoy Queensland's relaxed lifestyle, natural beauty and welcoming community spirit.

Register Your Interest

If you're considering your next career move and would like to explore current or future Audiology opportunities with Bloom Hearing Specialists in Rockhampton or Townsville, we'd love to hear from you.

Submit your expression of interest today and join an organisation where you can grow, thrive and help people hear their best.

Apply Now

Applicants must be Australian or New Zealand citizens, permanent residents, or hold valid working rights in Australia or New Zealand to be considered for employment.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WS Audiology is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive employee experience. Regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

Candidates will be required to undergo a police check as a condition of employment. This check will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and will be used to assess the candidate's suitability for the position.

TD Commercial Banking provides financial solutions to North American businesses. Our quest is to deliver a first-class business banking client experience and to be” The Better Business Bank” in North America.

At TD, better business bankers have a strong background in business and finance as well as the specific products they are responsible to sell and service. They have keen insight into all their clients – their industry, products, finances, and markets. Better business bankers demonstrate good judgment in people, businesses and markets based on education, experience, “gut instincts” and “street smarts”.

description:
Important Application Submission Information

In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Thursday, September 17, 2026

More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

Position Summary:

The Senior Engineer manages work in engineering areas of specialization, with minimal supervision. The Senior Engineer is expected to develop advanced skills and to have the ability to work independently, with guidance limited to unusual or complex projects or issues. Employees in the Senior Engineer position are fully competent in the use of concepts and procedures. The Senior Engineer identifies problems, develops solutions and takes action to resolve

Responsibilities

  • Provides engineering/technical expertise and guidance in the identification, analysis and resolution of complex EMS problems with the ability to visualize long-term results and assess impacts on a system-wide basis.

  • Conducts engineering and related studies with full technical responsibility for planning and coordinating complex projects; applies extensive technical expertise to manage projects and disseminate knowledge to enhance the organizational unit's competitive position.

  • Possesses and applies a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures; demonstrates ability to analyze and recommend enhancements to business processes and develops standards relevant to the EMS. Keeps abreast of new developments, technologies procedures and equipment.

  • Works with IT and EMS teammates to ensure proper cyber security, NERC and O&P compliance for EMS environment.

  • Maintains and exercises in depth knowledge of EMS advanced software applications (State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, Network)

  • Provides leadership in the development of corporate positions on technical matters related to the future direction of EMS.

  • Serves on 24x7 callout rotation.

  • Provides engineering/technical expertise and guidance in the identification, analysis and resolution of problems of increasing scope and complexity in both inside as well as outside the scope of typical responsibility.

  • Ensures accomplishment of business goals and objectives through effective planning, organizing, estimating, scheduling and monitoring of work activities; decisions may affect the operations or results of the work group and may have some impact on major projects or department results.

  • Prepares thorough and accurate technical reports, correspondence, documentation, calculations and sketches related to defined problems and analysis of increasing scope and complexity.

  • Conducts engineering and related studies; completes non-routine engineering projects with minimal oversight with the ability to independently manage project schedules and interfaces; competent to design, operate and maintain systems with moderate impact on existing systems.

  • Possesses and applies the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures; proficient in technical and analytical competencies necessary to handle assignments of increasing complexity.

  • Develops positive working relationships to effectively coordinate work activities. Demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills. Maintains accurate records and files.

  • Supports the company's goals and represents the company positively and professionally

Required/Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in engineering from an ABET accredited program

  • In addition to required degree, six (6) years minimum required related experience

  • A master’s degree in engineering will be considered in lieu of the B.S. Engineering degree

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience with General Electric Grid EMS/DMS systems.

  • In Depth knowledge of NERC CIP cyber security standards.

  • Broad experience with Electric Transmission systems, including NERC transmission reliability standards (BA, TOP, etc.)

  • Comprehensive experience with real time computer systems, including programming languages (C++, FORTRAN, etc.), scripting languages (PERL, etc.).

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to form and maintain positive working relationships with teammates, peers and clients and to coordinate between team members, business units, support groups, corporate areas, contractors, and vendors to ensure appropriate communication and problem resolution..

  • Demonstrated ability to develop processes/procedures for new technologies or changing business needs to ensure compliance with all applicable standards, regulations and company requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide leadership in the development of corporate positions on technical matters related to the future direction of EMS.

  • Proficient in engineering theories and principles

  • Proficient in practices of researching engineering and design issues, evaluating alternatives, making sound recommendations, and preparing and presenting recommendations,

  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills

  • Proficient in principles of project management

  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE)

  • Experience in the utility industry

title: 2027 Summer Internship Program - Fixed Income Services
description:
Job Description:

At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future.

We believe diverse teams with unique backgrounds, skills and experiences yield more innovative solutions. Our mission is to recruit, develop, retain and engage a diverse, high-performing team. Our business enables bright, committed people working in partnership within an environment that allows each person to achieve at a high level. We commit to encouraging and valuing inclusivity because every partner brings unique perspectives that help us better serve our clients.

Piper Sandler is currently seeking interns for our Fixed Income Services business line for Summer 2027 in Chicago, IL. Learn more about our fixed income team here.

The Fixed Income Internship Program is a 10-week program where you will learn about Fixed Income from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to work with professionals in all areas of Fixed Income that include Municipal Underwriting and Trading, Credit Trading, Fixed Income Strategy & Analytics, Treasury Trading, Agency Underwriting and Trading, Mortgage-Backed Securities, Public Finance Investment Banking, Fixed Income Sales, High Yield Special Situations, Risk Management and various support groups.

The first week you will be introduced to Piper Sandler’s businesses and learn about the business as a whole. During the 10 weeks, you will attend Senior Management speaker series, desk teach-ins, engage in a community service project, presentation skills training, performance review and partake in a final project with fellow interns.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Develop an understanding of our client verticals and how they interact with various fixed income products

  • Support financial strategies team with a variety of assigned projects

  • Utilize back-office system, working with support groups

  • Support sales team, learn how we sell products to the buyside

  • Assist trading and underwriting teams, supporting all aspects of the new issue and secondary market process

  • Assist with publications of weekly commentary

Requirements:

  • This internship opportunity is open to rising juniors & rising seniors who have a GPA of 3.0 or above

  • Interest in Finance but a major in Finance is not a requirement for employment

  • While no prior knowledge of finance or sales & trading is required, you should possess a keen interest in the financial markets

  • Prepare for and take the SIE exam per guidelines

  • Strong written and verbal skills

  • Comfortable knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Tableau

  • Detail oriented, strong work ethic, possess leadership skills but also enjoy working on a team

  • Participate in Capstone Project/Final Presentation

Piper Sandler values a strong culture dedicated to the emotional and physical well-being of our employees. Learn more about our commitment to our employee’s health and well-being. Learn more about our benefits program and how we are here for our employees and their families today, tomorrow and beyond.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Pihlajalinna Hämeenlinnaan
description:
Hei sairaanhoitaja! Kiinnostaisiko sinua vaihteleva työ lääkärikeskuksessa Pihlajalinna Hämeenlinnassa?


Pihlajalinna Hämeenlinnassa työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä osallistuen laadukkaiden ja vaikuttavien terveydenhuollon palveluiden tuottamiseen. Sairaanhoitajana työnkuvasi on monipuolinen sisältäen itsenäistä vastaanottotyötä, lääkärin vastaanottotoiminnan tukemista ja toimenpiteissä avustamista, kliinisen fysiologian tutkimuksia, laboratoriotyötä sekä asiakaspalvelua. Toivomme sinulta osaamista erilaisten skopiatutkimusten, kuten gastroskopioiden ja kolonoskopioiden avustamisesta.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat aamu- ja iltavuoroihin arkipäivisin sekä viikonloppuisin. Työsuhde on toistaisesti voimassaoleva kokoaikainen.



🧡 Unelmien työpaikka Pihlajalinnassa? Meille Pihlajalinnassa unelmien työpaikka tarkoittaa paikkaa, jossa ihminen tulee ensin. Asiakaslähtöinen toimintamme nojaa Pihlis-periaatteisiin: rakennan luottamusta, onnistun yhdessä ja pidän huolta. Autamme toisiamme onnistumaan ja luomme ympärillemme iloista, mutkatonta ja turvallista työarkea. Meille on tärkeää, että ammattilaisemme voivat hyvin ja siksi kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota esihenkilötyöhön.

💎 Sinä olet meille tärkeä

  • Huolehdimme terveydestäsi tarjoamalla monipuoliset työterveyden palvelut, johon sisältyy myös Mielen Pihlajalinnan palvelut

  • Huolehdimme hyvinvoinnistasi tarjoamalla kattavan vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen Pihlajalinnalaiset saavat myös henkilöstöetuna osallistua työnantajan tukemana lukuisiin liikuntatapahtumiin ja kuntoilla edullisempaan hintaan Pihlajalinnan Forever-liikuntakeskuksissa (tarjolla myös etäliikuntamahdollisuuksia).

  • Huolehdimme osaamisestasi tarjoamalla kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia, jatkuvasti käytössäsi olevan oppimisympäristö Pihlajalinna Akatemian ja saat esiperehdytyksen jo ennen työsuhteen alkua työyhteisöön tutustumisen tueksi

  • Huolehdimme siitä, että saat kannustavan tiimin tuen monipuolisiin tehtäviin.

  • Työnantajana ja kollegoina lupaamme kuunnella ja auttaa sinua kehittymään työssäsi. Palkkauksessa ja työehdoissa noudatamme terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta sekä huomioimme työkokemuksesi ja osaamisesi yksilöllisesti

🎯 Olisitko sinä etsimämme uusi pihlajalinnalainen? Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?

Sinulla on ✅

  • sairaanhoitajan tai terveydenhoitajan tutkinto ja Valviran laillistus

  • aikaisempaa kokemusta erilaisissa toimenpiteissä ja tähystyksissä avustamisesta esim. kolonoskopia ja gastroskopia

  • aiempaa työkokemusta yksityisellä lääkäriasemalla työskentelystä ja DH-potilastietojärjestelmän käytöstä

  • asiakaspalvelun huippuosaamista! Kohtaat jokaisen asiakkaan lämmöllä, asiantuntemuksella ja vahvalla osaamisella

  • sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakas- ja potilastyössä vaadittava tartuntatautilain mukainen soveltuvuus

Haluan tämän työn! Miten toimin?

Jos tunnistit itsesi etsimämme henkilön kuvauksesta, jätäthän hakemuksesi 16.9.2026 mennessä rekrytointijärjestelmäämme.

Mikäli haluaisit jutella tehtävästä tarkemmin, palveluvastaava Taina Heinilä kertoo sinulle lisää arkisin klo 13-15 p. 0503152127 taina.heinila@pihlajalinna.fi

title: Supply  Nursery Practitioner- Welcome Bonus
description:
Remarkable future starts here


Nursery: Children 1st Chesterfield Nursery School by Storal

Address: Dryhurst House, Car Park 4, Calow, Chesterfield, S44 5BL

Hours: Monday - Friday, Zero hour contract hours to be discussed
Salary: £12.71per hour - £13.30 per hour, Salary will depend on qualifications and experience

Welcome Bonus £500
Hello, I’m Katie, the Nursery Manager at Chesterfield.

I have been part of the Chesterfield team for over 15 years. Alongside my deputy manager, we bring a wealth of early years knowledge and lead a dedicated, long-standing team—all committed to providing the best care and learning experiences for our children.

Housed in a beautiful Grade II listed building, our nursery offers a true home-from-home atmosphere, where every child is warmly welcomed into a close-knit and nurturing environment.

We place a strong focus on connecting with nature through our outdoor spaces, which include a teepee, vegetable patch, sensory garden, and apple trees—inviting children to explore, discover, and learn throughout all seasons.

Impact Lives, with a Schedule That Works for You

Chesterfield’s Purpose

To give children healthy foundations in fantastic settings, helping them build the confidence and resilience that will set them up for success later in life.

How you’ll spend your time here

You’ll be helping to provide cover for the children as and when needed. This could be for periods of holiday, sickness, or even vacancy gaps. Sometimes you'll support for a full day, or it may just be a morning or afternoon session.

You'll likely start most of your days with a fully formulated plan.... That will soon get completely derailed though... Pivoting when the circumstances call for it is a regular occurrence in child care!

Creativity is key. Teaching young children allows for hands on arts and crafts, storytelling, exercise, and educational games. It’s important to keep things fresh and try new activities to keep attention spans engaged. Of course we work within the EYFS standards, but that doesn't stop you from engaging your creative flair and enthusiasm for learning.

We’d love to talk to you if you have the following
Ideally hold a Level 2 or above qualified, Early Years Educator / Practitioner / Nursery Nurse or similar and you're looking for an Early Years Educator/Nursery Nurse/Early Years Practitioner role that allows you flexibility of working shifts around your other commitments.

You enjoy supporting and encouraging the natural curiosity and excitement of young children and were born to teach and shape the future of our younger generations.

You have a natural, nurturing, openness, a warm and positive outlook, and you care about learning and education standards in the UK.

(We can sometimes consider unqualified Educators, so if you can demonstrate the necessary values and enthusiasm for working within this environment, submit an application. Nothing ventured nothing gained).

What you'll need

  • A full and relevant Level 2 or above qualification within early years. (We can sometimes consider unqualified Educators, as long as they demonstrate the necessary qualities, values and enthusiasm for working within this environment. If you think you've got the right attitude and abilities, submit an application, who knows it might be the best thing you ever did. Nothing ventured nothing gained!)

  • Experience as an Early Years Educator (Nursery Nurse/Practitioner) or having worked with children under the age of 5, is advantageous

  • Knowledge and understanding of the EYFS is desirable

  • Reflecting the Storal values around responsibility, openness and working together

Benefits for You

For you - We get the basics right enhanced holidays, paid sick pay, extra wellness day off (yearly) and you can access your pay before payday with Pay Captain

Family matters - Balance starts at home Funding, compassionate leave & enhanced maternity leave

Health & wellness - Nourishing body & mind Partnerships with Vitality & Peppy; fertility & menopause support, gym discount, free movie tickets

Development - Investing in your future with micro-learning, financial stability tools & the Storal Support Fund

Our community -Growing together Termly inset days, team member app and Storal Awards

Not everything fits in a job advert

Click apply today, don’t worry if your CV isn’t perfect just send us what you have and we’ll work out the rest later.

Storal sets the highest of standards when it coming to safeguarding, the welfare of children and creating a work environment that encourages feedback-discussion-resilience. We take our role in the safety of children, our families and our team extremely seriously. As governed by the EYFS, we have a designated safeguarding lead in each setting and all staff (and volunteers) complete a through compliance checks prior to employment including employment references & DBS.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajaa kevennettyyn esiopetusryhmään Naantalin Aurinkometsän päiväkotiin 23.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Esiopetusryhmässä on tällä hetkellä 15 lasta. Toiminnan tavoitteena on vastata lasten yksilöllisiin tarpeisiin.

Ryhmässä työskentelevät: varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja ja varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja.

Erityisopettaja on vastuussa lapsen tarvitseman tuen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta yhteistyössä varhaiskasvatuksen henkilökunnan, huoltajien ja monialaisen yhteistyöverkoston kanssa.

Tarjoamme innostavan työyhteisön sekä hyvän ammatillisen tuen.


Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajalta edellytämme
-vahvaa pedagogista osaamista
-hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
-korvaavien kommunikaatiokeinojen hallintaa

Arvostamme
-myönteistä ja joustavaa työotetta
-rohkeutta tarttua itsenäisesti asioihin
-halua kehittää uusia toimintatapoja varhaiserityiskasvatuksessa

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajan tehtävään on varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 mukainen kelpoisuus. Huomioimme haussa myös varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajaksi valmistuvat. Mikäli kelpoisuusehdot täyttäviä hakijoita ei löydy, voidaan tehtävä täyttää määräaikaisesti hakijalla, jolla on varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuus.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Kunta-alan opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (OVTES). Naantalin varhaiskasvatuksen tasopalkan mukainen palkkaus 3313,74€/kk kuukaudessa. Lisäksi käytössämme on henkilökohtainen lisä, joka määräytyy ammatinhallinnan ja työssä suoriutumisen perusteella.

Voimme haastatella hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

Tehtävän vastaanottamisen yhteydessä hakijan on esitettävä terveydenhuollon arvio edellytyksistä hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä sekä rikosrekisterilain 6.2§ mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Työssä on koeaika.

title: Information Security Consultant
description:
Who you’ll be joining

We’re problem solvers at heart. Sometimes the answer is technology, sometimes it is strategy, and sometimes it is a strong cup of tea and a bit of thoughtful conversation. Whatever it takes, we work it out with our clients.

We’re an IT consultancy that helps organisations get the best out of their technology. That means keeping them secure and keeping the bad guys out, making sure everything works and is easy to use, and doing smart things with data and software to give their business an edge. It is important work, and we care about doing it well and for the right reasons.

Life at Waterstons is friendly, flexible and built on trust. We hire people who are curious, thoughtful and good at getting to the heart of a problem. You get support, trust and room to grow in a place that still feels human. The unlimited holidays and private healthcare are a nice touch, although most people stay because it feels like the right place to do good work with good people.

What You’ll Be Doing

We’re looking for an Information Security professional with a strong focus on GRC. As an Information Security Consultant, you'll have a good understanding of information security and data protection.

You’ll build relationships with prospective and active clients across the business and act as their trusted advisor, helping them to secure their business through the pragmatic use of technology and protect them from incoming threats.

This is a hybrid role based from our Glasgow, Durham or London office, with some travel to client sites as required.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Deliver information security and compliance projects.

  • Identify new business opportunities with clients and prospects, acting as their trusted advisor.

  • Deliver projects, including information security strategy, data protection consultancy, and assessments against frameworks like ISO 27001, CAF and NIST.

  • Stay updated on the latest information security and data protection best practices to provide clients with the best advice.

What we're looking for

If some (or most) of the following sound like you, we'd love to hear from you:

  • A strong background in Information Security and a focus on GRC.

  • A good understanding of information security and data protection.

  • The ability to build relationships with prospective and active clients across the business and act as their trusted advisor, helping them to secure their business through the pragmatic use of technology and protect them from incoming threats.

How We Take Care of You

As well as offering a competitive salary, we have an attractive benefits package including:

We require a security check to be carried out on all colleagues due to the nature of some of our clients’ industries.

Waterstons is committed to creating and an inclusive, understanding, and flexible place to work. We value diversity, equality and inclusion and encourage everyone to 'bring their whole selves' to work. We believe that a company that works to truly embrace and value diversity, create an environment where everyone from any background can do their best work, and feel valued and appreciated is a better company to work for.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Microsoft Fabric & Azure
description:
Location: Hybrid

Division: Engineering

Reports to: Chief Architect - Data and Insights

ABOUT US

Agilisys is at the forefront of digital transformation and innovation in the public services sector. With over two decades of experience, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for governments, local authorities, and organizations nationwide. Our mission is to empower our clients to deliver exceptional public services by harnessing the full potential of technology and data.

OUR VALUES

Partnership: we become one team and family with organisations, helping them to navigate change and stay agile.

Integrity: our people really care, going beyond the brief to make change happen for organisations and citizens.

Innovation: we bring together the right technologies and services to design solutions that work.

Passion: we are passionate about - and dedicated to - public services and improving people’s lives.

THE ROLE

The Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Azure is a senior, hands-on role within Agilisys’ Data & AI Practice. You will take engineering ownership of modern data-platform workstreams from approved design through build, testing, production deployment and handover, with Microsoft Fabric and the Azure Data Platform at the core.

Working closely with architects, analysts, delivery teams and client stakeholders, you will help turn architecture into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. You will also contribute to engineering standards, mentor other engineers and help clients move from proof-of-value or legacy data platforms to production-grade services.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver Fabric and Azure data platforms end to end: Build and productionise Microsoft Fabric solutions using OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Dataflows and Azure Data Factory, including integration with legacy, cloud and on-premises data sources.
  • Engineer reliable data pipelines and models: Design batch, incremental and near-real-time ETL/ELT using SQL, Python and PySpark; apply medallion, dimensional/Kimball, normalised and data-product patterns as appropriate; and use production-grade techniques such as CDC, SCD, schema-change handling, idempotency, retry/replay, backfill and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • Own Dev/Test/Production delivery and CI/CD: Configure Fabric workspace structures and environment-specific settings, and implement controlled promotion using Git, Azure DevOps/GitHub, Fabric Deployment Pipelines, APIs or controlled manual steps where Fabric item limitations require them. Apply branch protection, peer review, testing, approvals, rollback and release evidence.
  • Build for security, governance and compliance: Implement secure-by-design controls using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Fabric workspace/item/data permissions, managed identities or service principals, encryption and appropriate network controls. Work with architects and governance specialists on Fabric-native governance and Microsoft Purview requirements where these are in project scope.
  • Optimise, monitor and troubleshoot production workloads: Tune SQL, Spark, Delta/Parquet storage, partitioning and compute for performance, cost and reliability. Establish monitoring and alerting for pipelines, notebooks, semantic-model refreshes, data freshness and Fabric capacity, and diagnose failures, data-quality issues and performance problems during delivery and hypercare.
  • Support Power BI and data consumption: Work effectively with data analysts for Power BI semantic models and reporting solutions, including Direct Lake and Import concepts, refresh, RLS/OLS, performance and deployment considerations, and enable governed consumption through semantic models, SQL endpoints, data products and APIs where required.
  • Lead engineering delivery and handover: Own assigned engineering workstreams, collaborate with stakeholders, mentor engineers, contribute to design and engineering standards, and produce clear technical documentation including implementation details, HLD/LLD contributions, operational runbooks and knowledge-transfer materials for client and support teams.

ESSENTIAL TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

You will have a strong track record of hands-on data engineering delivery, with the technical depth to work independently and the communication skills to operate confidently with technical and business stakeholders.

  • 5+ years’ commercial data engineering experience, including experience operating at Senior Data Engineer level, with strong recent hands-on Microsoft Fabric delivery experience (ideally 18–24+ months) and demonstrable delivery of at least one production-grade Fabric implementation.
  • Strong Microsoft Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Notebooks and Dev/Test/Production workspace patterns.
  • Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark, with practical experience of Delta/Parquet, medallion architecture and production-grade batch/incremental ETL/ELT.
  • Strong Git and CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub, including controlled release, testing, deployment, rollback and environment promotion practices.
  • Good Azure data-platform experience, including Azure Data Factory and secure cloud/on-premises connectivity using gateway, managed private endpoint or related network patterns where required.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI semantic-model integration, Direct Lake/Import concepts, refresh, RLS/OLS, performance and deployment.
  • Practical experience of Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities/service principals, secure engineering, data quality, testing, troubleshooting, operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Strong stakeholder management, mentoring and communication skills, with the ability to work in fast-moving multidisciplinary teams and contribute constructively to architecture and engineering decisions.
  • Experience of public-sector, local-government or other regulated environments is strongly valued. You must hold active Security Clearance or be eligible and willing to undertake BPSS/security clearance appropriate to client requirements.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE & CERTIFICATION

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700); DP-600 is also beneficial.
  • Microsoft Purview and Fabric-native governance capabilities.
  • Fabric Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstreams and Eventhouse/KQL.
  • Private Link, managed private endpoints, Azure Key Vault and gateway infrastructure.
  • Fabric REST APIs, PowerShell/Azure CLI, Infrastructure as Code and deployment automation.
  • Experience with Databricks and/or Snowflake.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You will join a growing Data & AI Practice delivering modern Data, AI, Analytics and Cloud solutions across the public sector, with particular emphasis on Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. The role offers hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale programmes, complex production challenges and the opportunity to influence how Agilisys designs and engineers modern data platforms.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

This role will offer exposure to the right mix of challenges, within a culture that promotes continuous learning and development.

Benefits include:

  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Access to exclusive discounts and offers through the company’s “Perks at Work” scheme
  • 25 days annual leave (with the option to buy more)

PROCESS

Simply submit your CV.

By submitting your CV, you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role. This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for. You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing talentacquisition@agilisys.co.uk – but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.

We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.

Individuals seeking employment at Agilisys must note that we see diversity as something that creates a better workplace and delivers better outcomes. As such, we are keen to maximise the diversity of our workforce and actively encourage applications from all. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.

The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

Job Description:

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

For TD Bank Group (TD) to remain competitive, it is essential to selectively take and manage risks. TD acknowledges that having a strong risk culture and a robust approach to risk management is fundamental to our ongoing success.

The mandate of the TD Global Compliance Department is to foster a culture of integrity, ethics, and compliance and deliver independent risk management and oversight of regulatory compliance risk and conduct risk throughout The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries globally (TD), to protect our reputation and operate within our risk appetite and is designed to support sustained trust and confidence in TD by our customers, employees, regulators, investors, and markets.

JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Program

If you can find clarity inside complexity, have a keen eye for research and a passion for procedure, this program is for you. Our 24-month Associate Program for new graduates is designed to attract, develop and retain top talent and build a leadership pipeline within Compliance.

The Compliance team assists various TD lines of business to understand regulations applicable to their departments, while also ensuring everyone implements policies and procedures to manage their unique compliance risks. We also conduct ongoing monitoring and testing.

In this program you'll complete four customized, six-month rotations within Compliance where you may learn more about:

  • Central Compliance Functions comprising of: Regulatory Change, Compliance Academy, Quality Assurance Review, Privacy, Testing and FATCA.

  • Compliance Units comprising of: Canadian Banking, Wealth, Insurance, Capital Markets, Corporate Office and Transformation, Enablement and Customer Experience – Platforms Privacy.

We align rotation opportunities with our business strategies to ensure you work on the most important priorities.

What You'll Do

No matter where you work at TD, you’ll make a meaningful impact, grow your skills and thrive in our culture of care. Here’s what that means for each rotation in this program:

Make an Impact

  • Use your strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills to add value to each rotation you're assigned

  • Provide a range of research, analysis, advisory and operational support to internal team members and/or business groups on compliance matters and related program risks

  • Use your strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills to add value to projects you’re assigned

  • Define opportunities for continued enhancements to departmental processes and make recommendations within assigned areas of responsibility

Experience Growth

  • Build a diverse skill set, implement process improvements and develop the confidence to tackle challenging tasks in an entirely new area of each line of business rotation

  • Receive feedback and mentorship from senior management. You’ll connect with senior management and gain valuable experience from experts at the top of their game who can help you develop your leadership skills

  • Learn from your dedicated mentor(s) throughout your 24-month rotation

Cultivate Our Culture of Care

  • Interact with other Associates to share learnings and network within the organization

  • Build strong relationships to identify collaborative opportunities and coordinate efforts across Risk groups.

  • Engage in challenging projects with experienced leaders, supported by a robust team of colleagues, peers, and advisors.

COLLEAGUE DEVELOPMENT

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. Receive regular career, development and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. Whether you have a passion for helping customers and want to expand your experience, or you want to coach and inspire your colleagues, there are many different career paths within our organization at TD – and we’re committed to helping you identify opportunities that support your goals.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

What You Need to Succeed

We’re proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Access, Tableau, Power Point, Power Pivot)

  • Strong conceptual, analytical and problem-solving skills; can see the “big picture” in a complex or ambiguous environment

  • Ability to develop solid business relationships with clients, business partners and stakeholders

  • Well organized; can prioritize multiple tasks and deliver results on multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communicator with the ability to impact and influence others; demonstrated presentation skills

  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion

  • Desire to work in a caring, respectful and inclusive environment where all employees are supported

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Educational Requirements; Must be graduated between May 2025 and May 2027 with a bachelor's degree.

Program Location and Start Date: Toronto-based program which starts in July 2027. Candidates must have graduated prior to start (including final grades, excluding convocation).

Applications Must Include:

  • Transcripts

  • Cover letter, including an explanation of how the Associate Program fits within your career aspirations (one letter-sized page or less)

  • Resume (maximum of 2 pages)

Hours & Workplace Model: Monday–Friday, standard business hours

INCLUSIVENESS

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. We thank all applicants for their interest!

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. title: Automation Tester
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability.

Accountabilities

  • Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards.
  • Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues. .
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested.
  • Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution.
  • Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
  • Partner with other functions and business areas.
  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
  • Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
  • Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
  • Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as an Automation Tester at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as an Automation Tester , you should have experience with:

• Playwright Typescript or java

• Selenium Typescript or java

• SQL

Some other highly valued skills may include:

• Cucumber BDD

• API Testing/UI Testing

• Agile, DevOps, Shift-Left Testing, and Quality Engineering practices

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune, India.
