title: HR Controlling VIE
description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

Forvia: Technology leader in the automotive industry

FORVIA comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA. With over 300 industrial sites and 77 R&D centers, 150,000 people, including more than 35,000 engineers across 40+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow.

Composed of 6 business groups with 24 product lines, and a strong IP portfolio of over 14,000 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMS worldwide.

FORVIA aims at being a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen.

Your mission, roles and responsibilities

Forvia’s VIE Program?
The VIE Program of Forvia is an international young graduate program, which enables young graduates native from the European Economic Area (EU + Norway, Liechtenstein and Iceland) aged between 18 and 28 to work for one of our subsidiary around the world!

Business France, the French agency for international business development, is in charge of all the administrative procedures of your assignment. For further information, please visit the following link: and


PLEASE NOTE: your application must be submitted in English to be considered by our non-French speaking teams in our plants worldwide.

PLEASE NOTE: as part of your international development, you cannot perform a VIE in the country of your citizenship.

Your position and environment?
We are looking for an HR HR Controlling VIE who will provide support to the HEADQUARTERS DIV SHARED SERVICES , and who will be based in Santa Maria da Feira, Portugal.

About the Role:

As a VIE HR Controlling, you will support the management of global Corporate/Headquarters headcount planning. You will play a key role in ensuring workforce decisions are aligned with business priorities, budget constraints, and forecast assumptions.

  • Workforce Planning & Headcount Monitoring

    • Monitor worldwide Corporate/Headquarters headcount evolution against approved budget and forecast.
    • Track hiring activities and workforce movements, identifying potential deviations from approved plans.
    • Support the preparation of monthly headcount and workforce planning reviews.

    Hiring Governance & Exception Requests

    • Coordinate the review of hiring exception requests across Corporate/ HQR.
    • Verify alignment of recruitment requests with approved headcount budgets and workforce forecasts.
    • Challenge and validate assumptions with HR Business Partners and Finance stakeholders when needed.

    Forecast & Cost Control Support

    • Monitor the execution of workforce-related initiatives designed to secure budget and forecast targets.
    • Support the preparation of workforce forecasts and scenario analyses.

    HR Analytics & Decision Support

    • Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reporting tools.
    • Perform ad hoc analyses on workforce, organizational, and talent topics for senior HR leadership.
    • Support the Talent & Organization Development (TOD) team with strategic analyses and presentations.

    Continuous Improvement

    • Participate in the enhancement of HR controlling processes, reporting tools, and governance mechanisms.
    • Contribute to data quality initiatives and reporting automation.

Your profile and competencies to succeed

Profile

Education

  • Master's degree (or equivalent) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and numerical capabilities.
  • Advanced Excel skills; Power BI knowledge is a strong advantage.
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and transform them into actionable insights.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in an international and multicultural environment.

Languages

  • Fluent English required.

What You Will Gain

  • Exposure to global workforce planning and HR governance topics.
  • Direct interaction with Corporate HR, Finance, and international leadership teams.
  • Experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, and strategic decision support.
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact initiatives supporting the company's transformation and growth strategy.

What we can do for you

  • You will work within an international team full of energy;
  • You will work on challenges that matter;
  • You will find a strong emphasis on talent development and abundant opportunities for growth;
  • You will have the autonomy to launch processes and to be accountable for them as a process owner;
  • A powerful VIE community spirit within Forvians.

Why join us

FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.

With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R&D engineers across 40+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.

In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.

FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen.


Salary Range: EUR 2 677,43 €

title: MIG-Hitsaaja Järvenpäähän
description:

* Hyvä suomenkielentaito
* Hyvät tiimityöskentelytaidot



Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen työn toistaiseksi voimassaolevan työsuhteen sekä hyvän palkkauksen.



Lisätiedot: Anni Koskela / 050 4622817 / Anni.koskela@wirestaff.fi



WIRESTAFF on tuore, mutta kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija. Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset.   • Experience with source code, build, deploy, orchestration and configuration management tools.

  • Experience in writing code and scripts in at least one high-level programming language.

  • An eye to identify and a desire to resolve insufficiencies and manual activities via automation.

title: AI-Technical Lead
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The Opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role

As an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technical Lead, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 8+ Years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

  • As an AI Tech Lead, you will help design, build, and optimize AI-first systems and solutions that advance our digital capabilities and create real value for our clients.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a multidisciplinary AI team.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business opportunities and AI use cases.
  • Translate abstract business problems into concrete, innovative AI solutions.
  • Drive code quality, robust architecture, and documentation within technical teams.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and upskilling within the AI team.
  • You will collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Work on Valtech’s various AI Accelerators

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI engineering and 10+ years of overall work experience.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Python.
  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices including source control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies and managed AI services such as Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI Platform.
  • Understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, and ethical AI development.
  • Understanding of AI Concepts like LLMs, RAG, AgenticAI, MCPs. Stay updated with the latest AI research and technologies.
  • Prior involvement in MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, and automation of AI workflows.
  • Strong critical thinking, communication, and teamwork skills, with a willingness to share ideas and collaborate.
  • Zeal to learn & Excel.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Full Time position based in Bengaluru.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

title: Backend Developer Senior
description:
H3RE è un'agenzia PropTech che integra marketing, progettazione visiva e sviluppo software per operatori del settore immobiliare. Accanto all'attività di servizio, l'azienda sviluppa prodotti proprietari: la presente ricerca riguarda una posizione dedicata al prodotto, non alle commesse cliente.


Il progetto

La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo backend di una piattaforma di marketing intelligence per il real estate, concepita per collegare la spesa pubblicitaria all'intero funnel di vendita, dall'impression al contratto firmato. Il prototipo e le specifiche funzionali sono già definiti; l'interfaccia è in fase avanzata di progettazione interna.

In una seconda fase, la stessa figura contribuirà all'infrastruttura di un ulteriore prodotto proprietario in ambito assicurativo, attualmente in fase di prototipazione, destinato a un'utenza professionale enterprise.


Responsabilità

  • Progettazione e sviluppo delle API e del modello dati della piattaforma, in architettura multi-tenant e multilingua (IT/EN)
  • Integrazione delle sorgenti dati: Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, portali immobiliari e CRM dei clienti
  • Realizzazione delle pipeline di ingestion e dei processi di sincronizzazione, con gestione di rate limit, retry e dati parziali o incoerenti
  • Implementazione della logica di attribuzione lungo il funnel: lead, visita, trattativa, rogito
  • Gestione di autenticazione, ruoli, permessi e isolamento dei dati per cliente
  • Deployment, monitoraggio e ottimizzazione delle performance sulle query analitiche
  • Definizione e manutenzione della documentazione tecnica dell'infrastruttura


Requisiti

  • Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo backend, di cui almeno un progetto nel quale si sia definita in prima persona l'architettura, dalla fase iniziale fino alla messa in produzione, senza subentrare a un sistema già impostato da terzi
  • Esperienza con clienti enterprise o in contesti regolamentati: audit trail, tracciabilità delle operazioni, gestione dei dati personali in conformità al GDPR
  • Solida competenza su database relazionali (PostgreSQL) e sulla progettazione di schemi per carichi analitici
  • Esperienza documentabile di integrazione con API di terze parti, inclusi flussi di autenticazione OAuth
  • Padronanza di containerizzazione e pipeline CI/CD
  • Capacità di lavorare a partire da specifiche di prodotto, con l'autonomia necessaria a segnalarne i limiti quando presenti
  • Italiano fluente; inglese tecnico


Stack tecnologico

Non è previsto un vincolo tecnologico predeterminato. Si richiede padronanza effettiva di un ecosistema backend moderno e diffuso - Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, Java/Kotlin o C# - unita alla capacità di argomentare in sede di colloquio perché la tecnologia proposta risulti la più adeguata a questo specifico caso d'uso. PostgreSQL è assunto come base di partenza sul fronte dati.


Requisiti preferenziali

  • Esperienza su piattaforme di advertising o su dati di marketing
  • Conoscenza di soluzioni analitiche dedicate (ClickHouse, BigQuery, DuckDB) o di strategie di materializzazione su PostgreSQL
  • Familiarità con il settore immobiliare o assicurativo
  • Aver già accompagnato un prodotto SaaS dal prototipo alla prima release commerciale


Modalità di lavoro

Team ridotto, processi decisionali brevi e interlocuzione diretta con la direzione di prodotto. Il frontend viene prototipato internamente e l'interfaccia arriva già definita.


Processo di selezione

  1. Colloquio conoscitivo con la direzione
  2. Colloquio tecnico, con la partecipazione di un consulente tecnico interno.
  3. Prova pratica retribuita di breve durata: progettazione dello schema dati e del flusso di ingestion per una sorgente advertising, con relativa nota di motivazione delle scelte architetturali
  4. Proposta


Candidature

  • Inviare curriculum a jobs@h3re.it, indicando due o tre progetti backend significativi e specificando il proprio contributo diretto in ciascuno. Repository pubbliche o documentazione di API progettate in prima persona sono considerate elemento di valutazione preferenziale rispetto alla lettera di presentazione.

title: Senior NetSuite Finance Consultant
description:
Position Title: Senior NetSuite Finance Consultant

Work Arrangement / Work Shift: Remote / UK time

Role Overview:

The Senior NetSuite Finance Consultant will provide senior functional expertise across Oracle NetSuite Finance, with a strong focus on Order-to-Cash (O2C), Salesforce/CPQ integration, billing, and revenue recognition. Approximately 80% of the role will focus on O2C and related commercial integrations, with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) as a secondary area. The successful candidate will work across Finance, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, IT, and external partners to design, support, and improve scalable NetSuite solutions.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • * Own and support NetSuite Order-to-Cash processes, including:

  • * Sales Orders

  • * Billing Schedules

  • * Invoicing

  • * Accounts Receivable

  • * Customer payments

  • * Credit memos

  • * Revenue Recognition

  • * Advanced Revenue Management

  • * Support and improve integrations between Salesforce, CPQ platforms, and NetSuite.

  • * Understand the end-to-end process from: Salesforce / CPQ → Sales Order → Billing → Revenue Recognition → Invoice → Cash.

  • * Work with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and technical teams to ensure accurate flow of customer, product, pricing, contract, billing, and revenue data.

  • * Investigate and resolve issues related to Salesforce/CPQ and NetSuite integrations.

  • * Support complex billing requirements, including recurring billing, billing schedules, milestone billing, and subscription-based models.

  • * Provide strong functional expertise in NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management and revenue recognition.

  • * Support Procure-to-Pay processes as a secondary responsibility, including:

    • * Purchase Orders

    • * Vendor Bills

    • * Vendor Payments

    • * Vendor Credits

    • * Approval workflows

    • * Procurement integrations

    • * Provide functional support across wider NetSuite Finance modules, including:

    • * General Ledger

    • * Accounts Payable

    • * Accounts Receivable

    • * Record-to-Report

    • * Intercompany

    • * Multi-currency

    • * OneWorld / Multi-subsidiary

    • * Fixed Assets

    • * Amortization

    • * Month-end and period close

  • * Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable NetSuite solutions.

  • * Support configuration, enhancements, testing, UAT, releases, and production issue resolution.

  • * Work closely with NetSuite developers and integration teams on functional and technical requirements.

  • * Perform root-cause analysis and drive issues through to resolution.

What You’ll Need:

  • * At least 5 years of strong hands-on NetSuite Finance experience.

  • * Deep expertise in Order-to-Cash.

  • * Strong experience with Salesforce and/or CPQ integrations with NetSuite.

  • * Strong knowledge of:

    • * Sales Orders

    • * Billing Schedules

    • * Accounts Receivable

    • * Revenue Recognition

    • * Advanced Revenue Management

  • * Good understanding of complex billing and subscription-based business models.

  • * Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay.

  • * Broad knowledge of NetSuite Finance modules and accounting processes.

  • * Experience working with NetSuite OneWorld and multi-entity environments.

  • * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • * Ability to work effectively across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, IT, and external partners.

  • * Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • * NetSuite certification is preferred.

What Will Set You Apart:

  • * Good understanding of NetSuite SuiteScript and customization concepts.

  • * Experience with SuiteFlow / NetSuite workflows.

  • * Understanding of NetSuite APIs, REST/SOAP web services, and integration architecture.

  • * Experience with integration platforms such as Celigo, Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or similar.

  • * Experience with Coupa, Payhawk, Concur, or similar finance and procurement systems.

  • * Experience in SaaS, subscription, or recurring-revenue businesses.

---

About Atticus:

Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc. is a specialized remote staffing and IT offshoring firm based in the Philippines, providing vetted, high-quality Filipino talent to global tech startups, SMEs, and consulting firms, focusing heavily on niche areas like ERP (NetSuite), Accounting and Finance and IT, offering integrated recruiting, upskilling, and HR support to ensure high retention and reliable offshore teams.

Atticus provides a comprehensive solution for international companies to build dedicated, outsourced teams and efficiently scale their technical and administrative capabilities by leveraging skilled Filipino talent, managed with a focus on quality and long-term retention. We ensure the teams perform like extensions of the client’s own operations.

Who We Are:

We are a customer-focused organization that puts people at the heart of everything we do. We believe great outcomes come from strong collaboration, where ideas are openly shared and teamwork is valued.

Our team members are proactive and confident—they take ownership, speak up, and are not afraid to ask questions. We encourage curiosity and continuous improvement, empowering everyone to challenge the status quo and find better ways of working.

We foster a growth mindset, where learning is continuous, feedback is welcomed, and mistakes are seen as opportunities to grow. Here, you are supported to develop your skills, improve processes, and make a meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:

At Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc, we value our employees and provide a positive and collaborative work environment. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, annual leaves, health and medical insurances. Our culture offers flexible working arrangement and opportunities for growth and development.

title: LEGOLAND® Resort søger ny Facility-elektriker med interesse for CTS
description:
Roller og ansvar

LEGOLAND® Resort søger ny Facility-elektriker med interesse for CTS

Trives du i en hverdag med alsidige opgaver, høj faglighed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab? Er du faglært elektriker og har du lyst til et alsidigt job i en unik virksomhed med fokus på samarbejde og variation? Så er du måske vores nye Facility elektriker i Teknisk Drift.

Parkens Facility afdeling leder efter dig til vores team af 6 dygtige og engagerede elektrikere. I Facility-afdelingen bliver du primært ansvarlig for CTS og driften af HVAC-anlæg. Om sommeren er du med til at holde parken i gang, og om vinteren vil opgaverne fordele sig på vedligehold af maskiner og anlæg samt forskellige projekter.

Du bliver en del af et team på 6 dygtige og engagerede elektrikere, hvor samarbejde og faglig stolthed er i centrum.

Vi forventer, at du har en uddannelse som elektriker, gerne med nogle års erfaring indenfor faget. Derudover har du kendskab til følgende;

  • Kontrol og fejlfinding på CTS, køl, ventilation og varme
  • KLS-systemer – installationer og test, samt dokumentation – iht. DS/HD 60364
  • Vedligeholdssystemer
  • Netværksinstallationer / kameraovervågning
  • Service og vedligehold af tekniske anlæg, maskiner og hvidevarer
  • Officepakkens programmer

Electrical manager Søren fortæller om jobbet: ”Som min nye elektriker kan du se frem til en indholdsrig hverdag, hvor der aldrig er to dage, der er ens. Der er fuld fart over feltet i åbningssæsonen, hvor vores tekniske anlæg, køkkener og butikker skal fungere optimalt for at sikre vores gæster en god oplevelse. Udenfor sæsonen vil du få egne ansvarsområder og styre forskellige renoverings- og udviklingsprojekter, hovedsageligt med henblik på indeklima”

Kvalifikationer og erfaring

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har en uddannelse som elektriker - gerne med nogle års erfaring
  • Har godt kendskab til tekniske installationer og vedligehold
  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på dokumentation og systemer
  • Har godt humør og trives i et team med høj faglighed og samarbejde
  • Kommunikerer på både dansk og engelsk
  • Bevarer overblikket og roen - også når det går stærkt
  • Er serviceminded og tager ansvar både selvstændigt og i fællesskab

Fordele

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med frihed under ansvar, indflydelse på planlægning og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling. Der er tale om en meget afvekslende hverdag, hvor samarbejde og holdånd er afgørende.

Arbejdstiden er i gennemsnit 37 timer pr. uge. I åbningssæsonen indgår du i en vagtordning alle ugens 7 dage, og derfor er det et krav, at du bor inden for rimelig afstand af Billund. Der vil være en grundig oplæring, så du bliver fortrolig med parkens tekniske installationer. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Electrical Manager Søren Steppat på tlf. 23 36 38 15.

Vi ansætter løbende, så send din ansøgning snarest muligt.

title: Cybersecurity - Summer 2027 Corporate Internship
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.


DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

The Cybersecurity and Digital Trust Intern will be embedded within the following teams throughout the 11-week experience to gain exposure to a wide breadth of capabilities/processes as defined below.

Cybersecurity Engineering

  • Consult with technology and security staff to ensure that security is factored into the evaluation, selection, installation and configuration of hardware, applications, and software.

  • Recommend and coordinate the implementation of technical controls to support and enforce defined security policies

  • Provide technical expertise for the implementation and management of security tools such as EDR, PKI, enterprise firewalls, and secrets management

Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, & Incident Response

  • Perform security event log monitoring and analysis for applications and infrastructure in both DSG and third-party environments to identify possible cybersecurity threats

  • Gathering, analyze, and assess the current and future threat landscape to provide a realistic overview of risks and threats in the enterprise environment. Application/Platform Security

  • Utilize commercial and open-source intelligence providers to gain insight into adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, as well as planned activities and emerging motivations

  • Participates in security incident response, including incident detection, containment, investigation, eradication, and recovery.

Digital Fraud

  • Develop platforms to identify, assess, and prevent fraudulent omnichannel transactions.

  • Protect revenue and bot product acquisition

Application/Platform Security

  • Manage web application firewall configuration to prevent web-based attacks such as account takeover, DDoS, malicious code, and other application-based attacks.

  • Provide secure-coding expertise to developers

  • Identify and mitigate bot traffic

Vulnerability Management

  • Identify vulnerabilities across infrastructure, platforms, and applications.

  • Create reporting to identify vulnerability risk and remediation priority.

  • Partner with engineers and developers to remediate identified vulnerabilities, including providing guidance on root cause and specific remediation actions.

Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC):

  • Perform risk assessments of processes and technologies to identify policy compliance and appropriateness of security controls.

  • Serve as a second line of defense for PCI and SOX by evaluating control design and effectiveness.

  • Create security awareness training content and conduct ethical phishing campaigns.

Business Resilience

  • Conduct business impact analyses to identify the criticality of business processes

  • Document business continuity plans to identify people process, and technology dependencies and how to continue business operations during a continuity event

Privacy

  • Perform privacy impact assessments of process and technologies to identify determine data usage in alignment with privacy policy and privacy best practices

  • Respond to consumer privacy rights requests

Some of your experiences will include:


• Multi day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your classmates
• Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as develop their business acumen and office professionalism
• Extensive exposure to our senior leadership through our exclusive intern only Executive Speaker Series which includes a private meet & greet with our CEO
• Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events
• Working a 40 hour work week, Monday – Friday

We look for potential candidate with:

  • Graduation date in Winter 2027 or Spring 2028

  • Attending an accredited university, college, or technical school
    with a major in Cyber Security, Information Sciences & Technology, Computer Science, Management Information systems, or other related majors.

  • An interest and passion for cybersecurity and digital trust areas of focus.

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027

Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:


Interns qualified for full-time opportunities will be evaluated at the end of the program.

Perks:

  • Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*

  • Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG

  • Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.

  • Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th

  • Teammate Discount

  • Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office

  • Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks

  • Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders

  • Executive Speaker Series

  • Professional development

  • Volunteer opportunities

  • Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office.

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. I especially appreciated the collaborative environment and the opportunity to apply both creative and strategic thinking. This experience has strengthened my passion for the retail industry, and I would love the opportunity to come back and continue growing with the DSG team in the future." – Sarah Cyphers, Merchandising Intern

Interested to learn more? Watch our Internship Recap Video!

  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment

title: Programme Manager
description:
Company culture

Transparity is a fast-growing IT company focusing on Microsoft Cloud based solutions. Our culture has an enviable reputation in the industry which we work hard to maintain. We are focused on creating an inclusive environment where our employees thrive based upon integrity, strong work ethic, a one-team ethos, desire to learn and develop and a commitment to deliver unwavering service excellence to our customers, vendors and partners. Therefore, first and foremost we recruit with our cultural fit in mind.

Job Overview/Purpose

Every day may be different – it’s the nature of managing programmes and complex projects!

Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that programmes and large-scale projects under your management run smoothly, delivering value and aligning with strategic business objectives. You will oversee multiple interrelated projects within a programme while also being hands-on in managing individual complex projects when required. If you are a passionate Programme Manager who thrives on strategic oversight, stakeholder engagement, and driving successful outcomes, then come and join our enthusiastic team.

This role is a blend of customer-facing programme and project management (65% billable work), supporting direct reports (20% line management) and supporting our sales organisation (15% Pre-Sales engagement). You will be hands-on in ensuring successful customer deliveries while also contributing to business growth by managing a team successfully, shaping proposals, engaging in pre-sales discussions, and helping to define the strategic direction of new engagements.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be liaising with our wonderful Customers (both new and longstanding) and working with nearly all areas of the business, including Pre-Sales, Commercial, Consultancy, Support, and Finance. Your activities will include strategic planning, overseeing programme delivery, directly managing high-impact projects, forecasting, communicating progress, mitigating risks, and managing interdependencies. You will also manage budgets and ensure that projects within the programme deliver value and align with business goals.

You will play a key role in programme governance, ensuring projects contribute effectively to the overall objectives of the programme and business strategy.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the successful delivery of complex customer programmes, ensuring projects align with strategic goals and deliver measurable business value.

  • Take ownership of high-profile, business-critical projects while providing leadership and guidance across a wider project portfolio.

  • Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor and ensuring an exceptional delivery experience from initiation through to completion.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Consultants and Solution Architects to shape delivery strategies, support new opportunities and influence customer roadmaps.

  • Drive programme governance, planning, risk management and financial performance, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

  • Mentor and develop a team of Project Managers, fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on continuous improvement and customer success.

  • Provide strategic oversight across your portfolio, proactively managing risks, resolving challenges and identifying opportunities to improve delivery outcomes and commercial performance.

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Proven track record delivering complex projects and multi-workstream programmes in a Microsoft Partner or professional services environment.

  • Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring, developing and inspiring Project Managers to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, driving profitability and balancing customer success with business objectives.

  • Strategic thinker who can translate business goals into successful programme roadmaps and delivery plans.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage and influence customers, partners and senior leaders at all levels.

  • Hands-on programme and project delivery expertise, with the ability to balance governance, risk management and execution in fast-paced environments.

  • Relevant programme or project management certifications (MSP, PgMP, PRINCE2, PMP or similar) alongside a proactive, solution-focused mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

Disability Confident

Transparity have a proactive attitude when it comes to looking after the wellbeing and inclusion of all our employees. We promote equal opportunities through our recruitment process and a positive, inclusive culture across the business which we are proud of. We are diverse in our approach to recruitment and recognise that talent comes in all different forms. The diversity in our team is what helps our business work so well.

To find out more about our disability commitment please contact People & Culture or ask during the interview.

Our Offering

In addition to a competitive salary, there are a number of benefits and perks we offer to say thank you for being a part of our journey:

  • To work at a 3* World Class Best Company

  • Flexibility over where you work with our Winning from Anywhere® approach

  • 25 days holiday

  • Home working allowance paid monthly

  • Winning from Anywhere® allowance to help your set up at home

  • 24/7 GP at hand

  • Immediate 24/7 access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • We’ll support you when you’re not well with our Company sick pay scheme

  • 4x base salary life assurance

  • Private health insurance after a successful year’s service

  • Enhanced parental pay and leave, supporting you with those precious life moments

  • Access to the Perkbox platform to help make your money go further

  • Cyclescheme

  • Electric car scheme

  • And many more!

AI in our recruitment process

At Transparity becoming a Frontier organisation is key to our success, so we use AI to support our recruitment team with tasks such as note‑taking and automating parts of the recruitment process so we can focus more time on meaningful, human conversations and providing a positive candidate experience.

We do not use AI to review, screen, score, or rank applications. All hiring decisions are made by people.

If you have questions about our recruitment process or need adjustments at any stage, please let us know, we’re happy to help.

title: Myyjä/varastovastaava 25h/vko
description:
Mahtavaa, että olet kiinnostunut liittymään Gina Tricot -tiimiimme!



Mitä sinun tulee tietää meistä?

Meille tärkeintä on WOW-fiilis! Haluamme, että meillä työskentely ja asiointi on hauskaa. Rakastamme asiakkaitamme sekä työntekijöitämme ja haluamme tarjota heille yllättäviä elämyksiä ja hauskoja hetkiä myymälöissämme. Arvomme ovat Passion & Commitment, Teamwork, Smartness sekä Challenge, ja ne ovat mukana kaikessa mitä teemme. Meillä voit sekä kehittyä itse, auttaa kehittämään toimintaamme ja edetä urallasi. Gina Tricot on toiminut Suomessa vuodesta 2007, ja tiimissämme on yhä työntekijöitä, jotka ovat olleet mukana alusta saakka. Työtehtävät ovat tosin voineet muuttua useastikin matkan varrella – meillä aidosti viihdytään ja haluamme tarjota myös kehittymismahdollisuuksia. Kun töissä on hyvä ilmapiiri, se välittyy asiakkaillemme!



Nyt haemme Sellon myymäläämme määräaikaiseen (10/2026-03/2027) työsuhteeseen myyjää, jolla on vastuu varastonhallinnasta. Viikkotyöaika on keskimäärin 25h/vko.

Etsimme sinua, joka:

* Olet motivoitunut, oma-aloitteinen, ja kykenet työskentelemään tehokkaasti

* Osaat viestiä selkeästi ja kannustavasti tiimille, ja pidät huolen siitä, että kaikki ovat ajan tasalla varastotilanteesta

* Olet helposti lähestyttävä ja teet yhteistyötä sujuvasti erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

* Et kaihda fyysistä työtä, vaan suhtaudut siihen myönteisesti ja innokkaasti

* Olet ahkera ja innovatiivinen – keksit luovia ratkaisuja tilanhallinnan haasteisiin

* Sopeudut hyvin muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja reagoit niihin joustavasti

* Aamuisin herätys sujuu sinulta helposti, ja jaksat aloittaa päivän pirteästi

* Osaat ottaa vastaan yllätyksiä ja johdat omaa työtäsi hallitusti

* Sinulla on positiivinen asenne, halu oppia uutta ja kehittyä jatkuvasti

Pääasiallisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu varastotyöskentely, eli kuormien purkaminen ja lajittelu, varaston järjestyksestä ja siisteydestä huolehtiminen, inventaariot ja tuotehuolto. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää itsenäistä, ripeää ja järjestelmällistä otetta. Varastotyön lisäksi osallistut myymälätyöskentelyyn ja myyjänä Gina Tricot'lla rakastat muotia ja asiakaspalvelua!

Meillä Gina Tricot'lla saat työskennellä inspiroivassa ympäristössä kannustavan tiimin kanssa, ja opit kaiken monipuolisesta myymälätyöstä. Meille tärkeintä on onnellinen asiakas, joka saa inspiraatiota ja energiaa työssään viihtyviltä työntekijöiltämme. Varastotyöskentely sijoittuu pääasiassa arkiaamuihin, mutta toivomme, että voit työskennellä joustavasti kaikkina myymälän aukioloaikoina. Kokemus myymälätyöstä ei ole välttämätöntä, koulutamme sinut tehtävään. Tärkeintä on halu oppia nopeasti, myönteinen asenne ja kyky toimia tehokkaasti ja iloisesti kaikissa tilanteissa. Meillä yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen ja töissä saa olla hauskaa!

Meille monimuotoisuus on vahvuus. Sitoudumme tasa-arvoiseen rekrytointiin ja kannustamme kaikkia hakijoita hakemaan tehtävään – erilaiset kokemukset ja näkökulmat rikastuttavat työyhteisöämme.

title: Director, Pre-Construction, APAC
description:
About Vantage


Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.



Position Overview


Vantage Data Centers is looking for a Director, Pre-Construction, APAC to provide overall pre-construction leadership for the growing Design, Engineering and Construction team and key internal partners, including New Site Development (NSD) and Site Selection (SSA), as the company expands across the region.

This role will be responsible for new and existing developments across new and existing sites, Working with Stakeholder teams on Due Diligence works on new sites, providing Design and Construction inputs (through consultation with the DE&C Teams), development of concept and schematic design with the Engineering team, Assisting with Consultant engagements and on-boarding, entitlement and permitting, and all aspects of pre-construction with general contractors and Project Management teams.

As a leader, this position will work seamlessly with multiple projects and teams, ensuring all pre-construction activities are aligned with strategic corporate objectives and supporting successful project delivery from early development through construction readiness.


Essential Job Functions

Lead development and planning approval processes, including master and precinct planning, development planning, and construction permitting

Support utilities provisioning negotiations, with particular emphasis on power and networking provision with the NSD team

Partner with project teams to resolve data center designs that deliver Tier III data centers at optimal cost and in alignment with design parameters

Work with the Project Controls team to advise on programme, cost, buildability, regional statutory, consultant, and Early Contractor Involvement (ECI).

Manage Vantage’s build partners through technical feedback, review, and active participation in schedule and budget management during the pre-construction phase.


Duties

  • Assist with procurement and tender strategy for professional services, works, and where applicable, supply contracts for significant plant and equipment in partnership with the APAC OFCI team

  • Work with Project Controls on pre-construction programmes and micro-programmes, and contribute to the master construction programme

  • Work with general contractors, architects, and engineers to lead the project ECI phase

  • Manage direct reports, third-party project management resources, and staffing utilization

  • Create and manage RFPs for consultants and providers

  • Obtain project budgets, working with the Construction Commercial Team

  • Partner with stakeholders in Construction Cost and Finance to produce monthly project forecasts, including variance analyses

  • Ensure lessons learned are captured and placed into the feedback loop to drive continuous improvement


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or similar field, or equivalent experience

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in a management role required; 10 to 15 years preferred

  • Complex and technical construction experience required

  • Data center experience preferred

  • Experience in CSA and MEP construction management required

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools such as MS Project or P6

  • Experience developing executive-level presentations

  • Substantial project management experience preferred; PMP certification

title: Senior Accountmanager
description:
Bij Easyfairs houden we van live events: ze verbinden mensen en communities, laten zien wat er speelt in uiteenlopende industrieën en stimuleren innovaties. Wij willen betekenisvolle ervaringen bieden die onze exposanten en bezoekers niet snel vergeten.

Bij Easyfairs werk je in een dynamische omgeving waar gedrevenheid en plezier samenkomen. Als een van de wereldwijde top 20 beursorganisatoren bieden we je veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor ondernemerschap en volop kansen om je te ontwikkelen. We zijn ervan overtuigd dat een werkomgeving met fun als pijler leidt tot betere prestaties en tevreden teams. Samen bereiken we pieken, vieren we onze successen en brengen we mensen samen.

Senior Accountmanager Agri & Horti

Ben jij een ervaren B2B-salesprofessional die energie krijgt van zelf verkopen, sterke klantrelaties bouwen en commerciële kansen creëren? Sta jij graag midden in de markt, weet je hoe je strategische partners aan je bindt en krijg je er energie van om collega’s mee te nemen in jouw commerciële aanpak? Dan hebben we een mooie uitdaging voor je!

Voor ons Agri & Horti team zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal belangrijke klanten en strategische partners en tegelijkertijd een belangrijke commerciële rol speelt binnen het team. Je bent iemand die de markt in wil, gesprekken voert, deuren opent en deals sluit.

Tegelijkertijd kijken we graag met je vooruit. Deze functie is er ook op ingericht om door te groeien naar een leidinggevende salesrol. Op termijn kun je je verantwoordelijkheid uitbreiden naar het aansturen en coachen van een salesteam bestaande meerdere accountmanagers. Maar eerst laten we je vooral doen waar je goed in bent: verkopen, relaties bouwen en de beurzen verder ontwikkelen.

Wat deze rol interessant maakt

Je krijgt bij ons niet alleen een portefeuille om te beheren, maar vooral de ruimte om iets op te bouwen. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid over belangrijke relaties, ruimte om nieuwe partnerships te ontwikkelen en de mogelijkheid om zichtbaar impact te maken op onze beurzen binnen de Agri & Horti-markt.

Dit ga je doen

Samen met het team werk je aan de verdere groei van onze vakbeurzen binnen de Agri- & Horti-sector. Je kent de markt of hebt de nieuwsgierigheid en commerciële drive om deze snel te doorgronden. Je weet wat er speelt bij klanten, kent de belangrijkste spelers en ziet waar kansen liggen.

  • Je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor een aantal strategische klanten, prospects en partnerships.

  • Je bouwt actief aan je netwerk en weet relaties uit te bouwen tot langdurige commerciële partnerships.

  • Je bent veel in gesprek met de markt: je bezoekt klanten, bent aanwezig op relevante momenten en weet wat er speelt binnen de sector.

  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete proposities en deals.

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen commerciële resultaten en werkt gestructureerd aan het behalen van je doelstellingen.

  • Vanuit je senioriteit ben je een commerciële kartrekker binnen het team en deel je kennis, ervaring en best practices met collega's.

  • Je denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling en positionering van onze beurzen en brengt inzichten vanuit de markt actief in.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met Marketing en andere collega's binnen het beursteam om onze events ieder jaar verder te laten groeien.

  • Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen richting een toekomstige leidinggevende sales-rol.

title: Digital Transformation Program Manager
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.

The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. The role requires strong program leadership, business process expertise, stakeholder management, change leadership, and execution excellence in a global environment.

As a Program or Project Manager at Lam, you will play a pivotal role in driving projects/programs for Digital Transformation. You’ll be at the forefront of project initiation through delivery, using your expertise to coordinate cross-functional teams and ensuring projects are completed on time and within budget. In this role, you will directly contribute to the successful digital transformation of our organization.

The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. The role requires strong program leadership, business process expertise, stakeholder management, change leadership, and execution excellence in a global environment.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process.
  • Run change management for projects and programs and support proper project closure.
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and timely delivery.
  • Utilize Jira for project tracking, testing, cutover, and deployment processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or related field with 10-12+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 8+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.

It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits.

title: Young Person's Resilience Worker
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options. Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We are looking for a passionate, motivated and resilient individual to join our team as a Young Person's Resilience Worker.

This is more than a job. It's an opportunity to make a genuine difference to the lives of young people age up to 25 affected by substance use.

One day you could be supporting a young person in school, helping them navigate difficult choices. The next, session working alongside partner agencies, or helping a young person identify goals and build the confidence to achieve them.

If you thrive on building relationships, thinking creatively and helping young people overcome barriers, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Horsham, West Sussex

Working Hours: Fulltime hours 37.5 hours per weekContract Type: 1 year fixed term contact

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

What You'll Be Doing

You'll work directly with young people aged up to 25 who are experiencing difficulties related to drug and alcohol use, helping them make safer choices and achieve positive outcomes.

The role includes:

  • Building trusted relationships with young people and families
  • Completing assessments and creating tailored support plans
  • Supporting young people in schools, communities and other outreach settings
  • Identifying and managing risk and safeguarding concerns
  • Working closely with partner agencies and professionals
  • Delivering training and raising awareness around issues affecting young people
  • Maintaining accurate and timely case records

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Passionate about supporting young people
  • Non-judgemental, approachable and compassionate
  • A confident communicator who can engage young people from diverse backgrounds
  • Resilient and able to manage challenging situations professionally
  • Organised and able to manage a varied caseload
  • A strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively

Experience of working with young people, safeguarding, adolescent development, substance use or related issues would be beneficial, but most importantly we're looking for someone who shares our values and commitment to making a difference.

What we will give to you:

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Additionally, you'll receive one extra day of annual leave for each year of service during your first five years, therefore you will enjoy 30 days of leave after five years with us.
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities
  • Generous Refer-a-Friend Scheme

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

description:
Role Type:

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Department Overview

The Canadian Card Payments, Loyalty & Personal Lending (CCPL&PL) department is a dynamic team responsible for strategy, product development, customer lifecycle management and the financial performance of all Canadian credit card and personal lending products.

We consistently innovate our Canadian credit cards with industry-leading digital capabilities: TD Consumer and Business credit cards are found in wallets across Canada, thanks to the ease and convenience our products offer. We also leverage our retail distribution network, direct response channels and key co-brand partnerships (including Aeroplan and Amazon) to deliver unexpectedly human perks for our valued customers.

Our team's overall goal is to help customers build better lives with simplified borrowing solutions that not only serve their needs but are accessible to all our customers across all channels.

Job Details

About The Program

The Canadian Card Payments, Loyalty and Personal Lending Associate Program is an immersive 24-month program designed to help you step into our world of Canadian Credit Cards and personal lending products through challenging projects and assignments alongside experienced colleagues at the top of their game. The goal of the program is to help you develop strong analytical skills to determine the business impact of our product offerings and understand how it all relates back to our customers.

If you're customer-focused, business-savvy and have a knack for product appeal, we want you to be part of our leadership rotational program.

In this program you’ll rotate* across Canadian Credit Cards and Personal Lending business units every six months:

  • Product Management

  • Project Delivery & Execution

  • Loyalty & Partnerships

  • Credit Risk & Loss Mitigation

*We align rotation opportunities with our business strategies to ensure you work on the most important priorities.

What You’ll Do

No matter where you work at TD you'll make a meaningful impact, grow your skills and thrive in our culture of care. Here's what that means as a Canadian Credit Card and Personal Lending associate:

Make an Impact:

  • Use your strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills to add value to each rotation you're assigned

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues across the Canadian Credit Card Businesses in addition to various support partners

Experience Growth:

  • Participate in unique development opportunities, such as learning sessions with principal Credit Card partners

  • Spend time with executive leadership for mentorship and presentations

  • Get regular access to personal brand development sessions

Cultivate Our Culture of Care:

  • Act as a Canadian Credit Cards, Loyalty and Personal Lending Associate Program ambassador by supporting future cohorts

  • Participate in internal committees to drive positive change as well as community events to make an impact on our greater customer and colleague community

Job Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

We're proud to work with a diverse group of colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn’t mentioned below, tell us in your resume or cover letter:

  • A self-starter who can work autonomously and be a strong team player

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to navigate through ambiguity

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

  • Inquisitive with a proven ability to learn in unfamiliar environments

  • Innovative Thought Leader

  • Microsoft Office Suite Skills (including Excel)

  • Jira experience is an asset

  • Adaptable and resilient

  • A focus on customer service and building strong relationships

  • Desire to work in a caring, respectful and inclusive environment where all employees are supported

Additional Information

Educational Requirements

  • Undergraduate degree in a business-related field. Must be graduated by May 2027 with an Undergraduate degree in a business-related field

Program Location and Start Date

This is a Toronto-based program which starts in July 2027.

Applications must include:

  • Transcripts

  • Cover letter (one letter-sized page or less; include graduation month/date/year in your cover letter)

  • Resume (maximum of two pages)

Posting Close Date: September 25th.

We welcome all applications but can only respond to candidates selected for an interview.

We thank all applicants for their interest!

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation
