title: Associate Office Administrator
description:
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an Associate Office Administrator to support the daily operations of the Taichung office. This role provides dependable reception, office administration, mailroom, and employee service support to help create a smooth, welcoming, and well-organized workplace experience.

The ideal candidate is service-oriented, organized, detail-minded, and able to follow established procedures with confidentiality and accountability. This position will also serve as a proxy for the other Associate Office Administrator when that person is on leave, ensuring business continuity for key office administration tasks.

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

  • Welcome visitors and complete visitor registration processes in a professional and timely manner.
  • Support office mail distribution, and daily front-desk operations.
  • Support meeting room set up.
  • Monitor and replenish office supplies, snacks, refreshments and so on.
  • Conduct routine office environment and equipment checks to help maintain a safe and well-functioning workplace.
  • Complete regular AED, fire extinguishers, and first-aid-kit checks and prepare required reports.
  • Support office events, employee engagement activities, and gift distribution.
  • Provide mail delivery support for employees as needed.

Proxy Coverage & Business Continuity

When the other Associate Office Administrator is on leave, you will provide trained and authorized proxy support for selected administration processes, including:

  • Handle UPS shipping, postage, and mail delivery support.
  • Purchase approved office supplies and refreshments following the required approval process.
  • Coordinate with facility vendors and service providers.
  • Process authorized payments and Coupa activities after proper training and approval.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A professional and welcoming communicator who creates a positive first impression for visitors, teammates, and partners.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage daily tasks with consistency and follow-through.
  • Service-minded and responsive, with the ability to support office needs in a calm and dependable manner.
  • Able to handle confidential information with care and follow approval and escalation procedures.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic office environment and adapting to changing priorities.
  • A collaborative teammate who is willing to cross-train, learn new systems, and support business continuity.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • A certificate of physical or mental disability is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • At least one year of relevant experience in reception, office administration, facilities coordination, or employee service support preferred.
  • English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office; experience with Coupa, vendor portals, or similar systems is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records, checklists, and reports.
  • Ability to follow established procedures, complete assigned tasks independently, and escalate issues appropriately.

title: Associate III, Pricing Operation [L3] (Coupon)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Pricing Operations 조직의 Coupon 팀은 리테일 및 로켓직구 상품의 전반적인 할인 프로모션을 운영하는 팀으로, 고객에게 신뢰도 높은 최적의 할인 프로모션을 제공하기 위한 운영 프로세스를 관리합니다. 본 포지션은 다양한 프로모션 요구사항을 검토하고 운영 정책에 맞게 프로모션을 시스템에 등록하며, 할인 표기 관련 유관부서와의 업무를 진행하기 때문에 이커머스 비즈니스에 대한 폭넓은 인사이트를 쌓을 수 있습니다.

업무 내용

• 프로모션 운영을 위한 다양한 요구사항 검토 및 프로모션 셋팅
• 골드박스, 지금할인중 등 타임딜 프로모션 운영관리
• 할인 표기 정확도 점검 및 이슈와 문제 해결을 위한 분석, 프로세스 개선

자격 요건

• 학사 학위 이상을 보유하신 분
• 운영 관련 업무 경력 1년 이상을 보유하신 분
• Microsoft Excel 및 Google 스프레드시트 활용이 가능하신 분
• 데이터 및 운영 정책 기준에 따라 꼼꼼하고 정확한 업무 수행이 가능하신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스 또는 리테일 업계에서 유사한 운영 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
• 기존 운영 프로세스에서 개선이 필요한 부분을 발굴하고 개선 제안 경험이 있으신 분
• 하나의 프로젝트를 처음부터 끝까지 해결해본 경험이 있거나 리딩 경험이 있으신 분
• 이해력이 높고 적극적이며 빠른 업무 변화에 열정을 갖고 책임감 있게 진행하실 수 있는 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

반드시 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 지원해 주시기 바랍니다.

Please make sure to apply with your Coupang e-mail address.

title: Systemingeniør
description:
Vil du være med å bygge fremtidens plattformtjenester for helseforvaltningen?

Felles tjenestesenter (FTS) leverer felles IT-tjenester og teknologiske løsninger til virksomheter i helseforvaltningen. FTS Plattform bygger og drifter den tekniske grunnmuren som applikasjoner og tjenester kjører på. Plattformen består blant annet av infrastruktur, skytjenester, automatisering og felles tekniske komponenter som gjør det mulig å levere sikre, stabile og skalerbare tjenester.

Vi jobber med en moderne hybrid plattform hvor Linux, Kubernetes står sentralt. Nå ønsker vi oss en ny kollega som enten har erfaring fra disse teknologiene – eller som har et sterkt ønske om å lære og utvikle seg videre innen dem.

Du trenger altså ikke være ekspert på alt fra første dag. Det viktigste for oss er at du har en god teknisk grunnforståelse, er nysgjerrig og liker å kaste deg over nye problemstillinger.

Hva vil du jobbe med?

Hos oss vil du blant annet få jobbe med:

  • Linux og moderne plattformdrift

  • Kubernetes og containerteknologi

  • Infrastruktur som kode (Infrastructure as Code / IaC)

  • Automatisering og scripting

  • Overvåking, logging og feilsøking

  • Sikkerhet, stabilitet og tilgjengelighet

  • Samarbeid med utviklere, kunder og andre tekniske fagmiljøer

Du vil få mulighet til å lære av erfarne kollegaer, samtidig som vi forventer at du etter hvert tar ansvar og bidrar med egne ideer og løsninger.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har erfaring eller interesse innen noen av områdene Linux, Kubernetes, containere, automatisering eller Infrastructure as Code.

Det er en fordel om du har jobbet med teknologier som Docker, Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, Python, Git – men vi forventer ikke at du kan alt.

Kanskje har du jobbet noen år med infrastruktur og ønsker å ta steget videre mot sky og Kubernetes. Eller kanskje du er relativt tidlig i karrieren, men allerede har opparbeidet deg god teknisk forståelse og har lyst til å lære masse. Begge deler er interessant for oss.

Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og løsningsorientert. Du liker å forstå hvordan ting henger sammen, deler kunnskap med andre og er ikke redd for å prøve ny teknologi. Hos oss får du jobbe sammen med dyktige fagfolk og samtidig være med på å påvirke hvordan plattformene våre skal utvikles fremover.

Det vi bygger og drifter understøtter tjenester i norsk helseforvaltning – arbeidet vårt har betydning langt utover teknologien i seg selv.

Vi ønsker oss mangfold! Mangfold beskriver våre menneskelige forskjeller, store og små, synlig og usynlig. Vi tror på kraften som ligger i våre forskjeller, og at disse bidrar til mer innovasjon, læring og verdiskapning. Vi oppfordrer kandidater med ulik utdanning, arbeids- og livserfaring til å søke.

Denne stillingen er av sikkerhetsmessige hensyn vurdert å være kritisk. Det vil derfor bli gjennomført sikkerhetssamtale og bakgrunnssjekk før ansettelse i denne stillingen. Bakgrunnssjekk innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen relevant dokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen m.m.

Ønsker du å få et innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Ta en titt her:

Hvorfor Norsk helsenett?

Målet vårt er at helsepersonell har informasjonen de trenger når de trenger den.

Helsevesenet i Norge er i dag preget av programvare og IT-systemer utviklet av mange ulike leverandører for mange ulike kunder i både privat og offentlig sektor. De kommuniserer ikke alltid godt nok. Norsk helsenett bidrar, på oppdrag fra myndighetene, i samarbeid med både leverandører og kunder, til å løse disse utfordringene.

Potensialet for en mer bærekraftig helsesektor er enormt, og vi er godt i gang. Blir du med?

Vi er 1000 ansatte på våre kontorer i Trondheim, Oslo, Tromsø og Svalbard med driv, nysgjerrighet, og som genuint bryr seg om å løse dette puslespillet ved hjelp av teknologi!

Vi tilbyr en lærerik arbeidshverdag i et teknologiunivers som overgår de flestes:

  • Vi utvikler og drifter sentrale nasjonale kritiske IT-løsninger som for eksempel Helsenorge.no, e-Resept og kjernejournal, samt en infrastruktur som lar alle i helsesektoren samhandle sikkert med 100% oppetid.

  • Vi drifter og forvalter en av Norges største private skyer, men har også bred erfaring og drift av allmenne skytjenester som Microsoft Azure og Amazon AWS. I tillegg til teknologier innen blant andre Microsoft, Cisco, Checkpoint, Veritas, Splunk, VMware og F5, har vi også Norges største operative linuxmiljø!

  • Vi har et av Norges sterkeste cybersikkerhetsmiljøer med både HelseCERT, Security Operations Center og vårt operasjonssenter som passer på kritiske løsninger 24/7/365.

  • Norsk helsenett utvikler fremtidens teknologiske pilarer for helsevesenet i tett samarbeid med både leverandørmarkedet, brukerne og myndighetene, og vi mener vi er Norges beste arbeidsplass for teknologiinteresserte med et ønske om å gjøre en forskjell!

I tillegg kan vi selvsagt friste med:

  • 7,5 timers arbeidsdag med fleksitid og betalt lunsjpause

  • individuell avlønning (ikke lønnstrinn), betalt reisetid og overtid

  • at vi tar regninga for mobil, data og bredbånd hjemme

  • bidrag til å dekke utgifter til trening

  • gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • og mye mer!

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at i henhold til offentleglova, kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten.

title: Graduate Field Technicians
description:
About us

Here at T&G Global we're passionate about growing healthier futures. Our story began 125 years ago and today our 2,000 people are located in 13 countries, where we grow, market, sell and distribute high-quality fresh produce to customers in more than 60 countries.

Our mindsets are: Do the Mahi, Be Bold, One Team and Take Good Care. Our talented team members embody these mindsets and are passionate about making a difference at T&G.

Looking to kick-start your career in horticulture? We have four exciting Graduate Internship opportunities within our Technical & Quality Team based in Hawke's Bay.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on industry experience, work alongside experienced professionals, and develop practical skills that will set you up for success after university. No two days are the same, with a mix of office-based work and time spent out in the orchards learning about fruit production, quality systems, research, and innovation.

The internship is a full-time seasonal opportunity running from November 2026 through to March 2027.

What we're looking for

You don't need previous horticulture experience as full training will be provided. We're looking for enthusiastic people who are keen to learn and get stuck in.

You'll ideally be:

  • Currently studying towards, or recently completed, a degree in Horticulture, Agriculture, Plant Science, Food Science, Environmental Science, or a related field

  • Positive, motivated, and eager to learn

  • Comfortable with a mix of indoor and outdoor work

  • Physically capable of working in orchard environments

  • Detail-oriented and organised

  • A strong team player with good communication skills

  • Reliable, punctual, and consistent

  • Able to arrange your own transport - restricted or full licence required

What's in it for you?

  • $29.90 per hour

  • Valuable industry experience with one of New Zealand's leading horticultural businesses

  • A variety of work across orchards, quality assurance, data collection, and technical projects

  • Exposure to innovative technologies, systems, and equipment

  • On-the-job training, mentoring, and support from an experienced team

  • Opportunities to build industry connections and practical skills for your future career

  • A fun, supportive team environment where you'll learn something new every day

All we ask is that you bring a positive attitude, a willingness to learn, reliable transport, and a commitment to being drug-free.

If you're looking for a summer role that offers real-world experience, professional development, and a chance to be part of New Zealand's thriving horticulture industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and grow your future with us! 🍎🌱

Proof of eligibility to work in New Zealand is required for all applicants, we are not able to sponsor visa applications for this position. Any offer of employment will be subject to a satisfactory drug test and security check.

We want T&G to be a place where everyone is accepted, respected and celebrated for who they are – regardless of our similarities or differences. It’s essential that everyone can be themselves and thrive, and that together we create a diverse and vibrant workplace.

title: Student Assistant, Commercial Platforms & Operation
description:
Are you interested in digital platforms, system administration, and improving how global organizations use technology? Do you enjoy working with data, digital tools, and operational processes?

Then you may be our new Student Assistant for Commercial Platforms & Operations in Global Commercial Excellence.

Working as a Student Assistant in Global Commercial Excellence

As a Student Assistant, you will support the administration and continuous improvement of a portfolio of commercial platforms used across our global organization. The platforms support areas such as learning, events, content management, and digital collaboration.

You will work closely with the Commercial Tools Product Manager and collaborate with colleagues across IT, Marketing, local markets, and external partners.

You will receive training on the platforms and gradually take ownership of recurring administrative and operational activities.

On average, you can expect a workload of 10-20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and holidays. The position is based in Lynge, with the opportunity to work partly from home.

In this role, you will:

· Support the administration and maintenance of commercial platforms.

· Manage user access, licenses, and platform data.

· Support content management, testing, and platform improvements.

· Conduct reporting and analysis on platform usage and performance.

· Support user onboarding, training sessions, and communications.

· Collaborate with stakeholders across functions and vendors.

Your profile

· Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree with at least 12 months remaining of your studies, preferably within Business, IT, Digital Business, Information Systems, or similar.

· Previous experience from a student job, internship, or similar role.

· Interested in digital platforms, system administration, and data management.

· Comfortable demonstrating software and explaining platform functionality to non-technical users.

· Comfortable working with MS Office, Excel, and structured data.

· Fluent in spoken and written English. Danish is not a requirement.

· Technically curious and motivated to understand how systems work.

· Structured, proactive, and able to work independently.

· Service-minded and eager to learn.

What we offer

At WSA, you will gain hands-on experience managing global commercial platforms and learn how digital tools are governed, operated, and continuously improved in a large international organization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and develop valuable technical, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Silkkiniityn päiväkoti
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään Silkkiniityn päiväkotiin. Päiväkodissamme on 6 lapsiryhmää, joista kaksi on eskariryhmiä. Toinen esiopetusryhmistä on ruotsin kielen kielikylpyryhmä. Nyt haettava tehtävä on pienten alle kolmevuotiaiden lasten ryhmässä.

Olemme kannustava ja kehittämismyönteinen päiväkoti. Panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja meille huumori ja yhdessä tekeminen ovat tärkeitä asioita. Työyhteisömme on avoin, kannustava ja helposti lähestyttävä. Yksikössämme on apulaisjohtajamalli eli henkilöstön tukena työskentelee varhaiskasvatusyksikön johtaja ja apulaisjohtaja. Meille esihenkilöinä on tärkeää, että jokaisella on mahdollisuus tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä. Työsi tukena toimii myös laaja-alainen erityisopettaja.

Päiväkodissamme näkyvät vahvasti lasten osallisuus, yhteisöllisyys sekä lämmin ja arvostava kohtaaminen. Hyödynnämme aktiivisesti lähiympäristöä ja luontoa. Sijaintimme Tapiolan keskustassa tarjoaa paljon mahdollisuuksia hyvien kulkuyhteyksien lisäksi myös kulttuurielämyksiin lasten kanssa. Myös päiväkotimme piha on täysin uusittu remontissa tänä vuonna. Jos nämä asiat saavat myös sinut innostumaan, sovit meille erinomaisesti.

Tarjoamme sinulle mentorointiohjelmamme tuen aloittaessasi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan työt. Mentorointiryhmän tuella espoolainen varhaiskasvatus tulee sinulle tutuksi ja opit tunnistamaan omat vahvuutesi ja osaamisesi. Samalla saat aineksia omaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja työhyvinvointiin. Pääset keskustelemaan kokeneen mentorin kanssa uran alkuvaiheeseen liittyvistä iloista ja haasteista, ja tutustut myös muihin varhaiskasvatuksen opettajina aloitteleviin kollegoihin.


Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Silkkiniityn päiväkoti, Opinkuja 1, 02100 Espoo
Työaika: 38 h 15 min/viikko
Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.5.2027 saakka.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Teemme valinnan heti kelpoisen, tehtävään soveltuvan henkilön löydyttyä. Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian!

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus.

Vähintään kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto, johon sisältyy varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan koulutus, tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (varhaiskasvatus) tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005).

Haussa huomioidaan myös juuri valmistuvat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajat.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.
Tartuntatautilaki velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Arvostamme kykyä kohdata lapset ja heidän vanhempansa yksilöllisesti, arvostavasti ja sensitiivisesti. Lisäksi arvostamme hyviä tiimityötaitoja ja intoa kehittää päiväkotimme toimintaa jatkuvasti.

Tervetuloa joukkoomme kasvattamaan vastuullista ja välittävää uutta sukupolvea!

Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

Toimintamme perustuu avoimuuteen ja luottamukseen, ja kohtaamme toisemme arvostavasti. Olemme sitoutuneet yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseen ja toivomme työyhteisöömme eri-ikäisiä, eri taustoista ja eri kieliä puhuvia osaajia.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä tehtävän lisätietojen antajaan.

Erityistarpeisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit ottaa yhteyttä: keha.rekrytointi@espoo.fi. Käsittelemme yhteydenotot luottamuksellisesti.

Lue lisää: https://www.esitteemme.fi/espoonrekry/MailView/

title: Yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettaja, kappaletavara, Riihimäki
description:
Työnkuvaus

Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme CE-kortillista kuljettajaa täysperävaunuyhdistelmälle kappaletavaran ajoon Etelä-Suomen alueelle.

Työssä kuljetat kappaletavaraa erilaisiin asiakaskohteisiin. Yhdistelmän perässä kulkee ajoittain ajoneuvotrukki (Moffett), joten tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään monipuolisesti kuljetusalan osaamistasi.

Työ on pääasiassa arkityötä maanantaista perjantaihin ja työpäivät alkavat aamuisin klo 6–7 välillä. Noin 1–2 kertaa kuukaudessa voi olla tarve yöpyä autossa, mutta muuten kyseessä ovat normaalit päivittäiset ajot.

Asemapaikkana on Riihimäki.

Odotamme sinulta

– Voimassa oleva CE-ajokortti ja ammattipätevyys
– Aikaisempaa kokemusta yhdistelmäajoneuvolla ajamisesta
– Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti
– Huolellinen ja vastuullinen työote
– Reipas ja oma-aloitteinen asenne
– Valmius satunnaisiin yöpymisiin autossa
– Kokemus Moffett-ajoneuvotrukista katsotaan eduksi, mutta tehtävään koulutetaan

Tarjoamme sinulle

– Vakituisen ja pitkäkestoisen työn
– Palkan AKT-TES mukaan
– Monipuolisen työn kappaletavaraliikenteessä
– Mahdollisuuden oppia ja kouluttautua Moffett-ajoneuvotrukin käyttöön
– Kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään
– Työvaatteet meidän kauttamme
– Monipuoliset henkilöstöedut

Hakuprosessi

Työ alkaa heti, joten paikka voidaan täyttää nopeasti sopivan kuljettajan löydyttyä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian!

Lisätietoja

Rekrytointikonsultti Aapo Virtanen
aapo.virtanen@workpower.fi

Avainsanat: kuljetus, logistiikka, CE-kuljettaja, yhdistelmäajoneuvo, täysperävaunu, kappaletavara, Moffett, ajoneuvotrukki, perälautanosturi, Etelä-Suomi, Riihimäki, ammattipätevyys, työturvallisuuskortti, vakituinen työ, AKT-TES

title: Marketing & Design Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

For 50 years we have been leaders in the hire of lifting and hoisting equipment. Our locations are spread over the UK and the EU. Our sister company, LGH Winches, is one of the leading winch specialists in Europe.

We combine the highest quality equipment, unrivalled experience, and industry leading expertise, with excellent customer service, to offer you state of the art solutions to meet your lifting challenges. Whatever the load, whatever the location, LGH can take the strain, with unmatched reliability, range, and readiness. LGH adds specialist knowledge and know-how to your operation, lifting your team as well as your load. From a simple toe jack for manual handling, to sophisticated spreader beams for larger loads, we offer the widest range of lifting equipment, on call and ready for delivery, backed by expert advice and on-site expertise.

Across the world, across all industry sectors, trust LGH – the global leaders in lifting gear hire.

SUMMARY OF THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic Marketing & Design Specialist to strengthen our brand and support marketing efforts. This role involves marketing administration, coordination, and creating high-quality visual assets to ensure consistent and professional communications across all channels, directly contributing to our growth and market reach.

OVERVIEW OF ACCOUNTABILITIES

Graphic Design & Visual Content Creation:

  • Design and update professional sales brochures, technical datasheets, and product guides.

  • Create engaging social media visuals (graphics, images, short animations) for platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.

  • Develop digital assets for email marketing, website banners, blog headers, and online advertisements.

  • Act as a brand guardian, ensuring strict adherence to brand guidelines across all visual materials.

  • Efficiently utilize and adapt existing design templates, alongside independently conceptualizing and executing original design elements for new campaigns and specific storytelling needs.

  • Manage image sourcing and editing, and prepare final design files for print.

Marketing Administration & Coordination:

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support for marketing activities, including content management, social media scheduling, and email campaign support.

  • Perform routine website visual updates using our CMS.

  • Support marketing events, webinars, and trade shows with administrative and logistical assistance.

  • Liaise with external vendors (printers, photographers, agencies) as needed.

  • Offer general marketing administrative support to the team as required.

Collaboration & Project Management:

  • Collaborate closely with marketing and sales teams across the UK, DACH and Benelux to ensure visuals and initiatives effectively support campaign goals and brand messaging.

  • Manage design and marketing projects from concept through to delivery, ensuring deadlines are met and quality standards are maintained.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Essential:

  • 2+ years of experience in a graphic design role, preferably within a marketing or B2B environment.

  • Proven Graphic Design Skills: A strong portfolio demonstrating proficiency in creating visually appealing and effective marketing materials across print and digital.

  • Software Proficiency: Expert-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) is essential. Familiarity with other tools like Canva, Figma, or video editing software is a plus.

  • Marketing Acumen: Solid understanding of core marketing principles, digital marketing channels (social media, email, web), and brand management.

  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous eye for design consistency, grammar, spelling, and adherence to brand guidelines.

  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate design concepts, write engaging copy, and interact effectively with colleagues and external partners.

  • Proactive & Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, take initiative, and contribute new ideas.

  • Adaptability: Willingness to learn new tools and adapt to evolving marketing strategies and design trends.

Desirable

  • Educational Background: A degree or diploma in Marketing, Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field.

  • Ambitious Growth Mindset: Demonstrated ambition to grow within the role and contribute additional value to the team.

  • Experience: Typically 2-4 years of relevant professional experience in a marketing or design role within a business setting.

WORKING PATTERN:

Days: Monday to Friday

Hours: 37.5 hours per week between 9am – 5pm

Lunch break: 30 minutes unpaid

COMPANY BENEFITS

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: London or Paris (hybrid)
Experience: 2–4 years
Reporting to: Product Director

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own and drive the roadmap for Learn, one of YOOBIC’s core product pillars.

YOOBIC is the frontline employee experience platform. More than 350 global brands across retail, hospitality and manufacturing use YOOBIC to give their frontline teams a single mobile app for everything they need to perform: their day-to-day tasks and workflows through Work, their training and development through Learn, and their internal communications through Communicate.

We build for people who don’t sit at a desk — including store associates, restaurant teams and field staff — and we obsess over making their working day simpler, faster and more engaging.

YOOBIC Learn is how hundreds of thousands of frontline employees are onboarded, upskilled and certified. It brings together mobile-first microlearning, gamification, role-based learning paths, AI-assisted course creation and adaptive quizzes. Our customers use it to reduce onboarding time, improve product knowledge on the shop floor and turn training into measurable business performance.

As Product Manager for Learn, you’ll decide what we build, what we deliberately don’t build and why. You’ll take that thinking all the way through to shipped, adopted and measurable outcomes, working with the Product Director as your strategic partner.

You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Pre-sales, Implementation, Customer Success and Support to align product initiatives with our wider business objectives. You’ll also be a visible driver of innovation across the product portfolio.

AI creates significant opportunities for Learn — from richer ways to create and adapt content to personalised learning and a clearer understanding of how training changes performance on the frontline. Much of that opportunity is still ahead of us, and this role exists to help us realise it.

What You’ll Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap

You’ll own the direction of Learn, deciding where the product is going, what we build and what we deliberately choose not to pursue.

You will:

  • Develop a clear point of view on frontline learning, informed by customer conversations, product usage data and insights from our customer-facing teams.

  • Own and prioritise the Learn roadmap in partnership with the Product Director.

  • Make clear, evidence-based decisions about product priorities and trade-offs.

  • Define the customer and commercial value of product initiatives before committing resources to them.

  • Build a roadmap that you can confidently explain and defend to customers, internal teams and the executive leadership team.

  • Connect the Learn strategy to YOOBIC’s wider product and business objectives.

Product Discovery & Validation

You’ll turn customer problems and ambiguous ideas into clear, testable product opportunities.

You will:

  • Speak regularly with customers and frontline users to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.

  • Combine qualitative customer insight with product usage data and commercial feedback.

  • Distinguish between isolated customer requests and broader market patterns.

  • Define the user, the problem they’re trying to solve and why the current experience is failing them before proposing a solution.

  • Create clickable prototypes, realistic mock data and working concepts to make ideas tangible before Engineering commits significant time.

  • Use early testing and feedback to validate assumptions, refine scope or stop work that won’t create sufficient value.

Product Delivery

You’ll work closely with Design, Engineering and QA to turn validated opportunities into high-quality product experiences.

You will:

  • Translate product opportunities into clear requirements and outcomes that teams can build against.

  • Write your own product specifications and create prototypes where written documentation alone isn’t enough.

  • Work alongside Design, Engineering and QA throughout delivery.

  • Keep scope focused and ensure the team remains aligned on the problem being solved.

  • Unblock decisions quickly and manage trade-offs as new information emerges.

  • Stay close enough to delivery to identify and resolve problems while they’re still inexpensive to fix.

  • Use the product regularly, test what is being built and maintain a detailed understanding of the customer experience.

AI Product Development

You’ll help shape how AI is used within Learn, ensuring we create features that offer genuine customer value rather than novelty.

You will:

  • Help define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across areas such as course generation, adaptive assessment, personalisation and translation.

  • Maintain a practical understanding of what current AI models can and cannot do reliably.

  • Design AI experiences with model limitations and potential failure modes in mind.

  • Distinguish between compelling demonstrations and capabilities that will deliver sustainable value in production.

  • Prototype AI-powered concepts before committing significant Engineering resources.

  • Ensure AI features are usable, trustworthy and aligned with real customer needs.

  • Stay informed about developments in AI and assess how they could improve Learn and the wider YOOBIC platform.

Launch, Adoption & Performance

You’ll remain accountable after a feature ships, ensuring releases are understood, adopted and delivering measurable results.

You will:

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Enablement and Support to ensure releases land effectively.

  • Help create clear positioning that explains the value of new capabilities in language customers understand.

  • Maintain strong product documentation and knowledge resources so colleagues can confidently sell, implement and support what we build.

  • Define success measures and monitor adoption and performance after launch.

  • Work directly with product data to understand whether a release achieved its intended outcomes.

  • Use evidence to refine features, change direction or challenge your original assumptions.

  • Become the internal subject-matter expert for Learn and the person colleagues turn to when questions about the pillar become complex.

AI-Enabled Product Management

AI isn’t a side project at YOOBIC. It is part of the product our customers use and an important part of how our Product team works.

You will:

  • Use AI as a core part of your day-to-day approach to research, drafting, analysis and prototyping.

  • Prototype before you specify, analyse before you ask and draft before you delegate.

  • Use AI-assisted prototyping, no-code tools or light coding to make ideas tangible without waiting for an Engineering slot.

  • Work directly with data, using AI assistance to query, clean, explore and visualise it.

  • Use AI to remove unnecessary dependencies while maintaining sound judgement, accuracy and appropriate oversight.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • 2–4 years’ experience as a Product Manager within a B2B SaaS business.

  • Experience owning a product area or feature end to end, from initial customer discovery through to launch, adoption and performance measurement.

  • A strong product mindset, with the ability to begin with the user problem rather than a predefined feature.

  • The ability to define who the user is, what they’re trying to achieve and why the current experience isn’t working.

  • A value-led approach to prioritisation, with the confidence to explain why something is worth building and to stop or reduce the scope of work that won’t create sufficient value.

  • A hands-on working style, including writing specifications, building prototypes, testing product experiences and analysing product data.

  • Experience making ideas tangible through clickable prototypes, no-code tools, light coding or other rapid prototyping methods.

  • Experience speaking directly with users and combining qualitative feedback with quantitative product data.

  • The ability to distinguish between individual customer requests and meaningful, recurring patterns.

  • An understanding of how product positioning affects the way a capability is understood, sold and adopted.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and experience working with Engineering, Design and customer-facing teams.

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools for activities such as research, drafting, analysis and prototyping.

  • The ability to build a working prototype independently using AI-assisted tools, no-code platforms or light coding.

  • Confidence working directly with data, including querying, cleaning, exploring and visualising it with AI assistance.

  • A practical understanding of what large language models can and cannot do reliably.

  • Strong curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to change direction when evidence challenges an existing plan.

Nice to Have

  • A technical or analytical educational background, such as Computer Science, Engineering or Economics.

  • Experience working in EdTech, learning and development, or learning and training products.

  • Experience shipping LLM-powered features into production.

  • Experience within retail, hospitality or another frontline-heavy industry.

  • French-language skills.

What We Care About

You start with the problem.
You understand the user, what they’re trying to achieve and why the current experience is failing before you begin designing a solution.

You think in value, not output.
You focus on what will change for the customer and the business, rather than measuring success by the number of features shipped.

You make things tangible.
You would rather test a rough prototype than debate an abstract document. You create something people can react to early in the process.

You stay close to users.
You speak with customers regularly and compare what they tell you with what the data shows.

You get into the detail.
You use the product, write your own specifications, build prototypes, test upcoming releases and work directly with product data.

You use AI practically.
AI has meaningfully changed how you work. You use it to research, analyse, draft and build while applying sound judgement to its limitations.

You care about adoption.
A feature isn’t finished when it ships. You make sure it can be clearly explained, successfully launched and meaningfully adopted.

You’re curious by default.
You experiment, explore ideas outside your immediate domain and develop an informed point of view. You would rather learn something uncomfortable from the evidence than defend an outdated plan.

You take ownership.
You’re comfortable working through ambiguity, making decisions and remaining accountable for measurable outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Dental and vision cover.

title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.
  • You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you.
  • You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the foundation
  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute
  • Your SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice
  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Postdoctoral researcher in synthesis and analysis
description:
The University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en), founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research. The university has an international academic community of 40,000 students and staff members. The Department of Chemistry (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science/faculty/chemistry) at the Faculty of Science (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science) carries out research on chemistry and its applications at an international level and provides academic teaching based on high quality research.
The Department of Chemistry invites applications for one
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER
position in Synthesis and Analysis. The successful applicant will join the developing research group at the Department of Chemistry. The position is fixed-term for 12 months with a possible extension. Employment starts as soon as possible.

Position description
The postdoctoral position funded by the Research Council of Finland aims to design closed-loop dissolution/activation laboratory and scaled-up methodologies for recycling platinum group metals and rare-earth elements using green chemicals energy- and resource-efficient approaches - including organometallurgy and mechanochemistry - complying with sustainable development, resource safety and circular economy. This interdisciplinary project lays on the interface between coordination chemistry, metal dissolution and organometallurgy, organic chemistry, methodology development and mechanochemistry. Postdoctoral researchers tasks will include the development of recycling protocols for different metals, advanced characterization of the reaction mixtures and obtained isolated materials. The work will also comprise help in the supervision of undergraduate, graduate and visiting students. The researcher is expected to present their findings in scientific meetings, prepare funding applications for travel and research grants, as well as prepare manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. The position has a trial period of 6 months.

Requirements
Motivated, ambitious and self-driven candidates with a PhD degree in a relevant field (chemistry or related) interested in metal recycling are encouraged to apply. Experience in the fields of coordination complex chemistry, molecular metal compounds, homogeneous metal catalysis, organic synthesis, mechanochemistry of metals, as well as experience in analytical techniques including NMR, PXRD, HRMS and ICP-MS/AES are advantageous. Most importantly, you should have strong motivation for research in a highly multidisciplinary topic, enthusiasm to learn new things and contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research team. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. We will offer a meaningful, original and ambitious scientific project in an international, top-level research environment. From the applicant we expect high motivation to conduct demanding experimental work, as well as a curiosity driven science-enthusiastic mindset.

Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (requirement level 5). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* a CV with a list of publications,
* a brief description of your research interests (1 page) with clear indication on the motivation to apply for this position,
* a copy of a PhD degree certificate.

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
The deadline for applications is October 8th, unless the right candidate is found before. Interviews will commence right away, already during the application period.

Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Research Council of Finland Fellow, Dr. Anže Zupanc (anze.zupanc@helsinki.fi). For more information on Dr. Zupancs publications, see Anže Zupanc (0000-0002-3697-7839) - ORCID and Anže Zupanc - Google Scholar.

title: Afdelingsleder til Partering og opskæring
description:
Vi leder efter en afdelingsleder til dagholdet i vores parteringsafdeling – måske er det dig? Her får du en central lederrolle tæt på den daglige drift, hvor du både skal skabe overblik, sikre udvikling og være en synlig leder for medarbejderne i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

Du bliver en del af Operations Aars, som består af mange forskellige faggrupper. Dit nærmeste team består af seks afdelingsledere og en Staff Manager. Sammen arbejder I for at sikre et højt niveau i produktionen – både når det gælder medarbejdertrivsel, udvikling, arbejdsmiljø, kvalitet og optimering. Teamet er energisk, hjælpsomt og præget af humor, ærlighed og en praktisk tilgang til hverdagen.

”Jeg søger en ærlig og oprigtig afdelingsleder, der kan mærke menneskerne omkring sig og samtidig holde retningen i en hverdag, hvor tingene kan ændre sig hurtigt. Kulturen i afdelingen er præget af tempo, godt samarbejde og plads til en frisk bemærkning – men også af ansvarlighed og respekt for hinanden. Den rette leder skal kunne skabe ro, overblik og god energi i teamet”, fortæller Produktionschef Daniel Vraa.

Tag ansvar for afdelingens udvikling

Som afdelingsleder får du en omfattende og driftsnær lederrolle med ansvar for trivsel, udvikling og resultater blandt 80 produktionsmedarbejdere og to driftsassistenter.

Mere konkret får du ansvar for at:

- lede, motivere og udvikle medarbejderne i afdelingen

- planlægge bemanding, uddannelse og kompetenceudvikling, så driften fungerer optimalt

- godkende tidsregistreringer og sikre korrekt opfølgning i hverdagen

- rekruttere nye medarbejdere i samarbejde med vores Staff Manager

- følge op på afdelingens performance inden for arbejdsmiljø, kvalitet, effektivitet og udbytte

- skabe et godt samarbejde med øvrige afdelinger på tværs af produktionen

Et succesfuldt samarbejde
Vi søger en afdelingsleder med godt humør, høj energi og en positiv tilgang til mennesker og opgaver. Du trives i et lederteam, men kan også eksekvere selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne beslutninger.

· Du har erfaring med personaleledelse – gerne fra produktion eller fødevarebranchen.

· Du kommunikerer tydeligt på dansk og engelsk og trives på en multikulturel arbejdsplads.

· Du arbejder struktureret og er vant til at bruge systemer og rapportering i din hverdag.

· Du har en praktisk og fleksibel tilgang til problemløsning.

· Det er en fordel, hvis du kender til certificeringer og standarder som BRC, IFS eller lignende.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at være tæt på produktionen, skabe følgeskab og bidrage til en hverdag, hvor både mennesker og resultater udvikler sig. Har du en uddannelsesmæssig baggrund inden for produktion eller erfaring fra fødevareindustrien, er det en fordel.

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel og attraktiv arbejdsplads med mangeartede opgaver, et stærkt lederfællesskab og mulighed for at præge udviklingen i afdelingen. Derudover har vi en række medarbejdergoder, som blandt andet omfatter sundhedssikring, kantineordning, frugtordning og padelbaner, der er frit tilgængelige på vores lokationer i Aars og Farre.

Træd ind i en stilling med kød på

Som en del af en stor koncern er Danpo en international arbejdsplads, hvor der er fokus på dyrevelfærd, sundhed og gode produkter. Hvis du vil have et indblik i vores kultur og vores dyrevelfærd, kan du her læse om vores familiegårde.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning snarest muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Hvis du kan se dig selv som en synlig, handlekraftig og nærværende leder på dagholdet, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Sr Director Product Management
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Sr Director Product Management

We are Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we are involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Senior Director, Product Management

Job Description
At Fiserv, we are transforming financial services through innovative technologies and strategic foresight. Our Financial Crimes and Risk Management Solutions team is dedicated to providing advanced solutions to combat financial crimes and manage risks effectively. We are seeking a strategic and results-driven product leader to drive innovation and to ensure our products delight our customers, and effectively detect, prevent, and manage financial risks including fraud, money laundering, and sanctions violations.

What You'll Do
As a Senior Director, you will play a pivotal role in the modernization of our product suite. Collaborating with Sales, Marketing, other internal teams, partners, and clients, you will focus on elevating customer experience and fostering business growth.

  • Be a product evangelist for the FCRM product suite
  • Foster thought leadership by creating compelling value propositions and marketing narratives that resonate with the market, customers, and sales
  • Develop, evaluate, and execute on buy, build, partner strategies to bring the highest value to our customers and to drive growth
  • Drive innovation that exceeds customer and market expectations, in partnership with technology and other product managers by executing on initiatives based on gathering voice of customer, staying on top of industry trends, understanding competitive landscape, technological and analytic advances, etc.
  • Create and execute go-to-market strategies to drive growth that include product commercialization, pricing considerations, and distribution channels
  • Work alongside internal teams to strategize and implement continual improvement initiatives in methodologies, processes, and technologies
  • Lead digital transformation and modernization initiatives to deliver innovative solutions and services
  • Support and collaborate with multiple sales and distribution teams across multiple global markets
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary

Experience You'll Need to Have

  • 8+ years of product management experience in financial services
  • 8+ years in financial services regulatory and compliance environment or Financial Crimes, fraud, and AML
  • 8+ years of experience in effective communication skills and building strong relationships with key stakeholders
  • 5+ years of experience engaging with clients, partners, internal teams, and supporting sales functions
  • Track record of successfully launching and managing product portfolios
  • Prior experience with Agile development methodologies
  • Prior experience creating and executing go-to-market, commercialization, and sales enablement strategies

What would be great to have:

  • Prior experience or working knowledge of AI/ML methodologies, including Agentic AI
  • In-depth knowledge of technologies and emerging trends, with a proven ability to leverage these trends to drive business growth
  • Experience working across global teams with different regulatory standards
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant field

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

Note to agencies:

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Warning about fake job posts:

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Projektledare
description:
Projektkontoret på W5 Solutions fortsätter att växa. Nu söker vi två seniora projektledare som vill ta ansvar för tekniskt avancerade projekt. Beroende på din erfarenhet kan du komma att leda flera mindre utvecklingsprojekt eller ansvara för större, affärsdrivna projekt med internationella slutkunder.

W5 Solutions utvecklar och levererar avancerade system inom kraftförsörjning och simulering till kunder inom försvars- och myndighetssektorn. I stort sett alla våra projekt är kundunika och utgår från kundens behov. Varje leverans ska fungera i praktiken, i verkligheten och över tid.

”Vi har nyligen välkomnat en ny kollega och söker nu ytterligare två projektledare. Vi har många projekt i gång och fler på väg in. Därför stärker vi organisationen med tekniskt kunniga projektledare som trivs med att driva och leda ett engagerat team samt hålla en nära dialog med kunden. Här får du en bred och komplex roll som rymmer både teknisk problemlösning och ett tydligt affärsfokus”, säger Niklas Sjödén, projektchef.

Din framtida utmaning

Inom Power arbetar omkring 130 medarbetare, där utveckling, produktion, test och slutleverans finns nära varandra. Det skapar korta beslutsvägar, men ställer också krav på tydligt ledarskap i projekten.

Som senior projektledare ansvarar du för genomförandet av kundprojekt inom exempelvis elverk, batteri och laddarsystem och simulatorlösningar. Uppdragens omfattning varierar. Du kan driva flera mindre produktutvecklingsprojekt parallellt eller leda ett större projekt med omfattande kommersiellt ansvar med internationella slutkunder.

Oavsett projektets storlek leder du tvärfunktionella team med kompetens inom bland annat mekanik, el, elektronik, mjukvara, test, teknisk dokumentation, produktionsteknik och inköp. Du skapar framdrift, hanterar tekniska och kommersiella frågeställningar och ser till att teamet har rätt förutsättningar för att nå projektets mål.

”Du behöver kunna röra dig mellan detaljer och helhet. Ena stunden diskuterar du en teknisk lösning tillsammans med ingenjörerna, nästa stämmer du av ekonomi, risker eller leverans med kunden. Du håller ihop projektet och ser till att beslut fattas och aktiviteter genomförs”, fortsätter Niklas.

Helhetsansvar från start till leverans

Rollen innebär ett tydligt kommersiellt ansvar. Du arbetar aktivt med uppföljning av budget, prognoser och marginaler. Samtidigt är du en naturlig samordnare internt, den som skapar struktur, prioriterar och håller ihop helheten när komplexiteten ökar.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera projektledning med ett starkt tekniskt engagemang.

”Hos oss på W5 arbetar du nära utvecklingen och behöver ha förmågan att förstå de tekniska frågeställningarna, föra dialog med ingenjörer och specialister och vara med och driva lösningarna framåt. Du leder alltså inte bara projektet – du är en aktiv del av utvecklingen”, avslutar Niklas.

Vill du ta ansvar för projekt där teknik, affär och leverans behöver fungera tillsammans? Då hoppas vi att du skickar in din ansökan!

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Leda och genomföra tekniskt avancerade kundprojekt från start till slut.

  • Säkerställa att projekten levereras enligt krav, tidplan och kvalitet.

  • Hantera budget, prognoser, resurser och ekonomisk uppföljning.

  • Leda tvärfunktionella team inom utveckling, inköp, produktion och test.

  • Identifiera och hantera tekniska, kommersiella och operativa risker.

  • Skapa framdrift genom tydliga prioriteringar, beslut och uppföljning.

  • Bidra till utvecklingen av projektmetodik, processer och arbetssätt.

  • Upprätthålla en nära och professionell dialog med kunder och andra intressenter.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Flerårig erfarenhet av att leda tekniska projekt i en tillverkande eller teknikorienterad verksamhet.

  • Erfarenhet av att ta helhetsansvar för leverans, ekonomi och kundrelation.

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom el, elektronik, mekanik eller likvärdig.

  • Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska.

  • B-körkort då tjänsteresor kan förekomma.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin eller arbete med komplexa system, t.ex. innehållande avancerade el och elektroniklösningar.

Vi söker dig som är självgående och strukturerad, med förmåga att skapa förtroende både internt och externt. Du trivs i en miljö där teknik och affär går hand i hand, och där leveransen alltid är högsta prioritet.

Du erbjuds

Hos W5 drivs hela kedjan – från utveckling och verifiering till dokumentation och support. Det ger dig möjlighet att följa tekniken på nära håll, förstå helheten och fatta välgrundade beslut tillsammans med projektteamet. Din tekniska förståelse blir en viktig del av att balansera krav, funktion, tid och resurser och att säkerställa att projektet når rätt lösning.

Du hanterar ofta flera parallella projekt och arbetar i en internationell kontext, med både nationella och globala kunder. För dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik och projektledning erbjuder W5 en roll med stort ansvar, teknisk komplexitet och möjlighet att påverka – där du får använda både din projektledarförmåga och din tekniska kompetens.

Information och ansökan

I denna rekrytering har W5 Solutions valt att samarbeta med AxÖ Consulting. Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsansvarig från AxÖ Consulting: Angelica Mäenpää, angelica.maenpaa@axoconsulting.se

Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, då urval sker löpande.

Befattningen innebär arbete i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet och kan komma att kräva godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt §1 kap. 3 Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). I förekommande fall kan även krav om visst medborgarskap förekomma.

title: Head of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure - Europe
description:
Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation. No matter where you come from, your aspirations matter to us. We believe in the power of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds to ignite innovation and drive success. We're in the business of empowering people, and that includes you. Your journey here is not just about a job; it's about a shared vision for a brighter, more sustainable future.

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and dynamic leader to join us as Head of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure – Europe.

In this Director-level role, you will lead the development and execution of Eaton’s EV charging infrastructure strategy across Europe—a critical region in the global energy transition.
You will have a unique opportunity to work cross-functionally across multiple business units, including Power Distribution equipment, Battery Storage, and other Eaton and partner solutions, to deliver integrated, end-to-end offerings.
As part of the Global Energy Transition business unit, you will drive business growth by delivering comprehensive EV charging solutions (power distribution equipment, battery storage, and EV chargers) and accelerating market adoption. You will collaborate closely with global teams and lead regional engagement with key ecosystem partners, including our strategic partnership with ChargePoint.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you will leverage your strong commercial acumen, influence across functions, and ability to build and scale high-performing teams.

Locations: Fully remote role open to candidates based in Germany, the Netherlands, or the United Kingdom

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape and bring to life the Europe EV charging infrastructure strategy, aligned with Eaton’s global roadmap and regional market opportunities
  • Partner closely across Eaton business units for Power Distribution and balance of system to deliver comprehensive and differentiated customer solutions
  • Nurture business growth and performance by building strong pipelines and expanding revenue and market presence through scalable solutions
  • Cultivate and grow strategic partnerships, including ChargePoint and the broader EV ecosystem
  • Inspire and develop a high-performing regional team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous growth
  • Connect and collaborate across global and regional functions to deliver seamless, customer-centric solutions

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred)
  • 10+ years of experience in electrification, energy, EV infrastructure, or related industries
  • Proven ability to lead teams and deliver strong business results

Preferred:

  • Strong understanding of the European EV charging ecosystem, including regulatory environment and market dynamics
  • Experience with EV charging technologies (AC/DC infrastructure, energy management, grid integration)
  • Track record of developing and executing strategy within a global, matrixed organization
  • Experience building and managing strategic partnerships, particularly with technology or platform partners
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen

Success in this role requires:

  • Shaping strategic direction and guiding execution by translating market insights and global priorities into sustainable business growth
  • Fostering alignment and building strong connections across regional and global stakeholders to deliver integrated outcomes
  • Cultivating and expanding impactful partnerships and ecosystems to support and accelerate market adoption
  • Inspiring and developing high-performing teams, strengthening both results and long-term organizational capability
  • Championing customer-centric solutions by anticipating evolving needs and translating them into scalable, meaningful offerings

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Merchant Integration Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a prominent Electronic Money Institution (EMI) dedicated to providing online payment processing solutions. They offer a comprehensive suite of services, including payment gateway services, global payment processing, merchant accounts, open banking, recurring payments, and mass payments. Catering to online businesses across a variety of sectors, they support multiple currencies and payment methods, enabling efficient global transactions.

Role Overview

Join an international team as a Merchant Integration Engineer, where you will be at the forefront of ensuring seamless integrations between merchants and payment systems. This role offers the chance to work with cutting-edge APIs, diagnose complex issues, and directly influence the success of merchant integrations. The hybrid work environment based in Riga allows for a balance of remote and in-office collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain integrations between merchants and payment systems.

  • Diagnose integration issues by analysing logs and tracing API requests and responses.

  • Reproduce bugs and prepare clear technical escalations for developers, including what was sent, what was received, and where the behaviour differs from the specification or expected result.

  • Test integrations against technical specifications before go-live.

  • Perform sandbox testing and verification after system or integration changes.

  • Work with server-to-server REST API integrations.

  • Troubleshoot asynchronous payment flows involving webhooks, callbacks, and status polling.

  • Configure and troubleshoot payment plugins and modules for CMS platforms such as WooCommerce and OpenCart.

  • Communicate directly with technical teams in English and/or Russian.

  • Maintain integration documentation, onboarding checklists, FAQs, and common troubleshooting scenarios.

  • Follow information-security requirements when working with payment and sensitive data, including proper handling of masked data, credentials, test accounts, tickets, screenshots, chats, and external services.

Requirements

  • Experience in Integration Engineering, API QA, or a similar technical role.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and Postman.

  • Ability to read technical documentation and existing code, troubleshoot integrations, and clearly communicate technical issues.

  • Working knowledge of PHP/Laravel, JavaScript, SQL, and MySQL/MariaDB.

  • Familiarity with Git, Swagger/OpenAPI, Browser DevTools, Kibana/Grafana, and Jira.

  • Good understanding of information security and handling sensitive data.

  • English B1+.

  • Experience with payments/acquiring (3DS, webhooks, transaction statuses, payment response codes), WooCommerce/OpenCart integrations, PCI DSS, or technical customer support would be a nice to have.

  • Languages: English, Russian.

  • Experience in fintech.

Key Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving mindset - able to investigate technical issues systematically and identify root causes.

  • Clear communication - able to explain technical issues clearly and collaborate effectively with merchants and engineering teams.

  • Attention to detail & ownership - careful with technical specifications, testing, and sensitive payment data, and takes responsibility for issues through resolution.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary aligned with experience

  • Collaborative and transparent team culture

  • High-impact role in a scaling fintech company

  • Recognition of personal milestones and achievements

  • Social benefits

title: Healthcare Assistant
description:
Right at Home Homecare Assistant

The Healthcare Assistant will deliver care in accordance with individual Care Plans and organisational policies, reporting any changes in a client’s condition or wellbeing to the Care Manager or designated supervisor.

Our mission is to improve the quality of life for those we serve.
