title: Business Analyst - Insurance
description:
Help Shape the Future of Insurance Technology

Orvia Underwriting is Ardonagh’s pan-European MGA, currently operating across the UK, Netherlands and Germany, with ambitious plans for further growth. As part of our continued expansion, we are embarking on the implementation of a new Policy Administration System (PAS) that will support the next phase of our underwriting and operational capabilities.

We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in the successful delivery of this programme. Working as part of a dedicated project team and reporting directly to our CTO, you will help deliver the initial UK implementation, covering eight insurance products across a phased 9-12 month programme.

This is an opportunity to work at the heart of a transformational technology project, partnering with underwriting, pricing, operations, finance, data, IT and external technology vendors to shape how insurance products are built, traded and managed.

What You'll Be Doing

Requirements & Product Design

  • Collaborate with underwriting, pricing and data teams to define detailed, build-ready requirements for insurance products.

  • Design and document risk capture question sets, data structures, validation rules and product workflows.

  • Ensure all rating models and required data inputs are accurately captured and aligned with pricing requirements.

  • Define underwriting rules including eligibility criteria, referral triggers, authority limits and declinature logic.

  • Gather and document policy document generation requirements, including schedules, invoices, policy wordings and lifecycle communications.

  • Work with finance teams to define premium bordereaux and accounting output requirements.

Delivery & Build Support

  • Act as the key liaison between Orvia stakeholders and the PAS vendor's delivery team.

  • Clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities and ensure solutions are delivered in line with agreed scope and business needs.

  • Maintain full requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support project planning, sequencing, dependency management and release readiness activities.

Testing & Product Launch

  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts across multiple product releases.

  • Create test plans, coordinate testing activities and ensure comprehensive test coverage.

  • Support business users throughout the testing process to drive high-quality outcomes.

  • Record, manage and track defects through to resolution and retesting.

  • Assist with product go-live activities and transition into business-as-usual operations.

Documentation & Governance

  • Own and maintain project documentation, including requirements, specifications, analysis, decision logs and change history.

  • Ensure Jira (or equivalent tooling) is used effectively as the single source of truth throughout delivery.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst delivering insurance product build or configuration projects within a Policy Administration System environment.

  • Strong experience producing structured requirements documentation covering:

    • Rating structures

    • Risk capture question sets

    • Underwriting rules

    • Policy and document templates

  • Ability to work confidently with underwriters, actuaries and pricing teams, challenging assumptions and driving clarity where required.

  • Experience working alongside third-party software vendors where requirements ownership sits with the business and delivery ownership sits with the vendor.

  • Hands-on UAT experience, including test planning, defect management and test execution support.

  • Strong Jira (or similar) administration and documentation skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with insurance PAS platforms such as Insly, Acturis, Novidea, Instanda, Genasys, OpenGI, Duck Creek or Guidewire.

  • MGA, delegated authority or London Market experience.

  • Exposure to insurance accounting processes, bordereaux production, management information and reporting.

Why Join Orvia?

  • Be part of a fast-growing pan-European MGA backed by The Ardonagh Group.

  • Play a key role in a business-critical technology transformation programme.

  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and influence how insurance products are designed and delivered.

  • Join an ambitious, entrepreneurial business with significant growth plans across Europe.

Ready to help build the future of Orvia Underwriting? We'd love to hear from you. Apply today.

Orvia Underwriting is a pan‑European MGA built on connection and capability—delivering precise, insight‑driven underwriting and exceptional service for brokers and insurer partners.

  • At Orvia Underwriting, we believe in connection through expertise. Our pan‑European platform brings together the strongest underwriting talent in the industry. Orvia is a home for specialists who want to push boundaries, learn from one another, and consistently deliver market‑leading results.

  • We connect brokers and insurance capacity through deep underwriting expertise and a culture defined by collaboration and trust. Our success is built on strong relationships and a shared commitment to delivering the right outcomes for our partners.

  • Service is our competitive edge. Fast, reliable and responsive, we are built around the needs of brokers. Powered by deep capacity partnerships, our underwriting combines speed, precision and consistency, strengthening confidence at every interaction.

A destination for exceptional talent. Attracting and developing top underwriting professionals is central to our ambition. We invest in our people, creating opportunities to grow, lead and shape the future of underwriting at Orvia.

Orvia Underwriting is an equal opportunities employer, with a growing and thriving diversity, equity and inclusion strategy; we are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

title: Varasto- ja kokoonpanotyöntekijä, UH-Koneistus
description:
UH-Koneistus Oy on vaativien metallitöiden erikoisosaaja, joka valmistaa tuotteita asiakkaiden toiveiden mukaan polttamalla, koneistamalla ja hitsaamalla. UH-koneistuksen toimipisteet sijaitsevat Seinäjoella, Koivulahdessa ja Oravaisissa. Koko tuotantoprosessi on sertifioitu mikä kertoo, että UH-Koneistus on sitoutunut laatuun ja pystyy täyttämään asiakkaiden haastavammatkin vaatimukset.


Haemme UH-Koneistuksen Seinäjoen toimipisteeseen Varasto- ja kokoonpanotyöntekijää

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?

Työskentelet sisäisen logistiikan ja kokoonpanon tehtävissä. Työhösi kuuluvat tuotteiden keräily ja kokoonpano sekä varaston järjestyksestä huolehtiminen. Lisäksi viimeistelet tuotteita paineilmalaitteita hyödyntäen ja tuuraat tarvittaessa muissa varaston tehtävissä, kuten tavaran vastaanotossa ja pakkaamisessa. Tehtävässä käytetään myös sähkötrukkia.

Työaika on arkisin klo 7.00-15.30 liukuvalla työajalla ja työpaikka sijaitsee Seinäjoella osoitteessa Jalostajantie 1.

Mitä me odotamme sinulta?

Etsimämme henkilö on tarkka ja tiimityöskentelytaitoinen, jolla löytyy teknisten piirustusten lukutaito. Tarvitset työssäsi huolellista työotetta ja hyvää fyysistä peruskuntoa. Toivomme, että sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta metallialasta ja jonkin verran taustaa varastotyöskentelystä.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme vakituisen päivätyön monipuolisilla työtehtävillä. Pääset osaksi mukavaa ja rentoa työyhteisöä, jossa yhteishenki on vahva. Perehdytämme sinut kattavasti tehtäviisi, ja koko tiimi tukee sinua. Työsopimus solmitaan Biisoni Pohjanmaan kanssa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tehtävä herätti kiinnostuksesi, haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 22.9.2026 mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa mahdollisimman nopeasti.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonilta Roope Takala, puh. 050 475 2852 tai roope.takala@biisoni.fi

title: Water Hygiene Technician
description:
Location: Leicester - static position

Contract: Permanent and Full-Time, 40 hpw Monday to Friday (no evenings, no weekends, no on-call)

OTE 35-37k+ (including basic salary + sign on bonus + 10% monthly bonus + overtime)

A New Chapter: Join a Growing Leader

It is an incredibly exciting time to join PTSG Water Treatment. As a rapidly expanding leader in the water safety and treatment industry, we are setting new standards for excellence across the UK. With a portfolio spanning over 25,000 sites nationwide and a team of dedicated specialists operating across every sector, our growth is driven by a commitment to delivering faster, more innovative, and deeper solutions for our clients. We are not just expanding our footprint; we are evolving our capabilities and investing in the experts who make it happen. If you are looking to be part of a forward-thinking, industry-leading team where your contribution truly matters, we want you to be part of our journey.

What you'll be doing:

As a key part of our team, you'll travel to customer sites, ensuring water systems are safe and compliant across the region. Your day will involve essential tasks like inspecting and cleaning water storage vessels (including leading on tank chlorinations), installing and servicing Thermostatic Mixing Valves, and conducting routine monitoring tasks in line with HSG 274 Part 2. This means you'll be flushing water outlets, monitoring temperatures, descaling showerheads, flushing pressure vessels, and performing crucial sampling for closed water systems.

You'll also expertly use our SimPRO system to manage your workload. Your ability to spot problems and proactively find solutions, combined with your detailed knowledge of HSE’s ACoP L8 and HSG274, will be vital in maintaining our professional and compliant reputation.

You'll need a full, clean UK driving licence and have City & Guilds Legionella Awareness Training, equivalent or suitable industry experience to succeed in this role.

What we offer:

We believe in supporting our people! You'll receive a competitive salary that reflects your expertise, a company vehicle to get you to customer sites, and a full technology package to support your work.

This is a field-based, permanent and full-time (40 hours per week) opportunity.

We're committed to your growth, offering full training in company processes and fantastic opportunities to upskill and develop your career. You'll also benefit from a comprehensive group benefits package.

  • Competitive salary + company car with fuel card

  • Overtime rate 1.5-2x

  • 10% bonus when working certain sites

  • Earn £500 per successful employee referral

  • Paid travel time after 30 minutes

  • Life assurance (3x salary)

  • Online GP access + prescriptions

  • Vivup discount platform (gym, tech, holidays, retail & more)

  • Salary sacrifice pension

Please note that a successful candidate must undergo an enhanced DBS check and CTC clearance.

Apply today and let's make a difference together!

About PTSG

PTSG Group is a leading provider of specialist services across the UK and Europe.

Through the acquisition of high-quality specialist businesses, PTSG has built a group of industry-leading companies delivering services across Access & Safety, Electrical Services, Building Access, Fire Solutions, and Water Treatment.

With over 3,300 specialists supporting 90,000+ customers across 200,000 buildings, delivering over 170 different services, we are committed to delivering safe, compliant, and high-quality services nationwide.

At PTSG, our aim is simple. To be a great place to work and a great company to do business with.

Armed Forces Covenant

PTSG Group is proud to support the Armed Forces community and has formally signed the UK Armed Forces Covenant.

We recognise the valuable skills and experience that service leavers, veterans, reservists, and military families bring to the workplace, including leadership, teamwork, resilience, and technical expertise.

As part of our commitment, we guarantee an interview to ex-Forces applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role and are committed to supporting Armed Forces personnel in building long-term civilian careers across our business.

PTSG Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are dedicated to promoting diversity, equality, and inclusion throughout our recruitment process and across the wider business.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - 260421-5
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high-growth, high-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.

At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.

Position Summary

The Senior Staff Software Engineer will provide technical leadership in designing and evolving large-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures across multiple teams and organizational domains. This role will drive long-term technical strategy, architectural modernization, AI-enabled engineering practices, and platform capabilities while improving system reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of large-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures to ensure long-term scalability, reliability, and extensibility.
  • Define and guide technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams, aligning engineering priorities with business objectives and product goals.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development practices and AI-enabled capabilities to improve engineering effectiveness, product innovation, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple systems and domains while driving technical alignment and successful execution.
  • Identify, communicate, and mitigate systemic technical risks while advancing system reliability, observability, performance, and operational maturity.
  • Define and drive strategies for reducing technical debt, modernizing legacy systems, and improving platform architecture across the organization.
  • Develop and promote shared platform capabilities, services, tooling, and engineering practices that improve developer productivity and system consistency.
  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, influence technical direction, and promote a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and high-quality system design.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience driving technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams or organizational domains.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and evolving large-scale distributed systems, platform architectures, and cloud-based production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud-native architecture, scalability, reliability, security, and cost optimization.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex and ambiguous environments, influence technical stakeholders, and drive alignment and execution across teams without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with .NET full-stack and API development across frontend and backend technologies, with proficiency in Rust, C#, and/or JavaScript.
  • Extensive experience with distributed systems, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep.
  • Deep expertise in observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, incident response, reliability engineering, and operational excellence.
  • Experience with modern authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML, as well as secure coding and security architecture practices.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, progressive deployment strategies, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases and the architectural considerations involved in designing systems at scale.
  • Demonstrated experience driving engineering productivity, platform improvements, technical modernization, and AI adoption across multiple teams or organizational domains.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: PT Welcome Space Ambassador
description:
Overview

Post Covid, the working world has changed, with visitor and occupier experience at the heart of everything we do. Our Welcome Ambassadors are the first and last impression that people will have with our brand, and the brands of those we provide office space for. In order to attract and retain occupiers and top talent whilst enabling growth within a challenging market, our workplaces have become an ‘experience destination’ in themselves.

Increasing office utilisation is now firmly at the forefront of our client objectives, and our Workplace Experience roles are uniquely positioned to support desirable outcomes. Our ambition at Avison Young is simple – deliver a dynamic, market leading client solution that captures modernised needs, and drives enhanced engagement throughout the entire community in new and exciting ways. We are building for the future, and you will play a huge part in creating brand advocacy whilst delivering excellence for our clients.

Our Welcome Space Ambassadors are the first and last impression that people will have with our brand, and the brands of those Occupiers we represent. It is essential that a positive, memorable experience is delivered to all those walking through our doors. The opportunities available to us connect and engage with our customers in new and exciting ways outside of the traditional receptionist duties make our roles more attractive to those with a passion for service running through them. Avison Young are seeking to create thriving spaces that welcome everybody; informal meetings, social meetings, networking, and relaxation spaces, and we want our Welcome Space Ambassadors to be the wow differentiator within them. The role is also key in supporting and promoting our client brand values.

You will be responsible for ensuring every building user is provided with an exceptional experience. This could be provided within a variety of ways and locations; however, this role will predominantly be based out within the lobby floor ready to receive, triage and support incoming customers.

You will own the space around you, demonstrating pride in its appearance. You will constantly seek and implement new ideas, initiatives, and facilities to create a community feel which provides encouragement to others to maximise use of the space. Where available, you will utilise technology to implement an efficient and effective check-in, support onward travel and provide an ongoing experience and community focused service solution, alongside your friendly, informative, and interactive delivery. We want you to push the boundaries of the possible as you seek to provide the best-in-class user experience, always finding the hidden opportunity to surprise and delight our customers.

Our values are inherent to the success of this role. They are more than just words; they are the DNA that drives our culture and define how our people and services exceed expectations. Along with our Behaviours Playbook, they are our ways of working together, delivering for others and our all-round service ethos.

Responsibilities

  • Provide a user focused service experience that is built on the foundations of exceeding expectations, making each and every visitor and employee feel important and valued
  • Always demonstrate the behaviours set out in the ‘Behaviours Playbook’
  • Ensure the cleanliness and upkeep of the space, including entryways, surfaces, glass windows and doors are free from fingerprints escalating to cleaning operative as required
  • Welcome all users into the building in a warm, friendly, and efficient manner, supporting the onward journey where required
  • Ensure no unauthorised access is gained by following established visitor procedures for all
  • Ensure you are aware of the space around you, challenging any unusual situations appropriately
  • Ensure the location is adequately secured prior to leaving in line with established procedures, including locking of doors and switching off relevant appliances, lights etc as confirmed in training
  • Ensure you are knowledgeable about all occupiers within the building, and strive to build positive relationships with key contacts within each
  • Create and disable access passes as required for long term use (Occupiers) and day use (Visitors) in line with established procedures
  • Liaise with occupier contacts to promote the benefits of available technology to pre-book visitors, and assist with tailored pre-arrival confirmation information and pre-arrival guest services as required
  • Support efficient check-in of visitors, utilising technology where possible to ensure efficient and cost-effective solutions are promoted
  • Ensure quick communication of visitor arrivals is achieved where automated options are not utilised
  • Continuously drive relationships and connectivity with all building users to better understand their views on changing needs and requirements of the service delivery, keeping aware of service trends and seeking solutions to introduce them into the everyday service
  • Utilise technology to drive communication and community within your space
  • Use autonomy given to take ownership of the welcome spaces, taking pride in appearance, and regularly reviewing innovative opportunity the space can accommodate
  • Promote, manage, and maintain the use of touch down areas within the Welcome spaces as well as other facilities within the building / community as appropriate
  • Where appropriate, provide waiting visitors with a hot/cold beverage and offer any further support if needed, acting as a representative for, and until they are collected by, their host
  • Champion a ‘One Team’ approach with other service providers to ensure the service is seamless in appearance to the user
  • Build and maintain a current, working knowledge of all FOH policies, procedures, systems and tools in order to provide building users with information as required
  • View all challenges and complaints as an opportunity; seek to resolve the situation in a way that excels expectations, ensuring to escalate to your line manager where required
  • Be an advocate for change, motivating and supporting others with the introduction of new initiatives
  • Continuously seek and action feedback on service delivery and opportunity
  • Play an active role in reviewing, and creating improvement plans from external audit reports
  • Network with your Experience colleagues around the UK, building relationships and supporting each other
  • Offer input and perspective at team meetings, demonstrating reason and emotional intelligence
  • Offer input into the monthly client report, taking ownership of allocated sections as requested
  • Take an active role in training and supporting new/cover colleagues through their induction period
  • Attend training courses as required, actively seeking to introduce learnings into everyday service
  • Take charge of your own development, actively contributing to appraisals and seeking training opportunity
  • Ensure Health and Safety requirements within your remit are monitored, escalating where appropriate ensuring that you do not endanger yourself or others in your working environment
  • Where agreed within your location, monitor CCTV and escalate any concerns appropriately (CCTV SIA License required)
  • Ensure compliance (zero tolerance policy) with all Avison Young policies, including but not limited to; GDPR, Bribery, Bullying and Harassment, and unconscious bias
  • Participate and assist with client visits and prospective occupier show rounds
  • To portray yourself as an Ambassador for Avison Young at all times

This job description is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks. Your day-to-day workstreams may include tasks not listed above and it is expected that you will demonstrate a positive, ‘can do’ approach to any other reasonable duties requested of you with the correct escalation of concerns where required. It is a live document and will be reviewed and reissued as appropriate in line with any changes to our service requirements.

Qualifications

  • SIA Licensed (Security and CCTV where required), or willingness to achieve accreditation (Please discuss with your recruiter if you do not currently have an SIA License)
  • Exudes passion for service delivery in their character
  • Has a proactive, motivated, good natured personality
  • Always communicates in a positive tone
  • Possesses a very customer focused manner, confident in delivering exceptional services in all circumstances and environments
  • Has a passion for technology and opportunity to utilise within service delivery environment
  • Thrives in an environment where providing solutions is key to success, demonstrating creativity to problem solving
  • Is a change advocate
  • Forward thinking, and wants to continuously develop the service and themselves
  • Excellent attention to detail – always seeking to find the hidden opportunity to wow whilst ensuring the security of the building
  • Team player, supports all colleagues to achieve with a ‘One Team’ focus
  • Maintains pride in personal appearance, following any guidelines set by the company
  • Ability to react quickly, and prioritise needs in a fast-paced environment
  • Previous experience within a service delivery environment similar to hotels, airlines etc and confidence to demonstrate at interview
  • Previous experience and comfort working with technology in service delivery, and possessing the ability to adapt to new technology as it is launched and confidence to demonstrate at interview
  • Ability to demonstrate understanding of, and previous experience of delivering, exceptional service at interview
  • Confident communicator
  • Competent user of Microsoft Office suite
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • This is not a ‘desk-only’ based role; you will be expected to be present and mobile within the Lobby area for parts of the day

Equal Opportunities

At Avison Young, we are committed to building an inclusive culture that empowers all of our employees to thrive, be successful and feel a sense of belonging. Avison Young is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally. If you are person with a disability, if you are neurodivergent, or if you have a condition that you believe may affect your performance during our selection process, Avison Young will be happy to make reasonable adjustments to our processes for you.

- monipuolisen työn vaihtelevissa kohteissa

- laadukkaan perehdytyksen

Muuttajan työ on aktiivista ja liikkuvaa ryhmätyötä. Palvelet asiakkaitamme tärkeässä roolissa osana muuttoryhmää. Yleisimpiä työtehtäviäsi ovat tavaroiden suojaus, pakkaus ja siirto sekä mahdolliset muut työtehtävät oman osaamisesi mukaisesti.

Vaatimuksena on 18 vuoden ikä sekä virallinen henkilöllisyystodistus. Ajokorttia tai aikaisempaa kokemusta ei vaadita. Tärkeintä on reipas asenne.

Työ on erikseen töihin kutsuttavaa, eli voit itse määrittää, koska olet käytettävissä. Töitä tehdään pääsääntöisesti arkisin ja satunnaisesti myös viikonloppuisin. Palkkaus on Muuttopalvelualan TES A-Tason mukainen 12,46€/h

Mikäli kiinnostuit paikasta, jätä hakemuksesi hakulomakkeen kautta mahdollisimman pian, sillä täytämme paikat haun edetessä. Lisätietoja antaa seppo.hummelholm@niemi.fi

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3gYVE_F0MPc

Niemi Muuttaa Kaiken

Niemi Palvelut Oy on vuonna 1981 perustettu muutto- ja logistiikkapalveluihin erikoistunut yritys. Toteutamme vuosittain kymmeniätuhansia palvelutoimeksiantoja yli 800 ammattilaisen voimin. Asiakkaidemme suositteluhalukkuus on erittäin korkealla tasolla (NPS 93, Niemi Palvelut 2025). Olemme vastuullisuuden edellätekijä. Koko kalustomme kulkee fossiilittomasti biokaasulla, uusiutuvalla dieselillä tai sähköllä. Tavoitteenamme on nollapäästöinen kalusto sekä hiilineutraalius vuonna 2035.

title: Family Engagement Lead - Blackburn
location: Blackburn Youth Zone, Jubilee St, Blackburn, BB1 1EP
description:
Family Engagement Lead - Babyzone Blackburn

Key Details:

  • 8:30am to 3:00pm on Wednesdays in term time
  • £13.45 per hour
  • Based at Blackburn Youth Zone, Jubilee Street, Blackburn BB1 1EP
  • Reporting to the Head of Babyzone Blackburn

About Babyzone:

Babyzone is a charity which aims to support parents with children in the early years, aged 0 to 5 years. We are focused on removing barriers that many parents face in accessing high quality early years provision.

Babyzones are made up of soft play and evidence-based early years classes, one day a week in a clean, safe and welcoming environment. We design our approach around the needs of families who may not otherwise be able to access this support but are open to all.

Parents and carers do not sign up in advance; there is no charge and we do not ask for any personal details. We believe that by removing barriers we are creating a fully accessible, inclusive place for parents and carers to bring their children to talk, read, sing and play together.

The role:

The Babyzone Family Engagement Lead is the face of Babyzone for our families and is responsible for ensuring that the set up and operations of the Babyzone run smoothly throughout the day.

Key activities:

  • Setting up and packing away Babyzone each Wednesday. This will include preparing the space by moving furniture, adjusting the layout to meet the needs of the families and ensuring that the space is clear of any hazards.
  • Supporting the external class leads with equipment that is required to deliver the Babyzone each week.
  • Supporting with the set up and packing away of the exploratory areas/soft play areas and overseeing these areas during the day (making sure there is no food or shoes on the mats, keeping the space tidy, safe and free of hazards).
  • Setting up and maintaining additional elements such as a book corner and ensuring easy access to buggy parking and the baby-changing facilities.
  • Personally, welcoming each family to Babyzone, engaging with families and their children throughout the day, facilitating relationships, building community and signposting to local services.
  • Capturing family numbers by entering basic postcode data into a digital form as families arrive at Babyzone
  • Acting as a point of contact and problem solver for any issues during the day that are raised by families or class leaders to ensure the smooth running of the Babyzone.
  • Welcoming external stakeholders to Babyzone
  • Championing the Babyzone ethos and mission
  • Meeting regularly with the Head of Babyzone Blackburn to share good practice.

Your skills and experience:

  • You must love engaging with all families and young children.
  • Understand and care about Babyzone’s mission.
  • Be motivated and committed to the Babyzone principles and show sensitivity to the needs of the families who visit Babyzone.
  • Be energetic and proactive, remaining calm under pressure.
  • Value and support everyone who comes into contact with Babyzone with an awareness of, and commitment to equal opportunities, equality and diversity.
  • Have an awareness of the importance of safeguarding children and understand that this is the responsibility of everyone.
  • Be comfortable with the physical demands of moving furniture around and be up for the challenge of a quick set up and close down process
  • Work effectively as part of a team.
  • Have excellent verbal communication skills.

Babyzone will offer:

  • Safeguarding training and DBS check
  • Training and development opportunities

Babyzone is committed to safer recruitment practice as an important part of safeguarding and protecting children and vulnerable adults. If successful in your application for this role, you will have a DBS check approved prior to your first day in the job.

title: Footwear Designer II, Color & Materials, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

Nike Local Creation GC is one of the fastest product engines at Nike, enabling designers to connect with geo-specific consumers quickly and effectively. Reporting to the Local Creation Design organization, this role focuses on creating inspiring products tailored to specific marketplaces and geographic audiences, capturing fast-moving trends and delivering regionally relevant narratives with flexibility and speed. Local Creation team's mission is to amplify and incubate new ideas while driving and extending consumer favorites, serving local consumers with executions that offer greater relevance and immediacy. We seek a candidate who embodies our values of authenticity, accountability, collaboration, and courage—someone eager to grow, challenge themselves, and act independently as a self-driven contributor.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Designer II, Footwear Color & Materials, Local Creation GC to create color and material expression across sportswear footwear opportunities for the Greater China marketplace.

This is an intermediate-level individual contributor role. The Designer II is expected to apply established creative direction, increasingly own assigned work, and build fluency across the end-to-end footwear product creation process.

The ideal candidate has strong foundational color and material skills, curiosity about Greater China consumers and culture, attention to detail, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving Local Creation environment.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Design Manager, Footwear Color & Materials, Local Creation GC.

You will collaborate with:

  • GC Footwear and Apparel Design, Color & Materials, and Graphics

  • GC Product Management, Merchandising, Development, and Marketing

  • Sportswear category and partners

  • Global and Geo Design counterparts

  • Material developers, vendors, manufacturers, and external creative partners

  • Consumer insights and marketplace teams

You’ll also engage with external vendors and suppliers to bring your designs to life, ensuring alignment with Nike’s brand standards and regional consumer expectations.

WHAT YOU BRING

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Footwear Design, Color Design, Material Design, Textile Design, Fashion Design, Industrial Design, or a related field preferred.

  • Equivalent education, experience, or professional training will be considered.

Experience and Capabilities:

  • Typically 1 to 4 years of relevant design experience.

  • A portfolio demonstrating color sensibility, material awareness, creative thinking, and product application.

  • Working knowledge of color theory, color blocking, material selection, trims, finishes, and product storytelling.

  • Foundational understanding of footwear construction and manufacturing.

  • Curiosity about Greater China consumers, culture, sport, style, and marketplace trends.

  • Ability to work within defined creative direction while contributing original ideas.

  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn from feedback.

  • Clear visual, verbal, and written communication.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple assigned tasks and meet deadlines.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

  • Familiarity with 3D and AI-enabled visualization tools such as Vizcom, and collaborative tools preferred.

  • Ability to travel as required by the role.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As the Designer II, Footwear Color & Materials, Local Creation GC, you will:

  • Execute assigned footwear color and material projects aligned with design direction, seasonal concepts, consumer briefs, and project timelines.

  • Create color palettes, colorways, color blocking, material selections, trims, finishes, and product details with guidance from design leadership.

  • Apply GC consumer, trend, city, sport, and marketplace research to assigned design work.

  • Support seasonal narrative building, concept development, mood boards, material boards, and visual presentations.

  • Develop CAD pages, color-ups, line art, material callouts, and other design communication required for product creation.Review prototypes and samples, resolve color and material achievability issues, and protect design intent through final execution.

  • Participate in sample and prototype reviews, identify execution issues, and incorporate feedback into revisions.

  • Learn footwear construction, material behavior, color achievability, manufacturing processes, and commercialization requirements.

  • Communicate design concepts in internal and cross-functional reviews.

  • Manage assigned tasks, handoffs, files, and deadlines with increasing independence.

  • Collaborate with Footwear and Apparel, Color & Materials, and Graphic Design.

  • Support required digital workflow, file-upload, or legal-submission processes associated with assigned products.

  • Receive feedback openly, explore alternatives, and make design changes with speed and precision.

  • Contribute to team tools, color and material libraries, trend research, and shared project resources.

#MYNEXT: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

  • Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
  • Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
  • Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
  • Partner with other functions and business areas.
  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
  • Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
  • Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
  • Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Business Analyst at Barclays, where you will play a key role in driving strategic change and business transformation across the organisation. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business requirements, design operating models and deliver innovative solutions that support Barclays' strategic objectives while ensuring robust risk management and governance.

To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:

• Strong experience in business analysis, requirements elicitation, and requirements management
• Expertise in translating complex business challenges into executable business and technology solutions
• Experience in process design, operational design, and target operating model development
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders
• Experience in business case development, feasibility assessments, and solution evaluation
• Knowledge of change management practices, including requirements traceability and benefits realization
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience evaluating multiple solution options and recommendations
• Experience managing risks, controls, and governance requirements within business change initiatives
• Ability to create and present clear and concise documentation, reports, and strategic recommendations
• Experience working across cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes

Some other highly valued skills may include:

• Ability to contribute to strategy development and drive business transformation initiatives
• Experience supporting large-scale, complex, and multi-year change programs
• Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies including Agile and Waterfall approaches
• Ability to challenge existing processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills
• Experience coaching and mentoring junior analysts and business stakeholders
• Strong understanding of financial services, regulatory, risk, and control environments
• Ability to conduct research and apply industry best practices to business challenges
• Experience collaborating across business, operations, technology, and support functions
• Professional certifications such as CBAP/BCS Business Analysis/ Agile Business Analyst or equivalent qualifications

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, business analysis, stakeholder management, change and transformation, strategic thinking, leadership, business acumen, and problem solving, as well as role-specific business analysis expertise.

The role is based out of Pune.

title: Multilingual Medical Information Specialist - Korean/English
description:
For the past 25 years, ProPharma has improved the health and wellness of patients by providing advice and expertise that empowers biotech, med device, and pharmaceutical organizations of all sizes to confidently advance scientific breakthroughs and introduce new therapies. title: Kitchen Supervisor - MOXY Edinburgh
description:
Kitchen Supervisor - Moxy Edinburgh

This position is based on a full time contract.

Gross Salary: £29.650,57 per year



SUMMARY

A hands-on, organised and accountable kitchen specialist who leads by example. The Kitchen Supervisor combines consistent food preparation and presentation with strong control of hygiene, compliance, ordering, stock, cost and waste. The role turns business forecasts, brand standards and food safety requirements into clear daily plans, ensuring the kitchen and Crew are ready to deliver a reliable Moxy food experience.

MAIN TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support Crew Leaders in coordinating the kitchen operation and take ownership of kitchen priorities, preparation plans, standards and task allocation during assigned shifts.

· Lead food preparation, set-up, service, replenishment and close-down across all service periods and menus, including breakfast and the wider all-day Food & Beverage offer.

· Prepare and present food using Merrychef ovens and other approved equipment, following recipe, portion, quality, presentation and service-time standards.

· Own kitchen food safety and hygiene standards, ensuring compliance with HACCP principles, company procedures, applicable legislation and safe working practices.

· Own the relevant kitchen and food-safety sections of the Saeker compliance platform, ensuring checklists, temperature records, cleaning records, actions and supporting evidence are accurate, complete and submitted on time.

· Review Saeker performance and overdue actions routinely, investigate non-compliance, implement corrective actions and escalate significant or recurring risks to the Crew Leaders and Captain without delay.

· Maintain effective controls for cooking, reheating, hot and cold holding, chilling, storage, date labelling, traceability, product rotation and FIFO stock management.

· Maintain a clean, organised and sanitary kitchen, stores and back-of-house areas through clear cleaning schedules, safe chemical use and documented standards.

· Ensure allergen information is accurate and accessible, prevent cross-contact, respond correctly to guest allergen enquiries and ensure only trained colleagues handle allergen-related requests.

· Complete routine quality, hygiene and readiness inspections, correct issues immediately where possible and communicate outstanding risks through clear shift handovers.

· Own food ordering for every service period and menu, placing accurate orders within agreed schedules, supplier arrangements and budget expectations.

· Liaise closely with reception Crew Leaders to review occupancy, arrivals, departures, groups, events, packages and expected covers, translating forecasts into ordering and preparation requirements.

· Maintain appropriate stock levels and contingency for demand changes while avoiding unnecessary over-ordering, shortages, expired stock and emergency purchases.

· Receive and check deliveries for quantity, quality, temperature, damage, dates and specification; resolve discrepancies and store products safely and promptly.

· Control food cost through accurate ordering, stock counts, portion control, recipe compliance, invoice and delivery checks, and investigation of significant usage or stock variances.

· Monitor and reduce food waste through accurate forecasting, careful preparation, stock rotation, correct storage and recording of waste by type and reason.

· Share food cost, waste, stock and compliance performance against relevant goals with Crew Leaders and the team, identifying actions and following progress through to completion.

· Maintain and communicate Marriott and Moxy Food & Beverage brand standards, menu updates, campaigns, product specifications and presentation requirements.

· Build and maintain a structured kitchen training plan covering induction, food hygiene, allergens, safe equipment use, food production, recipes, portioning, cleaning and Saeker compliance.

· Deliver practical training, demonstrations, role-play and refresher sessions; maintain accurate training and proficiency records and follow up where further support is required.

· Coach Crew Members in the moment and support Crew Leaders in identifying capability gaps, setting development actions and recognising improvement.

· Ensure only trained and authorised colleagues complete food production, use kitchen equipment or undertake higher-risk food-safety tasks.

· Plan daily preparation and communicate clear handovers so all shifts understand stock levels, defrosting or preparation requirements, shortages, allergens, equipment issues and outstanding actions.

· Monitor guest feedback and relevant Food & Beverage satisfaction results, identify recurring issues and implement practical improvements to quality, availability and service consistency.

· Keep kitchen equipment clean, safe and serviceable, complete routine checks, report defects promptly and prevent use of unsafe equipment.

· Work collaboratively with reception and Food & Beverage Crew to manage peaks, maintain availability and deliver a seamless guest experience.

· Follow security, cash-handling, licensing, health & safety, manual-handling and emergency procedures relevant to the role.

· Undertake any other duties that may reasonably be required in line with the main purpose of the role.

KNOWLEDGE / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

· Previous experience in a kitchen, food-production or hospitality environment, ideally with responsibility for coordinating colleagues or standards.

· A recognised food hygiene qualification appropriate to the role, or willingness and ability to complete the required training promptly.

· Practical knowledge of HACCP, allergens, temperature control, cleaning, traceability, FIFO, stock rotation and safe food storage.

· Experience of food ordering, stock control, food cost and waste management, with confidence using forecasts and basic performance data.

· Confidence using online compliance platforms such as Saeker, ordering systems, email and Microsoft Office applications.

· Experience training, coaching or supporting colleagues, with the confidence to deliver structured and practical learning sessions.

· Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise and make calm decisions in a fast-paced environment.

· Clear written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to challenge unsafe or non-compliant practice constructively.

PERSONALITY

· Has high energy and a fearless do-it-yourself attitude.

· Passionate about food, cleanliness and delivering consistent quality.

· A credible, patient and enthusiastic trainer who enjoys helping others improve.

· Proactive and accountable, with the confidence to challenge standards and follow actions through.

· A skilled multitasker who balances food safety, commercial control and great service.

· A positive team player who knows being relaxed isn't the same as being lazy.

BENEFITS FOR YOU!

  • Health Cash Plan
  • Discounted room rates for you, as well as your Friends and Family, at Marriott hotels worldwide
  • Discount on Food & Beverages at Marriott hotels worldwide
  • Enhanced Maternity/Paternity/Adoption pay
  • Pension scheme
  • Twenty eight holidays (annually increasing to max thirty three holidays)


*a personality assessment can be part of the recruitment process*

title: Product Manager - Legal
description:
Join OneAdvanced

The Product Manager is responsible for the successful development, delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of the Legal Portfolio. The role acts as the voice of the customer, translating customer needs, business priorities, data insights, and market opportunities into a clear and prioritised product backlog and roadmap. Working closely with engineering, design, commercial, marketing, and customer-facing teams, this role ensures that solutions deliver measurable customer and business value while maintaining high standards of quality, usability, performance, and compliance. The role also leverages AI-enabled capabilities and tools to enhance product outcomes, accelerate discovery, and improve decision-making.

This role is advertised as a Birmingham hybrid position. However, we are committed to supporting internal mobility and will consider applications from colleagues with existing alternative working arrangements on a case-by-case basis.

What You Will Do

  • Own and manage the product backlog end to end, leads sprint plans, backlog grooming, and release planning. Ensure features, enhancements, defects, technical debt, and risks are effectively prioritised to maximise customer and business value.
  • Lead customer discovery activities, including customer interviews, feedback analysis, research, and insight gathering to identify user needs and opportunities.
  • Act as the primary voice of the customer, ensuring customer insights directly influence product decisions and priorities.
  • Define requirements, acceptance criteria, and success measures for product features and releases. Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and cross-functional delivery activities with engineering teams.
  • Own, maintain and effectively communicates the product roadmap, making informed decisions on sequencing, priorities, and trade-offs.
  • Partner with UX and design colleagues to create intuitive, customer-centred experiences and ensure solutions meet usability and quality standards.
  • Define, track, analyse, and report on product performance metrics against pre-defined success measures. Build and interpret product dashboard and use data to drive continuous improvement and validate decisions. Setting clear measures for success for features and releases
  • Serve as the product expert, deeply understanding and able to provide guidance on product capabilities, technical architecture, limitations, and dependencies.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and manage competing priorities across engineering, commercial, operational, customer, and partner groups.
  • Contribute to product launches and go-to-market activities, ensuring readiness across commercial, marketing, and customer-facing teams.
  • Maintain ownership of product health, including quality, performance, security, compliance, technical debt, and ongoing lifecycle management

What You Will Have

  • Strong understanding of modern product management methodologies, agile delivery practices, and product lifecycle management.
  • Good understanding of the legal sector and workflows within that sector
  • Knowledge of customer discovery techniques, user research methods, and customer-centred product development.
  • Understands and applies AI capabilities and prompt engineering to improve the quality of outputs in day-to-day work.
  • Practical understanding of UX principles and the relationship between user experience and product success. Understanding of product metrics, analytics, performance measurement, and data-driven decision making.
  • Awareness of commercial drivers, including revenue growth, retention, customer value, and product profitability.
  • Understanding and experience of AI-enabled technologies, product applications of AI, and responsible AI principles.
  • Knowledge of market analysis, competitive positioning, and emerging technology trends.

Please note, This vacancy will remain open until 25 August 2026. Interviews will be scheduled shortly after the closing date, so we encourage interested colleagues to submit their application as early as possible. All applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application.

What We Do For You

Making a Difference

Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including:

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

As a SDE 2 Backend Engineer at AiDASH, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimising scalable backend systems that power our web and mobile app platform. You will own end-to-end feature development - translating product requirements into fully functional features that work well at scale by deploying robust backend microservices.

Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, web and mobile engineers, you will drive intuitive, data-driven applications while maintaining high availability, fault tolerance, and performance efficiency.   • Implement scalable and resilient distributed systems, ensuring fault tolerance and reliability.
  • Work on having enough testability and observability in place for running world-class production systems with near 100% system uptime.
  • Encourage and follow good coding practices via peer-to-peer code reviews.
  • Refactor services to improve code quality, runtime efficiency and resource optimisation.
  • Evolve AiDASH architecture as we continue to scale.
  • Monitor, analyse, and optimise system performance and resource utilisation.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in distributed systems technologies and methodologies.

What we're looking for:

  • Sound understanding of Java and Spring Boot/ Python. Unit test cases, code quality and coverage.
  • An extremely good working knowledge of relational database systems (PostgreSQL/MySQL) or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
  • Experience in designing, developing and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Operational experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS.
  • Knowledge of performance optimisation techniques, including load testing, profiling, and the ability to identify and resolve bottlenecks in backend systems.
  • Understanding of backend security principles, encryption, authentication, and authorisation.

title: Criminal Justice Team Leader
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Criminal Justice Team Leader who has the skills and experience to support and develop our Criminal Justice offer at CGL River. The successful candidate will manage a team of Criminal Justice Recovery Coordinators to support clients involved in the Criminal Justice System as well as working closely with partner agencies.

No two days are the same and we treat every person who comes into our service as an individual, so being flexible, curious and a good listener are key.

Where: CoventryHours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Please note: Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and any associated payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

As a Criminal Justice Team Leader, you will work as part of the service, developing pathways between Criminal Justice Agencies, both in the community and within the prison service in order to support seamless continuity of care. As the Team Leader, the post holder will be expected to work with their team to support service users subject to court orders such as ATR, DRR, IOM and prescribed clients released from custody. The Team Leader will line manage a number of Recovery Coordinators working within the Criminal Justice Team and will link in with the Opiate, Engagement and Alcohol Team Leaders to ensure that all staff work collaboratively within the teams.

Partnership Working: To work in partnership with all Criminal Justice Agencies (including police, probation, court staff and liaison and diversion partners) within the area and develop pathways and mutual ways of working to gain the best outcomes for the service users.

Service Development: Work with partners to increase accessibility into treatment for those involved within the criminal justice system. Developing initiatives that CGL River are involved in, such as the Intensive Supervision Court Pilot.

Leadership: To lead a team that manages criminal justice service users that are subject to a Community Sentence Treatment Requirement.

Developing Relationships: To lead on relationships with the National Probation Service and the Judiciary to ensure an effective pathways for service users involved in the Criminal Justice System who will be managed in a community setting.

Supporting Staff: To support staff to increase the number of successful completions, and reduce the number of representations to service and reduce the harm caused by substance use and crime. To support staff through regular supervisions and provide additional support, where needed.

Data: To work with staff including data analyst as well as partners, to ensure data is captured and recorded appropriately, developing processes when required to ensure data is reported to external bodies such as PHE and NDTMS in accordance with requirements.

Person Specification:

Understanding: Excellent understanding of drug and alcohol issues and experience of working within Criminal Justice or related field.

Knowledge: Knowledge of the Criminal Justice system.

Collaboration: Experience of working with Criminal Justice partnerships.

Supportive: Knowledge of effective interventions that lead to reduction in drug related crime.

If you're ready to make a positive impact and help individuals navigate the criminal justice system toward's a brighter future, we encourage you to apply. Join us in creating lasting change and empowering lives.

What We Offer:

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Additionally, you'll receive one extra day of annual leave for each year of service during your first five years, therefore you will enjoy 30 days of leave after five years with us.
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour weekly.
  • 'Wellness' hub and Employee Assist Programme.
  • Contributory pension scheme.
  • Varied benefits incl. shopping, cinema, and holiday discounts.
  • Supportive team, training, career progression opportunities.
  • Competitive rates of pay, free eye tests, product discounts.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

The successful candidate will need to complete an enhanced DBS check and obtain HMPPS vetting.

title: FINCRIME ANALYST (M/F)
description:
Behind every transaction, there’s a story. Find the ones that don’t add up.

We're a fintech that makes money move simply, quickly and securely.

What started as a Croatian idea has grown into a European fintech platform trusted by millions of users. From everyday payments and money transfers to the Aircash Mastercard, we keep expanding our products, entering new markets and finding new ways to make financial services work better for our users.

“That’s just how it’s always been done” isn’t an answer we accept.

Our FinCrime team is growing, and we're looking for someone with a detective brain — curious, sharp and stubborn enough to keep digging until the facts line up.

No deep risk background needed. Just a strong analytical instinct, an eye for detail and the kind of mind that simply can’t leave a loose end alone.

Location: Zagreb office or Split office

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor transactions and behaviour, spotting risky patterns and staying a step ahead
  • Running investigations end-to-end and reviews against defined risk indicators, documenting everything so it's airtight and easy to build on
  • Handling escalated cases and seeing them through to a clear, defensible outcome
  • Connecting dots across transactions, behaviour, and everything else that doesn't fit the story
  • Flagging accounts that need a closer look, verification, or restriction
  • Spotting emerging fraud tactics before they become tomorrow's headline, and shutting them down early
  • Turning your findings into sharp reports that move cases fast when they need to be escalated
  • Working with different teams across the company to piece the full picture together and drive cases to resolution
  • Learning the inner workings of payments, fintech and financial crime as you go

Qualifications you bring:

  • 2+ years of professional experience
  • Earlier in your career? If you've got a strong analytical instinct and a real feel for detail, we'd still love to hear from you
  • Hands-on experience in AML / FinCrime / Fraud Prevention is a plus, not a must
  • A degree in economics, finance, law, technology, or something adjacent
  • Sharp analytical thinking and a structured, no-shortcuts approach to problem-solving
  • An eye for the details everyone else scrolls past, and the focus to stay sharp even when the work gets repetitive
  • A "why did this happen" mindset, not just a "what happened" one
  • Comfortable with data, pivot tables and formulas
  • A clear communicator and team player — you explain complex cases simply and know when to loop others in
  • Fluent English, spoken and written
  • A genuine curiosity about fintech, payments and financial crime

What we bring to the table:

Innovation drives us, and we never stop asking "what's next?".
