title: Footwear Designer I, Color & Materials, Jordan, Local Creation GC
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world's best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At Nike, it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

As the pace of the Global consumer is rapidly changing all around the world, the Nike local creation looks to create inspiring product closer to the consumer. Deepening consumer connection and operating with speed, the Greater China local creation team looks to serve consumers with speed and specificity with a focus on the Key Cities of Shanghai & Beijing.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a Designer I, who will work with a cross-functional team of design, product management, and development partners. The ideal candidate is an entry level creative who understands and learns how to deliver story and style. Through the design of Footwear (CGM), this role will assist design team with supervision of design leaders to create industry leading footwear collections that connect with local consumer expression through authentic local narratives. The candidate will craft unique work with Color and Graphic Design in conjunction with Materials, Trims and Details to create highly covetable product that connects athletes* in their local market. They have an eye for detail and motivation to craft premium product. This role has a unique opportunity to drive hyperlocal narrative and a holistic vision for style that resonates with Sports, Streetwear and Lifestyle consumers in the Greater China (GC) geography.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will be working with GC geography experts in insights, marketing, product, development and design. You will collaborate with functional experts and leadership in Color, Material, Graphic and Footwear and Apparel Product Design across various parts of the business.

WHAT YOU BRING

• BA/Associate Degree in Graphic Design, Product Design or related field preferred.

• 0-2 years relevant work experience in Graphic Design, Color Design, Product Design or Fashion Design.

• Portfolio of work to show creative ability.

• Strong passion for research and gathering cultural and market insights.

• Effective communicator and collaborator with cross-functional partners.

• Awareness of the Nike brand, its design ethos, and its cultural relevance.

• Professional working English for day-to-day work. Bilingual is a plus.

• Proven ability to create concepts, iterate and collaborate with a multi-disciplinary product and creative team.

• Connection to contemporary art and design, sport and streetwear trends.

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize work and handle multiple projects and timelines.

• Basic ability to apply and perform color and graphic design skills, including drawing/sketching, typography, ideation, color theory, use of texture, spacing, and scale, visual presentation development and layout that is supported by a portfolio of non-computer-based creative art and graphic design.

• Computer literate using Mac platforms with a high digital design acumen in design-based software (Creative Suite).

• Experience with 3D and AI Design tools is not required, but is a plus.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

This designer will work with their cross-functional partners to understand the needs of the consumer and create an inspiring product narrative using market trend and local cultural insights. They will be part of the creative process to create a vision by telling unique hyperlocal stories that resonate with Sports, Streetwear and Lifestyle consumers. They will assist the design team to make world-class footwear expressions using Graphic and Color Design in collaboration with Materials, Trim and Development experts.

As an entry level designer, they will assist the design team and Design Director in preparation of materials for communication and presentation of design concepts to internal and external audiences, and help the team create tools (CADs / design tech pack / graphic schematics, etc.) for product development, legal approval, and archive integrity.

If this is you, you’ll be working with the GC local creation team to design compelling Footwear and Apparel products that bring energy to local markets.

Day-to-day tasks include:

• Consumer and trend research.

• Understanding and learning the design process.

• Communicating design intent through presentations and mood boards.

• Sketching and exploration.

• Collaborating with other designers and participating in design reviews.

• Creating product CADs and tech packs.

#MYNEXT: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

title: Small Business Banking, National Office, Intern/Co-op (WINTER 2027)
description:
Role Type:

Internship/Co-op

Work Term:

Winter/Term 2

Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours:

37.5

Pay Details:

$45,700 - $74,400 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Co-op and Internship opportunities allow you to gain valuable work experience across a number of the businesses at TD. You will work with experienced colleagues, receive world class training, and be part of a community of students across TD, where you will have an impact, grow as individual and experience our culture of care.

Our Co-op/Intern Programming is offered with select Co-op and Internship roles and is designed to help you better understand the TD business, build on critical career capabilities, and broaden your professional network. This program is designed to complement your on-the job experience and features:

  • Leadership talks with key Leaders from across the organization

  • Connect and Learns on topics such as Innovation

  • Diversity and Inclusion and Personal Branding and so much more

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

  • Canadian Personal Banking (CPB) provides a comprehensive suite of deposit, saving, payment and lending products and advice through a network of 1,062 branches, 3,438 automated teller machines (ATM), mobile specialized salesforce, and telephone, mobile and internet banking services. CPB is comprised of the following line of businesses:

  • Chief Operating Officer (COO) mandate is focused on building and executing innovative strategies for CPB partners that lead to new and deeper customer relationships, new revenue streams, improved colleague and customer experience, and greater productivity overall. The team is comprised of subject matter experts in diverse disciplines across strategy, finance, operations, risk management, regulatory governance, business architecture, change, communications, event planning, talent management, multi-media and more.

  • Real Estate Secured Lending (RESL) & Specialized Sales Force (SSF) help Canadians achieve their homeownership financial goals throughout the entire customer journey with Mortgages and TD Home Equity FlexLines. It also includes specialized credit advice, underwriting, and fulfillment of key processes for Personal Banking.

  • Canadian Card Payments, Loyalty & Personal Lending (CCPL&PL) is responsible for Credit Card and Personal Lending Banking Products that meet the unsecured borrowing needs of Canadians while enhancing TD's loyalty offerings and partnerships that improve the value propositions for our customers.

  • Everyday Savings & Investing (ES&I) is responsible for the day-to-day banking products (Chequing domestic and cross-border banking, Overdraft Protection, Savings, GICs and Mutual Fund products) that meet the everyday banking savings and investing needs of Canadians

  • Branch Banking Delivery Excellence (BBDE) is responsible for building customer and colleague confidence by supporting approximately 18,000 Branch Banking colleagues in TD's more than 1,100 branches across Canada.

  • Digital Transformation & Strategy focuses on driving CPB's digital strategy in partnership with our business leaders, journey owners and enterprise stakeholders, including Platforms and Technology and Transformation, Enablement and Customer Experience.

  • Small Business Banking – focuses on supporting Canadian entrepreneurs with advice, products, services and distribution support across branch, digital, remote and specialist channels, helping customers start, manage and grow their businesses.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Small Business Banking (SBB) is a dynamic business within TD Business Banking, focused on helping Canadian entrepreneurs start, manage, grow and transition their businesses. SBB serves SME owners through a multi-channel distribution model that includes in-person, remote and digital channels. The business has a clear ambition to become the Bank of choice for Canadian Entrepreneurs through supporting and enabling entrepreneurs to accomplish their business goals.

The successful candidate will support Small Business Banking Strategy and Segments, which acts as a central partner and subject matter resource for SBB distribution teams and partner lines of business. This may include helping coordinate and track initiatives that impact in-field teams, supporting issue resolution and escalation management, supporting field enablement materials, reviewing performance and operational reporting, and contributing to activities related to strategy and customer experience.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Data, Business/Commerce or related field

  • Must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree with the intent of going back to school at the start of your work term

  • Strong interest in Small Business Banking, distribution support, sales enablement, operations, customer experience, colleague experience, strategy or financial services

  • Comfortable working with business performance, operational and issue-tracking information to identify trends, summarize insights and support practical recommendations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear updates, field-facing materials, meeting notes, presentations and executive-ready summaries

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented and able to coordinate multiple priorities, follow-ups, stakeholders and timelines in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel and Word; experience organizing data, creating trackers or preparing reporting summaries is considered an asset

  • Demonstrated curiosity, problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity while learning about Small Business Banking distribution channels, customer journeys, partner interactions, governance and operational processes

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Please note that this posting is for a Small Business Banking work term. If you are selected for an interview, more information regarding the specific team, business priorities and day-to-day responsibilities will be provided.

  • This position is a 4-month work term and will commence January 4 2027 - April 23 2027

  • Applications must include a transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (maximum of 2 pages).

  • We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. Thank you for your interest.

  • TD requires employees to reside in the country where the role is located, irrespective of remote working arrangements

  • TD is committed to providing you with the best candidate experience and internship in these unique circumstances. As such, work location and start dates are subject to change.

HOURS

Monday-Friday, standard business hours

INCLUSIVENESS

At TD, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Saneringstekniker
description:
Vi söker nu ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt team i Piteå för att vi ska kunna hjälpa fler kunder att rädda ekonomiska värden och tid när olyckan varit framme. Ocab är Sveriges största skadeservicekoncern. Vi är inne på en spännande tillväxtresa med stora strategiska satsningar inom digitalisering, hållbarhet och utveckling av vår tjänsteleverans inom rivning och sanering.

Vårt erbjudande

På Ocab har du flera möjlighet att utvecklas i rollen som Rivning – och saneringstekniker. Vi sanerar efter brand, klotter och vattenskador, utför byggstädning och sanerar mögel, lukt, asbest och PCB med stort fokus på hållbarhet.

Vi erbjuder dig ett varierande arbete där du får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad för våra kunder. Du arbetar främst ute i fält med att utföra olika typer av uppdrag inom rivning och sanering efter brand-asbest och vattenskador eller vid ombyggnation.

Hos oss får löpande utbildning för att du ska växa och känna dig trygg i yrkesrollen. Alla saneringstekniker kommer arbeta med asbest och du får den utbildning du behöver för att kunna utföra arbetet. Du arbetar både självständigt och i team tillsammans med engagerade kollegor och vi delar alltid med oss av varandras kunskaper. För dig som är hungrig, vill lära dig mer och utvecklas finns goda karriärmöjligheter inom såväl avdelningen, bolaget och i koncernen. Det finns flera goda exempel på medarbetare som har byggt sin karriär hos oss.

Arbetet utgår från Piteå, men det kan förekomma arbete på annan ort.

Om dig

Att samarbeta med oss ska vara en kvalitetsgaranti. Våra största kunder är försäkringsbolag, större industrier, Fastighetsbolag och kommuner. På Ocab ”räddar vi värden” genom att sanera, torka och återställa istället för att kassera, riva och bygga nytt. I grunden en hållbar verksamhet som värnar om miljö och människan.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta brett med värderäddande insatser. Hos oss skiftar arbetslagen så dagen blir extra rolig och lärorik då du alltid jobbar med olika erfarna kollegor. I teamet delar vi med oss av varandras erfarenheter.

För att passa in i teamet ska du vara en lagspelare med förmåga att samarbeta. Vi ser det som en självklarhet att du är arbetsvillig och nyfiken att vilja lära mer. Som Saneringstekniker är du vårt ansikte utåt och den som har direkt kontakt med våra kunder. Därför är det viktigt att du är lyhörd med förmågan att förstå kundens behov.

Eftersom arbetet tidvis kan innehålla tunga lyft behöver du vara i god fysisk form. För oss är arbetsmiljö och säkerhet viktigt. Eftersom vissa arbeten är riskfyllda behöver du även vara ansvarstagande och värna om både din och dina kollegors arbetsmiljö och säkerhet. Du ska även gilla att hålla ordning och reda i ditt arbete.

Kompetenser och meriter för rollen

Att du är händig och har erfarenhet av fysiskt arbete inom närliggande verksamhet ser vi som en förutsättning. Vi lägger även stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och söker dig som har positiv energi, är driven och har viljan att utvecklas med oss. Du är även ansvarstagande och ordningsam och kan upprätthålla en hög servicenivå i alla lägen gentemot våra uppdragsgivare och skadedrabbade. Du bör även känna dig bekväm att hantera smartphone.

Kompetenskrav för rollen:

  • Körkort B

  • Kommunicera och göra dig förstådd på svenska. Kan du flera språk är det meriterande.

Övrig information:

Ocab ingår i en större koncern med kontor på över 50 orter i landet. Vi sanerar efter brand, klotter och vattenskador, utför byggstädning och sanerar mögel, lukt, asbest och PCB med stort fokus på hållbarhet.

Ordinarie arbetstider hos oss är 07-16. Eftersom vi inte kan styra när olyckan sker jobbar vi på dygnets alla timmar och för den som vill finns det möjlighet att ingå i vår jourgrupp och ha beredskap.

För våra medarbetare ska vi vara en trygg arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal, försäkringar, pension och avtalsenlig semester.

Är du intresserad?
Du ansöker genom att skicka in ansökningshandlingar via nedan ansökningsknapp.
Vi intervjuar kandidater löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas tidigare.
Start: Enligt ök
Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar provanställning.

Vi strävar efter jämn könsfördelning och värdesätter etnisk och kulturell mångfald. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Som ett led i att säkerställa hög kvalitet på våra rekryteringsprocesser vill vi uppmärksamma sökande att slutkandidater efter sitt godkännande kommer att omfattas av en bakgrundskontroll.

Om oss

Ocab är ett rikstäckande sanerings- och avfuktningsföretag som finns på ett 50-tal orter över hela landet. Våra kunder finns i hela Sverige inom försäkringsbolag, fastighetsbolag, FM-bolag, industri, bostadsrättsföreningar och privatpersoner. Vi räddar ekonomiska värden och tid vid skador orsakade av framförallt brand och vatten och erbjuder tjänster vid utredningar, underhåll och sanering av fastigheter och industri.

Vi strävar efter jämn könsfördelning och värdesätter etnisk och kulturell mångfald. Tillsammans står vi för Kvalitet – Engagemang – Hållbarhet.

title: Polish-speaking Quotes & Tenders Specialist
description:

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Härkämäen päiväkoti
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Härkämäen päiväkodin uudehkoihin, Väinölänpuistoon sijoittuviin toimintatiloihin. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen mukaan. Rahjekatu 4:ssä toimii yhteensä 9 ryhmää, joista kahdessa on esiopetusta ja avoin varhaiskasvatus. Lisäksi Härkämäen päiväkotiin kuuluu 2 esiopetusryhmää Aunelan koulussa.

Hakijalta odotamme tehtävän kannalta riittävän hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja pedagogista, lapsilähtöistä työotetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.

Liikunnalla, leikeillä ja luovuudella on toiminnassamme keskeinen merkitys. Tahdomme tarjota lapsillemme turvallisen ja lämpimän oppimisympäristön, jossa lapsi saa oppia ja kokea leikin, liikkumisen, tutkimisen, taiteen ja muun monipuolisen toiminnan kautta. Lapsen kohtaaminen ja arvostaminen ainutlaatuisena ihmisenä on meille tärkeä asia!

Päiväkotimme sijaitsee hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä. Bussipysäkit sijaitsevat päiväkodin läheisyydessä. Turun keskustasta päiväkotiin on matkaa noin 4 km. Päiväkotimme asettuu metsäiseen saarekkeeseen Naantalintien ja 8-tien väliin, joten kulkeminen on helppoa myös pyörällä, kävellen tai omalla autolla.

Härkämäen ulkoilumahdollisuudet ovat monipuoliset ja metsäretket kuuluvat viikoittaiseen ohjelmaamme.

Tule kanssamme luomaan hyvää ja oppimiseen innostavaa toimintakulttuuria.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jo hakuaikana.

Tervetuloa tiimiimme!

Kelpoisuusvaatimus määräytyy varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) § 26 / § 27 mukaan.

Tehtävään valittavan tulee toimittaa rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002) työnantajalle.

Eduksi luetaan esiopetuspätevyys.

- monipuolisia koulutuksia
- Fölin työmatkakortin edullisempiin bussimatkoihin
- Tyky-rannekkeen Turun kaupungin liikunta- ja kulttuuripalveluihin

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Turun kaupunki suosii anonyymiä rekrytointia. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa sitä, että rekrytointiprosessin ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työhakemuksen avoimiin kysymyksiin ei tule sisällyttää tietoja esim. iästä, äidinkielestä tai sukupuolesta. Vaikka osaa tiedoista taustatiedoissa kysytään, nämä tiedot eivät näy rekrytoivalle lähijohtajalle anonyymissä hakijaraportissa. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen.

title: Salesforce Data Architect
description:
Senior Salesforce Data Architect

Location: Johannesburg / Cape Town (Hybrid / Strong WFH flexibility)

Permanent: R950,000 – R1,350,000 per annum (Base package, negotiable based on tenure and scope)

Contract: R600 – R850 per hour (Long-term specialist contract)

Most data roles force you to choose between two frustrations: digging through data without the authority to build the solution, or designing architecture without touching the underlying insight.

This role sits directly in the gap between the two.

You will step into a high-visibility position within a premier financial services consultancy, connecting complex Salesforce environments with enterprise SAP core systems. You will not just report on data; you will design the technical blueprints, data pipelines, and architecture proposals that shape how major financial institutions operate.

What is in it for you:

  • Scope and Authority: You will own the full transition from data discovery to end-to-end solution design rather than generating static reports for someone else to act on.
  • Complex Tech Ecosystems: Build solutions across high-demand frameworks including Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC), OmniStudio (Vlocity), and core SAP integration patterns.
  • Direct Executive Influence: Pitch your architectural designs directly to business leaders across banking and insurance, operating as a commercial advisor rather than a back-room technical resource.
  • Work-Life Balance: Genuine hybrid flexibility operating out of modern Johannesburg or Cape Town hubs, built around delivering outcomes rather than tracking hours at a desk.
  • Flexible Engagement: Available as a permanent role or a long-term contract, letting you structure your employment to match your financial and career goals.

What you bring to the table:

  • 5+ years in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance (FSI): Deep knowledge of the regulatory landscape, data structures, and operational realities of financial institutions.
  • Dual Data & Architecture Capability: Proven track record running deep data analysis alongside enterprise data modelling, ETL design, and architecture blueprinting.
  • Salesforce & SAP Exposure: Hands-on experience navigating Salesforce data architectures and mapping them back to core SAP models.
  • Stakeholder Fluency: The ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, commercially sound recommendations for non-technical executives.

Exposure to Salesforce FSC, OmniStudio, TOGAF, or modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Snowflake) will put your application at the front of the queue.

If you are ready to take full ownership of cross-platform solution design, send your CV through to Badger & Bird Talent today.

description:
Hoitajat ja terveydenhuollon ammattilaiset, kiinnostaako työskentely Pohjois-Norjassa?

Oletko haaveillut työskentelystä ulkomailla? Norja on yksi Pohjoismaiden parhaista työympäristöistä terveydenhuollon ammattilaisille: kilpailukykyinen palkkaus, hyvät työolosuhteet ja kansainvälinen kokemus odottavat sinua.

Kartoitamme Norjassa työskentelystä kiinnostuneita lähi- ja sairaanhoitajia sekä kätilöitä. Työtä on tarjolla Pohjois-Norjassa, esimerkiksi Saltenin alueella Nordlandin läänissä. Työt sijoittuvat ensisijaisesti hoivakoteihin ja vanhuspalveluihin, mutta työtä voi olla myös sairaalaosastoilla.

Hyvällä ruotsin kielen osaamisella pärjää Norjassa. Paras tilanne on, jos sinulla on jo vahva ruotsin kielen osaaminen, mutta tarvittaessa voimme järjestää myös kielikoulutusta.

Autamme löytämään juuri sinulle sopivan työpaikan ja selvitämme puolestasi parhaat vaihtoehdot toiveidesi ja aikataulusi mukaan. Työtä voit sopia lyhyeksi tai pidemmäksi jaksoksi.

Mitä tarjoamme:
- Yksilöllinen työnvälitys, kerro toiveistasi
- Autamme majoitus- ja matkustusjärjestelyissä ja katamme kulut
- Suomenkielinen tuki koko rekrytointiprosessin ja työjakson ajalle, et ole yksin

Mitä edellytämme/toivomme sinulta:
- Sinun tulee olla terveydenhuollon laillistettu ammattilainen, esimerkiksi lähi- tai sairaanhoitaja (täytyy löytyä JulkiTerhikistä)
- Ruotsin tai norjan kielen osaamista

Ilmoita kiinnostuksesi ja kerro toiveistasi.

title: Digital Transformation Program Manager
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Digital Transformation is a multi-year enterprise initiative focused on standardizing business processes, creating a digital core, improving data quality, enabling AI-driven insights, and deploying scalable technology platforms across the organization. Key initiatives include Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and enterprise data modernization efforts.

The impact you’ll make

The Digital Transformation (DT) Program Manager will lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and related business process modernization. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs from planning through deployment, ensuring alignment with business objectives, digital transformation roadmaps, and enterprise architecture standards.

The Program Manager will partner with business stakeholders, IT, solution architects, vendors, and PMO leadership to design, implement, and optimize scalable business processes and technology solutions. title: Frysemaskinist
description:
Som Maskinromsoperatør/Kjøletekniker vil du ha en sentral rolle i å sikre stabil og sikker drift av fabrikkens tekniske anlegg. Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Overvåke og drifte fabrikkens kjøle-, fryse- og dampproduksjonsanlegg.

  • Sikre optimal drift av ammoniakkanlegg og tilhørende maskinrom.

  • Gjennomføre inspeksjoner og driftsrunder for å identifisere og forebygge avvik.

  • Feilsøke og utbedre tekniske og mekaniske feil på anlegg og utstyr.

  • Utføre vedlikehold, inkludert utskifting av ventiler, pakninger, sensorer og andre komponenter.

  • Overvåke og analysere driftsdata via fabrikkens styrings- og overvåkingssystemer.

  • Sørge for at anleggene drives i henhold til gjeldende krav innen sikkerhet, kvalitet og regelverk.

  • Dokumentere utført arbeid og rapportere avvik i interne systemer.

  • Samarbeide tett med produksjon og teknisk avdeling for å sikre høy oppetid og effektiv drift.

  • Delta ved installasjon, testing og oppstart av nytt utstyr og nye anlegg.

title: Toimistosiivooja arki-iltoihin (14-22)
description:
Haemme nyt osaavaa TOIMISTOSIIVOOJAA korkeatasoisen palvelutiimimme vahvistukseksi avainasiakaskohteeseemme ESPOON TAPIOLAAN!
Tässä tehtävässä vastaat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella Tapiolassa sijaitsevan toimitilakohteen ylläpitosiivouksesta. Puhtaana pidettäviin tiloihin kuuluu mm. toimistoja, kokoustiloja sekä sosiaali- ja yleisiä tiloja. Toimitilakohde on iso, joten työpäivän aikana kävellään paljon, ja työhön sisältyy päivittäin fyysisestä raskasta imurointia. Kohteen pääasiallinen työskentelykieli on englanti.
Hyödynnät päivittäisessä työssäsi nykyaikaisia siivoustekniikoita sekä erilaisia koneita ja laitteita. Olet hymyilevä ja haluat aidosti tuottaa ensiluokkaista palvelua sekä puhtaat ja viihtyisät tilat korkealla laatuluokituksella.
Työvuorosi ovat pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 14-22. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen (37,5 h / vk). Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja työsuhde on määräaikainen 31.12.2026 asti.
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 2 mukaista palkkaa (12,59 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.

ISS on paikka juuri sinulle! Meillä saat
- paikan, jossa voit kasvaa: meillä voit rakentaa oman urapolkusi ja hyödyntää monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksiamme.
- työyhteisön, jossa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi.
- vakaan ja luotettavan työpaikan, jossa voit luottaa siihen, että palkkasi maksetaan oikein ja ajallaan. Erityisiä onnistumisia huomioimme ISS-palkitsemisohjelman mukaisesti.
- turvalliset työolosuhteet: suojavarusteet, työvaatteet, perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, ennakoivaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin ja säännölliset turvavartit.


Meillä viihdytään, koska täällä voi kasvaa, vaikuttaa ja onnistua. Tutustu taitaviin tekijöihimme: ISS töISSä

Sinulta me odotamme
- aiempaa kokemusta toimistosiivouksesta vähintään 1 vuoden ajalta. Siivouskoneiden (Phantas, Whiz, iMop, Taski) käyttökokemuksen katsomme vahvasti eduksesi.
- sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa voidaksesi kommunikoida tiimisi ja asiakkaan kanssa. Suomen kielen taidon katsomme eduksesi.
- erinomaista palveluasennetta sekä ymmärrystä edustustason siivouksen ja palvelukulttuurin velvoitteista ja vaatimuksista.
- tarkkaa ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa sekä hyvää fyysistä kuntoa.


Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät. Tule meille rakentamaan omaa ISS urapolkuasi ja tekemään kanssamme tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Täytä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 16.9.! Voit kertoa osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi joko liittämällä hakemukseesi cv:n tai kirjoittamalla tiedot hakulomakkeen tekstikenttään. Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Me, ISS Suomi, olemme osa maailman johtavaa kiinteistö- ja toimitilapalveluyhtiötä, joka toimii yli 30 maassa. Suomessa meitä ISS:läisiä on yli 7 000 ja toimimme valtakunnallisesti. Toimintamme tarkoituksena on luoda tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla. Luomme näitä tiloja siivous-, kiinteistö-, ravintola- ja työpaikkapalveluillamme. Siivous on palvelualoistamme suurin. Olemme luoneet puhtaita ja siten turvallisia, viihtyisiä ja tuottavia tiloja yli 100 vuoden ajan. Nykyisin siivoamme yhä useammissa kohteissamme kemikaalivapaasti, moderneja siivouskoneita käyttäen. Työparinasi saattaa olla robotti!
Ilmastotavoitteenamme on olla hiilineutraali vuonna 2040 – ISS:läisenä pääsetkin vaikuttamaan merkittävästi tämän tavoitteen toteutumiseen ja yhteisen ympäristömme hyvinvointiin!
Kurkkaa, mitä ISS:llä tapahtuu:
- Verkkosivut: ISS Palvelut ja ISS työpaikkana
- Instagram: isssuomi
- LinkedIn: ISS Palvelut
- Facebook: Duunissa ISS Suomi
- YouTube: ISS Palvelut

title: Ulkoaluetyöntekijä Turku
description:
Pidätkö ulkotöistä ja fyysisestä työstä? Tule ulkoaluetyöntekijäksi Turkuun!



Etsimme asiakkaallemme ulkoaluetyöntekijää Turun alueelle monipuolisiin kiinteistöjen ja piha-alueiden kunnossapitotehtäviin. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään vaihtelevissa ympäristöissä ja huolehtimaan siitä, että ulkoalueet pysyvät siisteinä, turvallisina ja viihtyisinä.


Työpäiväsi koostuvat erilaisista ulkoalueiden hoito- ja ylläpitotehtävistä vuodenajan mukaan.
Tehtävässä menestyy henkilö, joka viihtyy ulkona säästä riippumatta, tarttuu työtehtäviin oma-aloitteisesti ja arvostaa huolellista työnjälkeä. Aiempi kokemus ulkoalueiden kunnossapidosta, kiinteistönhoidosta tai rakennusalan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on reipas asenne ja hyvä työmotivaatio.



Millaisella taustalla pääset hyvin alkuun?

- Kokemuksella ulkoalueiden kunnossapidosta, kiinteistönhoidosta tai vastaavista tehtävistä

- Kokemus puutarhatöistä katsotaan eduksi sekä alan koulutusta

- Hyvällä fyysisellä kunnolla

- Oma-aloitteisella ja vastuullisella työotteella

- Kyvyllä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana tiimiä

- Huolellisuudella ja luotettavuudella

- B-ajokortilla ja C-ajokortti, joka katsotaan eduksi



Miksi tähän mahdollisuuteen kannattaa tarttua?

- Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät ulkoalueiden parissa

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä itsenäisessä ja vastuullisessa roolissa

- Hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviin

- Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi käytännönläheisessä työssä



Oletko valmis tarttumaan tilaisuuteen?

Haluamme tehdä työnhausta sinulle vaivatonta ja helppoa. Jätä yhteystietosi sekä lyhyt kuvaus itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi alla olevan hakulomakkeen kautta.

Aloita uusi urasi tästä ja lähetä hakemuksesi tänään!


YES Your Excellent Staff Oy

Me YES:sillä haluamme löytää sinulle itsesi näköisen työpaikan. Voimme tarjota sinulle monenlaista työtä, mutta myös erilaisia työnteon malleja, jotka sopivat juuri sinun aikatauluihisi ja elämäntilanteeseesi.

Voit yhdistää helposti vapaa-ajan harrastuksesi tai opiskelusi tarjoamiimme töihin.
Toimialoihimme kuuluu mm. rakentaminen, teollisuus, logistiikka, toimisto- ja kaupan ala sekä hotelli- ja ravintola-ala.

Meille on myönnetty Arvostettu työpaikka® - sertifikaatti vuosille 2025–2026. Tämä tunnustus kertoo siitä, että panostamme työyhteisöömme, arvostamme työntekijöitämme ja kehitämme toimintaamme henkilöstön palautteen pohjalta.

title: 2027 Summer Analyst - Corporate Banking (Toronto)
description:
Role Type:

Internship/Co-op

Work Term:

Summer/Term 3

Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours:

37.5

Pay Details:

$100,000 - $100,000 CAD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

About TD Securities


TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience.

With more than 6,900 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we help clients meet their needs today and prepare for tomorrow. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

We are growth-oriented, people-focused, and community-minded. As a team, we work to deliver value to our clients every day.

TD Securities is one of Canada's most active dealers in Debt and Equity product. Corporate and Investment Banking Credit is our team of in-house credit assessment professionals. They work closely with our Investment Banking and Sales and Trading teams, as credit is an integral part of many of our institutional client initiatives. Our credit team is involved in the origination of business and responsible for the analysis, risk assessment and ongoing monitoring of these credit transactions. At TD Securities, we believe that diversity is the key to our success in the competitive global marketplaces and we embrace people with a wide range of unique experiences and abilities.

Job Description

Your Role as a Corporate Banking Analyst:

  • Involved with the structuring of new credit, preparation of client presentations, preparation of credit applications, providing support related to client and transaction development, and supporting transaction execution

How You Will Contribute:

  • Conduct appropriate market, industry and client research and risk analysis in support of the credit development and credit submissions where appropriate
  • Assist with the development of financial solutions for clients, including review and comment on credit facility term sheets and timely completion of client presentations
  • Prepare and recommend credit submissions including annual and interim client reviews
  • Work closely with Investment Banking, and other product groups, including Equity Capital Markets, Debt Capital Markets, Derivatives, Cash Management and Foreign Exchange to ensure that cross sell opportunities are being developed and captured.

Qualifications:

  • Graduating with an undergraduate business degree in December 2027 or June 2028
  • Strong financial and analytical skills
  • Excellent knowledge of MS Excel
  • Superior verbal and written communications skills

Location: Toronto

How to Apply:

You must submit your complete application package (cover letter, resume, most recent unofficial transcripts), including projected graduation date. Cover letters may be addressed to:

Novjiot Chahal

Early Talent Acquisition Partner, TD Securities

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.


Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Program Manufacturing Leader
description:
Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

Your mission, roles and responsibilities

The main missions of the role are:

  • Own overall manufacturing strategy and delivery for assigned programs from acquisition through stable production

  • Act as the senior manufacturing authority and primary interface with Program Management, Product Engineering, plants, customers, and suppliers

  • Lead design‑to‑manufacturing and industrialization strategy through concurrent engineering and manufacturability governance

  • Define and govern Manufacturing Validation Plans (MVP), prototypes, and industrial readiness reviews

  • Direct development, costing, and deployment of production systems using Lean, CAPEX, and Group standards

  • Govern engineering changes, industrial risks, FMEA, and make‑or‑buy decisions across the program lifecycle

  • Lead production readiness, PPAP, Run @ Rate, and launch execution across involved plants

  • Ensure achievement of Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Performance targets, including margin and investment commitments

  • Drive cross‑functional alignment and decision‑making across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, HSE, and Engineering

  • Monitor program performance, risks, and milestones, ensuring disciplined reporting and on‑time delivery

Your profile and competencies to succeed


Qualifications:

Minimum education level: Bachelor's degree in any related engineering field.

Experience:

  • 5 - 10 years of experience in NPI / Manufacturing Engineer/ Launch Management from Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) is required.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of:

    • Lean Manufacturing & production system design

    • Concurrent engineering and DFM/DFA

    • PPAP, Run @ Rate, MVP, FMEA

    • CAPEX management and manufacturing costing

  • Experience working with multi-plant or regional manufacturing environments

  • Strong project management, coordination, and stakeholder communication skills

  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a matrix organization

  • Good command of English for technical and program communication

What we can do for you

  • At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
  • We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
  • We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
  • We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
  • We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
  • Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.

Why join us

FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.

With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.

In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045.

As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road-users everywhere.

title: Specialist On Field Operations
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Sport inspires us. Innovation drives us. Come Win With Us at DICK’S Sporting Goods as part of a team that redefines what’s possible.

Whether you live for sport or cozy fashion, you’ll love building your career at DICK’S. It’s more than a job — it’s a chance to be part of a team where you’re welcomed, supported, and empowered from day one. In our stores, you’ll make a real difference by delivering exceptional experiences to athletes of all abilities. If you’re coachable, accountable, collaborative, and trustworthy, this is the place for you. Win with us every time you step onto the floor.

Support a seamless athlete experience by executing key on-floor processes including merchandising, pricing, and product availability. As a Specialist – On Field Operations, you will combine operational expertise with an athlete-first mindset to ensure the store delivers a consistent, high-quality experience. Be part of a team that brings discipline, energy, and service together.

Anticipates the needs of the athlete; actively drives sales through product and services recommendations and a deep understanding of athlete needs.
  • Assists with onboarding and training of new and existing team members (as subject matter expert of their area of the store), focusing on best practices, expectational selling skills, and key operational processes. Serves as a go-to expert in designated process categories, ensuring smooth execution and high productivity.
  • Demonstrates efficiency and effectiveness in process execution while maintaining an athlete-first mindset; ensures products are ready for athletes to purchase and athletes are engaged when, where, and how they want.

  • Promotes and drives customer participation in company programs (i.e., customer loyalty program participation, warranty sales, private label credit card enrollment, etc.).

Adheres to established policies and procedures related to safety, loss prevention and standard operating procedures, as well as to laws/guidelines of external governing entities.

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years of experience
  • Previous retail or customer-facing experience preferred

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.

  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.

  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

Targeted Pay Range: $20.00 - $28.00. Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, location, experience and position offered. The actual hourly rate will equal or exceed the required minimum wage applicable to the job location.DICK'S Sporting Goods complies with all state paid leave requirements. We also offer a generous suite of benefits. To learn more, visit www.benefityourliferesources.com.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About you

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished Python Developer to join our talented Engineering Enablement team. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise in modern Python development and a passion for working with cutting-edge AI technology. As a key player in our organization, you should have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software, building scalable systems, and continuously learning new technologies.

Purpose of the role

At nShift, we're developing a cutting-edge system that streamlines carrier integrations through intelligent automation. This role offers the chance to work on a dynamic platform that combines traditional software development with AI-powered coding assistance to accelerate integration workflows.

We're seeking a pragmatic, hands-on developer who will design and build integration solutions that connect seamlessly with external and internal systems. You'll write production code while also developing AI coding agents that enhance and expedite the integration process, making it faster and more efficient for our team and clients.

No prior AI/LLM experience required - we're looking for strong software engineers who are excited to learn and work with cutting-edge AI technology. If you have solid engineering fundamentals and curiosity about AI, we'll help you develop the AI-specific skills.

Technology

Process

Collaboration

  • Work closely with other developers, product managers, and stakeholders

  • Participate in planning and architectural discussions

  • Take ownership of features from design to deployment

Competence and Experience

For the role of Python Developer in our AI Platform team at nShift, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience with Python is required. Experience with API design, database optimization, and system architecture thinking is essential.

Not mandatory - these can be learned on the job: experience with LLMs, AI agent frameworks, or vector databases.

Problem-Solving Ability: You have strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Learning Mindset: Genuine curiosity about AI/ML and eagerness to learn new technologies. You are comfortable reading documentation and learning new frameworks.

Pragmatic Mindset: You balance quality with delivery speed, knowing when to ship a working solution and when to refine. You understand that iteration beats perfection, and you're skilled at evolving systems over time rather than trying to build everything at once.

Effective Communication: Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your work, follow through on commitments, and care about delivering value to users.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years hands on experience on Python

  • Experience with databases

Preferred (Nice to Have)

Education & Experience

title: Lead, Material Capability Engineer (Taichung is preferred)
description:
Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world's best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, push boundaries, and deliver what has never been done before. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream, and create. Its culture thrives on diversity and imagination. At Nike, it’s about bringing skills and passion to a challenging, constantly evolving game.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Nike’s Product Integrity organization is building scalable color and material quality capabilities that strengthen Tier 2 supplier readiness and execution before quality issues occur.

This role reports to the Director of Color & Materials Manufacturing Quality. As the Lead, Material Quality Capability Engineer for Leather and Synthetic Leather, you will serve as the material-class subject matter expert responsible for designing, developing, and scaling quality capability programs across APAC and Footwear. you will translate deep material and manufacturing expertise into practical capability frameworks, assessment methodologies, inspection protocols, training, and technical tools that strengthen Tier 2 supplier readiness and execution.

You will connect common needs across product engines, establish scalable approaches where appropriate, and ensure capability programs address the specific manufacturing and quality requirements of Leather and Synthetic Leather. You will partner with Supplier Management, Material Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Standards & Governance, Materials Quality Engineering, suppliers, laboratories, and third-party assessment partners to assess, verify, and uplift material quality capability.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Build cross-product engine material quality capability

  • Develop and maintain a capability strategy and roadmap for Leather and Synthetic Leather that supports priorities across APAC and Footwear.
  • Design scalable capability programs, tools, and technical guidance that can be applied consistently across product engines while addressing relevant regional and material-class needs.
  • Translate best-in-class manufacturing practices and Nike quality expectations into clear capability requirements for Tier 2 suppliers and partners.

Design programs, assessments, and enablement tools

  • Create and continuously improve accreditation and audit frameworks, supplier capability assessments, inspection protocols, scoring logic, readiness criteria, training, and supporting program documentation.
  • Define methods to evaluate quality management systems, technical competency, manufacturing process controls, testing capability, visual inspection practices, data integrity, and continuous-improvement maturity.
  • Pilot, validate, refine, and scale programs with Nike stakeholders, suppliers, laboratories, and third-party assessment partners.

Advance Leather and Synthetic Leather capability

  • Apply deep Leather expertise across tanning, finishing, grading(SATRA), surface aesthetics, physical performance, and related process controls to strengthen supplier capability programs.
  • Apply deep Synthetic Leather expertise across polymer systems, coating, lamination, backing construction, finishing, embossing, and related process controls.
  • Identify material-class capability gaps and convert them into structured learning priorities, supplier enablement plans, assessment content, and preventive guidance.

Strengthen supplier readiness and enablement

  • Design capability and manufacturing-readiness assessment for new or existing suppliers, manufacturing locations, technologies, and material applications using defined assessment criteria.
  • Develop and deliver onboarding, calibration, technical training, train-the-trainer materials, and deployment guidance for Nike teams, Tier 2 suppliers, and external partners.
  • Build deployment playbooks, auditor or assessor qualification requirements, and program governance tools that enable consistent and sustainable execution.

Turn quality signals into capability insights

  • Use assessment results, audit findings, program data, partner feedback, and relevant quality signals to identify systemic capability gaps and emerging material risks.
  • Define program data requirements and measures so capability and assessment results can be compared across suppliers, regions, and product engines.
  • Translate insights into program enhancements and focused recommendations for Supplier Management, Product Creation teams, Standards & Governance, and other execution partners.

Evaluate and scale new material quality approaches

  • Benchmark external practices and evaluate new quality tools or technologies, including digital and AI-enabled material inspection solutions.
  • Recommend where new methods can improve assessment consistency, technical learning, program scalability, or supplier capability visibility.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in materials manufacturing, supplier management, product creation or manufacturing.
  • 8+ years of experience in APAC or FW manufacturing, quality engineering, product integrity, supplier quality management, or a closely related field is preferred.
  • Hands‑on experience working directly with suppliers and factory partners.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and external manufacturing partners while maintaining clear quality governance and accountability.
  • Strong project management and execution discipline with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience using production quality data, dashboards, or analytics to improve visibility, support decision-making, and prioritize risk mitigation.
  • Demonstrated experience leading supplier quality programs, manufacturing readiness work, or capability deployment across regional or global manufacturing networks.
  • Clear communication with escalating risks and driving resolution.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10%.

title: Acoustic Engineer
description:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.

We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo & Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.

We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.

QUALIFICATION / EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture, Engineering, or equivalent

  • Generally, a minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience

  • 3+ years of relevant acoustic consulting experience (Middle East experience preferred)

  • Demonstrated experience in acoustic measurements (sound level meters, building acoustics test equipment)

  • Strong foundation in acoustic theory and calculations (sound insulation, room acoustics, HVAC noise, vibration isolation)

  • Familiarity with noise and vibration assessment methodologies for the built environment

  • Experience on residential and hospitality projects — from concept design through to completion and testing

  • Site experience is essential: noise monitoring, building acoustic testing, construction-stage inspections

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform building acoustic testing (airborne and impact sound insulation) to ISO 140 / ISO 16283 standards

  • Carry out acoustic calculations and analysis (sound transmission, reverberation time, HVAC noise, external noise ingress)

  • Prepare noise and vibration impact assessments for acoustic design projects throughout the project life cycle

  • Develop acoustic design strategies and specifications for residential, hospitality, and mixed-use developments

  • Client Focus / Relationship Building - Ability to independently represent the company in a client facing role and manage Client satisfaction.

  • Strategic Vision / Planning - Buy-in to corporate and divisional strategy. Ability to assist various divisions in developing business opportunities.

DEMONSTRATED KNOWLEDGE BASE AND PROFESSIONAL SKILLSET

  • Time Management / Planning - Monitor progress and time taken to complete tasks to ensure tasks completion stays on track. Balance the time spent on activities, understanding and prioritising the urgency of tasks.

  • Industry Experience / Thought Leadership - Demonstrated industry experience on a wide range of related project types, proven ability to efficiently manage project deadlines.

  • Project Management / Operational Delivery - Ability to independently manage the delivery of smaller projects ($50k) in a client facing role. Strong knowledge of technical discipline with experience in executing previous projects to a high level of independence.

  • Leadership / Team Management Experience - Commence taking on elements of team management in sub projects. Demonstrable experience in managing a small team of 2 or more, on live projects, or mentoring junior team members / graduates.

  • Commercial Acumen / Business Development - Manage commercials on project delivery with support from more senior team members. Assist in creation and delivery of proposals.

  • Problem Solving / Decision Making - Coordinating tasks and solving specific problems within the areas of responsibility.

  • Employee Focus / Process Compliance - Actively coordinate efforts to enhance employee experience, such as planning and executing recognition programs, conducting surveys, and organising employee well-being initiatives. Identifies external regulations that can impact the organisation.

  • Upholding AESG Core Values - Upholding AESG Core Values such as: Honesty, Flexibility, Adaptability, Client-centricity and Collaboration.

title: Specialist Planner
description:
Job Title

Specialist Planner

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

As a Specialist Project Planner, you will join the APAC Airports Planning Team and be responsible for end-to-end planning management for all project activities, including large-sized and complex projects. You will clearly set out decision moments and turnaround times for and with all of the disciplines involved in a project. You will set up and develop an integrated project plan using Primavera P6, which ensures that opportunities and threats are identified in good time. Armed with your information and reports, project managers, project leaders, and subcontractors and their teams will be in a position to set or adjust their course promptly, wherever they are in the world. You will play a central role in the projects in which you are involved. You will report to project management and will be required to produce project reports in line with the contract requirements.

Project planners are part of the Domain Airports Team:

You will be responsible for your own projects at the Airports Domain APAC. You will set priorities, identify problems and take the steps necessary to resolve them (as part of a multidisciplinary approach). You will be involved in every phase of a project: from sales, engineering, supply and shipping to the commissioning of systems. As a project planner, you will work intensively with other disciplines, such as sales, project management, project engineering and the supply chain. You will be the key person in a project; you will identify the consequences of misalignment between the expectations of project management, engineering and the possibilities offered by the supply chain. Apply Earned Value Management (EVM) functionalities to calculate and analyze PV (Planned Value), EV (Earned Value), AC (Actual Cost), SPI (Schedule Performance Index), and CPI (Cost Performance Index), providing quantitative insights into project health. You will ensure that projects are completed successfully, providing clear, quantifiable analysis of project performance, key milestones, and associated risk.

Your qualifications and skills:

If you’re an experienced, enthusiastic, and analytical project planner, you will excel at:

  • Effectively translating the scope of a project into an overall project plan

  • Developing and maintaining project progress reports, performance dashboards, and management information outputs.

title: Ylihoitaja
description:
Nykyisen ylihoitajan siirtyessä eläkkeelle haemme kokenutta ja asiantuntevaa hoitotyön johtajaa ja esihenkilöä Terhokodin ylihoitajan tehtävään.

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn vaativan erityistason palliatiivista hoitoa ja saattohoitoa tarjoavan Terhokodin hoitotyön johtajana.

Ylihoitajan tehtävässä

  • johdat Terhokodin hoitotyötä

  • toimit hoitohenkilökunnan (25) ja erityistyöntekijöiden (5) esihenkilönä

  • ohjaat Terhokodin päivittäistä hoitotyötä

  • huolehdit henkilökunnan hyvinvoinnista ja kannustavan ilmapiirin luomisesta

  • kehität henkilöstön osaamista ja hoitotyötä näyttöön perustuvien käytäntöjen kautta

  • vastaat omalta osaltasi potilasturvallisuudesta, laadunhallinnasta, prosessien sujuvuudesta ja toiminnan jatkuvasta kehittämisestä

  • teet yhteistyössä Terhokodin johtajan ja ylilääkärin kanssa talouden suunnittelua, seurantaa ja toiminnan sopeuttamista muuttuvissa tilanteissa

  • teet aktiivisesti yhteistyötä HUS:n, hyvinvointialueiden ja Helsingin kaupungin kanssa

  • toimit yhteistyö- ja asiantuntijaverkostoissa

Toimimme Terhokodissa moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä, jonka vuoksi työ vaatii selkeää viestintää sekä erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Ylihoitajana sinun on tärkeää tukea hoitohenkilöstön ja erityistyöntekijöiden voimavaroja, osaamisen kehittymistä sekä motivoida ja kannustaa henkilöstöä. Olet tavoitteellinen ja organisointikykyinen, mutta samalla inhimillinen arjen kohtaamisissa. Onnistuaksesi hyvin tehtävässä tarvitset vahvan kokemuksen henkilöstöjohtamisesta ja saattohoitotyöstä.

Kelpoisuusehdot

  • terveystieteen maisterin tutkinto tai vastaava aikaisempi tiedekorkeakoulututkinto

  • terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain 559/1994 mukainen laillistus Suomessa

  • saattohoitotyön työkokemus

  • kokemus ylihoitajan tehtävästä tai vastaavasta vaativasta esihenkilötehtävästä

  • tiedolla johtaminen ja talousosaaminen ovat niin ikään tarpeellisia tehtävässäsi menestymiseen

  • luemme eduksi kokemuksen verkostotyöstä ja muutosjohtamisesta

Työskentelemme arvojemme mukaisesti

Terhokodissa hoidetaan kuolemaan johtavaa vaikeaa sairautta sairastavia potilaita elämän loppuvaiheessa. Suurin osa Terhokodin potilaista on syöpää sairastavia, mutta hoidamme myös esimerkiksi eteneviä neurologisia sairauksia sairastavia potilaita (mm. ALS).

Terhokodilla on erityisosaamista nuorten potilaiden ja lapsiperheiden tukemiseen, vaikeiden oireiden hoitoon ja läheisten tukeen. Terhokoti toimii HUS sairaanhoitopiirin vaativan erityistason saattohoidon tuottajana.

Sairaanhoitajien lisäksi moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä toimii palliatiiviseen lääketieteeseen erikoistuneita lääkäreitä ja joukko erityistyöntekijöitä. Lisäksi vapaaehtoiset antavat kiireetöntä aikaa potilaan ja läheisten tueksi.

Arvomme kuoleman ainutkertaisuus, potilaan ja läheisten kohtaaminen yksilöllisyys, turvallisuus ja inhimillisyys huomioiden, perhekeskeisyys ja kodinomaisuus ja vastuullisuus ja korkea ammattitaito

ovat niin strategiamme kuin työmme ja kohtaamistemme vahva perusta.

title: Prison In-Reach Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live is a charity committed to making a real difference in the lives of the people we support. Our core values – Be open, be compassionate, and be bold – guide everything we do. We believe in treating everyone as an individual, providing support with respect and care, and working together to create meaningful change.

We are looking for a Prision In-Reach Recovery Coordinator to join our team in Coventry. Your role will focus on identifying, engaging and supporting service users with drug and/or alcohol needs, delivering targeted interventions and robust release planning to reduce substance misuse, re-offending and associated harm. You will work closely with prisons, probation services, and community-based providers to ensure seamless transitions and timely access to appropriate support on release.

A fantastic oportunity has arisen to become a Prison In-Reach Coordinator on a permanent basis, engaging service users who are engaged in a cycle of reoffending. This role involves weekly travel to our feeder prison, HMP Hewell, therefore access to a car and valid clean driving licence is essential for this role.

Location: Coventry

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

*Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

About the role:

  • Act as a key liaison between prison in-reach teams and community drug/alcohol services to support continuity of care, shared case management, and coordinated risk reduction planning.
  • Carry out prison-based screenings, initial assessments, and risk assessments, developing recovery plans in partnership with service users prior to release.
  • Provide harm reduction education, overdose prevention, and relapse management planning with service users in custody and following release into the community.
  • Deliver and promote Naloxone provision pre- and post-release, and train service users and peers in its use where appropriate.
  • Offer “through-the-gate” support including gate pickups where appropriate and facilitate access to community recovery services, housing, and health appointments upon release.
  • Conduct home visits, hostel visits, and community outreach as needed to maintain engagement, particularly with high-risk individuals and those at risk of disengagement.
  • Work collaboratively with police, probation, mental health, housing, and social care partners to address the complex needs of high-risk service users and promote recovery and rehabilitation.

About you:

  • Empathy and Understanding: A strong grasp of substance misuse issues and experience working in similar fields.
  • Clear Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with proficiency in IT.
  • Self-Motivated and Organised: Ability to take initiative, manage time effectively, and prioritise tasks.
  • Knowledgeable and Resourceful: Good understanding of mental health interventions and services.
  • Team-Oriented: A supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills, comfortable collaborating with a range of professionals and stakeholders.
  • Adaptable: Ability to manage change effectively, always prioritising the needs of our service users.
  • Committed to Best Practices: Understanding of information governance processes and dedication to applying all necessary safeguards.
  • Continuous Learner: Enthusiastic about seeking out learning opportunities and contributing to the development of others.
  • Approved for Restricted Institutional Access: The successful candidate will need to complete an enhanced DBS check and obtain HMPPS security clearance

What We Offer:

  • Wellness: Enjoy a paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week, access to a ‘Wellness’ hub, and an Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Time Off: Generous annual leave entitlement (+ bank holidays), increasing yearly for the first five years.
  • Financial Benefits: A contributory pension scheme and discounts on shopping, cinema, holidays, and more.
  • Refer a Friend Scheme: receive a voucher when they successfully join our team!
  • Growth Opportunities: We support your training, career development, and progression.
  • Supportive Environment: Join a friendly team that values collaboration and support

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Direct applications only — we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

Agoda is very excited to launch a new B2C fintech product

As Senior Business Analyst – New verticals, you will play a key role in defining, launching and growing the product across different markets. You'll devise, own and execute initiatives to drive acquisition, transaction growth and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to incubate and grow a new business vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who can handle ambiguity well while remaining independent in developing fast-paced initiatives across this new and interesting product.

In this Role, You Will

  • Help on defining the Product Customer Value Proposition and Go To Market (GTM) Strategy
  • Design optimization strategy for the product across the full funnel – from user across key business metrices (i.e., acquisition, activation, transaction growth, top-ups loyalty and customer engagement)

  • Launch the different marketing channels (e.g., paid search, app campaigns, affiliates)
