title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform)

Physitrack PLC · Fully remote, based in Poland Contract: B2B contractor, EUR 8,000 per month

About us

Physitrack PLC builds digital health software used by clinicians, physiotherapists and employers in over 100 countries. Our two product lines, Physitrack (exercise prescription, telehealth and patient engagement) and Champion Health (workplace wellbeing), run on a multi-region AWS platform serving Europe, the UK, North America, Australia and the Middle East.

We are ISO 27001:2022 certified. Healthcare data brings real constraints: data residency, auditability and a low tolerance for downtime. That shapes how we build.

The role

You will own the platform our engineers ship on: the Kubernetes estate, the delivery pipelines and the cloud infrastructure under both product lines. It is a small, senior group with a wide surface area, so you will be making architectural calls rather than picking up tickets someone else has scoped.

A large part of the work is migration and consolidation. Bringing acquired products onto shared infrastructure, moving workloads between providers and regions, and retiring what we no longer need. If you enjoy taking a system someone else built and landing it cleanly on your own platform, this will suit you.

We are recruiting two senior infrastructure roles. This one covers the platform, the delivery pipelines and the migrations. The other, Senior DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability), covers the edge, observability and cloud security posture. Apply for whichever fits, and tell us if both do.

What you will do

  • Run and evolve our multi-region AWS and EKS platform, managed as code in Terraform and deployed through ArgoCD

  • Own CI/CD across our repositories, on CircleCI and GitHub Actions, and keep the path from commit to production fast and boring

  • Lead infrastructure migrations end to end: containerising applications, moving databases between providers and regions, and cutting over with verification and a rollback plan

  • Manage PostgreSQL and RDS at production scale, covering version upgrades, instance sizing and performance work

  • Keep our Ruby on Rails runtime current, including framework upgrades, performance tuning and autoscaling behaviour

  • Own cloud cost: rightsizing, autoscaling, savings plan utilisation and a monthly cost report to Finance

  • Run disaster recovery testing and incident readiness drills, and fix what they expose

  • Act as the infrastructure point of contact for engineering, security and commercial colleagues

What we are looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineering, with meaningful time on AWS

  • Production Kubernetes, ideally EKS, well beyond having deployed to a cluster

  • Strong Terraform and an infrastructure as code instinct

  • You have run a real database migration or provider cutover, and can explain how you verified it

  • Comfortable with Linux, containers and GitOps

  • Solid scripting in Python, Go, Bash or similar, and enough application literacy to debug across the stack

  • English at a working professional level. Our engineering team is international

Nice to have

  • Ruby on Rails familiarity. Our main application is Rails

  • Cost optimisation or FinOps experience at scale

  • A regulated industry background: ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR

  • Infrastructure consolidation following an acquisition

  • Polish. The immediate team is Warsaw based, though the company works in English

How we work

  • On-call. We run a 24/7 rotation through PagerDuty, with documented playbooks and readiness checklists. Participation is agreed with you rather than assumed, and separately compensated.

  • Cadence. Written async updates, a fortnightly planning touchpoint and a regular infrastructure and security sync. You set your own hours and choose your own tools.

  • Documentation. Runbooks, decision records and incident write ups are part of the work, not an afterthought.

  • Autonomy. Small team, wide scope, very little process between you and a decision.

title: Senior Professional, Account Management - Converse
description:
At Converse we believe that those independent enough not to follow will move the world forward. We’re a place to explore potential, break barriers and push the edges. A company inspired by what came before us but even more excited about what’s coming next — and somewhere YOU get to write the next chapter of a 100+ year old story. We look for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Our culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination, with each person bringing their authentic selves to a challenging and constantly evolving world to push things forward.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will report directly to the UK Sales Director and work closely with the UK team and key stakeholders across the business.

You will also collaborate with the broader Global Growth Team and engage with Global partners on selected topics to support your accounts.

The role is based in London, with occasional travel to meet our retail partners and attend seasonal Go-to-Market meetings in Boston and across Europe.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Do you have experience in account management, a passion for fashion retail across digital and physical formats, and an interest in youth culture? Then the great news is that we have the perfect role for you!

As a Senior Professional supporting our business, you will help strengthen relationships with key accounts, support cross-functional collaboration, and contribute to unlocking the full potential of the Converse brand. You will play an important role in driving operational excellence and supporting the strategic direction of the business.

Essential qualifications:

  • Passion for the Converse brand and culture
  • Extensive account management experience, ideally within the fashion, sports or retail industry, across commercial, buying and/or merchandising
  • Sales experience with a strong awareness of selling dynamics
  • Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of financial processes and forecasting
  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills
  • Ability to collaborate in a matrix-oriented environment across various business functions
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Process and operational capability

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will support the day‑to‑day management of our business as we continue to grow the Converse business in alignment with our integrated marketplace strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create: define relevant partner assortments, Go-to-Market plans, opportunities and forecasts to execute against the account plan and seasonal priorities
  • Ownership: own the execution of the seasonal sales and Go-to-Market processes and milestones, within budget and against set timelines
  • Partnership: establish and maintain internal and external relationships with key stakeholders to provide best-in-class customer service at all levels of the customer’s business
  • Develop yourself: build your commercial, analytical and partnership skills to grow your career at Converse
  • Collaborate: work closely with Marketplace Supply Chain, Business Planning, Go-to-Market, Merchandising, Retail Marketing, Finance and Commercial teams to support account needs
  • Plan, Implement, Review & Optimise: contribute to seasonal planning, performance reviews and continuous improvement to best connect with the Converse consumer
  • Support the future: help translate the Global Growth Strategy into actionable plans for your account
  • Team player: be an active member of the team, sharing insights and supporting collective goals

Applications will be accepted until 16th September 2026. We encourage external candidates to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

Please note that no relocation support is offered for this role.

title: Sosionomi tai geronomi, Esperi Koti Popliini

Meillä Forssassa Koti Popliinissa on haussa osaava ja työstään innostunut sosionomi tai geronomi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen - olisitko se sinä?

Meidän kotimme - Esperi Koti Popliini

Koti Popliinissa tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista mielenterveyskuntoutujille. Meillä on yhteensä 15 asiakaspaikkaa. Popliinissa toiminnan lähtökohtana on aktiivinen arki. Monipuolinen aktiviteettitoiminta ja mielekäs tekeminen ovat viikko-ohjelman kulmakiviä. Kuntoutustavoitteina ovat mm. elämänhallinnan lisääminen, toimintakyvyn ylläpitäminen ja arjessa selviytyminen.

Popliini sijaitsee Vanhan Kutomon upeassa tehdasmiljöössä saneeratuissa tiloissa, Forssan sydämessä. Meillä huomioidaan niin asukkaat kuin työntekijätkin yksilöllisesti, jotta jokainen saa omia kiinnostuksen kohteitaan vastaavaa tekemistä. Kurkkaa arkeemme Instagramissa: [@esperi_popliini](https://www.instagram.com/esperi_popliini/)

Työpäiväsi meillä

Meillä Koti Popliinissa sosionomi/geronomi tekee kuntouttavaa ohjaustyötä. Vastaat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa asukkaiden arjen sujumisesta, heidän sosiaaliasioiden sujuvasta hoidosta sekä heidän ohjaamisestaan ja tukemisestaan yksilöllisesti. Työ sisältää perushoidollista työtä, jossa pääpaino on asukkaiden avustamisessa päivittäisissä toiminnoissa heidän tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Työhön kuuluu myös lääkehoidon toteuttamista, joten sinulla tulisi olla suoritettuna lääkehoidon lisäkoulutus.

Lisäksi työhön kuuluu myös ryhmätoimintojen ja erilaisten aktiviteettien suunnittelua ja toteutusta yhdessä työyhteisön kanssa. Lisäksi teet viranomais- ja omaisyhteistyötä. Kaiken kaikkiaan työtä Popliinissa kuvaa yhdessä tekemisen meininki: työtä tehdään aidosti yhteistyössä ja kaikki osallistuvat yhteisiin hommiin nimikkeestä riippumatta!

Työsuhteen tiedot

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Työ on 2-vuorotyötä tai toiveesi mukaan 3-vuorotyötä. Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan.

Palkka

Palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Pohjapalkka on kokemuslisistä riippuen palkkaluokan G24D mukaisesti 2 811,09 € - 3 071,09 €/kk.

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen vastaavista tehtävistä. Pyydämme lisäksi rikosrekisterilain mukaisen rikosrekisteriotteen nähtäväksi.

Miksi sinun kannattaisi tulla juuri meille töihin?

- laadukas perehdytys ja koko tiimin tuki - me haluamme että sinä onnistut!

- mielenkiintoinen työympäristö ja mahdollisuus kehittää ammattitaitoasi mm. koulutusten kautta

- monipuoliset työsuhde-edut mm. Cityshopparin alennukset, ePassin virike-etu, työmatkaetu

- kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä

Lähetä hakemuksesi 22.9. mennessä ja kerro meille itsestäsi! Älä aikaile, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi hakuaikana ja sovimme aloituksesta heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy tehtävään.

Haluatko kuulla tehtävästä lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä yksikönpäällikkö Kaisa Järvinen (yhteydenotot ark. 9–15), puh. 050 325 0065 // kaisa.jarvinen@esperi.fi.

Tervetuloa osaksi meidän porukkaamme!


Esperi Koti Popliini

Esperi on suomalainen asumispalveluita tarjoava valtakunnallinen yritys. Työllistämme yli 7200 sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaista, ja Esperi-koteja löytyy yli 100 paikkakunnalta ympäri Suomen. Kodeissamme asuu ikäihmisiä, mielenterveyskuntoutujia sekä vammaispalvelun asiakkaita. Hoitotyötä teemme asukaslähtöisesti ja laadukkaasti. Korkea asukastyytyväisyys (50 NPS) on ylpeytemme aihe. Tule kokemaan itse, minkälaista meillä on olla töissä! Kaikki avoimet työtehtävämme löydät [täältä](https://esperi.fi/tyopaikat/avoimet-tyopaikat/).

title: Ground Gas Specialist
description:
As an Amazon Worldwide (WW) Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Ground Gas Specialist you will be responsible for all aspects of supporting one of the safest real estate programs in the world! You will partner with various stakeholders and teams around the world to support ground gas mitigation program development and ongoing facility management including standards and policy development, implementation, and execution.

To be successful in this role, you will possess exceptional organizational and communication skills and be able to send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will have extensive ground gas experience, mitigation system experience including risk assessment, design, construction, operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM), understand the regulatory environment, and demonstrate this expertise when working with internal and external teams.

This role will be based in the EU and travel up to 50% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
• Provide a single point of contact to internal teams to develop, understand, and execute Amazon’s ground gas program in Europe.
• Complete due diligence reviews of properties to assess ground gas risk.
• Complete reviews of mitigation system designs, construction plans, and construction verification, startup testing, and OMM data.
• Inspect and/or oversee field personnel inspecting systems during construction, startup, and operation to evaluate conditions and confirm design and operating assumptions
• Oversee and direct field personnel providing OMM including developing scopes of work, coordinating and scheduling OMM events, evaluating field reports, and acting-on and implementing follow-up actions.
• Support legal, property owner, construction management, preconstruction management, consulting, transaction management, business leadership, and facility operations teams and partners on ground gas risks and intrusion mitigation systems, and operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM).
• Support and train a wide range of facility operations teams and partners on mitigation systems, monitoring equipment, and OMM.
• Review work performed by contractors, developers, and consultants.
• Prioritize and lead multiple projects and assignments concurrently.
• Represent Amazon at appropriate levels with property owners and their representatives, consultants, and legal advisors to maintain professional and effective relationships.
• Travel throughout EU

title: Televarainhankkija
description:
Haaveiletko joustavasta osa-aikatyöstä, jossa voit vaikuttaa positiivisesti ympäröivään maailmaan? Lääkärit Ilman Rajoja -järjestön televarainhankkijana soitat tukijoillemme ja potentiaalisille lahjoittajille. Pääset työvuorojen aikan hankkimaan järjestölle kuukausilahjoittajia, pyytämään lisätukea toiminnallemme sekä lausumaan kiitoksen sanat tukijoillemme heidän elintärkeästä avustaan.

Televarainhankinnan merkitystä ei voi liioitella: jokainen uusi kuukausilahjoitus pelastaa ihmishenkiä!

Televarainhankkijana opit kohtaamaan ihmisiä ja luomaan aitoja yhteyksiä. Kohtaat työssäsi myös haasteita, mutta tiivis ja energinen työyhteisö on koko ajan tukenasi. Tarjoamme sinulle tehtävässä onnistumiseksi kattavan varainhankintakoulutuksen sekä asiantuntevien ja kannustavien esihenkilöiden tuen.

Mitä me tarjoamme:

  • Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 14,43€/h + 12% lomakorvaus (yht. 16,16/h), + 15% iltalisä klo 18 jälkeen. Tuntipalkka nousee 2% jokaisesta työvuodesta palveluksessamme!

  • Joustavuuden työajoissa ja -vuoroissa: Televarainhankkija voi varata 3-5 vuoroa viikossa. Työvuorot kestävät 5 tuntia ja joka arkipäivälle on varattavana päivävuoro klo 10-15 tai iltavuoro klo 15-20.

  • Siistin sisätyön: Työtä tehdään järjestön toimistolla Helsingin Vallilassa osana innostavaa ja lämminhenkistä toimistoyhteisöä.

  • Työsuhde-edut: Vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunta- ja kulttuurietu ePassin kautta.

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan koulutuksen työsuhteen aikana

  • Vakituisen työsuhteen

Televarainhankintasoveltuujoustavuutensavuoksiopintojenohellesekä pidempiaikaiseen työskentelyyn. Työ alkaa heti tai sopimuksen mukaan syyskuun aikana. Työn luonne edellyttää vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.

Etsimme sinua, jos:

  • Ruotsin ja suomen kielitaitosi on erinomainen (soittoja tehdään molemmilla kielillä)

  • Olet positiivinen, itsevarma ja tulostavoitteellinen

  • Olet motivoitunut työskentelemään televarainhankinnan ja myynnin parissa

  • Hallitset kommunikaatio- ja tiimityöskentelytaidot

  • Sitoudut Lääkärit Ilman Rajoja -järjestön arvoihin

title: UK Senior Strategy Consultant
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

  • Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

  • Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

  • Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

  • Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation


We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

What this role is responsible for

Senior Strategy Consultants are exemplars of Crimson Education’s philosophy who are dedicated to making a difference in students’ lives, helping bridge gaps between present and future goals by personalising blueprints that will become the basis of all academic, extracurricular and personal development.

Your task as a Senior Strategy Consultant is to work closely with students and their other Crimson tutors, mentors and consultants. Primary client-facing responsibilities include the following: driving progress through long-term roadmaps, offering a perspective into UK higher education, and mentoring through the candidacy building and application processes.

Regarding application work, Senior Strategy Consultants assist in the development of students’ narratives, including the thematic direction of application essays. Students will have additional direct support from Application Mentors who own the responsibilities of essay consultation (brainstorms, revisions) and interview preparation.

With each case that one oversees in this role, a Senior Strategy Consultant is entrusted with the highest level of autonomy and accountability. Senior Strategy Consultants are thus held to the highest standards of integrity; maintain utmost responsibility in managing students’ goals and plans; and contribute to the professional development of the self and of the team.


What success looks like

Client Service

  • Provide overarching admissions strategies to students by creating individualized roadmaps and constantly evaluating progress to achieve a student’s primary goals

  • Collaborate with the rest of the students’ Crimson team (Account Managers, Academic Tutors, Application Consultants, ECL Mentors) to execute on the student’s roadmap

  • Maintain expert knowledge of high school curricula, extracurricular and leadership choices, summer program applications, and standardized test planning to make recommendations regarding admissions strategies

  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of institutions of higher learning to guide students and parents towards attainable school goals, working with them to create lists of best fit schools of varied competition to maximize acceptance chances

  • Conduct formal consulting sessions with students on a regular basis, chronicling and sharing with relevant stakeholders notes and action items via the Crimson App platform

  • Maintain reasonable levels of communication with students and families outside of formal sessions through various channels (e.g., Crimson App Messenger, email, etc.)

Sales and Marketing

  • Facilitate or lead development and presentation of marketing materials for seminars or expositions in local markets

  • Collaborate with local Sales teams in Initial Consultations to facilitate potential client investment and understanding in Crimson’s products and services

Product and Resource Development

  • Produce and acquire buy-in from the Senior Strategy Consulting team on (1) internal resources and (2) client-facing materials to provide the highest standard of quality service worldwide and to engage earnestly in a culture of continuous professional development

How you’ll know you’re crushing it

  • Supporting a high number of students through the application process + Meeting with students at regular intervals as noted in standard operating procedures

  • Achieving the number of students as agreed between Crimson and yourself, that receive admissions, offers in reach, target and safety designations

  • High Student Satisfaction scores

What skills and experience you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree from a UK top university/college preferred; advanced degrees will be advantageous

  • At least three years of full-time experience or equivalent, with proven track record of success supporting students into top universities including Oxford and Cambridge

  • Passion for coaching young adults and appreciation of global perspectives + Superior planning and organizational skills; experience in project management, event coordination, product management a plus

  • Superior written and oral communication skills

  • Resilience when working independently under pressure

Experience in formal education, coaching, tutoring preferred

Why work for Crimson?

  • Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work

  • Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

  • $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!

  • Psychologist on staff

  • Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team

  • Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

  • We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Software Engineering - Summer 2027 Corporate Internship
description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.


DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

The Software Engineer Intern will be placed on a product team and contribute to the software design, software development, and overall product lifecycle for a product that our users love. The engineering process is highly collaborative. Interns will have the opportunity to pair on as they work through user stories and support products as they evolve. In addition, interns may be involved in product configuration, performance tuning and testing as well as production monitoring. As a Software Engineer Intern, you will be part of a team with more experienced engineers to help build and grow your skills while you create, support, and deploy production applications. Potential placements include product teams in eCommerce, Fulfillment, Infrastructure, Technology Management, and Data Engineering.

Day to Day Responsibilities:


• Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
• Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
• Writes custom code or scripts to do “destructive testing” to ensure adequate resiliency in production
• Configures commercial off the shelf solutions to align with evolving business needs
• Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
• Monitors tools and participates in conversations to encourage collaboration across product teams
• Reviews and discusses code from more senior engineers to understand best practices and design patterns
• Increases business acumen by learning about other parts of the business

Some of your experiences will include:


• Multi day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your classmates
• Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as develop their business acumen and office professionalism
• Extensive exposure to our senior leadership through our exclusive intern only Executive Speaker Series which includes a private meet & greet with our CTO & CEO
• Working with a diverse group of talent within DSG, and learning how collaboration across multiple technology domains looks like in a world class enterprise technology function.
• Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events
• Working a 40 hour work week, Monday – Friday

Skills we are looking for:


• Exposure to modern programming languages
• Experience with Agile Development and knowledge on Agile Deployment tools and versioning using Git or similar tools
• Experience in a Linux or Unix based environment
• A competitive spirit with a passion for results
• Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to independently make data-driven recommendations
• Dynamic written and verbal communication style, as well as ability to communicate cross functionally and vertically throughout the organization
• Ability to work in a fast paced and iterative environment
• Someone enthusiastic about helping athletes and passionate about technology
• Someone who cares about people and how work gets done
• Someone who is solution orientated, curious and willing to dig into a challenge and ask questions to drive towards a desired outcome


We look for potential candidates with:


• Graduation date between December 2027 through May 2028
• Enrolled in an accredited 4-year institution
• A major in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or Information Sciences and Technology or related experience
• There will be periods of time where you are asked to spend up to a week at our Corporate Office in Pittsburgh as part of the Summer Internship program.

The majority of the summer and full-time roles within our Technology Department are eligible for remote work. Any travel and housing accommodations will be covered.

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027
Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:


Interns qualified for full-time opportunities will be evaluated at the end of the program. Qualified interns will be placed as Software Engineers into a full-time technology development rotational program (Technology Development Program).

Perks:

  • Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*

  • Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG

  • Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.

  • Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th

  • Teammate Discount

  • Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office

  • Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks

  • Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders

  • Executive Speaker Series

  • Professional development

  • Volunteer opportunities

  • Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office.

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. I especially appreciated the collaborative environment and the opportunity to apply both creative and strategic thinking. This experience has strengthened my passion for the retail industry, and I would love the opportunity to come back and continue growing with the DSG team in the future." – Sarah Cyphers, Merchandising Intern

Interested to learn more? Watch our Internship Recap Video!

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree

  • Strong verbal communication skills to read and write reports, as well as communicate cross-functionally and vertically throughout the organization

  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment

  • Eagerness to learn and work as part of a multidisciplinary team

  • Ability to communicate thoughts and technical ideas in an accessible manner

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

title: Freelance Digital Imaging Artist
description:
About Luxehouze
Luxehouze is a fast-growing omnichannel luxury marketplace operating across Indonesia and Singapore, serving high-value customers in watches, fashion, and beauty. We operate in an environment where trust, speed and excellence matter, and where outcomes matter more than activity.

We are looking for a Freelance Digital Imaging Artist, who takes responsibility naturally, thinks in outcomes and wants to build, improve, and scale — not just “execute tasks.”

What Will Be Challenging
Please read this carefully - it’s here to help you self-select.

  • Expectations are high and visible

  • Problems may be ambiguous and fast-moving

  • Priorities can change as the business scales

  • Feedback is direct and frequent

  • Performance is measured by results, not intentions

  • If you require rigid structure, narrow scope, or close supervision to perform well, this environment may not be a good fit.

Responsibilities:

  • Photo Editing & Retouching: Edit and retouch photos of watches and fashion items from our in-house photographer, including color, lighting, shadows, background clean-up, and product detailing.

  • AI Image Generation: Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for campaigns, social media, website, and other creative needs.

  • AI-Assisted Editing: Enhance or modify existing visuals using AI while maintaining realistic lighting, perspective, and product accuracy.

  • Quality & Brand Consistency: Ensure all visuals meet brand standards and accurately represent product colors, shapes, logos, materials, and details.

  • Creative Collaboration: Work closely with production team, designers, and the Creative team to execute briefs and visual concepts.

  • Asset Management: Prepare, resize, organize, and export final assets according to required formats and deadlines.

Requirement & Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom with strong photo retouching and image manipulation skills.

  • Familiar with AI image generation and editing tools such as Midjourney, Dreamina, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, or similar.

  • Strong understanding of color, lighting, composition, perspective, and realistic image manipulation.

  • Strong attention to detail, especially in maintaining product and brand accuracy.

  • Able to translate creative briefs and references into polished visual outputs.

  • Organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple projects within deadlines.

  • Portfolio of photo editing, retouching, compositing, and/or AI-generated work is preferred.

title: Biologian ja maantiedon lehtori, Sipoonlahden koulu
description:
Oletko innostunut ja yhteistyökykyinen opetus- ja kasvatustyön ammattilainen?

Sipoonlahden koulu on moderni yhtenäiskoulu, jossa opiskelee noin 620 oppilasta vuosiluokilla 1-9. Koulussamme järjestetään myös esiopetusta sekä siihen liittyvää täydentävää varhaiskasvatusta. Koulumme sijaitsee Sipoon Söderkullassa kauniilla ja luonnonläheisellä paikalla, josta on hyvät julkiset liikenneyhteydet mm. Helsinkiin ja Porvooseen ja Sipoo kuuluu HSL-alueeseen. Toimimme tiloissa yhdessä noin 160 oppilaan Söderkulla skolan kanssa.

Haemme nyt kouluumme

BIOLOGIAN JA MAANTIEDON LEHTORIA ajalle 23.9.26-12.2.27, opetustunnit 19h/vko.
Sipoonlahden koulu toimii nykyaikaisissa, joustavissa oppimisympäristöissä. Koulussamme on 9 oppikylää, joissa eri ikäluokat opiskelevat eri oppiaineita sulassa sovussa.

Oppilaat työskentelevät myös digitaalisissa oppimisympäristöissä, joten tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää TVT-osaamista. Modernit oppimisympäristömme tukevat yhteisopettajuuden pedagogiikkaa ja toivomme sinultakin joustavuutta ja kokemusta toiminnallisista opetusmenetelmistä.

Tarjoamme innostavan ja luovan työympäristön, jossa pääset kehittämään ja kehittymään. Työyhteisömme vahvuutena on hyvä yhteishenki, ammatillisuus ja kannustava ilmapiiri.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/98) mukaan. Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät OVTES:n mukaisesti ja virassa noudatetaan koeaikaa.
Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Pyydämme jättämään hakemukset 22.9.2026 klo 16 mennessä ohessa olevan linkin kautta tai osoitteessa www.sipoo.fi/rekry.
Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

title: Timvikarier till Stångby dagliga verksamhet sökes
description:
Om Unika Nimbus Stångby dagliga verksamhet

Stångby kyrkby ligger ute på gård där vi har ledorden djur, natur, odling och trädgård. Djuren träffar man i hagarna runt gården och kanin finns att sköta i stallet. Naturen finns runt omkring eller så åker man iväg på utflykt. Trädgården ska skötas och odlar gör vi mest i odlingslådor. På DV i Stångby kyrkby jobbar 18 deltagare.

Stångby ligger ute på landet utanför lund i en liten by som heter Stångby kyrkby. Man behöver körkort och egen bil för att ta sig hit.

Om rollen

Vi arbetar med tydliggörande pedagogik för att göra dagen förståelig och ge förutsägbarhet. Vi stöttar deltagaren i allt den behöver hjälp med och försöker inspirera till en aktiv arbetsdag. Vi sköter städning, hjälper till med hygien och lagar eller värmer mat och fixar fika.

Kvalifikationer

  • Erfarenhet eller utbildning inom pedagogik eller vården.

  • Erfarenhet av arbete med människor.

  • Körkort är ett krav.

Meriterande om du därtill har

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom LSS

    Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsvillkor

Anställningsform: Timvikarie
Arbetstid: måndag- fredag dagtid
Tillträde: enligt överenskommelse, men vänta in med din ansökan då rekryteringen sker löpande.
Kollektivavtal: Vi är kollektivavtalsbundna till Vårdföretagarna/Kommunal, Bransch E.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?

Attendo är en trygg arbetsgivare som kan erbjuda dig som vill goda möjligheter att ta mer ansvar eller att gå vidare till nya roller. Vi erbjuder dig som medarbetare utbildningsmöjligheter, kollektivavtal, friskvård samt flera andra förmåner och personalrabatter via vår förmånsportal AttendoPlus, i samarbete med Benifex.

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Före eventuell anställning ska utdrag ur belastningsregistret tillsammans med giltig fotolegitimation visas upp. Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd. Sista ansökningsdag 31 augusti men urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Om Attendo/Unika

Unika är en del av Attendo, som är ett av Nordens största omsorgsföretag och startades 1985. Vi är verksamma inom LSS. Våra värderingar omtanke, engagemang och kompetens vägleder oss dagligen i vårt arbete för att alla ska uppleva trivsel, delaktighet, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Tillsammans för en meningsfull vardag!

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:

Lina Jönsson: lina.jonsson@unika.se

Job Description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Technology Audit Associate is a structured 24-month rotational program designed to provide recent graduates with broad exposure to technology auditing, risk management, and regulatory compliance across TD's technology environment.

As a Technology Audit Associate, you will develop core audit, risk, and technology skills while working alongside experienced auditors and business partners. Responsibilities may include:

  • Developing a foundational understanding of technology risks, internal controls, and audit methodologies.
  • Participating in a variety of assurance activities, including audits, continuous monitoring, issue validation, regulatory initiatives, and risk assessments.
  • Assessing the design and effectiveness of controls across technology domains such as cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI), data management, infrastructure, application development, application controls, and technology operations.
  • Executing audit testing, analyzing data, documenting observations, and communicating results with guidance from audit leadership.
  • Preparing high-quality audit workpapers, process documentation, narratives, and risk/control assessments.
  • Leveraging data analytics and audit tools to support risk assessments and audit execution.
  • Developing an understanding of application controls, system implementations, software development practices, and technology governance processes to support audit assessments.
  • Collaborating with audit teams and business stakeholders across Canada and the U.S.
  • Building knowledge of the banking industry, regulatory expectations, and TD's risk management framework.
  • Demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and professional development.
  • Responsibilities may vary depending on the assigned audit coverage area.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • Must have graduated between May 2026 and May 2027 with an Undergraduate degree in Business Technology Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Candidates with relevant internship, co-op, or project experience are encouraged to apply.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrates foundational knowledge of technology concepts, including cybersecurity, application development, software development lifecycle (SDLC), data management, information systems, networks, or technology operations.
  • Exhibits strong critical thinking, analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills.
  • Demonstrates curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn in a dynamic environment.
  • Communicates effectively through clear and concise verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Works collaboratively and builds effective relationships across teams.
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Shows initiative, accountability, and sound professional judgment.
  • Seeks feedback and actively pursues personal and professional development.
  • Familiarity with AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, automation, application development, or emerging technologies is considered an asset.
  • Progress toward or interest in pursuing professional certifications such as CIA, CISA, CISSP, or related designations is considered an asset

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Application Deadline: Sep 25th 2026
  • Anticipated Start Date: July 5th, 2027 (pending academic completion)
  • Applications must include a transcript, cover letter (one letter-sized page or less) and a resume (maximum of 2 pages).
  • We welcome all applications; however, we will only contact qualified candidates chosen for an interview. Thank you for your interest.
  • TD requires employees to reside in the country where the role is located, irrespective of remote working arrangements
  • TD is committed to providing you with the best candidate experience in these unique circumstances. As such, work location and start dates are subject to change

HOURS

We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and communities in which we live and serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, Naantali, ANNU sosiaalipalvelut
description:
Tule töihin ANNU sosiaalipalveluille!

Etsimme henkilökohtaisia avustajia asiakkaallemme Naantaliin.

Etsimällämme työntekijällä on joustava ja innokas ote työhön. Kokemus henkilökohtaisen avustajan tehtävistä tai muista sosiaali- tai terveysalan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole pakollinen, tärkeintä on oikeanlainen asenne ja kohtaamisen taidot. Työ sopii erinomaisesti myös opiskelijalle. Vaatimuksena työhön on erinomainen suomen kielen taito. Mikäli koet muiden auttamisen sydämen asiaksi, olet sosiaalinen, luotettava ja oma-aloitteinen, niin saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Etsimme asiakkuuteen avointa, kannustavaa ja ystävällistä ja oma-aloitteista henkilöä. Työtehtäviin kuuluu arjen avustamista; vapaa-ajan harrastustoiminnan avustamista pääsääntöisesti keskiviikkoiltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Edellytämme, että voit sitoutua keskiviikkojen ja ennalta sovittuihin viikonloppuvuoroihin. Viikonlopun aikataulut sovitaan erikseen aina asiakkaan kanssa. Etsimme työntekijää säännöllisesti toteutuvaan työhön asiakkaalla, työ ei ole keikkatyötä. Toivomme työntekijän sitoutuvan asiakkuuteen pitkäaikaisesti. Työn määrä 25-30h /kk. Kokemus erityisryhmien parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi työhön.

Tarjoamme joustavan, merkityksellisen palkkatyön:

  • ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla sinulla on työntekoasi tukeva, kannustava esihenkilö.

  • Maksamme palkan valintasi mukaan joko kerran tai kahdesti kuukaudessa.

  • Tarjoamme perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien alkamista.

  • Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimusta ja maksamme työstä työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (G16A).

Tervetuloa mukaamme luomaan Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa!

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä 2023 perustettu, sote-alan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme palveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille ympäri Suomen. Voimme käyttää etäyhteyttä osana rekrytointiprosessiamme.

To help us achieve this, we’re seeking a driven EHS Officer. With your Bias for Action, we’ll need you to step in and help drive health and safety across our fulfillment center in Riyadh

- Lead site risk assessment for current and new activities.
- Establish site WHS training matrix.
- Lead implementation of site specific WHS standards and guidelines.
- Lead implementation of site WHS objective and programs.
- Promote safe culture among employees by providing daily WHS content to shift briefing.
- Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes at the site.
- Work with Operations team to implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury.
- Attending to incidents and occupational injuries cases on site.
- Guide and assist area managers on incident investigations, Gensuite write up and communication of lesson learned.
- Assisting Ops team in Gensuite follow up sheet and CAPA creation.
- Audit record-keeping practices and ensure Gensuite entries to be aligned with global WHS standards and local regulations.
- Ensure the PPE inventory at site and coordinate with procurement for order placement.
- Key Safety Requirement (KSR) Audit weekly assignment, monitoring and support.
- Ensure basic Fire Fighting training and first aid training completion. requirements.
- Daily Powered Industrial Tool and Trailer Dock Release inspection and communications.
- Daily Action Tracking System monitoring and support.
- Participate in site management safety walk, provide insight into unsafe acts and conditions to management.
- Provide daily update to Country WHS Manager on objectives progress, incidents, KSR, ATS, network actions, etc).
- Preparation of WHS committee meeting agenda, MOM write up, ATS creation.
- Daily Permit to Work review and sign off.
- Lead on WHS related procurement and follow up.
- Preparing emergency response plans.
- Managing and conducting emergency drills.
- Managing preparation and training of emergency drills, prepare records.
- Heat Index establishment, monitoring and support.
- Provide support to site specific requests, unplanned events and activities.
- Conduct daily and weekly WHS audits, such as hazard waste room inspection, spill kit inspection, first aid room, etc.

title: Forsikringsrådgiver - Taxiforsikring
description:
Vil du jobbe i et team der salg og service går hånd i hånd?

Hos Taxiforsikring tror vi at de beste kundeopplevelsene skapes når vi kjenner kunden gjennom hele reisen – fra første kontakt til fornyelse og videre.

Vi jobber derfor ikke i siloer. Som forsikringsrådgiver blir du en del av et team der alle bidrar både innen salg og kundeoppfølging, samtidig som rollen kan ha en hovedvekt mot enten salg eller service. For oss er det viktig at du forstår hele kundereisen og kan bidra der behovet er størst.

I praksis betyr det at du én dag kan jobbe med nye tilbud og salg, og den neste med oppfølging av eksisterende kunder. Uansett hva du jobber med, er målet det samme: å forstå kundens behov, finne gode løsninger og levere en kundeopplevelse fra A til Å.

Hva vil du jobbe med?

  • Rådgivning og salg av forsikringsløsninger til kunder i taxibransjen

  • Besvare kundehenvendelser på telefon og e-post

  • Innhente og analysere kundeinformasjon for å utarbeide gode og skreddersydde tilbud

  • Følge opp tilbud, drive salgsprosessen fremover og lukke avtaler

  • Identifisere muligheter for kryss- og mersalg når det skaper verdi for kunden

  • Bygge langsiktige relasjoner og skape tillit hos en lojal og direkte kundegruppe

  • Holde oversikt over pågående saker og sikre rask og god oppfølging

  • Bruke CRM og digitale systemer aktivt i kundearbeidet

  • Håndtere administrative oppgaver som fakturering, listearbeid og oppfølging av utestående

  • Bidra til å videreutvikle kundeopplevelsen og arbeidsprosessene våre

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har minimum ett års erfaring fra forsikringsbransjen, og trives med å kombinere salg og service. Du liker å ta ansvar for kunden og ser verdien av å forstå både behovet og hele prosessen rundt.

Vi tror du vil passe godt hos oss hvis du:

  • Er glad i å snakke med mennesker og skaper trygghet gjennom god kommunikasjon

  • Har kommersiell teft og motiveres av å finne løsninger som treffer kundens behov

  • Er strukturert og komfortabel med å håndtere flere oppgaver og systemer samtidig

  • Tar ansvar, jobber selvstendig og følger opp det du lover

  • Er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og bidrar med energi og godt humør

  • Kommuniserer godt, både skriftlig og muntlig, på norsk

  • Er komfortabel med CRM og digitale arbeidsverktøy

Kjennskap til taxibransjen eller transportsektoren er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Hva kan vi tilby?

  • En variert rolle med reelt ansvar og påvirkning fra dag én

  • Et kompetent og inkluderende team med flat struktur og kort vei til beslutninger

  • Tett kontakt med en unik og lojal kundegruppe

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter i et selskap i vekst

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Moderne fasiliteter på Hamar eller i Oslo

Om Taxiforsikring og Fair Insurance

Taxiforsikring er Norges markedsledende forsikringstilbyder for taxibransjen, med rundt 33 % markedsandel av forsikrede taxier i Norge. Vi drives av Fair Insurance AS, som er en del av ABAX Group – et av Europas ledende telematikkselskaper med over 300 ansatte.

Hos oss tror vi at data gir bedre forsikring. Vi forstår hvordan kjøretøy faktisk brukes – ikke bare hva som står på skiltet – og bruker denne innsikten til å prise risiko mer rettferdig, belønne gode sjåfører og hjelpe kundene våre med å ta bedre valg.

Kundene våre er lojale, direkte og setter pris på mennesker som gjør det de sier. Det er også en viktig del av kulturen hos oss.

Likestilling og mangfold

Fair Insurance AS ønsker å skape et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der alle får muligheten til å lykkes. Vi oppfordrer kandidater med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring til å søke.

Bakgrunnssjekk

Som en del av ansettelsesprosessen gjennomfører vi digital referansesjekk via RefApp. For enkelte stillinger kan det også være krav om bakgrunnssjekk i henhold til relevant bransjestandard.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Pohjois-Tapiolan päiväkoti
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään Pohjois-Tapiolan päiväkotiin. Päiväkodissamme on kahdeksan eri ryhmää 1-6-vuotiaille lapsille. Ryhmistä kaksi on esiopetusryhmiä. Esiopetusryhmät tekevät yhteistyötä Pohjois-Tapiolan koulun kanssa.

Meillä toimii 14 varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa, kaksi vaka-sosionomia, 8 lastenhoitajaa, LVEO, apulaisjohtaja sekä kolme kiertävää varahenkilöä. Lähimmiksi työkavereiksesi saat toisen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan ja -lastenhoitajan. Ryhmässäsi on 21 lasta, jotka ovat 3-4-vuotiaita.

Rakennuksemme on valmistunut 2018 ja sijaitsee metsän reunassa pientaloalueella. Tilamme ovat valoisat ja hyvin toimivat. Ryhmät on sijoitettu kahden ryhmän kotialuekokonaisuuksiksi omine eteisineen. Kulkuyhteydet ovat hyvät metron ja bussiliikenteen ansiosta. Myös Kehä 1. kulkeva bussi sekä raidejokeri tulee kävelymatkan päähän.

Olemme avoin, positiivinen ja toimelias päiväkoti. Iloinen ilmapiiri, kiireettömyys ja syli ovat arvojamme. Henkilökuntaamme yhdistää vahva ammattitaito ja ymmärrys varhaiskasvatustyön merkityksellisyydestä. Päiväkodissamme näkyvät vahvasti sensitiivisyys, pedagoginen kehittäminen ja yhteistyö niin keskenämme kuin vanhempienkin kanssa. Uteliaisuus ja kehittäminen ovat tärkeässä roolissa. Meillä saa kehittää ja jakaa osaamistaan. Projektit, draama, liikunta ja yhteiset tapahtumat rikastuttavat arkea.

Toimintakulttuuriamme on kiitelty; selkeät rakenteet ja ennakoiva koko talon toiminnan suunnittelu mahdollistavat opettajien oman työn hyvän suunnittelun.

Sijaisten suusta:
"Positiivinen, lasta kannustava toiminta ja kasvattajien sensitiivisyys sekä hyvät oppimisympäristöt ovat Pohjiksen valttikortteja".

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Pohjois-Tapiolan päiväkoti, Piilopolku 6, 02150 Espoo
Työaika: 38 h 15 min/viikko
Tehtävä on määräaikainen ajalle 14.9.2026- 8.9.2027.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Teemme valinnan heti kelpoisen, tehtävään soveltuvan henkilön löydyttyä. Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus.

Vähintään kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto, johon sisältyy varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan koulutus, tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (varhaiskasvatus) tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005).

Haussa huomioidaan myös juuri valmistuvat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajat.


Edellytämme suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.
Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.
Tartuntatautilaki velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Arvostamme kykyä kohdata lapset ja heidän vanhempansa yksilöllisesti, arvostavasti ja sensitiivisesti. Arvostamme myös hyviä tiimityötaitoja ja intoa kehittää päiväkotimme toimintaa jatkuvasti.

Tervetuloa joukkoomme kasvattamaan vastuullista ja välittävää uutta sukupolvea!


Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

Toimintamme perustuu avoimuuteen ja luottamukseen, ja kohtaamme toisemme arvostavasti. Olemme sitoutuneet yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseen ja toivomme työyhteisöömme eri-ikäisiä, eri taustoista ja eri kieliä puhuvia osaajia.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä tehtävän lisätietojen antajaan.

Erityistarpeisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit ottaa yhteyttä: keha.rekrytointi@espoo.fi. Käsittelemme yhteydenotot luottamuksellisesti.

Lue lisää: https://www.esitteemme.fi/espoonrekry/MailView/

title: Water Hygiene Technician
description:
Location: Liverpool area - Mobile position

Contract: Permanent and Full-Time, 40 hpw Monday to Friday (no evenings, no weekends, no on-call)

Basic salary up to £30k + sign on bonus + 10% bonus + overtime (£35-37k+ OTE)

A New Chapter: Join a Growing Leader

It is an incredibly exciting time to join PTSG Water Treatment. As a rapidly expanding leader in the water safety and treatment industry, we are setting new standards for excellence across the UK. With a portfolio spanning over 25,000 sites nationwide and a team of dedicated specialists operating across every sector, our growth is driven by a commitment to delivering faster, more innovative, and deeper solutions for our clients. We are not just expanding our footprint; we are evolving our capabilities and investing in the experts who make it happen. If you are looking to be part of a forward-thinking, industry-leading team where your contribution truly matters, we want you to be part of our journey.

What you'll be doing:

As a key part of our team, you'll travel to customer sites, ensuring water systems are safe and compliant across the region. Your day will involve essential tasks like inspecting and cleaning water storage vessels (including leading on tank chlorinations), installing and servicing Thermostatic Mixing Valves, and conducting routine monitoring tasks in line with HSG 274 Part 2. This means you'll be flushing water outlets, monitoring temperatures, descaling showerheads, flushing pressure vessels, and performing crucial sampling for closed water systems.

You'll also expertly use our SimPRO system to manage your workload. Your ability to spot problems and proactively find solutions, combined with your detailed knowledge of HSE’s ACoP L8 and HSG274, will be vital in maintaining our professional and compliant reputation.

You'll need a full, clean UK driving licence and have City & Guilds Legionella Awareness Training, equivalent or suitable industry experience to succeed in this role.

What we offer:

We believe in supporting our people! You'll receive a competitive salary that reflects your expertise, a company vehicle to get you to customer sites, and a full technology package to support your work.

This is a field-based, permanent and full-time (40 hours per week) opportunity.

We're committed to your growth, offering full training in company processes and fantastic opportunities to upskill and develop your career. You'll also benefit from a comprehensive group benefits package.

  • Competitive salary + company car with fuel card

  • Overtime rate 1.5-2x

  • 10% bonus when working certain sites

  • Earn £500 per successful employee referral

  • Paid travel time after 30 minutes

  • Life assurance (3x salary)

  • Online GP access + prescriptions

  • Vivup discount platform (gym, tech, holidays, retail & more)

  • Salary sacrifice pension

Please note that a successful candidate must undergo an enhanced DBS check and CTC clearance.

Apply today and let's make a difference together!

About PTSG

PTSG Group is a leading provider of specialist services across the UK and Europe.

Through the acquisition of high-quality specialist businesses, PTSG has built a group of industry-leading companies delivering services across Access & Safety, Electrical Services, Building Access, Fire Solutions, and Water Treatment.

With over 3,300 specialists supporting 90,000+ customers across 200,000 buildings, delivering over 170 different services, we are committed to delivering safe, compliant, and high-quality services nationwide.

At PTSG, our aim is simple. To be a great place to work and a great company to do business with.

Armed Forces Covenant

title: International Payment Specialist
description:
Banking hasn't changed much in decades. We're changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers, and product people work on problems that actually matter. Making money simpler, smarter, and more rewarding for a million of registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we're just getting started.

As our new International Payments Specialist you’ll join the Operations team based in Copenhagen, reporting to Sophia, working to ensure our customers can send and receive money across borders — seamlessly and reliably.

What will you do?

• Monitor and analyse international payment flows to identify issues and act on them before they impact customers.

• Handle international payment cases end-to-end — investigating, documenting, and resolving with care and precision.

• Collaborate with teams across Lunar to share insights and strengthen our international payments capabilities.

• Stay close to emerging developments in cross-border payments, compliance requirements, and correspondent banking, applying what you learn in your day-to-day work.

• Balance operational excellence with a great customer experience, making sure efficiency never comes at the cost of usability.

What are we looking for in you?

• Some experience with international payments, cross-border transactions, or a related field — whether through work, studies, or a strong interest in the space.

• An analytical mindset with an eye for patterns and anomalies.

• Clear and structured communication skills — you can explain complex situations simply, both in writing and in conversation.

• Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and no two cases are the same.

• Fluency in Danish and English (both spoken and written).

Benefits and perks

  • 4 days in the office. We're a team that builds together, thinks together, and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work.

  • State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse, and keyboard. We want you to do your best work without anything slowing you down.

  • Pension, health insurance, and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments. We've got you covered.


Are you ready to join the journey? Apply now and let's find out more!

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we’re up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it’s like to work here .

title: Treatment Coordinator
description:
Als Sales Associate ben jij het gezicht van onze kliniek en verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol afsluiten van onze persoonlijke verkoop. Je missie is om individuele klanten te begeleiden van hun eerste consultatie tot het moment dat ze inschrijven voor hun nieuwe glimlach.

Je verkoopt niet alleen onzichtbare beugels; je begeleidt klanten bij hun aankoopbeslissing,speelt ter plaatse in de kliniek in op bezwaren en zet bezoekers om in actieve, zelfverzekerde patiënten.

Over Impress

Wij geloven dat iedereen een glimlach verdient waar ze van houden. Wij zijn IMPRESS, de grootste keten van digitale orthodontiepraktijken in Europa. We brengen een revolutie teweeg in de sector van onzichtbare beugels en toveren een glimlach op het gezicht van onze patiënten. Onze unieke combinatie van medische expertise en digitalisering heeft ons erkenning opgeleverd als een van de snelst groeiende HealthTech-bedrijven volgens Forbes. Opgericht in Barcelona in 2019, zijn we inmiddels uitgebreid naar 10 landen met meer dan 110 locaties, waar we toonaangevende zorg en de modernste technologie bieden.

🚀 Wat wij bieden

  • Salaris: Aantrekkelijk pakket met een vast salaris + onbeperkte commissies.

  • Bonusplan: Neem deel aan het incentiveplan van de medische teams om mee te delen in ons succes.

  • Werkomgeving: Moderne, prachtig ontworpen klinieken met hoogwaardige apparatuur.

  • Cultuur: Energiek internationaal team. We houden van hands-on samenwerking, een constante drang naar verbetering en het vieren van onze successen.

  • Voordelen: Speciale kortingen en voordelen op behandelingen, aligners en producten.

  • Groei: Uitgebreide training voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Loopbaanontwikkeling: Dynamische en snelle omgeving met indrukwekkende doorgroeimogelijkheden.

  • Reisondersteuning: Wij bieden een reisregeling en onkostenvergoeding voor noodzakelijke bezoeken aan andere kliniek locaties.

🎯 Jouw impact

  • Verkoopresultaten: Behaal KPI's en conversiedoelstellingen als de leidende verkoper en beheer de volledige verkoopcyclus, van presentatie tot getekend contract.

  • Patiënt ambassadeur: Treed op als merkambassadeur om relaties op te bouwen en adviseer patiënten over hun behandel verwachtingen en tijdslijnen.

  • Pipeline Management: Stimuleer groei door leads op te volgen en actief sales funnel te onderhouden.

  • Kliniek Ondersteuning: Ondersteun bij patiëntenadministratie, het maken van 3D-scans en het coördineren van de planning voor een soepele workflow.

  • Financiële verantwoordelijkheid: Leg financieringsopties uit aan klanten en beheer het betalingsproces.

  • Operationele coördinatie: Zorgen voor een goede interne service door samen te werken met de kliniek en het hoofdkantoor om problemen van patiënten op te lossen.

  • Professionele uitmuntendheid: Houd je aan de kledingvoorschriften van het merk, sta open voor feedback en reis tussen klinieken wanneer dat nodig is.

🛠 Vereisten

  • Sales Expertise: Minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in resultaatgerichte salesfuncties.

  • Sector Ervaring: Ervaring in B2C-sectoren (Business-to-Consumer) zoals automotive, tandheelkunde, verzekeringen of high-end retail wordt zeer gewaardeerd.

  • Consultative Selling: Zelfverzekerd in het presenteren van producten en het oplossen van twijfels bij de klant.

  • Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C1+) is verplicht, plus Engels op conversatie niveau.

  • Werkvergunning: Een geldig recht om in Nederland te werken is vereist voor deze functie.

Klaar om de sector met ons te transformeren? Solliciteer nu en laten we samen lachen!

Bij Impress koesteren we een cultuur van inclusie en diversiteit. We moedigen alle kandidaten aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht ras, kleur, religie, genderidentiteit, seksuele geaardheid, leeftijd, nationale afkomst of handicap. 🌈💪

title: Lukitus- ja turvajärjestelmäasentaja
description:

Meillä CERTEGOssa pääset työskentelemään itsenäisesti asiakasrajapinnassa vaativissa ja mielenkiintoisissa lukitus-, turvajärjestelmä- ja oviautomaatioprojekteissa. Saat tueksesi osaavan tiimin tuen, joka varmistaa kehittymisesi lukitus- ja turvajärjestelmien ammattilaisena. Tiimin tuen lisäksi koulutamme aktiivisesti niin yksilö- kuin tiimitasollakin.

Meillä työpäivät ajoittuvat lähtökohtaisesti arkisin 8–16 välille, joten tasapaino työn ja vapaa-ajan välillä on työntekijöillämme taattu. Päivät koostuvat erilaisista asiakaskohteissa tehtävistä lukitus- ja/tai turvajärjestelmäprojektitehtävistä tai huollon tehtävistä, joista voit tarkemmin lukea Jonnan kertomana täältä. Kun työtä pystyy tekemään itsenäisesti, avautuu myös mahdollisuus reissutöihin muihin yksikköihimme niin Suomessa kuin ulkomaillakin.

Saatat olla etsimämme uusi certegolainen, mikäli sinulta löytyy:

aiempaa työkokemusta lukitus- ja/tai turvajärjestelmien (kamera-, hälytys- ja kulunvalvontajärjestelmät) ja/tai oviautomaation asennustehtävistä

asiakaslähtöisyyttä ja palveluhenkisyyttä

kykyä dokumentoida ja raportoida työtehtäviähyvää kirjallista ja suullista suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksesi

Haemme tehtävään oma-aloitteista ja vastuullisesti toimivaa ammattilaista.

Tehtävä edellyttää nuhteetonta, rikosrekisteritöntä taustaa viranomaisen myöntämää turvasuojaajakorttia varten. Tehtävä edellyttää lisäksi B-ajokorttia sekä matkustusvalmiutta.

CERTEGOn arvot kiteytyvät niin sisäisesti kuin ulkoisestikin kolmeen meille erityisen tärkeään osa-alueeseen:

  • Minä olen vastuullinen

  • Olemme innokkaita parantamaan

  • Yhdessä teemme asioista helppoa

Lue lisää arvoistamme sekä CERTEGOsta työnantajana nettisivuiltamme!

CERTEGO tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan Pohjoismaiden johtavan lukitus- ja turvallisuusratkaisuja tarjoavan yrityksen kasvutarinaan, ja kehittää omaa ammattiosaamistasi yhdessä alan kokeneiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Panostamme laadukkaaseen perehdyttämiseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kouluttamiseen. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittää omaa urapolkuasi sekä laajentaa monipuolisesti työnkuvaasi ja asiantuntijuuttasi niin Suomessa kuin muissakin CERTEGO-maissa. Saat käyttöösi ePassin monipuoliset liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut sekä laajennetun työterveyshuollon.

Rekrytointiprosessimme etenee seuraavanlaisesti:

- ensimmäisessä vaiheessa kaikki hakemukset käydään läpi
- rekrytoiva esihenkilö valitsee sopivimmat hakijat haastattelukierrokselle, ja kukin hakija kontaktoidaan henkilökohtaisesti, vaikka hakija ei etenisikään tällä kertaa haastattelukierrokselle
- valintaprosessi pyritään viemään maaliin mahdollisimman pian sopivan hakijan löydyttyä

Meille on helppo hakea myös ilman CVtä, ja pääset täydentämään profiiliasi myös myöhemmin, mikäli sinulla ei hakuhetkellä ole mahdollisuutta tehdä hakemusta loppuun. Pääset lähettämään vapaamuotoisen hakemuksesi klikkaamalla ”lähetä hakemus”. Ilmoitus on auki siihen asti, että sopiva uusi certegolainen on löytynyt. Kaikki meille saapuneet hakemukset käydään ajatuksella läpi. Hae mukaan!

title: Industrielektriker
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Vill du arbeta i ett av Europas mest moderna gjuterier som satsar på framtiden? Vill du dessutom bli en del av ett kompetent team av elektriker och mekaniker? Då kan tjänsten som Industrielektriker vara något för dig!

Underhållsavdelningen är en central funktion för teknisk service och support av produktionsutrustningar i våra verkstäder där positiv anda och ett högt engagemang präglar teamet.

Vi erbjuder en modern anläggning med hög teknisk nivå med stort fokus på maskintillgänglighete För att säkerställa detta investerar vi kontinuerligt i den senaste maskintekniken. Vi vidareutbildar personalen regelbundet inom ett flertal områden såsom inom exempelvis teknik, PLC programmering, säkerhet mm.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?

Industrielektriker är ett brett yrke med stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Du kommer att ingå i en grupp med erfarna medarbetare där ni tillsammans utvecklar arbetssätt, kompetens och utrustning. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och innefattar såväl akut felsökning som delaktighet i projekt och förebyggande underhåll.

Din profil

Vi ser att du har en stark förmåga att lösa olika sorters problem. Vidare har du även en god samarbets- och initiativförmåga och har lika lätt för att arbeta i grupp som självständigt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med personer såväl internt som med externa leverantörer.

Som person känner du igen dig i företagets värderingar vilka är respekt, ansvar, integritet och kreativitet.

Vidare söker vi dig som har:

· En avslutad gymnasieutbilding inom el/automation.

· Goda kunskap i svenska och engelska, tal och skrift.

Meriterande är även om du har erfarenhet av installation, underhåll och kontroll samt felsökning av industriella elektriska installationer.

Villkor

Tjänsten avser heltid och tillsvidareanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Arbetstiderna är främst 2-skift samt natt men även andra tider förekommer.

Kontakt

Välkommen med din ansökan. Urvalet av ansökningar sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via vår hemsida.

Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Madelene Merkel, madelene.merkel@xylem.com

Representant för IF Metall är Sofie Malmborg, 0471-24 70 00.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.
